domains.name: student
domains.description: Single source of truth for all student identity, demographics, academic standing, enrollment status, degree progress, academic history, and FERPA-protected records. Manages the student lifecycle from prospect through alumnus, supporting GPA calculations, SAP status, IPEDS reporting, Title IV compliance, and SIS integration with Ellucian Banner.
domains.references: FERPA, IPEDS, Title IV, Ellucian Banner SIS

products.name: profile
products.description: Authoritative master record for every individual who has ever interacted with the institution as a student — from prospect through alumnus. Stores legal name, preferred name, date of birth, gender identity, pronouns, citizenship, national origin, race/ethnicity (IPEDS categories), primary language, disability status (ADA), veteran status, Social Security Number (encrypted), institutional ID (Banner PIDM), contact information, emergency contacts, FERPA consent flags, directory information opt-out, and record-source system. This is the single source of truth (SSOT) for student identity across all downstream domains.

attributes.name: profile_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the student profile record. Primary key for the student profile entity.

attributes.name: academic_standing
attributes.description: Current academic standing status of the student based on GPA and SAP (Satisfactory Academic Progress) evaluation. Determines eligibility for continued enrollment, financial aid, and academic support interventions.
attributes.references: Institutional Academic Policy, Title IV SAP Standards

attributes.name: citizenship_status
attributes.description: Student's citizenship or immigration status. Critical for Title IV financial aid eligibility, visa compliance (SEVIS reporting), and state residency determination. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: us_citizen|permanent_resident|refugee|asylee|temporary_visa|undocumented|other — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Title IV Federal Student Aid, SEVIS (Student and Exchange Visitor Information System)

attributes.name: country_of_citizenship
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code representing the student's country of citizenship. Used for international student tracking, SEVIS reporting, and IPEDS reporting.

attributes.name: date_of_birth
attributes.description: Student's date of birth. Used for age verification, eligibility determination, IPEDS reporting, and identity verification. Protected under FERPA.
attributes.references: FERPA 34 CFR Part 99, IPEDS Data Collection

attributes.name: disability_status
attributes.description: Indicates whether the student has disclosed a disability and is registered with disability services for ADA accommodations. Used for accessibility planning and compliance reporting.
attributes.references: ADA (Americans with Disabilities Act), Section 504 Rehabilitation Act

attributes.name: email_address
attributes.description: Student's primary institutional or personal email address for official communications, course notifications, and account recovery. Protected under FERPA as directory information unless opt-out is elected.

attributes.name: emergency_contact_name
attributes.description: Full name of the student's primary emergency contact person. Used for critical notifications in case of medical emergency, safety incident, or urgent situation.
attributes.references: Campus Safety Policy, FERPA 34 CFR Part 99

attributes.name: emergency_contact_phone
attributes.description: Primary phone number for the student's emergency contact. Used for urgent notifications.
attributes.references: Campus Safety Policy, FERPA 34 CFR Part 99

attributes.name: emergency_contact_relationship
attributes.description: Relationship of the emergency contact to the student (e.g., parent, spouse, sibling, guardian, friend).

attributes.name: enrollment_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the student's relationship with the institution. Determines access to systems, services, and reporting inclusion. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: active|inactive|withdrawn|graduated|dismissed|leave_of_absence|deceased — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner SIS - Student Status Codes

attributes.name: ethnicity_hispanic_latino
attributes.description: Indicates whether the student identifies as Hispanic or Latino ethnicity per IPEDS two-part race/ethnicity reporting standard. Used for federal reporting, diversity analytics, and compliance.
attributes.references: IPEDS Race/Ethnicity Reporting Standards, U.S. Department of Education

attributes.name: ferpa_consent_third_party
attributes.description: Indicates whether the student has provided written consent for the institution to share education records with specified third parties (e.g., parents, sponsors, employers). Consent must be documented separately.

attributes.name: ferpa_directory_opt_out
attributes.description: Indicates whether the student has elected to opt out of directory information disclosure under FERPA. When true, the institution may not release directory information (name, email, phone, enrollment status, degrees, honors) without explicit consent.

attributes.name: first_time_in_any_college
attributes.description: Indicates whether the student is a first-time-in-any-college student (FTIAC) with no prior postsecondary enrollment. Critical for IPEDS cohort tracking, retention reporting, and graduation rate calculations.
attributes.references: IPEDS Enrollment and Graduation Rate Surveys

attributes.name: gender_identity
attributes.description: Student's self-identified gender identity. Used for inclusive campus services, housing assignments, and optional demographic reporting. Distinct from legal sex assigned at birth.
attributes.references: Campus Inclusive Practices Policy, Title IX

attributes.name: institutional_number
attributes.description: Institution-assigned unique identifier for the student, typically the Banner PIDM (Person Identification Master) or equivalent SIS identifier. This is the operational student ID used across all campus systems.

attributes.name: legal_first_name
attributes.description: Student's legal first name as it appears on official government-issued identification documents. Used for official transcripts, diplomas, and Title IV reporting.

attributes.name: legal_last_name
attributes.description: Student's legal last name (surname/family name) as it appears on official government-issued identification documents. Used for official transcripts, diplomas, and Title IV reporting.

attributes.name: legal_middle_name
attributes.description: Student's legal middle name or initial as it appears on official government-issued identification documents. Nullable if no middle name exists.

attributes.name: mailing_address_line1
attributes.description: First line of the student's current mailing address (street number and name, apartment/unit number). Used for official correspondence, billing statements, and emergency contact.

attributes.name: mailing_address_line2
attributes.description: Second line of the student's current mailing address (additional address details, building name, etc.). Nullable if not needed.

attributes.name: mailing_city
attributes.description: City of the student's current mailing address.

attributes.name: mailing_country
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code of the student's current mailing address.

attributes.name: mailing_postal_code
attributes.description: Postal code or ZIP code of the student's current mailing address.

attributes.name: mailing_state_province
attributes.description: State, province, or region of the student's current mailing address. Use standard postal abbreviations (e.g., CA, NY, ON).

attributes.name: phone_number
attributes.description: Student's primary contact phone number (mobile or landline). Used for emergency notifications, enrollment communications, and administrative contact. Protected under FERPA as directory information unless opt-out is elected.

attributes.name: preferred_first_name
attributes.description: Student's preferred first name for daily use in classroom rosters, email communications, and non-official documents. May differ from legal name to respect gender identity or cultural preferences.

attributes.name: preferred_last_name
attributes.description: Student's preferred last name for daily use in classroom rosters, email communications, and non-official documents. May differ from legal name.

attributes.name: primary_language
attributes.description: ISO 639-2 three-letter language code representing the student's primary or native language. Used for ESL program placement, accessibility services, and communication preferences.

attributes.name: pronouns
attributes.description: Student's preferred pronouns for use in communications and classroom settings (e.g., she/her, he/him, they/them, ze/zir). Supports inclusive campus environment.

attributes.name: race_american_indian_alaska_native
attributes.business_glossary_term: Race: American Indian or Alaska Native
attributes.description: Indicates whether the student identifies as American Indian or Alaska Native per IPEDS race categories. Students may select multiple race categories.
attributes.references: IPEDS Race/Ethnicity Reporting Standards, U.S. Department of Education

attributes.name: race_asian
attributes.description: Indicates whether the student identifies as Asian per IPEDS race categories. Students may select multiple race categories.
attributes.references: IPEDS Race/Ethnicity Reporting Standards, U.S. Department of Education

attributes.name: race_black_african_american
attributes.description: Indicates whether the student identifies as Black or African American per IPEDS race categories. Students may select multiple race categories.
attributes.references: IPEDS Race/Ethnicity Reporting Standards, U.S. Department of Education

attributes.name: race_native_hawaiian_pacific_islander
attributes.business_glossary_term: Race: Native Hawaiian or Other Pacific Islander
attributes.description: Indicates whether the student identifies as Native Hawaiian or Other Pacific Islander per IPEDS race categories. Students may select multiple race categories.
attributes.references: IPEDS Race/Ethnicity Reporting Standards, U.S. Department of Education

attributes.name: race_white
attributes.description: Indicates whether the student identifies as White per IPEDS race categories. Students may select multiple race categories.
attributes.references: IPEDS Race/Ethnicity Reporting Standards, U.S. Department of Education

attributes.name: record_created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this profile record was first created in the data warehouse. Used for audit trail and data lineage.

attributes.name: record_source_system
attributes.description: Name of the source system from which this profile record originated (e.g., Ellucian Banner, Slate CRM, manual entry). Used for data lineage and reconciliation.

attributes.name: record_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this profile record was last updated in the data warehouse. Used for audit trail and change tracking.

attributes.name: ssn
attributes.description: U.S. Social Security Number for the student. Must be encrypted at rest. Required for Title IV financial aid processing and IPEDS reporting. Nullable for international students.
attributes.references: FERPA 34 CFR Part 99, Title IV Federal Student Aid

attributes.name: veteran_status
attributes.description: Indicates whether the student is a U.S. military veteran. Used for veteran services, GI Bill benefits administration, and federal reporting.

attributes.name: visa_type
attributes.description: Type of visa held by international students (e.g., F-1, J-1, M-1). Required for SEVIS compliance and international student services. Nullable for domestic students.
attributes.references: SEVIS (Student and Exchange Visitor Information System)

products.name: academic_standing
products.description: Tracks a students current and historical academic standing and Satisfactory Academic Progress (SAP) evaluation per term. Captures institutional standing (good standing, probation, suspension, dismissal, deans list, honor roll), GPA components (cumulative, term, transfer), credit hours (attempted, earned, in progress), SAP evaluation results (GPA threshold, pace/completion rate, maximum timeframe), overall SAP status (satisfactory, warning, probation, suspension), Title IV financial aid impact, SAP appeal status and decision, academic plan attachment, policy version applied, and evaluating authority. One record per student per term evaluation cycle. Supports both institutional academic standing decisions and federal Title IV SAP compliance.

attributes.name: academic_standing_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the academic standing evaluation record. Primary key for this entity.

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the staff member, office, or automated system that performed or certified the academic standing evaluation. Used for audit trail and accountability.

attributes.name: policy_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the academic improvement plan assigned to the student, if applicable. Links to the academic plan document or record detailing required actions, milestones, and support services.

attributes.name: primary_academic_term_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the academic term for which this standing evaluation was performed. Links to the term reference table.

attributes.name: profile_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier of the student being evaluated for academic standing. Links to the student master record in the Student Information System (SIS).

attributes.name: academic_plan_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether the student is required to follow an academic plan as a condition of continued enrollment or financial aid eligibility. Typically required for students on probation or whose appeal was conditionally approved.

attributes.name: appeal_decision
attributes.description: The outcome of the student's SAP appeal. Approved appeals may reinstate Title IV eligibility with or without an academic plan. Denied appeals result in loss of federal financial aid eligibility.

attributes.name: appeal_decision_date
attributes.business_glossary_term: Satisfactory Academic Progress (SAP) Appeal Decision Date
attributes.description: The date on which the SAP appeal committee rendered a decision on the student's appeal.

attributes.name: appeal_submitted
attributes.business_glossary_term: Satisfactory Academic Progress (SAP) Appeal Submitted Indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether the student submitted a formal appeal for SAP suspension or probation status. Appeals typically cite extenuating circumstances such as medical issues, family emergencies, or other documented hardships.

attributes.name: completion_rate
attributes.description: The percentage of attempted credit hours that the student has successfully completed (earned credits / attempted credits * 100). Federal SAP requires a minimum 67% completion rate (pace) for Title IV eligibility.
attributes.references: 34 CFR 668.34 - Title IV SAP Pace Requirement

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this academic standing evaluation record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage.

attributes.name: credits_in_progress
attributes.description: Number of credit hours the student is currently enrolled in for the upcoming or current term. Used for enrollment status verification.

attributes.name: cumulative_credits_attempted
attributes.description: Total number of credit hours the student has attempted across all terms at the institution, including courses in progress, completed, withdrawn, and failed. Used in SAP pace calculation.

attributes.name: cumulative_credits_earned
attributes.description: Total number of credit hours the student has successfully completed with a passing grade across all terms at the institution. Used in SAP pace calculation and degree progress tracking.

attributes.name: cumulative_gpa
attributes.description: The student's cumulative grade point average across all terms at the institution, calculated on a 4.0 scale. Includes all graded coursework attempted at the institution, excluding transfer credits.

attributes.name: evaluation_date
attributes.description: The date on which the academic standing evaluation was performed. Typically occurs at the end of each term after final grades are posted.

attributes.name: evaluation_notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes or comments recorded by the evaluator regarding special circumstances, policy exceptions, or additional context for the standing determination. Confidential institutional record.

attributes.name: gpa_threshold_met
attributes.business_glossary_term: Grade Point Average (GPA) Threshold Met Indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether the student met the minimum cumulative GPA threshold required for satisfactory academic progress. Threshold varies by academic level and institutional policy.

attributes.name: institutional_standing
attributes.description: The official academic standing status assigned by the institution based on cumulative and term GPA performance. Determines eligibility for continued enrollment, honors recognition, and academic intervention programs.

attributes.name: ipeds_reportable
attributes.business_glossary_term: Integrated Postsecondary Education Data System (IPEDS) Reportable Indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether this academic standing record should be included in IPEDS reporting cohorts for retention, graduation rate, and academic progress metrics.

attributes.name: maximum_timeframe_exceeded
attributes.description: Indicates whether the student has exceeded the maximum timeframe allowed to complete their degree program. Federal SAP requires completion within 150% of the published program length.
attributes.references: 34 CFR 668.34 - Title IV SAP Maximum Timeframe

attributes.name: notification_date
attributes.description: The date on which the student was notified of their academic standing evaluation results. Important for compliance with institutional notification requirements and appeal deadlines.

attributes.name: notification_sent
attributes.description: Indicates whether the student was officially notified of their academic standing status and any associated actions required (probation, suspension, appeal rights, etc.).

attributes.name: pace_threshold_met
attributes.description: Indicates whether the student met the minimum completion rate (pace) threshold required for satisfactory academic progress. Federal requirement is 67% for Title IV eligibility.
attributes.references: 34 CFR 668.34 - Title IV SAP Pace Requirement

attributes.name: policy_version
attributes.description: The version identifier of the academic standing and SAP policy that was applied during this evaluation. Ensures historical evaluations can be audited against the policy in effect at the time.

attributes.name: sap_status
attributes.description: Federal Title IV financial aid eligibility status based on Satisfactory Academic Progress evaluation. Determines whether the student meets federal requirements for GPA, pace of completion, and maximum timeframe to continue receiving federal financial aid.

attributes.name: term_credits_attempted
attributes.description: Number of credit hours the student attempted during the evaluation term, including completed, withdrawn, and failed courses.

attributes.name: term_credits_earned
attributes.description: Number of credit hours the student successfully completed with a passing grade during the evaluation term.

attributes.name: term_gpa
attributes.description: The student's grade point average for the specific evaluation term, calculated on a 4.0 scale. Used to assess term-level academic performance.

attributes.name: title_iv_eligible
attributes.business_glossary_term: Title IV Financial Aid Eligible Indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether the student is eligible to receive federal Title IV financial aid based on the SAP evaluation results. False if SAP status is suspension or if appeal was denied.

attributes.name: transfer_gpa
attributes.description: The grade point average from transfer coursework accepted by the institution, if applicable. May be used in combined GPA calculations depending on institutional policy.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this academic standing evaluation record was last modified. Used for audit trail and change tracking.

products.name: degree_progress
products.description: Captures a student's progress toward completion of a declared degree program at a point in time. Includes declared major(s), declared minor(s), concentration, catalog year, total credits required, credits completed, credits in progress, credits waived, credits transferred, percentage to completion, anticipated graduation term, graduation application status, and degree audit run timestamp. Supports what-if scenario tracking for program changes. Links to the curriculum domain for degree requirements.

attributes.name: degree_progress_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the degree progress record. Primary key. Inferred role: MASTER_AGREEMENT (degree progress represents a student's binding relationship with a declared academic program at a point in time).

attributes.name: academic_program_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the declared academic program (degree, major, concentration). Links to the curriculum domain for degree requirements.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner Student Information System - Academic Program

attributes.name: accreditation_review_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.accreditation_review. Business justification: Program-level degree audits support accreditation evidence. Accreditors require demonstration of degree requirement enforcement and student progress monitoring. Essential for accreditation self-study

attributes.name: profile_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the student whose degree progress is being tracked. Links to the student master record.

attributes.name: anticipated_graduation_term
attributes.description: The academic term in which the student is expected to complete all degree requirements and graduate (e.g., Spring 2025).
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner Student Information System - Graduation Planning

attributes.name: audit_notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes or comments from the degree audit system regarding exceptions, substitutions, or special conditions affecting degree progress.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner Student Information System - Degree Audit

attributes.name: catalog_year
attributes.description: The academic catalog year under which the student is pursuing the degree (e.g., 2023-2024). Determines the set of degree requirements applicable to the student.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner Student Information System - Catalog

attributes.name: cip_code
attributes.description: The six-digit CIP code that classifies the instructional program according to the National Center for Education Statistics taxonomy (e.g., 11.0701 for Computer Science).

attributes.name: completion_percentage
attributes.description: Percentage of degree requirements completed, calculated as (credits completed + transferred + waived) / total credits required * 100.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner Student Information System - Degree Audit

attributes.name: concentration_code
attributes.description: The institutional code for the student's declared concentration or specialization within the major, if applicable.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner Student Information System - Academic Program

attributes.name: concentration_name
attributes.description: The full name of the student's declared concentration or specialization (e.g., Data Science, Finance), if applicable.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner Student Information System - Academic Program

attributes.name: credits_completed
attributes.description: Total number of credit hours the student has successfully completed toward the degree program, including passed courses with grades of D or better (or institution-specific passing threshold).
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner Student Information System - Academic History

attributes.name: credits_in_progress
attributes.description: Total number of credit hours the student is currently enrolled in for the current term that count toward degree requirements.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner Student Information System - Registration

attributes.name: credits_remaining
attributes.description: Total number of credit hours still required to complete the degree program, calculated as total required minus completed, transferred, and waived credits.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner Student Information System - Degree Audit

attributes.name: credits_transferred
attributes.description: Total number of credit hours accepted from other institutions or prior learning assessments that count toward the degree program.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner Student Information System - Transfer Credit

attributes.name: credits_waived
attributes.description: Total number of credit hours waived due to exemptions, advanced placement, or other institutional policies.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner Student Information System - Degree Audit

attributes.name: declaration_date
attributes.description: The date on which the student officially declared this major or program.

attributes.name: degree_audit_run_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when the most recent degree audit was executed to calculate progress toward degree completion.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner Student Information System - Degree Audit

attributes.name: degree_level
attributes.description: The level of the degree program the student is pursuing (e.g., Bachelor's, Master's, Doctoral).

attributes.name: degree_type
attributes.description: The type of degree being pursued (e.g., BA, BS, MA, MS, PhD, MBA).
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner Student Information System - Academic Program

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: The date from which this degree progress record is effective. Supports point-in-time tracking of program changes.

attributes.name: elective_credits_completed
attributes.description: Total number of elective credit hours the student has successfully completed.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner Student Information System - Degree Audit

attributes.name: elective_credits_required
attributes.description: Total number of elective credit hours required for the degree program.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner Student Information System - Degree Requirements

attributes.name: end_date
attributes.description: The date on which this degree progress record is no longer effective (e.g., when the student changes programs or graduates). Null for current active records.

attributes.name: general_education_credits_completed
attributes.description: Total number of general education or core curriculum credit hours the student has successfully completed.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner Student Information System - Degree Audit

attributes.name: general_education_credits_required
attributes.description: Total number of general education or core curriculum credit hours required for the degree program.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner Student Information System - Degree Requirements

attributes.name: graduation_application_date
attributes.description: The date on which the student submitted their application for graduation.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner Student Information System - Graduation Application

attributes.name: graduation_application_status
attributes.description: Current status of the student's application for graduation. Indicates whether the student has applied, been approved, denied, or had the degree conferred.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner Student Information System - Graduation Application

attributes.name: major_code
attributes.description: The institutional code for the student's declared major within the academic program.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner Student Information System - Academic Program

attributes.name: major_credits_completed
attributes.description: Total number of credit hours the student has successfully completed in the major field of study.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner Student Information System - Degree Audit

attributes.name: major_credits_required
attributes.description: Total number of credit hours required in the major field of study.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner Student Information System - Degree Requirements

attributes.name: major_name
attributes.description: The full name of the student's declared major (e.g., Computer Science, Biology, Business Administration).
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner Student Information System - Academic Program

attributes.name: minimum_gpa_required
attributes.description: The minimum cumulative or program GPA required for degree conferral under the applicable catalog year.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner Student Information System - Degree Requirements

attributes.name: minor_code
attributes.description: The institutional code for the student's declared minor, if applicable.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner Student Information System - Academic Program

attributes.name: minor_name
attributes.description: The full name of the student's declared minor (e.g., Mathematics, Psychology), if applicable.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner Student Information System - Academic Program

attributes.name: program_gpa
attributes.description: The student's cumulative GPA calculated only for courses that count toward the declared program requirements.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner Student Information System - Academic History

attributes.name: progress_status
attributes.description: Current status of the student's progress toward degree completion. Indicates whether the student is on track, at risk, behind schedule, has completed the degree, withdrawn, or is suspended.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner Student Information System - Academic Standing

attributes.name: residency_credits_completed
attributes.description: Total number of credit hours the student has completed at the institution that count toward residency requirements.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner Student Information System - Degree Audit

attributes.name: residency_credits_required
attributes.description: Minimum number of credit hours that must be completed at the institution (not transferred) to satisfy residency requirements for the degree.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner Student Information System - Degree Requirements

attributes.name: sap_status
attributes.description: The student's current SAP status for Title IV financial aid eligibility. Indicates whether the student is meeting, on warning, suspended, or on probation for academic progress standards.
attributes.references: Title IV Federal Student Aid - SAP Requirements

attributes.name: scenario_description
attributes.description: Description of the what-if scenario being evaluated (e.g., 'Change major to Economics', 'Add minor in Statistics'). Null for actual declared programs.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner Student Information System - Degree Audit What-If

attributes.name: total_credits_required
attributes.description: Total number of credit hours required to complete the degree program under the applicable catalog year.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner Student Information System - Degree Requirements

attributes.name: what_if_scenario_flag
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this degree progress record represents a hypothetical what-if scenario for program change analysis (True) or the student's actual declared program (False).
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner Student Information System - Degree Audit What-If

products.name: enrollment_status
products.description: Authoritative record of a student's enrollment status for each academic term. Captures full-time/part-time classification, FTE value, enrollment level (undergraduate, graduate, doctoral, professional, non-degree), primary campus, instructional method (on-campus, online, hybrid), enrollment date, last date of attendance, withdrawal date, withdrawal reason code, re-enrollment eligibility, and IPEDS enrollment category. One record per student per term. This is the SSOT for enrollment headcount and FTE reporting.
products.reference: Ellucian Banner SFRSTCR / IPEDS Fall Enrollment Survey

attributes.name: enrollment_status_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the enrollment status record. Primary key for this entity. One record per student per term.

attributes.name: campus_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to facility.campus. Business justification: Primary campus enrollment drives IPEDS reporting, tuition residency determination, student services allocation, and facilities capacity planning. Normalizes 'primary_campus_code' text field to structu

attributes.name: profile_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the student. Links to the student master record in the Student Information System (SIS).

attributes.name: academic_standing
attributes.description: Students academic standing status at the beginning of this term. Determines enrollment eligibility and academic intervention requirements.

attributes.name: athlete_indicator
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the student is a varsity athlete participating in NCAA-sanctioned sports. Used for NCAA compliance and academic support services.

attributes.name: census_date
attributes.description: Official census date for this enrollment term. Enrollment status as of this date is used for official headcount reporting and financial aid freeze.

attributes.name: cohort_year
attributes.description: Four-digit year identifying the students entry cohort for retention and graduation rate tracking. Used for IPEDS Graduation Rate Survey and institutional analytics.

attributes.name: credit_hours_attempted
attributes.description: Total number of credit hours the student attempted during this term, including courses dropped after census date. Used for SAP calculations.

attributes.name: credit_hours_enrolled
attributes.description: Total number of credit hours for which the student is enrolled in this term. Basis for FTE calculation and tuition billing.

attributes.name: degree_seeking_indicator
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the student is enrolled in a degree or certificate program. Determines IPEDS reporting inclusion and Title IV eligibility.

attributes.name: enrollment_date
attributes.description: Date the student officially enrolled in courses for this term. Typically the date of first registration or add transaction.

attributes.name: enrollment_intensity
attributes.description: Classification of student enrollment intensity based on credit hour load. Used for Title IV financial aid eligibility, SAP monitoring, and IPEDS reporting.
attributes.references: Title IV Federal Student Aid Regulations 34 CFR 668

attributes.name: enrollment_level
attributes.description: Academic level at which the student is enrolled for this term. Determines program requirements, tuition rates, and IPEDS reporting category.

attributes.name: enrollment_status
attributes.description: Current enrollment status of the student for this term. Reflects the students active standing in the academic term lifecycle.

attributes.name: enrollment_verification_date
attributes.description: Date the enrollment status was last verified by the Registrars Office. Used for National Student Clearinghouse reporting and loan deferment verification.

attributes.name: expected_graduation_term
attributes.description: Six-digit term code indicating the students expected graduation term based on program requirements and current progress. Used for degree audit and commencement planning.

attributes.name: ferpa_directory_hold_indicator
attributes.business_glossary_term: FERPA (Family Educational Rights and Privacy Act) Directory Hold Indicator
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the student has requested suppression of directory information under FERPA. When true, no directory information may be released without written consent.

attributes.name: financial_aid_recipient_indicator
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the student received any financial aid (federal, state, institutional, or private) for this term.

attributes.name: fte_value
attributes.description: Numeric FTE value representing the students enrollment intensity as a fraction of full-time status. Used for institutional capacity planning and state funding formulas. Range: 0.0000 to 1.0000.

attributes.name: ftiac_indicator
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this is the students first enrollment in any postsecondary institution. Critical for cohort tracking and graduation rate calculations.

attributes.name: honors_program_indicator
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the student is enrolled in an institutional honors program for this term.

attributes.name: housing_status
attributes.description: Indicates whether the student is living in institutional housing, off-campus, or commuting. Used for housing capacity planning and student life programming.

attributes.name: instructional_method
attributes.description: Primary mode of instructional delivery for the students enrolled courses in this term. Determines Title IV eligibility and state authorization requirements.

attributes.name: ipeds_enrollment_category
attributes.business_glossary_term: IPEDS (Integrated Postsecondary Education Data System) Enrollment Category
attributes.description: IPEDS-defined enrollment category for federal reporting. Classifies students by entry status and enrollment history for standardized national reporting.

attributes.name: last_date_of_attendance
attributes.description: Last documented date the student attended class or participated in an academically-related activity. Required for Title IV Return of Funds calculations when a student withdraws.
attributes.references: Title IV Return of Funds Regulations 34 CFR 668.22

attributes.name: primary_college_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the primary academic college or school in which the student is enrolled. Used for college-level enrollment reporting and resource allocation.

attributes.name: primary_major_code
attributes.description: Institutional code for the students primary declared major or program of study for this term. Maps to CIP code for federal reporting.

attributes.name: re_enrollment_eligibility
attributes.description: Indicates whether the student is eligible to re-enroll in a future term based on academic standing, conduct status, and financial obligations.

attributes.name: record_created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this enrollment status record was first created in the Student Information System. Used for audit trail and data lineage tracking.

attributes.name: record_updated_by
attributes.description: User ID or system identifier of the person or process that last updated this enrollment status record. Used for audit trail and accountability.

attributes.name: record_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this enrollment status record was last modified. Used for change tracking and data synchronization with downstream systems.

attributes.name: residency_status
attributes.description: Students residency classification for tuition and fee assessment purposes. Determines in-state vs out-of-state tuition rates.

attributes.name: sap_status
attributes.description: Students SAP status for Title IV financial aid eligibility. Evaluated based on GPA, completion rate, and maximum timeframe standards.

attributes.name: term_code
attributes.description: Six-digit code identifying the academic term (e.g., 202401 for Spring 2024). Format: YYYYTT where YYYY is year and TT is term sequence.

attributes.name: veteran_status_indicator
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the student is a military veteran or active duty service member. Used for veteran services and GI Bill administration.

attributes.name: withdrawal_date
attributes.description: Date the student officially withdrew from all courses in this term. Triggers Title IV Return of Funds calculation and impacts academic standing.
attributes.references: Title IV Return of Funds Regulations 34 CFR 668.22

attributes.name: withdrawal_reason_code
attributes.description: Institutional code indicating the reason for student withdrawal. Used for retention analysis and intervention program design.

products.name: academic_history
products.description: Immutable official transcript record of all courses a student has completed, including course subject, course number, course title, credit hours, grade earned, grade points, repeat indicator, grade replacement flag, transfer credit indicator, source institution (for transfer credits), term taken, section identifier, instructor of record, and grading mode (standard, pass/fail, audit). Supports GPA recalculation, FERPA-protected transcript generation, and IPEDS Completions Survey reporting.

attributes.name: academic_history_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for each academic history record. Primary key for the academic history product.

attributes.name: compliance_accreditation_standard_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.accreditation_standard. Business justification: Course-level outcomes and grade distributions are accreditation evidence. Accreditation standards require evidence of learning outcomes assessment at course level. Essential for accreditation standard

attributes.name: course_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the course taken. Links to the course catalog master record.

attributes.name: course_section_id
attributes.description: Identifier for the specific section of the course in which the student was enrolled.

attributes.name: instructor_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the instructor of record who taught this section. Links to the faculty master record.
attributes.references: CUPA-HR (College and University Professional Association for Human Resources)

attributes.name: it_asset_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to technology.it_asset. Business justification: Tracks which lab computer, assistive device, or proctoring workstation was used for course delivery. Essential for IT asset utilization reporting, maintenance scheduling tied to academic calendar, and

attributes.name: profile_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the student to whom this academic history record belongs. Links to the student master record.
attributes.references: FERPA (Family Educational Rights and Privacy Act)

attributes.name: research_irb_protocol_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to research.irb_protocol. Business justification: Students in research methods courses, clinical practicums, or psychology labs often participate as subjects or researchers under specific IRB protocols; required for human subjects compliance tracking

attributes.name: research_principal_investigator_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to research.principal_investigator. Business justification: Faculty who teach courses are often PIs; linking course instructor to PI record enables analysis of research productivity by teaching load, required for faculty workload planning and tenure review pro

attributes.name: term_id
attributes.description: Identifier for the academic term in which the course was taken (e.g., Fall 2023, Spring 2024).

attributes.name: academic_level
attributes.description: The academic level at which the course was taken (e.g., undergraduate, graduate, professional, doctoral).

attributes.name: academic_standing_impact
attributes.description: Indicates the impact of this course result on the student's academic standing (e.g., positive contribution, neutral, negative impact, triggered probation or dismissal).

attributes.name: completion_status
attributes.description: The completion status of the course indicating whether the student successfully completed the course requirements.

attributes.name: course_delivery_mode
attributes.description: The instructional delivery method for the course (e.g., in-person, online, hybrid, blended, synchronous, asynchronous).

attributes.name: course_level
attributes.description: The numeric level of the course indicating its difficulty or year level (e.g., 100-level for freshman, 200-level for sophomore, 500-level for graduate).

attributes.name: course_reference_number
attributes.description: The unique course reference number (CRN) assigned to the section for registration purposes. Commonly used in Ellucian Banner systems.

attributes.name: course_title
attributes.description: The official title of the course as it appears on the transcript (e.g., Introduction to Psychology, Calculus I).
attributes.references: FERPA (Family Educational Rights and Privacy Act)

attributes.name: credit_hours_attempted
attributes.description: The number of credit hours the student attempted for this course. Used in GPA (Grade Point Average) and SAP (Satisfactory Academic Progress) calculations.

attributes.name: credit_hours_earned
attributes.description: The number of credit hours the student successfully earned for this course. May differ from attempted hours if the course was failed or withdrawn.

attributes.name: degree_applicable_flag
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this course counts toward the student's degree requirements for their declared program.

attributes.name: financial_aid_eligible_flag
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this course is eligible for financial aid consideration under Title IV regulations.
attributes.references: Title IV Federal Student Aid Regulations

attributes.name: general_education_flag
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this course fulfills a general education or core curriculum requirement.

attributes.name: gpa_included_flag
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this course is included in the student's GPA calculation. Some courses (e.g., pass/fail, audit, transfer credits) may be excluded.

attributes.name: grade_change_date
attributes.description: The date on which the grade was last changed, if applicable. Used for audit trail and compliance purposes.
attributes.references: FERPA (Family Educational Rights and Privacy Act)

attributes.name: grade_change_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether the grade for this course has been changed after initial posting. Used for audit trail purposes.
attributes.references: FERPA (Family Educational Rights and Privacy Act)

attributes.name: grade_change_reason
attributes.description: The documented reason for any grade change, required for audit trail and FERPA compliance.
attributes.references: FERPA (Family Educational Rights and Privacy Act)

attributes.name: grade_earned
attributes.description: The letter grade or grade code earned by the student for this course (e.g., A, B+, C-, F, W for withdrawal, I for incomplete, P for pass, NP for no pass, AU for audit).

attributes.name: grade_points
attributes.description: The total grade points earned for this course, calculated as credit hours multiplied by the grade point value (e.g., 4.0 for A, 3.0 for B). Used in GPA (Grade Point Average) calculation.

attributes.name: grade_replacement_flag
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this grade replaces a previous grade for GPA calculation purposes under the institution's grade replacement policy.

attributes.name: grading_mode
attributes.description: The grading basis under which the student took the course (e.g., standard letter grade, pass/fail, audit, credit/no credit).

attributes.name: honors_course_flag
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this course was taken as part of an honors program or honors section.

attributes.name: major_requirement_flag
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this course fulfills a major requirement for the student's declared major program.

attributes.name: online_course_flag
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this course was delivered entirely online or through distance education.

attributes.name: quality_points
attributes.description: Alternative term for grade points used in some institutions. Represents the numeric value assigned to the grade for GPA calculation purposes.

attributes.name: record_created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this academic history record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail purposes.

attributes.name: record_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this academic history record was last updated. Used for audit trail and data lineage purposes.

attributes.name: registration_status
attributes.description: The current or final registration status for this course enrollment (e.g., registered, dropped, withdrawn, completed).

attributes.name: repeat_count
attributes.description: The number of times the student has attempted this specific course, including the current attempt.

attributes.name: repeat_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this course is a repeat of a previously taken course. True if the student has taken this course before.

attributes.name: source_institution_code
attributes.description: The code or identifier for the institution from which transfer credits were earned. Populated only for transfer credits.

attributes.name: source_institution_name
attributes.description: The name of the institution from which transfer credits were earned. Populated only for transfer credits.

attributes.name: subject_code
attributes.description: The subject area code for the course (e.g., MATH, ENGL, BIOL, CHEM).

attributes.name: transcript_display_flag
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this course should appear on the official transcript. Some courses may be excluded from transcript display per institutional policy.
attributes.references: FERPA (Family Educational Rights and Privacy Act)

attributes.name: transfer_credit_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this course was transferred from another institution rather than taken at the home institution.

products.name: student_test_score
products.description: Stores standardized test scores submitted by or on behalf of a student, including test type (SAT, ACT, GRE, GMAT, TOEFL, IELTS, AP, IB, CLEP, Duolingo English Test), test date, score components (e.g., SAT Evidence-Based Reading and Writing, SAT Math), composite score, percentile rank, score report date, score source (self-reported vs. official), official verification status, and superscore eligibility flag. Supports admissions evaluation and placement decisions.
products.reference: Ellucian Banner SOATEST / Slate CRM Test Score Import

attributes.name: student_test_score_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the student test score record. Primary key.

attributes.name: enrollment_application_id
attributes.description: Reference to the admissions application for which this test score was submitted. Links to the enrollment application record. Nullable if score was submitted outside of a specific application context.

attributes.name: profile_id
attributes.description: Reference to the student who took the test. Links to the student master record in the Student Information System (SIS).

attributes.name: regulatory_requirement_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.regulatory_requirement. Business justification: Test score reporting for admissions transparency is regulatory under state authorization and accreditation. Test score policies must comply with state disclosure requirements. Essential for state auth

attributes.name: composite_score
attributes.description: Overall composite or total score for the test. Scale varies by test type (e.g., SAT 400-1600, ACT 1-36, GRE 260-340, TOEFL 0-120, IELTS 0-9).
attributes.references: College Board, ACT Inc., ETS, British Council

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the test score record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage tracking.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the test score record was last updated or modified. Used for audit trail and change tracking.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes or comments about the test score record. May include information about score discrepancies, special circumstances, or additional context for admissions review.

attributes.name: official_verification_status
attributes.description: Status of official verification for the test score. Indicates whether an official score report has been received and validated by the institution. Pending indicates awaiting official report, verified indicates official report received and matched, rejected indicates discrepancy between self-reported and official scores, not_required indicates official verification is not needed for this use case.

attributes.name: percentile_rank
attributes.description: Percentile rank of the student's composite score compared to all test takers in the reference population. Value ranges from 1 to 99, indicating the percentage of test takers who scored at or below this score.

attributes.name: received_by
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the staff member or system that received and recorded the test score. Used for audit trail and accountability purposes.

attributes.name: received_date
attributes.description: Date when the test score record was received and entered into the Student Information System (SIS). Used for tracking processing timelines and application completeness.

attributes.name: record_status
attributes.description: Current status of the test score record. Active indicates the score is current and valid for use, superseded indicates a newer score has replaced this one, cancelled indicates the score has been invalidated, archived indicates the score is retained for historical purposes but no longer actively used.

attributes.name: score_report_date
attributes.description: Date when the official score report was issued by the testing agency. Used to track score validity periods and official reporting timelines.

attributes.name: score_send_date
attributes.description: Date when the official score report was sent to the institution by the testing agency. Used for tracking score receipt and processing timelines.

attributes.name: score_source
attributes.description: Indicates whether the test score was self-reported by the student or received as an official score report from the testing agency. Self-reported scores may be used for initial admissions review, while official scores are required for final admission decisions.

attributes.name: score_use_purpose
attributes.description: Primary purpose for which the test score is being used by the institution. Admission indicates use in admissions evaluation, placement indicates use for course placement decisions, scholarship indicates use for merit scholarship consideration, research indicates use for institutional research and reporting.

attributes.name: score_validity_end_date
attributes.description: Date after which the test score is no longer considered valid for admissions purposes. Validity periods vary by test type and institutional policy (e.g., GRE scores valid for 5 years, TOEFL scores valid for 2 years).

attributes.name: section_1_name
attributes.description: Name of the first test section or component (e.g., SAT Evidence-Based Reading and Writing, ACT English, GRE Verbal Reasoning, TOEFL Reading).

attributes.name: section_1_score
attributes.description: Score achieved on the first test section. Scale varies by test type and section.

attributes.name: section_2_name
attributes.description: Name of the second test section or component (e.g., SAT Math, ACT Math, GRE Quantitative Reasoning, TOEFL Listening).

attributes.name: section_2_score
attributes.description: Score achieved on the second test section. Scale varies by test type and section.

attributes.name: section_3_name
attributes.description: Name of the third test section or component (e.g., ACT Reading, GRE Analytical Writing, TOEFL Speaking). Nullable for tests with fewer sections.

attributes.name: section_3_score
attributes.description: Score achieved on the third test section. Nullable for tests with fewer sections. Scale varies by test type and section.

attributes.name: section_4_name
attributes.description: Name of the fourth test section or component (e.g., ACT Science, TOEFL Writing). Nullable for tests with fewer sections.

attributes.name: section_4_score
attributes.description: Score achieved on the fourth test section. Nullable for tests with fewer sections. Scale varies by test type and section.

attributes.name: superscore_eligible_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this test score is eligible for superscoring. Superscoring combines the highest section scores from multiple test dates to create a new composite score. Eligibility depends on institutional policy and test type.

attributes.name: test_administration_code
attributes.description: Unique code assigned by the testing agency to identify the specific test administration session. Used for score verification and tracking purposes.

attributes.name: test_center_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the test center location where the student took the test. Used for tracking and verification purposes.

attributes.name: test_center_name
attributes.description: Name of the test center location where the student took the test.

attributes.name: test_date
attributes.description: Date on which the student took the standardized test. Used for score validity assessment and superscore eligibility determination.

attributes.name: test_type
attributes.description: Type of standardized test taken by the student. Common types include SAT (Scholastic Assessment Test), ACT (American College Testing), GRE (Graduate Record Examination), GMAT (Graduate Management Admission Test), TOEFL (Test of English as a Foreign Language), IELTS (International English Language Testing System), AP (Advanced Placement), IB (International Baccalaureate), CLEP (College Level Examination Program), and Duolingo English Test. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: SAT|ACT|GRE|GMAT|TOEFL|IELTS|AP|IB|CLEP|Duolingo|MCAT|LSAT|PSAT — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: College Board, ACT Inc., ETS, GMAC, British Council, IDP Education

attributes.name: test_version
attributes.description: Version or form code of the test administered. Different versions may have slightly different questions but are equated to the same scoring scale.

attributes.name: writing_score
attributes.description: Optional writing or essay score component, if applicable for the test type (e.g., SAT Essay, ACT Writing, GRE Analytical Writing). Nullable for tests without writing components or when student did not take the writing section.

products.name: transfer_credit
products.description: Records the evaluation and articulation of academic credits earned at external institutions or through non-traditional pathways (AP, IB, CLEP, military, dual enrollment). Captures source institution name, source institution FICE/IPEDS code, original course title, original course number, original grade, credit hours awarded, equivalent institutional course (if articulated), equivalent credit type (elective, major, general education), evaluation status, evaluator, evaluation date, and appeal status. Supports degree audit and transfer student onboarding.

attributes.name: transfer_credit_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the transfer credit evaluation record. Primary key.

attributes.name: articulation_agreement_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the formal articulation agreement between the institution and the source institution, if applicable. Null if evaluated on a course-by-course basis without a standing agreement.

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Transfer credit evaluation is a registrar function with associated labor and operational costs. Business process: evaluation staff time is allocated to registrar cost center for budget tracking and wo

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the faculty member or registrar staff who performed the transfer credit evaluation. Links to employee or faculty record.

attributes.name: equivalent_course_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the institutional course to which the transfer credit has been articulated. Null if credit is awarded as elective or unassigned credit.

attributes.name: policy_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.policy. Business justification: Transfer credit evaluation follows institutional articulation and credit acceptance policies. Credit evaluators apply documented policy criteria for equivalency determination. Essential for transfer c

attributes.name: profile_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the student receiving the transfer credit. Links to the student master record.
attributes.references: FERPA (Family Educational Rights and Privacy Act)

attributes.name: appeal_date
attributes.description: Date when the student submitted an appeal of the transfer credit denial. Null if no appeal was filed.

attributes.name: appeal_decision_date
attributes.description: Date when the appeal decision was rendered. Null if no appeal or appeal still pending.

attributes.name: appeal_status
attributes.description: Status of student appeal process if the initial evaluation was denied: not appealed, appeal pending review, appeal approved (credit granted), or appeal denied (original decision upheld).

attributes.name: applies_to_gpa
attributes.description: Indicates whether the transfer credit and grade are included in the institutional GPA calculation. Typically false for transfer credits per institutional policy.

attributes.name: applies_to_residency_requirement
attributes.description: Indicates whether the transfer credit counts toward the minimum residency credit hour requirement for degree completion. Some institutions require a minimum number of credits earned in residence.

attributes.name: awarded_credit_hours
attributes.description: Number of institutional credit hours awarded to the student after evaluation and conversion. May differ from source credit hours due to credit system conversion (e.g., quarter to semester).

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the transfer credit evaluation record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and processing time analysis.

attributes.name: denial_reason
attributes.description: Explanation provided when transfer credit is denied (e.g., course content not equivalent, grade below minimum threshold, credit too old per institutional policy). Null if approved.

attributes.name: effective_term_code
attributes.description: Institutional term code when the transfer credit was officially posted to the student academic record (e.g., 202310 for Fall 2023).

attributes.name: equivalent_course_title
attributes.description: Title of the institutional equivalent course. Null if awarded as elective credit.

attributes.name: equivalent_credit_category
attributes.description: Category of degree requirement satisfied by the transfer credit: major requirement, minor requirement, general education, elective within major, prerequisite, or free elective.

attributes.name: evaluation_date
attributes.description: Date when the transfer credit evaluation was completed and decision was rendered.

attributes.name: evaluation_status
attributes.description: Current status of the transfer credit evaluation workflow: pending initial review, in review by evaluator, approved and posted, denied, under appeal, or expired (evaluation not completed within policy timeframe).

attributes.name: evaluator_name
attributes.description: Full name of the individual who evaluated the transfer credit. Stored for audit trail purposes.

attributes.name: general_education_area
attributes.description: Specific general education requirement area satisfied (e.g., Quantitative Literacy, Humanities, Social Sciences, Natural Sciences). Null if not applied to general education.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the transfer credit evaluation record was last updated. Tracks changes through the evaluation workflow.

attributes.name: maximum_age_policy_applied
attributes.description: Indicates whether the institution applied a maximum age policy to the transfer credit (e.g., credits older than 10 years may not transfer). True if age policy was a factor in evaluation.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes recorded by the evaluator regarding special circumstances, conditions, or additional context for the transfer credit decision.

attributes.name: posted_date
attributes.description: Date when the approved transfer credit was officially posted to the student transcript in the Student Information System.

attributes.name: source_course_number
attributes.description: Original course number or code as listed on the source institution transcript (e.g., MATH 101, ENG 1A).

attributes.name: source_course_title
attributes.description: Original course title as listed on the source institution transcript (e.g., Introduction to Calculus, Composition and Rhetoric).

attributes.name: source_credit_hours
attributes.description: Number of credit hours or units awarded by the source institution for the original course. May be semester hours, quarter hours, or other unit systems.

attributes.name: source_credit_type
attributes.description: Type of credit system used by the source institution (semester hours, quarter hours, trimester, or other).

attributes.name: source_grade
attributes.description: Grade earned in the original course at the source institution (e.g., A, B+, 3.7, Pass). Format varies by source institution grading scale.

attributes.name: source_institution_fice_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: Source Institution Federal Interagency Committee on Education (FICE) Code
attributes.description: Six-digit federal identification code assigned by the U.S. Department of Education to postsecondary institutions. Used for Title IV compliance and IPEDS reporting.
attributes.references: U.S. Department of Education FICE Code Standard

attributes.name: source_institution_ipeds_unitid
attributes.business_glossary_term: Source Institution Integrated Postsecondary Education Data System (IPEDS) Unit ID
attributes.description: Six-digit unique identifier assigned by IPEDS to postsecondary institutions for federal reporting and data collection.

attributes.name: source_institution_name
attributes.description: Full name of the external institution where the credit was originally earned (e.g., community college, university, international institution).

attributes.name: source_term
attributes.description: Academic term when the course was completed at the source institution (e.g., Fall 2020, Spring 2021).

attributes.name: transcript_received_date
attributes.description: Date when the official transcript from the source institution was received by the registrar office. Used to track evaluation processing time.

attributes.name: transcript_type
attributes.description: Format and authenticity level of the transcript received: official paper transcript, official electronic transcript (e.g., via National Student Clearinghouse), unofficial transcript, or self-reported by student (requires verification).
attributes.references: AACRAO (American Association of Collegiate Registrars and Admissions Officers) Standards

attributes.name: transfer_credit_type
attributes.description: Category of transfer credit source: traditional coursework, Advanced Placement (AP), International Baccalaureate (IB), College-Level Examination Program (CLEP), military training, dual enrollment, proficiency examination, life experience credit, or other non-traditional pathway. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: coursework|ap|ib|clep|military|dual_enrollment|proficiency_exam|life_experience|other — 9 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: American Council on Education (ACE) Credit Recommendation Standards

products.name: hold
products.description: Tracks administrative, academic, and compliance holds placed on a students record that restrict institutional services such as registration, transcript release, diploma conferral, or financial aid disbursement. Captures hold type (financial, academic, disciplinary, immunization, library, parking, compliance), hold reason description, originating office, date placed, date released, release reason, release authority, service restrictions (registration block, transcript block, diploma block, disbursement block), and priority level. Supports Banner hold processing, student services workflows, and clearance verification for enrollment and graduation.

attributes.name: hold_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the student hold record. Primary key.

attributes.name: conduct_record_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to student.conduct_record. Business justification: Conduct violations frequently result in administrative holds being placed on student records (e.g., disciplinary probation hold, suspension hold preventing registration, transcript hold during investi

attributes.name: ledger_account_id

attributes.name: profile_id

attributes.name: academic_year

attributes.name: amount_owed

attributes.name: appeal_date

attributes.name: appeal_status

attributes.name: appeal_submitted
attributes.description: Indicates whether the student has submitted an appeal or request for review of the hold (True/False).

attributes.name: comments

attributes.name: currency_code

attributes.name: enrollment_verification_block

attributes.name: ferpa_protected

attributes.description: Indicates whether the hold information is protected under FERPA and subject to restricted disclosure (True/False).

attributes.name: grade_block

attributes.name: hold_code

attributes.name: hold_type

attributes.name: last_modified_by
attributes.description: Username or identifier of the staff member or system process that last modified the hold record.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to the hold record, supporting audit trail and data lineage.

attributes.name: notification_date
attributes.description: Date on which the notification was sent to the student. Null if no notification was sent.

attributes.name: notification_method
attributes.description: Method by which the student was notified of the hold (email, mail, portal, phone, sms, none).

attributes.name: notification_sent
attributes.description: Indicates whether a notification was sent to the student informing them of the hold (True/False).

attributes.name: originating_office
attributes.description: Name or code of the institutional office or department that placed the hold (e.g., Bursar, Registrar, Student Health, Library, Parking Services, Dean of Students).

attributes.name: override_allowed
attributes.description: Indicates whether authorized staff are permitted to override this hold to allow restricted services (True/False).

attributes.name: override_authority
attributes.description: Role or position authorized to override this hold (e.g., Registrar, Dean, Bursar, Department Chair). Null if override is not allowed.

attributes.name: placed_by
