attributes.name: placed_date
attributes.description: Date on which the hold was placed on the student record.

attributes.name: priority_level
attributes.description: Numeric priority level of the hold, used to determine processing order when multiple holds exist. Lower numbers typically indicate higher priority.

attributes.name: reason
attributes.description: Detailed textual description of the reason the hold was placed, providing context for the restriction (e.g., outstanding tuition balance, missing immunization records, academic probation, library fines).

attributes.name: registration_block
attributes.description: Indicates whether this hold blocks the student from registering for courses (True/False).

attributes.name: release_reason
attributes.description: Textual description of the reason the hold was released (e.g., payment received, documentation submitted, appeal approved, administrative override).

attributes.name: released_by
attributes.description: Username or identifier of the staff member or system process that released the hold. Null if the hold is still active.

attributes.name: released_date
attributes.description: Date on which the hold was manually released or cleared. Null if the hold is still active.

attributes.name: system_generated
attributes.description: Indicates whether the hold was automatically generated by a system process (True) or manually placed by staff (False).

attributes.name: term_code
attributes.description: Academic term code associated with the hold, if the hold is term-specific (e.g., 202401 for Spring 2024). Null if the hold is not term-specific.

attributes.name: transcript_block
attributes.description: Indicates whether this hold blocks the release of official transcripts (True/False).

products.name: leave_of_absence
products.description: Documents approved leaves of absence from academic study, including leave type (medical, personal, military, parental, research), leave start term, expected return term, actual return date, leave approval status, approving authority, conditions for return, impact on financial aid SAP clock, impact on degree completion timeline, and re-enrollment confirmation. Supports student lifecycle continuity tracking and Title IV leave-of-absence compliance requirements.
products.reference: Ellucian Banner SOADMIT / Title IV LOA Policy

attributes.name: leave_of_absence_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the leave of absence record. Primary key for the leave_of_absence product.

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier of the faculty or staff member who approved the leave of absence. Links to employee or faculty record.

attributes.name: leave_start_term_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to enrollment.term. Business justification: Leave of absence administration requires formal term linkage for leave start dates to calculate return eligibility, financial aid impact, and degree timeline adjustments. Current leave_start_term is a

attributes.name: profile_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier of the student taking the leave of absence. Links to the student master record.

attributes.name: academic_standing_at_leave
attributes.description: Student's academic standing status at the time the leave of absence began. Good standing indicates satisfactory academic performance, academic probation indicates below-standard performance with conditions, academic suspension indicates temporary removal from enrollment, academic dismissal indicates permanent removal.

attributes.name: actual_return_date
attributes.description: Actual date when the student returned from leave and re-enrolled. Null if student has not yet returned. Used to measure leave duration accuracy and Title IV compliance.
attributes.references: Title IV Federal Student Aid Regulations; Ellucian Banner Student Information System

attributes.name: advisor_notified_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the student's academic advisor was notified of the leave of absence. True if advisor notified, false otherwise. Important for continuity of advising relationship.

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: Date on which the leave of absence request was officially approved by the approving authority. Null if not yet approved or if denied.

attributes.name: approving_authority
attributes.description: Name or title of the institutional official who approved the leave of absence request (e.g., Dean of Students, Registrar, Academic Advisor).

attributes.name: comments
attributes.description: Additional administrative notes or comments about the leave of absence, including special circumstances, follow-up actions, or coordination with other offices.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this leave of absence record was first created in the system. Audit field for data lineage and compliance tracking.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner Student Information System; FERPA

attributes.name: credits_earned_at_leave
attributes.description: Total number of credit hours the student had successfully completed at the time the leave of absence began. Used for degree progress tracking and SAP calculations.

attributes.name: degree_timeline_impact_days
attributes.description: Number of days by which the leave of absence extends the student's expected degree completion timeline. Used for academic planning and advising.

attributes.name: enrollment_hold_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether an enrollment hold is placed on the student's record during the leave period, preventing registration until return conditions are met. True if hold is active, false otherwise.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner Student Information System; Institutional Policy

attributes.name: expected_return_date
attributes.description: Anticipated date when the student plans to return from leave and re-enroll. Used for planning and Title IV compliance tracking.
attributes.references: Title IV Federal Student Aid Regulations

attributes.name: expected_return_term
attributes.description: Academic term code when the student is expected to return from leave and resume enrollment. Follows institutional term coding convention.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner Student Information System; IPEDS

attributes.name: financial_aid_impact_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the leave of absence affects the student's financial aid eligibility, Satisfactory Academic Progress (SAP) status, or Title IV aid clock. True if financial aid is impacted, false otherwise.
attributes.references: Title IV Federal Student Aid Regulations; SAP (Satisfactory Academic Progress) Policy

attributes.name: gpa_at_leave
attributes.description: Student's cumulative Grade Point Average (GPA) at the time the leave of absence began. Used to track academic standing and eligibility for return. Expressed on a 4.0 scale.

attributes.name: housing_contract_status
attributes.description: Status of the student's on-campus housing contract during the leave period. Active indicates contract remains in force, suspended indicates temporary pause, terminated indicates contract ended, not_applicable indicates student had no housing contract.

attributes.name: ipeds_reportable_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Integrated Postsecondary Education Data System (IPEDS) Reportable Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this leave of absence must be reported in IPEDS enrollment and retention surveys. True if reportable, false otherwise. Depends on leave duration and timing relative to census dates.
attributes.references: IPEDS (Integrated Postsecondary Education Data System); U.S. Department of Education

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this leave of absence record was most recently updated. Audit field for change tracking and data quality monitoring.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner Student Information System; FERPA

attributes.name: leave_end_date
attributes.description: Official end date of the approved leave of absence period. Represents the last day the student is on leave status before expected return.
attributes.references: Title IV Federal Student Aid Regulations

attributes.name: leave_start_date
attributes.description: Effective date when the leave of absence officially begins. Marks the first day the student is no longer enrolled.
attributes.references: Title IV Federal Student Aid Regulations; FERPA

attributes.name: leave_status
attributes.description: Current status of the leave of absence request in its lifecycle. Pending indicates awaiting approval, approved indicates authorization granted, denied indicates request rejected, active indicates student is currently on leave, returned indicates student has resumed enrollment, withdrawn indicates student withdrew the request.

attributes.name: leave_type
attributes.description: Category of leave of absence granted to the student. Medical covers health-related absences, personal covers non-medical personal reasons, military covers active duty service, parental covers childbirth or adoption, research covers off-campus research opportunities, and academic covers study abroad or exchange programs.
attributes.references: FERPA (Family Educational Rights and Privacy Act); Title IV Federal Student Aid Regulations

attributes.name: meal_plan_status
attributes.description: Status of the student's meal plan during the leave period. Active indicates plan continues, suspended indicates temporary pause, terminated indicates plan ended, not_applicable indicates student had no meal plan.

attributes.name: modified_by_user
attributes.description: Username or identifier of the system user who last modified this leave of absence record. Audit field for accountability and compliance.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner Student Information System; FERPA

attributes.name: re_enrollment_confirmed_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the student has confirmed their intent to re-enroll after the leave period. True if re-enrollment confirmed, false if not confirmed or student withdrew permanently.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner Student Information System; Institutional Policy

attributes.name: re_enrollment_term
attributes.description: Actual academic term code when the student re-enrolled after returning from leave. May differ from expected_return_term if student delayed return. Null if student has not yet re-enrolled.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner Student Information System; IPEDS

attributes.name: reason_description
attributes.description: Detailed narrative explanation provided by the student for requesting the leave of absence. May contain sensitive personal information. Classified as confidential to protect student privacy.
attributes.references: FERPA (Family Educational Rights and Privacy Act)

attributes.name: request_date
attributes.description: Date on which the student submitted the leave of absence request. Represents the business event timestamp for the leave request initiation.

attributes.name: return_conditions
attributes.description: Specific conditions or requirements the student must meet before being permitted to return from leave (e.g., medical clearance, academic advising meeting, financial holds resolved).
attributes.references: Institutional Policy; Title IV Federal Student Aid Regulations

attributes.name: sap_clock_stopped_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Satisfactory Academic Progress (SAP) Clock Stopped Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the Satisfactory Academic Progress (SAP) maximum timeframe clock is stopped during this leave period. True if SAP clock is paused, false if it continues to run. Critical for Title IV financial aid compliance.
attributes.references: Title IV Federal Student Aid Regulations; SAP Policy

attributes.name: supporting_documentation_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether supporting documentation (medical records, military orders, etc.) was submitted with the leave request. True if documentation provided, false otherwise.

attributes.name: title_iv_compliant_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the leave of absence meets Title IV federal financial aid compliance requirements (duration limits, approval documentation, return expectations). True if compliant, false if non-compliant.
attributes.references: Title IV Federal Student Aid Regulations; U.S. Department of Education

attributes.name: tuition_refund_eligibility_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the student is eligible for a tuition refund based on the timing of the leave relative to the institutional refund schedule. True if eligible for refund, false otherwise.
attributes.references: Institutional Refund Policy; Student Accounts Policy

attributes.name: tuition_refund_percentage
attributes.description: Percentage of tuition eligible for refund based on the leave start date and institutional refund schedule. Expressed as a decimal (e.g., 75.00 for 75% refund).
attributes.references: Institutional Refund Policy; Student Accounts Policy

products.name: cohort_membership
products.description: Associates students with institutional cohorts used for retention tracking, IPEDS graduation rate reporting, and federal compliance. Captures cohort type (FTIAC, transfer, Pell recipient, first-generation, STEM, athlete, veteran), cohort entry term, cohort year, cohort status (active, graduated, transferred out, still enrolled, withdrawn), outcome determination date, and the federal/institutional reporting framework the cohort supports. Enables 150% graduation rate and retention rate calculations per IPEDS methodology.
products.reference: IPEDS Graduation Rate Survey / Student Right-to-Know Act

attributes.name: cohort_membership_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the cohort membership record. Primary key for this entity.

attributes.name: entry_term_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to enrollment.term. Business justification: IPEDS cohort reporting requires precise entry term linkage for 100%/150%/200% completion calculations, retention rates, and graduation rates. Entry_term_code alone insufficient for census date determi

attributes.name: profile_id
attributes.description: Reference to the student who is a member of this cohort. Links to the student master record in the Student Information System (SIS).

attributes.name: regulatory_requirement_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.regulatory_requirement. Business justification: IPEDS cohort tracking is a federal reporting requirement. Cohort definitions and tracking methodology are driven by IPEDS regulatory requirements. Essential for IPEDS Graduation Rates and Outcome Meas

attributes.name: cohort_code
attributes.description: Business identifier code for the cohort. Used for reporting and operational reference (e.g., FTIAC_2023, PELL_2024, STEM_FALL22).

attributes.name: cohort_name
attributes.description: Human-readable descriptive name for the cohort (e.g., Fall 2023 First-Time Full-Time Freshmen, Pell Grant Recipients 2024, STEM Majors Fall 2022).

attributes.name: cohort_notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes documenting special circumstances, data quality issues, or additional context for this cohort membership record. Used by institutional research staff for audit trails and data stewardship.

attributes.name: cohort_type
attributes.description: Classification of the cohort based on institutional or federal reporting requirements. FTIAC (First-Time-In-Any-College) is the primary IPEDS cohort type. Other types support retention analysis, equity reporting, and program evaluation. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: FTIAC|Transfer|Pell Recipient|First-Generation|STEM|Athlete|Veteran|International|Honors|Underrepresented Minority — 10 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: cohort_year
attributes.description: The calendar year or academic year in which the cohort was established. Used for multi-year tracking and longitudinal analysis (e.g., 2023 for Fall 2023 cohort).

attributes.name: completion_within_100_pct_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the student completed their degree within 100% of normal time (e.g., 4 years for a bachelor's degree). Used for on-time graduation rate reporting.

attributes.name: completion_within_150_pct_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the student completed their degree within 150% of normal time (e.g., 6 years for a bachelor's degree). This is the standard IPEDS graduation rate metric.

attributes.name: completion_within_200_pct_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the student completed their degree within 200% of normal time (e.g., 8 years for a bachelor's degree). Used for extended completion rate analysis.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this cohort membership record was first created in the system. Used for audit trails and data lineage tracking.

attributes.name: data_quality_flag
attributes.description: Indicator of the data quality status for this cohort membership record. Used by institutional research and data stewardship teams to track records requiring validation or correction before IPEDS submission.

attributes.name: degree_seeking_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the student was degree-seeking at cohort entry. IPEDS cohorts include only degree-seeking students; non-degree students are excluded from graduation rate calculations.

attributes.name: entry_date
attributes.description: The specific date the student was added to the cohort. Typically the census date or official enrollment date for the entry term. Critical for IPEDS 150% graduation rate calculations.

attributes.name: exclusion_date
attributes.description: The date the student was excluded from the cohort, if applicable. Used to document when the exclusion event occurred for audit and compliance purposes.

attributes.name: exclusion_reason
attributes.description: The reason a student was excluded from the cohort per IPEDS allowable exclusions. Students who die, become permanently disabled, or leave for military/foreign aid/church service may be excluded from the denominator of graduation rate calculations. None indicates no exclusion applies.
attributes.value_regex: Death|Permanent Disability|Military Service|Foreign Aid Service|Official Church Mission|None
attributes.references: IPEDS Graduation Rate Survey - Allowable Exclusions

attributes.name: first_time_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the student was first-time (no prior postsecondary enrollment) at cohort entry. The FTIAC (First-Time-In-Any-College) cohort requires this flag to be true.

attributes.name: full_time_status_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the student was enrolled full-time at cohort entry. Critical for IPEDS cohort definition, which requires full-time status for the standard graduation rate cohort.

attributes.name: graduation_date
attributes.description: The date the student graduated from the institution, if the membership status is Graduated. Used to calculate time-to-degree and determine whether graduation occurred within 100%, 150%, or 200% of normal time.
attributes.references: IPEDS Graduation Rate Component; Ellucian Banner Degree Audit

attributes.name: graduation_term_code
attributes.description: The academic term code in which the student graduated, in Banner YYYYTT format (e.g., 202305 for Spring 2023). Used for term-based graduation rate reporting.

attributes.name: ipeds_cohort_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: IPEDS (Integrated Postsecondary Education Data System) Cohort Flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator whether this cohort membership is part of the official IPEDS Graduation Rate Survey cohort. True for FTIAC full-time degree-seeking students entering in the fall term.

attributes.name: ipeds_submission_year
attributes.business_glossary_term: IPEDS (Integrated Postsecondary Education Data System) Submission Year
attributes.description: The IPEDS collection year in which this cohort membership was reported to the U.S. Department of Education. Used to track historical submissions and support multi-year trend analysis.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this cohort membership record was last updated. Used for change tracking and data quality monitoring.

attributes.name: membership_status
attributes.description: Current status of the student within this cohort. Active indicates the student is still being tracked. Graduated, Transferred Out, Withdrawn, and Deceased are terminal outcomes. Still Enrolled indicates the student remains enrolled beyond the standard completion timeframe. Excluded indicates the student was removed from cohort tracking per IPEDS exclusion rules (e.g., death, permanent disability, military service). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: Active|Graduated|Transferred Out|Still Enrolled|Withdrawn|Deceased|Excluded — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: outcome_determination_date
attributes.description: The date on which the final cohort outcome status was determined. For IPEDS reporting, this is typically 150% of normal program completion time from the cohort entry date (e.g., 6 years for a 4-year degree program).

attributes.name: pell_recipient_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the student received a Federal Pell Grant in the cohort entry year. IPEDS requires disaggregation of graduation rates by Pell recipient status for equity reporting.
attributes.references: IPEDS Pell Grant Recipient Reporting; Federal Student Aid

attributes.name: persistence_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the student persisted to the next term (term-to-term persistence). True if the student enrolled in the immediately following term. Used for early intervention and student success initiatives.

attributes.name: reporting_framework
attributes.description: The regulatory or institutional reporting framework that this cohort supports. IPEDS is the federal standard. Institutional cohorts support internal retention and completion tracking. State frameworks support state performance funding. Accreditation cohorts support regional or programmatic accreditor requirements. NCAA cohorts track student-athlete graduation rates. VSA (Voluntary System of Accountability) cohorts support transparency initiatives. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: IPEDS|Institutional|State|Accreditation|Federal Title IV|NCAA|VSA — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: U.S. Department of Education IPEDS; NCAA Academic Performance Program

attributes.name: retention_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the student was retained to the next fall term (one-year retention). True if the student enrolled in the fall term one year after cohort entry. Critical metric for institutional performance and accreditation.
attributes.references: IPEDS Fall Enrollment Survey; Retention Rate Calculation

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: The system of record from which this cohort membership data originated. Typically Ellucian Banner SIS for operational cohorts, or Institutional Research systems for analytical cohorts.
attributes.value_regex: Banner SIS|Institutional Research|Manual Entry|Data Warehouse|External Feed

attributes.name: subsidized_loan_recipient_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the student received a Direct Subsidized Loan (but not a Pell Grant) in the cohort entry year. IPEDS requires disaggregation by loan recipient status.
attributes.references: IPEDS Financial Aid Recipient Reporting; Federal Student Aid

attributes.name: transfer_out_date
attributes.description: The date the student transferred out to another institution, if the membership status is Transferred Out. Used for IPEDS transfer-out reporting and to adjust retention calculations.
attributes.references: IPEDS Graduation Rate Survey - Transfer-Out Cohort

attributes.name: withdrawal_date
attributes.description: The date the student withdrew from the institution, if the membership status is Withdrawn. Used for retention analysis and stop-out tracking.

products.name: ferpa_consent
products.description: Manages FERPA (Family Educational Rights and Privacy Act) consent and disclosure authorizations for each student. Captures authorized party name, relationship to student, disclosure scope (full record, financial only, academic only, directory information), consent grant date, consent expiration date, consent revocation date, verification method (in-person, electronic, notarized), and the specific Banner FERPA release codes activated. Supports FERPA compliance audits and third-party record release workflows.
products.reference: FERPA 34 CFR Part 99 / Ellucian Banner GOAFERP

attributes.name: ferpa_consent_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: FERPA (Family Educational Rights and Privacy Act) Consent ID
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the FERPA consent record. Primary key for the ferpa_consent product.

attributes.name: policy_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.policy. Business justification: FERPA consents must align with institutional FERPA policy version. Consent forms reference specific policy language for legal compliance. Essential for consent validity verification and policy version

attributes.name: primary_ferpa_employee_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier of the institutional staff member who processed and authorized this FERPA consent in the system. Links to the staff or employee master record.

attributes.name: profile_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier of the student who granted or revoked FERPA consent. Links to the student master record in the Student Information System (SIS).

attributes.name: audit_trail_notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for institutional staff to record additional context, special circumstances, or compliance notes related to this FERPA consent.

attributes.name: authorized_by_staff_name
attributes.description: Full name of the institutional staff member who processed this FERPA consent. Denormalized for audit trail purposes.

attributes.name: authorized_party_email
attributes.description: Primary email address of the authorized party for communication regarding record disclosures.

attributes.name: authorized_party_name
attributes.description: Full legal name of the individual or organization authorized to receive the student's educational records under this FERPA consent.

attributes.name: authorized_party_phone
attributes.description: Primary contact phone number for the authorized party.

attributes.name: authorized_party_relationship
attributes.description: The relationship of the authorized party to the student. Indicates the basis for the disclosure authorization. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: parent|legal_guardian|spouse|attorney|employer|financial_aid_agency|scholarship_provider|third_party_vendor|other — 9 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: banner_release_code
attributes.description: The specific FERPA release code activated in Ellucian Banner SIS for this consent. Maps to Banner's GOBTPAC table release codes.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner Student Information System - FERPA Release Configuration

attributes.name: consent_document_url
attributes.description: URL or file path to the digitally stored signed FERPA consent form or authorization document. Used for audit trail and compliance verification.

attributes.name: consent_effective_date
attributes.description: The date from which the FERPA consent becomes enforceable and record disclosures may begin. May differ from grant date if consent is scheduled to start in the future.

attributes.name: consent_expiration_date
attributes.description: The date on which the FERPA consent authorization expires and is no longer valid for record disclosure. Nullable for open-ended consents.

attributes.name: consent_grant_date
attributes.description: The date on which the student formally granted FERPA consent to the authorized party. Marks the beginning of the consent period.

attributes.name: consent_language
attributes.description: ISO 639-3 three-letter language code indicating the language in which the consent was provided and documented. Supports multilingual compliance.

attributes.name: consent_revocation_date
attributes.description: The date on which the student formally revoked the FERPA consent authorization. Nullable if consent has not been revoked.

attributes.name: consent_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the FERPA consent authorization. Determines whether the consent is currently enforceable for record disclosure.

attributes.name: consent_type
attributes.description: The scope of educational records covered by this consent authorization. Defines which categories of student information may be disclosed to the authorized party.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this FERPA consent record was first created in the system. Part of the audit trail for compliance tracking.

attributes.name: disclosure_count
attributes.description: The total number of times educational records have been disclosed to the authorized party under this consent authorization. Supports compliance monitoring.

attributes.name: disclosure_scope_description
attributes.description: Detailed narrative description of the specific educational records and information categories covered by this consent. Provides additional context beyond the consent_type field.

attributes.name: institutional_policy_version
attributes.description: Version identifier of the institution's FERPA policy that was in effect when this consent was granted. Supports historical compliance tracking.

attributes.name: last_disclosure_date
attributes.description: The most recent date on which educational records were disclosed to the authorized party under this consent. Used for audit tracking.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this FERPA consent record was most recently updated in the system. Supports change tracking and audit compliance.

attributes.name: purpose_of_disclosure
attributes.description: The stated purpose or reason for which the authorized party will use the disclosed educational records. Required for FERPA compliance documentation.

attributes.name: requires_annual_renewal
attributes.description: Indicates whether this FERPA consent requires annual renewal by the student. Some institutions require periodic re-authorization for ongoing consents.

attributes.name: revocation_reason
attributes.description: Narrative explanation provided by the student for revoking the FERPA consent authorization. Nullable if consent has not been revoked.

attributes.name: third_party_redisclosure_allowed
attributes.description: Indicates whether the authorized party is permitted to further disclose the educational records to additional third parties. Critical for FERPA compliance.

attributes.name: verification_date
attributes.description: The date on which the student's identity and consent were verified by the institution.

attributes.name: verification_method
attributes.description: The method by which the student's identity and consent authorization were verified. Critical for FERPA compliance audits.

products.name: residency_classification
products.description: Stores the official in-state vs. out-of-state residency determination for tuition classification purposes. Captures residency status (in-state, out-of-state, international, military dependent, reciprocity agreement), determination date, effective term, supporting documentation type, domicile state, residency appeal status, appeal decision, and the institutional policy version applied. Directly drives tuition rate assessment in the billing domain and IPEDS residency reporting.
products.reference: Ellucian Banner SGASTDN Residency / State Residency Statutes

attributes.name: residency_classification_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the residency classification record. Primary key for this entity.

attributes.name: effective_term_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to enrollment.term. Business justification: Tuition billing and financial aid packaging require term-specific residency status for rate determination. Effective_term_code insufficient for automated billing integration; FK enables term census da

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: User ID of the registrar staff member or residency officer who performed the residency determination review. Supports accountability and audit trail requirements.

attributes.name: policy_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.policy. Business justification: Residency determinations follow state-specific institutional policies. Appeals cite policy version; documentation requirements are policy-driven. Required for residency appeals and tuition classificat

attributes.name: profile_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier of the student to whom this residency classification applies. Links to the student master record in the Student Information System (SIS).

attributes.name: appeal_decision_date
attributes.description: Date on which the residency appeal committee or officer rendered a final decision on the student's appeal. NULL if appeal is still pending or no appeal was filed.

attributes.name: appeal_decision_rationale
attributes.description: Textual explanation of the rationale behind the appeal decision, including key factors considered by the review committee. Provides transparency and documentation for audit and compliance purposes.

attributes.name: appeal_status
attributes.description: Current status of any residency classification appeal filed by the student. Tracks whether the student has contested the initial determination and the outcome of that appeal process.

attributes.name: appeal_submission_date
attributes.description: Date on which the student submitted a formal appeal of their residency classification. NULL if no appeal has been filed.

attributes.name: classification_source
attributes.description: Source or process through which the residency classification was established. Indicates whether the classification originated from the admissions application, a registrar review, a student petition, an appeal decision, or other source.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this residency classification record was first created in the system. Supports audit trail and data lineage requirements.

attributes.name: determination_date
attributes.description: Date on which the residency classification was officially determined by the registrar or residency officer. Represents the business event timestamp for this classification decision.

attributes.name: documentation_received_date
attributes.description: Date on which the residency supporting documentation was received by the registrar's office or residency review unit. Used to track processing timelines and compliance with submission deadlines.

attributes.name: documentation_type
attributes.description: Type of supporting documentation provided by the student to substantiate their residency claim. Common types include driver's license, voter registration, tax returns, lease agreements, utility bills, military orders, or visa/I-20 for international students. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: drivers_license|voter_registration|tax_return|lease_agreement|utility_bill|military_orders|visa_i20|other — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: domicile_country_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO country code representing the student's country of legal domicile. Primarily used for international students to distinguish country of origin for reporting and compliance purposes.

attributes.name: domicile_state_code
attributes.description: Two-letter US state code representing the student's legal domicile for residency determination purposes. Used to assess eligibility for in-state tuition or reciprocity agreements. NULL for international students.

attributes.name: duration_of_residency_months
attributes.description: Number of months the student has maintained continuous legal domicile in the state, as documented and verified during the residency determination process. Used to assess eligibility for in-state status, which typically requires 12 consecutive months of domicile.

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: Date on which this residency classification expires and must be re-evaluated. Some institutions require periodic re-verification of residency status, particularly for students claiming in-state status based on recent domicile establishment.

attributes.name: ferpa_restriction_indicator
attributes.business_glossary_term: FERPA (Family Educational Rights and Privacy Act) Restriction Indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether the student has requested FERPA directory information restrictions that limit disclosure of residency classification data. Ensures compliance with student privacy rights under FERPA.

attributes.name: financial_independence_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether the student has been determined to be financially independent from out-of-state parents or guardians for residency purposes. Financial independence is often a prerequisite for establishing in-state residency for students whose parents reside out of state.
attributes.references: Institutional Residency Policy; State Residency Statute

attributes.name: ipeds_residency_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: IPEDS (Integrated Postsecondary Education Data System) Residency Code
attributes.description: Residency classification code mapped to IPEDS reporting categories for federal compliance reporting. IPEDS requires institutions to report enrollment by residency status (in-state, out-of-state, foreign) for fall enrollment surveys.
attributes.references: IPEDS Data Collection System; NCES IPEDS Glossary

attributes.name: is_active
attributes.description: Indicates whether this residency classification record is currently active and in effect for the student. Only one residency classification per student should be active at any given time. Historical records are retained with is_active set to false.

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this residency classification record was most recently updated. Tracks the most recent modification to any field in the record for audit and data quality monitoring purposes.

attributes.name: military_affiliation_type
attributes.description: Type of military affiliation that may qualify the student for special residency consideration or in-state tuition rates under federal or state veteran education benefits policies. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: active_duty|veteran|reserve|national_guard|dependent|spouse|not_applicable — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Veterans Access, Choice, and Accountability Act; State Veteran Tuition Policy

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes or comments recorded by the residency reviewer regarding special circumstances, documentation issues, or other relevant context for the classification decision. Supports case-by-case decision transparency.

attributes.name: policy_version
attributes.description: Version identifier of the institutional residency policy that was applied to make this classification determination. Ensures traceability and consistency when policies are updated over time.

attributes.name: prior_residency_status
attributes.description: The student's residency classification in the immediately preceding term. Used to track residency status changes over time and to support audit and compliance reporting.

attributes.name: reciprocity_agreement_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the interstate reciprocity agreement under which the student qualifies for reduced tuition (e.g., Midwest Student Exchange Program, Academic Common Market, Western Undergraduate Exchange). NULL if no reciprocity agreement applies.

attributes.name: residency_status
attributes.description: Official residency classification for tuition assessment purposes. Determines whether the student qualifies for in-state, out-of-state, or other special tuition rates. Directly impacts tuition billing and IPEDS residency reporting.
attributes.references: State Higher Education Policy; IPEDS Residency Definitions

attributes.name: tuition_rate_category
attributes.description: Tuition rate category assigned based on the residency classification. Directly drives the tuition rate applied in the student billing system. May differ slightly from residency_status to accommodate special rate programs.

products.name: visa_immigration
products.description: Tracks immigration and visa status for international students, including visa type (F-1, J-1, M-1, H-1B, OPT, CPT), visa issue date, visa expiration date, I-20 or DS-2019 issue date, SEVIS ID, SEVIS status, authorized stay end date, OPT/CPT authorization period, employment authorization document number, country of citizenship, country of birth, passport number (encrypted), and SEVIS reporting compliance flags. Supports SEVP (Student and Exchange Visitor Program) compliance and DHS reporting.
products.reference: SEVIS / DHS SEVP / Ellucian Banner GOAINTL

attributes.name: visa_immigration_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the visa and immigration record. Primary key for the visa_immigration product.

attributes.name: export_control_review_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to research.export_control_review. Business justification: Export control reviews must document foreign national students with access to controlled technology or data; regulatory requirement under EAR/ITAR for universities conducting defense or dual-use resea

attributes.name: profile_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier of the international student associated with this visa and immigration record. Links to the student master record in the Student Information System (SIS).

attributes.name: regulatory_requirement_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.regulatory_requirement. Business justification: SEVIS reporting is a federal regulatory requirement under SEVP. Immigration status tracking directly supports compliance with F-1/J-1 visa regulations. Essential for SEVIS batch reporting and complian

attributes.name: authorized_stay_end_date
attributes.description: The date until which the student is authorized to remain in the United States. For F-1 and J-1 students, this is typically D/S (Duration of Status) which extends through the program end date plus any grace period.
attributes.references: U.S. Customs and Border Protection (CBP), Form I-94

attributes.name: country_of_birth
attributes.description: The three-letter ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code representing the student's country of birth. Required for SEVIS reporting and visa applications.

attributes.name: country_of_citizenship
attributes.description: The three-letter ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code representing the student's country of citizenship. This is the country that issued the student's passport.

attributes.name: cpt_authorization_end_date
attributes.business_glossary_term: Curricular Practical Training (CPT) Authorization End Date
attributes.description: The end date of the Curricular Practical Training (CPT) period. Students must cease CPT employment by this date unless a new authorization is granted.

attributes.name: cpt_authorization_start_date
attributes.business_glossary_term: Curricular Practical Training (CPT) Authorization Start Date
attributes.description: The start date of the Curricular Practical Training (CPT) period for F-1 students. CPT allows students to engage in internships or employment that is an integral part of their curriculum while enrolled.

attributes.name: cpt_type
attributes.description: Indicates whether the CPT authorization is for part-time employment (20 hours or less per week) or full-time employment (more than 20 hours per week). Full-time CPT for 12 months or more makes students ineligible for post-completion OPT.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this visa and immigration record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage tracking.

attributes.name: ds2019_expiration_date
attributes.description: The program end date listed on the Form DS-2019, indicating when the exchange visitor is expected to complete their program. J-1 visitors must complete their program by this date or request an extension.
attributes.references: U.S. Department of State, Form DS-2019

attributes.name: ds2019_issue_date
attributes.description: The date on which the Certificate of Eligibility for Exchange Visitor Status (Form DS-2019) was issued to the J-1 exchange visitor by the institution's Responsible Officer (RO). Required for J-1 visa holders.
attributes.references: U.S. Department of State, Form DS-2019

attributes.name: dso_email
attributes.description: The email address of the Designated School Official (DSO) responsible for this student's SEVIS record. Used for official communications regarding the student's immigration status.

attributes.name: dso_name
attributes.description: The name of the Designated School Official (DSO) who is the primary point of contact for this student's SEVIS record. The DSO is responsible for maintaining the student's record and ensuring compliance with SEVP regulations.

attributes.name: ead_expiration_date
attributes.description: The date on which the Employment Authorization Document (EAD) expires. Students must cease employment or renew their EAD before this date.

attributes.name: ead_issue_date
attributes.description: The date on which the Employment Authorization Document (EAD) was issued by USCIS.

attributes.name: ead_number
attributes.description: The unique number on the Employment Authorization Document (EAD card, Form I-766) issued by USCIS. This card authorizes the student to work in the United States during OPT or other authorized employment periods.

attributes.name: entry_date
attributes.description: The date on which the student most recently entered the United States. This date is recorded on the Form I-94 Arrival/Departure Record and is critical for calculating authorized stay periods.
attributes.references: U.S. Customs and Border Protection (CBP), Form I-94

attributes.name: full_course_of_study_compliant
attributes.business_glossary_term: Full Course of Study Compliance Flag
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the student is currently enrolled in a full course of study as required by their visa status. F-1 students must be enrolled full-time (typically 12 credit hours for undergraduates, 9 for graduates) to maintain status.

attributes.name: grace_period_end_date
attributes.description: The date on which the student's grace period ends. F-1 students receive a 60-day grace period after program completion or OPT end date. J-1 students receive a 30-day grace period. Students must depart the U.S. or change status by this date.

attributes.name: i20_expiration_date
attributes.description: The program end date listed on the Form I-20, indicating when the student is expected to complete their academic program. Students must complete their program by this date or request an extension.

attributes.name: i20_issue_date
attributes.description: The date on which the Certificate of Eligibility for Nonimmigrant Student Status (Form I-20) was issued to the F or M student by the institution's Designated School Official (DSO). Required for F-1 and M-1 visa holders.

attributes.name: i94_number
attributes.description: The unique 11-digit admission number from the Form I-94 Arrival/Departure Record issued by U.S. Customs and Border Protection upon entry to the United States. This number is used to verify lawful admission and authorized stay.
attributes.references: U.S. Customs and Border Protection (CBP), Form I-94

attributes.name: last_sevis_update_date
attributes.description: The timestamp of the most recent update to the student's SEVIS record. SEVIS records must be updated within 21 days of any change in student status, program, or personal information.

attributes.name: next_sevis_report_due_date
attributes.description: The date by which the next mandatory SEVIS report is due. Schools must report certain events (enrollment verification, program completion, status changes) within specific timeframes to maintain SEVP certification.

attributes.name: off_campus_employment_authorized
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the student is authorized to work off campus through CPT, OPT, severe economic hardship authorization, or other special circumstances.

attributes.name: on_campus_employment_authorized
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the student is authorized to work on campus. F-1 students are generally authorized to work on campus up to 20 hours per week while school is in session and full-time during breaks.

attributes.name: opt_authorization_end_date
attributes.business_glossary_term: Optional Practical Training (OPT) Authorization End Date
attributes.description: The end date of the Optional Practical Training (OPT) period. Students must cease employment and depart the U.S. or change status by this date unless they have applied for a STEM extension or other status change.

attributes.name: opt_authorization_start_date
attributes.business_glossary_term: Optional Practical Training (OPT) Authorization Start Date
attributes.description: The start date of the Optional Practical Training (OPT) period for F-1 students. OPT allows students to work in their field of study for up to 12 months (or 24 months for STEM extension) after completing their academic program.

attributes.name: opt_type
attributes.description: The type of OPT authorization. Pre-completion OPT allows students to work part-time while enrolled. Post-completion OPT allows full-time work after graduation. STEM extension provides an additional 24 months for STEM degree holders.

attributes.name: passport_expiration_date
attributes.description: The expiration date of the student's passport. Students must maintain a valid passport (typically valid for at least 6 months into the future) to maintain legal status in the United States.

attributes.name: passport_number
attributes.description: The passport number from the student's valid passport. This field should be encrypted at rest to protect sensitive personal information. Required for SEVIS reporting and visa tracking.

attributes.name: port_of_entry
attributes.description: The U.S. port of entry (airport, seaport, or land border crossing) through which the student most recently entered the United States. Examples include JFK (New York), LAX (Los Angeles), or ATL (Atlanta).

attributes.name: reduced_course_load_authorized
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the student has been authorized by the Designated School Official (DSO) to take a reduced course load due to academic difficulties, medical reasons, or initial difficulty with English language or reading requirements.

attributes.name: sevis_fee_amount
attributes.description: The amount of the SEVIS I-901 fee paid by the student in U.S. dollars. The fee amount varies by visa type (F/M students pay $350, J exchange visitors pay $220 as of recent rates).

attributes.name: sevis_fee_paid_date
attributes.description: The date on which the student paid the SEVIS I-901 fee. This fee must be paid before applying for an F, J, or M visa and is required for SEVIS activation.

attributes.name: sevis_number
attributes.business_glossary_term: Student and Exchange Visitor Information System (SEVIS) ID
attributes.description: The unique SEVIS identification number assigned by the U.S. Department of Homeland Security to track F and M nonimmigrant students and J nonimmigrant exchange visitors. Required for SEVP compliance and DHS reporting.
attributes.references: SEVP (Student and Exchange Visitor Program), U.S. Department of Homeland Security

attributes.name: sevis_status
attributes.description: The current status of the student in the SEVIS system. Initial indicates the student has been issued an I-20 or DS-2019 but has not yet entered the U.S. Active indicates the student is enrolled and maintaining status. Completed indicates the student has finished their program.

attributes.name: transfer_pending
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the student has a pending SEVIS transfer to another institution. During a transfer, the student's SEVIS record is released from the current school to the new school.

attributes.name: transfer_release_date
attributes.description: The date on which the student's SEVIS record was released to another institution for transfer. The student must report to the new school within 15 days of the program start date or the transfer release date, whichever is later.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this visa and immigration record was most recently updated. Used for audit trail and change tracking to ensure data quality and compliance.

attributes.name: visa_expiration_date
attributes.description: The date on which the visa expires. Note that for F-1 and J-1 visas, students may remain in the U.S. beyond this date as long as they maintain valid status (D/S - Duration of Status).

attributes.name: visa_issue_date
attributes.description: The date on which the visa was issued by the U.S. consulate or embassy. This is the date stamped on the visa in the student's passport.

attributes.name: visa_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the visa record. Active indicates the visa is valid and the student is in compliance. Expired indicates the visa has passed its expiration date. Terminated indicates the visa was ended due to program completion or violation.

attributes.name: visa_type
attributes.description: The type of visa held by the international student. F-1 is for academic students, J-1 for exchange visitors, M-1 for vocational students, H-1B for specialty occupation workers, and other categories for dependents and special cases. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: F-1|F-2|J-1|J-2|M-1|M-2|H-1B|H-4|O-1|TN|L-1|B-1|B-2 — 13 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: U.S. Department of State Visa Categories, SEVP

products.name: graduation_application
products.description: Records a student's formal application to graduate, including application term, degree level, degree program, diploma name, diploma mailing address, commencement participation intent, commencement ceremony selection, application status (pending, approved, denied, deferred), degree conferral date, diploma print date, diploma hold flag, and Latin honors designation (cum laude, magna cum laude, summa cum laude). Drives the degree conferral workflow and IPEDS Completions Survey submissions.
products.reference: Ellucian Banner SHAGAPP / IPEDS Completions Survey

attributes.name: graduation_application_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the graduation application record. Primary key for the graduation application entity.

attributes.name: application_term_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to enrollment.term. Business justification: Degree conferral processing and commencement planning require term linkage for application deadlines, degree audit scheduling, and diploma ordering. Application_term_code alone insufficient for automa

attributes.name: profile_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier of the student submitting the graduation application. Links to the student master record.

attributes.name: regulatory_requirement_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.regulatory_requirement. Business justification: Degree conferral reporting to state and federal agencies is regulatory. Graduation data feeds IPEDS Completions survey and state authorization reports. Essential for regulatory filing preparation.

attributes.name: application_approved_date
attributes.description: Date the graduation application was approved by the registrar or academic dean. Null if not yet approved.

attributes.name: application_fee_amount
attributes.description: Dollar amount of the graduation application fee charged to the student. Null if no fee is charged by the institution.

attributes.name: application_fee_paid_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the graduation application fee has been paid. True if paid, False if outstanding. Some institutions charge a fee for graduation application processing.

attributes.name: application_number
attributes.description: Human-readable business identifier for the graduation application, typically displayed on student portals and official communications.

attributes.name: application_status
attributes.description: Current workflow status of the graduation application. Pending indicates under review, Approved means cleared for degree conferral, Denied indicates requirements not met, Deferred means postponed to future term.

attributes.name: application_submitted_date
attributes.description: Date the student submitted the graduation application. Used to track application deadlines and processing timelines.

attributes.name: cip_code
attributes.description: Six-digit CIP code classifying the field of study for federal IPEDS reporting. Format: XX.XXXX (e.g., 52.0201 for Business Administration).
attributes.references: National Center for Education Statistics CIP 2020

attributes.name: commencement_ceremony_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the specific commencement ceremony the student will attend (e.g., College of Engineering ceremony, Graduate School ceremony). Null if not participating.

attributes.name: commencement_participation_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the student intends to participate in the commencement ceremony. True if participating, False if not attending.

attributes.name: concentration_code
attributes.description: Optional code identifying the academic concentration, specialization, or track within the program (e.g., Finance concentration within Business major).

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the graduation application record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage tracking.

attributes.name: degree_audit_date
attributes.description: Date the final degree audit was completed to verify all graduation requirements were met. Typically performed by the registrar's office.

attributes.name: degree_audit_performed_by
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the registrar staff member who performed the final degree audit. Used for accountability and audit trail purposes.

attributes.name: degree_code
attributes.description: Institutional code representing the specific degree or credential being conferred (e.g., BA, BS, MBA, PhD, AA). Links to the degree catalog.

attributes.name: degree_conferral_date
attributes.description: Official date the degree was conferred by the institution. This is the graduation date that appears on transcripts and is reported to IPEDS. Null until degree is officially awarded.

attributes.name: degree_level
attributes.description: Level of degree or credential for which the student is applying (Associate, Bachelor, Master, Doctoral, Certificate, Diploma). Used for IPEDS Completions Survey reporting.

attributes.name: degree_requirements_met_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether all degree requirements have been satisfied (credit hours, GPA, major requirements, general education, residency). True if all requirements met, False if deficiencies exist.

attributes.name: diploma_hold_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether there is a hold preventing diploma release (e.g., outstanding financial obligations, unreturned library materials, conduct sanctions). True if hold exists, False if clear.

attributes.name: diploma_hold_reason
attributes.description: Description of the reason for the diploma hold (e.g., Outstanding tuition balance, Library fines, Conduct sanction). Null if no hold exists.

attributes.name: diploma_mailed_date
attributes.description: Date the diploma was mailed to the student. Used for tracking diploma fulfillment and student inquiries. Null until diploma is mailed.

attributes.name: diploma_mailing_address_line1
attributes.description: First line of the mailing address where the diploma should be sent. Protected under FERPA as student directory information.

attributes.name: diploma_mailing_address_line2
attributes.description: Second line of the mailing address (apartment, suite, building number). Optional field. Protected under FERPA.

attributes.name: diploma_mailing_city
attributes.description: City for diploma mailing address. Protected under FERPA as student directory information.

attributes.name: diploma_mailing_country_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO country code for diploma mailing address (e.g., USA, CAN, GBR). Protected under FERPA.

attributes.name: diploma_mailing_postal_code
attributes.description: Postal or ZIP code for diploma mailing address. Protected under FERPA as student directory information.

attributes.name: diploma_mailing_state_province
attributes.description: State or province code for diploma mailing address (e.g., CA, TX, ON). Protected under FERPA.

attributes.name: diploma_name
attributes.description: Full legal name as it should appear on the printed diploma. May differ from current student name due to name changes or preferred formatting. Protected under FERPA.

attributes.name: diploma_print_date
attributes.description: Date the physical diploma was printed. Used for tracking diploma production and fulfillment workflows. Null until diploma is printed.

attributes.name: graduation_gpa
attributes.description: Final cumulative GPA at the time of graduation. This is the official GPA that appears on the final transcript and diploma.

attributes.name: honors_gpa
attributes.description: Cumulative GPA used to determine Latin honors eligibility. May differ from overall GPA if institution uses specific calculation rules (e.g., excluding transfer credits).

attributes.name: institutional_credits_earned
attributes.description: Number of credit hours earned at the degree-granting institution (excluding transfer credits). Used for residency requirement verification.

attributes.name: ipeds_reported_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: IPEDS (Integrated Postsecondary Education Data System) Reported Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this degree completion has been reported to IPEDS for the annual Completions Survey. True if reported, False if not yet reported.

attributes.name: ipeds_reporting_year
attributes.business_glossary_term: IPEDS (Integrated Postsecondary Education Data System) Reporting Year
attributes.description: Academic year for which this completion was reported to IPEDS (e.g., 2024 for 2023-2024 academic year). Null if not yet reported.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the graduation application record was last updated. Used for audit trail and change tracking.

attributes.name: latin_honors_designation
attributes.description: Latin honors awarded based on cumulative GPA thresholds (Cum Laude, Magna Cum Laude, Summa Cum Laude). Null if student does not qualify for honors. Appears on diploma and transcript.
attributes.value_regex: Cum Laude|Magna Cum Laude|Summa Cum Laude

attributes.name: program_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the academic program (major) from which the student is graduating. Links to the curriculum program catalog.

attributes.name: special_recognition
attributes.description: Additional honors, awards, or recognitions to be noted on the diploma or transcript (e.g., Honors Program Graduate, Phi Beta Kappa, Dean's List). Free-text field for institutional flexibility.

attributes.name: total_credits_earned
attributes.description: Total number of credit hours earned by the student at the time of graduation, including transfer credits if applicable. Used to verify degree completion requirements.

attributes.name: transfer_credits_accepted
attributes.description: Number of transfer credit hours accepted toward the degree from other institutions. Used for degree audit and IPEDS reporting.

products.name: advising_note
products.description: Captures academic advising interactions, early alert interventions, and student success case management records. Includes note type (academic plan, early alert, degree audit review, probation counseling, career advising, retention intervention), alert trigger (attendance, grade, engagement, financial, behavioral), alert source, risk level, meeting modality (in-person, virtual, phone, email), meeting date and duration, topics discussed, action items assigned, follow-up date, intervention outcome, referral made (to tutoring, counseling, financial aid), case resolution status, and FERPA-sensitive flag. Supports early alert systems, student success platforms (Starfish, EAB Navigate), and retention intervention tracking.
products.reference: Ellucian Banner SPACMNT / EAB Navigate / Civitas Learning

attributes.name: advising_note_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the advising note record. Primary key for the advising note entity.

attributes.name: academic_term_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to enrollment.term. Business justification: Academic advising and early alert systems require term context for intervention timing, course-specific concerns, and retention analytics. Academic_term_code insufficient for term-based reporting dash

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Advising services are budgeted to academic advising or college-specific cost centers. Business process: advisor FTE and program costs are allocated to cost centers for budget management and resource a

attributes.name: course_section_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to instruction.course_section. Business justification: Advising notes frequently document course-specific academic concerns, performance issues, and interventions. Advisors need to reference the exact section when discussing attendance problems, grade con

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: The system user identifier of the person who created the advising note record. Supports accountability and audit trails.

attributes.name: identity_account_id
attributes.description: The system user identifier of the person who last modified the advising note record. Supports change tracking and accountability.

attributes.name: instructor_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the faculty or staff member who created this advising note. Links to the faculty or staff record.

attributes.name: profile_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the student who is the subject of this advising note. Links to the student master record.
attributes.references: FERPA - Family Educational Rights and Privacy Act

attributes.name: service_request_id

attributes.description: Total cumulative credit hours successfully completed (earned) by the student at the time of this SAP evaluation. Used to calculate pace/completion rate.
