attributes.name: evaluation_type
attributes.description: Type of SAP evaluation conducted: annual (end-of-year standard review), mid-year (mid-term checkpoint), appeal (student-initiated review following suspension), reinstatement (review after academic plan completion), probation_review (review during probation period), or warning_review (review during warning period).

attributes.name: financial_aid_eligibility
attributes.description: Current Title IV financial aid eligibility status resulting from this SAP evaluation: eligible (aid continues), suspended (aid stopped), reinstated (aid resumed after appeal), or conditional (aid continues under academic plan).

attributes.name: gpa_requirement_met
attributes.description: Indicates whether the student met the minimum cumulative GPA requirement for SAP at the time of evaluation. True if cumulative_gpa >= gpa_threshold.

attributes.name: gpa_threshold
attributes.description: Minimum cumulative GPA required for satisfactory academic progress at the time of this evaluation. Threshold may vary by student level (undergraduate, graduate) and program.

attributes.name: ipeds_reportable
attributes.business_glossary_term: Integrated Postsecondary Education Data System (IPEDS) Reportable Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this SAP evaluation record should be included in IPEDS reporting submissions. True if reportable.

attributes.name: is_active
attributes.description: Indicates whether this SAP evaluation record is currently active and represents the most recent evaluation for the student in the given term. True if active, false if superseded or voided.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this SAP evaluation record was last modified. Critical for tracking changes to SAP status and appeal decisions.

attributes.name: maximum_timeframe_credits
attributes.description: Maximum number of credit hours allowed for the student to complete their program (typically 150% of published program length). Once exceeded, student loses Title IV eligibility.

attributes.name: maximum_timeframe_met
attributes.description: Indicates whether the student is within the maximum timeframe allowed to complete their program. True if credits_attempted < maximum_timeframe_credits and student can mathematically complete within maximum timeframe.

attributes.name: notification_date
attributes.description: Date on which the student was notified of their SAP evaluation results. Critical for compliance documentation.

attributes.name: notification_method
attributes.description: Method by which the student was notified of SAP results: email, mail (postal), portal (student information system), or in_person (face-to-face meeting).

attributes.name: notification_sent
attributes.description: Indicates whether the student was formally notified of their SAP evaluation results. True if notification was sent.

attributes.name: overall_sap_status
attributes.description: Overall SAP status determination: satisfactory (all requirements met), warning (first failure, aid continues), probation (appeal approved with academic plan, aid continues), suspension (aid suspended), or reinstatement (aid reinstated after successful appeal or plan completion).

attributes.name: pace_requirement_met
attributes.description: Indicates whether the student met the minimum completion rate (pace) requirement for SAP. True if completion_rate >= completion_rate_threshold.

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Name of the source system from which this SAP evaluation record originated (e.g., Ellucian Banner Financial Aid module). Used for data lineage and integration tracking.

products.name: degree_conferral
products.description: Official record of a degree, certificate, or credential lifecycle from application through conferral. Captures graduation application fields (application term, application status, commencement participation intent, commencement ceremony selection, diploma mailing address), degree details (degree type, degree title, CIP code, degree level), conferral fields (conferral date, conferral term, Latin honors awarded, institutional unit), diploma management (diploma number, diploma status, diploma hold flag, print date), and IPEDS Completions Survey submission status. This is the permanent, immutable record of academic credential award once conferred, and the authoritative source for transcript degree notation and commencement processing.
products.reference: Ellucian Banner SHADEGR / IPEDS Completions Survey / NSC Degree Verify

attributes.name: degree_conferral_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the degree conferral record. Primary key for this entity. This is the permanent, immutable record of academic credential award once conferred.

attributes.name: academic_program_id
attributes.description: Reference to the academic program from which the degree was conferred. Links to the curriculum domain program catalog.

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the system user or process that created this record. Used for audit trail and accountability.

attributes.name: identity_account_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the system user or process that last modified this record. Used for audit trail and accountability.

attributes.name: profile_id
attributes.description: Reference to the student who received the degree. Links to the student master record in the Student Information System (SIS).

attributes.name: scholarly_output_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to research.scholarly_output. Business justification: Doctoral and master's degrees often require thesis/dissertation as scholarly output; linking degree conferral to the resulting publication enables completion tracking, embargo management, and institut

attributes.name: application_date
attributes.description: Date the student submitted their graduation application. Used to track application processing timelines and compliance with institutional deadlines.

attributes.name: application_status
attributes.description: Current status of the graduation application. Tracks the application through the degree audit and conferral workflow.

attributes.name: application_term_code
attributes.description: Academic term code in which the student applied for graduation. May differ from conferral term if application was submitted early or deferred.

attributes.name: cip_code
attributes.description: Six-digit CIP code identifying the field of study. Required for IPEDS Completions Survey reporting and federal compliance.

attributes.name: commencement_ceremony_date
attributes.description: Date of the commencement ceremony the student attended or was eligible to attend. May differ from conferral date.

attributes.name: commencement_ceremony_name
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the specific commencement ceremony (e.g., Spring 2023 Undergraduate Ceremony, College of Engineering Ceremony). Used when multiple ceremonies are held.

attributes.name: commencement_participation_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the student participated in the commencement ceremony. Used for ceremony planning and alumni engagement.

attributes.name: concentration
attributes.description: Specific concentration, specialization, or track within the major, if applicable. Appears on transcript and diploma when awarded.

attributes.name: conferral_academic_year
attributes.description: Academic year in which the degree was conferred (e.g., 2022-2023). Used for annual reporting and trend analysis.

attributes.name: conferral_date
attributes.description: Official date the degree was conferred by the institution. This is the authoritative date that appears on the diploma and transcript. Typically set by the Board of Trustees or Regents.

attributes.name: conferral_term_code
attributes.description: Academic term code in which the degree was conferred (e.g., 202305 for Spring 2023). Used for cohort analysis and IPEDS reporting.

attributes.name: conferring_college
attributes.description: Name of the college, school, or academic unit that conferred the degree (e.g., College of Engineering, School of Business). Used for organizational reporting.

attributes.name: conferring_department
attributes.description: Academic department responsible for the program from which the degree was conferred. Used for departmental analytics and accreditation reporting.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this degree conferral record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage.

attributes.name: degree_audit_date
attributes.description: Date the degree audit was completed and requirements were verified. Used for compliance tracking and process improvement.

attributes.name: degree_audit_status
attributes.description: Status of the degree audit process verifying that all degree requirements have been satisfied. Critical gate before conferral approval.

attributes.name: degree_code
attributes.description: Institutional code representing the degree type. Used for internal classification and reporting.

attributes.name: degree_level
attributes.description: Level of the degree conferred. Used for IPEDS reporting and institutional analytics.

attributes.name: degree_title
attributes.description: Official title of the degree as it appears on the diploma and transcript (e.g., Bachelor of Science in Computer Science, Master of Business Administration).

attributes.name: degree_type
attributes.description: Type classification of the degree (e.g., BA, BS, MA, MS, MBA, PhD, EdD, Certificate). Distinguishes between degree variants at the same level.

attributes.name: diploma_hold_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a hold is preventing diploma release. Holds may be financial, disciplinary, or administrative.

attributes.name: diploma_hold_reason
attributes.description: Description of the reason for the diploma hold. Used for student communication and hold resolution tracking.

attributes.name: diploma_mail_date
attributes.description: Date the diploma was mailed to the graduate. Used for tracking fulfillment and resolving delivery inquiries.

attributes.name: diploma_number
attributes.description: Unique serial number printed on the physical diploma. Used for diploma verification and fraud prevention.

attributes.name: diploma_print_date
attributes.description: Date the diploma was printed. Used for tracking diploma production timelines and fulfillment metrics.

attributes.name: diploma_status
attributes.description: Current status of the physical diploma in the production and distribution workflow.

attributes.name: ferpa_directory_hold_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Family Educational Rights and Privacy Act (FERPA) Directory Hold Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the student has requested suppression of directory information including degree conferral. Used for FERPA compliance and privacy protection.

attributes.name: gpa_at_conferral
attributes.description: Cumulative GPA at the time of degree conferral. Used to determine honors eligibility and for alumni records.

attributes.name: honors_designation
attributes.description: Latin honors or institutional honors awarded with the degree based on cumulative GPA (Grade Point Average) or other academic achievement criteria. Appears on diploma and transcript.

attributes.name: institutional_credits_earned
attributes.description: Number of credit hours earned at the conferring institution, excluding transfer credits. Used to verify residency requirements.

attributes.name: ipeds_reportable_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Integrated Postsecondary Education Data System (IPEDS) Reportable Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this degree conferral should be included in the IPEDS Completions Survey. Used for federal reporting compliance.

attributes.name: ipeds_submission_date
attributes.business_glossary_term: Integrated Postsecondary Education Data System (IPEDS) Submission Date
attributes.description: Date this degree conferral record was included in an IPEDS Completions Survey submission. Used for audit trail and compliance verification.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this degree conferral record was last updated. Used for audit trail and change tracking.

attributes.name: major
attributes.description: Primary major or field of study for the degree. May differ from degree title in cases of interdisciplinary programs.

attributes.name: minor
attributes.description: Secondary field of study or minor completed as part of the degree requirements, if applicable.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes related to the degree conferral. May include special circumstances, exceptions, or administrative annotations.

attributes.name: total_credits_earned
attributes.description: Total number of credit hours earned toward the degree at the time of conferral. Includes transfer credits if applicable.

products.name: conduct_record
products.description: Tracks student disciplinary incidents, conduct code violations, investigations, hearings, sanctions, and outcomes. Captures incident date, violation type (academic integrity, behavioral, substance, harassment), reporting party, investigation status, hearing date, hearing body (conduct board, dean of students), finding (responsible, not responsible), sanction type (warning, probation, suspension, expulsion), sanction start and end dates, appeal status, and expungement eligibility. Supports Title IX coordination, Clery Act reporting, and student conduct history for readmission decisions.

attributes.name: academic_term_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to enrollment.term. Business justification: Student conduct administration requires term context for sanction timing, enrollment impact assessment, and Clery Act reporting. Academic_term_code insufficient for automated hold placement tied to te

attributes.name: building_id

attributes.name: cost_center_id

attributes.name: policy_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.policy. Business justification: Conduct violations are adjudicated under specific student conduct policies. Every conduct case cites the policy violated; sanctions and procedures are policy-driven. Essential for conduct case managem

attributes.name: profile_id
attributes.description: Reference to the student who is the subject of this conduct record. Links to the student profile entity.

attributes.name: appeal_decision_date
attributes.description: The date on which the appeals authority rendered a final decision on the students appeal, concluding the appeals process.

attributes.name: appeal_decision_rationale
attributes.description: Detailed explanation of the reasoning and justification for the appeals decision, documenting the basis for upholding, modifying, or overturning the original finding.

attributes.name: appeal_grounds
attributes.description: The basis or rationale cited by the student for appealing the conduct finding or sanction (e.g., procedural error, new evidence, disproportionate sanction).

attributes.name: appeal_status
attributes.description: Current status of the appeal, indicating the stage of review and whether the original finding or sanction has been affirmed, modified, or reversed.

attributes.name: appeal_submission_date
attributes.description: The date on which the student formally submitted an appeal of the conduct finding or sanction to the appropriate appeals authority.

attributes.name: appeal_submitted_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the student has submitted a formal appeal of the conduct finding or sanction, triggering the appeals review process.

attributes.name: case_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the conduct case, tracking its progression through the institutional conduct process from report to resolution. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: reported|under_investigation|pending_hearing|hearing_scheduled|resolved|closed|appealed — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: expungement_date

attributes.name: finding
attributes.description: The official determination or verdict rendered by the hearing body regarding whether the student is responsible for the alleged conduct violation.

attributes.name: finding_date
attributes.description: The date on which the official finding or verdict was rendered by the hearing body or conduct officer.

attributes.name: hearing_body

attributes.name: hearing_required_flag

attributes.name: hearing_type

attributes.name: incident_date

attributes.name: incident_number

attributes.name: incident_time

attributes.name: investigation_completion_date
attributes.description: The date on which the investigation was completed and findings were documented, marking readiness for adjudication.

attributes.name: investigation_start_date

attributes.name: investigation_status
attributes.description: Current status of the investigation phase of the conduct case, indicating progress in gathering evidence and interviewing parties.

attributes.name: investigator_name
attributes.description: Name of the staff member or official assigned to investigate the conduct incident and gather evidence.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this conduct record was most recently updated or modified, supporting audit trail and data lineage tracking.

attributes.name: notes

attributes.name: report_date
attributes.description: The date on which the conduct incident was formally reported to the institution or conduct office.

attributes.name: reporting_party_name

products.name: student_enrollment
products.description: This association product represents the enrollment event between a student profile and a course section. It captures the operational record of a student's registration in a specific course section for a specific term. Each record links one student to one course section with attributes that exist only in the context of this enrollment relationship, including registration status, grade mode, credit hours attempted, and waitlist information.. Existence Justification: Student enrollment in course sections is a canonical many-to-many relationship in higher education. One student enrolls in multiple course sections per term (typically 4-6 courses), and one course section has multiple enrolled students (typically 20-300 depending on course level and delivery mode). The enrollment relationship itself is a first-class business entity that the institution actively manages through registration workflows, add/drop processes, waitlist management, and grade mode selection.

attributes.name: student_enrollment_id
attributes.description: Primary key for student_enrollment

attributes.name: course_section_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the course section in which the student is enrolled

attributes.name: enrollment_registration_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for this enrollment record. Primary key for the enrollment association.

attributes.name: profile_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the student profile who is enrolled in the course section

attributes.name: term_id
attributes.description: Reference to the academic term for this enrollment. Denormalized from course_section for query performance and to support historical enrollment queries when section records may be archived.

attributes.name: add_authorization_code
attributes.description: Authorization code provided by instructor or department to allow enrollment in a closed or restricted section. Captured from detection phase relationship data.

attributes.name: add_date
attributes.description: Date when the student was added to the course section. Part of add/drop tracking mentioned in detection phase.

attributes.name: credit_hours_attempted
attributes.description: Number of credit hours the student is attempting for this specific enrollment. May differ from the section's standard credit hours if student is taking for variable credit. Captured from detection phase relationship data.

attributes.name: drop_date
attributes.description: Date when the student dropped or withdrew from the course section. Null if still enrolled. Part of add/drop tracking mentioned in detection phase.

attributes.name: grade_mode
attributes.description: Grading scheme the student has selected for this enrollment. Captured from detection phase relationship data. Values: letter (standard A-F), pass_fail, audit (no grade), satisfactory_unsatisfactory.

attributes.name: repeat_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether this enrollment is a repeat of a previously taken course. Used for grade replacement policies and academic standing calculations. Captured from detection phase relationship data.

attributes.name: student_enrollment_date
attributes.description: Timestamp when the student enrolled in this course section. Captured from the detection phase relationship data as enrollment_date.

attributes.name: student_enrollment_status
attributes.description: Current status of the enrollment. Captured from detection phase as enrollment_status and registration_status. Values: enrolled (active), dropped (removed before census), withdrawn (removed after census), completed (finished course).

attributes.name: waitlist_position
attributes.description: Position of the student on the waitlist if enrollment status is waitlisted. Null if student is enrolled or not on waitlist. Captured from detection phase relationship data.

products.name: student_submission
products.description: This association product represents the submission event between a student profile and an academic assignment. It captures the act of a student submitting work for evaluation, including submission timing, attempt tracking, grading outcomes, and late/excused status. Each record links one student to one assignment submission instance with attributes that exist only in the context of this specific submission event.. Existence Justification: Student assignment submission is a genuine operational M:N relationship. In real academic operations, one student submits work to many assignments across multiple courses throughout a term, and one assignment receives submissions from many enrolled students. The submission itself is a recognized business event that faculty and students actively manage, with distinct attributes (submission timing, attempt number, score, late status, grading feedback) that belong to neither the student profile nor the assignment alone.

attributes.name: student_submission_id
attributes.description: Primary key for student_submission

attributes.name: instruction_assignment_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the academic assignment being submitted

attributes.name: instructor_id
attributes.description: Reference to the faculty or TA user who graded this submission. Used for grading workflow tracking and audit.

attributes.name: profile_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the student profile who submitted the assignment

attributes.name: submission_id
attributes.description: Primary key for the submission record. Uniquely identifies each student submission event.

attributes.name: attempt_number
attributes.description: Sequential attempt number for this submission. Increments with each resubmission. Used when assignment allows multiple attempts.

attributes.name: comments
attributes.description: Feedback comments provided by the grader to the student about their submission. May include suggestions for improvement or explanations of scoring.

attributes.name: file_upload_path
attributes.description: Storage path or URL to the submitted file(s) in the institutional file system or LMS. Used for retrieval and archival.

attributes.name: grade
attributes.description: The letter grade or qualitative assessment assigned to this submission (e.g., A, B+, Pass, Fail). Format depends on assignment.grading_type.

attributes.name: graded_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the instructor or grader evaluated and scored this submission. Null if submission is not yet graded.

attributes.name: is_excused
attributes.description: Indicates whether the student has been excused from this assignment due to accommodations, illness, or other approved reasons. Excused submissions do not count against grade.

attributes.name: is_late
attributes.description: Indicates whether the submission was received after the assignment due_date. Automatically calculated by comparing submission_timestamp to due_date.

attributes.name: score
attributes.description: The numeric score awarded to the student for this submission. Must be less than or equal to assignment.points_possible.

attributes.name: submission_timestamp
attributes.description: The exact date and time when the student submitted their work. Used to determine late status by comparing against assignment due_date.

attributes.name: submission_type
attributes.description: The method by which the student submitted their work. Must align with the allowed submission_type on the assignment.

attributes.name: turnitin_score
attributes.description: Percentage similarity score from Turnitin or similar plagiarism detection service. Null if plagiarism checking is not enabled for this assignment.

attributes.name: workflow_state
attributes.description: Current state of the submission in the grading workflow. Tracks progression from submission through grading to return.

products.name: checkout
products.description: This association product represents the lending transaction between a student and an IT asset. It captures the operational checkout process managed by IT departments for equipment lending (laptops, tablets, hotspots, lab equipment). Each record links one student to one IT asset for a specific checkout period with attributes that exist only in the context of this lending relationship, including checkout/return dates, condition assessments, damage fees, and responsible staff.. Existence Justification: In higher education IT operations, students check out multiple IT assets over time (laptops, tablets, hotspots, lab equipment for coursework or temporary needs), and each IT asset is checked out by multiple students across semesters and academic years. IT departments actively manage this lending operation as a core service, tracking each checkout transaction with temporal attributes (checkout/return dates), condition assessments at both checkout and return, damage fees, responsible staff, and compliance status. This is an operational business process where the checkout itself is a managed entity.

attributes.name: checkout_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for this checkout transaction. Primary key for the checkout association.

attributes.name: it_asset_id
attributes.description: Foreign key to technology.it_asset.it_asset_id identifying the asset that was checked out

attributes.name: profile_id
attributes.description: Foreign key to student.profile.profile_id identifying the student who checked out the asset

attributes.name: responsible_party_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key to the IT staff employee who processed the checkout transaction and is responsible for condition assessment and compliance tracking

attributes.name: checkout_date
attributes.description: Date and time when the student checked out the IT asset from the lending facility

attributes.name: checkout_status
attributes.description: Current status of the checkout transaction tracking the lifecycle from active checkout through return or loss

attributes.name: condition_at_checkout
attributes.description: Assessment of the IT asset's physical and functional condition at the time of checkout, documented to establish baseline for return comparison

attributes.name: condition_at_return
attributes.description: Assessment of the IT asset's physical and functional condition at the time of return, compared against checkout condition to identify damage

attributes.name: damage_fee_assessed
attributes.description: Monetary fee assessed to the student for damage to the IT asset beyond normal wear and tear, determined by comparing checkout and return conditions

attributes.name: expected_return_date
attributes.description: Date by which the student is expected to return the IT asset, used for compliance tracking and overdue notifications

attributes.name: location
attributes.description: Physical location (building/room) where the checkout transaction occurred, typically an IT help desk or equipment lending office

attributes.name: purpose
attributes.description: Business reason or purpose for the checkout (e.g., coursework, research project, temporary replacement, semester loan, emergency access)

attributes.name: return_date
attributes.description: Date and time when the student returned the IT asset to the lending facility. Null if asset is still checked out.

products.name: student_training_completion
products.description: This association product represents the completion event between a student profile and a compliance training program. It captures the student's participation in mandatory compliance training, including completion status, assessment scores, certificate issuance, and recertification tracking. Each record links one student to one training program with attributes that exist only in the context of this specific training completion.. Existence Justification: In higher education compliance operations, students are required to complete multiple mandatory training programs (Title IX, FERPA, Clery Act, academic integrity, research ethics), and each training program is completed by many students across different cohorts and time periods. The compliance office actively manages these training completions as a distinct business process, tracking assignment, progress, scores, certificates, and recertification cycles for audit and regulatory reporting purposes.

attributes.name: student_training_completion_id
attributes.description: Primary key for student_training_completion

attributes.name: profile_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the student profile who completed or is assigned the training

attributes.name: training_completion_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for this training completion record. Primary key for the association.

attributes.name: training_program_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the compliance training program that was completed

attributes.name: assessment_score
attributes.description: Percentage score achieved on the training assessment (0.00 to 100.00). Null if training has not been attempted or does not include an assessment. Compared against training_program.passing_score_percentage to determine pass/fail. Explicitly identified in detection phase relationship data.

attributes.name: assignment_date
attributes.description: Date when this training was assigned to the student. Used to calculate completion deadline based on training_program.completion_deadline_days.

attributes.name: attempt_number
attributes.description: Sequential attempt number for this training assignment. Increments each time the student retakes the training (e.g., after failure or for recertification). First attempt is 1. Explicitly identified in detection phase relationship data.

attributes.name: certificate_number
attributes.description: Unique certificate number issued upon successful completion of the training. Only populated if training_program.certificate_issued_flag is true and completion_status is completed. Used for audit and verification purposes. Explicitly identified in detection phase relationship data.

attributes.name: completion_date
attributes.description: Date when the student successfully completed the training program. Null if training is not yet completed. Explicitly identified in detection phase relationship data.

attributes.name: completion_status
attributes.description: Current status of the training completion. Values: assigned (not started), in_progress (started but not finished), completed (successfully finished), failed (did not pass assessment), expired (deadline passed without completion), waived (exempted by compliance office). Explicitly identified in detection phase relationship data.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this training completion record was created in the system.

attributes.name: expiration_date

products.name: student_housing_assignment
products.description: This association product represents the assignment of a student to a residential room within campus housing. It captures the operational relationship between students and their assigned living spaces across academic terms. Each record links one student profile to one room with attributes that track assignment dates, occupancy type, access credentials, and roommate designation. This is the authoritative source for residential life operations, key management, and housing billing.. Existence Justification: Student housing assignment is a true operational many-to-many relationship in higher education. Students are assigned to multiple rooms over their academic career (freshman dorm, sophomore suite, off-campus return, summer housing), and rooms house multiple students both simultaneously (doubles, triples, suites with 2-4 occupants) and sequentially across terms. Residential Life actively manages these assignments as discrete operational records with assignment dates, key issuance, access levels, billing rates, and roommate designations.

attributes.name: student_housing_assignment_id
attributes.description: Primary key for student_housing_assignment

attributes.name: housing_assignment_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for this housing assignment record. Primary key.

attributes.name: profile_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the student profile who is assigned to the room

attributes.name: room_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the residential room being assigned

attributes.name: access_level
attributes.description: The level of physical access the student has to the assigned room. Full access for standard occupants, restricted for probationary status, guest for temporary visitors, suspended for disciplinary holds.

attributes.name: assignment_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the housing assignment. Pending for future assignments, active for current occupancy, completed for past assignments, cancelled for withdrawn assignments, no-show for students who never moved in.

attributes.name: assignment_type
attributes.description: Classification of the housing assignment period (academic year, semester, summer session, temporary, break housing). Determines billing cycle and contract terms.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp when this housing assignment record was created.

attributes.name: end_date
attributes.description: The date when the student's housing assignment ends and they must vacate the room. Used for move-out scheduling and billing end. May be null for ongoing assignments.

attributes.name: key_card_issued
attributes.description: Indicates whether a physical key card or access credential has been issued to the student for this room assignment. Used for key inventory management and security audits.

attributes.name: key_card_number
attributes.description: The unique identifier of the physical key card issued to the student for room access. Used for lost key tracking and replacement billing.

attributes.name: meal_plan_code
attributes.description: The meal plan associated with this housing assignment, if required. Many residential halls require meal plan enrollment. Links to dining services billing.

attributes.name: primary_occupant_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this student is designated as the primary occupant of the room (true) or a secondary roommate (false). Used for billing responsibility and room preference priority in multi-occupancy rooms.

attributes.name: room_rate_code
attributes.description: The billing rate code applied to this specific assignment, which may vary based on room type, assignment duration, and student financial aid status. Links to housing billing system.

attributes.name: special_accommodations
attributes.description: Description of any ADA or medical accommodations approved for this housing assignment (e.g., ground floor, private bathroom, emotional support animal). Sensitive data requiring FERPA protection.

attributes.name: start_date
attributes.description: The date when the student's housing assignment begins and they are authorized to occupy the room. Used for move-in scheduling and billing start.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp when this housing assignment record was last modified.

attributes.name: created_by
attributes.description: User ID or system identifier of the person or process that created this assignment record.

products.name: access_authorization
products.description: This association product represents the authorization relationship between students and buildings for physical access control. It captures time-bound, role-specific access permissions for research students, graduate assistants, and student employees who require card access to lab buildings, libraries, studios, and other facilities. Each record links one student profile to one building with authorization dates, access levels, and permission types that exist only in the context of this access relationship. Critical for campus security, facilities access management, and compliance with physical security policies.. Existence Justification: In higher education operations, students require physical access to multiple buildings simultaneously based on their research projects, employment positions, and academic program requirements (labs, libraries, studios, athletic facilities). Conversely, each building grants access to many students with varying authorization types, access levels, and time periods. Building access authorization is an actively managed operational process where facilities and campus security create, review, extend, and revoke access permissions with specific attributes (dates, access levels, after-hours permissions) that belong to each student-building authorization relationship.

attributes.name: access_authorization_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for this building access authorization record. Primary key for the association.

attributes.name: building_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the building for which access is authorized

attributes.name: profile_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the student profile who is authorized for building access

attributes.name: access_level
attributes.description: Level of access granted within the building indicating which areas the student can access (basic common areas, restricted labs/studios, full building access, emergency exits only). Determines which card readers will grant entry.

attributes.name: access_type
attributes.description: Type of access authorization indicating the business reason for access (research project, student employment, academic program requirement, administrative role, athletic facility use). Determines authorization workflow and approval requirements.

attributes.name: after_hours_access
attributes.description: Indicates whether the student is authorized for building access outside of normal operating hours (evenings, weekends, holidays). Requires additional approval for security and safety reasons.

attributes.name: authorization_end_date
attributes.description: Date on which the student's building access authorization expires. Card access is automatically disabled after this date. May be extended through reauthorization process.

attributes.name: authorization_start_date
attributes.description: Date on which the student's building access authorization becomes active. Card access is enabled starting on this date.

attributes.name: authorization_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the access authorization indicating whether it is active, expired, revoked for cause, temporarily suspended, or pending approval.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to this access authorization record.

attributes.name: revocation_reason
attributes.description: Reason for access revocation if authorization was terminated before the end date (project completion, employment termination, security violation, graduation, program withdrawal).

attributes.name: supervisor_name
attributes.description: Name of the faculty member, principal investigator, or supervisor who authorized this access. Required for research and employment-based access.

products.name: participation
products.description: This association product represents the participation relationship between a student profile and an IRB research protocol. It captures the operational record of a student's involvement as a human subject in an IRB-approved research study. Each record links one student to one research protocol with attributes that track consent, enrollment timing, participation status, role, and adverse events specific to that student's participation in that specific study. Required for IRB compliance, continuing review, OHRP reporting, and protocol closeout.. Existence Justification: In higher education research operations, students participate as human subjects in multiple IRB-approved research protocols (psychology studies, clinical trials, educational research), and each protocol enrolls multiple student participants. Universities actively manage these participation relationships through IRB compliance workflows including consent tracking, enrollment monitoring, adverse event reporting, continuing review, and protocol closeout. The participation relationship is an operational business entity with specific attributes (consent dates, enrollment status, adverse events, compensation) that belong to neither the student profile nor the protocol alone.

attributes.name: participation_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for this student-protocol participation record. Primary key for the participation association.

attributes.name: profile_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the student profile who is participating as a human subject in the research protocol.

attributes.name: research_irb_protocol_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the IRB protocol in which the student is participating.

attributes.name: adverse_event_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this student experienced any adverse events during their participation in this protocol. Adverse events must be reported to the IRB within specified timeframes and tracked for safety monitoring.

attributes.name: compensation_amount
attributes.description: Total monetary compensation paid to the student for their participation in the research study. Must be disclosed in informed consent and tracked for IRB compliance and financial reporting.

attributes.name: compensation_paid_date
attributes.description: Date on which compensation was paid to the student participant. Used for financial reconciliation and to ensure timely payment per IRB-approved protocol.

attributes.name: completion_date
attributes.description: Date on which the student completed all study procedures and their participation ended normally. Used for protocol closeout reporting and to calculate actual vs. planned study duration.

attributes.name: consent_date
attributes.description: Date on which the student provided informed consent to participate in the research protocol. Required for IRB compliance and must be on or after the protocol approval date. Critical for OHRP audits.

attributes.name: enrollment_date
attributes.description: Date on which the student was formally enrolled as a participant in the research study. Typically the same as or shortly after consent_date. Used to track actual enrollment against estimated enrollment in the IRB protocol.

attributes.name: participation_role
attributes.description: The role in which the student is participating in the research protocol. Most commonly 'subject' for human subjects research, but can also include 'co-investigator' or 'research_assistant' for students who are part of the research team.

attributes.name: participation_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of this student's participation in the protocol. Tracks progression from enrollment through completion or withdrawal. Used for continuing review reporting and protocol closeout.

attributes.name: withdrawal_date
attributes.description: Date on which the student withdrew from the research study prior to completion. Withdrawal is a participant right under IRB regulations. Used to track attrition rates and must be reported in continuing reviews.

attributes.name: withdrawal_reason
attributes.description: Narrative or coded reason for the student's withdrawal from the study (e.g., 'participant request', 'adverse event', 'lost to follow-up', 'protocol violation'). Required for IRB continuing review and safety monitoring.

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: The date on which the course was formally approved by the institutional curriculum committee or faculty governance body. Used for accreditation documentation and curriculum change audit trails.
attributes.references: HLC Criteria for Accreditation; AACSB Curriculum Governance; Institutional Faculty Senate Policy

attributes.name: approval_status
attributes.description: The current status of the course within the institutional curriculum approval workflow. New courses and course modifications must pass through faculty governance review before becoming active in the catalog. Used for curriculum management and accreditation audit trails.
attributes.references: HLC Criteria for Accreditation; AACSB Curriculum Governance Standards; Institutional Faculty Senate Policy

attributes.name: banner_course_key
attributes.description: The natural business identifier for the course as stored in Ellucian Banner, typically the concatenation of subject code, course number, and effective term (e.g., MATH101-202310). Serves as the externally-known unique course identifier for system integration and data lineage tracing.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner SCBCRSE Primary Key (SUBJ_CODE + CRSE_NUMB + EFF_TERM)

attributes.name: canvas_course_code
attributes.description: The course code or SIS ID used to identify this course in the Canvas Learning Management System (LMS). Used for LMS integration, content mapping, and learning analytics alignment between the SIS and LMS.
attributes.references: Canvas LMS SIS Integration; Instructure Canvas API

attributes.name: catalog_year_end
attributes.description: The four-digit academic year in which this course definition was last valid in the published academic catalog. Null for currently active course definitions. Used for degree audit and historical catalog archiving.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner SCBCRSE; HLC Curriculum Change Policy

attributes.name: catalog_year_start
attributes.description: The four-digit academic year in which this course definition first appeared in the published academic catalog (e.g., 2023 for the 2023-2024 catalog). Used for degree audit grandfathering and curriculum change tracking.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner SCBCRSE_EFF_TERM; HLC Curriculum Change Policy

attributes.name: contact_hours
attributes.description: The total number of scheduled instructional contact hours per week (or per term) for the course. Used for faculty workload calculations, accreditation compliance, and Carnegie Unit verification. Distinct from credit hours.
attributes.references: U.S. Department of Education Carnegie Unit; SACSCOC Principles of Accreditation; ABET Criteria

attributes.name: corequisite_text
attributes.description: The human-readable narrative description of corequisite requirements — courses that must be taken concurrently with this course. Published in the academic catalog and enforced during registration.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner SCRPREQ; HLC Curriculum Standards

attributes.name: course_description
attributes.description: The full narrative course description as published in the academic catalog. Describes course content, objectives, and scope. Used by students for course selection, by advisors for degree planning, and by accreditors for curriculum review.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner SCBCRSE; HLC Criteria for Accreditation; AACSB Curriculum Standards

attributes.name: course_level
attributes.description: The numeric level of the course indicating its academic complexity tier (e.g., 100=introductory undergraduate, 200=sophomore, 300=junior, 400=senior, 500=graduate, 600=advanced graduate, 700=doctoral, 800=professional, 900=post-doctoral). Used for degree audit, prerequisite enforcement, and IPEDS reporting.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner SCBCRSE_LEVL_CODE; IPEDS Instructional Level

attributes.name: course_number
attributes.description: The numeric or alphanumeric course designator within a subject area (e.g., 101, 301, 4820). Combined with subject_code to form the full course identifier (e.g., MATH 101). Corresponds to Banner SCBCRSE_CRSE_NUMB.

attributes.name: course_status
attributes.description: The current lifecycle status of the course master record in the catalog. Active courses are available for scheduling and registration. Inactive or discontinued courses are retained for historical transcript purposes but cannot be scheduled. Corresponds to Banner SCBCRSE_CSTA_CODE.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner SCBCRSE_CSTA_CODE; HLC Curriculum Approval Standards

attributes.name: course_type
attributes.description: The primary instructional format or delivery type of the course. Distinguishes lecture-based, laboratory, seminar, studio, clinical, independent study, internship, thesis, dissertation, and hybrid formats. Used for scheduling, accreditation, and faculty workload reporting. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: lecture|lab|seminar|studio|clinical|independent_study|internship|thesis|dissertation|hybrid|online|practicum — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner SCBCRSE_SCHD_CODE; IPEDS Instructional Activity; AACSB Curriculum Standards

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when the course master record was first created in the source system or ingested into the Silver Layer. Used for data lineage, audit compliance, and curriculum change history tracking.
attributes.references: FERPA Data Stewardship; Institutional Data Governance Policy

attributes.name: credit_hours
attributes.description: The number of academic credit hours (CR) awarded upon successful completion of the course. Used for degree requirement tracking, financial aid eligibility (SAP), full-time equivalent (FTE) calculations, and IPEDS reporting. Corresponds to Banner SCBCRSE_CREDIT_HR_HIGH or SCBCRSE_CREDIT_HR_LOW for variable-credit courses.
attributes.references: U.S. Department of Education Credit Hour Definition (34 CFR 600.2); IPEDS; Ellucian Banner SCBCRSE_CREDIT_HR_HIGH

attributes.name: credit_hours_min
attributes.description: The minimum number of credit hours that may be awarded for variable-credit courses (e.g., independent study, thesis, internship). Null for fixed-credit courses. Corresponds to Banner SCBCRSE_CREDIT_HR_LOW.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner SCBCRSE_CREDIT_HR_LOW; U.S. Department of Education 34 CFR 600.2

attributes.name: cross_listed_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this course is cross-listed under multiple subject codes or departments. Cross-listed courses share the same instructional content but appear under different prefixes (e.g., WMST 301 / SOC 301). Used for enrollment reporting and catalog management.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner SCBCRSE Cross-Listing; HLC Curriculum Standards

attributes.name: delivery_modality
attributes.description: The instructional delivery modality for the course as defined in the catalog. Indicates whether the course is delivered in-person, fully online, hybrid (blended), HyFlex, synchronous online, or asynchronous online. Used for enrollment reporting, accreditation, and IPEDS distance education reporting.
attributes.references: IPEDS Distance Education Definition; U.S. Department of Education; HLC Distance Education Guidelines

attributes.name: discontinue_date
attributes.description: The date on which the course was officially discontinued and removed from the active catalog. Null for active courses. Used for historical reporting, degree audit grandfathering, and accreditation documentation.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner SCBCRSE; HLC Substantive Change Policy

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: The date from which this version of the course definition is effective in the academic catalog. Used for catalog year tracking, curriculum change management, and degree audit. Corresponds to Banner SCBCRSE_EFF_TERM converted to date.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner SCBCRSE_EFF_TERM; HLC Curriculum Change Policy

attributes.name: gen_ed_category
attributes.description: The general education (gen ed) distribution category or core curriculum area fulfilled by this course (e.g., Quantitative Reasoning, Written Communication, Natural Sciences, Social Sciences, Humanities, Diversity). Used for degree audit and accreditation reporting. Values are institution-specific. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: written_communication|quantitative_reasoning|natural_sciences|social_sciences|humanities|diversity|global_awareness|arts — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: HLC Criteria for Accreditation; SACSCOC Core Curriculum Requirements; Institutional General Education Policy

attributes.name: grading_basis
attributes.description: The grading method applied to the course. Determines how student performance is recorded on the transcript and factored into GPA calculations. Letter-graded courses affect GPA; pass/fail and audit courses typically do not. Corresponds to Banner SCBCRSE_GMOD_CODE.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner SCBCRSE_GMOD_CODE; FERPA; NACUBO Academic Records Standards

attributes.name: honors_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether the course is eligible for honors designation or is part of the institution's honors program curriculum. Used for honors program tracking, degree audit, and academic distinction reporting.
attributes.references: Institutional Honors Program Policy; HLC Curriculum Standards

attributes.name: lab_hours
attributes.description: The number of weekly laboratory contact hours for the course. Relevant for STEM courses, nursing, and other lab-intensive disciplines. Used in accreditation reporting (ABET) and facility scheduling.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner SCBCRSE_LAB_HR_HIGH; ABET Criteria for Accreditation

attributes.name: lecture_hours
attributes.description: The number of weekly lecture contact hours for the course. Used to distinguish instructional modality components and calculate faculty FTE workload. Part of the contact hours breakdown alongside lab and seminar hours.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner SCBCRSE_LEC_HR_HIGH; IPEDS Instructional Activity

attributes.name: long_title
attributes.description: The full descriptive title of the course used in catalog publications, accreditation reports, and articulation agreements where the abbreviated transcript title may be insufficient.
attributes.references: HLC Criteria for Accreditation; AACSB Standards

attributes.name: max_enrollment
attributes.description: The default maximum number of students permitted to enroll in a single section of this course, as defined at the catalog level. May be overridden at the section level for specific terms. Used for capacity planning and accreditation student-to-faculty ratio reporting.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner SCBCRSE_MAX_EXT_ENRL; SACSCOC Faculty-Student Ratio Standards

attributes.name: max_repeat_hours
attributes.description: The maximum total credit hours that may be earned by repeating this course. Null if the course is not repeatable or has no cap. Used in degree audit to prevent over-crediting. Corresponds to Banner SCBCRSE_MAX_RPT_UNITS.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner SCBCRSE_MAX_RPT_UNITS; U.S. Department of Education SAP

attributes.name: oer_designated
attributes.description: Indicates whether the course has been officially designated as using Open Educational Resources (OER) as the primary course materials, eliminating or significantly reducing textbook costs for students. Supports affordability reporting and student financial aid cost-of-attendance (COA) calculations.
attributes.references: U.S. Department of Education OER Initiative; NACUBO Student Affordability Standards

attributes.name: prerequisite_text
attributes.description: The human-readable narrative description of prerequisite requirements for enrollment in this course, as published in the academic catalog. May include course prerequisites, minimum GPA requirements, class standing, or instructor consent. The structured prerequisite chain is managed separately in the curriculum domain.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner SCRPREQ; HLC Curriculum Standards

attributes.name: repeatable
attributes.description: Indicates whether the course may be repeated for additional credit (True) or may only be taken once for credit (False). Common for topics courses, independent study, thesis, and performance courses. Corresponds to Banner SCBCRSE_REPEAT_IND.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner SCBCRSE_REPEAT_IND; FERPA Academic Records

attributes.name: stem_designated
attributes.description: Indicates whether the course is classified as a Science, Technology, Engineering, or Mathematics (STEM) course per the DHS STEM Designated Degree Program List. Relevant for international student visa compliance (OPT extension eligibility) and federal STEM grant reporting.
attributes.references: DHS STEM Designated Degree Program List; NSF STEM Education Reporting; IPEDS

attributes.name: subject_code
attributes.description: The academic subject or department prefix that identifies the discipline area of the course (e.g., MATH, ENGL, BIOL, CS). Corresponds to the Banner SCBCRSE_SUBJ_CODE field and is used in the human-readable course identifier alongside the course number.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner SCBCRSE_SUBJ_CODE; IPEDS CIP Code Framework

attributes.name: title
attributes.description: The official short title of the course as it appears in the academic catalog and on student transcripts. Corresponds to Banner SCBCRSE_TITLE. Used in registration systems, LMS, and official academic records.

attributes.name: transfer_equivalency_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this course participates in formal transfer equivalency or articulation agreements with other institutions. Used by the registrar and transfer credit evaluation process to identify courses with established equivalencies.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner Transfer Articulation; AACRAO Transfer Credit Practices

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when the course master record was most recently modified in the source system or Silver Layer. Used for incremental ETL processing, change data capture, and audit trail compliance.
attributes.references: FERPA Data Stewardship; Institutional Data Governance Policy; ETL Change Data Capture

attributes.name: writing_intensive
attributes.description: Indicates whether the course has been designated as writing intensive, requiring substantial written work as a core component of instruction and assessment. Used to track fulfillment of general education writing requirements and for accreditation reporting.
attributes.references: HLC Criteria for Accreditation; Institutional General Education Requirements

products.name: degree_requirement
products.description: Defines the structured set of requirements a student must satisfy to earn a specific academic program's degree or certificate. Captures requirement group type (core, elective, concentration, general education, capstone), minimum credit hours, minimum GPA threshold, course substitution rules, residency requirements, and the Banner SMRPRLE/SMRALIB rule structures. Supports degree audit processing and academic advising. Each record represents one requirement block within a program's degree plan.

attributes.name: degree_requirement_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each degree requirement block within a program's degree plan. Primary key for this entity in the Databricks Silver Layer.

attributes.name: academic_program_id
attributes.description: Reference to the academic program (degree or certificate) to which this requirement block belongs. Links to the curriculum program master.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner SMRPRLE; CIP Classification of Instructional Programs

attributes.name: cip_code_id
attributes.description: FK to curriculum.cip_code

attributes.name: concentration_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to curriculum.concentration. Business justification: degree_requirement currently has concentration_code (STRING) to identify which concentration a requirement applies to. This should be normalized to a FK relationship to the concentration master table.

attributes.name: plo_id
attributes.description: Reference to the primary Program Learning Outcome (PLO) that this requirement block is mapped to in the curriculum assessment framework. Supports assurance of learning and accreditation reporting.
attributes.references: SACSCOC Standard 8.2; AACSB Assurance of Learning; ABET Student Outcomes

attributes.name: prerequisite_rule_id
attributes.description: Reference to another degree requirement block that must be completed before this block can be satisfied. Supports prerequisite chain modeling within the degree plan structure.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner SMRPRLE prerequisite rule; institutional degree sequencing policy

attributes.name: accreditation_body
attributes.description: The accreditation body whose standards this requirement block is designed to satisfy (e.g., AACSB for business programs, ABET for engineering). Supports accreditation self-study documentation and compliance reporting. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: AACSB|ABET|ABA|LCME|SACSCOC|HLC|MSCHE|NWCCU|NECHE|WSCUC|NCAA|none — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: AACSB Standard 4; ABET Criterion 5; SACSCOC Standard 10; HLC Criteria 4

attributes.name: allow_concurrent_enrollment
attributes.description: Indicates whether courses taken concurrently (simultaneously enrolled in two courses that satisfy the same block) may both count toward this requirement block (True). Prevents double-counting when False.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner SMRPRLE; institutional concurrent enrollment policy

attributes.name: allow_substitution
attributes.description: Indicates whether course substitutions are permitted within this requirement block (True). When True, an academic advisor may substitute an equivalent course via a formal substitution/waiver process tracked in Banner SMRALIB.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner SMRALIB substitution rule; institutional academic policy

attributes.name: allow_test_credit
attributes.description: Indicates whether credit earned through standardized examinations (AP, CLEP, IB, DSST) may be applied toward this requirement block (True). Supports prior learning assessment (PLA) policy enforcement.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner SMRPRLE; College Board AP/CLEP policy; institutional PLA policy

attributes.name: allow_transfer_credit
attributes.description: Indicates whether transfer credit may be applied toward this requirement block (True). Governs articulation agreement enforcement and transfer credit evaluation workflows.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner SMRPRLE; SACSCOC transfer credit policy; institutional articulation agreement standards

attributes.name: approval_status
attributes.description: Current status of this requirement block within the institutional curriculum approval workflow (e.g., curriculum committee review, faculty senate approval). Tracks the governance lifecycle from draft through final approval.
attributes.references: Institutional curriculum governance policy; SACSCOC Standard 6.2; HLC Criteria 5A

attributes.name: approved_date
attributes.description: The date on which this requirement block received final institutional approval from the curriculum committee or faculty governance body. Null if not yet approved.
attributes.references: Institutional curriculum governance policy; SACSCOC; HLC

attributes.name: approving_body
attributes.description: Name of the institutional governance body that approved this requirement block (e.g., 'Undergraduate Curriculum Committee', 'Graduate Council', 'Faculty Senate'). Supports audit trail for accreditation and compliance reviews.
attributes.references: SACSCOC Standard 6.2; HLC Criteria 5A; institutional shared governance policy

attributes.name: catalog_year
attributes.description: The academic catalog year (e.g., 2024) under which this requirement block is effective. Students are typically held to the catalog year in effect at the time of their enrollment or program declaration.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner SMRPRLE; SACSCOC; HLC accreditation standards

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this degree requirement record was first created in the data platform. Supports data lineage, audit trail, and Silver Layer ingestion tracking.
attributes.references: Institutional data governance policy; FERPA audit requirements

attributes.name: degree_type
attributes.description: The type of academic credential (degree or certificate) to which this requirement block belongs (e.g., BA, BS, MBA, PhD, certificate). Drives degree audit differentiation across credential types within the same program. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: BA|BS|BFA|BBA|MA|MS|MBA|MFA|PhD|EdD|JD|MD|certificate|associate — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: IPEDS completions survey; Ellucian Banner degree type codes; U.S. Department of Education

attributes.name: diversity_requirement
attributes.description: Indicates whether this requirement block fulfills an institutional diversity, equity, and inclusion (DEI) general education or program requirement. Supports diversity curriculum reporting and accreditation documentation.
attributes.references: Institutional DEI curriculum policy; HLC Criteria 1C; SACSCOC Standard 7.3

attributes.name: effective_from
attributes.description: The date from which this requirement block is effective and enforceable in degree audit processing. Students entering the program on or after this date are subject to this requirement block.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner SMRPRLE effective term; institutional catalog policy

attributes.name: effective_until
attributes.description: The date after which this requirement block is no longer enforced for new students. Null for currently active blocks. Supports catalog year versioning and sunset of deprecated requirement structures.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner SMRPRLE expiration term; institutional catalog policy

attributes.name: is_repeatable
attributes.description: Indicates whether courses within this requirement block may be repeated for additional credit toward the requirement (True) or whether repeat attempts are excluded from credit hour totals (False).
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner SMRPRLE; institutional repeat course policy

attributes.name: is_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether this requirement block is mandatory (True) or optional/advisory (False) for degree completion. Mandatory blocks must be satisfied before degree clearance is granted.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner SMRPRLE; institutional degree audit policy

attributes.name: level_code
attributes.description: Academic level at which this requirement block applies: UG (Undergraduate), GR (Graduate), PF (Professional), DC (Doctoral). Ensures degree audit rules are applied only to students at the appropriate academic level.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner academic level codes; IPEDS level-of-study definitions

attributes.name: max_credit_hours
attributes.description: Maximum number of credit hours (CR) that may be applied toward this requirement block. Caps the number of credits counted from elective or free-elective pools in degree audit processing.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner SMRPRLE; institutional degree audit policy

attributes.name: max_transfer_credit_hours
attributes.description: Maximum number of transfer credit hours that may be applied toward this specific requirement block. Enforces institutional transfer credit caps at the block level, complementing the program-level residency requirement.
attributes.references: SACSCOC transfer credit policy; Ellucian Banner SMRPRLE transfer limit; institutional articulation agreement

attributes.name: min_course_count
attributes.description: Minimum number of distinct courses a student must complete within this requirement block, independent of credit hour totals. Used when a block requires completion of a specific number of courses (e.g., 'complete at least 3 courses from the following list').
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner SMRPRLE; institutional degree audit policy

attributes.name: min_credit_hours
attributes.description: Minimum number of credit hours (CR) a student must complete within this requirement block to satisfy the degree requirement. Expressed in semester credit hours per federal definition (34 CFR 600.2).
attributes.references: 34 CFR 600.2 (Credit Hour definition); Ellucian Banner SMRPRLE; SACSCOC; HLC

attributes.name: min_gpa
attributes.description: Minimum cumulative or block-level Grade Point Average (GPA) a student must achieve within this requirement group to satisfy the requirement. Supports Satisfactory Academic Progress (SAP) enforcement and degree clearance.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner SMRPRLE; FERPA; U.S. Department of Education SAP regulations (34 CFR 668.34)

attributes.name: min_grade
attributes.description: Minimum letter grade a student must earn in individual courses within this requirement block for those courses to count toward the requirement (e.g., 'C', 'C-', 'B'). Enforced during degree audit course-level evaluation.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner SMRPRLE; institutional grading policy; AACSB; ABET program standards

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text advisory notes or special instructions associated with this requirement block, as displayed to academic advisors and students in degree audit reports and advising worksheets. May include waiver conditions, special circumstances, or catalog footnotes.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner SMRPRLE notes field; institutional advising policy

attributes.name: oer_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether courses satisfying this requirement block are designated as using Open Educational Resources (OER), reducing or eliminating textbook costs for students. Supports affordability reporting and OER initiative tracking.
attributes.references: U.S. Department of Education OER initiative; institutional affordability policy; IPEDS student cost reporting

attributes.name: requirement_code
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric code identifying this requirement block within the Banner SMRPRLE/SMRALIB rule structure (e.g., CORE-ENG-2024, ELEC-BUS-CONC). Used in degree audit processing and advising reports.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner SMRPRLE rule code; NACUBO curriculum standards

attributes.name: requirement_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name of the requirement block as it appears in the academic catalog and degree audit (e.g., 'Core Curriculum', 'Business Concentration Electives', 'Capstone Experience').
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner SMRPRLE; institutional catalog standards

attributes.name: requirement_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the requirement block. 'active' blocks are enforced in degree audits; 'superseded' blocks are replaced by a newer version; 'pending_approval' blocks are in curriculum committee review.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner SMRPRLE; institutional curriculum governance policy

attributes.name: requirement_type
attributes.description: Categorical classification of the requirement block indicating its role in the degree plan. Drives degree audit logic and advising workflows. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: core|elective|concentration|general_education|capstone|residency|free_elective|cognate — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner SMRPRLE rule type; SACSCOC; HLC; AACSB; ABET curriculum standards

attributes.name: residency_credit_hours
attributes.description: Minimum number of credit hours within this requirement block that must be earned in residence at the awarding institution (not via transfer, AP, CLEP, or prior learning assessment). Supports accreditation residency standards.
attributes.references: SACSCOC Standard 10.7; HLC Criteria 4B; Ellucian Banner SMRPRLE residency rule

attributes.name: sequence_number
attributes.description: Numeric ordering of this requirement block within the program's degree plan. Controls the display order in degree audit reports, academic advising worksheets, and catalog publications.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner SMRPRLE sequence; institutional catalog standards

attributes.name: slo_alignment
attributes.description: Free-text or structured reference to the Student Learning Outcomes (SLOs) or Program Learning Outcomes (PLOs) that this requirement block is designed to develop or assess. Supports curriculum mapping and accreditation quality assurance reporting.
attributes.references: SACSCOC Standard 8.2; HLC Criteria 4A; AACSB Assurance of Learning standards; ABET Student Outcomes

attributes.name: smralib_rule_code
attributes.description: The native area/list rule code from Ellucian Banner's SMRALIB (Student Module Requirements Area List) table associated with this requirement block. Identifies the specific course list or area rule used in degree audit processing.

attributes.name: smrprle_rule_code
attributes.description: The native rule code from Ellucian Banner's SMRPRLE (Student Module Requirements Program Rule) table that corresponds to this requirement block. Used for direct traceability to the system of record and degree audit engine.

attributes.name: stem_designated
attributes.description: Indicates whether this requirement block is classified as part of a Science, Technology, Engineering, and Mathematics (STEM) designated program area. Relevant for OPT STEM extension eligibility reporting and federal STEM program tracking.
attributes.references: DHS STEM OPT extension regulations; U.S. Department of Education STEM designation; IPEDS

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this degree requirement record was most recently modified in the data platform. Supports change detection, incremental ETL processing, and audit trail maintenance.
attributes.references: Institutional data governance policy; FERPA audit requirements

attributes.name: writing_intensive
attributes.description: Indicates whether this requirement block includes or requires writing-intensive courses as part of the institution's writing across the curriculum (WAC) or writing in the disciplines (WID) program.
attributes.references: SACSCOC Standard 9.1; HLC Criteria 4A; institutional general education writing requirement

products.name: prerequisite_rule
products.description: Defines prerequisite, corequisite, and anti-requisite relationships for courses, enforcing enrollment eligibility rules during registration. Captures the controlling course (the course requiring the prerequisite), the required course(s) or standardized test scores (SAT, ACT, AP, placement exam), minimum grade threshold (e.g., C or better), concurrent enrollment allowance for corequisites, override permission levels (instructor, department chair, registrar), and complex Boolean logic (AND/OR groupings, nested conditions). Supports real-time registration enforcement in SIS (Banner SFAREGS), academic advising, and degree planning tools.

attributes.name: prerequisite_rule_id
attributes.description: Unique system-generated identifier for the prerequisite rule record. Primary key for the prerequisite_rule data product in the curriculum domain.

attributes.name: academic_program_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the academic program (major, minor, or certificate) in which a student must be enrolled to satisfy this prerequisite rule. Applicable only when program_enrollment_required is True.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner SMRPRLE; CIP Classification of Instructional Programs

attributes.name: articulation_agreement_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the articulation agreement under which this prerequisite rule may be satisfied by a course completed at a partner institution. Links to the curriculum domain articulation agreement product for transfer pathway validation.
attributes.references: AACRAO Transfer Credit Practices; Ellucian Banner SHATAEQ

attributes.name: effective_term_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to enrollment.term. Business justification: Prerequisite rules activate at specific term boundaries for registration enforcement. SIS prerequisite checking requires term-specific rule activation for accurate student registration validation. Rep

attributes.name: org_unit_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the academic department that owns and administers this prerequisite rule. Determines which department chair has override authority and which curriculum committee reviews rule changes.

attributes.name: parent_rule_prerequisite_rule_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing identifier pointing to the parent prerequisite rule record in a nested Boolean condition hierarchy. Null for top-level rules. Enables recursive evaluation of complex prerequisite trees.

attributes.name: primary_prerequisite_controlling_course_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the course that owns this prerequisite rule — the course a student is attempting to register for. This is the 'gating' course whose enrollment eligibility is governed by this rule.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner SMBPRRQ; CIP Classification of Instructional Programs

attributes.name: rule_group_id
attributes.description: Identifier linking multiple prerequisite rule records into a logical group for complex Boolean evaluation (e.g., 'CALC1 AND (TRIG OR PRECALC)'). Rules sharing the same rule_group_id are evaluated together using their respective boolean_operator values.

attributes.name: advisory_only_flag
attributes.description: Indicates that this rule is displayed as an academic advising recommendation in degree planning tools but does not generate a hard registration block in the SIS. Distinct from sis_enforcement_flag: a rule may be SIS-enforced as a soft warning but still be advisory.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner SFAREGS; NACADA Academic Advising Standards

attributes.name: ap_credit_applicable
