attributes.name: analysis_completed_date
attributes.description: The date when the analysis of assessment data was completed.

attributes.name: assessment_method_description
attributes.description: Detailed description of the specific assessment method used (e.g., embedded case analysis rubric in capstone course, exit survey, portfolio review).

attributes.name: assessment_method_type
attributes.description: Classification of the assessment method as direct (embedded exam, rubric-scored artifact, capstone evaluation) or indirect (survey, focus group, self-report).

attributes.name: benchmark_met_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the target benchmark was achieved (True) or not (False) in this cycle.

attributes.name: catalog_year
attributes.description: The catalog year of the program curriculum being assessed, ensuring alignment with published program requirements.

attributes.name: cip_code
attributes.description: The CIP code of the program being assessed, used for federal reporting and program classification.

attributes.name: closure_evidence
attributes.description: Documentation that improvement actions were enacted and their impact evaluated, demonstrating closure of the assess-analyze-act-improve loop required by accreditors.

attributes.name: cycle_closed_date
attributes.description: The date when the assessment cycle was formally closed, indicating that improvement actions were implemented and closure-of-loop evidence was documented.

attributes.name: cycle_code
attributes.description: Business identifier for the assessment cycle, typically combining program code, PLO code, and academic year (e.g., MBA-PLO1-2023).

attributes.name: cycle_name
attributes.description: Descriptive name for the assessment cycle, summarizing the program, outcome, and period under review.

attributes.name: cycle_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the assessment cycle within the assess-analyze-act-improve loop.
attributes.references: AACSB Assurance of Learning Standards, ABET Criterion 4, HLC Criterion 4.B

attributes.name: data_collection_end_date
attributes.description: The date when data collection for this assessment cycle was completed.

attributes.name: data_collection_instrument
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the tool, rubric, survey, or exam used to collect assessment data (e.g., AAC&U VALUE Rubric, custom capstone rubric, Qualtrics exit survey).

attributes.name: data_collection_start_date
attributes.description: The date when data collection for this assessment cycle began.

attributes.name: degree_level
attributes.description: The level of the degree program being assessed (e.g., bachelor, master, doctoral).

attributes.name: gap_analysis

attributes.name: implementation_timeline

attributes.name: improvement_actions
attributes.description: Specific improvement actions identified to address performance gaps, such as curriculum revisions, pedagogical changes, or resource enhancements.

attributes.name: instrument_version

attributes.name: notes

products.name: cip_code
products.description: Reference taxonomy record for the Classification of Instructional Programs (CIP) maintained by the National Center for Education Statistics (NCES), updated biennially. Captures CIP code (6-digit hierarchical: XX.XXXX), title, definition, two-digit series (broad field), four-digit series (narrow field), six-digit series (specific program), active/inactive status, STEM designation flag (DHS STEM Designated Degree Program List), and crosswalk mappings to prior CIP editions (2010→2020). Serves as the authoritative classification for IPEDS completions reporting, state authorization applications, OPT/STEM OPT visa eligibility determination, Title IV federal financial aid program eligibility, and institutional research analytics. Updated centrally when NCES publishes new editions; institutional programs reference but do not modify CIP definitions.

attributes.name: cip_code_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Classification of Instructional Programs (CIP) Code Identifier
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the CIP code record. Primary key for the CIP code reference taxonomy.

attributes.name: action_code
attributes.description: The type of change applied to this CIP code in the current edition relative to the prior edition. New indicates a newly created code. Revised indicates definition or title changes. Moved indicates reclassification to a different series. Deleted indicates retirement. No change indicates the code is unchanged from the prior edition.

attributes.name: cip_code
attributes.description: Six-digit hierarchical CIP code in format XX.XXXX where the first two digits represent the broad field (series), the middle two represent the narrow field (intermediate grouping), and the last two represent the specific program. This is the authoritative NCES classification code.

attributes.name: cip_definition
attributes.description: Official NCES definition and scope statement for the CIP code. Describes the instructional content, typical courses, and program characteristics that define this classification.

attributes.name: cip_edition_year
attributes.business_glossary_term: Classification of Instructional Programs (CIP) Edition Year
attributes.description: The year of the CIP taxonomy edition in which this code was published or last updated (e.g., 2010, 2020). NCES updates the CIP taxonomy biennially.

attributes.name: cip_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the CIP code. Active codes are valid for current use in IPEDS reporting and program classification. Inactive codes have been retired or superseded. Moved codes have been reclassified to a different CIP code. Deleted codes are no longer valid.

attributes.name: cip_title
attributes.description: Official NCES title for the CIP code. This is the authoritative program name as published by the National Center for Education Statistics.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this CIP code record was first created in the institutional system. Used for audit trail and data lineage.

attributes.name: cross_reference_cip_codes
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of related or similar CIP codes that institutions should consider when classifying programs. Used for disambiguation and classification guidance.

attributes.name: discontinue_date
attributes.description: The date on which this CIP code was retired, superseded, or otherwise discontinued for use in program classification. Null for active codes.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: The date on which this CIP code became valid for use in institutional program classification and IPEDS reporting.

attributes.name: examples
attributes.description: Illustrative examples of specific degree programs, majors, or concentrations that would be classified under this CIP code. Provided by NCES for classification guidance.

attributes.name: four_digit_series
attributes.description: The first four digits of the CIP code (XX.XX format) representing the intermediate or narrow instructional field within the broad series (e.g., 11.01 = Computer and Information Sciences, General).

attributes.name: four_digit_series_title
attributes.description: The official NCES title for the four-digit narrow field series (e.g., Computer and Information Sciences, General).

attributes.name: ipeds_reporting_eligible
attributes.business_glossary_term: Integrated Postsecondary Education Data System (IPEDS) Reporting Eligible Flag
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this CIP code is valid for use in IPEDS completions reporting. Only active CIP codes from the current edition are IPEDS-eligible.

attributes.name: is_stem_designated
attributes.business_glossary_term: Science Technology Engineering Mathematics (STEM) Designation Flag
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this CIP code is designated as a STEM program per the Department of Homeland Security STEM Designated Degree Program List. STEM designation affects international student Optional Practical Training (OPT) eligibility and STEM OPT extension eligibility.
attributes.references: DHS STEM Designated Degree Program List

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this CIP code record was last updated in the institutional system. Used for data lineage and change tracking.

attributes.name: nces_url
attributes.business_glossary_term: National Center for Education Statistics (NCES) URL
attributes.description: The official NCES web URL for this CIP code definition and detailed classification guidance.

attributes.name: opt_stem_extension_eligible
attributes.business_glossary_term: Optional Practical Training (OPT) STEM Extension Eligible Flag
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether international students who complete a degree program in this CIP code are eligible for the 24-month STEM OPT extension beyond the standard 12-month OPT period.

attributes.name: prior_cip_code_2010
attributes.description: The equivalent CIP code from the 2010 edition, if applicable. Used for historical crosswalk mapping and longitudinal analysis of program completions data.

attributes.name: title_iv_eligible
attributes.business_glossary_term: Title IV Federal Financial Aid Eligible Flag
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether programs classified under this CIP code are eligible for Title IV federal financial aid. Certain CIP codes (e.g., recreational or avocational programs) may be ineligible for federal aid.
attributes.references: U.S. Department of Education Title IV Regulations

attributes.name: two_digit_series
attributes.description: The first two digits of the CIP code representing the broad instructional field or discipline area (e.g., 11 = Computer and Information Sciences, 14 = Engineering, 51 = Health Professions).

attributes.name: two_digit_series_title
attributes.description: The official NCES title for the two-digit broad field series (e.g., Computer and Information Sciences and Support Services, Engineering, Health Professions and Related Programs).

products.name: concentration
products.description: Master record for concentrations, tracks, specializations, emphases, and minors embedded within an academic program that represent a structured sub-plan of study. Captures concentration title, parent academic program, required credit hours, elective credit hours, specific course requirements, CIP sub-code if distinct from parent program, active status, effective catalog year range, admission requirements (if restricted), whether the concentration appears on the official transcript and/or diploma, and Banner SMRPRLE area code. Supports degree audit processing (DegreeWorks/Banner), program-level IPEDS completions reporting at the concentration level, and student academic planning.
products.reference: Ellucian Banner SMRPRLE Concentration / IPEDS Completions

attributes.name: concentration_id
attributes.description: Unique system identifier for the concentration, track, specialization, emphasis, or minor within an academic program. Primary key for the concentration entity.

attributes.name: academic_program_id
attributes.description: Foreign key reference to the parent academic program under which this concentration is offered. Links to curriculum.academic_program.

attributes.name: cip_code_id
attributes.description: FK to curriculum.cip_code

attributes.name: concentration_college_org_unit_id
attributes.description: Foreign key reference to the college or school that houses the concentration. Typically aligns with the parent program college but may differ for cross-college concentrations.

attributes.name: concentration_org_unit_id
attributes.description: Foreign key reference to the academic department that administers the concentration. May differ from the parent program department for interdisciplinary concentrations.

attributes.name: director_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key reference to the faculty member serving as the concentration director or coordinator, responsible for curriculum oversight, student advising, and assessment.

attributes.name: accreditation_body
attributes.description: Name of the specialized accrediting agency that reviews this concentration if distinct from the parent program accreditation (e.g., AACSB for a Finance concentration within a Business program, ABET for an Engineering concentration).

attributes.name: accreditation_status
attributes.description: Current accreditation status of the concentration with the specialized accrediting body. Not applicable if the concentration does not require separate accreditation.

attributes.name: admission_requirements
attributes.description: Narrative description of any special admission requirements for the concentration, including prerequisite courses, minimum GPA, application materials, auditions, portfolios, or faculty approval processes.

attributes.name: admission_restricted
attributes.description: Indicates whether admission to the concentration requires a separate application, faculty approval, portfolio review, or other selective criteria beyond enrollment in the parent program.

attributes.name: appears_on_diploma
attributes.description: Indicates whether the concentration title is printed on the official diploma. Varies by institutional policy; some institutions print only the major degree, others include concentrations.

attributes.name: appears_on_transcript
attributes.description: Indicates whether the concentration title is printed on the official academic transcript. True for most concentrations; false for internal tracking-only designations.

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: Date on which the concentration was formally approved by the curriculum committee, faculty senate, or governing board, authorizing its inclusion in the academic catalog.

attributes.name: banner_area_code
attributes.description: Ellucian Banner SMRPRLE area code used in degree audit processing (DegreeWorks) to identify and evaluate concentration requirements. Maps directly to Banner curriculum rules.

attributes.name: capstone_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether completion of a capstone course, project, thesis, or comprehensive examination is required as part of the concentration requirements.

attributes.name: catalog_year
attributes.description: Academic catalog year in which this concentration version became effective, formatted as YYYY-YYYY (e.g., 2023-2024). Students are typically held to the catalog year in effect at the time of their initial enrollment.

attributes.name: concentration_code
attributes.description: Short alphanumeric code uniquely identifying the concentration within the institution. Used in student information systems, degree audits, and transcript processing. Maps to Banner SMRPRLE area code.

attributes.name: concentration_description
attributes.description: Detailed narrative description of the concentration, including its academic focus, career outcomes, unique features, and relationship to the parent program. Published in the academic catalog.

attributes.name: concentration_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the concentration indicating whether it is available for student enrollment and degree audit processing.

attributes.name: concentration_type
attributes.description: Classification of the sub-plan type: concentration (focused study area within major), track (pathway variant), specialization (advanced focus), emphasis (thematic grouping), minor (secondary credential), or certificate (standalone credential).

attributes.name: core_credit_hours
attributes.description: Number of credit hours that must be fulfilled through required core courses specific to the concentration, with no substitution allowed.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp recording when this concentration record was first created in the student information system.

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: Date on which this concentration was discontinued or superseded by a new version. Null for currently active concentrations. Students enrolled before this date may continue under teach-out provisions.

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: Date on which this concentration became available for student enrollment and degree audit processing. Aligns with the start of the catalog year or mid-year curriculum changes.

attributes.name: elective_credit_hours
attributes.description: Number of credit hours that must be fulfilled through elective courses within the concentration, allowing student choice within defined parameters.

attributes.name: honors_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether students in this concentration are eligible to pursue honors designation through additional coursework, thesis, or research requirements.

attributes.name: internship_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether completion of an internship, practicum, clinical placement, or field experience is required as part of the concentration requirements.

attributes.name: ipeds_reportable
attributes.business_glossary_term: Integrated Postsecondary Education Data System (IPEDS) Reportable Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether completions of this concentration must be reported separately to IPEDS as a distinct award. True when the concentration has a unique CIP code and meets IPEDS reporting thresholds.

attributes.name: last_curriculum_review_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent comprehensive curriculum review for the concentration, typically conducted on a 3-7 year cycle as part of program assessment and continuous improvement.

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp recording when this concentration record was most recently modified, supporting audit trail and data lineage tracking.

attributes.name: max_transfer_credit_hours
attributes.description: Maximum number of transfer credit hours that may be applied toward concentration requirements. Null if no transfer credit is allowed or if parent program limits apply.

attributes.name: min_gpa_required
attributes.description: Minimum cumulative or major GPA required for admission to or continuation in the concentration. Null if no GPA threshold applies.

attributes.name: next_review_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date for the next comprehensive curriculum review of the concentration, ensuring ongoing alignment with industry standards, accreditation requirements, and student learning outcomes.

attributes.name: oer_designated
attributes.description: Indicates whether the concentration has been designated as using primarily Open Educational Resources, reducing textbook costs for students and supporting affordability initiatives.

attributes.name: required_credit_hours
attributes.description: Total number of credit hours required to complete the concentration, including both required and elective courses within the concentration plan.

attributes.name: residency_credit_hours
attributes.description: Minimum number of credit hours within the concentration that must be completed in residence at the degree-granting institution, not through transfer or test credit.

attributes.name: stem_designated
attributes.business_glossary_term: Science Technology Engineering Mathematics (STEM) Designated Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the concentration is designated as a STEM program for purposes of Optional Practical Training (OPT) extension eligibility for international students on F-1 visas.
attributes.references: DHS STEM Designated Degree Program List

attributes.name: thesis_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether completion of a formal thesis or dissertation is required as part of the concentration requirements, typically for graduate-level concentrations.

attributes.name: title
attributes.description: Official full title of the concentration, track, specialization, emphasis, or minor as it appears in the academic catalog and on official transcripts.

attributes.name: total_enrolled_students
attributes.description: Current count of students actively enrolled in this concentration. Used for capacity planning, resource allocation, and viability assessment.

attributes.name: url
attributes.description: Web address of the official concentration page on the institutional website, providing prospective and current students with detailed information, course requirements, and contact information.

attributes.name: writing_intensive
attributes.description: Indicates whether the concentration includes a significant writing component across multiple courses, meeting institutional writing-intensive program criteria.

products.name: curriculum_enrollment
products.description: This association product represents the enrollment event between a course and a student athlete. It captures the term-specific registration of a student athlete in a course, including enrollment status, academic performance, credit hours earned, and whether the credits count toward degree progress for NCAA eligibility certification. Each record links one course to one student athlete for a specific term with attributes that exist only in the context of this enrollment relationship.. Existence Justification: In higher education operations, student athletes enroll in multiple courses each term to maintain full-time status (minimum 12 credit hours for NCAA eligibility), and each course section has multiple student athletes enrolled. Compliance officers actively manage and monitor these enrollments to verify eligibility requirements: full-time enrollment status, term GPA calculation, percentage-of-degree progress, and whether credits are degree-applicable. Enrollment is a recognized business entity with term-specific data (grades, status, dates) that belongs to neither the course catalog nor the student athlete profile alone.

products.name: program_affiliation
products.description: This association product represents the formal appointment or affiliation relationship between an instructor and an academic program. It captures faculty sufficiency for accreditation, workload allocation across programs, graduate faculty status, and appointment terms. Each record links one instructor to one academic program with attributes that exist only in the context of this affiliation relationship, supporting accreditation reporting (AACSB, ABET faculty sufficiency requirements), workload planning, and academic governance.. Existence Justification: In higher education, instructors routinely hold formal affiliations with multiple academic programs (joint appointments, cross-disciplinary teaching, graduate faculty appointments), and programs require multiple affiliated faculty to meet accreditation standards for faculty sufficiency. The affiliation relationship itself carries critical operational data including workload allocation percentages, graduate faculty status, and appointment terms that belong to neither the instructor nor the program alone but to the specific instructor-program pairing.

Primary indicates main program responsibility, secondary indicates supporting role, joint indicates shared appointment across programs, courtesy indicates non-compensated affiliation, affiliate indicates external/adjunct relationship, graduate_faculty indicates authorization to teach graduate courses and chair dissertations. Critical for accreditation faculty sufficiency calculations.

attributes.name: appointment_term
attributes.description: Academic term or contract period for this affiliation (e.g., Fall 2024, AY 2024-2025, Multi-year). Supports term-based appointment tracking and renewal processes.

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: Date on which this program affiliation ended or will end. Null for current active affiliations. Supports historical tracking and transition planning.

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: Date on which this program affiliation became effective. Supports historical tracking of faculty affiliations for accreditation self-studies and workload history.

attributes.name: graduate_faculty_status
attributes.description: Graduate faculty status of the instructor within this program. Full indicates authorization to teach graduate courses, chair dissertations, and serve on comprehensive exam committees. Associate indicates authorization to teach graduate courses and serve on committees but not chair. None indicates no graduate faculty privileges. attributes.description: Percentage of the instructor's research workload allocated to this program. Relevant for research-intensive programs and graduate programs where faculty research productivity contributes to program quality metrics.

attributes.name: service_percentage
attributes.description: Percentage of the instructor's service workload (committees, advising, governance) allocated to this program. Used for workload planning and faculty contribution assessment.

attributes.name: teaching_percentage
attributes.description: Percentage of the instructor's teaching workload allocated to this program. Used for faculty sufficiency calculations in accreditation reporting. Sum across all program affiliations for an instructor should equal 100% of their teaching FTE.

products.name: section
products.description: This association product represents the specific offering of a course taught by an instructor in a particular term. It captures the operational reality of course delivery: scheduling, enrollment capacity, delivery modality, and meeting patterns. Each record links one course definition to one instructor for one term and section, with attributes that exist only in the context of this specific teaching assignment.. Existence Justification: In higher education operations, instructors teach multiple courses across different terms and sections, and courses are taught by different instructors depending on term, section, and faculty availability. The business actively manages course sections as operational entities with scheduling, enrollment capacity, delivery modality, and meeting patterns. Section is a recognized business concept in academic operations, distinct from both the course catalog definition and the instructor master record.

attributes.name: meeting_pattern

attributes.name: term_code

products.name: teaching_assignment
products.description: This association product represents the teaching assignment relationship between courses and instructors (non-faculty employees). It captures the operational assignment of staff instructors to course sections, including workload distribution, instructional role, and section-specific teaching responsibilities. Each record links one course to one employee with attributes that exist only in the context of this teaching relationship.. Existence Justification: In higher education operations, courses are routinely taught by multiple instructors through team-teaching arrangements, lab coordinators, teaching assistants, and co-instructors across different sections and terms. Simultaneously, instructors teach multiple courses per term as part of their workload. The registrar actively manages these teaching assignments as operational records, tracking instructor-of-record status, workload distribution, credit hour allocation, and section-specific responsibilities.

attributes.name: workload_percentage

products.name: course_training_requirement
products.description: This association product represents the compliance training requirements mandated for faculty teaching specific courses. It captures which compliance training programs must be completed before or during instruction of particular courses, driven by regulatory requirements (Title IX, FERPA, accessibility standards, research ethics) and institutional policy. Each record links one course to one required training program with completion tracking attributes that exist only in the context of this teaching requirement relationship.. Existence Justification: In higher education compliance operations, courses require multiple compliance training programs based on their content and delivery characteristics (e.g., health courses require Title IX training, online courses require accessibility training, lab courses require research ethics training), and each compliance training program applies to multiple courses across different departments. Compliance officers actively manage these requirement mappings, tracking which trainings are mandatory for teaching specific courses, setting course-specific completion deadlines, managing waiver requests, and auditing instructor compliance before course assignments.

Active requirements are enforced for instructor assignments; Inactive requirements are historical; Pending requirements are scheduled for future enforcement; Superseded requirements have been replaced by updated training programs.

attributes.name: effective_start_date

attributes.name: notes

attributes.name: waiver_status
attributes.description: Current status of any waiver request for this training requirement for this course. Tracks whether an exception has been requested or granted due to equivalent prior training, subject matter expertise, or other institutional considerations.

products.name: course_asset_requirement
products.description: This association product represents the operational requirement relationship between courses and IT assets. It captures the specific technology assets required to deliver a course, including lab computers, specialized software, projectors, and equipment. Each record links one course to one IT asset with scheduling and quantity attributes that exist only in the context of this requirement. This supports registrar scheduling, facilities management, and resource conflict resolution across academic terms.. Existence Justification: In higher education operations, courses require multiple IT assets (lab computers, projectors, specialized software, equipment) to support delivery, and individual assets are shared across multiple courses throughout academic terms. The registrar and facilities management actively manage these requirements to schedule sections, avoid resource conflicts, and ensure availability. This is an operational relationship with specific attributes (quantity, priority, term) that belong to neither the course catalog nor the asset inventory alone.

attributes.name: priority_rank
attributes.description: Applicant-assigned numeric rank indicating preference order when applying to multiple programs simultaneously (1 = first choice, 2 = second choice, etc.). Used to determine primary program assignment upon admission and to analyze applicant program preferences.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner Student Information System - Admissions Module; Slate CRM Application Processing

attributes.name: program_code
attributes.description: Institution-assigned alphanumeric code uniquely identifying the academic program being applied to (e.g., BSCS, MBAFIN, PHDBIO). Used for reporting, IPEDS submissions, and SIS integration.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner Student Information System - Admissions Module; IPEDS Integrated Postsecondary Education Data System

attributes.name: program_name
attributes.description: Full descriptive name of the academic program being applied to (e.g., 'Bachelor of Science in Computer Science', 'Master of Business Administration - Finance Concentration'). Used in applicant communications and official documents.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner Student Information System - Admissions Module

attributes.name: required_credit_hours
attributes.description: Total number of credit hours (CR) required to complete this program as defined in the academic catalog at the time of application. Used for degree audit planning, financial aid cost-of-attendance (COA) calculations, and enrollment projections.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner Student Information System - Academic Programs; IPEDS Integrated Postsecondary Education Data System; U.S. Department of Education

attributes.name: residency_classification
attributes.description: Tuition residency classification for this program application determining applicable tuition rate tier (in-state, out-of-state, or international). Drives tuition billing, financial aid packaging, and enrollment revenue forecasting.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner Student Information System - Admissions Module; State Higher Education Finance Regulations; NACUBO

attributes.name: scholarship_consideration
attributes.description: Indicates whether the applicant has opted into or been flagged for merit scholarship consideration for this specific program application. True = under scholarship consideration; False = not considered for merit scholarship. Drives financial aid packaging workflows.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner Student Information System - Financial Aid Module; U.S. Department of Education Title IV

attributes.name: source_system_key
attributes.description: Natural key or record identifier from the originating operational system of record (Ellucian Banner or Slate CRM) for this application-program association. Enables lineage tracing and reconciliation between the Silver Layer lakehouse and the source SIS.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner Student Information System - Admissions Module; Slate CRM Application Processing

attributes.name: student_type
attributes.description: Classification of the applicant's enrollment history context for this program application. FTIAC (First-Time-In-Any-College) indicates no prior college attendance; transfer indicates prior college credit; readmit indicates prior enrollment at this institution. Critical for IPEDS cohort reporting and retention tracking.
attributes.references: IPEDS Integrated Postsecondary Education Data System; Ellucian Banner Student Information System - Admissions Module

attributes.name: submitted_date
attributes.description: Date on which the applicant formally submitted this program selection as part of their application. May differ from the overall application submission date if programs are added sequentially.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner Student Information System - Admissions Module; Slate CRM Application Processing

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to this application-program association record. Used for incremental ETL processing, change data capture, and audit compliance under FERPA.
attributes.references: FERPA Family Educational Rights and Privacy Act; Ellucian Banner Student Information System

attributes.name: waitlist_position
attributes.description: Numeric position of the applicant on the program waitlist when the application_status is 'waitlisted'. Lower numbers indicate higher priority for admission from the waitlist. Null if the applicant is not on the waitlist.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner Student Information System - Admissions Module; Slate CRM Application Processing

products.name: admission_decision
products.description: Transactional record capturing the official admissions decision and corresponding offer communication for an application. Stores decision type (admit, deny, waitlist, defer, conditional admit), decision date, decision authority (committee, automated rules engine, individual reviewer), scholarship eligibility flag, honors program eligibility, and conditions for conditional admits. For admit decisions, also captures offer letter generation date, delivery method (portal, email, mail), offer expiration date, scholarship amount included, honors designation, and applicant response (accepted, declined, deferred response). One record per application per decision cycle. Supports holistic review outcomes, yield management, and enrollment funnel reporting.

attributes.name: admission_decision_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each admission decision record. One record per application per decision cycle. Primary key for the admission_decision data product.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner Student Information System - Admissions Module

attributes.name: academic_program_id
attributes.description: Reference to the academic program (degree, certificate, or credential) to which the applicant applied and for which this decision was rendered.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner Student Information System - Admissions Module; CIP (Classification of Instructional Programs)

attributes.name: award_package_id
attributes.description: Reference to the financial aid award package associated with this admission offer. Links the admission decision to the corresponding aid offer for COA (Cost of Attendance) and EFC (Expected Family Contribution) reporting.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner Student Information System - Financial Aid Module; FAFSA; U.S. Department of Education; SAP (Satisfactory Academic Progress)

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the staff or faculty member who rendered or finalized the admission decision when decision_authority_type is individual_reviewer or dean_override. Null when decision was made by committee or automated rules engine.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner Student Information System - Admissions Module; Workday HCM

attributes.name: enrollment_applicant_id
attributes.description: Reference to the prospective student (applicant) party record associated with this admission decision. Supports yield management and enrollment funnel reporting.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner Student Information System - Admissions Module; FERPA

attributes.name: enrollment_application_id
attributes.description: Reference to the student application record for which this admission decision was rendered. Links the decision to the originating application in the admissions lifecycle.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner Student Information System - Admissions Module; Slate CRM - Application Processing

attributes.name: term_id
attributes.description: Reference to the term or academic period for which admission is being offered (e.g., Fall 2025, Spring 2026). Drives term-based enrollment cycle reporting.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner Student Information System - Registration Module; IPEDS

attributes.name: applicant_response
attributes.description: The applicant's formal response to the admission offer. Drives yield calculation and enrollment confirmation workflows. Values: accepted (applicant confirmed enrollment intent), declined (applicant declined the offer), deferred_response (applicant requested additional time), no_response (no response received by offer expiration date).
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner Student Information System - Admissions Module; Slate CRM; IPEDS

attributes.name: applicant_response_date
attributes.description: The date on which the applicant submitted their formal response (accept, decline, or deferred response) to the admission offer. Null if no response has been received.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner Student Information System - Admissions Module; Slate CRM

attributes.name: condition_deadline
attributes.description: The date by which the applicant must fulfill all conditions of a conditional admission offer. Null for unconditional admits and non-admit decisions.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner Student Information System - Admissions Module; HLC; SACSCOC

attributes.name: condition_description
attributes.description: Narrative description of the conditions the applicant must satisfy to convert a conditional admission to a full admission (e.g., final transcript submission, minimum GPA requirement, English proficiency test score). Populated only when is_conditional is True.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner Student Information System - Admissions Module; TOEFL; IELTS; HLC; SACSCOC

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time at which this admission decision record was first created in the data platform. Serves as the audit creation timestamp for the Silver Layer record. Distinct from decision_timestamp which captures the business event time.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner Student Information System - Admissions Module; FERPA; Databricks Lakehouse Silver Layer Audit Standards

attributes.name: decision_authority_type
attributes.description: Identifies the mechanism or body that rendered the admission decision. Supports holistic review documentation and institutional audit requirements. Values: committee (admissions committee vote), automated_rules_engine (system-generated based on configured criteria), individual_reviewer (single admissions officer), dean_override (dean or senior administrator override).
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner Student Information System - Admissions Module; HLC; SACSCOC; AACSB

attributes.name: decision_cycle
attributes.description: Identifies the admissions decision cycle within a term (e.g., Early Decision, Early Action, Regular Decision, Rolling). Supports yield management analytics and enrollment funnel segmentation by admission round.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner Student Information System - Admissions Module; Slate CRM; NACUBO

attributes.name: decision_date
attributes.description: The official calendar date on which the admissions decision was rendered and recorded. Represents the principal real-world business event date for this transaction. Used in cycle-time analytics and accreditation reporting.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner Student Information System - Admissions Module; IPEDS; U.S. Department of Education

attributes.name: decision_number
attributes.description: Externally visible, human-readable identifier for this admission decision record (e.g., DEC-2025-0048291). Used in correspondence, portal displays, and audit trails.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner Student Information System - Admissions Module; Slate CRM

attributes.name: decision_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of this admission decision record. Pending indicates the decision is in review; finalized indicates the decision has been officially rendered and communicated; rescinded indicates a previously issued offer has been withdrawn; superseded indicates this record has been replaced by a newer decision in the same cycle.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner Student Information System - Admissions Module; FERPA

attributes.name: decision_timestamp
attributes.description: Precise date and time at which the admission decision was officially recorded in the system, including timezone offset. Supports audit trails and SLA measurement for admissions processing turnaround.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner Student Information System - Admissions Module; FERPA

attributes.name: decision_type
attributes.description: The official classification of the admissions decision rendered for this application. Drives downstream yield management, enrollment funnel reporting, and accreditation data submissions. Values: admit (full unconditional offer), deny (application rejected), waitlist (placed on waitlist pending space), defer (decision postponed to next cycle), conditional_admit (offer contingent on meeting specified conditions).
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner Student Information System - Admissions Module; IPEDS; HLC; SACSCOC

attributes.name: defer_target_term
attributes.description: The academic term to which the application has been deferred for reconsideration (e.g., Spring 2026, Fall 2026). Populated only when decision_type is defer. Supports cycle-over-cycle enrollment funnel tracking.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner Student Information System - Admissions Module

attributes.name: deny_reason_code
attributes.description: Standardized institutional code indicating the primary reason for a denial decision (e.g., academic_qualifications, capacity, incomplete_application, program_fit). Populated only when decision_type is deny. Supports equity analysis and holistic review documentation.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner Student Information System - Admissions Module; HLC; SACSCOC; U.S. Department of Education

attributes.name: enrollment_deposit_amount
attributes.description: The enrollment confirmation deposit amount (in USD) required from the applicant upon accepting the admission offer. Confirms seat reservation and is typically credited toward tuition. Null for non-admit decisions.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner Student Information System - Student Accounts Module; NACUBO; U.S. Department of Education

attributes.name: enrollment_deposit_paid_date
attributes.description: The date on which the applicant submitted the enrollment confirmation deposit. Null if deposit has not been received. Confirms intent to enroll and triggers downstream onboarding processes.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner Student Information System - Student Accounts Module; NACUBO

attributes.name: holistic_review_score
attributes.description: Composite numeric score assigned to the application during holistic review, aggregating academic, extracurricular, essay, and recommendation dimensions per institutional rubric. Supports equity analysis, yield modeling, and accreditation documentation of holistic review practices.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner Student Information System - Admissions Module; HLC; SACSCOC; AACSB; ABET

attributes.name: honors_designation
attributes.description: The specific honors program or designation offered to the applicant (e.g., University Honors, Departmental Honors, Presidential Scholars). Populated only when is_honors_eligible is True. Null otherwise.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner Student Information System - Admissions Module; HLC

attributes.name: is_conditional
attributes.description: Indicates whether this admission offer is conditional, requiring the applicant to satisfy specified conditions prior to enrollment. True = conditional admit; False = unconditional offer. Applicable only when decision_type is conditional_admit.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner Student Information System - Admissions Module; HLC; SACSCOC

attributes.name: is_honors_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether the applicant has been identified as eligible for the institutional honors program as part of this admission decision. True = eligible for honors designation; False = not eligible.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner Student Information System - Admissions Module; HLC; SACSCOC

attributes.name: is_rescinded
attributes.description: Indicates whether a previously issued admission offer has been formally rescinded by the institution (e.g., due to academic performance decline, disciplinary action, or misrepresentation on application). True = offer rescinded; False = offer remains valid.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner Student Information System - Admissions Module; FERPA; HLC

attributes.name: is_scholarship_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether the applicant has been identified as eligible for institutional merit or need-based scholarship consideration as part of this admission decision. True = eligible; False = not eligible.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner Student Information System - Financial Aid Module; U.S. Department of Education; FAFSA (Free Application for Federal Student Aid)

attributes.name: offer_delivery_method
attributes.description: The channel through which the admission offer letter was delivered to the applicant. Supports communication analytics and yield management. Values: portal (applicant self-service portal), email (electronic mail), mail (physical postal mail), in_person (delivered during campus visit or event).
attributes.references: Slate CRM - Communications Module; Ellucian Banner Student Information System - Admissions Module

attributes.name: offer_expiration_date
attributes.description: The date by which the applicant must respond to the admission offer (accept or decline) before the offer is considered expired. Commonly May 1 for undergraduate admissions per National Candidates Reply Date. Null for deny, waitlist, and defer decisions.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner Student Information System - Admissions Module; National Candidates Reply Date (NACAC); U.S. Department of Education

attributes.name: offer_letter_generated_date
attributes.description: The date on which the official admission offer letter was generated and prepared for delivery. Applicable only for admit and conditional_admit decisions. Supports yield management and communication timeline analytics.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner Student Information System - Admissions Module; Slate CRM

attributes.name: offer_sent_date
attributes.description: The date on which the admission offer letter was dispatched to the applicant via the designated delivery method. Distinct from offer_letter_generated_date; captures actual transmission date for SLA and yield analytics.
attributes.references: Slate CRM - Communications Module; Ellucian Banner Student Information System - Admissions Module

attributes.name: rescind_date
attributes.description: The date on which the admission offer was formally rescinded. Populated only when is_rescinded is True. Null otherwise.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner Student Information System - Admissions Module; FERPA

attributes.name: rescind_reason
attributes.description: Narrative or coded reason explaining why a previously issued admission offer was rescinded. Populated only when is_rescinded is True. Supports compliance documentation and institutional audit requirements.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner Student Information System - Admissions Module; FERPA; HLC; SACSCOC

attributes.name: scholarship_amount
attributes.description: The annual institutional scholarship or merit aid amount (in USD) included in the admission offer letter. Applicable only when is_scholarship_eligible is True and an offer has been extended. Null for non-admit decisions.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner Student Information System - Financial Aid Module; U.S. Department of Education; NACUBO; FAFSA

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Identifies the operational system of record from which this admission decision record originated. Supports data lineage and ETL (Extract Transform Load) audit in the Databricks Silver Layer. Values: banner (Ellucian Banner SIS), slate (Slate CRM), manual (manually entered record).
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner Student Information System; Slate CRM; ETL (Extract Transform Load) Data Lineage Standards

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time at which this admission decision record was most recently modified in the data platform. Supports change tracking, data quality monitoring, and incremental ETL processing in the Silver Layer.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner Student Information System - Admissions Module; FERPA; Databricks Lakehouse Silver Layer Audit Standards

attributes.name: waitlist_offered_date
attributes.description: The date on which an applicant on the waitlist was extended a formal admission offer from the waitlist. Null if the applicant has not been offered admission from the waitlist.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner Student Information System - Admissions Module; Slate CRM

attributes.name: waitlist_rank
attributes.description: Numeric rank or position of the applicant on the institutional waitlist. Lower numbers indicate higher priority for admission if seats become available. Populated only when decision_type is waitlist. Null otherwise.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner Student Information System - Admissions Module; Slate CRM

products.name: enrollment_test_score
products.description: Master record of externally-sourced academic evidence submitted by an applicant for admissions evaluation. Includes standardized test scores (SAT, ACT, GRE, GMAT, TOEFL, IELTS) and international academic credentials (foreign transcripts, degree certificates, WES/ECE evaluation reports). For test scores: captures test type, test date, composite score, sub-scores by section, score source (self-reported vs. official), score report date, and superscore eligibility flag. For international credentials: captures country of origin, credential type, issuing institution, evaluation agency, evaluated US-equivalent degree level, and evaluation report date. Supports admissions criteria evaluation, international admissions review, and IPEDS reporting.
products.reference: Banner SOATEST / College Board / ACT / ETS Score Records

attributes.name: enrollment_test_score_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each test score or international credential record submitted by an applicant. Primary key for the test_score data product in the enrollment domain Silver layer.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner SIS — Academic History / Admissions Test Score Entity

attributes.name: application_checklist_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to enrollment.application_checklist. Business justification: Test score is a specific type of application checklist item. While test_score already references application_id directly, it should also link to its corresponding checklist entry to track receipt stat

attributes.name: enrollment_applicant_id
attributes.description: Reference to the applicant who submitted this test score or international credential. Links the score record to the admissions applicant master record in Ellucian Banner and Slate CRM.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner SIS — Admissions Module; Slate CRM — Application Processing

attributes.name: enrollment_application_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific admissions application for which this test score or credential was submitted. An applicant may have multiple applications across terms or programs.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner SIS — Admissions Module; Slate CRM — Application Processing

attributes.name: academic_program_code
attributes.description: Institutional code identifying the academic program or degree program to which the applicant applied and for which this test score is being evaluated. Used to apply program-specific minimum score thresholds (e.g., MBA programs requiring minimum GMAT scores, engineering programs requiring minimum GRE Quantitative scores).
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner SIS — Program Table; CIP (Classification of Instructional Programs) Codes; IPEDS Completions Component

attributes.name: composite_score
attributes.description: The total or composite score for the test as reported by the testing agency. Scale varies by test type (e.g., SAT: 400–1600, ACT: 1–36, GRE: 260–340, GMAT: 200–800, TOEFL iBT: 0–120, IELTS: 0–9.0). Null for international credential records where no single composite score applies.
attributes.references: College Board SAT Score Scale; ACT Score Scale; ETS GRE Score Scale; GMAC GMAT Score Scale; ETS TOEFL Score Scale; IELTS Score Scale

attributes.name: country_of_origin
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 three-letter country code of the country where the credential was issued or the test was administered. Used in international admissions review, IPEDS reporting of international student enrollment, and country-specific admissions criteria application.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1 Alpha-3 Country Codes; IPEDS Admissions Component; NAFSA International Admissions Standards

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this test score or credential record was first created in the system, either through manual data entry by admissions staff, electronic score import from the testing agency, or automated ETL ingestion from Ellucian Banner or Slate CRM into the Silver layer.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner SIS — Admissions Module; Databricks Lakehouse Silver Layer Audit Standards; FERPA Record-Keeping Requirements

attributes.name: credential_type
attributes.description: For international credential records (record_type = 'international_credential'), the type of academic credential submitted (e.g., 'secondary_transcript', 'undergraduate_transcript', 'degree_certificate', 'evaluation_report', 'mark_sheet', 'leaving_certificate'). Null for standardized test score records. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: secondary_transcript|undergraduate_transcript|degree_certificate|evaluation_report|mark_sheet|leaving_certificate|other — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: NAFSA International Credential Evaluation Standards; WES Credential Evaluation; ECE Credential Evaluation; Ellucian Banner SIS — Admissions International Credentials

attributes.name: english_proficiency_waiver
attributes.description: Indicates whether the applicant has been granted a waiver of the English language proficiency test requirement (TOEFL/IELTS) based on factors such as prior English-medium instruction, citizenship in an English-speaking country, or completion of a U.S. degree. Relevant for international admissions compliance.
attributes.references: NAFSA International Admissions Standards; Institutional English Proficiency Policy; U.S. Department of Education International Student Admissions

attributes.name: evaluation_agency
attributes.description: Name of the third-party credential evaluation agency that assessed the international academic credential (e.g., 'WES' for World Education Services, 'ECE' for Educational Credential Evaluators, 'NACES' member agencies). Null for standardized test records or credentials evaluated internally.
attributes.references: NACES (National Association of Credential Evaluation Services); WES; ECE; NAFSA International Admissions Standards

attributes.name: evaluation_report_date
attributes.description: Date on which the credential evaluation agency issued the evaluation report for the international academic credential. Used to assess report recency and to track the completeness of the international admissions file.
attributes.references: NACES Credential Evaluation Standards; WES Evaluation Report; ECE Evaluation Report; Ellucian Banner SIS — Admissions International Credentials

attributes.name: gpa_equivalent
attributes.description: The U.S. 4.0-scale Grade Point Average (GPA) equivalent assigned by the credential evaluation agency for the international academic credential. Enables standardized academic performance comparison across international applicants. Null for standardized test score records.
attributes.references: NACES Credential Evaluation Standards; WES GPA Conversion; ECE GPA Conversion; NACAC Admissions Practices

attributes.name: ipeds_test_score_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Integrated Postsecondary Education Data System (IPEDS) Test Score Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this test score record is included in the institution's IPEDS Admissions Component reporting for the 25th and 75th percentile score ranges of enrolled first-time degree-seeking undergraduates. Supports federal regulatory reporting to the U.S. Department of Education.
attributes.references: IPEDS Admissions Component (IC-AY); U.S. Department of Education IPEDS Reporting Requirements; National Center for Education Statistics (NCES)

attributes.name: issuing_institution_name
attributes.description: Name of the foreign university, college, secondary school, or credentialing body that issued the international academic credential. Used in international admissions review to assess institutional reputation and accreditation status in the country of origin.
attributes.references: NAFSA International Admissions Standards; WES Credential Evaluation; Ellucian Banner SIS — Admissions International Credentials

attributes.name: language_of_instruction
attributes.description: ISO 639-2 three-letter language code indicating the primary language of instruction at the issuing institution for the international credential. Used to determine English proficiency test waiver eligibility (e.g., applicants from English-medium institutions may be exempt from TOEFL/IELTS requirements).
attributes.references: ISO 639-2 Language Codes; NAFSA International Admissions Standards; Institutional English Proficiency Policy

attributes.name: meets_minimum_requirement
attributes.description: Indicates whether the composite score or credential evaluation meets the institution's or program's minimum admissions score threshold for the applicable test type. Computed at the time of admissions review based on program-specific thresholds. Supports automated admissions screening workflows.
attributes.references: Institutional Admissions Policy; AACSB Admissions Standards; ABET Admissions Standards; Ellucian Banner SIS — Admissions Module

attributes.name: percentile_rank
attributes.description: National percentile rank corresponding to the composite score as published by the testing agency. Indicates the percentage of test-takers who scored at or below this score. Used in admissions benchmarking and IPEDS reporting of admitted student test score profiles.
attributes.references: College Board SAT Percentile Tables; ACT National Norms; ETS GRE Percentile Ranks; GMAC GMAT Percentile Rankings; IPEDS Admissions Component

attributes.name: record_type
attributes.description: Discriminator indicating whether this record represents a standardized test score (SAT, ACT, GRE, GMAT, TOEFL, IELTS) or an international academic credential (foreign transcript, degree certificate, evaluation report). Drives downstream processing logic in admissions review.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner SIS — Admissions Test Score Entity; IPEDS Reporting Standards

attributes.name: score_notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for admissions staff to record contextual notes about the test score or credential record, such as discrepancies between self-reported and official scores, special testing accommodations, score cancellation history, or credential authentication concerns.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner SIS — Admissions Module; Slate CRM — Application Processing; FERPA (Family Educational Rights and Privacy Act)

attributes.name: score_report_date
attributes.description: Date on which the official score report was received by the institution from the testing agency (e.g., College Board, ETS, ACT Inc.) or evaluation agency. Distinct from test_date; used to track score receipt timelines and admissions file completeness.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner SIS — Admissions Module; College Board Score Send; ETS Score Reporting

attributes.name: score_report_number
attributes.description: The externally-assigned confirmation or report number provided by the testing agency on the official score report. Used to cross-reference and verify the score against the agency's records and to resolve discrepancies between self-reported and official scores.
attributes.references: College Board Score Send Confirmation; ETS Score Report Reference; ACT Score Report Number; Ellucian Banner SIS — Admissions Test Score Entity

attributes.name: score_section_1_label
attributes.description: Name or label of the first sub-score section for the test (e.g., 'Evidence-Based Reading and Writing' for SAT, 'English' for ACT, 'Verbal Reasoning' for GRE, 'Verbal' for GMAT, 'Reading' for TOEFL). Enables structured storage of section scores across heterogeneous test types.
attributes.references: College Board SAT Structure; ACT Score Report; ETS GRE Score Report; GMAC GMAT Score Report; ETS TOEFL Score Report

attributes.name: score_section_1_value
attributes.description: Numeric score for the first sub-score section identified in score_section_1_label. Scale is test-type dependent. Used in admissions criteria evaluation and program-specific minimum score thresholds.
attributes.references: College Board SAT Structure; ACT Score Report; ETS GRE Score Report; GMAC GMAT Score Report; ETS TOEFL Score Report

attributes.name: score_section_2_label
attributes.description: Name or label of the second sub-score section (e.g., 'Math' for SAT/ACT, 'Quantitative Reasoning' for GRE, 'Quantitative' for GMAT, 'Listening' for TOEFL/IELTS). Null if the test type has fewer than two scored sections.
attributes.references: College Board SAT Structure; ACT Score Report; ETS GRE Score Report; GMAC GMAT Score Report; ETS TOEFL Score Report

attributes.name: score_section_2_value
attributes.description: Numeric score for the second sub-score section identified in score_section_2_label. Null if the test type has fewer than two scored sections.
attributes.references: College Board SAT Structure; ACT Score Report; ETS GRE Score Report; GMAC GMAT Score Report; ETS TOEFL Score Report

attributes.name: score_section_3_label
attributes.description: Name or label of the third sub-score section (e.g., 'Reading' for ACT, 'Analytical Writing' for GRE/GMAT, 'Speaking' for TOEFL/IELTS). Null if the test type has fewer than three scored sections.
attributes.references: ACT Score Report; ETS GRE Score Report; GMAC GMAT Score Report; ETS TOEFL Score Report; IELTS Score Report

attributes.name: score_section_3_value
attributes.description: Numeric score for the third sub-score section identified in score_section_3_label. Null if the test type has fewer than three scored sections.
attributes.references: ACT Score Report; ETS GRE Score Report; GMAC GMAT Score Report; ETS TOEFL Score Report; IELTS Score Report

attributes.name: score_section_4_label
attributes.description: Name or label of the fourth sub-score section (e.g., 'Science' for ACT, 'Writing' for TOEFL/IELTS). Null if the test type has fewer than four scored sections.
attributes.references: ACT Score Report; ETS TOEFL Score Report; IELTS Score Report

attributes.name: score_section_4_value
attributes.description: Numeric score for the fourth sub-score section identified in score_section_4_label. Null if the test type has fewer than four scored sections.
attributes.references: ACT Score Report; ETS TOEFL Score Report; IELTS Score Report

attributes.name: score_source
attributes.description: Indicates whether the score was self-reported by the applicant, received as an official score report directly from the testing agency, or verified by a third-party evaluation agency. Drives admissions decision validity rules; self-reported scores may require official verification upon enrollment.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner SIS — Admissions Test Score Entity; Common Application Standards; NACAC Admissions Practices

attributes.name: score_status
attributes.description: Current processing status of the test score record within the admissions workflow. 'pending' = awaiting official score receipt; 'received' = official score received but not yet reviewed; 'verified' = score confirmed authentic; 'expired' = score past validity window; 'waived' = test requirement waived per institutional policy; 'rejected' = score deemed invalid or fraudulent.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner SIS — Admissions Module; Slate CRM — Application Processing; Institutional Admissions Policy

attributes.name: score_validity_expiry_date
attributes.description: Date on which the test score expires per the testing agency's validity policy (e.g., GRE scores valid for 5 years from test date, TOEFL/IELTS scores valid for 2 years). Null for tests with no expiry policy (e.g., SAT, ACT). Used to flag stale scores during admissions file review.
attributes.references: ETS GRE Score Validity Policy; ETS TOEFL Score Validity Policy; IELTS Score Validity Policy; GMAC GMAT Score Validity Policy

attributes.name: superscore
attributes.description: Institution-calculated superscore representing the highest composite score assembled from the best section scores across multiple test sittings of the same test type. Applicable for SAT and ACT where the institution has a superscore policy. Null if the institution does not superscore or if only one sitting exists.
attributes.references: College Board SAT Superscore Policy; ACT Superscore Policy; NACAC Admissions Practices; Ellucian Banner SIS — Admissions Test Score Entity

attributes.name: superscore_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether this test score record is eligible to be included in the institution's superscore calculation for the applicant. True when the test type supports superscoring per institutional policy and the score is official. Drives the superscore computation logic in admissions analytics.
attributes.references: College Board SAT Superscore Policy; ACT Superscore Policy; Institutional Admissions Policy

attributes.name: term_code
attributes.description: Institutional term code identifying the admissions cycle or enrollment term for which this test score was submitted (e.g., 'FALL2025', '202509'). Aligns with Ellucian Banner term coding conventions and supports term-based admissions cohort analysis.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner SIS — Term Table; Institutional Academic Calendar

attributes.name: test_date
attributes.description: Calendar date on which the applicant sat for the standardized test or, for international credentials, the date the credential was issued or conferred. Used to assess score recency and validity windows per admissions policy.
attributes.references: College Board; ACT Inc.; ETS; GMAC; Ellucian Banner SIS — Admissions Test Score Entity

attributes.name: test_optional_waiver
attributes.description: Indicates whether the applicant was granted a test-optional waiver, meaning the institution does not require a standardized test score for this application cycle. Reflects test-optional or test-blind admissions policies adopted by many institutions. Relevant for IPEDS admissions reporting.
attributes.references: NACAC Test-Optional Admissions Policy; IPEDS Admissions Component; Institutional Admissions Policy

attributes.name: test_type
attributes.description: Standardized classification of the test or credential instrument submitted. Examples include SAT (Scholastic Assessment Test), ACT (American College Testing), GRE (Graduate Record Examination), GMAT (Graduate Management Admission Test), TOEFL (Test of English as a Foreign Language), IELTS (International English Language Testing System), AP (Advanced Placement), IB (International Baccalaureate), DUOLINGO, or FOREIGN_CREDENTIAL. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: SAT|ACT|GRE|GMAT|TOEFL|IELTS|AP|IB|DUOLINGO|FOREIGN_CREDENTIAL|OTHER — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: College Board SAT; ACT Inc.; ETS GRE/TOEFL; GMAC GMAT; IELTS Partners; IPEDS CDS Reporting

attributes.name: testing_agency_code
attributes.description: Standardized code identifying the external testing agency or credentialing body that issued the score or credential (e.g., 'CB' for College Board, 'ACT' for ACT Inc., 'ETS' for Educational Testing Service, 'GMAC' for Graduate Management Admission Council, 'IELTS' for IELTS Partners, 'WES' for World Education Services, 'ECE' for Educational Credential Evaluators).
attributes.references: College Board; ACT Inc.; ETS; GMAC; IELTS Partners; WES; ECE; Ellucian Banner SIS — Admissions Module

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to this test score or credential record, such as when an official score replaced a self-reported score, when score status was updated, or when admissions staff added notes. Supports data lineage and audit trail requirements.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner SIS — Admissions Module; Databricks Lakehouse Silver Layer Audit Standards; FERPA Record-Keeping Requirements

attributes.name: us_equivalent_degree_level
attributes.description: The U.S. degree level equivalent assigned by the credential evaluation agency for the international academic credential (e.g., 'bachelor' = equivalent to a U.S. bachelor's degree). Used to determine admissions eligibility and program placement for international applicants. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: high_school|associate|bachelor|master|doctoral|professional|other — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: NACES Credential Evaluation Standards; WES Evaluation Report; ECE Evaluation Report; U.S. Department of Education Credential Recognition

attributes.name: used_in_admissions_decision
attributes.description: Indicates whether this specific test score or credential record was used as evidence in the final admissions decision for the associated application. An applicant may submit multiple scores of the same type; only the highest or most recent may be used. Supports audit trails for admissions decisions and FERPA compliance.
attributes.references: FERPA (Family Educational Rights and Privacy Act); Ellucian Banner SIS — Admissions Module; Institutional Admissions Policy; IPEDS Admissions Component

products.name: application_checklist
products.description: Tracks the required and optional materials for each application including transcripts, letters of recommendation, personal statements, test scores, portfolios, essays, and application fees. For recommendation items, captures recommender identity, title, institution, relationship to applicant, submission method, FERPA waiver of access, and structured evaluation ratings. For transcript items, captures sending institution, CEEB/FICE code, transcript type (high school, undergraduate, graduate), cumulative GPA, class rank, and credit hours. Records item type, required flag, received date, waiver flag, verification status, and reviewer notes. Drives the application completeness workflow in Slate CRM and Banner.

attributes.name: application_checklist_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each application checklist item record in the Silver layer lakehouse. Primary key for this entity.

attributes.name: enrollment_application_id

Tracking which application manages each checklist item type is essential for

attributes.description: The College Board CEEB code (for high schools) or FICE code (for colleges/universities) of the sending institution. Used to uniquely identify the transcript source institution and cross-reference with national clearinghouse records. Applicable when item_type = 'transcript'.
