attributes.name: checklist_code
attributes.description: Institution-defined alphanumeric code uniquely identifying the type of checklist requirement (e.g., TRANS_HS, LOR_1, PERS_STMT, TEST_SAT, APP_FEE). Sourced from Banner checklist code table and synchronized with Slate CRM checklist configuration.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner SARCHKL; Slate CRM Checklist Configuration

attributes.name: class_rank
attributes.description: Applicant's ordinal rank within their graduating class as reported on the high school transcript. Applicable when item_type = 'transcript' and transcript_type = 'high_school'. Null if the sending institution does not report class rank.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner SOAHSCH; IPEDS Admissions Reporting

attributes.name: class_size
attributes.description: Total number of students in the applicant's graduating class as reported on the high school transcript. Used in conjunction with class_rank to compute class rank percentile for admissions evaluation. Applicable when item_type = 'transcript' and transcript_type = 'high_school'.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner SOAHSCH; IPEDS Admissions Reporting

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this checklist item record was first created in the source system or ingested into the Silver layer. Supports audit trail, data lineage, and application completeness timeline analysis. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner SARAPPD Audit; Slate CRM Audit Log; FERPA Record-Keeping Requirements

attributes.name: credit_hours_earned
attributes.description: Total credit hours earned as reported on the transcript from the sending institution. Applicable when item_type = 'transcript' and transcript_type is 'undergraduate' or 'graduate'. Used for transfer credit evaluation and degree audit. CR = Credit Hour.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner SHRTRAM; AACRAO Transfer Credit Practices

attributes.name: cumulative_gpa
attributes.description: Cumulative GPA as reported on the official transcript from the sending institution. Applicable when item_type = 'transcript'. Stored on the 4.0 scale unless otherwise noted in gpa_scale. Used in admissions eligibility evaluation and academic standing analysis. GPA = Grade Point Average.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner SOATEST/SOAHSCH; FERPA; IPEDS Admissions Reporting

attributes.name: deadline_date
attributes.description: The date by which this checklist item must be received for the application to be considered complete and eligible for review. May differ by item type, program, and application round (e.g., Early Decision vs. Regular Decision). Drives deadline compliance alerts in Slate CRM.
attributes.references: Slate CRM Deadline Configuration; Ellucian Banner SARAPPD; Institutional Admissions Calendar

attributes.name: ferpa_waiver_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Family Educational Rights and Privacy Act (FERPA) Waiver of Access Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the applicant has waived their right to access this letter of recommendation under FERPA. True = applicant waived access (confidential recommendation); False = applicant retains right to access. Applicable when item_type = 'recommendation'. FERPA = Family Educational Rights and Privacy Act.
attributes.references: FERPA 34 CFR Part 99; U.S. Department of Education FERPA Guidance; Ellucian Banner SARAPPD

attributes.name: gpa_scale
attributes.description: The maximum GPA scale used by the sending institution (e.g., 4.0, 5.0, 10.0, 100.0). Required to normalize cumulative_gpa for comparative admissions analysis. Applicable when item_type = 'transcript'.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner SOAHSCH; NACES Credential Evaluation Standards

attributes.name: is_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether this checklist item is mandatory for the application to be considered complete and eligible for an admissions decision. True = required; False = optional or supplemental.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner SARCHKL; Slate CRM Checklist Required Flag

attributes.name: item_description
attributes.description: Human-readable label for the checklist requirement as displayed to the applicant and admissions staff (e.g., 'Official High School Transcript', 'Letter of Recommendation — Academic', 'SAT Score Report'). Sourced from Banner checklist description and Slate CRM checklist label.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner SARCHKL; Slate CRM Checklist Label

attributes.name: item_status
attributes.description: Current workflow status of this checklist item within the application completeness process. Drives the application completeness calculation in Slate CRM and Banner admissions workflow. Pending = not yet received; Received = document in hand but not yet reviewed; Verified = reviewed and accepted; Incomplete = received but insufficient; Rejected = received but not accepted; Waived = requirement formally waived.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner SARAPPD; Slate CRM Checklist Status; HLC Admissions Standards

attributes.name: item_type
attributes.description: Categorical classification of the checklist material required. Drives downstream processing logic: transcript items trigger GPA/credit-hour capture; recommendation items trigger recommender identity capture; test_score items trigger score verification. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: transcript|recommendation|personal_statement|test_score|portfolio|essay|application_fee|financial_document|resume|writing_sample|other — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner SARCHKL; NACUBO Admissions Best Practices

attributes.name: official_score_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the test score was received as an official score report directly from the testing agency (True) or as a self-reported score from the applicant (False). Applicable when item_type = 'test_score'. Official scores are required for final admissions decisions at most institutions.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner SOATEST; College Board Score Send Policy; ETS Score Reporting

attributes.name: program_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the academic program or degree level to which the applicant applied (e.g., BSCS, MBA, PHD-CHEM). Checklist requirements may vary by program; this field enables program-specific completeness rules and reporting.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner SMRPRLE; CIP Classification of Instructional Programs

attributes.name: received_date
attributes.description: Calendar date on which the checklist item was received by the admissions office, whether submitted electronically, by mail, or via third-party service. Null if not yet received. Used to calculate application completeness timelines and deadline compliance.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner SARAPPD; Slate CRM Document Receipt Date

attributes.name: recommender_email
attributes.description: Email address of the recommender used to send recommendation request notifications and track submission status. Applicable when item_type = 'recommendation'. Governed by FERPA and institutional privacy policy.
attributes.references: Slate CRM Recommender Object; FERPA 34 CFR Part 99; GDPR Article 4

attributes.name: recommender_institution
attributes.description: Name of the institution, organization, or employer where the recommender is employed. Applicable when item_type = 'recommendation'. Supports evaluation of recommender credibility and relationship context.
attributes.references: Slate CRM Recommender Object; Ellucian Banner SARAPPD

attributes.name: recommender_name
attributes.description: Full legal name of the individual providing the letter of recommendation. Applicable when item_type = 'recommendation'. Captured for identity verification and FERPA waiver tracking purposes.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner SARAPPD; Slate CRM Recommender Object; FERPA 34 CFR Part 99

attributes.name: recommender_rating_academic
attributes.description: Structured evaluation rating provided by the recommender assessing the applicant's academic ability relative to peers. Applicable when item_type = 'recommendation'. Sourced from structured recommendation form fields in Slate CRM. Supports holistic admissions review analytics.
attributes.references: Slate CRM Recommendation Form; Common Application Recommender Rating Scale

attributes.name: recommender_rating_personal
attributes.description: Structured evaluation rating provided by the recommender assessing the applicant's personal character, integrity, and interpersonal skills. Applicable when item_type = 'recommendation'. Sourced from structured recommendation form fields in Slate CRM.
attributes.references: Slate CRM Recommendation Form; Common Application Recommender Rating Scale

attributes.name: recommender_relationship
attributes.description: Nature of the relationship between the recommender and the applicant. Applicable when item_type = 'recommendation'. Used to assess the type and relevance of the recommendation in the admissions review process.
attributes.references: Slate CRM Recommender Relationship Type; Ellucian Banner SARAPPD

attributes.name: recommender_title

attributes.references: Slate CRM Recommender Object; Ellucian Banner SARAPPD

attributes.name: reviewed_by

attributes.name: reviewer_notes

attributes.name: sending_institution_name
attributes.description: Name of the institution that issued the transcript (for transcript-type checklist items). Applicable when item_type = 'transcript'. Examples: 'Lincoln High School', 'University of Michigan'.

attributes.name: sort_order
