attributes.references: FERPA (Family Educational Rights and Privacy Act); Ellucian Banner Admissions

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the originating operational system from which this recommendation record was ingested into the data lakehouse. Supports data lineage tracking across Ellucian Banner, Slate CRM, Common Application, Coalition Application, and Interfolio.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner Student Information System; Slate CRM; Common Application Standards

attributes.name: source_system_rec_code
attributes.description: Native identifier of this recommendation record in the originating operational system (e.g., Banner SPRRECC key, Slate document ID). Enables reconciliation and traceability between the lakehouse silver layer and the system of record.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner Student Information System; Slate CRM

attributes.name: strength
attributes.description: Recommender's explicit endorsement level for the applicant's admission. Captures the recommender's overall willingness to advocate for the applicant's acceptance.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner Admissions; Slate CRM; Common Application Standards

attributes.name: submission_date
attributes.description: Date on which the recommender submitted the completed recommendation. Used to confirm checklist completion and assess timeliness relative to application deadlines.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner Admissions; Slate CRM; Common Application Standards

attributes.name: submission_method
attributes.description: Method by which the recommendation was submitted to the institution. Tracks whether the document arrived via the online admissions portal, physical mail, email attachment, fax, hand delivery, or a third-party credential service such as Interfolio. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: online_portal|mail|email|fax|hand_delivered|interfolio — promote to reference product if additional values are needed]
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner Admissions; Slate CRM; Common Application Standards

attributes.name: submission_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the recommendation within the admissions process. Tracks progression from initial request through receipt and review. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: requested|pending|submitted|received|waived|expired|declined — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner Admissions; Slate CRM Application Checklist

attributes.name: term_code
attributes.description: Academic term code for which the application and associated recommendation are being considered (e.g., 202501 for Spring 2025). Aligns with the institutional term calendar in the Student Information System (SIS).
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner Student Information System; IPEDS (Integrated Postsecondary Education Data System)

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this recommendation record was most recently modified. Supports incremental data loading, change data capture, and audit compliance in the Databricks Lakehouse Silver Layer.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner Admissions; FERPA (Family Educational Rights and Privacy Act); Databricks Lakehouse Silver Layer Audit Standards

attributes.name: verification_status
attributes.description: Status of any authenticity or identity verification performed on the recommendation or recommender. Used to flag potentially fraudulent submissions and support compliance with institutional integrity policies.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner Admissions; Regional Accreditation Agencies (HLC; SACSCOC); Institutional Integrity Policies

products.name: transcript
products.description: Record of an official or unofficial academic transcript received from a prior institution as part of the application process. Captures sending institution name, CEEB/FICE code, transcript type (high school, undergraduate, graduate), receipt date, evaluation status, cumulative GPA, class rank, and credit hours attempted. Supports transfer credit evaluation and admissions criteria review.

attributes.name: transcript_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each transcript record received from a prior institution as part of the admissions or transfer credit evaluation process.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner Student Information System - Academic History Module

attributes.name: application_checklist_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to enrollment.application_checklist. Business justification: Transcript is a specific type of application checklist item. While transcript already references application_id directly, it should also link to its corresponding checklist entry to track receipt stat

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the staff member or admissions counselor responsible for evaluating this transcript and making the credit or admissions determination.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner Admissions Module; Workday HCM

attributes.name: enrollment_applicant_id
attributes.description: Reference to the individual applicant or prospective student who submitted or for whom this transcript was received.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner Admissions Module; Slate CRM Prospect Management

attributes.name: enrollment_application_id
attributes.description: Reference to the admissions application with which this transcript is associated, linking the transcript to the applicant's file in the admissions workflow.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner Admissions Module; Slate CRM Application Processing

attributes.name: ferpa_disclosure_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.ferpa_disclosure. Business justification: Transcript releases are FERPA disclosures requiring audit trail per 34 CFR 99.32. Registrar offices must track each disclosure event, recipient, purpose, and student consent. Essential for FERPA compl

attributes.name: academic_standing
attributes.description: Academic standing of the student at the sending institution as reported on the transcript (e.g., good standing, academic probation, academic suspension, academic dismissal, dean's list). Used in admissions eligibility review and transfer credit decisions.
attributes.references: FERPA (Family Educational Rights and Privacy Act); AACRAO Standards; Ellucian Banner Academic History

attributes.name: ceeb_code
attributes.description: Six-digit College Entrance Examination Board (CEEB) code assigned by College Board to uniquely identify the sending high school or college. Used for standardized institution identification in admissions processing.
attributes.references: College Board CEEB Code Registry; Common Application Standards

attributes.name: cip_code
attributes.description: Six-digit Classification of Instructional Programs (CIP) code corresponding to the major or program of study at the sending institution. Enables standardized program comparison and transfer articulation across institutions.
attributes.references: CIP (Classification of Instructional Programs) - National Center for Education Statistics (NCES); IPEDS

attributes.name: class_rank
attributes.description: Ordinal rank of the student within their graduating class as reported on the transcript. Used in admissions criteria review for competitive programs. Null if the sending institution does not report class rank.
attributes.references: FERPA (Family Educational Rights and Privacy Act); AACRAO Standards

attributes.name: class_size
attributes.description: Total number of students in the graduating class at the sending institution, used in conjunction with class rank to calculate class rank percentile for admissions evaluation.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this transcript record was first created in the system, representing the point at which the transcript was logged into the admissions processing workflow.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner Admissions Module; FERPA Audit Requirements

attributes.name: credit_system
attributes.description: Credit hour system used by the sending institution: semester hours, quarter hours, trimester hours, ECTS (European Credit Transfer System) credits, or institutional units. Required for accurate credit conversion during transfer evaluation.
attributes.references: ECTS (European Credit Transfer System); AACRAO Transfer Credit Practices

attributes.name: credits_attempted
attributes.description: Total number of credit hours (CR) attempted by the student at the sending institution as reported on the transcript. Used in transfer credit evaluation and Satisfactory Academic Progress (SAP) determination.
attributes.references: AACRAO Transfer Credit Practices; SAP (Satisfactory Academic Progress) Federal Regulations 34 CFR 668.34

attributes.name: credits_earned
attributes.description: Total number of credit hours (CR) successfully earned (passed) by the student at the sending institution as reported on the transcript. Distinct from credits attempted; used to assess academic completion rate.
attributes.references: AACRAO Transfer Credit Practices; SAP (Satisfactory Academic Progress) Federal Regulations 34 CFR 668.34

attributes.name: credits_transferable
attributes.description: Number of credit hours from the sending institution that have been approved for transfer to the receiving institution following evaluation. May be less than or equal to credits earned.
attributes.references: AACRAO Transfer Credit Practices; Ellucian Banner Academic History

attributes.name: cumulative_gpa
attributes.description: Cumulative Grade Point Average (GPA) as reported on the transcript from the sending institution, typically on a 4.0 scale. Used as a primary academic performance indicator in admissions criteria review and transfer credit eligibility assessment.
attributes.references: FERPA (Family Educational Rights and Privacy Act); AACRAO Standards; Ellucian Banner Academic History

attributes.name: degree_awarded
attributes.description: Name of the degree, diploma, or credential awarded by the sending institution as printed on the transcript (e.g., Bachelor of Science, Associate of Arts, High School Diploma, GED). Null if no degree was conferred.
attributes.references: CIP (Classification of Instructional Programs); IPEDS Completions Survey; AACRAO Standards

attributes.name: delivery_method
attributes.description: Method by which the transcript was delivered to the receiving institution: electronic (e.g., via Parchment, National Student Clearinghouse), physical mail, hand-delivered by applicant, or fax.
attributes.references: AACRAO Electronic Transcript Standards; Parchment/National Student Clearinghouse EDI Standards

attributes.name: disciplinary_notation
attributes.description: Indicates whether the transcript contains a disciplinary notation or academic integrity violation record from the sending institution (True). Used in admissions character review and compliance with institutional conduct policies.
attributes.references: FERPA (Family Educational Rights and Privacy Act); AACRAO Standards

attributes.name: document_reference_number
attributes.description: External reference or tracking number assigned by the sending institution or transcript delivery service (e.g., Parchment order ID, NSC tracking number) to uniquely identify the transcript document for reconciliation and audit purposes.
attributes.references: Parchment EDI Standards; National Student Clearinghouse; AACRAO Electronic Transcript Standards

attributes.name: document_source_system
attributes.description: Electronic transcript exchange network or delivery platform through which the transcript was received (e.g., Parchment, National Student Clearinghouse, Scrip-Safe, paper mail). Used for document provenance tracking and audit.
attributes.references: AACRAO Electronic Transcript Standards; Parchment EDI Standards; National Student Clearinghouse

attributes.name: evaluation_date
attributes.description: Calendar date on which the transcript evaluation was completed by the admissions evaluator or transfer credit analyst.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner Admissions Module; AACRAO Transfer Credit Practices

attributes.name: evaluation_status
attributes.description: Current workflow status of the transcript evaluation process: pending (received, not yet reviewed), in_review (actively being evaluated), evaluated (review complete), accepted (credits or credentials accepted), rejected (not accepted), or on_hold (awaiting additional information). Drives admissions and transfer credit workflows.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner Admissions Module; AACRAO Transfer Credit Practices

attributes.name: fice_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: Federal Interagency Committee on Education (FICE) Code
attributes.description: Six-digit Federal Interagency Committee on Education (FICE) code assigned by the U.S. Department of Education to identify postsecondary institutions. Used for IPEDS reporting and transfer credit institution matching.
attributes.references: IPEDS (Integrated Postsecondary Education Data System); U.S. Department of Education

attributes.name: foreign_credential_eval_agency
attributes.description: Name of the NACES-member credential evaluation agency (e.g., WES, ECE, AACRAO EDGE) that evaluated the foreign transcript. Populated only when foreign_credential_eval_required is True.
attributes.references: NACES (National Association of Credential Evaluation Services); AACRAO EDGE

attributes.name: foreign_credential_eval_date
attributes.description: Date on which the foreign credential evaluation was completed by the designated evaluation agency. Used to track evaluation turnaround and application completeness for international applicants.
attributes.references: NACES (National Association of Credential Evaluation Services); AACRAO Standards

attributes.name: foreign_credential_eval_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether this transcript requires a foreign credential evaluation by a NACES-member evaluation service (True) because it originates from a non-U.S. institution. Triggers the foreign credential evaluation workflow in admissions.
attributes.references: NACES (National Association of Credential Evaluation Services); U.S. Department of Education; AACRAO Standards

attributes.name: gpa_scale
attributes.description: Maximum GPA scale used by the sending institution (e.g., 4.0, 5.0, 10.0, 100.0). Required to normalize and compare GPA values across institutions with different grading systems.
attributes.references: AACRAO Transfer Credit Practices; ECTS (European Credit Transfer System) Guidelines

attributes.name: graduation_date
attributes.description: Date on which the student graduated or completed their program at the sending institution as reported on the transcript. Used to verify degree completion for graduate admissions and transfer eligibility.
attributes.references: FERPA (Family Educational Rights and Privacy Act); AACRAO Standards

attributes.name: honors_notation
attributes.description: Academic honors designation printed on the transcript from the sending institution (e.g., cum laude, magna cum laude, summa cum laude, honors program). Used in merit scholarship evaluation and admissions recognition.
attributes.references: AACRAO Standards; Ellucian Banner Academic History

attributes.name: institution_country
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 three-letter country code of the country where the sending institution is located. Used to identify international transcripts requiring foreign credential evaluation.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1 Alpha-3 Country Codes; NACES (National Association of Credential Evaluation Services)

attributes.name: institution_name
attributes.description: Full legal name of the prior institution (high school, college, or university) that issued this official or unofficial transcript.
attributes.references: IPEDS (Integrated Postsecondary Education Data System); National Center for Education Statistics (NCES)

attributes.name: institution_state
attributes.description: Two-letter U.S. state or territory abbreviation where the sending institution is located. Applicable for domestic institutions; null for international institutions.

attributes.name: major_field_of_study
attributes.description: Primary academic major or field of study as reported on the transcript from the sending institution. Used in transfer credit articulation and program admission requirements review.
attributes.references: CIP (Classification of Instructional Programs); IPEDS; AACRAO Standards

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes entered by the admissions evaluator or registrar staff regarding special circumstances, exceptions, or observations related to this transcript evaluation. May contain sensitive academic information.
attributes.references: FERPA (Family Educational Rights and Privacy Act); Ellucian Banner Admissions Module

attributes.name: official_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the transcript is an official document received directly from the issuing institution (True) or an unofficial copy submitted by the applicant (False). Official transcripts are required for final admissions decisions and enrollment confirmation.
attributes.references: AACRAO (American Association of Collegiate Registrars and Admissions Officers) Standards; Ellucian Banner Admissions

attributes.name: receipt_date
attributes.description: Calendar date on which the transcript was received by the institution's admissions or registrar office. Used to track application completeness and compliance with admissions deadlines.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner Admissions Module; AACRAO Standards

attributes.name: term_end_date
attributes.description: End date of the last term of enrollment at the sending institution as reported on the transcript. Used to establish the duration of prior enrollment and recency of academic activity.
attributes.references: AACRAO Standards; Ellucian Banner Academic History

attributes.name: term_start_date
attributes.description: Start date of the first term of enrollment at the sending institution as reported on the transcript. Used to establish the duration of prior enrollment and academic history timeline.
attributes.references: AACRAO Standards; Ellucian Banner Academic History

attributes.name: transcript_type
attributes.description: Classification of the transcript by the level of education it represents: high school (secondary), undergraduate (bachelor's-level), graduate (master's/doctoral), professional (law/medical/business), or vocational/technical. Drives transfer credit evaluation rules and admissions criteria review. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: high_school|undergraduate|graduate|professional|vocational|international — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: CIP (Classification of Instructional Programs); AACRAO Transfer Credit Practices; Ellucian Banner Academic History

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent update to this transcript record, supporting audit trail requirements and change tracking for FERPA compliance and accreditation reporting.
attributes.references: FERPA (Family Educational Rights and Privacy Act); HLC Accreditation Standards; Ellucian Banner

attributes.name: verification_date
attributes.description: Date on which the transcript was verified as authentic by the admissions office or third-party verification service. Populated only when verified_flag is True.
attributes.references: HLC (Higher Learning Commission) Accreditation Standards; AACRAO Standards

attributes.name: verified_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the authenticity of the transcript has been independently verified by the admissions office or a third-party verification service (True). Supports fraud prevention and accreditation compliance.
attributes.references: HLC (Higher Learning Commission) Accreditation Standards; SACSCOC Standards; AACRAO Standards

products.name: admission_criteria
products.description: Reference entity defining the admissions requirements and evaluation criteria for each program, entry level, and entry term. Captures minimum GPA thresholds, required test scores, prerequisite coursework, portfolio requirements, interview requirements, and holistic review weights. Managed by the admissions office and updated each cycle. Drives automated eligibility screening.
products.reference: Institutional Admissions Policy / Common Data Set Section C

attributes.name: admission_criteria_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each admission criteria record. Primary key for the admission_criteria data product.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner Student Information System - Admissions Module

attributes.name: academic_program_id
attributes.description: Reference to the academic program for which these admission criteria apply. Links criteria to a specific degree or certificate program.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner Student Information System - Admissions Module; CIP (Classification of Instructional Programs)

attributes.name: authored_by_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to hr.employee. Business justification: Admission criteria authorship and approval tracking requires linking to the faculty member or academic administrator who created or last reviewed the criteria. Accreditation reviews and academic gover

attributes.name: compliance_accreditation_standard_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.accreditation_standard. Business justification: Admission criteria must demonstrably align with accreditor standards (e.g., AACSB minimum GMAT, ABET prerequisite requirements). Program directors and accreditation liaisons use this link to document

attributes.name: term_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to enrollment.term. Business justification: Admission criteria vary by entry term. Currently admission_criteria has entry_term_code as STRING but no FK to term. Adding term_id FK normalizes the term reference and enables proper term-based crite

attributes.name: accreditation_body_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the accreditation body whose standards govern the admission criteria for this program. Ensures criteria align with accreditor-mandated admission requirements. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: HLC|SACSCOC|ABET|AACSB|ABA|LCME|MSCHE|NWCCU|NECHE|WSCUC — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: HLC (Higher Learning Commission); SACSCOC; ABET; AACSB; ABA; LCME; U.S. Department of Education

attributes.name: application_deadline_date
attributes.description: Final date by which applications must be submitted to be evaluated under this criteria set. Used to configure deadline enforcement in Slate CRM and Banner admissions workflows.
attributes.references: Slate CRM - Application Processing; Ellucian Banner Student Information System - Admissions Module

attributes.name: approved_by
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the admissions office authority (e.g., Dean of Admissions, Program Director) who approved this criteria configuration. Supports governance and audit trail for criteria changes.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner Student Information System - Admissions Module; HLC; SACSCOC; Institutional Accreditation and Compliance

attributes.name: approved_date
attributes.description: Date on which this admission criteria configuration was formally approved by the designated authority. Supports governance, audit, and accreditation compliance documentation.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner Student Information System - Admissions Module; HLC; SACSCOC; FERPA (Family Educational Rights and Privacy Act)

attributes.name: automated_screening_enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether this criteria set is configured to drive automated eligibility screening in the admissions system. When True, Banner or Slate CRM applies the criteria thresholds to filter applications without manual review.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner Student Information System - Admissions Module; Slate CRM

attributes.name: citizenship_requirement
attributes.description: Citizenship status requirement for applicants under this criteria set. Relevant for programs with federal funding restrictions or visa-related enrollment constraints.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner Student Information System - Admissions Module; U.S. Department of Education; Title IV Financial Aid Administration

attributes.name: criteria_code
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric code uniquely identifying this criteria configuration within the admissions office. Used for cross-referencing in Slate CRM and Banner.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner Student Information System - Admissions Module; Slate CRM

attributes.name: criteria_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name describing this set of admission criteria (e.g., 'Fall 2025 Undergraduate Engineering Freshman Criteria'). Used in admissions office reporting and communications.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner Student Information System - Admissions Module

attributes.name: criteria_notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional context, exceptions, or special instructions associated with this admission criteria set. Used by admissions staff to document program-specific nuances not captured in structured fields.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner Student Information System - Admissions Module

attributes.name: criteria_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of this admission criteria record. DRAFT indicates criteria under review; ACTIVE indicates currently in use for eligibility screening; INACTIVE indicates suspended; ARCHIVED indicates historical record no longer applied.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner Student Information System - Admissions Module

attributes.name: criteria_type
attributes.description: Classification of the admission review methodology. STANDARD applies fixed thresholds; HOLISTIC incorporates weighted qualitative review; SELECTIVE applies competitive ranking; OPEN_ADMISSION has no minimum requirements; CONDITIONAL applies provisional admission rules.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner Student Information System - Admissions Module; NACUBO; IPEDS

attributes.name: decision_notification_date
attributes.description: Target date by which admission decisions are communicated to applicants for this criteria cycle. Used for planning admissions office workflows and applicant communications in Slate CRM.
attributes.references: Slate CRM - Application Processing; Ellucian Banner Student Information System - Admissions Module

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: Date after which this admission criteria configuration is no longer applied. Null indicates the criteria is open-ended and currently active. Supports historical versioning.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner Student Information System - Admissions Module; HLC; SACSCOC

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: Date from which this admission criteria configuration becomes effective and is applied to incoming applications. Supports versioning of criteria across admission cycles.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner Student Information System - Admissions Module; HLC (Higher Learning Commission); SACSCOC

attributes.name: entry_level_code
attributes.description: Academic entry level for which these criteria apply, such as freshman, transfer, graduate, doctoral, certificate, or professional. Determines which applicant population is evaluated against this criteria set.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner Student Information System - Admissions Module; IPEDS (Integrated Postsecondary Education Data System)

attributes.name: essay_weight_pct
attributes.description: Percentage weight assigned to personal statement or essay submissions in the holistic review scoring model. Expressed as a percentage (0-100).
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner Student Information System - Admissions Module; U.S. Department of Education

attributes.name: extracurricular_weight_pct
attributes.description: Percentage weight assigned to extracurricular activities, leadership, and community involvement in the holistic review scoring model. Expressed as a percentage (0-100).
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner Student Information System - Admissions Module; U.S. Department of Education

attributes.name: gpa_scale
attributes.description: The numeric scale used to evaluate the minimum GPA requirement (e.g., 4.0, 5.0, 10.0). Necessary to correctly interpret min_gpa when evaluating international or non-standard transcripts.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner Student Information System - Admissions Module; ECTS (European Credit Transfer System)

attributes.name: gpa_weight_pct
attributes.description: Percentage weight assigned to GPA in the holistic review scoring model. Expressed as a percentage (0-100). All weight percentages across review criteria should sum to 100 when holistic review is enabled.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner Student Information System - Admissions Module; U.S. Department of Education

attributes.name: holistic_review_enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether holistic review methodology is applied in the admission evaluation, considering non-academic factors such as leadership, community service, and life experience alongside academic metrics.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner Student Information System - Admissions Module; U.S. Department of Education; HLC; SACSCOC

attributes.name: interview_format
attributes.description: Format of the required admission interview. IN_PERSON for on-campus interviews; VIRTUAL for video-based interviews; PANEL for multi-interviewer sessions; MMI (Multiple Mini Interview) for medical/health professional programs.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner Student Information System - Admissions Module; Slate CRM; LCME

attributes.name: interview_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether a formal interview is required as part of the admission evaluation process. Applicable to selective programs such as honors, medical, law, and MBA programs.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner Student Information System - Admissions Module; Slate CRM; LCME; ABA

attributes.name: last_reviewed_date
attributes.description: Date on which this admission criteria record was last reviewed by the admissions office for accuracy and relevance. Supports annual review cycles required by accreditation bodies.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner Student Information System - Admissions Module; HLC; SACSCOC; AACSB; ABET

attributes.name: letters_of_recommendation_required
attributes.description: Number of letters of recommendation required as part of the application. Zero indicates no letters are required. Used to configure application checklists in Slate CRM.
attributes.references: Slate CRM - Application Processing; Ellucian Banner Student Information System - Admissions Module

attributes.name: min_act_composite
attributes.business_glossary_term: Minimum ACT (American College Testing) Composite Score
attributes.description: Minimum ACT (American College Testing) composite score required for admission consideration. Null indicates ACT is not required or no minimum is enforced. Applies to undergraduate freshman applicants.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner Student Information System - Admissions Module; ACT Score Reporting Standards

attributes.name: min_class_rank_pct
attributes.description: Minimum high school class rank percentile required for admission consideration (e.g., 75.00 means applicant must be in the top 25% of their graduating class). Null indicates class rank is not evaluated.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner Student Information System - Admissions Module; IPEDS

attributes.name: min_credit_hours_completed
attributes.description: Minimum number of college credit hours (CR) an applicant must have completed prior to admission. Primarily applicable to transfer applicants. Null indicates no minimum credit hour requirement.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner Student Information System - Admissions Module; IPEDS

attributes.name: min_gmat_total
attributes.business_glossary_term: Minimum GMAT (Graduate Management Admission Test) Total Score
attributes.description: Minimum GMAT (Graduate Management Admission Test) total score required for business graduate program admission. Null indicates GMAT is not required or no minimum is enforced. Relevant for AACSB-accredited programs.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner Student Information System - Admissions Module; AACSB (Association to Advance Collegiate Schools of Business); GMAC GMAT Score Reporting Standards

attributes.name: min_gpa
attributes.description: Minimum cumulative GPA (Grade Point Average) on a 4.0 scale required for an applicant to be considered for admission. Null indicates no minimum GPA threshold is enforced for this criteria set.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner Student Information System - Admissions Module; IPEDS

attributes.name: min_gre_quantitative
attributes.business_glossary_term: Minimum GRE (Graduate Record Examination) Quantitative Score
attributes.description: Minimum GRE (Graduate Record Examination) quantitative reasoning score required for graduate admission. Null indicates GRE quantitative is not required or no minimum is enforced.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner Student Information System - Admissions Module; ETS GRE Score Reporting Standards

attributes.name: min_gre_verbal
attributes.business_glossary_term: Minimum GRE (Graduate Record Examination) Verbal Score
attributes.description: Minimum GRE (Graduate Record Examination) verbal reasoning score required for graduate admission. Null indicates GRE verbal is not required or no minimum is enforced.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner Student Information System - Admissions Module; ETS GRE Score Reporting Standards

attributes.name: min_ielts_band
attributes.business_glossary_term: Minimum IELTS (International English Language Testing System) Band Score
attributes.description: Minimum IELTS (International English Language Testing System) overall band score required for international applicants. Null indicates IELTS is not required. Accepted as an alternative to TOEFL.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner Student Information System - Admissions Module; IELTS Score Reporting Standards; U.S. Department of Education

attributes.name: min_sat_total
attributes.business_glossary_term: Minimum SAT (Scholastic Assessment Test) Total Score
attributes.description: Minimum combined SAT (Scholastic Assessment Test) score required for admission consideration. Null indicates SAT is not required or no minimum is enforced. Applies to undergraduate freshman applicants.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner Student Information System - Admissions Module; College Board SAT Score Reporting Standards

attributes.name: min_toefl_score
attributes.business_glossary_term: Minimum TOEFL (Test of English as a Foreign Language) Score
attributes.description: Minimum TOEFL (Test of English as a Foreign Language) iBT total score required for international applicants whose native language is not English. Null indicates TOEFL is not required.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner Student Information System - Admissions Module; ETS TOEFL Score Reporting Standards; U.S. Department of Education

attributes.name: personal_statement_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether a personal statement or statement of purpose essay is required as part of the application. Drives application checklist configuration in Slate CRM.
attributes.references: Slate CRM - Application Processing; Ellucian Banner Student Information System - Admissions Module

attributes.name: portfolio_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether a creative or professional portfolio submission is required for admission. Applicable to programs in fine arts, architecture, design, and similar disciplines.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner Student Information System - Admissions Module; Slate CRM

attributes.name: portfolio_type
attributes.description: Type of portfolio required for admission when portfolio_required is True. CREATIVE for arts/design programs; PROFESSIONAL for business/engineering; RESEARCH for graduate research programs; DIGITAL for online submission formats.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner Student Information System - Admissions Module; Slate CRM

attributes.name: prerequisite_coursework_description
attributes.description: Narrative description of required prerequisite courses or subject areas (e.g., 'Calculus I, Chemistry I, Biology I'). Used by admissions counselors and applicants to understand coursework requirements.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner Student Information System - Admissions Module; ABET; AACSB

attributes.name: prerequisite_coursework_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether specific prerequisite coursework must be completed prior to admission. When True, the admissions office evaluates transcripts for required course completion.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner Student Information System - Admissions Module; ABET; AACSB

attributes.name: priority_deadline_date
attributes.description: Earlier deadline by which applications must be submitted to receive priority consideration for admission and financial aid. Applications received after this date but before the final deadline are still reviewed but may not receive priority treatment.
attributes.references: Slate CRM - Application Processing; Ellucian Banner Student Information System - Admissions Module; U.S. Department of Education

attributes.name: residency_requirement
attributes.description: Residency classification requirement for applicants under this criteria set. Determines whether criteria apply to in-state, out-of-state, international, or all applicants. Affects tuition classification and eligibility screening.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner Student Information System - Admissions Module; U.S. Department of Education; IPEDS

attributes.name: test_optional_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether standardized test scores (SAT/ACT/GRE/GMAT) are optional for this admission criteria set. True means applicants may apply without submitting test scores. Reflects test-optional admission policies.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner Student Information System - Admissions Module; NACUBO; IPEDS

attributes.name: test_score_weight_pct
attributes.description: Percentage weight assigned to standardized test scores (SAT/ACT/GRE/GMAT) in the holistic review scoring model. Expressed as a percentage (0-100).
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner Student Information System - Admissions Module; U.S. Department of Education

products.name: recruitment_event
products.description: Master record for admissions recruitment events and the geographic territories they serve. Captures event type (open house, campus tour, college fair, virtual info session, high school visit), date, location, target audience (FTIAC, transfer, graduate), registration capacity, actual attendance, host staff, and territory context (territory name, geographic boundaries, assigned counselor). Sourced from Slate CRM Events module. Supports yield management, recruitment ROI analysis, territory-based recruitment planning, and counselor workload management.

attributes.name: recruitment_event_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each recruitment event record in the enrollment domain. Primary key for the recruitment_event data product.

attributes.name: primary_recruitment_employee_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the primary admissions counselor responsible for hosting and managing this recruitment event. Links to the staff/employee record for workload management, territory assignment, and performance reporting. Serves as the PARTY_REFERENCE for this transaction.
attributes.references: Slate CRM Events Module; Workday HCM

attributes.name: recruitment_territory_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to enrollment.recruitment_territory. Business justification: Recruitment events are organized within specific territories. Currently recruitment_event has territory_name and territory_region as denormalized strings. Adding FK to recruitment_territory normalizes

attributes.name: venue_building_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to facility.building. Business justification: On-campus recruitment events (open houses, admitted student days) are held in specific buildings. Event planning, space coordination, and facility services require linking recruitment events to buildi

attributes.name: academic_term
attributes.description: The enrollment term for which this recruitment event is intended to generate yield (e.g., 'Fall 2025', 'Spring 2026'). Aligns recruitment activity to term-based enrollment cycles and supports cohort-level yield analysis.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner Student Information System (SIS); Slate CRM Events Module

attributes.name: academic_year
attributes.description: The academic year associated with this recruitment event (e.g., '2024-2025'). Used for year-over-year trend analysis, accreditation reporting, and IPEDS enrollment data submissions.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner SIS; IPEDS Enrollment Reporting; HLC Accreditation Standards

attributes.name: actual_attendance
attributes.description: The actual number of individuals who attended the recruitment event. Populated after event completion. Used for yield management analysis, ROI calculation, and show rate (actual_attendance / registered_count) reporting.
attributes.references: Slate CRM Events Module; NACUBO Enrollment Management Standards

attributes.name: actual_cost
attributes.description: The actual total expenditure (in USD) incurred for this recruitment event after completion. Populated from Oracle PeopleSoft Financials. Used for recruitment ROI analysis, cost-per-attendee calculations, and territory budget variance reporting.
attributes.references: Oracle PeopleSoft Financials; NACUBO Financial Reporting Standards; GASB

attributes.name: cancellation_reason
attributes.description: Free-text description of the reason this recruitment event was cancelled or postponed. Populated only when event_status is 'cancelled' or 'postponed'. Used for operational review and future event planning.

attributes.name: cip_code
attributes.description: The six-digit Classification of Instructional Programs (CIP) code associated with the primary academic program being recruited for at this event (e.g., '11.0701' for Computer Science). Enables standardized program-level reporting to IPEDS and accreditation bodies.
attributes.references: NCES CIP Code Framework; IPEDS; U.S. Department of Education

attributes.name: college_unit
attributes.description: The specific college, school, or academic unit within the institution that this recruitment event primarily represents or is organized by (e.g., 'College of Engineering', 'School of Business', 'Graduate School'). Supports unit-level yield analysis and AACSB/ABET accreditation reporting.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner SIS; Slate CRM Events Module; AACSB; ABET

attributes.name: cost_center_code
attributes.description: The institutional cost center or budget unit code to which the expenses for this recruitment event are charged. Sourced from Oracle PeopleSoft Financials chart of accounts. Enables financial reporting and budget reconciliation by organizational unit.
attributes.references: Oracle PeopleSoft Financials; NACUBO Financial Reporting Standards; GASB

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this recruitment event record was first created in the source system (Slate CRM). Serves as the RECORD_AUDIT_CREATED field for data lineage, audit trail, and silver layer ingestion tracking.
attributes.references: Slate CRM Events Module; FERPA; HLC Accreditation Standards

attributes.name: delivery_mode
attributes.description: Indicates whether the recruitment event is conducted in-person at a physical location, fully virtual (online), or in a hybrid format combining both modalities. Informs logistics planning, technology requirements, and attendance capacity management.
attributes.references: Slate CRM Events Module; NACUBO Enrollment Management Standards

attributes.name: end_timestamp
attributes.description: The precise date and time at which the recruitment event concludes. Combined with start_timestamp to calculate event duration for ROI and counselor workload analysis.

attributes.name: estimated_cost
attributes.description: The planned or budgeted total cost (in USD) for executing this recruitment event, including venue rental, travel, materials, and staff time. Used for recruitment ROI analysis and budget planning. Compared against actual_cost post-event.
attributes.references: Oracle PeopleSoft Financials; NACUBO Financial Reporting Standards

attributes.name: event_date
attributes.description: The calendar date on which the recruitment event is scheduled to occur or did occur. Used for term-based recruitment cycle planning, territory scheduling, and yield management timelines.
attributes.references: Slate CRM Events Module; IPEDS Enrollment Reporting

attributes.name: event_name
attributes.description: Human-readable title or name of the recruitment event as displayed to prospective students and staff (e.g., 'Fall Open House 2024', 'Engineering Campus Tour – October'). Used in communications, reporting dashboards, and yield management analysis.
attributes.references: Slate CRM Events Module; IPEDS Enrollment Reporting

attributes.name: event_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the recruitment event. Tracks the event from initial planning through execution and closure. 'draft' indicates planning phase; 'published' indicates open for registration; 'active' indicates event is in progress; 'completed' indicates event concluded; 'cancelled' or 'postponed' indicate event did not proceed as scheduled.

attributes.name: event_type
attributes.description: Categorical classification of the recruitment event format. Drives yield management strategy, ROI analysis, and counselor workload reporting. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: open_house|campus_tour|college_fair|virtual_info_session|high_school_visit|yield_event|admitted_student_day|graduate_info_session — promote to reference product if additional types are needed]
attributes.references: Slate CRM Events Module; NACUBO Enrollment Management Standards

attributes.name: is_registration_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether advance registration is required to attend this recruitment event. When True, attendance is tracked against registered_count and registration_capacity. When False, the event is open walk-in and capacity is managed differently.

attributes.name: is_virtual_platform_recorded
attributes.description: Indicates whether a recording of the virtual or hybrid recruitment event is available for on-demand viewing by prospective students who could not attend live. Relevant only for virtual and hybrid delivery modes; supports asynchronous yield engagement.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for admissions staff to capture operational notes, special instructions, or contextual information about the recruitment event that does not fit structured fields. Sourced from Slate CRM event record comments.

attributes.name: program_focus
attributes.description: The specific academic program or field of study that this recruitment event is designed to promote (e.g., 'Computer Science', 'MBA', 'Nursing'). May align to Classification of Instructional Programs (CIP) codes. Supports program-level yield analysis and enrollment pipeline reporting.
attributes.references: Slate CRM Events Module; CIP Code Framework (NCES); IPEDS

attributes.name: registered_count
attributes.description: The total number of individuals who have registered for this recruitment event as of the last data refresh. Compared against registration_capacity to determine fill rate and waitlist trigger thresholds.

attributes.name: registration_capacity
attributes.description: The maximum number of registrants (prospective students and guests) permitted to register for this recruitment event. Used for capacity planning, waitlist management, and yield optimization. Represents the planned upper bound set at event creation.
attributes.references: Slate CRM Events Module; NACUBO Enrollment Management Standards

attributes.name: registration_close_date
attributes.description: The date on which registration for this recruitment event closes. After this date, no new registrations are accepted unless the event allows walk-ins. Used for communications scheduling and final capacity management.

attributes.name: registration_open_date
attributes.description: The date on which registration for this recruitment event opens to prospective students. Used to manage the registration window, trigger Slate CRM communications, and monitor early registration demand.

attributes.name: staff_count
attributes.description: The total number of institutional staff members (admissions counselors, faculty, student ambassadors) assigned to support this recruitment event. Used for counselor workload management and event resource planning.
attributes.references: Slate CRM Events Module; Workday HCM

attributes.name: start_timestamp
attributes.description: The precise date and time at which the recruitment event begins. Used for scheduling, calendar integration, and counselor workload management. Stored in ISO 8601 format with timezone offset.

attributes.name: target_audience
attributes.description: The primary prospective student population this event is designed to recruit. First-Time-In-Any-College (FTIAC) refers to first-year undergraduate prospects; transfer refers to students moving from another institution; graduate refers to post-baccalaureate prospects; international refers to non-domestic prospects. Drives yield management segmentation and ROI analysis by audience type.
attributes.references: Slate CRM Events Module; IPEDS Enrollment Reporting; NACUBO Enrollment Management Standards

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this recruitment event record was most recently modified in the source system (Slate CRM). Serves as the RECORD_AUDIT_UPDATED field for change detection, incremental ETL processing, and audit compliance.
attributes.references: Slate CRM Events Module; FERPA; HLC Accreditation Standards

attributes.name: venue_city
attributes.description: The city in which the recruitment event venue is located. Used for geographic territory analysis, travel cost tracking, and territory-based recruitment planning.

attributes.name: venue_country
attributes.description: The three-letter ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code for the country where the recruitment event venue is located (e.g., 'USA', 'CAN', 'GBR'). Supports international recruitment tracking and territory-based planning.
attributes.references: Slate CRM Events Module; ISO 3166-1 Alpha-3

attributes.name: venue_name
attributes.description: The name of the physical or virtual venue where the recruitment event is held (e.g., 'University Student Union Ballroom', 'Chicago Marriott Downtown', 'Zoom Webinar'). Used for logistics coordination and event reporting.
attributes.references: Slate CRM Events Module; Archibus Facilities Management

attributes.name: venue_state_province
attributes.business_glossary_term: Recruitment Event Venue State or Province
attributes.description: The two-letter US state or Canadian province code where the recruitment event venue is located (e.g., 'MI', 'IL', 'ON'). Used for territory assignment, geographic yield analysis, and counselor territory mapping.

attributes.name: virtual_event_url
attributes.description: The web URL or meeting link for accessing the virtual or hybrid recruitment event. Distributed to registered attendees via Slate CRM communications. Applicable when delivery_mode is 'virtual' or 'hybrid'.

attributes.name: virtual_platform
attributes.description: The technology platform used to host virtual or hybrid recruitment events (e.g., Zoom, Microsoft Teams, Webex). Applicable when delivery_mode is 'virtual' or 'hybrid'. Used for technology cost tracking and platform performance analysis.

attributes.name: waitlist_count
attributes.description: The number of prospective students currently on the waitlist for this recruitment event after registration capacity has been reached. Supports demand analysis and informs decisions to add additional event sessions.

products.name: event_registration
products.description: Transactional record of a prospect or applicant registering for and attending a recruitment event. Captures registration date, attendance status (registered, attended, no-show, cancelled), check-in method, and post-event survey response flag. Links prospects and applicants to recruitment events for funnel attribution and yield modeling.

attributes.name: event_registration_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each event registration record in the enrollment recruitment funnel. Primary key for the event_registration data product.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner SIS / Slate CRM — Enrollment Event Module

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the admissions counselor or recruiter assigned to this prospect at the time of event registration. Used for counselor workload reporting, territory management, and follow-up accountability tracking.
attributes.references: Slate CRM — Counselor Assignment; Ellucian Banner Admissions Staff

attributes.name: enrollment_application_id
attributes.description: Reference to the admissions application submitted by the prospect following event attendance. Null if no application has been submitted. Enables direct linkage between event participation and application conversion for yield modeling.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner — Admissions Application Table; Slate CRM Funnel Attribution

attributes.name: event_session_id
attributes.description: Reference to a specific session or breakout within a multi-session recruitment event (e.g., a campus open house with concurrent information sessions by college). Null for single-session events.

attributes.name: prospect_id
attributes.description: Reference to the prospective student or applicant who registered for the recruitment event. Links to the prospect master record in the admissions CRM for funnel attribution and yield modeling.

attributes.name: recruit_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to athletics.recruit. Business justification: NCAA limits official and unofficial campus visits by athletic recruits. When a prospect registers for a campus event and is also a recruit, this link enables compliance tracking of visit counts, ensur

attributes.name: recruitment_event_id
attributes.description: Reference to the recruitment event for which this registration was created. Links to the event master record capturing event type, location, date, and capacity.
attributes.references: Slate CRM — Events Module; Ellucian Banner Admissions

attributes.name: academic_term_code
attributes.description: The academic term (e.g., FALL2025, SPRING2026) for which the prospect intends to enroll. Used to align recruitment event attendance with enrollment cycle planning and yield forecasting by term.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner — Term Code Table; IPEDS Enrollment Reporting

attributes.name: accessibility_accommodation
attributes.description: Free-text or coded description of any accessibility or disability-related accommodations requested by the registrant for the event (e.g., wheelchair access, sign language interpreter, dietary restriction). Classified as confidential per ADA and institutional disability services policy.
attributes.references: Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA); Section 504 Rehabilitation Act; FERPA

attributes.name: application_submitted_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the prospect submitted an application to the institution following attendance at this recruitment event. Key yield modeling indicator linking event attendance to application conversion in the admissions funnel.
attributes.references: Slate CRM — Funnel Attribution; Ellucian Banner Admissions; NACUBO Enrollment Management

attributes.name: cancellation_date
attributes.description: The date on which the registrant cancelled their event registration. Null if the registration was not cancelled. Used to track cancellation lead time relative to the event date and to manage seat reallocation.
attributes.references: Slate CRM — Event Registration Cancellation Workflow

attributes.name: cancellation_reason
attributes.description: Standardized reason provided by the registrant or staff for cancelling the event registration. Supports analysis of barriers to attendance and informs event scheduling and logistics improvements.
attributes.references: Slate CRM — Cancellation Reason Codes; NACUBO Enrollment Management

attributes.name: check_in_method
attributes.description: The mechanism by which the registrant checked in to the event. Supports operational analysis of check-in efficiency and technology adoption. Values: qr_code (scanned QR code), staff_manual (staff entered manually), self_service_kiosk (kiosk terminal), mobile_app (institution mobile app), online_virtual (virtual event login).

attributes.name: check_in_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the registrant physically or virtually checked in to the recruitment event. Null if the registrant did not attend. Distinct from registration_date; used to confirm actual attendance and calculate check-in lead time.

attributes.name: communication_opt_in_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the registrant consented to receive future recruitment communications from the institution at the time of event registration. Required for CAN-SPAM and GDPR compliance in outbound admissions marketing.
attributes.references: CAN-SPAM Act; GDPR Article 6 (Lawful Basis for Processing); FERPA

attributes.name: consent_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the registrant provided or withdrew consent for recruitment communications. Required for GDPR and CAN-SPAM audit trails. Null if no explicit consent action was recorded.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 7 (Conditions for Consent); CAN-SPAM Act; FERPA

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the event registration record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail, data lineage, and registration velocity analysis. Aligns with FERPA record-keeping requirements.
attributes.references: FERPA; Slate CRM — Record Audit; Databricks Lakehouse Silver Layer Audit Standards

attributes.name: dietary_restriction
attributes.description: Dietary restriction or preference indicated by the registrant at the time of registration (e.g., vegetarian, vegan, halal, kosher, gluten-free). Used for catering planning at events that include meals or refreshments.
attributes.references: Slate CRM — Event Registration Custom Fields; Archibus Facilities Management

attributes.name: first_generation_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the prospect self-identified as a first-generation college student (neither parent holds a bachelor's degree). Used for targeted outreach, equity reporting, and Title IV program eligibility tracking.
attributes.references: U.S. Department of Education — First-Generation Student Definition; IPEDS

attributes.name: follow_up_date
attributes.description: The date on which the post-event follow-up communication was completed or is scheduled to be completed by the assigned admissions counselor. Used for counselor accountability and pipeline management reporting.
attributes.references: Slate CRM — Follow-Up Scheduling; NACUBO Enrollment Management

attributes.name: follow_up_status
attributes.description: Status of the post-event follow-up action assigned to the admissions counselor for this registrant. Tracks whether outreach has been initiated, completed, or is not required (e.g., for no-shows who cancelled). Supports counselor workflow management.
attributes.references: Slate CRM — Follow-Up Workflow; NACUBO Enrollment Management

attributes.name: ftiac_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the prospect is a First-Time-In-Any-College (FTIAC) student with no prior postsecondary enrollment. Critical for IPEDS cohort reporting, NCAA eligibility, and institutional retention benchmarking.
attributes.references: IPEDS Fall Enrollment Survey — FTIAC Definition; U.S. Department of Education

attributes.name: guest_count
attributes.description: Number of additional guests (e.g., parents, guardians, siblings) registered to accompany the primary prospect at the event. Used for event capacity planning, catering, and logistics management.
attributes.references: Slate CRM — Event Guest Registration; Archibus Room Scheduling

attributes.name: intended_degree_level
attributes.description: The degree level the prospect intends to pursue at the institution. Used to segment recruitment events by audience type and to route prospects to appropriate admissions counselors and follow-up workflows.
attributes.references: IPEDS Completions Survey — Degree Level Classification; U.S. Department of Education

attributes.name: intended_program_code
attributes.description: The Classification of Instructional Programs (CIP) code or institution-specific program code representing the academic program the prospect intends to pursue. Supports program-level yield analysis and targeted follow-up by academic unit.
attributes.references: CIP Code Standard — U.S. Department of Education NCES; Ellucian Banner Program Table

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes entered by admissions staff regarding the registrant's event participation, special circumstances, or follow-up actions. Classified as confidential per FERPA student record privacy requirements.
attributes.references: FERPA (Family Educational Rights and Privacy Act); Slate CRM — Staff Notes

attributes.name: registration_channel
attributes.description: The channel or interface through which the prospect submitted their event registration. Used for marketing attribution and channel effectiveness analysis. Values: web_portal (institution website), email_link (direct email campaign link), staff_entry (entered by admissions staff), mobile_app (institution mobile app), third_party_fair (college fair or external platform).
attributes.references: Slate CRM — Source Tracking; CRM Attribution Standards

attributes.name: registration_date
attributes.description: The exact date and time (with timezone offset) when the prospect or applicant submitted their registration for the recruitment event. Used for lead time analysis, registration velocity reporting, and funnel timing metrics.
attributes.references: Slate CRM — Event Registration Timestamp; FERPA

attributes.name: registration_number
attributes.description: Externally visible, human-readable confirmation number assigned to the registrant at the time of registration. Used in confirmation emails, check-in kiosks, and attendee communications. Format: REG-YYYY-NNNNNN.
attributes.references: Slate CRM — Event Registration Confirmation; Ellucian Banner Admissions

attributes.name: registration_source_code
attributes.description: Marketing or outreach source code associated with the registration, used to attribute the registrant to a specific campaign, communication, or recruitment initiative. Aligns with Slate CRM source tracking for yield modeling and ROI analysis.
attributes.references: Slate CRM — Source Code Tracking; NACUBO Enrollment Management

attributes.name: registration_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the event registration record. Drives funnel attribution, yield modeling, and post-event follow-up workflows. Values: registered (confirmed seat), attended (physically or virtually present), no_show (did not attend without cancellation), cancelled (registrant withdrew), waitlisted (capacity full, on waitlist), pending (registration submitted but not yet confirmed). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: registered|attended|no_show|cancelled|waitlisted|pending — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Slate CRM — Event Attendance Tracking; NACUBO Enrollment Management Best Practices

attributes.name: residency_type
attributes.description: Indicates whether the prospect is a domestic or international student. Drives routing to appropriate admissions teams, financial aid eligibility screening, and TOEFL/IELTS requirement flags. Relevant for IPEDS reporting and international enrollment tracking.
attributes.references: IPEDS Fall Enrollment Survey; U.S. Department of Education Title IV

attributes.name: survey_response_date
attributes.description: The date on which the registrant submitted their post-event survey response. Null if no survey was completed. Used to measure response timeliness and correlate survey completion with subsequent application activity.

attributes.name: survey_response_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the registrant completed a post-event satisfaction or feedback survey. Used to measure event engagement quality, calculate survey response rates, and identify prospects for follow-up outreach.
attributes.references: Slate CRM — Post-Event Survey Tracking; NACUBO Enrollment Management Best Practices

attributes.name: survey_satisfaction_score
attributes.description: Numeric satisfaction rating provided by the registrant in the post-event survey, typically on a scale of 1–5 or 1–10 as defined by the institution. Null if no survey was completed. Used as a KPI for event quality and recruiter performance.
attributes.references: Slate CRM — Post-Event Survey Scoring; NACUBO Enrollment Management KPIs

attributes.name: transportation_assistance_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the registrant requested transportation assistance (e.g., shuttle service, bus coordination) to attend the event. Used for logistics planning and equity-focused recruitment program tracking.
attributes.references: Slate CRM — Event Logistics; NACUBO Enrollment Management Equity Initiatives

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the event registration record was most recently modified. Used for incremental ETL processing, change data capture, and audit trail compliance in the Databricks Lakehouse Silver Layer.
attributes.references: FERPA; Slate CRM — Record Audit; Databricks Lakehouse Silver Layer ETL Standards

attributes.name: virtual_attendance_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the registrant attended the event virtually (online) rather than in person. Supports hybrid event analytics, virtual engagement tracking, and geographic reach reporting.
attributes.references: Slate CRM — Virtual Event Module; NACUBO Enrollment Management

attributes.name: virtual_platform_session_code
attributes.description: The session or participant identifier assigned by the virtual event platform (e.g., Zoom, Teams, Hopin) for the registrant's virtual attendance. Used to reconcile virtual check-in data with the CRM registration record.
attributes.references: Slate CRM — Virtual Event Integration; Institutional Analytics

attributes.name: waitlist_position
attributes.description: Numeric position of the registrant on the event waitlist when the event has reached capacity. Null if the registrant is not on the waitlist. Used to manage seat releases and notify prospects when seats become available.
attributes.references: Slate CRM — Event Capacity and Waitlist Management

attributes.name: yield_segment
attributes.description: Enrollment yield intent segment assigned to the registrant based on event engagement signals, survey responses, and CRM scoring models. Used by admissions leadership for targeted yield intervention strategies and enrollment forecasting.
attributes.references: Slate CRM — Yield Modeling; NACUBO Enrollment Management Analytics; Tableau/Power BI Enrollment Dashboards

products.name: communication_activity
products.description: Transactional log of all admissions-related outbound and inbound communications with prospects and applicants, sourced from Slate CRM. Captures communication type (email, SMS, phone, mail, portal message), direction, campaign or template used, delivery status, open/click flags, and staff initiator. Supports enrollment funnel nurturing and yield management workflows.

attributes.name: communication_activity_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each communication activity record in the admissions enrollment funnel. Primary key for this transactional log entity.

attributes.name: campaign_id
attributes.description: Reference to the enrollment marketing or yield management campaign under which this communication was sent. Null for ad-hoc or individually initiated communications.

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the admissions staff member or recruiter who initiated or is responsible for this communication. Null for fully automated system-generated communications.
attributes.references: Slate CRM – User Record; Workday HCM – Employee Record

attributes.name: enrollment_application_id
attributes.description: Reference to the admissions application associated with this communication, if applicable. Null for communications with prospects who have not yet submitted an application.
attributes.references: Slate CRM – Application Object; Ellucian Banner – Admissions Application

attributes.name: enterprise_application_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to technology.enterprise_application. Business justification: Communications are delivered through enterprise applications (Slate CRM, Salesforce, email platforms, SMS gateways, chatbots). Tracking which application sent each communication is essential for deliv

attributes.name: principal_investigator_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to research.principal_investigator. Business justification: Faculty PIs conduct direct recruitment outreach to prospective graduate students. Tracks PI-initiated communications for recruitment attribution, faculty engagement metrics, and yield analysis by rese

attributes.name: prospect_id
attributes.description: Reference to the prospect or applicant who is the recipient or sender of this communication. Links to the prospect/applicant master record in the enrollment domain.
attributes.references: Slate CRM – Prospect Record; Ellucian Banner – Admissions Person Record

attributes.name: recruit_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to athletics.recruit. Business justification: NCAA recruiting rules require tracking all institutional contacts with athletic recruits (phone, email, text) to enforce permissible contact periods and frequency limits. When a prospect is also a rec

attributes.name: recruitment_event_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to enrollment.recruitment_event. Business justification: Communications can be event-related (invitations, reminders, follow-ups). This FK links communications to the specific recruitment event they support, enabling event-based communication tracking and c

attributes.name: academic_period
attributes.description: The academic term or entry period for which the prospect is being recruited (e.g., Fall 2025, Spring 2026). Supports term-based enrollment cycle reporting and yield analysis.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner – Term Code; IPEDS Reporting

attributes.name: academic_year
attributes.description: The academic year associated with the enrollment cycle for which this communication was generated (e.g., 2024-2025). Supports year-over-year enrollment funnel benchmarking.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner – Academic Year; IPEDS Reporting

attributes.name: bounce_type
attributes.description: Classifies the type of email bounce if the communication failed to deliver. Hard bounce indicates a permanent delivery failure (invalid address); soft bounce indicates a temporary failure. Null or 'none' for non-email channels or successful deliveries.
attributes.references: Slate CRM – Bounce Classification; CAN-SPAM Act

attributes.name: click_count
attributes.description: The total number of link clicks recorded for this communication by the prospect. Applicable to email and portal message channels. Supports engagement depth analysis beyond the binary is_clicked flag.

attributes.name: clicked_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the prospect first clicked a link within the communication (applicable to email and portal messages). Null if no click was recorded or channel does not support click tracking.
attributes.references: Slate CRM – Click Tracking; CAN-SPAM Act

attributes.name: communication_notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes entered by the admissions staff member regarding the content or outcome of this communication. Applicable primarily to phone calls and in-person interactions. Classified as confidential per FERPA student record privacy requirements.
attributes.references: Slate CRM – Activity Notes; FERPA (20 U.S.C. § 1232g)

attributes.name: communication_purpose
attributes.description: The business purpose or intent of the communication within the enrollment funnel. Classifies communications by their role in the recruitment-to-matriculation lifecycle. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: inquiry_response|application_status|decision_notification|yield_nurture|financial_aid_info|event_invitation|document_request|general_outreach — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Slate CRM – Communication Purpose; NACUBO Enrollment Management

attributes.name: communication_type
attributes.description: The channel or medium through which the communication was delivered or received. Drives channel-specific analytics and yield management reporting across the enrollment funnel.
attributes.references: Slate CRM – Communication Type; NACUBO Enrollment Management Best Practices

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this communication activity record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage tracking in the Silver layer lakehouse.
attributes.references: Slate CRM – Record Created Date; FERPA

attributes.name: degree_level
attributes.description: The level of the degree program the prospect is pursuing (e.g., undergraduate, graduate). Enables segmentation of communication analytics by degree level for enrollment planning.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner – Degree Level; IPEDS Reporting

attributes.name: delivered_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the communication was confirmed as delivered to the recipient's inbox, device, or mailbox. Null if delivery has not been confirmed or failed.
attributes.references: Slate CRM – Delivery Confirmation Timestamp; CAN-SPAM Act

attributes.name: delivery_status

attributes.name: ferpa_disclosure_flag

attributes.name: is_automated
