attributes.name: is_clicked
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the prospect clicked at least one link within this communication. Applicable to email and portal messages. Supports click-through rate KPI for yield management.
attributes.references: Slate CRM – Click Tracking; CAN-SPAM Act

attributes.name: is_opened
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the prospect opened or viewed this communication. Applicable to email and portal message channels. Supports open rate KPI calculation for enrollment campaigns.
attributes.references: Slate CRM – Open Tracking; CAN-SPAM Act

attributes.name: is_responded
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the prospect replied to or responded to this communication. Supports response rate analytics across channels and enrollment funnel stages.

attributes.name: mail_piece_type
attributes.description: The type of physical mail piece sent to the prospect, applicable when communication_type is 'mail'. Supports direct mail campaign cost and response rate analysis.
attributes.references: Slate CRM – Mail Activity Type; NACUBO Enrollment Management

attributes.name: open_count
attributes.description: The total number of times this communication was opened or viewed by the prospect. Applicable to email and portal messages. Supports engagement frequency analysis for yield management.

attributes.name: opened_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the prospect first opened or viewed the communication (applicable to email and portal messages). Null if not opened or channel does not support open tracking.
attributes.references: Slate CRM – Open Tracking; CAN-SPAM Act

attributes.name: opt_out_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this communication triggered an opt-out or unsubscribe action by the prospect. Critical for CAN-SPAM, TCPA, and institutional communication preference compliance.
attributes.references: CAN-SPAM Act; TCPA; FERPA; Slate CRM – Opt-Out Tracking

attributes.name: opt_out_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the prospect opted out of communications following this activity. Null if no opt-out was recorded. Required for CAN-SPAM and TCPA compliance audit trails.

attributes.name: phone_call_duration_sec
attributes.description: Duration of the phone call in seconds, applicable only when communication_type is 'phone'. Null for non-phone channels. Supports recruiter productivity and engagement quality analysis.

attributes.name: phone_call_outcome
attributes.description: The outcome of a phone call communication attempt. Applicable only when communication_type is 'phone'. Supports recruiter call effectiveness reporting and follow-up workflow triggers.

attributes.name: program_of_interest
attributes.description: The academic program or degree program the prospect is interested in at the time of this communication. Supports program-level yield analysis and targeted recruitment strategy.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner – Program Code; CIP (Classification of Instructional Programs)

attributes.name: prospect_geographic_region
attributes.description: The geographic region or state of the prospect at the time of this communication. Supports regional enrollment funnel analytics and targeted recruitment strategy reporting.
attributes.references: Slate CRM – Prospect Address Region; IPEDS Reporting

attributes.name: recruiter_territory
attributes.description: The geographic or market territory assigned to the recruiter or admissions counselor who initiated this communication. Supports territory-based enrollment funnel performance reporting.
attributes.references: Slate CRM – Recruiter Territory Assignment; NACUBO Enrollment Management

attributes.name: responded_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the prospect replied to or responded to this communication. Applicable to email, phone, and portal message channels. Null if no response was recorded.

attributes.name: scheduled_send_date
attributes.description: The date on which this communication was scheduled to be sent as part of a campaign workflow or drip sequence. Null for immediately dispatched or inbound communications. Supports campaign scheduling analysis.

attributes.name: sent_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the communication was dispatched from the institution's system or received from the prospect. Represents the principal business event time for this transaction log record.

attributes.name: slate_activity_ref
attributes.description: The native activity or communication record identifier from Slate CRM, used for cross-system reconciliation and audit traceability back to the source system of record.

attributes.name: source_system

attributes.references: Slate CRM; Ellucian Banner; Data Governance Policy

attributes.name: subject_line
attributes.description: The subject line of the email or portal message, or a brief descriptive title for other communication types (e.g., phone call topic, mail piece title). Supports content performance analysis.
attributes.references: Slate CRM – Communication Subject; CAN-SPAM Act

attributes.name: template_code
attributes.description: The identifier or code of the Slate CRM communication template used to generate this message. Enables template performance analysis and A/B testing across enrollment campaigns.

attributes.name: template_name
attributes.description: The human-readable name of the communication template used. Supports reporting and yield management analysis without requiring a join to the template reference table.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this communication activity record was last modified. Tracks status updates, delivery confirmations, and engagement flag changes.
attributes.references: Slate CRM – Record Modified Date; FERPA

products.name: deposit
products.description: Transactional record of an enrollment deposit (intent-to-enroll payment) submitted by an admitted student to confirm matriculation intent. Captures deposit amount, payment date, payment method (credit card, check, wire), deposit type (tuition, housing), waiver flag, waiver reason, refund status, and refund date. Critical yield management indicator linking the admission decision to confirmed matriculation. One deposit record per admitted application per deposit type.

attributes.name: deposit_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each enrollment deposit record. Primary key for the enrollment_deposit data product in the Databricks Silver Layer.

attributes.name: admission_offer_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to enrollment.admission_offer. Business justification: Enrollment deposit is paid in response to a specific admission offer. This FK links the deposit to the offer it accepts, enabling tracking of offer-to-deposit conversion and deposit reconciliation aga

attributes.name: enrollment_application_id
attributes.description: Reference to the admissions application for which this enrollment deposit was submitted. Links the deposit to the admitted student's application record, enforcing the one-deposit-per-application-per-deposit-type constraint.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner Admissions Module; Slate CRM Application Processing

attributes.name: profile_id
attributes.description: Reference to the student (admitted applicant) who submitted the enrollment deposit. Used for yield management reporting and matriculation tracking.

attributes.name: term_id
attributes.description: Reference to the academic term for which the student is confirming enrollment intent via this deposit. Supports term-based yield and enrollment cycle analysis.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner Registration Module; IPEDS Enrollment Reporting

attributes.name: academic_level
attributes.description: Level of study for which the enrollment deposit was submitted. Used for yield segmentation, financial aid eligibility determination, and IPEDS enrollment level reporting.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner Admissions Module; IPEDS Fall Enrollment Survey; U.S. Department of Education

attributes.name: academic_program_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the academic program (degree program) for which the student submitted the enrollment deposit. Supports program-level yield analysis and capacity planning. Aligns with CIP (Classification of Instructional Programs) coding.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner Admissions/Registration Module; CIP Classification of Instructional Programs; IPEDS

attributes.name: admit_type
attributes.description: Classification of the admitted student's entry type at the time of deposit. Supports yield analysis segmented by admit cohort (e.g., FTIAC freshman vs. transfer vs. graduate). Aligns with IPEDS enrollment reporting categories.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner Admissions Module; IPEDS Fall Enrollment Survey; U.S. Department of Education

attributes.name: amount
attributes.description: Gross monetary amount of the enrollment deposit required or assessed, expressed in the institutional operating currency (USD). Represents the full deposit obligation before any waivers or adjustments.
attributes.references: NACUBO Student Financial Services Standards; GASB Statement No. 34; Ellucian Banner Student Accounts

attributes.name: amount_paid
attributes.description: Actual monetary amount received from the student for this deposit. May differ from deposit_amount in cases of partial payment, waiver, or institutional adjustment. Used for cash reconciliation and student account posting.
attributes.references: NACUBO Student Financial Services Standards; GASB Statement No. 34; Ellucian Banner Student Accounts

attributes.name: college_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the college or school within the university to which the student was admitted and for which the deposit was submitted (e.g., College of Engineering, College of Business). Supports college-level yield and enrollment reporting.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner Admissions Module; AACSB; ABET; HLC Accreditation Reporting

attributes.name: country_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code representing the student's country of citizenship or permanent residence. Used for international student yield analysis, visa compliance tracking, and IPEDS international enrollment reporting.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1; IPEDS Fall Enrollment Survey; U.S. Department of Education; SEVIS

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this enrollment deposit record was first created in the data platform (Silver Layer). Represents the audit creation time, distinct from payment_date (the business event date). Supports data lineage and audit trail requirements.
attributes.references: FERPA; Institutional Data Governance Policy; Databricks Lakehouse Audit Standards

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the deposit transaction (e.g., USD, CAD, GBP). Supports international student deposit processing and multi-currency reconciliation.
attributes.references: ISO 4217 Currency Codes; NACUBO International Student Financial Services

attributes.name: deadline
attributes.description: Institutional deadline by which the admitted student must submit the enrollment deposit to confirm matriculation intent. Used for yield management, deadline compliance monitoring, and National Candidates Reply Date (May 1) tracking per NACAC guidelines.
attributes.references: NACAC Statement of Principles of Good Practice; Ellucian Banner Admissions Module

attributes.name: deposit_number
attributes.description: Externally visible, human-readable business identifier for the deposit transaction, used in student-facing communications, receipts, and reconciliation with the student accounts system in Ellucian Banner.

attributes.name: deposit_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the enrollment deposit. 'pending' indicates payment initiated but not yet confirmed; 'received' indicates payment received but not yet cleared; 'cleared' indicates funds confirmed; 'refunded' indicates deposit returned to student; 'waived' indicates deposit requirement formally waived; 'cancelled' indicates deposit voided.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner Student Accounts Module; NACUBO Student Financial Services Standards

attributes.name: deposit_type
attributes.description: Categorizes the purpose of the deposit. Common types include tuition (confirms academic enrollment intent), housing (reserves on-campus housing), and orientation (reserves orientation seat). One record per admitted application per deposit type. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: tuition|housing|orientation|health|parking|other — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner Student Accounts Module; NACUBO Student Financial Services Standards

attributes.name: financial_aid_applicant
attributes.description: Indicates whether the student has submitted a FAFSA (Free Application for Federal Student Aid) or institutional financial aid application. Used to contextualize deposit waiver decisions and yield analysis by financial aid status.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner Financial Aid Module; U.S. Department of Education FAFSA; Title IV

attributes.name: first_generation_student
attributes.description: Indicates whether the student is a first-generation college student (neither parent holds a bachelor's degree). Used for equity-focused yield analysis, Title III/IV reporting, and institutional diversity metrics.
attributes.references: U.S. Department of Education Title III; IPEDS; HLC Accreditation Criteria

attributes.name: geographic_origin
attributes.description: Two-letter U.S. state code (or equivalent geographic origin code) of the student's permanent address at time of deposit. Used for in-state vs. out-of-state yield analysis, tuition classification, and IPEDS geographic distribution reporting.
attributes.references: IPEDS Fall Enrollment Survey; U.S. Department of Education; Ellucian Banner Admissions

attributes.name: housing_preference
attributes.description: Student's stated housing preference at the time of deposit submission. Relevant when deposit_type includes housing. Used by Facilities/Housing management (Archibus) for capacity planning and room assignment.
attributes.references: Archibus Facilities Management; Ellucian Banner Student Module

attributes.name: is_active
attributes.description: Indicates whether this enrollment deposit record is the current active version. Supports soft-delete patterns and SCD (Slowly Changing Dimension) Type 2 history management in the Databricks Silver Layer without physical deletion.
attributes.references: Databricks Lakehouse Silver Layer Data Management Standards; Institutional Data Governance Policy

attributes.name: is_refunded
attributes.description: Indicates whether the enrollment deposit has been refunded to the student. True when a refund has been issued. Used for yield management, financial reconciliation, and melt (deposit-to-enrollment attrition) analysis.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner Student Accounts Module; NACUBO Student Financial Services

attributes.name: is_waived
attributes.description: Indicates whether the enrollment deposit requirement was formally waived for this student. True when the institution has granted a waiver, allowing the student to confirm enrollment without payment. Critical for financial aid equity reporting and yield analysis.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner Student Accounts Module; NACUBO Student Financial Services

attributes.name: matriculation_confirmed
attributes.description: Indicates whether the student ultimately matriculated (enrolled) at the institution following submission of this deposit. True when the student completed registration for the target term. Key yield management KPI linking deposit to actual enrollment.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner Registration Module; IPEDS Fall Enrollment Survey; HLC Accreditation Enrollment Reporting

attributes.name: matriculation_date
attributes.description: Date on which the student officially matriculated (first registered for courses) for the target term. Populated when matriculation_confirmed is True. Used for enrollment reporting, IPEDS census date calculations, and FTIAC tracking.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner Registration Module; IPEDS Fall Enrollment Survey; U.S. Department of Education

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for admissions or student accounts staff to record contextual notes about the deposit transaction (e.g., special payment arrangements, exception approvals, follow-up actions). Not used for structured reporting.

attributes.name: payment_channel
attributes.description: Interface or channel through which the deposit payment was submitted (e.g., online student portal, in-person at bursar's office, mailed check). Distinct from payment_method; supports channel-level yield and operational analytics.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner Student Accounts Module; Slate CRM Enrollment Communications

attributes.name: payment_date
attributes.description: Calendar date on which the enrollment deposit payment was received or processed by the institution. Used as the principal business event date for yield management reporting, deadline compliance tracking, and IPEDS enrollment reporting.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner Student Accounts Module; IPEDS Fall Enrollment Survey; NACUBO

attributes.name: payment_method

attributes.name: refund_date
attributes.description: Calendar date on which the enrollment deposit refund was issued to the student. Populated only when is_refunded is True. Used for refund timeline compliance and cash flow reporting.

attributes.name: refund_reason

attributes.name: scholarship_recipient
attributes.description: Indicates whether the student has been awarded an institutional scholarship at the time of deposit. Used to analyze the relationship between merit/need-based aid awards and deposit yield rates.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner Financial Aid Module; U.S. Department of Education Title IV; NACUBO

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Identifies the operational system of record from which this deposit record originated (e.g., Ellucian Banner Student Accounts, Slate CRM, TouchNet payment gateway). Supports data lineage and ETL reconciliation in the Databricks Silver Layer.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner; Slate CRM; Databricks Lakehouse Data Lineage Standards

attributes.name: source_system_record_code
attributes.description: The native primary key or record identifier of this deposit in the originating operational system (e.g., Banner SPRIDEN PIDM-based transaction ID, TouchNet payment ID). Enables traceability from the Silver Layer back to the system of record.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner Student Accounts Module; Databricks Lakehouse Data Lineage Standards

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this enrollment deposit record was last modified in the data platform. Used for incremental ETL processing, change data capture, and audit trail maintenance in the Databricks Silver Layer.
attributes.references: FERPA; Institutional Data Governance Policy; Databricks Lakehouse Audit Standards

attributes.name: waiver_approved_by
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the institutional staff member or office that authorized the deposit waiver. Supports audit trail and compliance review for waiver decisions.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner Student Accounts Module; FERPA; Institutional Audit Standards

attributes.name: waiver_reason
attributes.description: Reason code explaining why the enrollment deposit was waived. Populated only when is_waived is True. attributes.references: Ellucian Banner Admissions/Registration Module; IPEDS; U.S. Department of Education

attributes.name: matriculation_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the matriculation record. 'Active' indicates the student is enrolled; 'cancelled' indicates the matriculation was reversed; 'deferred' indicates the student requested a term deferral post-matriculation; 'withdrawn' indicates the student withdrew after matriculating.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner Student Module; U.S. Department of Education Title IV Return of Funds

attributes.name: orientation_date
attributes.description: The date on which the student completed new student orientation. Null if orientation has not yet been completed or was waived. Used for first-year experience analytics and enrollment readiness reporting.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner Student Module; Slate CRM Events Module

attributes.name: orientation_status
attributes.description: The student's orientation registration and completion status at the time of matriculation. Tracks whether the student has registered for, completed, or been waived from mandatory new student orientation. Required for enrollment holds management and first-year experience reporting.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner Student Module; Slate CRM Events Module

attributes.name: person_uid
attributes.description: Institution-assigned universal person identifier (PIDM in Ellucian Banner) that persists across all roles a person may hold (applicant, student, employee, alumni). Restricted PII as it directly identifies an individual across institutional systems.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner General Person Module; FERPA 34 CFR Part 99

attributes.name: prior_institution_code
attributes.description: The IPEDS Unit ID or FICE (Federal Interagency Committee on Education) code of the most recent prior institution attended by transfer students. Null for FTIAC students. Used for articulation agreement analysis and transfer pathway reporting.
attributes.references: IPEDS Institutional Characteristics Survey; U.S. Department of Education FICE Codes; National Student Clearinghouse

attributes.name: program_code
attributes.description: The institutional code of the degree program confirmed at matriculation (e.g., BS-CS, MBA, PHD-CHEM). Represents the program the student is formally enrolled in as of matriculation. Aligns with CIP (Classification of Instructional Programs) coding for federal reporting.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner Academic Programs; CIP Codes — U.S. Department of Education; IPEDS Completions Survey

attributes.name: program_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name of the degree program confirmed at matriculation (e.g., 'Bachelor of Science in Computer Science', 'Master of Business Administration'). Stored for reporting and display purposes independent of the program code.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner Academic Programs; CIP Codes — U.S. Department of Education

attributes.name: residency_status
attributes.description: The student's tuition residency classification at the time of matriculation (in-state, out-of-state, international, military). Determines applicable tuition rate schedule and financial aid eligibility. Established through the residency determination process.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner Student Accounts; State Higher Education Residency Statutes; U.S. Department of Education Title IV

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: The operational system of record from which this matriculation record was sourced (e.g., Banner, Slate, Manual entry). Supports data lineage tracking in the Databricks Silver Layer ETL pipeline and audit trail requirements.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner SIS; Slate CRM; Databricks Lakehouse Data Lineage Standards

attributes.name: stem_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the student's program at matriculation is classified as a STEM (Science, Technology, Engineering, Mathematics) program per the U.S. Department of Homeland Security STEM OPT designated degree program list. True = STEM program. Relevant for international student visa extensions and NSF/NIH grant reporting.
attributes.references: DHS STEM OPT Designated Degree Program List; NSF; NIH; U.S. Department of Education CIP Codes

attributes.name: student_level
attributes.description: Broad academic level of the student at matriculation (undergraduate, graduate, professional, non-degree). Distinct from entry_level; used for tuition rate determination, financial aid packaging, and accreditation reporting.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner Student Module; IPEDS; HLC Criteria for Accreditation

attributes.name: transfer_credits_accepted
attributes.description: The number of transfer credit hours officially accepted and posted to the student's academic record at the time of matriculation. Applicable to transfer and readmit students. Impacts degree completion timeline and financial aid credit hour tracking.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner Academic History Module; ECTS; U.S. Department of Education Title IV

attributes.name: transfer_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the student transferred from another institution prior to matriculation. True = transfer student. Used for IPEDS transfer cohort reporting, articulation agreement analysis, and transfer credit evaluation tracking.
attributes.references: IPEDS Fall Enrollment Survey; U.S. Department of Education; Ellucian Banner Admissions

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this matriculation record was most recently modified in the system of record. Formatted as yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX. Used for incremental ETL processing in the Databricks Silver Layer and change data capture (CDC) workflows.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner SIS; Databricks Lakehouse ETL Standards; FERPA 34 CFR Part 99

attributes.name: veteran_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the student is a veteran or military-affiliated student (active duty, reservist, dependent) at the time of matriculation. True = veteran/military-affiliated. Triggers VA benefits processing, Yellow Ribbon Program eligibility, and dedicated advising services.
attributes.references: U.S. Department of Veterans Affairs GI Bill; Ellucian Banner Student Module; IPEDS

attributes.name: visa_type
attributes.description: The visa classification of the student at the time of matriculation, applicable to international students (e.g., F-1 student visa, J-1 exchange visitor). Required for SEVIS compliance reporting and financial aid eligibility determination. Null for domestic students. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: F-1|J-1|M-1|H-1B|OPT|CPT|domestic|permanent-resident|other — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: DHS Student and Exchange Visitor Program (SEVIS); U.S. Department of Homeland Security; IPEDS

products.name: waitlist
products.description: Tracks applicants placed on an admissions waitlist for a specific program and entry term. Captures waitlist position, waitlist date, notification date, applicant response (accept/decline waitlist offer), offer extended date, and final disposition (admitted from waitlist, denied, withdrew). Supports capacity management and yield contingency planning.
products.reference: Banner SARADAP Waitlist / Common Data Set Section C

attributes.name: waitlist_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each admissions waitlist record. Primary key for the waitlist data product in the enrollment domain.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner Student Information System - Admissions Module

attributes.name: academic_program_id
attributes.description: Reference to the academic program (degree, certificate, or credential) for which the applicant is waitlisted. Supports capacity management by program.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner Student Information System - Admissions Module; Classification of Instructional Programs (CIP)

attributes.name: admission_decision_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to enrollment.admission_decision. Business justification: Admissions waitlist entry is created as the result of a waitlist admission decision. This FK links the waitlist record to the decision that placed the applicant on the waitlist, enabling tracking of d

attributes.name: department_org_unit_id
attributes.description: Reference to the academic department responsible for the program for which the applicant is waitlisted. Enables department-level waitlist reporting and capacity oversight.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner Student Information System - Admissions Module

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the admissions counselor or recruiter assigned to manage this waitlist record and communicate with the applicant. Supports workload tracking and relationship management in Slate CRM.
attributes.references: Slate CRM - Prospect Management; Ellucian Banner Student Information System - Admissions Module

attributes.name: enrollment_applicant_id
attributes.description: Reference to the applicant who has been placed on the admissions waitlist. Links to the applicant master record in the Student Information System.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner Student Information System - Admissions Module; Slate CRM - Application Processing

attributes.name: enrollment_application_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific admissions application associated with this waitlist placement. An applicant may have multiple applications across terms or programs.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner Student Information System - Admissions Module; Slate CRM - Application Processing

attributes.name: org_unit_id
attributes.description: Reference to the college or school within the institution that administers the program for which the applicant is waitlisted (e.g., College of Engineering, College of Business). Supports college-level capacity management.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner Student Information System - Admissions Module; AACSB; ABET

attributes.name: term_id
attributes.description: Reference to the academic entry term for which the applicant is waitlisted (e.g., Fall 2025, Spring 2026). Drives term-based enrollment cycle management.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner Student Information System - Registration Module; IPEDS (Integrated Postsecondary Education Data System)

attributes.name: academic_level
attributes.description: Level of study for which the applicant is waitlisted. Drives admissions workflow routing, capacity pool segmentation, and IPEDS reporting. Valid values: undergraduate, graduate, doctoral, professional, certificate.
attributes.references: IPEDS (Integrated Postsecondary Education Data System); U.S. Department of Education; Ellucian Banner Student Information System - Admissions Module

attributes.name: applicant_response
attributes.description: Applicant's response to the waitlist placement notification indicating whether they wish to remain on the waitlist. Valid values: accepted (applicant confirmed intent to remain), declined (applicant declined waitlist placement), no_response (no response received by deadline).
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner Student Information System - Admissions Module; Slate CRM - Application Processing

attributes.name: applicant_response_date
attributes.description: Date on which the applicant submitted their response (accept or decline) to the waitlist placement offer. Null if no response has been received.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner Student Information System - Admissions Module; Slate CRM - Application Processing

attributes.name: capacity_pool_size
attributes.description: Total number of seats available in the waitlist pool for the program and entry term at the time of this record's creation. Used in yield contingency planning to determine how many waitlisted applicants may be admitted.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner Student Information System - Admissions Module; IPEDS

attributes.name: cip_code
attributes.description: Six-digit CIP code assigned to the academic program for which the applicant is waitlisted. Used for IPEDS reporting, accreditation documentation, and program-level enrollment analytics.
attributes.references: Classification of Instructional Programs (CIP) - National Center for Education Statistics (NCES); IPEDS

attributes.name: citizenship_status
attributes.description: Applicant's citizenship classification relevant to admissions processing, financial aid eligibility, and IPEDS reporting. Valid values: us_citizen, permanent_resident, international, daca, unknown. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: us_citizen|permanent_resident|international|daca|unknown — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: IPEDS (Integrated Postsecondary Education Data System); U.S. Department of Education Title IV; FERPA (Family Educational Rights and Privacy Act)

attributes.name: communication_preference
attributes.description: Applicant's preferred communication channel for waitlist-related notifications and correspondence. Drives outreach strategy in Slate CRM. Valid values: email, portal, mail, phone.
attributes.references: Slate CRM - Communications; FERPA (Family Educational Rights and Privacy Act)

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this waitlist record was first created in the system. Serves as the audit creation marker for data lineage and compliance tracking in the Databricks Silver Layer.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner Student Information System - Admissions Module; FERPA; Databricks Lakehouse Silver Layer Audit Standards

attributes.name: entry_type
attributes.description: Classification of the applicant's entry pathway into the institution. FTIAC (First-Time-In-Any-College) indicates a first-time freshman; transfer indicates a student transferring from another institution. Supports cohort-based capacity planning and yield modeling. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: ftiac|transfer|readmit|international|non_degree — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: IPEDS (Integrated Postsecondary Education Data System); Ellucian Banner Student Information System - Admissions Module

attributes.name: ferpa_release_on_file
attributes.description: Indicates whether the applicant has a FERPA (Family Educational Rights and Privacy Act) release authorization on file permitting disclosure of admissions and waitlist information to designated third parties (e.g., parents, guardians). True = release on file; False = no release on file.
attributes.references: FERPA (Family Educational Rights and Privacy Act); U.S. Department of Education

attributes.name: final_disposition
attributes.description: Ultimate outcome of the waitlist record at the close of the admissions cycle. Valid values: admitted (admitted from waitlist), denied (denied from waitlist by institution), withdrew (applicant withdrew from waitlist), no_action (waitlist closed with no action taken). Supports IPEDS reporting and yield analysis.
attributes.references: IPEDS (Integrated Postsecondary Education Data System); U.S. Department of Education; Ellucian Banner Student Information System - Admissions Module

attributes.name: final_disposition_date
attributes.description: Date on which the final disposition of the waitlist record was recorded (admission, denial, withdrawal, or no action). Marks the closure of the waitlist lifecycle for this applicant-program-term combination.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner Student Information System - Admissions Module; IPEDS

attributes.name: financial_aid_impact
attributes.description: Indicates the financial aid eligibility status for the applicant if admitted from the waitlist. Waitlist admissions may have reduced or no institutional aid availability depending on remaining aid budget. Valid values: eligible (institutional aid available), not_eligible (no institutional aid remaining), pending_review (aid availability under review).
attributes.references: U.S. Department of Education Title IV; FAFSA (Free Application for Federal Student Aid); Ellucian Banner Student Information System - Financial Aid Module

attributes.name: intended_enrollment_type
attributes.description: Applicant's intended enrollment intensity if admitted from the waitlist. Used in FTE (Full-Time Equivalent) projections and capacity planning. Valid values: full_time, part_time.
attributes.references: IPEDS (Integrated Postsecondary Education Data System); Ellucian Banner Student Information System - Registration Module

attributes.name: is_position_disclosed
attributes.description: Indicates whether the institution has disclosed the applicant's waitlist position to the applicant. Some institutions do not disclose ranked positions. True = position disclosed to applicant; False = position not disclosed.
attributes.references: U.S. Department of Education Admissions Transparency Guidance; Slate CRM - Communications

attributes.name: is_ranked
attributes.description: Indicates whether the waitlist for this program and term is a ranked (ordered) waitlist or an unranked pool. True = ranked waitlist with assigned positions; False = unranked pool where all applicants have equal consideration.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner Student Information System - Admissions Module; U.S. Department of Education

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for admissions staff to record relevant observations, special circumstances, or follow-up actions related to this waitlist record. Subject to FERPA access controls.
attributes.references: FERPA (Family Educational Rights and Privacy Act); Ellucian Banner Student Information System - Admissions Module

attributes.name: notification_date
attributes.description: Date on which the applicant was formally notified of their waitlist placement via official communication (email, portal, or letter). Supports compliance with institutional notification timelines.
attributes.references: Slate CRM - Communications; U.S. Department of Education Title IV Admissions Notification Requirements

attributes.name: offer_accepted_date
attributes.description: Date on which the applicant formally accepted the admission offer extended from the waitlist. Null if offer was declined, not yet responded to, or not yet extended.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner Student Information System - Admissions Module; Slate CRM - Application Processing

attributes.name: offer_extended_date
attributes.description: Date on which an admission offer was formally extended to the applicant from the waitlist. Null if no offer has been made. Distinct from the initial waitlist notification date.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner Student Information System - Admissions Module; Slate CRM - Communications

attributes.name: offer_response_deadline_date
attributes.description: Deadline date by which the applicant must accept or decline the admission offer extended from the waitlist. Supports yield management and seat reallocation planning.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner Student Information System - Admissions Module; U.S. Department of Education Admissions Guidance

attributes.name: pool_size
attributes.description: Total number of applicants on the waitlist for the same program and entry term at the time this record was created. Provides context for the applicant's relative position and probability of admission.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner Student Information System - Admissions Module

attributes.name: position
attributes.description: Ordinal rank of the applicant on the waitlist for the given program and entry term. Lower numbers indicate higher priority for admission offers. Used in yield contingency planning and capacity management.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner Student Information System - Admissions Module

attributes.name: prior_institution_code
attributes.description: IPEDS unit ID or FICE code of the most recent institution attended by the applicant prior to this application. Relevant for transfer applicants on the waitlist. Supports transfer credit evaluation and articulation agreement analysis.
attributes.references: IPEDS (Integrated Postsecondary Education Data System); U.S. Department of Education

attributes.name: reason
attributes.description: Narrative or coded reason explaining why the applicant was placed on the waitlist rather than admitted or denied outright. Examples include capacity constraints, incomplete file pending review, or competitive pool evaluation. Supports admissions process transparency and appeals.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner Student Information System - Admissions Module; Slate CRM - Application Processing

attributes.name: residency_status
attributes.description: Applicant's residency classification for tuition and enrollment purposes. Affects tuition rate assignment and state-level enrollment reporting. Valid values: in_state, out_of_state, international.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner Student Information System - Admissions Module; IPEDS; U.S. Department of Education

attributes.name: response_deadline_date
attributes.description: Deadline date by which the applicant must respond to the waitlist placement notification. Applicants who do not respond by this date may be removed from the waitlist.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner Student Information System - Admissions Module; U.S. Department of Education Admissions Guidance

attributes.name: scholarship_eligibility
attributes.description: Indicates whether the applicant, if admitted from the waitlist, would be eligible for merit-based scholarship consideration. True = eligible for scholarship review upon waitlist admission; False = not eligible.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner Student Information System - Financial Aid Module; U.S. Department of Education Title IV

attributes.name: source_channel
attributes.description: Channel through which the waitlist placement was initiated or the applicant's response was received. Supports process analytics and system integration auditing. Valid values: online_portal, paper, slate_crm, edi, staff_entry.
attributes.references: Slate CRM - Application Processing; Ellucian Banner Student Information System - Admissions Module

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Identifies the operational system of record from which this waitlist record originated. Supports data lineage tracking and ETL (Extract Transform Load) reconciliation in the Silver Layer. Valid values: banner (Ellucian Banner SIS), slate (Slate CRM), manual (manually entered).
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner Student Information System; Slate CRM; Databricks Lakehouse Silver Layer Data Lineage Standards

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to this waitlist record. Used for incremental data pipeline processing, change detection, and audit trail maintenance in the Silver Layer.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner Student Information System - Admissions Module; FERPA; Databricks Lakehouse Silver Layer Audit Standards

attributes.name: waitlist_date
attributes.description: Calendar date on which the applicant was officially placed on the admissions waitlist. Serves as the principal business event date for this record and is used to determine waitlist seniority when positions are equal.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner Student Information System - Admissions Module; Slate CRM - Application Processing

attributes.name: waitlist_number
attributes.description: Externally visible, human-readable business identifier for this waitlist record. Used in applicant communications, staff lookups, and Slate CRM correspondence tracking.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner Student Information System - Admissions Module; Slate CRM - Communications

attributes.name: waitlist_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the waitlist record. Tracks progression from active waitlist placement through final disposition. Valid values: active (on waitlist, no offer yet), offer_extended (admission offer sent), admitted (applicant accepted offer from waitlist), denied (institution denied from waitlist), withdrew (applicant withdrew from waitlist), expired (waitlist closed without action). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: active|offer_extended|admitted|denied|withdrew|expired — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner Student Information System - Admissions Module; HLC; SACSCOC

attributes.name: waitlist_type
attributes.description: Classification of the waitlist placement indicating the category or tier of the waitlist. Valid values: standard (general waitlist), priority (elevated consideration tier), alternate (alternate list for specific cohorts), conditional (waitlist contingent on meeting specific conditions such as financial aid or prerequisite completion).
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner Student Information System - Admissions Module

products.name: application_review
products.description: Transactional record of a reviewer's evaluation of an application during the admissions review process. Captures reviewer identity (staff, faculty, committee), review date, evaluation scores by dimension (academic, extracurricular, essay, interview), overall recommendation, and review round. Supports holistic review workflows and committee-based decision processes.
products.reference: Slate CRM Reader Review / Holistic Admissions Review

attributes.name: application_review_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each application review record in the admissions review process. Primary key for this entity.

attributes.name: academic_program_id
attributes.description: Reference to the academic program or degree program to which the applicant is applying. Enables program-level review analytics and admission rate reporting by Classification of Instructional Programs (CIP) code.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner SIS - Admissions Module; CIP (Classification of Instructional Programs)

attributes.name: committee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the admissions committee responsible for this review, when the review is conducted as part of a formal committee-based decision process rather than an individual review.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner SIS - Admissions Module; Slate CRM - Application Processing

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the staff member, faculty member, or committee delegate who conducted this review. Supports tracking reviewer workload, calibration, and inter-rater reliability analysis.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner SIS - Admissions Module; Workday HCM

attributes.name: enrollment_application_id
attributes.description: Reference to the admissions application being reviewed. Links this review record to the applicant's submitted application in the Student Information System (SIS).
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner SIS - Admissions Module; Slate CRM - Application Processing

attributes.name: faculty_reviewer_instructor_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to faculty.instructor. Business justification: Faculty serve on admissions review committees, especially for graduate programs. Accreditation bodies (SACSCOC, specialized accreditors) require documentation of faculty participation in admissions de

attributes.name: term_id
attributes.description: Reference to the academic term or period for which the applicant is seeking admission (e.g., Fall 2025, Spring 2026). Supports term-based enrollment cycle reporting.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner SIS - Admissions Module; IPEDS Reporting

attributes.name: academic_score
attributes.description: Numeric score assigned by the reviewer for the academic dimension of the holistic review, typically assessing GPA (Grade Point Average), course rigor, class rank, and standardized test performance (SAT/ACT/GRE/GMAT). Scale defined by institutional rubric.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner SIS - Admissions Module; Slate CRM - Application Processing; NACUBO Best Practices

attributes.name: academic_year
attributes.description: Academic year associated with the admissions review cycle (e.g., '2024-2025'). Used for year-over-year trend analysis of admissions outcomes, reviewer patterns, and program-level admit rates.
attributes.references: IPEDS Reporting; Ellucian Banner SIS - Admissions Module; U.S. Department of Education

attributes.name: banner_review_ref
attributes.description: Source system reference identifier from Ellucian Banner SIS for this review record. Enables traceability and reconciliation between the Databricks Silver Layer and the Banner admissions module.

attributes.name: conflict_of_interest_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the reviewer declared a conflict of interest with this applicant (e.g., family relationship, prior professional relationship). When flagged, the review may be reassigned per institutional policy.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner SIS - Admissions Module; Institutional Compliance Policy; HLC Accreditation Standards

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this application review record was first created in the system. Supports audit trail requirements and data lineage tracking in the Databricks Silver Layer.
attributes.references: FERPA (Family Educational Rights and Privacy Act); Ellucian Banner SIS - Admissions Module

attributes.name: decision_alignment_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this reviewer's recommendation aligned with the final admissions decision made for the application. Supports inter-rater reliability analysis, reviewer calibration, and quality assurance (QA) of the holistic review process.
attributes.references: Slate CRM - Application Processing; HLC Accreditation Standards; SACSCOC Standards

attributes.name: degree_level
attributes.description: Level of the degree program for which the application is being reviewed. Supports segmentation of review analytics by degree level and alignment with IPEDS degree-level reporting categories.
attributes.references: IPEDS Reporting; U.S. Department of Education; Ellucian Banner SIS - Admissions Module

attributes.name: essay_score
attributes.description: Numeric score assigned by the reviewer for the personal statement and supplemental essay dimension of the holistic review, assessing writing quality, self-reflection, intellectual curiosity, and fit with institutional mission.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner SIS - Admissions Module; Slate CRM - Application Processing

attributes.name: extracurricular_score
attributes.description: Numeric score assigned by the reviewer for the extracurricular and co-curricular activities dimension of the holistic review, assessing leadership, community involvement, athletics, and other non-academic achievements.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner SIS - Admissions Module; Slate CRM - Application Processing

attributes.name: first_generation_noted
attributes.description: Indicates whether the reviewer noted first-generation college student status as a contextual factor in the holistic evaluation. Supports equity, access, and diversity reporting for accreditation and IPEDS compliance.
attributes.references: IPEDS Reporting; U.S. Department of Education Title IV; HLC Accreditation Standards

attributes.name: honors_nomination
attributes.description: Indicates whether the reviewer has nominated this applicant for the institutional honors program based on demonstrated academic excellence and intellectual potential.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner SIS - Admissions Module; Slate CRM - Application Processing

attributes.name: internal_notes
attributes.description: Internal-only notes recorded by the reviewer for committee deliberation purposes. These notes are not shared with the applicant and are subject to institutional FERPA policy regarding the disclosure of admissions records.
attributes.references: FERPA (Family Educational Rights and Privacy Act); Ellucian Banner SIS - Admissions Module

attributes.name: international_applicant_noted
attributes.description: Indicates whether the reviewer noted international student status as a contextual factor, including consideration of TOEFL/IELTS scores, credential evaluation, and country-of-origin context in the holistic review.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner SIS - Admissions Module; TOEFL/IELTS Standards; U.S. Department of Education

attributes.name: interview_score
attributes.description: Numeric score assigned following an admissions interview, assessing communication skills, motivation, and institutional fit. Nullable when no interview was conducted as part of the review process.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner SIS - Admissions Module; Slate CRM - Application Processing

attributes.name: is_blind_review
attributes.description: Indicates whether this review was conducted under a blind or anonymized review protocol, where certain applicant identifying information (e.g., name, demographic data) was redacted to reduce reviewer bias.
attributes.references: Slate CRM - Application Processing; HLC Accreditation Standards; SACSCOC Standards

attributes.name: overall_score
attributes.description: Composite overall score assigned by the reviewer summarizing the holistic evaluation across all dimensions. May be a weighted average of dimension scores or an independent holistic judgment score per institutional rubric.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner SIS - Admissions Module; Slate CRM - Application Processing; HLC Accreditation Standards

attributes.name: recommendation
attributes.description: The reviewer's formal recommendation for the admissions decision on this application. 'admit' recommends acceptance; 'deny' recommends rejection; 'waitlist' recommends placement on waitlist; 'defer' recommends deferral to a future term; 'further_review' flags for additional committee consideration.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner SIS - Admissions Module; Slate CRM - Application Processing

attributes.name: recommendation_score
attributes.description: Numeric score assigned by the reviewer for the quality and strength of letters of recommendation submitted with the application. Reflects the caliber of endorsements from teachers, counselors, and other references.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner SIS - Admissions Module; Slate CRM - Application Processing

attributes.name: recommendation_strength
attributes.description: Qualitative indicator of the reviewer's confidence or conviction in their recommendation. Supports committee deliberation by distinguishing between strong and borderline recommendations.

attributes.name: recusal_reason
attributes.description: Free-text description of the reason a reviewer recused themselves or was removed from reviewing a specific application. Populated only when conflict_of_interest_flag is true or review_status is 'withdrawn'.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner SIS - Admissions Module; Institutional Compliance Policy

attributes.name: review_date
attributes.description: Calendar date on which the reviewer completed or submitted this evaluation. Used for tracking review cycle timelines, reviewer productivity, and admissions decision turnaround reporting.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner SIS - Admissions Module; Slate CRM - Application Processing

attributes.name: review_duration_min
attributes.description: Total time in minutes the reviewer spent evaluating this application, calculated from review_start_timestamp to review_submit_timestamp. Used for reviewer workload analysis and process efficiency reporting.

attributes.name: review_method
attributes.description: Mode or channel through which the review was conducted. Distinguishes between online portal reviews (Slate), paper-based reviews, in-person committee meetings, and video conference committee sessions.
attributes.references: Slate CRM - Application Processing; Ellucian Banner SIS - Admissions Module

attributes.name: review_number
attributes.description: Externally visible business identifier for this review record, used in admissions correspondence, committee reports, and audit trails. Typically system-generated in Slate CRM or Banner.
attributes.references: Slate CRM - Application Processing; Ellucian Banner SIS - Admissions Module

attributes.name: review_round
attributes.description: Stage or round within the holistic admissions review workflow at which this evaluation was conducted. Supports multi-round review processes including first read, second read, committee review, final decision, and appeal rounds.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner SIS - Admissions Module; Slate CRM - Application Processing

attributes.name: review_start_timestamp
attributes.description: Precise date and time when the reviewer opened and began evaluating the application. Used in conjunction with review_submit_timestamp to calculate time-on-task and reviewer efficiency metrics.

attributes.name: review_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of this review record. 'pending' indicates assigned but not started; 'in_progress' indicates partially completed; 'completed' indicates all scores and recommendation submitted; 'withdrawn' indicates reviewer recused; 'overridden' indicates a senior officer superseded the review outcome.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner SIS - Admissions Module; Slate CRM - Application Processing

attributes.name: review_submit_timestamp
attributes.description: Precise date and time when the reviewer submitted the completed evaluation. Represents the principal business event timestamp for this transaction. Used for SLA tracking and admissions cycle management.
attributes.references: Slate CRM - Application Processing; Ellucian Banner SIS - Admissions Module

attributes.name: reviewer_comments
attributes.description: Free-text narrative comments entered by the reviewer summarizing their holistic evaluation, noting strengths, concerns, and contextual factors. Subject to FERPA protections as part of the student's education record once an admissions decision is made.
attributes.references: FERPA (Family Educational Rights and Privacy Act); Ellucian Banner SIS - Admissions Module; Slate CRM - Application Processing

attributes.name: reviewer_type
attributes.description: Classification of the reviewer's role in the admissions process. Distinguishes between admissions staff, faculty reviewers, alumni readers, formal committee members, and external readers. Supports analysis of review outcomes by reviewer category.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner SIS - Admissions Module; Slate CRM - Application Processing

attributes.name: rubric_version
attributes.description: Version identifier of the institutional scoring rubric applied during this review. Enables longitudinal comparability of scores across admissions cycles when rubric criteria are updated.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner SIS - Admissions Module; Slate CRM - Application Processing; HLC Accreditation Standards

attributes.name: scholarship_nomination
attributes.description: Indicates whether the reviewer has nominated this applicant for merit scholarship consideration as part of the holistic review. Feeds into the financial aid and scholarship award process.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner SIS - Financial Aid Module; Slate CRM - Application Processing

attributes.name: score_scale_max
attributes.description: Maximum possible value on the scoring rubric used for this review. Enables normalization of scores across different review cycles, programs, or institutional rubric versions for comparative analytics.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner SIS - Admissions Module; Slate CRM - Application Processing

attributes.name: slate_review_ref
attributes.description: Source system reference identifier from Slate CRM for this review record. Enables traceability and reconciliation between the Databricks Silver Layer and the operational Slate CRM admissions system.

attributes.name: special_talent_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the reviewer identified a special talent (e.g., NCAA athletics, performing arts, STEM research distinction) that warrants special consideration in the admissions decision process.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner SIS - Admissions Module; NCAA Compliance Standards

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this application review record was most recently modified. Supports change tracking, data quality monitoring, and incremental ETL (Extract Transform Load) processing in the lakehouse pipeline.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner SIS - Admissions Module; Slate CRM - Application Processing

products.name: admission_offer
products.description: Formal offer of admission extended to an applicant, distinct from the internal decision record. Captures offer letter generation date, delivery method (portal, email, mail), offer expiration date, scholarship amount included in offer, honors designation, and applicant response (accepted, declined, deferred response). Drives yield management and enrollment funnel reporting.
products.reference: Banner SAAADMS Offer / Slate CRM Decision Release

attributes.name: admission_offer_id
attributes.description: Unique system-generated identifier for the admission offer record. Primary key for this entity.

attributes.name: academic_program_id
attributes.description: Reference to the academic program (degree program) for which the admission offer is extended.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner SIS — Academic Records; CIP (Classification of Instructional Programs)

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the admissions staff member or counselor responsible for managing this offer. Used for territory-based yield reporting and counselor performance analytics.
attributes.references: Slate CRM — Prospect Management; Ellucian Banner SIS

attributes.name: enrollment_applicant_id
attributes.description: Reference to the prospective student (applicant/party) to whom this offer is extended. Supports yield management and enrollment funnel reporting.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner SIS — Admissions Module; FERPA

attributes.name: enrollment_application_id
attributes.description: Reference to the student application from which this admission offer was generated. Links the offer to the originating admissions application record.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner SIS — Admissions Module; Slate CRM — Application Processing

attributes.name: research_award_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to research.research_award. Business justification: Graduate admission offers with research assistantship funding specify the source grant/award. Required for offer letter generation with accurate funding details, award budget commitment tracking, and

attributes.name: admit_type
attributes.description: Classification of the admission offer by applicant category. Determines applicable admission policies, financial aid eligibility, and enrollment reporting segments. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: freshman|transfer|graduate|readmit|international|non_degree — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner SIS — Admissions Module; IPEDS (Integrated Postsecondary Education Data System)

attributes.name: applicant_response
attributes.description: The applicant's formal response to the admission offer. Drives yield management, seat reservation, and enrollment funnel reporting. 'deferred_response' indicates the applicant has requested additional time.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner SIS — Admissions Module; NACAC

attributes.name: applicant_response_date
attributes.description: The date on which the applicant formally responded to the admission offer (accepted, declined, or deferred response). Null if no response has been received.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner SIS — Admissions Module; Slate CRM

attributes.name: cip_code
attributes.description: The six-digit Classification of Instructional Programs (CIP) code assigned to the academic program in the admission offer. Required for IPEDS reporting and federal program classification.
attributes.references: CIP (Classification of Instructional Programs) — U.S. Department of Education; IPEDS

attributes.name: coa_amount
attributes.description: The estimated total Cost of Attendance (COA) for the entry term included in the offer package. Includes tuition, fees, room, board, and other allowances. Used in financial aid packaging and yield counseling.
attributes.references: U.S. Department of Education — COA (Cost of Attendance); FAFSA; NACUBO

attributes.name: college_unit_code
attributes.description: The institutional code identifying the college or school within the university to which the applicant has been admitted (e.g., College of Engineering, College of Business). Used for unit-level enrollment reporting and accreditation.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner SIS — Academic Structure; AACSB; ABET; HLC

attributes.name: condition_notes
attributes.description: Free-text description of specific conditions attached to the admission offer when conditions_of_admission is not unconditional. Documents requirements the applicant must satisfy before enrollment is confirmed.

attributes.name: conditions_of_admission
attributes.description: Specifies whether the offer is unconditional or subject to conditions the applicant must fulfill prior to enrollment (e.g., submission of final transcripts, English proficiency verification, completion of prerequisite coursework). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: unconditional|conditional_final_transcript|conditional_english_proficiency|conditional_prerequisite|conditional_other — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner SIS — Admissions Module; HLC; SACSCOC

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time the admission offer record was first created in the system. Supports audit trail, data lineage, and FERPA compliance documentation.
attributes.references: FERPA (Family Educational Rights and Privacy Act); Ellucian Banner SIS

attributes.name: decision_authority
attributes.description: Identifies the authority or body that approved the admission offer (e.g., admissions committee, dean, automated rules engine). Supports audit trails and accreditation compliance.
attributes.references: HLC; SACSCOC; Ellucian Banner SIS — Admissions

attributes.name: degree_level
attributes.description: The academic degree level associated with the program for which the offer is extended. Used for IPEDS reporting, financial aid eligibility, and enrollment segmentation.
attributes.references: IPEDS (Integrated Postsecondary Education Data System); U.S. Department of Education

attributes.name: delivery_method
attributes.description: The channel through which the admission offer was delivered to the applicant (e.g., applicant portal, email, physical mail, in-person). Used for communication effectiveness analysis.
attributes.references: Slate CRM — Communications; Ellucian Banner SIS

attributes.name: delivery_timestamp
attributes.description: The exact date and time the admission offer was delivered to the applicant via the specified delivery method. Supports SLA tracking and communication audit trails.
attributes.references: Slate CRM — Communications; Ellucian Banner SIS

attributes.name: deposit_amount
attributes.description: The dollar amount of the enrollment deposit required to confirm acceptance of the admission offer. Null if no deposit is required. Used in student accounts and yield management reporting.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner SIS — Student Accounts; NACUBO

attributes.name: deposit_paid_date
attributes.description: The date on which the applicant paid the enrollment deposit to confirm acceptance. Null if deposit has not been paid. Triggers seat reservation and onboarding workflows.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner SIS — Student Accounts; Oracle PeopleSoft Financials — AR

attributes.name: deposit_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether an enrollment deposit is required from the applicant to confirm acceptance of the admission offer. Drives student accounts and yield management workflows.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner SIS — Student Accounts; NACAC

attributes.name: entry_academic_year
attributes.description: The academic year associated with the entry term for which the offer is extended (e.g., 2025-2026). Used for cohort tracking and annual enrollment reporting.

attributes.name: entry_term_code
attributes.description: The academic term for which the applicant is being offered admission (e.g., 2025FA for Fall 2025). Drives enrollment cycle planning and cohort reporting.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner SIS — Academic Calendar; IPEDS

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: The date by which the applicant must respond to the admission offer. After this date, the offer is considered expired if no response has been recorded. Critical for enrollment funnel management.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner SIS — Admissions Module; National Candidate Reply Date (NACAC)

attributes.name: ftiac_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the applicant is a First-Time-In-Any-College (FTIAC) student. Critical for IPEDS first-time freshman cohort reporting, retention tracking, and federal enrollment statistics.
attributes.references: IPEDS (Integrated Postsecondary Education Data System); U.S. Department of Education

attributes.name: honors_designation
attributes.description: Indicates whether the admission offer includes an honors college or honors program designation. Drives specialized onboarding, advising, and scholarship eligibility workflows.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner SIS — Admissions Module; NCHC (National Collegiate Honors Council)

attributes.name: housing_guarantee
attributes.description: Indicates whether the admission offer includes a guaranteed on-campus housing assignment for the entry term. Relevant for yield management and facilities planning.
attributes.references: Archibus — Facilities Management; Ellucian Banner SIS

attributes.name: international_student
attributes.description: Indicates whether the applicant is classified as an international student for this admission offer. Drives visa processing workflows, SEVIS reporting, and international student services.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner SIS — Admissions; U.S. Department of Homeland Security — SEVIS; IPEDS

attributes.name: issued_date
attributes.description: The date on which the formal admission offer was generated and made available to the applicant. Represents the principal business event timestamp for this transaction. Used in yield analysis and time-to-offer reporting.

attributes.name: offer_letter_template_code
attributes.description: The code identifying the offer letter template used to generate the admission offer communication. Supports communication consistency audits and template version tracking.
attributes.references: Slate CRM — Communications; Ellucian Banner SIS

attributes.name: offer_number
attributes.description: Externally visible, human-readable identifier for the admission offer, used in offer letters, portal communications, and correspondence with the applicant. Format: ADM-YYYY-NNNNNN.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner SIS — Admissions Module; Slate CRM

attributes.name: offer_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the admission offer. Drives yield management workflows and enrollment funnel reporting. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: draft|issued|accepted|declined|deferred|rescinded|expired — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner SIS — Admissions Module; HLC; SACSCOC

attributes.name: portal_viewed
attributes.description: Indicates whether the applicant has viewed the admission offer in the applicant portal. Used for yield management follow-up workflows and engagement tracking.
attributes.references: Slate CRM — Prospect Management; Ellucian Banner SIS

attributes.name: portal_viewed_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time the applicant first viewed the admission offer in the applicant portal. Supports yield counseling intervention timing and engagement analytics.

attributes.name: rescind_reason
attributes.description: The reason the admission offer was rescinded, if applicable. Required for compliance documentation and institutional reporting.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner SIS — Admissions Module; NACAC; HLC; SACSCOC

attributes.name: rescinded_date
attributes.description: The date on which the admission offer was rescinded by the institution, if applicable. Null if the offer has not been rescinded. Used for compliance documentation and enrollment audit trails.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner SIS — Admissions Module; NACAC; HLC

attributes.name: scholarship_amount
attributes.description: The institutional merit scholarship dollar amount included in the admission offer letter. Represents the gross institutional grant offered at time of admission. Distinct from need-based financial aid awarded through FAFSA processing.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner SIS — Financial Aid; U.S. Department of Education Title IV; NACUBO

attributes.name: scholarship_name
attributes.description: The name of the institutional scholarship or merit award included in the admission offer (e.g., Presidential Scholarship, Dean's Award). Used for donor stewardship, yield communications, and financial aid reporting.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner SIS — Financial Aid; Blackbaud Raiser's Edge — Gift Processing

attributes.name: scholarship_renewable
attributes.description: Indicates whether the scholarship included in the admission offer is renewable for subsequent academic years, subject to Satisfactory Academic Progress (SAP) requirements.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner SIS — Financial Aid; U.S. Department of Education — SAP (Satisfactory Academic Progress)

attributes.name: scholarship_renewal_gpa
attributes.business_glossary_term: Scholarship Renewal GPA (Grade Point Average) Requirement
attributes.description: The minimum cumulative GPA (Grade Point Average) the student must maintain to retain the scholarship in subsequent terms. Null if scholarship is not renewable or has no GPA requirement.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner SIS — Financial Aid; U.S. Department of Education — SAP (Satisfactory Academic Progress)

attributes.name: stem_designated
attributes.business_glossary_term: STEM (Science Technology Engineering Mathematics) Designated Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the program in the admission offer is classified as a STEM (Science, Technology, Engineering, Mathematics) designated program. Relevant for OPT extension eligibility for international students and federal reporting.
attributes.references: U.S. Department of Homeland Security — STEM OPT; U.S. Department of Education CIP

attributes.name: toefl_waived
attributes.business_glossary_term: TOEFL (Test of English as a Foreign Language) Waived Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the TOEFL (Test of English as a Foreign Language) or equivalent English proficiency requirement has been waived for this applicant as part of the admission offer. Relevant for international student admissions compliance.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner SIS — Admissions; U.S. Department of Education; SEVIS

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time the admission offer record was last modified. Supports audit trail, change tracking, and data lineage for compliance and reporting purposes.
attributes.references: FERPA (Family Educational Rights and Privacy Act); Ellucian Banner SIS

attributes.name: visa_type_required
attributes.description: The U.S. student visa type required for the applicant to enroll, if applicable. Used for I-20/DS-2019 issuance workflows and SEVIS compliance reporting.
attributes.references: U.S. Department of Homeland Security — SEVIS; U.S. Department of State

products.name: transfer_credit_eval
products.description: Record of the evaluation of transfer coursework submitted by a transfer applicant for potential credit articulation. Captures sending institution, course title, course number, credit hours, grade earned, equivalent institutional course, credit awarded flag, and evaluating department. Supports transfer admission decisions and pre-enrollment academic planning.

attributes.name: transfer_credit_eval_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each transfer credit evaluation record in the Ellucian Banner Student Information System (SIS). Entity role: TRANSACTION_HEADER — represents a discrete academic evaluation event with its own lifecycle.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner SIS — Transfer Articulation Module

attributes.name: aid_sap_evaluation_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to aid.sap_evaluation. Business justification: Transfer credits impact SAP maximum timeframe calculations (attempted hours vs. program length). Operational link for aid eligibility when transfer students approach 150% completion threshold. Require

attributes.name: articulation_agreement_id
attributes.description: Reference to a formal articulation agreement between the receiving institution and the sending institution, if one exists. When populated, the evaluation follows pre-negotiated equivalency mappings rather than individual review.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner SIS — Transfer Articulation Module; AACRAO Transfer Credit Practices

attributes.name: athletic_eligibility_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to athletics.athletic_eligibility. Business justification: Transfer student-athletes' eligibility depends on accepted transfer credits counting toward degree requirements for progress-toward-degree percentage calculation. Compliance officers must verify each

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the faculty member, academic advisor, or registrar staff member who rendered the articulation decision. Satisfies PARTY_REFERENCE category for TRANSACTION_HEADER role.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner SIS — Transfer Articulation Module; Workday HCM

attributes.name: enrollment_application_id
attributes.description: Reference to the admissions application submitted by the transfer applicant. Links the credit evaluation to the applicant's enrollment application record in Ellucian Banner Admissions.

attributes.name: equivalent_course_id
attributes.description: Reference to the receiving institution's course catalog entry that the sending course has been articulated to. Null if no direct equivalent exists and credit is awarded as elective or generic credit.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner SIS — Course Catalog Module

attributes.name: org_unit_id
attributes.description: Reference to the academic department responsible for reviewing and rendering the articulation decision for this transfer course. Departments evaluate subject-matter equivalency.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner SIS — Academic Structure Module

attributes.name: profile_id
attributes.description: Reference to the student or prospective student record for whom the transfer credit evaluation is being conducted. May be populated after matriculation when the applicant becomes an enrolled student.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner SIS — Student Records Module; FERPA

attributes.name: transcript_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to enrollment.transcript. Business justification: Transfer credit evaluation is based on coursework documented in a specific transcript. This FK links the evaluation to the source transcript, enabling transcript-to-credit-award traceability. Removes
