attributes.name: appeal_decision
attributes.description: Outcome of the formal appeal process for a disputed transfer credit evaluation. 'upheld' = original denial maintained; 'overturned' = credit awarded upon appeal; 'pending' = appeal under review; 'withdrawn' = applicant withdrew appeal.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner SIS — Transfer Articulation Module; FERPA

attributes.name: appeal_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the applicant or student has filed a formal appeal of the transfer credit evaluation decision (True = appeal filed; False = no appeal). Triggers appeal workflow in the registrar's office.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner SIS — Transfer Articulation Module; FERPA

attributes.name: awarded_credit_hours
attributes.description: Number of credit hours (CR) granted by the receiving institution for this transfer course after evaluation. May differ from sending_credit_hours due to unit conversion or partial credit awards. Satisfies QUANTITATIVE_RESULT category for this non-monetary transaction.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner SIS — Transfer Articulation Module; AACRAO Transfer Credit Practices

attributes.name: course_level
attributes.description: Academic level classification of the sending institution's course. Determines how credit applies toward degree requirements (e.g., lower-division credits may not satisfy upper-division requirements). Critical for degree audit and program planning.
attributes.references: AACRAO Transfer Credit Practices; Ellucian Banner SIS — Transfer Articulation Module

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this transfer credit evaluation record was first created in the system. Satisfies RECORD_AUDIT_CREATED category for TRANSACTION_HEADER role.

attributes.name: credential_eval_service
attributes.description: Name of the third-party credential evaluation service used to assess international transcripts (e.g., 'WES', 'ECE', 'NACES member'). Applicable only for foreign transcripts requiring external evaluation before institutional review.
attributes.references: NACES (National Association of Credential Evaluation Services); U.S. Department of Education

attributes.name: credit_awarded_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether academic credit was awarded for this transfer course (True = credit awarded; False = credit denied). Primary decision indicator used in transfer admission decisions and degree audit processing.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner SIS — Transfer Articulation Module; AACRAO Transfer Credit Practices

attributes.name: credit_type
attributes.description: Classification of how the awarded credit applies at the receiving institution. 'direct_equivalent' = maps to a specific course; 'elective' = counts as free elective; 'generic' = counts in subject area without specific course match; 'remedial' = developmental credit, not degree-applicable; 'no_credit' = denied; 'advanced_standing' = exemption without credit.
attributes.references: AACRAO Transfer Credit Practices; Ellucian Banner SIS — Transfer Articulation Module

attributes.name: degree_program_applicability
attributes.description: Indicates the specific degree program(s) or major(s) for which this transfer credit evaluation applies (e.g., 'B.S. Computer Science', 'B.A. Psychology'). A course may satisfy requirements in one program but not another.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner SIS — Degree Audit Module; AACRAO Transfer Credit Practices

attributes.name: denial_reason
attributes.description: Reason code explaining why transfer credit was denied or not awarded. Populated when credit_awarded_flag is False. Used for applicant communication, appeal processing, and policy analysis. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: insufficient_grade|no_equivalent|outdated_content|unaccredited_institution|incomplete_documentation|remedial_course|other — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: AACRAO Transfer Credit Practices; Ellucian Banner SIS — Transfer Articulation Module

attributes.name: eval_date
attributes.description: The date on which the evaluating department rendered its articulation decision. Represents the principal real-world business event timestamp (day-level) for this evaluation. Satisfies BUSINESS_EVENT_TIMESTAMP category.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner SIS — Transfer Articulation Module; AACRAO Transfer Credit Practices

attributes.name: eval_notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes entered by the evaluating department or registrar staff documenting the rationale for the articulation decision, conditions attached to conditional approvals, or instructions for the applicant. Subject to FERPA access controls.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner SIS — Transfer Articulation Module; FERPA (Family Educational Rights and Privacy Act)

attributes.name: eval_reference_number
attributes.description: Human-readable, externally communicable reference number assigned to this evaluation record (e.g., TCE-2024-000123). Used in correspondence with applicants, advisors, and sending institutions. Satisfies BUSINESS_IDENTIFIER category requirement for TRANSACTION_HEADER role.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner SIS — Transfer Articulation Module

attributes.name: eval_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the transfer credit evaluation. 'pending' = submitted, awaiting review; 'in_review' = under departmental review; 'approved' = credit awarded; 'denied' = credit not awarded; 'conditional' = credit awarded pending additional documentation; 'withdrawn' = applicant withdrew request. Satisfies LIFECYCLE_STATUS category.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner SIS — Transfer Articulation Module; AACRAO Transfer Credit Practices

attributes.name: eval_type
attributes.description: Method by which the transfer credit evaluation was conducted. 'individual_review' = evaluated on a case-by-case basis by the department; 'articulation_agreement' = governed by a formal bilateral agreement; 'statewide_policy' = governed by state-mandated transfer policy; 'national_policy' = governed by national standards (e.g., AP, CLEP).
attributes.references: AACRAO Transfer Credit Practices; U.S. Department of Education

attributes.name: intended_entry_term
attributes.description: The academic term for which the transfer applicant intends to enroll at the receiving institution (e.g., 'Fall 2024'). Used to align credit evaluation with the applicable catalog year and degree requirements.

attributes.name: min_grade_required
attributes.description: The minimum letter grade that must have been earned at the sending institution for this course to be eligible for credit transfer under institutional policy (e.g., 'C', 'C-', 'B'). Used to enforce grade threshold policies during evaluation.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner SIS — Transfer Articulation Module; AACRAO Transfer Credit Practices

attributes.name: posted_date
attributes.description: Date on which the awarded transfer credit was officially posted to the student's academic transcript. Null until posting occurs. Used for enrollment timeline tracking and degree audit activation.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner SIS — Academic History Module; FERPA

attributes.name: posted_to_transcript_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the awarded transfer credit has been officially posted to the student's academic transcript in the Student Information System (SIS) (True = posted; False = not yet posted). Credit is typically posted after official transcript receipt and matriculation.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner SIS — Academic History Module; FERPA; AACRAO Transfer Credit Practices

attributes.name: sending_cip_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: Sending Course Classification of Instructional Programs (CIP) Code
attributes.description: Six-digit CIP (Classification of Instructional Programs) code assigned to the sending institution's course, used to classify the academic discipline for articulation matching, IPEDS reporting, and program alignment analysis.
attributes.references: NCES CIP Code Taxonomy; IPEDS (Integrated Postsecondary Education Data System)

attributes.name: sending_course_number
attributes.description: The course number as recorded on the official transcript from the sending institution (e.g., 'MATH 201'). Preserved verbatim for audit and articulation agreement matching.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner SIS — Transfer Articulation Module; AACRAO Transfer Credit Practices

attributes.name: sending_course_title
attributes.description: The official course title as it appears on the sending institution's transcript (e.g., 'Calculus II'). Used by evaluators to assess subject-matter equivalency against the receiving institution's catalog.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner SIS — Transfer Articulation Module; AACRAO Transfer Credit Practices

attributes.name: sending_credit_hours
attributes.description: Number of credit hours (or equivalent units) assigned to the course at the sending institution as recorded on the official transcript. May differ from awarded credit hours due to unit conversion (e.g., quarter-to-semester conversion).
attributes.references: AACRAO Transfer Credit Practices; ECTS (European Credit Transfer System) for international transcripts

attributes.name: sending_credit_unit_type
attributes.description: The credit unit system used by the sending institution. Required for accurate credit hour conversion when the sending institution uses a different academic calendar system (e.g., quarter hours must be converted to semester hours at a 2/3 ratio).
attributes.references: AACRAO Transfer Credit Practices; ECTS (European Credit Transfer System)

attributes.name: sending_grade
attributes.description: The letter grade or grade symbol earned in the course at the sending institution as recorded on the official transcript (e.g., 'A', 'B+', 'C', 'P', 'S'). Used to determine grade threshold eligibility for credit transfer under institutional policy.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner SIS — Academic History Module; AACRAO Transfer Credit Practices

attributes.name: sending_grade_points
attributes.description: Numeric grade point value corresponding to the grade earned at the sending institution on that institution's grading scale (e.g., 3.700 for A-). Used for GPA (Grade Point Average) equivalency analysis and transfer GPA calculations.
attributes.references: AACRAO Transfer Credit Practices; Ellucian Banner SIS — Academic History Module

attributes.name: sending_institution_accreditation
attributes.description: Accreditation classification of the sending institution at the time of transcript evaluation. Determines eligibility for credit transfer under institutional policy. Regionally accredited institutions typically receive full credit consideration.
attributes.references: U.S. Department of Education — Accreditation Database; Regional Accreditation Agencies (HLC; SACSCOC; MSCHE; NWCCU; NECHE; WSCUC)

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Identifies the operational system of record from which this transfer credit evaluation record originated. 'banner' = Ellucian Banner SIS; 'slate' = Slate CRM (preliminary evaluation during admissions); 'manual' = manually entered by registrar staff.

attributes.name: term_completed
attributes.description: The academic term and year in which the course was completed at the sending institution as recorded on the transcript (e.g., 'Fall 2022', 'Spring 2023'). Used to assess course recency policies and catalog year applicability.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner SIS — Academic History Module; AACRAO Transfer Credit Practices

attributes.name: transcript_source_type
attributes.description: Indicates the form in which the sending institution's transcript was received. Official transcripts (paper or electronic) are required for final credit posting; unofficial or self-reported transcripts may be used for preliminary evaluation during admissions.
attributes.references: AACRAO Transfer Credit Practices; Ellucian Banner SIS — Admissions Module

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this transfer credit evaluation record was last modified. Tracks revisions to articulation decisions, credit awards, or equivalent course mappings. Satisfies RECORD_AUDIT_UPDATED category for TRANSACTION_HEADER role.

products.name: international_credential
products.description: Master record for international academic credentials submitted by international applicants, including foreign transcripts, degree certificates, and credential evaluation reports from agencies such as WES or ECE. Captures country of origin, credential type, issuing institution, evaluation agency, evaluated US equivalent degree level, and evaluation report date. Supports international admissions review.

attributes.name: international_credential_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the international academic credential record in the Databricks Silver Layer. Primary key for this master resource entity.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner Student Information System - Admissions Module

attributes.name: enrollment_applicant_id
attributes.description: Reference to the individual applicant who submitted this international credential. Enables direct linkage to the applicant's demographic and contact record.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner Student Information System - Admissions Module

attributes.name: enrollment_application_id
attributes.description: Reference to the admissions application with which this international credential is associated. Links the credential to the applicant's admission record in Ellucian Banner or Slate CRM.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner Student Information System - Admissions Module; Slate CRM

attributes.name: accreditation_status
attributes.description: Accreditation or recognition status of the foreign issuing institution as determined by the relevant national authority or international body. Unrecognized institutions may result in credential rejection per institutional policy.
attributes.references: UNESCO World Higher Education Database (WHED); NACES; U.S. Department of Education

attributes.name: admissions_reviewer_notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes entered by the admissions reviewer regarding the international credential, including observations about document quality, equivalency concerns, or special circumstances. Classified as confidential per FERPA student record protections.
attributes.references: FERPA (Family Educational Rights and Privacy Act); Ellucian Banner Admissions

attributes.name: cip_code
attributes.description: Six-digit CIP code mapped to the field of study of the foreign credential, following the National Center for Education Statistics taxonomy. Enables standardized program comparison and IPEDS reporting.
attributes.references: CIP (Classification of Instructional Programs) - NCES; IPEDS

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this international credential record was first created in the system. Provides audit trail and supports data lineage tracking in the Databricks Silver Layer.

attributes.name: credential_award_date
attributes.description: Date on which the foreign academic credential was officially awarded or conferred by the issuing institution. Used to verify recency and eligibility for graduate or professional program admission.

attributes.name: credential_code
attributes.description: Externally-known business identifier assigned to this credential record by the admissions office or Student Information System (SIS). Used for tracking and correspondence with applicants and evaluation agencies.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner Student Information System - Admissions Module

attributes.name: credential_name
attributes.description: Official name of the academic credential as it appears on the foreign document (e.g., 'Licenciatura', 'Abitur', 'A-Levels', 'Bachelor of Engineering'). Preserves the original credential title for accurate evaluation and record-keeping.
attributes.references: NACES; UNESCO International Standard Classification of Education (ISCED)

attributes.name: credential_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the international credential record within the admissions review workflow. Tracks progression from initial receipt through evaluation and final admissions decision. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: received|under_review|evaluated|accepted|rejected|pending_official — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner Student Information System - Admissions Module; HLC Accreditation Standards

attributes.name: credential_type
attributes.description: Classification of the submitted international academic credential document. Distinguishes between original foreign transcripts, degree certificates, diplomas, mark sheets, and formal credential evaluation reports from agencies such as WES or ECE. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: transcript|degree_certificate|diploma|mark_sheet|credential_evaluation_report|other — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: NACES (National Association of Credential Evaluation Services); Ellucian Banner Admissions

attributes.name: credit_hours_evaluated
attributes.description: Number of US-equivalent credit hours (CR) awarded or recognized based on the credential evaluation. Used for transfer credit articulation and degree completion planning.
attributes.references: AACRAO; Ellucian Banner Registration Module; ECTS (European Credit Transfer System)

attributes.name: document_delivery_method
attributes.description: Method by which the credential document was delivered to the institution (e.g., postal mail, email, applicant portal upload, direct submission from evaluation agency, courier). Supports document tracking and audit.

attributes.name: document_received_date
attributes.description: Date on which the physical or electronic credential document was received by the admissions office. Triggers the document verification and evaluation workflow in the admissions process.

attributes.name: ects_credits
attributes.description: Number of European Credit Transfer System (ECTS) credits associated with the foreign credential, where applicable. Relevant for credentials from European institutions and supports international credit transfer articulation.
attributes.references: ECTS (European Credit Transfer System) - European Commission; Bologna Process

attributes.name: enrollment_end_date
attributes.description: Date the applicant completed or ended enrollment at the foreign issuing institution. Together with enrollment start date, defines the full period of foreign study.

attributes.name: enrollment_start_date
attributes.description: Date the applicant first enrolled at the foreign issuing institution. Used to calculate duration of study and verify academic history completeness.

attributes.name: evaluated_gpa
attributes.description: The US-equivalent Grade Point Average (GPA) on a 4.0 scale as determined by the credential evaluation agency or admissions office conversion. Used for academic standing comparison and admissions eligibility assessment.
attributes.references: NACES; AACRAO (American Association of Collegiate Registrars and Admissions Officers)

attributes.name: evaluation_agency_membership
attributes.description: Professional membership body to which the credential evaluation agency belongs (e.g., NACES or AICE). Confirms the agency meets institutional standards for accepted evaluators in the admissions process.

attributes.name: evaluation_agency_name
attributes.description: Name of the third-party credential evaluation agency that assessed the foreign credential (e.g., World Education Services (WES), Educational Credential Evaluators (ECE), Josef Silny & Associates). Required for verifying the legitimacy and accreditation of the evaluation.
attributes.references: NACES (National Association of Credential Evaluation Services); AICE (Association of International Credential Evaluators)

attributes.name: evaluation_report_date
attributes.description: Date on which the credential evaluation report was issued by the evaluation agency. Used to assess report recency and compliance with institutional policies requiring evaluations within a specified timeframe.

attributes.name: evaluation_report_number
attributes.description: Unique reference number assigned by the credential evaluation agency to the evaluation report. Used to verify authenticity and retrieve the official evaluation document from the agency.
attributes.references: NACES; WES (World Education Services); ECE (Educational Credential Evaluators)

attributes.name: field_of_study
attributes.description: Academic discipline or major field of study associated with the foreign credential as reported by the issuing institution. Supports program alignment and CIP code mapping during admissions review.
attributes.references: CIP (Classification of Instructional Programs) - NCES; ISCED-F 2013

attributes.name: is_official_document
attributes.description: Indicates whether the submitted credential is an official document (sealed, certified, or sent directly from the issuing institution or evaluation agency) as opposed to an unofficial copy submitted by the applicant. Official documents are required for final admissions decisions.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner Admissions; FERPA; HLC Accreditation Standards

attributes.name: is_translated
attributes.description: Indicates whether the credential document required translation into English. Flags records where a certified translation was obtained, supporting document completeness verification.

attributes.name: isced_level
attributes.business_glossary_term: International Standard Classification of Education (ISCED) Level
attributes.description: UNESCO ISCED 2011 level classification assigned to the foreign credential. Provides internationally standardized education level coding for cross-border comparability and institutional reporting. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: ISCED-1|ISCED-2|ISCED-3|ISCED-4|ISCED-5|ISCED-6|ISCED-7|ISCED-8 — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: UNESCO ISCED 2011; U.S. Department of Education

attributes.name: issuing_country_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 three-letter country code representing the country of origin of the foreign academic credential. Critical for international admissions review, visa processing, and IPEDS reporting.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1 Alpha-3; IPEDS (Integrated Postsecondary Education Data System); U.S. Department of Education

attributes.name: issuing_institution_city
attributes.description: City where the foreign issuing institution is located. Supports geographic analysis and institutional verification workflows.

attributes.name: issuing_institution_name
attributes.description: Full legal name of the foreign academic institution that issued the credential (e.g., university, college, or secondary school abroad). Used for institutional verification and accreditation cross-reference.
attributes.references: UNESCO World Higher Education Database (WHED); NACES

attributes.name: original_grade_value
attributes.description: The applicant's academic performance result as recorded on the foreign credential in the issuing institution's native grading format (e.g., '8.5/10', '85%', 'First Class'). Preserved for audit and re-evaluation purposes.

attributes.name: original_grading_scale
attributes.description: Description of the grading scale used by the foreign issuing institution (e.g., '1-10 scale', 'percentage 0-100', 'First/Second Class Honours'). Provides context for GPA conversion and academic performance interpretation.

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Operational system of record from which this international credential record was sourced (e.g., Ellucian Banner SIS, Slate CRM, or manually entered). Supports data lineage and ETL audit in the Databricks Silver Layer.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner Student Information System; Slate CRM

attributes.name: source_system_record_code
attributes.description: The native record identifier from the originating operational system (e.g., Banner credential record ID or Slate document ID). Enables traceability and reconciliation between the lakehouse Silver Layer and the system of record.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner Student Information System; Slate CRM

attributes.name: translation_agency
attributes.description: Name of the certified translation agency or individual translator who provided the English translation of the foreign credential document. Required when is_translated is true.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this international credential record was most recently modified. Supports change tracking, incremental ETL processing, and audit compliance in the Databricks Silver Layer.

attributes.name: us_equivalent_degree_level
attributes.description: The evaluated United States equivalent degree level assigned to the foreign credential by the credential evaluation agency or admissions office. Determines admissions eligibility and program placement. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: high_school_diploma|associate|bachelor|master|doctoral|professional|certificate|other — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: NACES; U.S. Department of Education; IPEDS

attributes.name: verification_date
attributes.description: Date on which the credential verification process was completed. Supports audit trail requirements and accreditation compliance documentation.

attributes.name: verification_status
attributes.description: Status of the institutional verification process confirming the authenticity of the foreign credential with the issuing institution or evaluation agency. Distinct from credential_status which tracks the admissions workflow stage.

attributes.name: verified_by
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the admissions staff member or office responsible for completing the credential verification. Provides accountability and audit trail for the verification decision.

products.name: recruitment_territory
products.description: Reference entity defining geographic recruitment territories assigned to admissions counselors. Captures territory name, geographic boundaries (states, counties, zip codes, countries), territory type (domestic, international, virtual), assigned counselor, effective dates, and target prospect volume. Supports territory-based recruitment planning and counselor workload management.

attributes.name: recruitment_territory_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the recruitment territory record. Primary key for the recruitment_territory entity in the enrollment domain Silver layer.

attributes.name: primary_recruitment_employee_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the primary admissions counselor responsible for this territory. Links to the staff/counselor entity for workload management, performance tracking, and prospect routing in Slate CRM.

attributes.name: tertiary_recruitment_assigned_counselor_employee_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Tertiary Recruitment Assigned Counselor Employee Id
attributes.description: FK to hr.employee

attributes.name: academic_year
attributes.description: Academic year for which this territory configuration is active (e.g., '2024-2025'). Territories may be reconfigured annually to reflect enrollment strategy changes, counselor staffing, and institutional priorities.

attributes.name: banner_territory_code
attributes.description: Territory code as stored in Ellucian Banner Student Information System (SIS). Used for cross-system reconciliation between Banner admissions records and Slate CRM territory assignments, and for IPEDS reporting alignment.

attributes.name: college_unit_focus
attributes.description: Name or code of the college, school, or academic unit that this territory primarily recruits for (e.g., 'College of Engineering', 'School of Business', 'All Colleges'). Supports college-specific recruitment planning and AACSB/ABET reporting.

attributes.name: cost_center_code
attributes.description: Financial cost center code in Oracle PeopleSoft Financials to which territory-related expenses (travel, events, materials) are charged. Enables financial reporting and budget reconciliation at the territory level.

attributes.name: counties_covered
attributes.description: Pipe-delimited list of county names or FIPS county codes included in this territory for sub-state geographic precision (e.g., 'Cook County, IL|DuPage County, IL'). Used for high-density metro area territory delineation.
attributes.references: U.S. Census Bureau FIPS County Codes; Slate CRM

attributes.name: countries_covered
attributes.description: Pipe-delimited list of ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country codes included in this territory for international recruitment (e.g., 'CHN|IND|KOR|BRA'). Null for purely domestic territories. Used for international prospect routing and visa/citizenship reporting.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1 Alpha-3 Country Codes; SEVIS; Slate CRM

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this recruitment territory record was first created in the data platform. Supports audit trail, data lineage, and Silver layer record management per institutional data governance policy.
attributes.references: FERPA Data Governance; Institutional Data Governance Policy

attributes.name: degree_level_focus
attributes.description: Degree level(s) that this territory is primarily responsible for recruiting (e.g., undergraduate, graduate, professional). Supports segmented recruitment strategy and counselor specialization by academic level.
attributes.references: IPEDS Degree Level Classification; Ellucian Banner Admissions

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: Date on which this territory assignment and configuration expires or is superseded. Null indicates an open-ended, currently active territory. Used for historical territory analysis and counselor transition management.

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: Date on which this territory assignment and configuration becomes effective. Supports bi-temporal modeling of territory changes across recruitment cycles and counselor transitions.

attributes.name: high_school_count
attributes.description: Number of high schools within the territory's geographic boundaries. Used for planning high school visit schedules, counselor workload estimation, and CEEB code-based prospect sourcing.
attributes.references: College Board CEEB Code Directory; Slate CRM

attributes.name: is_first_generation_focus
attributes.description: Indicates whether this territory has a designated focus on recruiting first-generation college students (FTIAC students whose parents did not complete a four-year degree). Supports equity and access reporting and targeted outreach program planning.
attributes.references: U.S. Department of Education Title IV; IPEDS; FERPA

attributes.name: is_international
attributes.description: Indicates whether this territory covers international (non-U.S.) geographic areas. Drives SEVIS compliance workflows, visa counseling requirements, TOEFL/IELTS score routing, and international student services coordination.
attributes.references: SEVIS; U.S. Department of Education; Slate CRM

attributes.name: is_stem_focus
attributes.business_glossary_term: Science Technology Engineering Mathematics (STEM) Focus Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this territory has a designated focus on recruiting STEM (Science, Technology, Engineering, Mathematics) program prospects. Supports targeted STEM pipeline initiatives and federal reporting on STEM enrollment diversity.
attributes.references: U.S. Department of Education STEM Designation; IPEDS

attributes.name: priority_tier
attributes.description: Strategic priority classification of the territory based on enrollment yield history, institutional goals, and market opportunity (Tier 1 = highest priority). Drives resource allocation, travel frequency, and event investment decisions.
attributes.references: NACUBO Enrollment Management Standards; Slate CRM

attributes.name: slate_territory_ref
attributes.description: Source system identifier for this territory record in Slate CRM (Admissions and Enrollment system). Enables lineage tracing, incremental ETL reconciliation, and cross-system auditing between the Silver layer and the operational Slate CRM instance.
attributes.references: Slate CRM; ETL Data Lineage Standards

attributes.name: states_covered
attributes.description: Pipe-delimited list of U.S. state abbreviations (USPS two-letter codes) included in this domestic territory (e.g., 'IL|WI|MN|IA'). Null for international or virtual territories. Used for prospect routing and geographic reporting.
attributes.references: USPS State Abbreviation Standard; Slate CRM

attributes.name: target_applicant_volume
attributes.description: Planned number of completed applications expected from this territory for the academic year. Distinct from prospect volume; used to set conversion funnel benchmarks and measure territory yield performance.
attributes.references: NACUBO Enrollment Management Standards; Slate CRM

attributes.name: target_enrolled_volume
attributes.description: Planned number of students expected to enroll (matriculate) from this territory for the academic year. Supports enrollment goal tracking and territory-level yield analysis.

attributes.name: target_prospect_volume
attributes.description: Planned number of prospective students to be recruited from this territory during the academic year. Used for counselor workload planning, travel budget allocation, and recruitment goal-setting.
attributes.references: NACUBO Enrollment Management Standards; Slate CRM

attributes.name: territory_code
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric code uniquely identifying the recruitment territory within the admissions office (e.g., 'DOM-MW-IL', 'INTL-APAC'). Used as the business key in Slate CRM and Banner for cross-system reference.

attributes.name: territory_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name of the recruitment territory (e.g., 'Midwest Illinois', 'Southeast Asia Pacific', 'Virtual Graduate Domestic'). Used in dashboards, counselor assignments, and recruitment planning reports.

attributes.name: territory_notes
attributes.description: Free-text operational notes about the territory including special recruitment considerations, key feeder high schools, partnership agreements, competitive landscape observations, or counselor-specific guidance.

attributes.name: territory_region
attributes.description: Broader geographic or organizational region grouping this territory (e.g., 'Northeast', 'Midwest', 'Southeast', 'West Coast', 'Latin America', 'EMEA', 'APAC'). Supports regional rollup reporting and counselor team management. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: Northeast|Midwest|Southeast|West|Southwest|Latin America|EMEA|APAC|Canada|Other — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: IPEDS Geographic Region Classification; Slate CRM

attributes.name: territory_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the recruitment territory. Active territories are in use for the current recruitment cycle; inactive territories are suspended; pending territories are being configured; archived territories are retained for historical reporting.

attributes.name: territory_type
attributes.description: Classification of the territory by geographic scope: domestic (U.S.-based states/counties/zip codes), international (foreign countries/regions), virtual (online-only outreach without geographic boundary), or hybrid (combination of in-person and virtual coverage).
attributes.references: NACUBO Enrollment Management Standards; Slate CRM

attributes.name: travel_budget
attributes.description: Annual travel and recruitment event budget allocated to this territory in USD. Used for financial planning, counselor expense management, and ROI analysis of territory-level recruitment spend.
attributes.references: NACUBO Financial Reporting Standards; Oracle PeopleSoft Financials

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this recruitment territory record was most recently modified. Used for incremental ETL processing, change detection, and audit trail maintenance in the Databricks Silver layer.
attributes.references: FERPA Data Governance; Institutional Data Governance Policy

attributes.name: virtual_platform
attributes.description: Primary virtual engagement platform used for this territory's online recruitment activities (e.g., Zoom, Teams, Slate Events). Applicable for virtual and hybrid territory types. Null or 'none' for purely in-person domestic territories.

attributes.name: zip_codes_covered
attributes.description: Pipe-delimited list or range expression of U.S. ZIP codes included in this territory for fine-grained geographic targeting (e.g., '60601|60602|60603'). Supports precise prospect routing in Slate CRM and targeted direct mail campaigns.
attributes.references: USPS ZIP Code Standard; Slate CRM

products.name: term
products.description: Academic term master record defining the enrollment period (semester, quarter, trimester, or summer session). Captures term code, start/end dates, registration open/close dates, census date, add/drop deadline, withdrawal deadline, grade submission deadline, term type (fall/spring/summer/winter), academic year, and term status. Serves as the foundational time dimension for all enrollment activity and integrates with Ellucian Banner term control table.

attributes.name: term_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the academic term record in the Databricks Silver Layer. Primary key for the term master table.

attributes.name: campus_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to facility.campus. Business justification: Academic terms may have campus-specific calendars, registration periods, and census dates in multi-campus institutions. Term management and registration systems require campus assignment. Campus_code

attributes.name: fiscal_period_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.fiscal_period. Business justification: Academic terms must align with fiscal periods for tuition revenue recognition, financial statement preparation, IPEDS reporting, and audit compliance. Every institution maps academic calendars to fisc

attributes.name: academic_year
attributes.description: The academic year to which this term belongs, expressed in YYYY-YYYY format (e.g., '2024-2025'). Used for IPEDS reporting, financial aid year alignment, accreditation data submissions, and annual enrollment trend analysis.
attributes.references: IPEDS Glossary; U.S. Department of Education Title IV; SACSCOC Standards

attributes.name: add_deadline_date
attributes.description: The last date students may add courses to their schedule for this term. After this date, course additions require instructor and dean approval. Critical for enrollment management, financial aid recalculation, and DFW rate tracking.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner Registration Control (SOATERM); U.S. Department of Education

attributes.name: banner_term_ref
attributes.description: The native term code as stored in the Ellucian Banner Student Information System (STVTERM table). Serves as the integration key for data lineage tracing between the Silver Layer and the Banner SIS source system. Enables reconciliation during ETL validation.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner STVTERM; ETL Integration Standards

attributes.name: calendar_type
attributes.description: The institutional calendar structure under which this term operates. Determines credit hour equivalencies, ECTS conversion factors, and financial aid disbursement schedules. Reported to IPEDS and regional accreditors.
attributes.references: IPEDS Glossary; ECTS User Guide; U.S. Department of Education

attributes.name: census_date
attributes.description: The official enrollment snapshot date used for IPEDS headcount and FTE reporting, state funding calculations, and institutional enrollment benchmarking. Enrollment counts frozen at census are the authoritative figures for accreditation and regulatory submissions.
attributes.references: IPEDS Fall Enrollment Survey; U.S. Department of Education; NACUBO Reporting Standards

attributes.name: commencement_date
attributes.description: The date of the graduation ceremony associated with this term, if applicable. Used for degree conferral processing, alumni record creation in Blackbaud Raiser's Edge, and NCAA eligibility tracking for student-athletes.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner Graduation; Blackbaud Raiser's Edge; NCAA Eligibility Center

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this term record was first created in the data platform. Supports audit trail requirements, data lineage tracking, and FERPA compliance documentation for record management.
attributes.references: FERPA; NACUBO Data Governance Standards; Databricks Lakehouse Audit Standards

attributes.name: degree_conferral_date
attributes.description: The official date on which degrees are conferred for students completing requirements in this term. May differ from commencement_date (e.g., degrees conferred at end of term but ceremony held later). Used for transcript notation, alumni record activation, and IPEDS Completions Survey reporting.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner Graduation; IPEDS Completions Survey; U.S. Department of Education

attributes.name: drop_deadline_date
attributes.description: The last date students may drop courses without academic record notation (no 'W' grade). Drops before this date result in full or partial tuition refund per the institutional refund schedule. Impacts DFW rate calculations and enrollment reporting.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner Registration Control (SOATERM); U.S. Department of Education Title IV

attributes.name: end_date
attributes.description: The last day of the academic term when instruction concludes. Marks the boundary for enrollment reporting, financial aid return-to-title-IV (R2T4) calculations, and academic standing evaluations.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner STVTERM; U.S. Department of Education Title IV R2T4; IPEDS

attributes.name: financial_aid_disbursement_date
attributes.description: The scheduled date for initial financial aid disbursement to student accounts for this term. Must comply with U.S. Department of Education Title IV disbursement timing rules (no earlier than 10 days before term start for most aid types). Drives student billing and accounts receivable processing.
attributes.references: U.S. Department of Education Title IV; FAFSA Regulations; NACUBO Student Financial Services

attributes.name: financial_aid_year_code
attributes.description: The FAFSA award year associated with this term (e.g., '2024-2025'). Links the term to the correct FAFSA cycle for Title IV aid eligibility determination, Expected Family Contribution (EFC) calculations, and Cost of Attendance (COA) budgets.
attributes.references: U.S. Department of Education Title IV; FAFSA; Ellucian Banner Financial Aid

attributes.name: fte_credit_hour_threshold
attributes.description: The minimum number of credit hours required for a student to be classified as full-time for FTE calculation purposes in this term. Typically 12 credit hours for undergraduates and 9 for graduates. Used in IPEDS FTE reporting, state funding formulas, and financial aid full-time enrollment requirements.
attributes.references: IPEDS Glossary; U.S. Department of Education; NACUBO FTE Reporting Standards

attributes.name: grade_change_deadline
attributes.description: The last date by which faculty or academic administrators may submit grade changes (corrections or incomplete grade resolutions) for this term without requiring academic committee approval. Governs academic record integrity and transcript finalization.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner Academic History; FERPA; HLC Accreditation Standards

attributes.name: grade_submission_deadline
attributes.description: The deadline by which faculty must submit final grades for all courses in this term via the SIS or LMS gradebook. Triggers academic standing evaluation, Dean's List processing, and financial aid SAP review upon completion.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner Academic History; Canvas LMS Gradebook; HLC Accreditation Standards

attributes.name: half_time_credit_hour_threshold
attributes.description: The minimum number of credit hours required for a student to be classified as half-time enrollment status for this term. Typically 6 credit hours for undergraduates. Determines financial aid eligibility levels and loan deferment qualification under Title IV regulations.
attributes.references: U.S. Department of Education Title IV; FAFSA Regulations; Ellucian Banner Financial Aid

attributes.name: incomplete_grade_deadline
attributes.description: The deadline by which students must complete coursework to resolve an 'Incomplete' (I) grade assigned in this term. After this date, incomplete grades typically convert to a failing grade per institutional policy. Tracked in Banner Academic History.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner Academic History; HLC Accreditation Standards; SACSCOC

attributes.name: instruction_weeks
attributes.description: The number of weeks of scheduled instruction in this term. Used for credit hour compliance verification per U.S. Department of Education regulations (Carnegie Unit standard: 1 credit hour = 1 hour of instruction + 2 hours of out-of-class work per week for 15 weeks), ECTS conversion, and accreditation reporting.
attributes.references: U.S. Department of Education Credit Hour Definition (34 CFR 600.2); ECTS User Guide; HLC

attributes.name: instructional_method
attributes.description: Primary instructional delivery modality for this term. Reported to IPEDS and accreditors. 'Hyflex' indicates simultaneous in-person and online delivery. Drives distance education compliance reporting under U.S. Department of Education regulations.
attributes.references: IPEDS Distance Education Definition; U.S. Department of Education; HLC Distance Education Standards

attributes.name: ipeds_term_type_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: Integrated Postsecondary Education Data System (IPEDS) Term Type Code
attributes.description: IPEDS-defined term type code for federal enrollment reporting: '1' = Fall, '2' = Spring, '3' = Summer. Required for IPEDS Fall Enrollment Survey and 12-Month Enrollment Survey submissions to the U.S. Department of Education.
attributes.references: IPEDS Data Collection System; U.S. Department of Education IPEDS Glossary

attributes.name: is_degree_applicable
attributes.description: Indicates whether credits earned in this term count toward degree completion requirements. Non-degree-applicable terms (e.g., certain continuing education sessions) are excluded from academic progress calculations and transcript degree audits.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner Academic History; HLC Accreditation Standards; SACSCOC

attributes.name: is_financial_aid_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether students enrolled in this term are eligible to receive Title IV federal financial aid disbursements. Some special sessions or non-credit terms may not qualify. Governs FAFSA processing and aid packaging in Banner Financial Aid.
attributes.references: U.S. Department of Education Title IV; FAFSA Regulations; Ellucian Banner Financial Aid

attributes.name: is_open_enrollment
attributes.description: Indicates whether this term uses open/rolling enrollment (True) rather than a fixed registration window (False). Relevant for MOOC-style programs, continuing education, and competency-based education offerings that do not follow traditional term calendars.
attributes.references: U.S. Department of Education Competency-Based Education Guidelines; HLC

attributes.name: is_standard_term
attributes.description: Indicates whether this term follows the institution's standard academic calendar (True) or is a non-standard/accelerated/special session term (False). Non-standard terms may have different financial aid disbursement rules and credit hour compliance requirements under Title IV.
attributes.references: U.S. Department of Education Title IV Non-Standard Term Rules; Ellucian Banner

attributes.name: last_day_of_attendance_date
attributes.description: The last official day of academic activity for this term, used for Title IV Return to Title IV (R2T4) calculations when a student withdraws. Distinct from end_date as it may exclude final exam periods for R2T4 purposes.
attributes.references: U.S. Department of Education Title IV R2T4 Regulations; Ellucian Banner

attributes.name: payment_due_date
attributes.description: The deadline by which students must pay tuition and fees or establish a payment plan to avoid late fees or enrollment cancellation for this term. Managed in Banner Student Accounts.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner Student Accounts; NACUBO Student Financial Services Standards

attributes.name: registration_close_date
attributes.description: The final date by which students may register for courses in this term through standard registration processes. After this date, late registration or departmental override processes apply.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner Registration Control (SOATERM); HLC Accreditation Standards

attributes.name: registration_open_date
attributes.description: The date on which student course registration opens for this term. Priority registration windows for different student populations (e.g., seniors, athletes, honors students) are governed by this baseline date in Banner's registration control.

attributes.name: sap_evaluation_date
attributes.description: The date on which Satisfactory Academic Progress (SAP) is evaluated for students enrolled in this term. SAP evaluation is required by U.S. Department of Education Title IV regulations to determine continued financial aid eligibility based on GPA and completion rate thresholds.
attributes.references: U.S. Department of Education Title IV SAP Regulations (34 CFR 668.34); Ellucian Banner Financial Aid

attributes.name: session_code
attributes.description: Sub-term session identifier used when a term contains multiple instructional sessions of different lengths (e.g., 'A', 'B', 'C' for 8-week sessions within a 16-week semester, or 'S1'/'S2' for summer sessions). Aligns with Banner part-of-term configuration.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner Part-of-Term (SOATERM); U.S. Department of Education

attributes.name: start_date
attributes.description: The first day of the academic term when instruction begins. Used to calculate enrollment duration, financial aid disbursement eligibility, and Satisfactory Academic Progress (SAP) evaluation periods.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner STVTERM; U.S. Department of Education Title IV; IPEDS

attributes.name: term_code
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric code uniquely identifying the academic term, following Ellucian Banner's YYYYTT convention (e.g., 202410 for Fall 2024, 202420 for Spring 2025). Used as the primary cross-system integration key across Banner, Canvas LMS, and Kuali Research.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner STVTERM; IPEDS Reporting Standards

attributes.name: term_name
attributes.description: Human-readable display name of the academic term (e.g., 'Fall 2024', 'Spring 2025', 'Summer 2024 Session I'). Used in student-facing portals, transcripts, and institutional reporting.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner STVTERM; IPEDS Reporting Standards

attributes.name: term_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the academic term. 'Planning' indicates the term is being configured; 'Open' indicates registration is available; 'Active' indicates the term is in session; 'Closed' indicates the term has ended and grades are finalized; 'Archived' indicates the term is historical. Controls system-wide access and processing rules in Banner.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner Term Control Table; HLC Accreditation Standards

attributes.name: term_type
attributes.description: Classification of the academic term by season or session type. Drives financial aid disbursement cycles, IPEDS reporting, and enrollment analytics segmentation.
attributes.references: IPEDS Glossary; U.S. Department of Education Title IV Regulations

attributes.name: tuition_billing_date
attributes.description: The date on which tuition and fee charges are assessed to student accounts for this term. Aligns with the institutional billing cycle and triggers accounts receivable processing in Banner Student Accounts and PeopleSoft Financials.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner Student Accounts; Oracle PeopleSoft Financials AR; NACUBO

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this term record was most recently modified in the data platform. Used for incremental ETL processing, change data capture, and audit trail maintenance in the Silver Layer.
attributes.references: FERPA; NACUBO Data Governance Standards; Databricks Lakehouse Audit Standards

attributes.name: withdrawal_deadline_date
attributes.description: The last date students may withdraw from courses with a 'W' grade notation on their academic record. Withdrawals after this date require academic committee approval. Affects SAP evaluation, financial aid return-to-title-IV (R2T4), and DFW rate reporting.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner Registration Control (SOATERM); U.S. Department of Education Title IV R2T4; SACSCOC

products.name: enrollment_registration
products.description: Core transactional record of a student's enrollment in a specific course section for a given term. Captures registration date/time, registration status (registered, dropped, withdrawn, audit, pass/fail), credit hours attempted, grade mode, repeat indicator, add/drop/withdraw timestamps, registration source (web self-service, registrar office, advisor override), and Banner SFRSTCR record linkage. This is the primary enrollment transaction and the authoritative source for headcount and credit hour reporting.

attributes.name: enrollment_registration_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the student course registration record in the Silver Layer lakehouse. Primary key for the enrollment.registration data product.

attributes.name: ada_accommodation_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.ada_accommodation. Business justification: Course registrations implement approved ADA accommodations (extended time, note-takers, accessible seating). Registrar and disability services offices use this link to verify accommodation delivery an

attributes.name: campus_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to facility.campus. Business justification: Course registrations occur at specific campuses. Space utilization analysis, campus-level enrollment planning, and multi-campus scheduling coordination require linking registrations to campus. Campus_

attributes.name: course_section_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific course section (CRN) in which the student is enrolled for the given term.

attributes.name: disbursement_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to aid.disbursement. Business justification: Disbursements require enrollment verification at census date. Operational link for Title IV compliance (enrollment status confirmation), COD reporting, and post-withdrawal disbursement eligibility. Tr

attributes.name: profile_id
attributes.description: Reference to the student who is enrolled in the course section. Links to the student master record.

attributes.name: term_id
attributes.description: Reference to the academic term (semester, quarter, or session) for which this registration applies.

attributes.name: tuition_charge_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to billing.tuition_charge. Business justification: Each registration generates specific tuition charges based on credit hours, program, and residency. Drop/add transactions require linking registration to originating charge for refund calculation per

attributes.name: add_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the student added this course section, particularly relevant for late adds processed after the initial registration period. Supports add/drop period compliance reporting.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner SFRSTCR; Institutional Academic Calendar Policy

attributes.name: banner_sfrstcr_key
attributes.description: Composite natural key from Ellucian Banner SFRSTCR table (PIDM + CRN + term code) used for source system lineage and reconciliation.

attributes.name: billing_hours
attributes.description: Number of credit hours used for tuition billing purposes for this registration. May differ from credit_hours_attempted for audit enrollments, variable-credit courses, or consortium arrangements.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner SFRSTCR_BILL_HR; NACUBO Tuition Billing Standards

attributes.name: census_enrolled_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the student was enrolled in this course section as of the official census date (enrollment snapshot date). Drives IPEDS headcount, FTE reporting, and state funding calculations.
attributes.references: IPEDS Fall Enrollment Survey; U.S. Department of Education; HLC Accreditation

attributes.name: cip_code
attributes.description: Six-digit CIP code classifying the academic discipline of the course. Required for IPEDS completions and enrollment reporting, and for STEM designation under DHS regulations.
attributes.references: NCES CIP 2020; IPEDS; DHS STEM OPT Extension List

attributes.name: college_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the academic college or school that owns the course section (e.g., ENGR, BUS, LAS). Used for enrollment reporting by college unit and accreditation body reporting (AACSB, ABET).
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner SSBSECT; AACSB; ABET; HLC

attributes.name: course_number
attributes.description: Numeric course identifier within the subject discipline (e.g., 101, 4520). Combined with course_subject forms the human-readable course designator used in transcripts and schedules.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner SCBCRSE_CRSE_NUMB; AACRAO Academic Records Standards

attributes.name: course_subject
attributes.description: Discipline subject prefix code for the course (e.g., MATH, ENGL, BIOL). Denormalized from the course catalog for reporting convenience and IPEDS CIP code alignment.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner SCBCRSE_SUBJ_CODE; CIP Classification of Instructional Programs; IPEDS

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this registration record was first created in the data platform. Supports audit trail, data lineage, and Silver Layer ingestion tracking.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner SFRSTCR_ACTIVITY_DATE; FERPA 34 CFR Part 99

attributes.name: credit_hours_attempted
attributes.description: Number of credit hours the student is attempting for this course section registration. Used in FTE calculations, financial aid SAP evaluation, and IPEDS credit hour reporting.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner SFRSTCR_CREDIT_HR; IPEDS; 34 CFR Part 668 SAP

attributes.name: crn
attributes.description: Banner Course Reference Number uniquely identifying the course section within a term. The primary operational identifier used by students and registrar staff.

attributes.name: department_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the academic department responsible for the course section. Used for departmental enrollment analytics, faculty workload reporting, and budget allocation.

attributes.name: drop_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the student dropped this course section. A drop before the census date typically results in no academic record; after census date may result in a W grade. Critical for DFW rate calculation.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner SFRSTCR; IPEDS; HLC Accreditation

attributes.name: enrollment_type
attributes.description: Enrollment intensity classification for the student in this term based on total credit hours. Affects financial aid disbursement thresholds, SAP evaluation, and IPEDS enrollment category reporting.

attributes.name: final_grade
attributes.description: Official final grade awarded for the course registration as recorded on the academic transcript. Drives GPA calculation, SAP evaluation, and degree audit. Values are institution-defined (A, B, C, D, F, W, I, etc.).
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner SFRSTCR_GRDE_CODE; AACRAO Academic Records Standards; FERPA

attributes.name: financial_aid_eligible_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this course registration counts toward the student's financial aid eligible enrollment intensity. Courses not meeting aid eligibility criteria (e.g., non-credit, repeated beyond limit) are flagged false.
attributes.references: 34 CFR Part 668 Title IV; FAFSA; SAP Policy

attributes.name: fte_contribution
attributes.description: Fractional FTE value contributed by this registration record, calculated as credit_hours_attempted divided by the full-time credit hour threshold (typically 15 for undergrad, 9 for grad). Used in IPEDS FTE reporting and state funding formulas.
attributes.references: IPEDS Glossary; U.S. Department of Education; NACUBO

attributes.name: grade_mode
attributes.description: Grading basis elected by the student for this registration. Determines how the course outcome is recorded on the academic transcript and whether it affects GPA calculation.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner SFRSTCR_GMOD_CODE; AACRAO Academic Records Standards

attributes.name: grade_points
attributes.description: Numeric grade point value assigned to the final grade for this registration (e.g., A=4.0, B=3.0). Used in GPA calculation. Stored at the registration level to support historical GPA reconstruction.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner SFRSTCR_GRDE_CODE; AACRAO; Institutional Grading Policy

attributes.name: incomplete_expiry_date
attributes.description: Deadline by which the student must complete outstanding coursework to resolve an Incomplete (I) grade. After this date, the grade typically converts to a failing grade per institutional policy.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner; AACRAO Academic Records Standards; Institutional Grading Policy

attributes.name: instructional_method
attributes.description: Mode of instruction for the course section in which the student is registered. Required for IPEDS distance education reporting and accreditation compliance.
attributes.references: IPEDS Distance Education Definition; HLC Distance Education Policy; U.S. Department of Education

attributes.name: last_status_change_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time of the most recent change to the registration status. Supports audit trail and change history analysis for compliance and operational reporting.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner SFRSTCR_ACTIVITY_DATE; FERPA 34 CFR Part 99

attributes.name: lms_enrollment_code
attributes.description: Corresponding enrollment record identifier in Canvas LMS. Enables cross-system linkage between the Banner registration record and the Canvas course enrollment for analytics and grade passback.
attributes.references: Canvas LMS Enrollment API; Instructure Canvas Data

attributes.name: midterm_grade
attributes.description: Interim grade assigned at midterm for early alert and academic intervention purposes. Not a final transcript grade; used by advisors and retention programs to identify at-risk students.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner SFRSTCR; Canvas LMS Gradebook; Institutional Early Alert Policy

attributes.name: override_authorized_by
attributes.description: Username or staff ID of the advisor, faculty member, or registrar staff who authorized the registration override. Required for audit trail and accountability reporting.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner SFRSTCR; FERPA 34 CFR Part 99; Institutional Policy

attributes.name: override_type
attributes.description: Type of registration restriction that was overridden to allow this enrollment. Tracks exceptions granted by advisors or registrar staff for compliance and audit purposes.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner SFRSTCR Override Processing; Institutional Registration Policy

attributes.name: pidm
attributes.description: Ellucian Banner internal Person IDentification Master number uniquely identifying the student across all Banner modules. Restricted as it is a system-of-record personal identifier.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner SPRIDEN; FERPA 34 CFR Part 99

attributes.name: registration_source
attributes.description: Channel or mechanism through which the registration was initiated. Distinguishes student self-service (Banner SSB), registrar staff entry, advisor override, or automated batch/API load.

attributes.name: registration_status
attributes.description: Current enrollment status of the student in the course section. Drives headcount, FTE calculations, and DFW rate reporting. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: registered|dropped|withdrawn|audit|waitlisted|pass_fail|incomplete|cancelled — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner SFRSTCR_RSTS_CODE; IPEDS; HLC Accreditation Standards

attributes.name: registration_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the student initially registered for the course section. The principal business event timestamp for this transaction. Used for priority registration analysis and add/drop period compliance.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner SFRSTCR_ACTIVITY_DATE; FERPA 34 CFR Part 99

attributes.name: repeat_course_count
attributes.description: Number of times the student has previously attempted this course, including the current registration. Used to enforce institutional repeat policies and Title IV financial aid repeat course limits.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner; 34 CFR Part 668.2; HEA Title IV

attributes.name: repeat_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether this registration is a repeated attempt of a course the student has previously enrolled in. Affects GPA recalculation policies and financial aid eligibility under SAP rules.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner SFRSTCR_REPT_COURSE; 34 CFR Part 668.2 SAP; AACRAO

attributes.name: sap_applicable_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this registration is included in the student's Satisfactory Academic Progress (SAP) evaluation for Title IV financial aid purposes. Excludes audit and certain non-credit enrollments.
attributes.references: 34 CFR Part 668.34 SAP; U.S. Department of Education; FAFSA

attributes.name: section_number
attributes.description: Alphanumeric identifier distinguishing this section from other sections of the same course in the same term (e.g., 001, 002, H01 for honors). Used in student schedules and registrar operations.

attributes.name: student_level
attributes.description: Academic level of the student at the time of registration. Determines applicable tuition rates, financial aid eligibility, and IPEDS reporting category.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner SGBSTDN_LEVL_CODE; IPEDS; 34 CFR Part 668

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this registration record was last modified in the data platform. Used for incremental ETL processing and change data capture in the Databricks Silver Layer.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner SFRSTCR_ACTIVITY_DATE; Databricks Delta Lake CDC

attributes.name: waitlist_position
attributes.description: Numeric position of the student on the course section waitlist when registration_status is waitlisted. Null when not on waitlist. Used to manage seat availability and notify students of openings.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner SFRSTCR; Institutional Registration Policy

attributes.name: withdraw_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the student officially withdrew from this course section after the drop deadline, resulting in a W grade on the transcript. Used in DFW rate and retention analytics.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner SFRSTCR; IPEDS DFW Rate; SACSCOC Standards

products.name: waitlist_entry
products.description: Tracks a student's position on a course section waitlist when the section is at capacity. Captures waitlist position number, date/time added to waitlist, notification sent flag, notification timestamp, offer expiration date/time, offer accepted/declined status, and auto-enroll eligibility flag. Supports automated waitlist processing and seat offer workflows in Banner registration module.

attributes.name: waitlist_entry_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each waitlist entry record in the course section waitlist system. Primary key for the waitlist_entry data product.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner Student Information System – Registration Module

attributes.name: course_section_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific course section for which the student is waitlisted. A section is a scheduled offering of a course in a given term with an assigned instructor and meeting pattern.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner Student Information System – Registration Module

attributes.name: enrollment_registration_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to enrollment.registration. Business justification: When a student is enrolled from a course waitlist (auto_enrolled_flag = true), this FK links the waitlist entry to the registration record that was created. This enables tracking of waitlist-to-enroll

attributes.name: profile_id
attributes.description: Reference to the student who holds this waitlist position. Links to the student master record in Banner (PIDM-derived surrogate).
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner Student Information System – Registration Module

attributes.name: term_id
attributes.description: Reference to the academic term (semester, quarter, or session) in which the waitlisted course section is offered. Supports term-based enrollment cycle processing.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner Student Information System – Registration Module; IPEDS Reporting

attributes.name: academic_level
attributes.description: The student's academic level at the time of waitlist entry. Used to enforce enrollment eligibility rules and section-level restrictions (e.g., graduate-only sections).
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner Student Information System – Registration Module; IPEDS Reporting

attributes.name: added_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the student was placed on the course section waitlist. This is the principal business event timestamp establishing the student's queue position and priority.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner Student Information System – Registration Module

attributes.name: auto_enroll_eligible_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the student is eligible for automatic enrollment into the course section when a seat becomes available, without requiring manual acceptance. Eligibility is determined by Banner registration rules, holds, and student consent.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner Student Information System – Registration Module

attributes.name: auto_enrolled_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the student was automatically enrolled into the course section via the Banner automated waitlist processing job, as opposed to manually accepting a seat offer.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner Student Information System – Registration Module

attributes.name: auto_enrolled_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the student was automatically enrolled into the course section by the Banner automated waitlist processing job. Null if auto-enrollment did not occur.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner Student Information System – Registration Module

attributes.name: banner_waitlist_ref
attributes.description: Source system record identifier from Ellucian Banner Registration module (SFRSTCR/SSBSECT waitlist sequence key). Used for reconciliation and ETL traceability back to the system of record.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner Student Information System – Registration Module

attributes.name: college_code
attributes.description: Institutional college or school code owning the course section (e.g., 'BUS' for College of Business, 'ENG' for College of Engineering). Supports college-level waitlist capacity and demand reporting.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner Student Information System – Registration Module; AACSB; ABET

attributes.name: course_number
attributes.description: Numeric or alphanumeric course number within the subject (e.g., '101', '301W'). Combined with subject_code forms the human-readable course identifier (e.g., MATH 301).
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner Student Information System – Registration Module

attributes.name: course_reference_number
attributes.description: Banner Course Reference Number (CRN) uniquely identifying the course section within a term. The CRN is the primary operational identifier used by students and staff during registration.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner Student Information System – Registration Module

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the waitlist entry record was first created in the data platform. Serves as the audit creation timestamp for data lineage and compliance purposes.
attributes.references: FERPA; Ellucian Banner Student Information System – Registration Module

attributes.name: credit_hours
attributes.description: Number of credit hours (CR) associated with the waitlisted course section. Used to assess impact on the student's total enrolled credit load and full-time equivalent (FTE) calculations upon enrollment.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner Student Information System – Registration Module; IPEDS FTE Reporting

attributes.name: department_code
attributes.description: Academic department code responsible for the course section. Used for departmental waitlist management, override approvals, and capacity planning.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner Student Information System – Registration Module

attributes.name: enrollment_type
attributes.description: The student's intended enrollment type for the waitlisted section, indicating full-time or part-time status and instructional delivery mode. Relevant for FTE calculations and financial aid eligibility.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner Student Information System – Registration Module; IPEDS FTE Reporting

attributes.name: entry_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the waitlist entry. 'active' = student is waiting; 'offered' = seat offer extended; 'accepted' = student accepted the seat offer; 'declined' = student declined the offer; 'expired' = offer deadline passed without response; 'cancelled' = student removed themselves or was administratively removed.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner Student Information System – Registration Module

attributes.name: ferpa_disclosure_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Family Educational Rights and Privacy Act (FERPA) Disclosure Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the student has an active FERPA disclosure restriction on file that limits sharing of this enrollment-related record with third parties. Governs data access controls for this waitlist entry in compliance with FERPA regulations.
attributes.references: FERPA (20 U.S.C. § 1232g); U.S. Department of Education

attributes.name: financial_aid_impact_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether enrollment from this waitlist entry would affect the student's financial aid eligibility or Satisfactory Academic Progress (SAP) status, such as pushing the student above or below full-time credit thresholds.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner Student Information System – Financial Aid Module; U.S. Department of Education Title IV; FAFSA

attributes.name: grading_mode
attributes.description: The grading basis the student intends to use for the waitlisted course section upon enrollment (e.g., standard letter grade, pass/fail, audit). Captured at waitlist entry to preserve student intent.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner Student Information System – Registration Module

attributes.name: notification_channel
attributes.description: The communication channel used to deliver the seat offer notification to the student. Supports multi-channel notification workflows in Banner and integrated CRM systems.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner Student Information System – Registration Module

attributes.name: notification_sent_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a seat offer notification has been sent to the student via the configured communication channel (email, SMS, or student portal). True = notification dispatched; False = not yet sent.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner Student Information System – Registration Module

attributes.name: notification_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the seat offer notification was sent to the student. Null if notification_sent_flag is False.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner Student Information System – Registration Module

attributes.name: offer_expiration_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time by which the student must accept or decline the seat offer before it expires and is passed to the next student on the waitlist. Configurable per term and course level.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner Student Information System – Registration Module

attributes.name: offer_extended_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when a seat offer was formally extended to the student, triggered by a vacancy opening in the course section. Null if no offer has been made.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner Student Information System – Registration Module

attributes.name: prerequisite_verified_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the student's prerequisites for the waitlisted course have been verified as satisfied. A False value may block auto-enrollment even when a seat becomes available.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner Student Information System – Registration Module

attributes.name: priority_reason
attributes.description: Descriptive reason for priority waitlist status when waitlist_type is 'priority' or 'department_override'. Examples include 'graduating senior', 'required for major', 'department chair approval'. Null for standard waitlist entries.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner Student Information System – Registration Module

attributes.name: registration_hold_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the student has an active registration hold in Banner that would prevent automatic enrollment even if a seat becomes available. Holds may include financial, academic, or administrative blocks.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner Student Information System – Registration Module; FERPA

attributes.name: removal_reason
attributes.description: Reason the student was removed from the waitlist. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: enrolled|declined_offer|offer_expired|student_withdrew|admin_removed|registration_hold|prerequisite_failed — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner Student Information System – Registration Module

attributes.name: removal_timestamp
