attributes.description: Date and time when the student was removed from the waitlist, regardless of reason (enrolled, declined, expired, withdrew, or administratively removed). Null if the entry is still active.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner Student Information System – Registration Module

attributes.name: section_capacity
attributes.description: Maximum enrollment capacity of the course section at the time the student was added to the waitlist. Provides context for waitlist depth analysis and seat availability forecasting.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner Student Information System – Registration Module

attributes.name: section_number
attributes.description: Section identifier distinguishing multiple offerings of the same course in a term (e.g., '001', '002', 'W01' for online). Used alongside subject_code and course_number to fully identify the section.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner Student Information System – Registration Module

attributes.name: student_response
attributes.description: The student's explicit response to the seat offer: 'accepted' = student confirmed enrollment; 'declined' = student declined the seat; 'no_response' = offer expired without a response.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner Student Information System – Registration Module

attributes.name: student_response_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the student responded to the seat offer (accepted or declined). Null if no response has been recorded.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner Student Information System – Registration Module

attributes.name: subject_code
attributes.description: Alphabetic subject/discipline code for the course (e.g., 'MATH', 'ENGL', 'CS'). Supports domain-level waitlist analysis and reporting by academic department.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner Student Information System – Registration Module; CIP Code Framework

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the waitlist entry record was last modified in the data platform. Tracks changes to status, position, notification flags, and offer details for audit and change-data-capture purposes.
attributes.references: FERPA; Ellucian Banner Student Information System – Registration Module

attributes.name: waitlist_capacity
attributes.description: Maximum number of students permitted on the waitlist for the course section, as configured in Banner SSBSECT. When the waitlist reaches this limit, no further students may join.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner Student Information System – Registration Module

attributes.name: waitlist_pool_size
attributes.description: Total number of students on the waitlist for the course section at the time this entry was created. Provides context for the student's relative position and likelihood of enrollment.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner Student Information System – Registration Module

attributes.name: waitlist_position
attributes.description: Ordinal position of the student on the course section waitlist, where 1 indicates the next student to be offered a seat. Position is recalculated dynamically as students ahead are enrolled or removed.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner Student Information System – Registration Module

attributes.name: waitlist_type
attributes.description: Classification of the waitlist entry type: 'standard' = general first-come-first-served queue; 'priority' = student has been granted priority waitlist status (e.g., graduating senior, major requirement); 'department_override' = department-initiated placement bypassing standard queue.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner Student Information System – Registration Module

products.name: add_drop_transaction
products.description: Immutable audit record of every add, drop, or withdrawal action performed on a student's registration during a term. Captures transaction type (add/drop/withdraw/grade-mode-change/credit-change), transaction timestamp, initiating user (student/advisor/registrar), reason code, effective date, prior status, new status, and whether the action occurred before or after the refund deadline. Supports DFW rate tracking, financial aid SAP calculations, and regulatory reporting.

attributes.name: add_drop_transaction_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each immutable add, drop, or withdrawal transaction record in the enrollment registration audit trail. Primary key for this product.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner Student Information System — Registration Module

attributes.description: Foreign key linking to billing.charge_adjustment. Business justification: Add/drop transactions trigger tuition adjustments and refund calculations per institutional refund schedule. Links enrollment action to billing adjustment for audit trail, refund percentage applicatio

attributes.name: course_section_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific course section (CRN) that was added, dropped, or withdrawn from in this transaction.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner SSBSECT — Course Section Master

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the user (student, advisor, or registrar staff) who performed this registration transaction.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner GOBEACC — User Account; FERPA 34 CFR Part 99

attributes.name: enrollment_registration_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to enrollment.registration. Business justification: Add/drop transaction is an immutable audit record of changes to a registration. This FK links the transaction to the registration record it modifies, enabling complete registration change history and

attributes.name: profile_id
attributes.description: Reference to the student whose course registration was affected by this transaction. Links to the student master record.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner SPRIDEN / SGBSTDN; FERPA 34 CFR Part 99

attributes.name: r2t4_calculation_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to aid.r2t4_calculation. Business justification: Complete withdrawals trigger Return of Title IV (R2T4) calculations per federal regulation. Links withdrawal transactions to aid return calculations. Operational for institutional/student return amoun

attributes.name: term_id
attributes.description: Reference to the academic term during which this registration transaction occurred.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner STVTERM; IPEDS Enrollment Reporting

attributes.name: academic_period_week
attributes.description: The week number within the academic term during which this transaction occurred (e.g., Week 1, Week 8). Enables analysis of add/drop/withdrawal patterns by week of term for retention early-alert and DFW rate reporting.
attributes.references: Institutional Retention Analytics; HLC Accreditation Evidence

attributes.name: banner_sfrstcr_key
attributes.description: The composite source system key from Ellucian Banner's SFRSTCR (Student Course Registration) table, used for lineage tracing and ETL reconciliation between the lakehouse silver layer and the Banner SIS source of record.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner SFRSTCR — Student Course Registration Table

attributes.name: course_number
attributes.description: The catalog course number of the section affected by this transaction (e.g., 101, 301, 4500). Combined with course_subject_code to form the full course identifier (e.g., MATH 101). Denormalized for reporting.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner SCBCRSE; AACRAO Academic Records Standards

attributes.name: course_subject_code
attributes.description: The subject/discipline code of the course section affected by this transaction (e.g., MATH, ENGL, BIOL). Denormalized for DFW rate analysis and enrollment reporting by discipline without requiring section joins.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner SCBCRSE; CIP Code Framework — NCES

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this add/drop transaction record was first written to the data lakehouse silver layer. Represents the ETL ingestion time, distinct from transaction_timestamp which captures the business event time in Banner.
attributes.references: Databricks Lakehouse Silver Layer Audit Standards; FERPA 34 CFR Part 99

attributes.name: credit_hours_after
attributes.description: The number of credit hours (CR) associated with the section after this transaction is applied. Zero for drop/withdraw transactions. For credit_change transactions, reflects the newly registered credit value. Drives FTE and SAP calculations.
attributes.references: IPEDS Enrollment Reporting; Ellucian Banner SFRSTCR.SFRSTCR_CREDIT_HR

attributes.name: credit_hours_before
attributes.description: The number of credit hours (CR) the student was enrolled in for the section prior to this transaction. For variable-credit courses, captures the previously registered credit value. Used in FTE calculations and SAP monitoring.
attributes.references: IPEDS Enrollment Reporting; Ellucian Banner SFRSTCR.SFRSTCR_CREDIT_HR

attributes.name: crn
attributes.description: The Course Reference Number uniquely identifying the course section within a term in Ellucian Banner. Denormalized for direct reporting and audit queries without requiring a join to the section dimension.

attributes.name: dfw_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this transaction contributes to the DFW (D-grade, F-grade, Withdrawal) rate metric for the associated course section. True = this drop or withdrawal counts as a DFW event for institutional analytics and accreditation reporting.
attributes.references: HLC Accreditation Standards; SACSCOC Principles of Accreditation; Institutional DFW Rate Reporting

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: The calendar date on which the registration change takes effect for academic and financial purposes. May differ from transaction_timestamp when a registrar processes a backdated adjustment.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner SFRSTCR; NACUBO Tuition Refund Policy Standards

attributes.name: financial_aid_impact_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this transaction triggered a review or recalculation of the student's financial aid package. True = financial aid office was notified or a recalculation was initiated. Critical for Satisfactory Academic Progress (SAP) monitoring and Title IV compliance.
attributes.references: U.S. Department of Education Title IV; FAFSA SAP Requirements 34 CFR 668.34

attributes.name: fte_after
attributes.description: The student's Full-Time Equivalent (FTE) enrollment value calculated from total term credit hours after this transaction is applied. Paired with fte_before to measure the FTE impact of each registration action for IPEDS and state funding reporting.
attributes.references: IPEDS FTE Calculation Methodology — NCES; State Higher Education Finance (SHEF) Reporting

attributes.name: fte_before
attributes.description: The student's Full-Time Equivalent (FTE) enrollment value calculated from total term credit hours prior to this transaction. Computed as total_credit_hours / FTE_divisor (12 for undergraduate, 9 for graduate). Used in IPEDS FTE reporting and state funding formulas.
attributes.references: IPEDS FTE Calculation Methodology — NCES; State Higher Education Finance (SHEF) Reporting

attributes.name: grade_mode_after
attributes.description: The grading mode applied to the student-section record as a result of this transaction. Paired with grade_mode_before to capture the complete grade mode transition for grade_mode_change transactions.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner STVGMOD — Grade Mode Validation Table

attributes.name: grade_mode_before
attributes.description: The grading mode in effect for the student-section record prior to this transaction. GR=Standard Graded, PF=Pass/Fail, AU=Audit, SA=Satisfactory/Unsatisfactory. Relevant for grade_mode_change transactions.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner STVGMOD — Grade Mode Validation Table

attributes.name: initiator_role
attributes.description: The role of the user who initiated this registration transaction. Distinguishes self-service student actions from advisor-directed changes, registrar administrative overrides, automated system processes, or faculty-initiated actions.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner GOBEACC; FERPA 34 CFR Part 99 — access control audit

attributes.name: ipeds_enrollment_status
attributes.description: The student's Integrated Postsecondary Education Data System (IPEDS) enrollment status after this transaction is applied, based on total enrolled credit hours for the term. full_time = 12+ undergraduate or 9+ graduate credit hours; part_time = below full-time threshold; not_enrolled = zero credit hours remaining.
attributes.references: IPEDS Enrollment Survey — U.S. Department of Education NCES; 34 CFR Part 668

attributes.name: is_after_withdraw_deadline
attributes.description: Indicates whether this transaction occurred after the last day to withdraw without academic penalty. True = late withdrawal subject to W or WF grade assignment; False = within the standard withdrawal window. Drives DFW rate calculations and academic standing determinations.
attributes.references: AACRAO Academic Records Standards; Ellucian Banner SFATERM — Term Control

attributes.name: is_before_refund_deadline
attributes.description: Indicates whether this transaction occurred before the institutional tuition refund deadline for the term. True = transaction is within the refund window; False = transaction occurred after the refund deadline. Critical for Student Accounts billing adjustments and NACUBO refund policy compliance.
attributes.references: NACUBO Tuition Refund Policy; Ellucian Banner SFARGFE — Registration Fee Assessment

attributes.name: is_complete_withdrawal
attributes.description: Indicates whether this transaction represents or contributes to a complete withdrawal from all courses for the term (total withdrawal). True = student is withdrawing from all enrolled sections. Triggers specific financial aid return-to-Title-IV (R2T4) calculations.
attributes.references: U.S. Department of Education 34 CFR 668.22 — Return of Title IV Funds (R2T4); FAFSA

attributes.name: new_registration_status
attributes.description: The Banner registration status code (STVRSTS) applied to the student-section record as a result of this transaction. Paired with prior_registration_status to form the complete state transition record. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: RE|DD|DN|WD|AU|WF|WN — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner STVRSTS — Registration Status Validation Table

attributes.name: override_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this transaction required an administrative override of a system-enforced registration restriction (e.g., prerequisite override, capacity override, time conflict override, holds override). True = at least one restriction was overridden to complete this transaction.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner SFASRPO — Student Registration Permit Override

attributes.name: override_type
attributes.description: Specifies the type of registration restriction that was overridden when override_flag is True. Values: prerequisite (prerequisite not met), capacity (section full), time_conflict (schedule overlap), hold (student account hold bypassed), level (student level restriction), college (college restriction), none (no override applied). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: prerequisite|capacity|time_conflict|hold|level|college|none — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner SFASRPO; AACRAO Registration Standards

attributes.name: prior_registration_status
attributes.description: The Banner registration status code (STVRSTS) that was in effect for the student-section record immediately before this transaction was applied. Enables before/after audit comparison. Common codes: RE=Registered, DD=Dropped, DN=Dropped No Refund, WD=Withdrawn, AU=Audit, WF=Withdrawn Failing, WN=Withdrawn Not Failing. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: RE|DD|DN|WD|AU|WF|WN — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner STVRSTS — Registration Status Validation Table

attributes.name: processing_channel
attributes.description: The channel through which this registration transaction was submitted. web_self_service = student self-service portal; registrar_office = in-person or phone processing by registrar staff; advisor_portal = advisor-initiated via advising system; batch_process = automated system batch; api = programmatic API integration.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner Self-Service; AACRAO Registration Standards

attributes.name: r2t4_required_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Return to Title IV (R2T4) Required Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this transaction triggers a Return to Title IV (R2T4) funds calculation per U.S. Department of Education regulations. True = financial aid office must perform R2T4 calculation within 30 days. Applies when is_complete_withdrawal is True and student received Title IV aid.
attributes.references: U.S. Department of Education 34 CFR 668.22 — Return of Title IV Funds

attributes.name: reason_code
attributes.description: Standardized institutional code indicating the business reason for the registration action (e.g., SCHED_CONFLICT, FINANCIAL, MEDICAL, ACADEMIC_DIFFICULTY, ADVISOR_DIRECTED, ADMIN_CORRECTION). Supports DFW rate analysis and retention reporting. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: SCHED_CONFLICT|FINANCIAL|MEDICAL|ACADEMIC_DIFFICULTY|ADVISOR_DIRECTED|ADMIN_CORRECTION|PERSONAL|PROGRAM_CHANGE — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner STVRSTS; AACRAO Withdrawal Reason Taxonomy

attributes.name: reason_description
attributes.description: Free-text narrative provided by the student, advisor, or registrar staff explaining the reason for the registration action. Supplements the structured reason_code with additional context.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner SFRSTCR; FERPA 34 CFR Part 99

attributes.name: refund_percentage
attributes.description: The percentage of tuition charges eligible for refund based on the institutional refund schedule at the time of this transaction (e.g., 100.00, 75.00, 50.00, 25.00, 0.00). Determined by the effective_date relative to the term refund schedule. Used by Student Accounts for billing adjustments.
attributes.references: NACUBO Tuition Refund Policy; Ellucian Banner SFARGFE — Fee Assessment

attributes.name: sap_impact_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this transaction affects the student's Satisfactory Academic Progress (SAP) calculation for financial aid eligibility. True = the credit hour change from this transaction must be factored into the SAP completion rate and maximum timeframe calculations.
attributes.references: U.S. Department of Education 34 CFR 668.34 — SAP Standards; FAFSA

attributes.name: transaction_number
attributes.description: Externally visible, human-readable reference number assigned to this registration transaction by the Student Information System (SIS). Used for audit inquiries and student-facing receipts.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner SFRSTCR — Student Course Registration

attributes.name: transaction_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of this registration transaction. Completed indicates the action was successfully applied; reversed indicates a subsequent corrective action nullified this transaction; failed indicates a system or rule rejection.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner SFRSTCR; AACRAO Records and Registration Standards

attributes.name: transaction_timestamp
attributes.description: The precise date and time (with timezone offset) at which the registration action was executed in the Student Information System. This is the principal business event timestamp for this record.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner SFRSTCR; FERPA 34 CFR Part 99 — audit trail requirement

attributes.name: transaction_type
attributes.description: Classifies the nature of the registration action: add (enrolling in a section), drop (removing before drop deadline), withdraw (removing after drop deadline with W grade), grade_mode_change (switching between graded/pass-fail/audit), credit_change (modifying variable credit hours), or audit_change (changing to audit status).
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner SFRSTCR.SFRSTCR_RSTS_CODE; AACRAO Registration Standards

attributes.name: tuition_adjustment_amount
attributes.description: The dollar amount of tuition charge adjustment (credit or debit) generated on the student's account as a result of this registration transaction. Negative values indicate a credit to the student account. Feeds Oracle PeopleSoft Financials AR module.
attributes.references: NACUBO Financial Reporting Standards; Oracle PeopleSoft Financials AR; GASB Statement No. 35

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this record was last modified in the data lakehouse silver layer, such as when a status correction or reversal was applied. Supports incremental ETL processing and audit trail completeness.
attributes.references: Databricks Lakehouse Silver Layer Audit Standards; FERPA 34 CFR Part 99

products.name: census
products.description: Point-in-time snapshot of enrollment counts captured at the official census date for each term. Records official headcount, FTE (Full-Time Equivalent) count, credit hours enrolled, unduplicated headcount by level (undergraduate/graduate/professional/doctoral), residency breakdown, and instructional method breakdown. Used for IPEDS reporting, state funding formulas, accreditation data submissions, and institutional research benchmarking. Distinct from live registration data — this is the frozen official record.
products.reference: IPEDS Fall Enrollment Survey / Census Date Snapshot

attributes.name: census_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each enrollment census snapshot record. Primary key for the enrollment_census data product in the Databricks Silver Layer.

attributes.name: ipeds_submission_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Integrated Postsecondary Education Data System (IPEDS) Submission ID
attributes.description: The IPEDS data collection submission identifier assigned by the U.S. Department of Education when this census record was submitted as part of the Fall Enrollment or 12-Month Enrollment survey. Null if not yet submitted.
attributes.references: IPEDS Data Collection System; U.S. Department of Education

attributes.name: org_unit_id
attributes.description: Reference to the academic college or school unit for which this census breakdown is recorded. Enables college-level enrollment reporting.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner STVCOLL; IPEDS Completions Survey

attributes.name: term_id
attributes.description: Reference to the academic term for which this census snapshot was captured. Links to the academic term master record.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner STVTERM; IPEDS Fall Enrollment Survey

attributes.name: academic_year
attributes.description: Academic year in which this census falls, formatted as YYYY-YYYY (e.g., 2024-2025). Used for year-over-year trend analysis and IPEDS annual reporting.
attributes.references: IPEDS Glossary; U.S. Department of Education Academic Year Definition

attributes.name: accreditation_submission_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this census record has been included in an accreditation data submission (e.g., HLC Annual Institutional Data Update, SACSCOC Fifth-Year Interim Report). True when submitted.
attributes.references: HLC Criteria for Accreditation; SACSCOC Principles of Accreditation; AACSB Standards

attributes.name: attendance_type
attributes.description: Enrollment attendance classification for this census record: full-time, part-time, or combined (all). Full-time/part-time distinction is required for FTE calculation and IPEDS reporting.
attributes.references: IPEDS Fall Enrollment Survey — Attendance Status; U.S. Department of Education

attributes.name: census_date
attributes.description: The official point-in-time date on which enrollment counts were frozen for this snapshot. This is the authoritative date used for IPEDS reporting, state funding formulas, and accreditation submissions. Distinct from the date the record was created.
attributes.references: IPEDS Fall Enrollment Survey; U.S. Department of Education Title IV Regulations; HLC Criteria for Accreditation

attributes.name: census_number
attributes.description: Externally-known business identifier for this census snapshot record, typically formatted as TERM_CODE-CENSUS_TYPE (e.g., 202410-OFFICIAL). Used for audit trails and cross-system reconciliation.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner Enrollment Reporting; IPEDS Reporting Standards

attributes.name: census_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of this census record. 'Locked' indicates the record is frozen and immutable for regulatory submission. 'Superseded' indicates a newer revision has replaced this record.
attributes.references: IPEDS Data Collection System; Ellucian Banner Enrollment Reporting

attributes.name: census_type
attributes.description: Classification of the census snapshot indicating whether it is the official frozen record, a preliminary estimate, a post-census revision, or a supplemental count. Only 'official' records are submitted to IPEDS and state agencies.
attributes.references: IPEDS Reporting Standards; NACUBO Enrollment Reporting Guidelines

attributes.name: continuing_headcount
attributes.description: Count of students who were enrolled in a prior term at this institution and are continuing enrollment in the current term. Used for retention analysis and year-over-year enrollment trend reporting.
attributes.references: IPEDS Fall Enrollment Survey; Institutional Research Retention Reporting

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this census record was first created in the data platform. Audit trail field for data lineage and Silver Layer processing tracking.
attributes.references: FERPA Data Stewardship; Databricks Lakehouse Audit Standards

attributes.name: credit_hours_total
attributes.description: Sum of all credit hours (CR) enrolled by students included in this census record as of the census date. Used as the numerator in FTE calculations and for state funding formula submissions.
attributes.references: IPEDS 12-Month Enrollment Survey; State Funding Formula Credit Hour Reporting

attributes.name: finalized_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time at which this census record was officially finalized and locked. Represents the principal business event time — when the enrollment count was frozen and became the authoritative official record.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner Enrollment Reporting; IPEDS Data Collection Deadlines

attributes.name: first_generation_headcount
attributes.description: Count of students who are the first in their immediate family to attend a postsecondary institution as of the census date. Used for equity reporting, Title III/V grant compliance, and student success program targeting.
attributes.references: U.S. Department of Education Title III/V; IPEDS Equity in Athletics; Institutional Equity Reporting

attributes.name: fte_count
attributes.description: Full-Time Equivalent enrollment count calculated by dividing total credit hours by the standard full-time credit hour load (typically 15 for undergraduates, 12 for graduate). Used for state funding formulas, IPEDS FTE reporting, and institutional benchmarking via NACUBO.
attributes.references: IPEDS 12-Month Enrollment Survey — FTE; NACUBO; U.S. Department of Education FTE Methodology

attributes.name: ftiac_headcount
attributes.description: Count of students who have never previously attended any postsecondary institution, enrolling for the first time in this term. FTIAC is a key IPEDS metric and is used for cohort-based retention and graduation rate calculations.
attributes.references: IPEDS Glossary — First-Time Student; U.S. Department of Education Graduation Rate Survey

attributes.name: full_time_headcount
attributes.description: Count of students enrolled full-time as of the census date. Full-time is defined as 12+ credit hours for undergraduates and 9+ for graduate students per IPEDS standards.
attributes.references: IPEDS Fall Enrollment Survey — Full-Time Headcount; U.S. Department of Education

attributes.name: graduate_fte
attributes.description: FTE count for graduate students only, calculated as total graduate credit hours divided by 12 (standard full-time load). Used for state funding formula submissions and IPEDS graduate FTE reporting.
attributes.references: IPEDS 12-Month Enrollment Survey — Graduate FTE; State Funding Formula

attributes.name: headcount
attributes.description: Total unduplicated student headcount as of the census date for the specified level, attendance type, and residency combination. Each student is counted once regardless of the number of courses enrolled. Primary metric for IPEDS headcount reporting.
attributes.references: IPEDS Fall Enrollment Survey — Headcount; U.S. Department of Education

attributes.name: headcount_variance
attributes.description: Difference between current term headcount and prior term headcount (headcount minus prior_term_headcount). Stored as a pre-computed field on the frozen census record for regulatory submission packages and executive dashboards. Positive values indicate enrollment growth.
attributes.references: IPEDS Trend Reporting; HLC Criteria for Accreditation — Institutional Effectiveness

attributes.name: hybrid_headcount
attributes.description: Count of students enrolled in some but not all distance education courses (hybrid/blended modality) as of the census date. Required for IPEDS distance education breakdown reporting.
attributes.references: IPEDS Fall Enrollment Survey — Distance Education; U.S. Department of Education

attributes.name: in_state_headcount
attributes.description: Count of students classified as in-state residents as of the census date. Used for state funding formula submissions and tuition revenue analysis.
attributes.references: State Higher Education Finance (SHEF) Reporting; IPEDS Residency Reporting

attributes.name: institution_code
attributes.description: Reference to the institution or campus unit for which this census record applies. Supports multi-campus reporting.
attributes.references: IPEDS Institutional Characteristics Survey; Ellucian Banner STVCAMP

attributes.name: instructional_method
attributes.description: Delivery modality breakdown for this census record. IPEDS requires separate reporting of exclusively distance education, some distance education, and no distance education enrollments.
attributes.references: IPEDS Distance Education Definition; U.S. Department of Education Program Integrity Rules

attributes.name: international_headcount
attributes.description: Count of students classified as international (non-immigrant visa holders) as of the census date. Used for IPEDS reporting, visa compliance tracking, and international enrollment strategy.
attributes.references: IPEDS Fall Enrollment Survey — Residency; SEVIS Reporting; U.S. Department of Homeland Security

attributes.name: new_student_headcount
attributes.description: Count of students enrolling for the first time at this institution in this term, including First-Time-In-Any-College (FTIAC) and transfer students. Used for cohort tracking and IPEDS first-time student reporting.
attributes.references: IPEDS Fall Enrollment Survey — First-Time Students; FTIAC Definition

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes recorded by institutional research staff regarding anomalies, adjustments, or contextual information about this census snapshot (e.g., late registration extensions, system corrections, natural disaster impacts on enrollment).

attributes.name: online_exclusive_headcount
attributes.description: Count of students enrolled exclusively in distance education (online) courses as of the census date. Required for IPEDS distance education reporting and accreditation submissions.
attributes.references: IPEDS Fall Enrollment Survey — Distance Education; U.S. Department of Education Program Integrity

attributes.name: out_of_state_headcount
attributes.description: Count of students classified as out-of-state residents as of the census date. Used for tuition revenue analysis and enrollment mix reporting.
attributes.references: State Higher Education Finance (SHEF) Reporting; IPEDS Residency Reporting

attributes.name: part_time_headcount
attributes.description: Count of students enrolled part-time as of the census date. Part-time is defined as fewer than 12 credit hours for undergraduates and fewer than 9 for graduate students per IPEDS standards.
attributes.references: IPEDS Fall Enrollment Survey — Part-Time Headcount; U.S. Department of Education

attributes.name: pell_eligible_headcount
attributes.description: Count of students who are Pell Grant eligible as of the census date. Used for financial aid reporting, Title IV compliance, and institutional equity analytics.
attributes.references: U.S. Department of Education Title IV; FAFSA (Free Application for Federal Student Aid); IPEDS Student Financial Aid Survey

attributes.name: prior_term_headcount
attributes.description: Official headcount from the equivalent prior-year term census record. Stored on this record to enable direct year-over-year variance calculation without requiring a self-join. Populated during census finalization.
attributes.references: IPEDS Trend Analysis; Institutional Research Benchmarking; NACUBO

attributes.name: readmit_headcount
attributes.description: Count of students who previously attended this institution, stopped out for at least one term, and have been readmitted and are enrolling in the current term.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner SGASTDN Student Type; IPEDS Enrollment Reporting

attributes.name: reporting_level
attributes.description: Granularity level at which this census record is aggregated. Institution-level records represent total unduplicated headcount; college/department/program levels represent sub-unit breakdowns.
attributes.references: IPEDS Enrollment by Level; NACUBO Reporting Standards

attributes.name: residency_status
attributes.description: Residency classification for this census record. Drives state funding formula allocations, tuition revenue projections, and IPEDS enrollment by residency reporting.
attributes.references: IPEDS Fall Enrollment Survey — Residency; State Higher Education Finance (SHEF) Reporting

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Operational system of record from which this census data was extracted. Typically Ellucian Banner SIS for enrollment counts. Supports data lineage and reconciliation.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner SIS; Databricks Lakehouse Data Lineage Standards

attributes.name: stem_headcount
attributes.description: Count of students enrolled in Science, Technology, Engineering, and Mathematics (STEM) designated programs as of the census date. Used for STEM reporting to NSF, NIH, and institutional diversity/pipeline analytics.
attributes.references: NSF STEM Education Reporting; DHS STEM OPT Extension Eligibility; CIP STEM Designation List

attributes.name: student_level
attributes.description: Academic level of students included in this census record. Used for IPEDS unduplicated headcount reporting by level and state funding formula calculations.
attributes.references: IPEDS Glossary — Student Level; U.S. Department of Education Title IV

attributes.name: transfer_headcount
attributes.description: Count of students who previously attended another postsecondary institution and are enrolling at this institution for the first time in this term. Used for transfer cohort tracking and IPEDS reporting.
attributes.references: IPEDS Fall Enrollment Survey — Transfer Students; U.S. Department of Education

attributes.name: undergraduate_fte
attributes.description: FTE count for undergraduate students only, calculated as total undergraduate credit hours divided by 15 (standard full-time load). Used for state funding formula submissions and IPEDS undergraduate FTE reporting.
attributes.references: IPEDS 12-Month Enrollment Survey — Undergraduate FTE; State Funding Formula

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this census record was last modified in the data platform. Used to detect revisions and support incremental ETL processing in the Silver Layer.
attributes.references: FERPA Data Stewardship; Databricks Lakehouse Audit Standards

attributes.name: veteran_headcount
attributes.description: Count of students who are veterans or active-duty military personnel as of the census date. Required for VA education benefit compliance reporting and institutional veteran services planning.
attributes.references: U.S. Department of Veterans Affairs Education Benefits; IPEDS Military/Veteran Enrollment Reporting

products.name: student_term_record
products.description: Aggregate enrollment record summarizing a student's academic standing and enrollment status for a specific term. Captures enrollment status (full-time/part-time/less-than-half-time), total credit hours attempted, total credit hours earned, term GPA, cumulative GPA, academic standing (good standing/probation/suspension/dismissal), class level (freshman/sophomore/junior/senior/graduate), primary program of study, residency classification, and SAP (Satisfactory Academic Progress) status. Sourced from Banner SGBSTDN and SHRTTRM. Serves as the per-term academic summary for a student.

attributes.name: student_term_record_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the student term record in the Silver Layer lakehouse. Primary key for this aggregate enrollment summary entity.

attributes.name: academic_program_id
attributes.description: Reference to the student's primary program of study for this term as declared in the Student Information System (SIS). Drives degree audit and accreditation reporting.

attributes.name: accreditation_review_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.accreditation_review. Business justification: Student outcome data (retention, progression, graduation rates) is core evidence for accreditation self-studies. Accreditation coordinators tag cohorts of student records to specific review cycles for

attributes.name: aid_sap_evaluation_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to aid.sap_evaluation. Business justification: SAP evaluations assess term-by-term academic progress (GPA, completion rate, max timeframe). Operational link for aid eligibility determination, academic standing holds, and financial aid warning/susp

attributes.name: campus_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to facility.campus. Business justification: Term enrollment records track campus attendance for each academic period. IPEDS enrollment reporting, state funding formulas, and campus-level enrollment census require this link. Campus_code denormal

attributes.name: instructor_id
attributes.description: Reference to the primary academic advisor assigned to the student for this term. Used for advisor caseload reporting, early alert workflows, and retention intervention tracking.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner SGBSTDN; NACADA Advising Standards

attributes.name: profile_id
attributes.description: Reference to the student master record. Corresponds to Banner PIDM (Person Identification Master) — the internal system-of-record identifier for the student.

attributes.name: term_id
attributes.description: Reference to the academic term for which this enrollment summary applies (e.g., Fall 2024, Spring 2025). Drives all term-scoped calculations.

attributes.name: academic_standing
attributes.description: Student's academic standing at the end of the term as determined by institutional GPA and credit completion thresholds. Governs financial aid eligibility, registration holds, and institutional intervention programs.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner SHRTTRM; HLC Criteria for Accreditation; SACSCOC Standards

attributes.name: academic_year
attributes.description: Academic year in which this term falls, formatted as YYYY-YYYY (e.g., 2024-2025). Used for annual IPEDS reporting, financial aid year alignment, and institutional analytics.
attributes.references: IPEDS Glossary; U.S. Department of Education

attributes.name: athlete_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the student is a varsity athlete participating in an NCAA-sanctioned sport. Required for NCAA eligibility certification, academic progress rate (APR) reporting, and athletic scholarship compliance.
attributes.references: NCAA Division I/II/III Bylaws; NCAA Academic Progress Rate (APR)

attributes.name: attendance_type
attributes.description: Primary mode of instructional delivery for the student's enrollment in this term. Drives Distance Education reporting for IPEDS, state authorization compliance, and financial aid eligibility for online programs.
attributes.references: IPEDS Distance Education; U.S. Department of Education; HEA §101

attributes.name: banner_pidm
attributes.description: Ellucian Banner internal Person Identification Master (PIDM) number. The authoritative cross-module identifier linking student records across Banner modules (Registration, Financial Aid, Academic History, Student Accounts).
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner SPRIDEN; FERPA 34 CFR Part 99

attributes.name: cip_code
attributes.description: Six-digit Classification of Instructional Programs (CIP) code identifying the student's primary field of study for this term. Required for IPEDS completions reporting, STEM designation, and federal financial aid program eligibility.
attributes.references: NCES CIP 2020; IPEDS; U.S. Department of Education

attributes.name: class_level
attributes.description: Student's class level classification for the term based on cumulative credit hours earned and degree program. Used for course eligibility, financial aid packaging, and IPEDS enrollment reporting. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: freshman|sophomore|junior|senior|graduate|doctoral|professional|post-baccalaureate|non-degree — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: cohort_code
attributes.description: Institutional cohort identifier assigned to the student (e.g., FTIAC Fall 2022, Transfer Fall 2023). Used for cohort-based retention, graduation rate tracking, and IPEDS Graduation Rate Survey reporting.
attributes.references: IPEDS Graduation Rate Survey; U.S. Department of Education

attributes.name: college_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the academic college or school within the institution to which the student's primary program belongs for this term (e.g., CAS = College of Arts and Sciences, COB = College of Business). Used for college-level enrollment reporting and accreditation (AACSB, ABET).

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this student term record was first created in the Silver Layer lakehouse, typically populated during the end-of-term Banner SHRTTRM extract. Supports data lineage and audit trail requirements.
attributes.references: Institutional Data Governance Policy; FERPA 34 CFR Part 99

attributes.name: credit_hours_attempted
attributes.description: Total credit hours (CR) the student attempted during the term, including courses with grades of W (withdrawal), F, and D. Used as the denominator in SAP pace calculation and enrollment intensity classification.

attributes.name: credit_hours_earned
attributes.description: Total credit hours successfully completed (earned) during the term with a passing grade. Used in SAP pace/completion rate calculation and cumulative progress toward degree.

attributes.name: cumulative_credit_hours_attempted
attributes.description: Total cumulative credit hours attempted by the student across all terms at the institution as of the end of this term. Used for SAP maximum timeframe evaluation and class level determination.

attributes.name: cumulative_credit_hours_earned
attributes.description: Total cumulative credit hours earned by the student across all terms at the institution as of the end of this term. Used for degree audit, graduation eligibility, and class level classification.

attributes.name: cumulative_gpa
attributes.description: Student's cumulative Grade Point Average (GPA) across all terms at the institution as of the end of this term. Primary metric for academic standing, graduation eligibility, honors designation, and SAP qualitative standard evaluation.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner SHRTTRM; FERPA 34 CFR Part 99; AACRAO

attributes.name: degree_type
attributes.description: Type of degree or credential the student is pursuing in their primary program for this term. Used for IPEDS completions, financial aid program eligibility, and accreditation reporting. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: AA|AS|AAS|BA|BS|BFA|BBA|MA|MS|MBA|MFA|MEd|PhD|EdD|JD|MD|DNP|certificate|non-degree — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: IPEDS Completions Survey; U.S. Department of Education

attributes.name: department_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the academic department associated with the student's primary program for this term. Used for departmental enrollment analytics and faculty workload planning.

attributes.name: dfw_count
attributes.description: Count of courses in which the student received a D grade, F grade, or Withdrawal (W) during the term. The DFW rate is a key institutional retention and academic success metric used in accreditation reporting and early alert systems.
attributes.references: HLC Criteria for Accreditation; SACSCOC; Institutional Effectiveness Standards

attributes.name: enrollment_status
attributes.description: Student's enrollment intensity classification for the term based on credit hours attempted. Drives financial aid eligibility (Title IV), SAP evaluation, and IPEDS FTE reporting. Values align with U.S. Department of Education enrollment intensity definitions.
attributes.references: U.S. Department of Education Title IV; IPEDS; 34 CFR §668.2

attributes.name: financial_aid_applicant_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the student submitted a FAFSA (Free Application for Federal Student Aid) or institutional aid application for this term. Used to link enrollment records to financial aid packaging and SAP evaluation workflows.
attributes.references: FAFSA; 34 CFR §668; U.S. Department of Education Title IV

attributes.name: first_generation_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the student is a first-generation college student (neither parent holds a bachelor's degree). Used for Title III/IV reporting, TRIO program eligibility, and institutional equity analytics.
attributes.references: Higher Education Act Title IV; TRIO Programs; IPEDS

attributes.name: fte_value
attributes.description: Student's Full-Time Equivalent (FTE) value for the term, calculated as credit hours attempted divided by the full-time credit hour threshold (typically 12 for undergraduate, 9 for graduate). Used for state funding formulas, IPEDS FTE reporting, and institutional resource planning.
attributes.references: IPEDS Glossary; U.S. Department of Education; NACUBO

attributes.name: ftiac_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the student is a First-Time-In-Any-College (FTIAC) student. Required for IPEDS 12-Month Enrollment and Graduation Rate surveys and federal cohort default rate calculations.
attributes.references: IPEDS; U.S. Department of Education; 34 CFR §668

attributes.name: international_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the student holds a non-immigrant visa status (e.g., F-1, J-1) for this term. Drives SEVIS reporting requirements, international student services, and IPEDS international student enrollment counts.
attributes.references: SEVIS (Student and Exchange Visitor Information System); DHS; IPEDS

attributes.name: last_date_of_attendance
attributes.description: The last date on which the student attended class or participated in an academically related activity during the term. Required for Return to Title IV (R2T4) calculations when a student withdraws and for federal financial aid compliance.
attributes.references: 34 CFR §668.22 Return to Title IV (R2T4); U.S. Department of Education

attributes.name: quality_points_cumulative
attributes.description: Total cumulative grade quality points earned across all terms at the institution as of the end of this term. Used as the numerator in cumulative GPA calculation.

attributes.name: quality_points_term
attributes.description: Total grade quality points earned during the term, calculated as the sum of (grade points × credit hours) for each course. Used as the numerator in term GPA calculation.

attributes.name: registration_hold_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the student has an active registration hold at the time of this term record snapshot. Holds may be academic (probation), financial (outstanding balance), or administrative. Used for enrollment management and student services workflows.

attributes.name: residency_classification
attributes.description: Student's tuition residency classification for the term as determined by the institution's residency policy. Drives tuition rate assessment, state funding formulas, and IPEDS residency reporting.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner SGBSTDN; State Higher Education Finance Policy

attributes.name: sap_status
attributes.description: Satisfactory Academic Progress (SAP) status for the term as required by Title IV federal financial aid regulations. Evaluates qualitative (GPA), quantitative (pace/completion rate), and maximum timeframe standards. Determines continued financial aid eligibility.
attributes.references: 34 CFR §668.34; U.S. Department of Education Title IV SAP

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Operational system of record from which this student term record was sourced. Primarily Ellucian Banner (SGBSTDN/SHRTTRM) for enrollment domain. Supports data lineage and ETL audit in the lakehouse.

attributes.name: student_level
attributes.description: Broad academic level of the student for the term (undergraduate, graduate, professional, doctoral, non-degree). Distinct from class level — drives tuition rate schedules, financial aid programs, and accreditation reporting.

attributes.name: term_gpa
attributes.description: Student's Grade Point Average (GPA) calculated for the current term only, based on quality points earned divided by credit hours attempted with grade points. Protected under FERPA. Used for academic standing determination and Dean's List eligibility.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner SHRTTRM; FERPA 34 CFR Part 99; AACRAO

attributes.name: transfer_credit_hours_accepted
attributes.description: Total credit hours accepted from prior institutions via transfer credit evaluation. Included in cumulative hours for degree audit and class level but may be excluded from institutional GPA calculation per policy.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner SHRTTRM; AACRAO Transfer Credit Practices

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this student term record was last updated in the Silver Layer lakehouse, reflecting grade changes, academic standing recalculations, or SAP status updates post-term.
attributes.references: Institutional Data Governance Policy; FERPA 34 CFR Part 99

attributes.name: veteran_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the student is a veteran or active-duty military member. Drives VA education benefits processing (GI Bill), Yellow Ribbon Program eligibility, and veteran services reporting.
attributes.references: 38 U.S.C. Chapter 33 (Post-9/11 GI Bill); VA School Certifying Official

attributes.name: visa_type
attributes.description: Non-immigrant visa classification for international students. Required for SEVIS compliance reporting and determination of financial aid eligibility. Null for domestic students. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: F-1|J-1|M-1|H-1B|H-4|O-1|domestic|other — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: withdrawal_count
attributes.description: Number of courses from which the student officially withdrew during the term. Distinct from DFW count — used for financial aid Return to Title IV (R2T4) calculations and enrollment intensity adjustments.

products.name: registration_hold
products.description: Records holds placed on a student's account that restrict registration activity. Captures hold type (financial, academic, advising, immunization, library, judicial), hold description, originating office, date placed, date released, release reason, hold severity, and restriction scope (blocks registration, transcript, graduation, or combination). Sourced from Banner SPRHOLD. Critical for enforcing prerequisite compliance, financial clearance, and advising mandates before registration opens. Supports batch hold processing and automated release workflows.

attributes.name: registration_hold_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each registration hold record in the Silver Layer lakehouse. Primary key for this entity.

attributes.name: ada_accommodation_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.ada_accommodation. Business justification: Registration holds may be placed pending ADA accommodation documentation or released once accommodations are approved. Disability services and registrar offices use this link to coordinate hold manage

attributes.name: athletic_eligibility_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to athletics.athletic_eligibility. Business justification: Ineligible student-athletes must be blocked from registration until eligibility is restored. This link enables automated hold placement when eligibility certification fails (GPA, progress-toward-degre

attributes.name: primary_registration_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the staff user or system process that released the hold. Supports accountability and audit trail requirements under FERPA.

attributes.name: profile_id
attributes.description: Reference to the student whose account carries this hold. Links to the student master record.

attributes.name: term_id
attributes.description: Academic term during which this hold is active or was placed. Used to scope hold enforcement to a specific enrollment cycle.

attributes.name: academic_standing_trigger
attributes.description: Academic standing condition that triggered an academic hold, if applicable (e.g., probation, suspension, dismissal). Null or 'none' for non-academic hold types. Supports Satisfactory Academic Progress (SAP) compliance reporting.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner SGASTDN / U.S. Department of Education SAP Requirements (34 CFR 668.34)

attributes.name: advising_requirement_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the specific advising mandate that must be fulfilled to release an advising hold (e.g., NEWSTUDENT, PROBATION, MAJOR_CHANGE, PREREQ_REVIEW). Null for non-advising hold types.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner SGAADVR / Institutional Advising Policy

attributes.name: appeal_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the student has filed a formal appeal to contest or request waiver of this hold.

attributes.name: appeal_status
attributes.description: Current status of the student's appeal against this hold. Null if no appeal has been filed.

attributes.name: banner_pidm
attributes.description: Ellucian Banner internal Person Identification Master number uniquely identifying the individual across all Banner modules. Required for cross-module joins in the source system.

attributes.name: blocks_enrollment_verification
attributes.description: Indicates whether this hold prevents the issuance of enrollment verification letters or certifications to third parties such as employers or insurance providers.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner SPRHOLD / National Student Clearinghouse

attributes.name: blocks_financial_aid
attributes.description: Indicates whether this hold prevents disbursement of financial aid funds or processing of financial aid awards. Relevant for Title IV compliance.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner SPRHOLD / U.S. Department of Education Title IV

attributes.name: blocks_graduation
attributes.description: Indicates whether this hold prevents the student from applying for graduation or having a degree conferred.

attributes.name: blocks_registration
attributes.description: Indicates whether this hold prevents the student from adding, dropping, or modifying course registrations. Core enforcement flag for the registration workflow.

attributes.name: blocks_transcript
attributes.description: Indicates whether this hold prevents the release of official or unofficial academic transcripts to the student or third parties.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this registration hold record was first created in the Silver Layer lakehouse. Supports audit trail and data lineage requirements.
attributes.references: FERPA (20 U.S.C. § 1232g); Enterprise Data Governance Policy

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the outstanding balance amount (e.g., USD). Defaults to USD for domestic institutions.

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: Date on which the hold automatically expires if not manually released. Null indicates the hold has no automatic expiration and requires manual release. Corresponds to Banner SPRHOLD_TO_DATE.

attributes.name: hold_description
attributes.description: Free-text narrative describing the specific reason for the hold, resolution steps required, or additional context provided by the originating office. Displayed to students and advisors.

attributes.name: hold_notes
attributes.description: Internal staff notes providing additional context about the hold, resolution history, or special circumstances. Not displayed to students. Supports case management and inter-office communication.

attributes.name: hold_number
attributes.description: Externally visible alphanumeric identifier for this hold record as assigned by the originating office or Banner. Used for student-facing communications and staff lookup.

attributes.name: hold_severity
attributes.description: Severity level indicating how strictly the hold is enforced. 'hard' blocks the restricted action entirely; 'soft' generates a warning but allows the action to proceed; 'informational' is advisory only with no system enforcement.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner SPRHOLD / Institutional Registration Policy

attributes.name: hold_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the hold. 'active' means the hold is currently enforced; 'released' means it has been cleared; 'expired' means it lapsed past its end date without manual release; 'pending' means it is queued but not yet enforced; 'suspended' means temporarily paused.

attributes.name: hold_type_code
attributes.description: Standardized code classifying the category of hold (e.g., FI=Financial, AC=Academic, AD=Advising, IM=Immunization, LB=Library, JD=Judicial, HO=Housing, IN=Insurance). Drives enforcement rules and routing. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: FI|AC|AD|IM|LB|JD|HO|IN|OT — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: hold_type_description
attributes.description: Human-readable label for the hold type code (e.g., 'Financial Hold', 'Academic Hold', 'Advising Hold'). Sourced from the Banner STVHOLD validation table.

attributes.name: is_auto_release_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether this hold is eligible for automated release when the triggering condition is resolved (e.g., balance paid, immunization record received). Drives automated release workflow processing.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner SPRHOLD / Institutional Registration Policy

attributes.name: is_automated
attributes.description: Indicates whether the hold was placed by an automated batch process (True) or manually by a staff member (False). Supports workflow auditing and distinguishes system-generated from human-initiated holds.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner SPRHOLD / Institutional Registration Policy

attributes.name: notification_date
attributes.description: Date on which the student was notified of the hold via email, student portal, or other communication channel.

attributes.name: notification_sent_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a notification has been sent to the student informing them of the hold placement and required resolution steps.

attributes.name: originating_office_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the institutional office or department that placed the hold (e.g., BURSAR, REGISTRAR, ADVISING, LIBRARY, HEALTH, JUDICIAL). Determines which office must authorize release.

attributes.name: originating_office_name
attributes.description: Full name of the institutional office or department that placed the hold (e.g., 'Bursar Office', 'Office of the Registrar', 'Academic Advising Center').

attributes.name: outstanding_balance_amount
attributes.description: Dollar amount of the outstanding financial obligation that triggered or is associated with a financial hold. Applicable primarily to bursar/financial holds. Null for non-financial hold types.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner TBRACCD / NACUBO Financial Reporting Standards

attributes.name: placed_date
attributes.description: Calendar date on which the hold was placed on the student account. Represents the principal business event date for this transaction.

attributes.name: placed_timestamp
attributes.description: Precise date and time when the hold was placed, including timezone offset. Used for audit trails and batch processing sequencing.

attributes.name: release_reason_code
attributes.description: Standardized code indicating why the hold was released (e.g., PAID=Balance paid, ADVMEET=Advising meeting completed, IMMCOMP=Immunization records complete, APPEAL=Appeal approved, AUTO=Automated batch release). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: PAID|ADVMEET|IMMCOMP|APPEAL|AUTO|WAIVER|ADMIN — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner SPRHOLD / Institutional Registration Policy

attributes.name: release_reason_description
attributes.description: Free-text narrative explaining the specific circumstances under which the hold was released. Complements the release reason code with additional context.

attributes.name: released_date
attributes.description: Calendar date on which the hold was manually or automatically released. Null if the hold is still active.

attributes.name: released_timestamp
attributes.description: Precise date and time when the hold was released, including timezone offset. Supports audit trail and SLA measurement for hold resolution.

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Identifies the originating system or process that created this hold record (e.g., Banner for SIS-generated holds, Batch for automated nightly processes, Manual for staff-entered holds, API for integration-sourced holds).
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner SPRHOLD / Enterprise Data Governance Policy

attributes.name: source_system_record_code
attributes.description: The native record identifier from the originating source system (e.g., Banner SPRHOLD sequence key). Enables lineage tracing and reconciliation between the lakehouse Silver Layer and the system of record.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner SPRHOLD / Enterprise Data Governance Policy

attributes.name: student_acknowledged_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the student has acknowledged receipt and awareness of the hold through the student self-service portal or other acknowledgment mechanism.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this registration hold record was last modified in the Silver Layer lakehouse. Used for incremental ETL processing and change data capture.
attributes.references: FERPA (20 U.S.C. § 1232g); Enterprise Data Governance Policy

products.name: registration_override
products.description: Documents authorized exceptions granted to allow a student to bypass a registration restriction such as a prerequisite, co-requisite, time conflict, capacity limit, or major restriction. Captures override type, granting authority (advisor/department chair/registrar), override date, justification notes, expiration date, and approval status. Provides an auditable trail of all registration exceptions for compliance and academic integrity purposes.
products.reference: Banner Registration Override / Permission to Register

attributes.name: registration_override_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the registration override record. Primary key.

attributes.name: course_section_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the course section for which the override is granted.

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the staff member or faculty who granted the override.

attributes.name: enrollment_registration_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to enrollment.registration. Business justification: Registration override is granted and then used during a specific registration transaction. The used_date attribute indicates when the override was applied. This FK links the override to the registrati

attributes.name: profile_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the student receiving the registration override.

attributes.name: term_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the academic term in which the override applies.

attributes.name: academic_year
attributes.description: Academic year in which the override applies (e.g., 2023-2024).

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: Date the override was officially approved by the authorizing party.

attributes.name: approval_timestamp
attributes.description: Precise timestamp when the override approval was recorded in the system.

attributes.name: capacity_override_count
attributes.description: Number of seats being added beyond the section enrollment capacity limit.

attributes.name: condition_description
attributes.description: Description of any conditions or requirements the student must meet to use the override.

attributes.name: corequisite_course_code
attributes.description: Course code of the corequisite requirement being waived, if applicable.

attributes.name: course_number
attributes.description: Catalog course number within the subject (e.g., 101, 2050, 4999).

attributes.name: course_reference_number
attributes.description: Banner Course Reference Number uniquely identifying the course section within the term.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the override record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: denial_reason
attributes.description: Explanation provided when an override request is denied.

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: Date after which the override is no longer valid and cannot be used for registration.

attributes.name: granting_authority_type
attributes.description: Role or position type of the individual authorized to grant this override.

attributes.name: granting_department_code
attributes.description: Code of the academic department or administrative unit that authorized the override.

attributes.name: granting_user_name
attributes.description: Full name of the staff member or faculty who granted the override.

attributes.name: is_conditional
attributes.description: Indicates whether the override is subject to additional conditions or requirements.

attributes.name: is_one_time_use
attributes.description: Indicates whether the override can only be used once or is reusable within the validity period.

attributes.name: justification_notes
attributes.description: Detailed explanation or rationale for granting the registration override.

attributes.name: level_restriction_code
attributes.description: Code of the student classification or level restriction being waived (e.g., freshman, sophomore, graduate).

attributes.name: major_restriction_code
attributes.description: Code of the major or program restriction being waived.

attributes.name: override_number
attributes.description: Human-readable reference number assigned to the override for tracking and audit purposes.

attributes.name: override_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the override request or authorization.

attributes.name: override_type
attributes.description: Category of registration restriction being overridden. attributes.name: prerequisite_course_code
attributes.description: Course code of the prerequisite requirement being waived, if applicable.

attributes.name: request_date
attributes.description: Date the student or advisor initiated the override request.

attributes.name: restriction_code
attributes.description: System code identifying the specific registration restriction being overridden.

attributes.name: restriction_description
attributes.description: Human-readable description of the registration restriction that was overridden.

attributes.name: revocation_reason
attributes.description: Explanation provided when an approved override is subsequently revoked.

attributes.name: revoked_date
attributes.description: Date the override was revoked or withdrawn before use.

attributes.name: section_number
attributes.description: Section identifier for the course offering (e.g., 001, A, LAB).

attributes.name: source_system

attributes.name: source_system_record_code

attributes.name: student_banner_code

attributes.name: subject_code

attributes.name: time_conflict_course_code
attributes.description: Course code of the conflicting section for which the time conflict is being overridden.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp

products.name: restriction
products.description: Defines rules that restrict or control enrollment in a course section, including major restrictions, class-level restrictions (sophomore and above), college restrictions, degree restrictions, cohort restrictions, and population-based reserved seating (e.g., honors program, athletes, veterans). Captures restriction type, restriction value, restriction scope, effective term, and override eligibility. Sourced from Banner SSRRESV and SSRRSTS tables.

attributes.name: restriction_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the enrollment restriction record. Primary key.

attributes.name: course_section_id
attributes.description: Reference to the course section to which this restriction applies.

attributes.name: identity_account_id
attributes.description: User ID of the staff member who created this restriction record. Used for audit and accountability.

attributes.name: restriction_corequisite_course_id
attributes.description: Reference to a corequisite course that must be taken concurrently for enrollment eligibility. Used when restriction enforces corequisite enrollment.

attributes.name: restriction_prerequisite_course_id
attributes.description: Reference to a prerequisite course that must be completed for enrollment eligibility. Used when restriction enforces prerequisite completion.

attributes.name: updated_by_user_identity_account_id
attributes.description: User ID of the staff member who last updated this restriction record. Used for audit and accountability.

attributes.name: applies_to_waitlist
attributes.description: Indicates whether this restriction also applies to waitlist enrollment. If false, ineligible students may join the waitlist even if they cannot register directly.

attributes.name: attribute_code
attributes.description: Student attribute code when restriction_type is 'attribute'. References institutional student attribute classifications.

attributes.name: class_level_minimum
attributes.description: Minimum class standing required for enrollment when restriction_type is 'class_level'. Values: FR (Freshman), SO (Sophomore), JR (Junior), SR (Senior), GR (Graduate).

attributes.name: cohort_code
attributes.description: Cohort identifier when restriction_type is 'cohort'. Used for cohort-based programs and special populations.

attributes.name: college_code
attributes.description: College or school code when restriction_type is 'college'. Identifies the academic college unit.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this restriction record was created in the system.

attributes.name: credit_hours_minimum
attributes.description: Minimum cumulative credit hours earned required for enrollment eligibility. Used for progression-based restrictions.

attributes.name: degree_code
attributes.description: Degree type code when restriction_type is 'degree' (e.g., BA, BS, MS, MBA, PHD).

attributes.name: department_code
attributes.description: Academic department code when restriction_type is 'department'. Identifies the departmental unit.

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: Date when the restriction expires and no longer controls enrollment eligibility. Null indicates no expiration.

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: Date when the restriction becomes active and begins to control enrollment eligibility.

attributes.name: gpa_minimum
attributes.description: Minimum cumulative GPA required for enrollment eligibility. Used for academic performance-based restrictions.

attributes.name: major_code
attributes.description: Four-character major code when restriction_type is 'major'. References institutional major classification.

attributes.name: message
attributes.description: User-facing message displayed when a student attempts to register but does not meet the restriction criteria. Provides guidance on eligibility requirements.

attributes.name: override_authority_level
attributes.description: Minimum authority level required to override this restriction. Null or 'none' if override_eligible is false.

attributes.name: override_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether this restriction can be overridden by authorized personnel (registrar, advisor, department chair) to allow enrollment of otherwise ineligible students.

attributes.name: permission_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether explicit instructor or department permission is required for enrollment in addition to meeting restriction criteria.

attributes.name: population_code
attributes.description: Special population code when restriction_type is 'population' (e.g., HONORS, ATHLETE, VETERAN, INTERNATIONAL).

attributes.name: priority_rank
attributes.description: Numeric rank defining the order in which multiple restrictions are evaluated for a course section. Lower numbers indicate higher priority.

attributes.name: program_code
attributes.description: Academic program code when restriction_type is 'program'. Identifies specific degree program.

attributes.name: release_date
attributes.description: Date when reserved seats are released to the general population if not filled by eligible students. Used for time-based seat release strategies.

attributes.name: reserved_seat_count
attributes.description: Number of seats reserved for the specified population when restriction_scope is 'reserved'. Null for include/exclude restrictions.

attributes.name: reserved_seat_used_count
attributes.description: Number of reserved seats currently occupied by eligible students. Tracks utilization of reserved capacity.

attributes.name: restriction_code
attributes.description: Institutional code identifying the specific restriction rule (e.g., MAJOR, LEVEL, COLLEGE, COHORT, HONORS).

attributes.name: restriction_description
attributes.description: Human-readable description of the restriction rule and its purpose. Displayed to students and advisors during registration.

attributes.name: restriction_scope
attributes.description: Defines whether the restriction includes only specified populations (include), excludes specified populations (exclude), or reserves seats for specified populations (reserved).

attributes.name: restriction_status
attributes.description: Current operational status of the restriction rule.

attributes.name: restriction_type
attributes.description: Category of restriction applied to the course section enrollment. Defines the dimension along which enrollment is controlled. products.name: cross_list_group
products.description: Manages cross-listed course sections where multiple sections (often from different departments or academic levels) share a combined enrollment pool and meet together in the same room at the same time. Captures cross-list group identifier, maximum combined enrollment, current combined enrollment, primary section designator, and participating section references. Ensures accurate seat availability reporting across linked sections and prevents double-counting in official enrollment headcounts and FTE calculations.

attributes.name: primary_cross_course_section_id

attributes.name: room_id

attributes.name: available_seats

attributes.name: cross_list_type

attributes.name: current_enrollment

products.name: concurrent_enrollment
products.description: Records students enrolled simultaneously at this institution and another institution under formal agreements. Covers dual enrollment (high school students taking college courses), consortium agreements (financial aid coordination across institutions), and visiting student arrangements. Captures home/host institution, enrollment type, credit hours at each institution, combined FTE for financial aid purposes, consortium agreement reference, and National Student Clearinghouse reporting flags. Supports Title IV financial aid eligibility determination and FERPA-compliant cross-institutional data sharing.

Good standing indicates satisfactory progress; probation indicates below-standard performance; suspension indicates temporary removal; dismissal indicates permanent removal; warning indicates at-risk status.

attributes.name: agreement_number

attributes.references: Title IV Federal Student Aid Regulations 34 CFR 668.5

attributes.name: agreement_type
attributes.description: Type of formal agreement between institutions. Consortium agreements coordinate financial aid; articulation agreements facilitate credit transfer; dual credit covers high school partnerships; exchange covers student exchange programs; reciprocal allows mutual course access; visiting covers temporary enrollment arrangements.

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: Date when the concurrent enrollment arrangement was officially approved by both institutions. Required for audit trail and compliance verification.

attributes.name: approved_by_home

attributes.name: approved_by_host

attributes.name: combined_credit_hours
attributes.description: Total credit hours across both home and host institutions. Critical for Title IV financial aid eligibility determination and enrollment intensity classification.

attributes.name: combined_fte
attributes.description: Combined Full-Time Equivalent enrollment status calculated across both institutions. Used for financial aid eligibility, enrollment reporting, and satisfactory academic progress (SAP) determination. Typically 1.0 = full-time, 0.5 = half-time.

attributes.name: created_timestamp

attributes.name: credit_transfer_status
