attributes.name: appeal_submitted_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the student submitted a formal SAP appeal following a suspension or warning status. True if appeal was submitted; false otherwise.

attributes.name: comments
attributes.description: Additional notes, comments, or documentation related to the SAP evaluation, appeal decision, or special circumstances considered by the evaluator.

attributes.name: completion_rate_percentage
attributes.description: The student's pace of progression, calculated as (cumulative earned credits / cumulative attempted credits) * 100. Federal regulation requires minimum 67% completion rate.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this SAP evaluation record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: cumulative_credits_attempted
attributes.description: Total number of credit hours the student has attempted in the program as of this evaluation, including withdrawals, incompletes, and failed courses.

attributes.name: cumulative_credits_earned
attributes.description: Total number of credit hours the student has successfully completed (passed) in the program as of this evaluation.

attributes.name: cumulative_gpa
attributes.description: The student's cumulative GPA at the time of this SAP evaluation, calculated across all attempted coursework in the program.

attributes.name: evaluation_date
attributes.description: The date on which the Satisfactory Academic Progress evaluation was performed. Typically occurs at the end of a term or payment period.

attributes.name: evaluation_type
attributes.description: The type or trigger of the SAP evaluation: end of term, payment period checkpoint, annual review, mid-term check, appeal review, or reinstatement evaluation.

attributes.name: financial_aid_eligibility_status
attributes.description: The student's Title IV financial aid eligibility status resulting from this SAP evaluation: eligible (meeting standards), ineligible (suspended), or conditional (probation with academic plan).

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this SAP evaluation record was last updated or modified in the system.

attributes.name: maximum_credits_allowed
attributes.description: The maximum number of credit hours the student may attempt to complete the program, calculated as 150% of the published program length per federal regulation.

attributes.name: maximum_timeframe_status
attributes.description: Status of the maximum timeframe measure. Within_limit indicates the student can complete the program within 150% of published length; exceeded indicates the student cannot.

attributes.name: minimum_completion_rate_required
attributes.description: The minimum completion rate percentage required by the institution's SAP policy. Federal regulation mandates at least 67%.

attributes.name: minimum_gpa_required
attributes.description: The minimum cumulative GPA required by the institution's SAP policy for the student's program and academic level at the time of evaluation.

attributes.name: notification_method
attributes.description: The method by which the SAP evaluation results were communicated to the student: email, postal mail, student portal message, in-person meeting, or phone call.

attributes.name: notification_sent_date
attributes.description: The date on which the institution notified the student of their SAP evaluation results and financial aid eligibility status.

attributes.name: overall_sap_status
attributes.description: The overall Satisfactory Academic Progress status resulting from this evaluation: meeting standards, warning (first failure), suspension (ineligible for aid), probation (on academic plan after appeal), dismissed, or reinstated.

attributes.name: prior_sap_status
attributes.description: The student's SAP status from the immediately preceding evaluation period, used to determine progression through warning, suspension, and probation stages. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: meeting|warning|suspension|probation|dismissed|reinstated|first_evaluation — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: program_published_length
attributes.description: The published length of the student's academic program in credit hours, used as the basis for calculating the 150% maximum timeframe.

attributes.name: qualitative_measure_status
attributes.description: Status of the qualitative measure (cumulative GPA requirement). Pass indicates the student meets the minimum cumulative GPA threshold; fail indicates below threshold.

attributes.name: quantitative_measure_status
attributes.description: Status of the quantitative measure (pace/completion rate requirement). Pass indicates the student meets the minimum 67% completion rate; fail indicates below threshold.

products.name: loan_record
products.description: Master record for each student loan originated under the institution's financial aid programs, including Direct Subsidized, Direct Unsubsidized, Direct PLUS (Parent and Grad), and Perkins loans. Tracks loan type, loan period, loan amount, origination date, MPN (Master Promissory Note) status, entrance counseling completion, loan servicer, interest rate, and origination fee. SSOT for student loan origination data. Sourced from Ellucian Banner Loan Processing and COD (Common Origination and Disbursement).

attributes.name: loan_record_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the student loan record. Primary key for the loan_record product.
attributes.references: Federal Student Aid COD Technical Reference

attributes.name: aid_award_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to aid.award. Business justification: loan_record is a specialized tracking record for student loans, which are a type of financial aid award. The loan_record should reference the parent award record in the general aid system. This allows

attributes.name: ar_invoice_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.ar_invoice. Business justification: Institutional loans (Perkins, emergency, short-term) generate AR invoices when repayment begins. Loan principal becomes a receivable tracked through student AR system. Essential for loan servicing, co

attributes.name: mpn_id
attributes.description: The unique identifier for the Master Promissory Note under which this loan was originated. An MPN can cover multiple loans over multiple years.
attributes.references: 34 CFR 685.204; Federal Student Aid MPN Requirements

attributes.name: parent_borrower_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the parent borrower if this is a Direct PLUS Parent loan. Links to the parent/guardian record. Null for student-borrowed loans.
attributes.references: FERPA; Ellucian Banner Financial Aid Module

attributes.name: profile_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the student borrower receiving this loan. Links to the student master record in the Student Information System (SIS).

attributes.name: regulatory_requirement_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.regulatory_requirement. Business justification: Each loan type (Direct Subsidized, Unsubsidized, PLUS) has specific HEA Title IV regulatory requirements for eligibility, annual/aggregate limits, interest rates, and origination fees. Essential for C

attributes.name: student_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to billing.student_account. Business justification: Loan proceeds credit student accounts when disbursed. Billing systems track which loans have posted to calculate net balance, generate accurate statements, determine refund eligibility, and manage acc

attributes.name: academic_year
attributes.description: The academic year for which the loan was originated, in format YYYY-YYYY (e.g., 2023-2024). Used for reporting and cohort analysis.
attributes.references: IPEDS Reporting Standards; Federal Student Aid Handbook

attributes.name: aggregate_loan_balance
attributes.description: The student's total outstanding loan balance across all prior loans at the time of this loan origination, in USD. Used to verify the student has not exceeded aggregate limits.
attributes.references: 34 CFR 685.203; Federal Student Aid COD Technical Reference

attributes.name: aggregate_loan_limit
attributes.description: The maximum cumulative loan amount the student is eligible to borrow across all years, in USD. Varies by dependency status, grade level, and loan type.
attributes.references: 34 CFR 685.203; Federal Student Aid Annual and Aggregate Loan Limits

attributes.name: anticipated_disbursement_date
attributes.description: The expected date for loan disbursement as reported to COD at origination. Used for planning and student account projections.
attributes.references: Federal Student Aid COD Technical Reference

attributes.name: award_year
attributes.description: The federal award year (July 1 - June 30) for which the loan was packaged and originated, in format YYYY-YYYY. Critical for Title IV compliance and COD reporting.

attributes.name: borrower_type
attributes.description: Identifies the type of borrower for this loan. STUDENT=undergraduate student borrower (Direct Subsidized/Unsubsidized), PARENT=parent borrower (Direct PLUS Parent), GRADUATE_STUDENT=graduate/professional student borrower (Direct Unsubsidized or PLUS Grad).

attributes.name: cancellation_date
attributes.description: The date on which the loan was cancelled, if applicable. Null if the loan was not cancelled.
attributes.references: Federal Student Aid COD Technical Reference

attributes.name: cancellation_reason_code
attributes.description: The reason code for loan cancellation, if applicable. STUDENT_REQUEST=student requested cancellation, ELIGIBILITY_CHANGE=student became ineligible, ENROLLMENT_CHANGE=student dropped below half-time, DUPLICATE=duplicate loan record, OTHER=other reason.
attributes.references: Federal Student Aid COD Technical Reference

attributes.name: coa_amount
attributes.description: The total Cost of Attendance for the loan period, in USD. Includes tuition, fees, room, board, books, supplies, transportation, and personal expenses. Used to determine loan eligibility.

attributes.name: cod_accepted_date
attributes.business_glossary_term: Common Origination and Disbursement (COD) Accepted Date
attributes.description: The date on which the loan record was accepted by the COD system. Confirms federal approval for loan origination and disbursement.
attributes.references: Federal Student Aid COD Technical Reference

attributes.name: cod_transaction_number
attributes.business_glossary_term: Common Origination and Disbursement (COD) Transaction Number
attributes.description: The unique transaction identifier assigned by the COD system for this loan origination or disbursement. Used for reconciliation and audit trails.
attributes.references: Federal Student Aid COD Technical Reference

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this loan record was first created in the Student Information System. Used for audit trail and data lineage.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner Audit Standards; Institutional Data Governance Policy

attributes.name: credit_check_passed_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether the borrower (parent or graduate student) passed the credit check required for PLUS loans. Not applicable to Direct Subsidized or Unsubsidized loans. True=passed, False=failed or not applicable.
attributes.references: 34 CFR 685.200; Federal Student Aid PLUS Loan Requirements

attributes.name: dependency_status
attributes.description: Indicates whether the student is classified as dependent or independent for federal financial aid purposes. Determines loan eligibility and annual limits.

attributes.name: disbursement_date
attributes.description: The date on which the net loan amount was disbursed (credited) to the student's account. May differ from origination date due to processing delays or scheduled disbursement dates.
attributes.references: 34 CFR 668.164; Federal Student Aid COD Technical Reference

attributes.name: disbursement_number
attributes.description: The sequence number of this disbursement within the loan period (e.g., 1 for first disbursement, 2 for second). Federal loans are typically disbursed in multiple installments per academic year.
attributes.references: 34 CFR 668.164; Federal Student Aid COD Technical Reference

attributes.name: efc_amount
attributes.description: The Expected Family Contribution calculated from the FAFSA for the award year, in USD. Used to determine financial need and subsidized loan eligibility. Replaced by SAI (Student Aid Index) starting 2024-2025.
attributes.references: 34 CFR 668.2; FAFSA Processing; Federal Student Aid Handbook

attributes.name: endorser_required_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether an endorser (co-signer) is required for a PLUS loan due to adverse credit history. True=endorser required, False=not required.
attributes.references: 34 CFR 685.200; Federal Student Aid PLUS Loan Requirements

attributes.name: enrollment_status
attributes.description: The student's enrollment intensity at the time of loan origination. Affects loan eligibility and disbursement amounts.

attributes.name: entrance_counseling_completed_date
attributes.description: The date on which the student completed entrance counseling, a federal requirement for first-time borrowers. Must be completed before first disbursement.
attributes.references: 34 CFR 685.304; Federal Student Aid Counseling Requirements

attributes.name: financial_need_amount
attributes.description: The calculated financial need for the loan period (COA minus EFC and other aid), in USD. Determines eligibility for subsidized loans.

attributes.name: grade_level
attributes.description: The student's academic grade level at the time of loan origination. Determines annual and aggregate loan limits. UG=Undergraduate, GRAD=Graduate, PROFESSIONAL=Professional (e.g., law, medicine).

attributes.name: gross_loan_amount
attributes.description: The total loan amount before any fees are deducted, in USD. This is the principal amount the student is authorized to borrow.
attributes.references: 34 CFR 685.203; Federal Student Aid COD Technical Reference

attributes.name: interest_rate
attributes.description: The annual interest rate applied to the loan, expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.045 for 4.5%). Rate is fixed at origination and varies by loan type and award year.
attributes.references: 34 CFR 685.202; Federal Student Aid Interest Rate Tables

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this loan record was last updated in the Student Information System. Used for audit trail and change tracking.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner Audit Standards; Institutional Data Governance Policy

attributes.name: loan_number
attributes.description: Externally-known unique loan identifier assigned by the institution or federal system. Used for tracking and reporting to COD (Common Origination and Disbursement) and loan servicers.
attributes.references: Federal Student Aid COD Technical Reference

attributes.name: loan_period_begin_date
attributes.description: The first date of the academic period (term or payment period) for which the loan is intended to cover costs. Used for COA (Cost of Attendance) and eligibility calculations.

attributes.name: loan_period_end_date
attributes.description: The last date of the academic period (term or payment period) for which the loan is intended to cover costs. Defines the effective-until boundary for the loan period.

attributes.name: loan_servicer_code
attributes.description: The code identifying the federal loan servicer assigned to manage this loan after disbursement (e.g., MOHELA, Nelnet, Great Lakes). Used for borrower communication and repayment tracking.
attributes.references: Federal Student Aid Loan Servicer Directory

attributes.name: loan_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the loan record. ORIGINATED=loan has been originated but not yet disbursed, DISBURSED=funds have been released to student account, CANCELLED=loan was cancelled before disbursement, RETURNED=disbursed funds were returned, ADJUSTED=loan amount or terms were adjusted post-origination.
attributes.references: Federal Student Aid COD Technical Reference

attributes.name: loan_type_code
attributes.description: Classification of the loan product. SUB=Direct Subsidized Loan, UNSUB=Direct Unsubsidized Loan, PLUS_PARENT=Direct PLUS Loan for Parents, PLUS_GRAD=Direct PLUS Loan for Graduate Students, PERKINS=Federal Perkins Loan, PRIVATE=Private/Alternative Loan.
attributes.references: Federal Student Aid Loan Programs; 34 CFR Part 685

attributes.name: mpn_signed_date
attributes.description: The date on which the student (or parent for PLUS loans) signed the Master Promissory Note. Required before loan disbursement.
attributes.references: 34 CFR 685.204; Federal Student Aid MPN Requirements

attributes.name: net_loan_amount
attributes.description: The actual loan amount disbursed to the student after origination fees are deducted (gross_loan_amount minus origination_fee_amount), in USD.
attributes.references: 34 CFR 685.203; Federal Student Aid COD Technical Reference

attributes.name: nslds_reported_date
attributes.business_glossary_term: National Student Loan Data System (NSLDS) Reported Date
attributes.description: The date on which this loan record was reported to the National Student Loan Data System. Required for federal compliance and borrower loan history tracking.

attributes.name: origination_date
attributes.description: The date on which the loan was officially originated and the borrower became legally obligated. This is the principal business event timestamp for the loan record.
attributes.references: 34 CFR 685.203; Federal Student Aid COD Technical Reference

attributes.name: origination_fee_amount
attributes.description: The federal origination fee deducted from the gross loan amount, in USD. Fee percentage varies by loan type and award year.
attributes.references: 34 CFR 685.202; Federal Student Aid Fee Schedule

attributes.name: subsidized_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether the loan is subsidized (government pays interest during in-school, grace, and deferment periods). True for Direct Subsidized Loans, False for all other loan types.

attributes.name: term_code
attributes.description: The academic term code (e.g., FALL2023, SPR2024) during which the loan was originated. Links to the institutional term calendar.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner Term Module; Institutional Academic Calendar

products.name: scholarship
products.description: Master catalog record for institutionally administered and externally sourced scholarships and grants, including merit-based, need-based, departmental, endowed, and outside/private scholarships. Captures scholarship name, funding source, eligibility criteria, renewable flag, renewal criteria, maximum award amount, donor/organization for external awards, and coordination rules for need-based aid packaging. SSOT for the institutional scholarship catalog and external scholarship registry.

attributes.name: scholarship_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the scholarship record. Primary key for the scholarship catalog.

attributes.name: academic_program_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to curriculum.academic_program. Business justification: Scholarships commonly restrict eligibility by academic program—donor-funded scholarships often specify major requirements, departmental scholarships target specific programs, and scholarship administr

attributes.name: aid_fund_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to aid.aid_fund. Business justification: Scholarships that are administered as institutional funds should reference the aid_fund record. This links the scholarship catalog entry to the fund accounting record. Note: scholarship already has en

attributes.name: concentration_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to curriculum.concentration. Business justification: Some scholarships target specific concentrations within programs (e.g., "Cybersecurity Concentration Scholarship" within Computer Science program). While less common than program-level restrictions, c

attributes.name: endowment_id
attributes.description: Foreign key reference to the endowment fund that supports this scholarship, if applicable. Links to the institutional endowment management system.

attributes.name: ledger_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.ledger_account. Business justification: Scholarships post to specific GL revenue or expense accounts based on fund source (endowed, annual, restricted). Required for fund accounting, donor stewardship reporting, and financial statement prep

attributes.name: policy_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.policy. Business justification: Institutional scholarships must be governed by documented policies defining eligibility criteria, selection process, renewal terms, and coordination rules. Policy reference ensures consistent administ

attributes.name: research_award_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to research.research_award. Business justification: Research training grants (NIH T32, NSF fellowships, etc.) provide student stipends administered as scholarships. Financial aid office must track the originating research award for federal reporting (I

attributes.name: student_org_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to studentlife.student_org. Business justification: Many scholarships are restricted to members of specific student organizations (Greek life scholarships, club-specific awards, honor society scholarships). Business process: Scholarship eligibility ver

attributes.name: academic_level
attributes.description: Academic level or degree program for which the scholarship is available. Restricts eligibility to undergraduate, graduate, doctoral, professional, or postdoctoral students, or allows any level.

attributes.name: application_deadline
attributes.description: Final date by which students must submit scholarship applications or supporting materials to be considered for the award cycle.

attributes.name: application_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether students must submit a separate scholarship application to be considered, or if the scholarship is automatically awarded based on admission or FAFSA data.

attributes.name: award_notification_date
attributes.description: Date on which scholarship recipients are notified of their award. Used for planning financial aid packaging timelines and student communication.

attributes.name: class_standing
attributes.description: Specific class year or standing required for scholarship eligibility. May restrict awards to incoming freshmen, continuing sophomores, juniors, seniors, or graduate students.

attributes.name: contact_email
attributes.description: Email address for scholarship inquiries and administration. Organizational contact data classified as confidential.

attributes.name: contact_name
attributes.description: Name of the institutional staff member, department, or external organization contact responsible for administering the scholarship and answering student inquiries.

attributes.name: contact_phone
attributes.description: Phone number for scholarship inquiries and administration. Organizational contact data classified as confidential.

attributes.name: coordination_rule
attributes.description: Rule governing how this scholarship interacts with other financial aid in the student's award package. Determines whether the scholarship is stackable with other aid, reduces need-based aid, replaces loans, replaces work-study, or has no coordination requirements.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the scholarship record was first created in the system. Audit field for data lineage and compliance.

attributes.name: donor_organization_name
attributes.description: Name of the individual donor, corporation, foundation, or organization that established or funds the scholarship. Critical for external and endowed scholarships for stewardship and recognition purposes.

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: Date on which the scholarship program ends or is no longer available for new awards. Null for perpetual endowed scholarships or ongoing programs.

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: Date on which the scholarship becomes available for awarding. Marks the beginning of the scholarship program's active period.

attributes.name: eligibility_criteria
attributes.description: Comprehensive description of all eligibility requirements for the scholarship, including academic qualifications, demographic criteria, residency requirements, major or program restrictions, financial need thresholds, and any other donor-specified or institutional criteria.

attributes.name: endowment_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the scholarship is funded by an endowment with perpetual principal and annual earnings distribution, as opposed to annual or one-time funding.

attributes.name: funding_source
attributes.description: Origin of the scholarship funds. Indicates whether the scholarship is funded by the institution, federal government, state government, private donor, corporation, foundation, alumni association, or endowment. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: institutional|federal|state|private|corporate|foundation|alumni|endowment — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: major_restriction
attributes.description: Academic major, program, or field of study required for scholarship eligibility. May specify a single major, a list of eligible majors, or a broad discipline such as STEM (Science Technology Engineering Mathematics) or business.

attributes.name: maximum_award_amount
attributes.description: Maximum dollar amount that can be awarded to a single recipient per academic year or term. Used in financial aid packaging to cap individual awards.

attributes.name: maximum_years_awarded
attributes.description: Maximum number of academic years a student may receive this scholarship, including initial award and renewals. Typically 4 for undergraduate scholarships, variable for graduate programs.

attributes.name: merit_based_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the scholarship is awarded based on academic merit, standardized test scores, or other achievement criteria independent of financial need.

attributes.name: minimum_award_amount
attributes.description: Minimum dollar amount that must be awarded if the scholarship is granted. Ensures awards meet donor or program requirements for minimum funding levels.

attributes.name: minimum_credit_hours
attributes.description: Minimum number of credit hours per term that a student must be enrolled in to be eligible for or retain the scholarship. Typically used to enforce full-time or half-time enrollment requirements.

attributes.name: minimum_gpa
attributes.description: Minimum cumulative or term GPA required for initial eligibility or renewal of the scholarship. Expressed on a 4.0 scale.

attributes.name: need_based_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the scholarship requires demonstrated financial need as determined by FAFSA (Free Application for Federal Student Aid) and EFC (Expected Family Contribution) calculations.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for internal administrative notes, special instructions, donor preferences, or historical context about the scholarship program. Not visible to students.

attributes.name: renewable_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the scholarship can be renewed for multiple academic years if the recipient continues to meet eligibility criteria.

attributes.name: renewal_criteria
attributes.description: Detailed description of the academic, enrollment, and behavioral requirements a student must maintain to renew the scholarship for subsequent years. May include minimum GPA, credit hour requirements, major continuation, and Satisfactory Academic Progress (SAP) standards.

attributes.name: reporting_category
attributes.description: Classification of the scholarship for IPEDS (Integrated Postsecondary Education Data System) and other regulatory reporting purposes. Aligns with federal financial aid reporting categories.

attributes.name: residency_requirement
attributes.description: Geographic or residency restrictions for scholarship eligibility, such as state residency, county of origin, or international student status. May specify in-state, out-of-state, or specific geographic regions.

attributes.name: scholarship_code
attributes.description: Externally-known unique code or identifier for the scholarship used in financial aid packaging and student communications. Business identifier for the scholarship.

attributes.name: scholarship_name
attributes.description: Full official name of the scholarship or grant program as it appears in institutional publications and award letters.

attributes.name: scholarship_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the scholarship. Indicates whether the scholarship is actively available for awarding, temporarily suspended, permanently discontinued, or pending approval for activation.

attributes.name: scholarship_type
attributes.description: Classification of the scholarship by its primary awarding criteria and funding structure. Distinguishes merit-based, need-based, departmental, endowed, external/private, athletic, diversity, research, and service scholarships. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: merit|need_based|departmental|endowed|external|athletic|diversity|research|service — 9 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: taxable_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the scholarship is considered taxable income under IRS regulations. Scholarships used for room, board, or non-qualified expenses may be taxable.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the scholarship record was last modified. Audit field for tracking changes to scholarship terms, funding, or eligibility criteria.

attributes.name: website_url
attributes.description: Web address for additional scholarship information, application instructions, and donor recognition. May link to institutional financial aid portal or external scholarship provider site.

products.name: r2t4_calculation
products.description: Return to Title IV (R2T4) calculation record triggered when a student withdraws from all courses during a payment period. Captures withdrawal date, last date of attendance, percentage of payment period completed, earned aid amount, unearned aid to be returned, institutional share, student share, return deadline, and completion status. SSOT for Title IV R2T4 compliance. Sourced from Ellucian Banner R2T4 module.

attributes.name: r2t4_calculation_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Return to Title IV (R2T4) Calculation ID
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the R2T4 calculation record. Primary key.
attributes.references: 34 CFR 668.22 - Treatment of Title IV Aid When a Student Withdraws

attributes.name: aid_year_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the financial aid year in which the withdrawal occurred.

attributes.name: journal_entry_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.journal_entry. Business justification: Return of Title IV calculations create journal entries to reverse aid revenue and establish federal liabilities. Federal regulation 34 CFR 668.22 requires proper accounting of returned funds. Critical

attributes.name: original_calculation_r2t4_calculation_id
attributes.description: Reference to the original R2T4 calculation record if this is a recalculation. Null if this is the initial calculation.

attributes.name: primary_r2t4_employee_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the financial aid staff member who performed or initiated the R2T4 calculation.

attributes.name: profile_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the student who withdrew and triggered the R2T4 calculation.
attributes.references: FERPA - Family Educational Rights and Privacy Act

attributes.name: regulatory_requirement_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.regulatory_requirement. Business justification: R2T4 calculations must follow 34 CFR 668.22 precisely, including percentage calculation methodology, post-withdrawal disbursement rules, and return allocation order. Regulatory reference is mandatory

attributes.name: student_athlete_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to athletics.student_athlete. Business justification: Return of Title IV calculations for withdrawn student-athletes require coordination with athletic compliance to determine impact on athletic scholarship, eligibility clock, and seasons of competition.

attributes.name: studentlife_housing_assignment_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to studentlife.housing_assignment. Business justification: Return of Title IV calculations must include institutional charges for housing and prorated refunds based on actual housing assignment dates. Business process: R2T4 institutional charges component req

attributes.name: term_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the academic term (payment period) in which the withdrawal occurred.

attributes.name: calculation_method
attributes.description: Method used for the R2T4 calculation based on the program structure: standard (credit-hour term-based), modular (courses not spanning entire term), or nonstandard term (non-traditional calendar).
attributes.references: 34 CFR 668.22(d) - Percentage of Title IV Aid Earned

attributes.name: calculation_number
attributes.description: Business identifier for the R2T4 calculation, typically formatted as aid year, term, and sequence number for audit and tracking purposes.

attributes.name: calculation_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the R2T4 calculation process.

attributes.name: calculation_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the R2T4 calculation was performed or last recalculated.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this R2T4 calculation record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for all monetary amounts in this calculation. Typically USD for U.S. Title IV aid.

attributes.name: days_completed
attributes.description: Number of calendar days the student completed in the payment period before withdrawing, calculated from payment period start date to withdrawal date.
attributes.references: 34 CFR 668.22(e)(1) - Percentage of Payment Period Completed

attributes.name: determination_date
attributes.description: Date the institution determined that the student withdrew. This date triggers the 45-day return deadline and is critical for compliance timing.

attributes.name: grant_protection_amount
attributes.description: Amount of grant aid protected from return under the 50% grant protection rule. Students are not required to return grant overpayments if the amount is 50% or less of total grants received.

attributes.name: institutional_charges
attributes.description: Total institutional charges (tuition, fees, room, board) assessed to the student for the payment period, used to calculate the institutional share of unearned aid to be returned.

attributes.name: institutional_return_amount
attributes.description: Amount of unearned Title IV aid the institution is responsible for returning to the Department of Education, calculated based on institutional charges and unearned aid.
attributes.references: 34 CFR 668.22(g) - Responsibility for Return of Title IV Funds

attributes.name: last_date_of_attendance
attributes.description: Last documented date the student attended an academically-related activity. Used when the institution is required to take attendance.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this R2T4 calculation record was last modified in the system.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes documenting special circumstances, exceptions, or additional context related to the R2T4 calculation for audit and compliance purposes.

attributes.name: payment_period_days
attributes.description: Total number of calendar days in the payment period, calculated as the difference between payment period end date and start date.
attributes.references: 34 CFR 668.22(e)(1) - Percentage of Payment Period Completed

attributes.name: payment_period_end_date
attributes.description: End date of the payment period (typically the term end date) used to calculate the percentage of the period completed.

attributes.name: payment_period_start_date
attributes.description: Start date of the payment period (typically the term start date) used to calculate the percentage of the period completed.

attributes.name: percentage_completed
attributes.description: Percentage of the payment period the student completed before withdrawing, calculated as (days completed / payment period days) * 100. Capped at 60% per federal regulation.
attributes.references: 34 CFR 668.22(e)(1) - Percentage of Payment Period Completed

attributes.name: post_withdrawal_disbursement_amount
attributes.description: Amount of Title IV aid the student earned but was not yet disbursed at the time of withdrawal. The institution must offer this to the student within regulatory timeframes.

attributes.name: recalculation_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this calculation is a recalculation of a previously completed R2T4 calculation, typically due to corrected data or audit findings.

attributes.name: return_completed_date
attributes.description: Date the institution completed the return of unearned Title IV funds to the Department of Education.
attributes.references: 34 CFR 668.22(j) - Timeframe for Return of Title IV Funds

attributes.name: return_deadline_date
attributes.description: Deadline by which the institution must return unearned Title IV funds to the Department of Education, typically 45 days from the date the institution determined the student withdrew.
attributes.references: 34 CFR 668.22(j) - Timeframe for Return of Title IV Funds

attributes.name: review_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the R2T4 calculation was reviewed and approved.

attributes.name: sixty_percent_rule_applied
attributes.description: Indicates whether the 60% rule was applied. If a student completes more than 60% of the payment period, they earn 100% of Title IV aid and no return is required.

attributes.name: student_return_amount
attributes.description: Amount of unearned Title IV aid the student is responsible for returning, calculated as total unearned aid minus institutional return amount.
attributes.references: 34 CFR 668.22(g) - Responsibility for Return of Title IV Funds

attributes.name: total_title_iv_aid_disbursed

attributes.name: benefit_percentage
attributes.description: The percentage of full benefit entitlement the student is eligible to receive, ranging from 0.00 to 100.00. For Post-9/11 GI Bill, determined by length of active duty service (e.g., 90 days = 40%, 36 months = 100%).

attributes.name: benefit_status

Active = currently receiving benefits, Pending = application submitted awaiting approval, Suspended = temporarily paused, Terminated = ended by student or institution, Exhausted = all benefit entitlement used, Denied = application rejected by VA.

attributes.name: book_stipend_amount
attributes.description: The annual book and supplies stipend amount the student is eligible to receive under Post-9/11 GI Bill (CH33). Typically $1,000 per academic year, prorated based on training time and benefit percentage. Not applicable for other benefit chapters.

attributes.name: certificate_of_eligibility_number

attributes.name: certification_date
attributes.description: The date on which the School Certifying Official (SCO) certified the student's enrollment to the VA for the current term. Required for VA payment processing and compliance tracking.

attributes.name: certified_credit_hours
attributes.description: The number of credit hours certified to the VA for the current enrollment period. Used to determine the student's training time (full-time, three-quarter-time, half-time) and corresponding benefit payment rate.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this veteran benefit record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage tracking.

attributes.name: delimiting_date
attributes.description: The final date by which the student must use their veteran education benefits. For Post-9/11 GI Bill, typically 15 years from the date of last discharge from active duty. After this date, unused benefits expire.

attributes.name: eligibility_begin_date
attributes.description: The date on which the student becomes eligible to receive veteran education benefits under this benefit chapter. Typically corresponds to the service discharge date or eligibility determination date.

attributes.name: eligibility_end_date
attributes.description: The date on which the student's eligibility for veteran education benefits expires. For Post-9/11 GI Bill (CH33), typically 15 years from last discharge date. Null if no expiration or benefit exhausted before expiration.

True = kicker eligible, False = not eligible. Kicker is an additional benefit on top of standard GI Bill payments.

attributes.name: kicker_monthly_amount
attributes.description: The additional monthly kicker payment amount the student is eligible to receive based on their military service agreement. Null if student is not kicker eligible.

attributes.name: last_certification_change_date

attributes.name: last_certification_change_reason
attributes.description: Description of the reason for the most recent change to the student's enrollment certification. Examples include course withdrawal, program change, enrollment status change, or correction of certification error.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp

attributes.name: last_payment_amount
attributes.description: The dollar amount of the most recent benefit payment disbursed by the VA for this student. Includes tuition, housing allowance, and book stipend components as applicable.

attributes.name: last_payment_date
attributes.description: The date of the most recent benefit payment disbursed by the VA for this student. Used for payment tracking and reconciliation purposes.

attributes.name: monthly_housing_allowance_amount
attributes.description: The monthly housing allowance amount the student is eligible to receive under Post-9/11 GI Bill (CH33). Amount is based on the Basic Allowance for Housing (BAH) rate for an E-5 with dependents at the institution's ZIP code. Not applicable for other benefit chapters.

attributes.name: payment_status
attributes.description: Current status of the VA benefit payment for the certified enrollment period. Pending = certification submitted awaiting VA processing, In Progress = VA processing payment, Paid = payment completed and disbursed, Denied = payment rejected by VA, Suspended = payment temporarily halted.

attributes.name: remaining_entitlement_months
attributes.description: The number of months of benefit entitlement remaining for the student. Typically starts at 36 months for full-time enrollment and decreases based on certified enrollment hours. Tracked to two decimal places for partial month usage.

attributes.description: The amount the Department of Veterans Affairs contributes toward the student's tuition and fees under the Yellow Ribbon Program, matching the institution's contribution. Null if student is not a Yellow Ribbon participant.

products.name: fund_fee_coverage
products.description: This association product represents the coverage rules between financial aid funds and fee schedules. It captures which types of fees each aid fund is authorized to cover, the percentage of coverage allowed, and any dollar limits on that coverage. Each record links one aid fund to one fee schedule with attributes that define the coverage policy for that specific fund-fee combination.. Existence Justification: In higher education financial aid operations, institutions establish coverage rules that define which aid funds are authorized to pay for which fee types. A single aid fund (e.g., Federal Pell Grant) can cover multiple fee categories (tuition, technology fee, health fee), and a single fee type (e.g., tuition) can be covered by multiple funds (Pell, state grant, institutional scholarship). These coverage rules are actively managed by financial aid administrators and include policy attributes such as coverage percentage, dollar limits, and effective dates.

attributes.name: fund_fee_coverage_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for this fund-fee coverage rule. Primary key.

attributes.name: aid_fund_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Fund Fee Coverage - Financialaid Fund Id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the financial aid fund that provides coverage

attributes.name: fee_schedule_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Fund Fee Coverage - Fee Schedule Id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the fee schedule that is eligible for coverage

attributes.name: coverage_percentage
attributes.description: The percentage of the fee that this fund is authorized to cover. For example, 100.00 means full coverage, 50.00 means half coverage. Derived from detection phase relationship_data.

attributes.name: coverage_status
attributes.description: Current operational status of this coverage rule. Controls whether the rule is applied during aid disbursement processing.

attributes.name: created_date
attributes.description: Timestamp when this coverage rule was created in the system.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: The date on which this coverage rule becomes active. Allows for temporal management of coverage policies. Derived from detection phase relationship_data.

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: The date on which this coverage rule ceases to be active. Nullable for open-ended rules. Derived from detection phase relationship_data.

attributes.name: maximum_coverage_amount
attributes.description: The maximum dollar amount this fund will cover for this fee type per student per term, regardless of percentage. Null if no cap applies. Derived from detection phase relationship_data.

attributes.name: modified_date
attributes.description: Timestamp when this coverage rule was last modified.

attributes.name: priority_rank
attributes.description: Numeric rank defining the order in which funds are applied when multiple funds can cover the same fee. Lower numbers indicate higher priority.

products.name: subaward
products.description: Transactional record for a subaward issued to a subrecipient organization under a prime sponsored research award. Captures subaward number, subrecipient organization name, subrecipient DUNS/UEI, subrecipient PI name, subaward type (subcontract, subgrant), total subaward amount, executed amount, period of performance, scope of work summary, monitoring risk level, subrecipient audit requirement (Single Audit threshold), invoicing frequency, payment terms, subaward status (pending, executed, active, closed), and federal flow-down clause applicability. Supports OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200 subrecipient monitoring requirements.

attributes.name: subaward_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the subaward record. Primary key.

attributes.name: audit_finding_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.audit_finding. Business justification: Subaward monitoring generates audit findings per OMB Uniform Guidance 200.332 subrecipient monitoring requirements. Links subaward to findings for risk assessment, corrective action, and pass-through

attributes.name: idc_rate_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to research.idc_rate. Business justification: subaward has indirect_cost_rate which should be normalized via FK to idc_rate master table. Subawards apply specific IDC rates (either the subrecipient's negotiated rate or a rate specified in the pri

attributes.name: institutional_contact_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to hr.employee. Business justification: Subaward monitoring requires institutional liaison for compliance oversight, invoice review, reporting coordination, and subrecipient communication. Essential for post-award office workload distributi

attributes.name: research_award_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent prime sponsored research award under which this subaward is issued.

attributes.name: subrecipient_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to research.subrecipient. Business justification: subaward currently has denormalized subrecipient attributes (organization_name, duns_number, uei). Adding subrecipient_id FK normalizes this relationship and allows joining to the subrecipient master

attributes.name: closeout_date
attributes.description: Date on which the subaward was officially closed out after all financial and administrative requirements were satisfied.

attributes.name: cost_sharing_amount
attributes.description: Total amount of cost sharing or matching funds that the subrecipient has committed to provide, if applicable.

attributes.name: cost_sharing_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether the subrecipient is required to provide cost sharing or matching funds as a condition of the subaward.

attributes.name: created_by_user
attributes.description: Username or identifier of the research administrator who created this subaward record.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this subaward record was first created in the research administration system.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for all monetary amounts in this subaward record (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP).

attributes.name: executed_amount
attributes.description: Amount currently executed and available for expenditure under the subaward. May differ from total amount if incremental funding is used.

attributes.name: execution_date
attributes.description: Date on which the subaward agreement was fully executed by all parties. Represents the official start of the contractual relationship.

attributes.name: federal_award_identification_number
attributes.description: Federal Award Identification Number assigned by the prime sponsor to the parent award. Required for FFATA subaward reporting.
attributes.references: Federal Funding Accountability and Transparency Act (FFATA)

attributes.name: federal_flow_down_clauses_applicable
attributes.description: Indicates whether federal flow-down clauses and requirements from the prime award must be incorporated into the subaward agreement. Typically true for federally-funded subawards.

attributes.name: invoicing_frequency
attributes.description: Frequency at which the subrecipient is permitted to submit invoices for reimbursement or payment under the subaward terms.

attributes.name: modified_by_user
attributes.description: Username or identifier of the research administrator who last modified this subaward record.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this subaward record was last modified in the research administration system.

attributes.name: monitoring_risk_level
attributes.description: Risk assessment level assigned to the subrecipient for monitoring purposes. Determines frequency and intensity of oversight activities required under OMB Uniform Guidance.

attributes.name: payment_terms
attributes.description: Description of the payment terms and conditions, including timing, method, and any advance payment provisions applicable to the subaward.

attributes.name: period_of_performance_end_date
attributes.description: Date on which the subaward period of performance ends. Subrecipient must complete all work and incur all allowable costs by this date.

attributes.name: period_of_performance_start_date
attributes.description: Date on which the subaward period of performance begins. Subrecipient may incur allowable costs starting from this date.

attributes.name: prime_sponsor_name
attributes.description: Name of the federal or non-federal sponsor providing funding for the prime award under which this subaward is issued (e.g., NSF, NIH, DOE).

attributes.name: scope_of_work_summary
attributes.description: High-level summary of the research activities, deliverables, and objectives that the subrecipient is responsible for under this subaward.

attributes.name: single_audit_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether the subrecipient is required to undergo a Single Audit under the OMB Uniform Guidance. Required if subrecipient expends $750,000 or more in federal awards in a fiscal year.
attributes.references: OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200 Subpart F

attributes.name: subaward_number
attributes.description: Externally-known unique identifier for the subaward, typically assigned by the institution's research administration office. Used for tracking and reporting.

attributes.name: subaward_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the subaward. Pending indicates awaiting execution; executed indicates signed but not yet active; active indicates work in progress; suspended indicates temporary hold; closed indicates normal completion; terminated indicates early cancellation.

attributes.name: subaward_type
attributes.description: Classification of the subaward instrument. Distinguishes between subcontracts (procurement), subgrants (assistance), consortium agreements, consultant agreements, vendor agreements, and other arrangements.

attributes.name: subrecipient_address_line1
attributes.description: First line of the subrecipient organization's official mailing address.

attributes.name: subrecipient_address_line2
attributes.description: Second line of the subrecipient organization's official mailing address (suite, building, department).

attributes.name: subrecipient_city
attributes.description: City of the subrecipient organization's official mailing address.

attributes.name: subrecipient_contact_email
attributes.description: Email address of the primary administrative contact at the subrecipient organization.

attributes.name: subrecipient_contact_name
attributes.description: Name of the primary administrative contact at the subrecipient organization for subaward management and compliance matters.

attributes.name: subrecipient_contact_phone
attributes.description: Phone number of the primary administrative contact at the subrecipient organization.

attributes.name: subrecipient_country_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code of the subrecipient organization's location.

attributes.name: subrecipient_pi_email
attributes.description: Primary email address of the subrecipient PI for official communications regarding the subaward.

attributes.name: subrecipient_pi_name
attributes.description: Full name of the Principal Investigator at the subrecipient organization who is responsible for the scientific and technical direction of the subaward project.

attributes.name: subrecipient_postal_code
attributes.description: Postal or ZIP code of the subrecipient organization's official mailing address.

attributes.name: subrecipient_state_province
attributes.description: State or province of the subrecipient organization's official mailing address.

attributes.name: termination_date
attributes.description: Date on which the subaward was terminated prior to the scheduled end date, if applicable.

attributes.name: termination_reason
attributes.description: Explanation of the reason for early termination of the subaward, if applicable. May include convenience, cause, or mutual agreement.

attributes.name: total_subaward_amount
attributes.description: Total obligated amount of the subaward over its entire period of performance, including all modifications and amendments.

products.name: irb_protocol
products.description: Master record for an Institutional Review Board (IRB) protocol governing human subjects research. Captures protocol number, protocol title, PI name, study type (exempt, expedited, full board), review category, approval date, expiration date, protocol status (pending, approved, suspended, closed, expired), subject population description, estimated enrollment, risk level classification, consent waiver status, data safety monitoring requirements, adverse event reporting history, continuing review due date, and Kuali Research IRB protocol ID. Required for OHRP compliance and federal research assurance (FWA) reporting.
products.reference: Kuali Research - IRB Module / 45 CFR 46 (Common Rule)

attributes.name: actual_enrollment
attributes.description: The actual number of human subjects enrolled in the study to date. Updated throughout the study lifecycle.

attributes.name: adverse_event_count
attributes.description: Total number of adverse events reported for this protocol to date. Used for safety monitoring and continuing review.

attributes.name: amendment_count
attributes.description: Total number of amendments or modifications submitted and approved for this protocol since initial approval.

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: Date on which the IRB granted approval for the research protocol to commence. This is the effective start date for the protocol.

attributes.name: clinical_trial_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the protocol is a clinical trial as defined by NIH and FDA. Clinical trials have additional registration and reporting requirements.

attributes.name: clinicaltrials_gov_number
attributes.description: The unique NCT number assigned by ClinicalTrials.gov for clinical trials subject to registration requirements. Required for applicable clinical trials.

attributes.name: closure_date
attributes.description: Date on which the protocol was officially closed by the IRB. Indicates completion of all research activities and final reporting.

attributes.name: college_name
attributes.description: College or school within the institution to which the research protocol is affiliated. Used for institutional reporting and compliance tracking.

attributes.name: consent_waiver_status
attributes.description: Indicates whether the IRB has granted a waiver or alteration of informed consent requirements for this protocol.

attributes.name: continuing_review_due_date
attributes.description: Date by which the PI must submit a continuing review application to maintain active IRB approval. Critical for compliance tracking.
attributes.references: 45 CFR 46.109(e), OHRP Guidance on Continuing Review

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this IRB protocol record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage.

attributes.name: data_safety_monitoring_plan
attributes.description: Description of the data and safety monitoring procedures in place for this protocol, including frequency of monitoring and responsible parties.
attributes.references: NIH Policy on Data and Safety Monitoring, FDA 21 CFR 312

attributes.name: data_safety_monitoring_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether the protocol requires a formal data and safety monitoring plan or Data Safety Monitoring Board (DSMB). Typically required for higher-risk studies.
attributes.references: 45 CFR 46.111, NIH Policy on Data and Safety Monitoring

attributes.name: department_name
attributes.description: Academic department or organizational unit to which the Principal Investigator is affiliated. Used for institutional reporting and resource allocation.

attributes.name: estimated_enrollment
attributes.description: The anticipated total number of human subjects to be enrolled in the research study. Used for risk assessment and resource planning.

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: Date on which the current IRB approval expires. Research activities must cease or continuing review must be completed before this date.

attributes.name: fda_regulated_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Food and Drug Administration (FDA) Regulated Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the research involves FDA-regulated products (drugs, biologics, devices) and is subject to FDA regulations in addition to Common Rule.

attributes.name: funding_source_type
attributes.description: Primary category of funding supporting this research protocol. Determines applicable regulatory requirements and reporting obligations.
attributes.references: 45 CFR 46, NSF Grant Policy Manual, NIH Grants Policy Statement

attributes.name: hipaa_authorization_required
attributes.business_glossary_term: Health Insurance Portability and Accountability Act (HIPAA) Authorization Required
attributes.description: Indicates whether the protocol requires HIPAA authorization for use and disclosure of protected health information (PHI). Applicable to research involving medical records or health data.

attributes.name: initial_approval_date
attributes.description: Date of the very first IRB approval for this protocol. Distinct from approval_date which may reflect a continuing review approval.

attributes.name: irb_of_record
attributes.description: Name of the IRB serving as the single IRB of record for multi-site research. For single-site studies, this is the institutions own IRB.

attributes.name: kuali_research_protocol_number
attributes.description: The unique protocol identifier in the Kuali Research system of record. Used for integration and data lineage tracking.

attributes.name: last_amendment_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent protocol amendment approval. Used for version control and compliance tracking.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent update to this IRB protocol record. Used for audit trail and change tracking.

attributes.name: multi_site_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the research is conducted at multiple sites or institutions. Multi-site studies may use a single IRB of record or require local IRB review at each site.

attributes.name: protocol_number
attributes.description: The externally-known unique protocol number assigned by the IRB office. This is the business identifier used in all communications, submissions, and regulatory reporting.

attributes.name: protocol_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the IRB protocol. Tracks the protocol through submission, review, approval, active research, and closure phases.

attributes.name: protocol_title
attributes.description: The full title of the research study as submitted to the IRB. This is the official name of the research project.

attributes.name: protocol_version_number
attributes.description: Version number of the protocol document. Incremented with each amendment or modification approved by the IRB.

attributes.name: review_category
attributes.description: Specific regulatory category under which the protocol was reviewed (e.g., exempt category 1-8, expedited category 1-9). Provides granular classification within study type.
attributes.references: 45 CFR 46.104, 45 CFR 46.110, Federal Register Vol. 83 No. 21

attributes.name: risk_level
attributes.description: IRB assessment of the level of risk to human subjects participating in the research. Determines review requirements and monitoring intensity.

attributes.name: serious_adverse_event_count
attributes.description: Total number of serious adverse events (SAEs) reported for this protocol. SAEs require expedited reporting to the IRB and sponsor.

attributes.name: study_type
attributes.description: Classification of the research study based on the level of IRB review required. Determines the review pathway and approval authority.

attributes.name: subject_population_description
attributes.description: Narrative description of the human subjects population to be enrolled in the study, including inclusion and exclusion criteria, vulnerable populations, and demographic characteristics.

attributes.name: submission_date
attributes.description: Date on which the protocol was originally submitted to the IRB for review.

attributes.name: vulnerable_population_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the study involves vulnerable populations such as children, prisoners, pregnant women, or cognitively impaired individuals. Triggers additional regulatory protections.

attributes.name: vulnerable_population_types
attributes.description: Specific types of vulnerable populations included in the study (e.g., children, prisoners, pregnant women, economically disadvantaged, cognitively impaired). Pipe-separated list if multiple.

products.name: iacuc_protocol
products.description: Master record for an Institutional Animal Care and Use Committee (IACUC) protocol governing vertebrate animal research. Captures protocol number, title, PI, species used, animal use justification, pain/distress category (USDA categories B-E), approved animal numbers, protocol approval date, expiration date, protocol status, three-year review cycle dates, veterinary oversight assignments, housing location, and AAALAC accreditation relevance. Supports USDA Animal Welfare Act compliance and PHS Policy on Humane Care and Use of Laboratory Animals reporting.

attributes.name: aaalac_accreditation_relevant
attributes.business_glossary_term: Association for Assessment and Accreditation of Laboratory Animal Care (AAALAC) Accreditation Relevant
attributes.description: Indicates whether this protocol is relevant to the institution's AAALAC International accreditation status. AAALAC accreditation is a voluntary peer-review program for animal care and use programs.

attributes.name: alternatives_databases_searched
attributes.description: List of databases and sources consulted during the alternatives search (e.g., PubMed, AGRICOLA, Web of Science). Required documentation for USDA compliance.

attributes.name: alternatives_search_conducted
attributes.description: Indicates whether the PI conducted and documented a search for alternatives to procedures that may cause more than momentary or slight pain or distress. Required by USDA regulations.
attributes.references: USDA Animal Welfare Regulations 2.31(d)(1)(ii); Animal Welfare Act Section 13(a)(3)(B)

attributes.name: alternatives_search_date
attributes.description: The date the alternatives search was conducted. Must be documented for USDA-covered species protocols involving more than momentary pain or distress.

attributes.name: animal_use_justification
attributes.description: The scientific rationale provided by the PI for the use of animals in this research, including justification for the species selected and the number of animals requested. Required element of IACUC protocol review.
attributes.references: PHS Policy IV.C.1.c; USDA Animal Welfare Regulations 2.31(e)(2)

attributes.name: annual_review_date
attributes.description: The date of the most recent annual review or continuing review of the protocol. Some institutions require annual reviews in addition to the mandatory three-year review.

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: The date the IACUC granted approval for the protocol. This is the official start date for the three-year approval period mandated by federal regulations.
attributes.references: PHS Policy IV.C.5; USDA Animal Welfare Regulations 2.31(d)(3)

attributes.name: approved_animal_count
attributes.description: The total number of animals approved for use in this protocol over the three-year approval period. Used for census tracking and regulatory reporting.
attributes.references: USDA Animal Welfare Regulations 2.36(b)(5); PHS Policy IV.C.1.c

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this protocol record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage tracking.

attributes.name: euthanasia_method
attributes.description: The method(s) of euthanasia that will be used for animals in this protocol. Must be consistent with AVMA Guidelines on Euthanasia unless scientifically justified otherwise.
attributes.references: AVMA Guidelines for the Euthanasia of Animals; PHS Policy IV.C.1.g

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: The date the protocol approval expires. Federal regulations require IACUC protocols to be reviewed and re-approved at least once every three years.
attributes.references: PHS Policy IV.C.5; USDA Animal Welfare Regulations 2.31(d)(3)

attributes.name: field_study_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether the protocol involves field studies (research conducted in natural environments outside of laboratory settings). Field studies have different regulatory considerations.
attributes.references: PHS Policy IV.C.1.h; USDA Animal Welfare Regulations 2.31(d)(1)(xi)

attributes.name: funding_source
attributes.description: The sponsor or funding agency supporting the research (e.g., National Science Foundation (NSF), National Institutes of Health (NIH), institutional funds, private foundation). Critical for compliance reporting and grant management.
attributes.references: PHS Policy IV.C.1.b; NIH Grants Policy Statement

attributes.name: hazardous_agents_used

attributes.references: PHS Policy IV.C.1.d; NIH Guidelines for Research Involving Recombinant or Synthetic Nucleic Acid Molecules

attributes.name: last_amendment_date
attributes.description: The date of the most recent approved amendment to the protocol. Used for tracking protocol change history and compliance monitoring.
attributes.references: PHS Policy IV.C.6; USDA Animal Welfare Regulations 2.31(d)(6)

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this protocol record was last modified in the system. Used for audit trail, change tracking, and data quality monitoring.

attributes.name: pain_distress_category
attributes.business_glossary_term: United States Department of Agriculture (USDA) Pain and Distress Category
attributes.description: USDA pain and distress classification for the protocol. Category B: animals being bred, conditioned, or held but not yet used; C: no pain or distress; D: pain or distress with appropriate anesthetics/analgesics; E: pain or distress without relief for scientific necessity.
attributes.references: USDA Animal Welfare Regulations 2.36(b)(6-7); USDA Animal Care Policy Manual

attributes.name: phs_assurance_number
attributes.description: The institution's PHS Assurance number (Animal Welfare Assurance) on file with the Office of Laboratory Animal Welfare (OLAW). Required for PHS-funded research involving vertebrate animals.
attributes.references: PHS Policy IV.A.1.a; OLAW Assurance Requirements

attributes.name: protocol_amendment_count
attributes.description: The number of amendments submitted and approved for this protocol since initial approval. Tracks protocol modifications over its lifecycle.
attributes.references: PHS Policy IV.C.6; USDA Animal Welfare Regulations 2.31(d)(6)

attributes.name: protocol_keywords
attributes.description: Comma-separated keywords or tags describing the research area, procedures, or scientific focus of the protocol. Used for searching, categorization, and reporting.

attributes.name: protocol_number
attributes.description: The externally-known business identifier assigned to the IACUC protocol by the institution. Used for tracking, reporting, and communication with investigators and regulatory bodies.
attributes.references: USDA Animal Welfare Act; PHS Policy; AAALAC International Standards

attributes.name: protocol_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the IACUC protocol. Tracks the protocol from initial submission through approval, active use, and eventual closure or expiration. attributes.references: PHS Policy IV.C; USDA Animal Welfare Regulations 2.31

attributes.name: protocol_title
attributes.description: The full descriptive title of the research protocol as submitted by the Principal Investigator (PI). Describes the nature and purpose of the animal research study.
attributes.references: PHS Policy IV.C.1; USDA Animal Welfare Regulations 2.31

attributes.name: review_type
attributes.description: The type of IACUC review conducted for this protocol. Full Committee Review (FCR) involves the entire IACUC; Designated Member Review (DMR) is conducted by one or more qualified members; Veterinary Verification and Consultation (VVC) is for minor changes.
attributes.references: PHS Policy IV.C.2-4; USDA Animal Welfare Regulations 2.31(d)(2)

attributes.name: species_used
attributes.description: Comma-separated list or description of vertebrate animal species used in the protocol (e.g., mice, rats, rabbits, non-human primates, dogs, cats, pigs). Critical for USDA reporting and animal welfare assessment.
attributes.references: USDA Animal Welfare Regulations 2.31(e)(1); PHS Policy IV.C.1.c

attributes.name: submission_date
attributes.description: The date the protocol was formally submitted to the IACUC for review. Marks the beginning of the regulatory review timeline.
attributes.references: PHS Policy IV.C.2; USDA Animal Welfare Regulations 2.31(d)

attributes.name: survival_surgery_performed
attributes.description: Indicates whether the protocol involves survival surgery (procedures where animals recover from anesthesia). Survival surgeries require enhanced veterinary oversight and aseptic technique.
attributes.references: PHS Policy IV.C.1.f; USDA Animal Welfare Regulations 2.31(d)(1)(x)

attributes.name: three_year_review_date
attributes.description: The scheduled date for the mandatory three-year continuing review of the protocol by the IACUC. Required by federal regulations to ensure ongoing compliance and animal welfare.
attributes.references: PHS Policy IV.C.5; USDA Animal Welfare Regulations 2.31(d)(3)

attributes.name: training_requirements
attributes.description: Description of training requirements for personnel working on this protocol, including species-specific training, procedural training, and occupational health clearances.
attributes.references: PHS Policy IV.A.1.f; USDA Animal Welfare Regulations 2.32

attributes.name: usda_registration_required
attributes.business_glossary_term: United States Department of Agriculture (USDA) Registration Required
attributes.description: Indicates whether this protocol involves USDA-covered species (all warm-blooded animals except rats, mice, and birds bred for research) and therefore requires USDA registration and annual reporting.
attributes.references: USDA Animal Welfare Act Section 2(g); Animal Welfare Regulations 2.30-2.36

attributes.name: veterinary_care_oversight
attributes.description: Description of veterinary oversight and care provisions for animals in this protocol, including attending veterinarian assignment and consultation arrangements.
attributes.references: PHS Policy IV.A.1.c; USDA Animal Welfare Regulations 2.33

Required under OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200.430 for personnel cost documentation on federal awards.

attributes.name: effort_certification_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the effort certification record. Primary key for the effort certification transaction.

attributes.name: award_budget_id

attributes.description: Identifier of the certification period (typically semester or academic year) during which the effort was expended. Links to the certification period reference table.

Auditors trace certified effort to actual course ros

attributes.name: primary_effort_employee_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the employee (faculty, staff, or graduate student) whose effort is being certified. Links to the personnel record in the HR system.

attributes.name: regulatory_requirement_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.regulatory_requirement.
