Direct link required for A-133/Single Audit compliance, questioned cost defense, and federal aud

attributes.name: research_award_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the sponsored research award against which the effort is being certified. Links to the award record in the research administration system.

attributes.name: student_athlete_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to athletics.student_athlete. Business justification: Tracks effort certification for student-athletes employed on research awards. Required for federal compliance (OMB Uniform Guidance), salary cost allocation verification, and ensuring research employm

attributes.name: adjustment_justification
attributes.description: Detailed narrative justification for any significant variance between proposed and certified effort. Required for audit documentation and sponsor reporting.

attributes.name: adjustment_reason_code
attributes.description: Standardized code indicating the reason for any adjustment between proposed and certified effort. Used for audit trail and trend analysis.

attributes.name: appointment_type
attributes.description: Classification of the employee's appointment type at the institution. Determines applicable effort reporting requirements and compensation rules.

attributes.name: approved_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the effort certification was officially approved and finalized. Represents the completion of the certification lifecycle.

attributes.name: certification_comments
attributes.description: Free-text comments or notes provided by the certifier regarding the effort certification. May include explanations, clarifications, or special circumstances.

attributes.name: certification_date
attributes.description: Date on which the effort was officially certified by the authorized individual. Represents the business event timestamp for the certification action.

attributes.name: certification_due_date
attributes.description: Deadline by which the effort certification must be completed to maintain compliance with federal and institutional policies. Typically 90-120 days after period end.

attributes.name: certification_method
attributes.description: Method by which the effort certification was completed. Indicates whether the certification was submitted electronically, on paper, auto-generated by the system, or completed retrospectively.

attributes.name: certification_number
attributes.description: Business identifier for the effort certification transaction, typically formatted as a human-readable reference number for tracking and audit purposes.

attributes.name: certification_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the effort certification. Indicates whether the certification is awaiting review, has been approved, requires adjustment, or has been rejected.

attributes.name: certified_effort_percentage
attributes.description: The actual percentage of the employee's total effort expended on this award during the certification period, as certified by the employee or authorized representative. Expressed as a percentage (e.g., 30.00 for 30%).

attributes.name: certifier_name
attributes.description: Full name of the individual who certified the effort. Captured for audit trail and compliance documentation purposes.

attributes.name: certifier_role
attributes.description: Role of the individual who certified the effort. Indicates the authority level and relationship to the employee whose effort is being certified.

attributes.name: compliance_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator of whether this effort certification meets all federal and institutional compliance requirements. False indicates a compliance issue requiring resolution.

attributes.name: compliance_issue_description
attributes.description: Detailed description of any compliance issues identified with this effort certification, such as late submission, excessive variance, or missing documentation. Null if no issues exist.

attributes.name: cost_shared_fringe_amount
attributes.description: Fringe benefits amount contributed by the institution as cost sharing for this award during the certification period, calculated on the cost-shared salary amount.

attributes.name: cost_shared_salary_amount
attributes.description: Salary amount contributed by the institution as cost sharing or matching funds for this award during the certification period. Represents institutional commitment not charged to the sponsor.

attributes.name: cost_transfer_amount
attributes.description: Dollar amount of the cost transfer required to align charges with certified effort. Positive values indicate charges to be moved to the award; negative values indicate charges to be moved off the award.

attributes.name: cost_transfer_required_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator of whether a cost transfer is required based on the variance between proposed and certified effort. True triggers a financial adjustment workflow.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the effort certification record was first created in the system. Audit trail field for record lifecycle tracking.

attributes.name: effort_variance_percentage
attributes.description: The difference between certified effort and proposed effort, expressed as a percentage. Positive values indicate over-commitment; negative values indicate under-commitment. Used to trigger cost transfer or rebudgeting actions.

attributes.name: federal_agency_code
attributes.description: Standard code identifying the federal agency sponsoring the award (e.g., NSF, NIH, DOE, DOD). Used for federal reporting and compliance tracking. Null for non-federal awards.

attributes.name: fringe_benefits_charged_amount
attributes.description: Total fringe benefits amount charged to the award during the certification period, calculated based on the institution's approved fringe benefit rate applied to the salary charged amount.

attributes.name: institutional_base_salary
attributes.description: The employee's institutional base salary (IBS) during the certification period, used as the denominator for calculating effort percentages. Represents the employee's annual compensation for their primary appointment.

attributes.name: modified_by
attributes.description: Username or identifier of the individual who last modified the effort certification record. Audit trail field for accountability and compliance.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the effort certification record was last modified. Audit trail field for tracking changes and updates to the certification.

attributes.name: period_end_date
attributes.description: End date of the certification period during which the effort was expended. Defines the boundary of the reporting window.

attributes.name: period_start_date
attributes.description: Start date of the certification period during which the effort was expended. Typically aligns with semester or fiscal year boundaries.

attributes.name: pi_approval_date
attributes.description: Date on which the Principal Investigator approved the effort certification. Null if PI approval is not required or has not yet been obtained.

attributes.name: pi_approval_required_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator of whether Principal Investigator approval is required for this effort certification, typically based on institutional policy or variance thresholds.

attributes.name: proposed_effort_percentage
attributes.description: The originally proposed or budgeted percentage of the employee's total effort allocated to this award during the certification period. Expressed as a percentage (e.g., 25.00 for 25%).

attributes.name: salary_charged_amount
attributes.description: Total salary amount charged to the award during the certification period, expressed in the institution's base currency. Represents direct personnel costs allocated to the sponsored project.

attributes.name: sponsor_type
attributes.description: Classification of the funding sponsor for the award. Federal sponsors have the most stringent effort reporting requirements under OMB Uniform Guidance. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: federal|state|local|private|industry|foundation|internal — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: submitted_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the effort certification was initially submitted for review. Captures the moment the certification entered the approval workflow.

attributes.name: total_compensation_amount
attributes.description: Total compensation (salary plus fringe benefits) charged and cost-shared for this employee on this award during the certification period. Sum of all salary and fringe components.

products.name: idc_rate
products.description: Reference record for negotiated Facilities and Administrative (F&A) / Indirect Cost (IDC) rates established between the institution and its federal cognizant agency (typically DHHS or ONR). Captures rate type (on-campus research, off-campus research, instruction, other sponsored activities), rate percentage, applicable base (MTDC - Modified Total Direct Costs), effective start date, effective end date, negotiation agreement date, cognizant federal agency, rate agreement document reference, and predetermined vs. fixed vs. provisional rate designation. Governs IDC recovery calculations on all federal awards.
products.reference: 2 CFR 200 Appendix III / F&A Rate Negotiation Agreement

attributes.name: idc_rate_id
attributes.description: Primary key for idc_rate

attributes.name: prior_rate_agreement_idc_rate_id
attributes.description: Reference to the previous rate agreement that this rate supersedes or replaces. Enables tracking of rate history and changes over time.

attributes.name: administrative_rate_component
attributes.description: The administrative portion of the F&A rate, covering general administration, departmental administration, and sponsored projects administration costs. Typically 26% of the total rate.

attributes.name: applicable_fiscal_year
attributes.description: The institution's fiscal year to which this rate applies. Used for multi-year rate agreements where different rates may apply to different fiscal periods.

attributes.name: approved_by_official
attributes.description: Name and title of the cognizant agency official who approved and signed the rate agreement. Used for verification and audit trail.

attributes.name: carryforward_provision
attributes.description: Description of any carryforward provisions in the rate agreement that allow over- or under-recovery of IDC in one period to be adjusted in subsequent periods.

attributes.name: cognizant_agency
attributes.description: The federal agency responsible for negotiating and approving the institution's IDC rates. Typically DHHS (Department of Health and Human Services) or ONR (Office of Naval Research) for most universities.
attributes.references: 2 CFR 200.19 Cognizant Agency for Indirect Costs

attributes.name: cost_base_type
attributes.description: The cost base to which the rate percentage is applied. MTDC (Modified Total Direct Costs) is most common and excludes equipment, capital expenditures, subawards over $25K, and other specified costs.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this IDC rate record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage tracking.

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: The date on which this IDC rate expires and is no longer applicable to new awards. Nullable for open-ended agreements or provisional rates pending final negotiation.

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: The date on which this IDC rate becomes effective and applicable to sponsored awards. Typically aligns with the institution's fiscal year start.

attributes.name: equipment_exclusion_threshold
attributes.description: The dollar threshold above which equipment purchases are excluded from the MTDC base for IDC calculation. Typically $5,000 per federal capitalization policies.

attributes.name: facilities_rate_component
attributes.description: The facilities portion of the F&A rate, covering depreciation, interest, operations and maintenance, and library costs. Combined with administrative component to form total F&A rate.

attributes.name: fringe_benefit_rate_included
attributes.description: Indicates whether fringe benefit costs are included in the IDC rate calculation or treated separately. True if fringe is part of the rate; false if fringe is calculated independently.

attributes.name: institutional_signatory
attributes.description: Name and title of the institutional official (typically CFO or VP for Research) who signed the rate agreement on behalf of the university.

attributes.name: modified_by
attributes.description: Username or identifier of the system user who last modified this IDC rate record. Used for audit trail and accountability.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this IDC rate record was last modified. Used for audit trail and change tracking.

attributes.name: mtdc_exclusion_threshold
attributes.business_glossary_term: Modified Total Direct Costs (MTDC) Exclusion Threshold
attributes.description: The dollar threshold above which certain costs (e.g., subawards, equipment) are excluded from the MTDC base. Commonly $25,000 for subawards per federal guidelines.

attributes.name: negotiation_date
attributes.description: The date on which the rate agreement was formally negotiated and executed between the institution and the cognizant federal agency.

attributes.name: rate_agreement_document_reference
attributes.description: Reference identifier or file path to the official rate agreement document signed by the cognizant agency. Used for audit trail and compliance verification.

attributes.name: rate_agreement_number
attributes.description: Official agreement number assigned by the cognizant federal agency for this negotiated rate agreement. Serves as the business identifier for the rate record.

attributes.name: rate_audit_date
attributes.description: The date of the most recent audit or review of the IDC rate calculation by the cognizant agency or external auditors. Used for compliance tracking.

attributes.name: rate_calculation_methodology
attributes.description: Description of the methodology used to calculate the IDC rate, including cost pools, allocation bases, and any special adjustments. Documents the technical approach for audit and compliance purposes.

attributes.name: rate_cap_percentage
attributes.description: Maximum allowable IDC rate percentage imposed by specific sponsors or programs. Some federal programs (e.g., training grants) cap IDC at 8%. Nullable if no cap applies.

attributes.name: rate_determination_type
attributes.description: Classification of the rate determination method. Predetermined rates are negotiated in advance for a multi-year period; provisional rates are temporary pending final rate calculation; fixed rates remain constant; final rates are determined after actual costs are known.

attributes.name: rate_negotiation_notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes documenting special conditions, exceptions, or context from the rate negotiation process. Used for institutional memory and future negotiations.

attributes.name: rate_percentage
attributes.description: The negotiated percentage rate applied to the cost base to calculate indirect cost recovery. Expressed as a percentage (e.g., 54.50 for 54.5%).

attributes.name: rate_proposal_submission_date
attributes.description: The date on which the institution submitted its IDC rate proposal to the cognizant agency for review and negotiation.

attributes.name: rate_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the rate agreement. Active rates are currently in use; expired rates are past their end date; superseded rates have been replaced by newer agreements; pending rates await approval; draft rates are under negotiation.

attributes.name: rate_type
attributes.description: Classification of the rate based on the type of sponsored activity and location. On-campus research typically has higher rates than off-campus due to facility usage.

attributes.name: special_rate_conditions
attributes.description: Documentation of any special conditions, restrictions, or requirements attached to this rate agreement by the cognizant agency or specific sponsors.

attributes.name: created_by
attributes.description: Username or identifier of the system user who created this IDC rate record. Used for audit trail and accountability.

products.name: award_modification
products.description: Transactional record capturing formal modifications to an existing sponsored research award, including sponsor-initiated amendments and institution-initiated change requests. Captures modification number, modification type (budget revision, no-cost extension, scope change, PI change, period extension, supplement, carryforward approval), modification date, previous award amount, new award amount, previous end date, new end date, justification narrative, sponsor approval date, modification status, and originating request reference. Provides a complete audit trail of award changes required for federal compliance and closeout.

attributes.name: award_modification_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the award modification record. Primary key.

attributes.name: award_budget_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to research.award_budget. Business justification: Award modifications that change funding amounts or scope result in new budget versions. Adding award_budget_id FK links modifications to the resulting budget version, providing traceability from modif

attributes.name: primary_award_employee_id
attributes.description: User identifier of the research administrator or system user who created this modification record. Part of the audit trail for accountability and compliance.

attributes.name: primary_award_principal_investigator_id
attributes.description: Reference to the Principal Investigator (PI) before this modification. Populated when modification_type is pi_change. Links to the principal_investigator record.

attributes.name: research_award_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent sponsored research award being modified. Links to the original award record in the research award system.

attributes.name: approved_by_name
attributes.description: Name of the institutional authorized organizational representative or research administrator who approved this modification on behalf of the institution.

attributes.name: approved_by_title
attributes.description: Title or role of the institutional representative who approved this modification. Typically Director of Sponsored Programs, Associate Vice President for Research, or Authorized Organizational Representative.

attributes.name: attachment_count
attributes.description: Number of supporting documents attached to this modification record. May include sponsor notices, revised budgets, PI (Principal Investigator) justification letters, or institutional approval forms.

attributes.name: carryforward_amount
attributes.description: The amount of unobligated funds being carried forward to the next budget period. Populated when modification_type is carryforward_approval. Subject to sponsor policies and percentage thresholds.
attributes.references: National Institutes of Health (NIH) Grants Policy Statement Section 8.4.1

attributes.name: closeout_impact_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this modification affects the award closeout process, timeline, or requirements. Important for final reporting and financial reconciliation.
attributes.references: National Science Foundation (NSF) Award and Administration Guide (AAG) Chapter VI

attributes.name: cost_sharing_change_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this modification alters the institutional cost sharing commitment. Cost sharing changes require institutional approval and sponsor notification.
attributes.references: Office of Management and Budget (OMB) Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200.306

attributes.name: fa_rate_change_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Facilities and Administrative (F&A) Rate Change Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this modification includes a change to the Facilities and Administrative (F&A) cost rate (also known as Indirect Cost (IDC) rate). Typically occurs with negotiated rate agreements or budget revisions.
attributes.references: Office of Management and Budget (OMB) Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200 Subpart E

attributes.name: federal_reporting_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this modification must be reported to federal agencies through Research Performance Progress Report (RPPR), Federal Financial Report (FFR), or other compliance mechanisms.
attributes.references: National Science Foundation (NSF) Award and Administration Guide (AAG) Chapter VII

attributes.name: institutional_approval_date
attributes.description: The date the institution's authorized organizational representative or research administration office approved the modification internally before sponsor submission or after sponsor-initiated changes.

attributes.name: justification_narrative
attributes.description: Detailed business and scientific rationale for the modification request. Required for sponsor review and institutional approval. Explains why the change is necessary and how it supports the research objectives.
attributes.references: National Science Foundation (NSF) Proposal and Award Policies and Procedures Guide (PAPPG) Chapter II.E.7

attributes.name: modification_amount_change
attributes.description: The net change in award funding resulting from this modification. Positive for supplements and incremental funding; zero for no-cost extensions; negative for de-obligations.
attributes.references: National Science Foundation (NSF) Award and Administration Guide (AAG) Chapter II.E.3

attributes.name: modification_date
attributes.description: The date on which the modification becomes effective. Typically the sponsor approval date or a future date specified in the modification agreement.
attributes.references: Federal Demonstration Partnership (FDP) Terms and Conditions

attributes.name: modification_initiator
attributes.description: Identifies the party that initiated the modification request. Sponsor-initiated modifications are typically administrative or compliance-driven; institution-initiated modifications are requested by the PI (Principal Investigator) or research administration.

attributes.name: modification_notes
attributes.description: Additional internal notes, comments, or administrative details about the modification. Used for institutional record-keeping and audit trail documentation.

attributes.name: modification_number
attributes.description: Sequential or sponsor-assigned identifier for this modification within the award lifecycle. Typically follows format MOD-001, A001, or Amendment 1.
attributes.references: Federal Demonstration Partnership (FDP) Award Modification Standards

attributes.name: modification_request_date
attributes.description: The date the institution submitted the modification request to the sponsor or initiated the internal change request.

attributes.name: modification_status
attributes.description: Current workflow state of the modification request. Tracks progression from draft through institutional and sponsor approval to final execution or rejection. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: draft|submitted|under_review|sponsor_approved|institutionally_approved|executed|rejected|withdrawn — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: modification_type
attributes.description: Classification of the modification action. Budget revision adjusts funding amounts; no-cost extension extends timeline without additional funds; scope change alters research objectives; PI (Principal Investigator) change updates project leadership; period extension modifies performance period; supplement adds incremental funding; carryforward approval permits unspent funds to roll forward; administrative correction fixes clerical errors. attributes.references: National Science Foundation (NSF) Award and Administration Guide (AAG) Chapter II.E

attributes.name: new_award_amount
attributes.description: The total award funding amount after this modification is applied. Represents the cumulative funding commitment from the sponsor.
attributes.references: Federal Demonstration Partnership (FDP) Financial Reporting Standards

attributes.name: new_end_date
attributes.description: The award performance period end date after this modification is applied. Reflects timeline extensions granted through no-cost extensions or funded period extensions.
attributes.references: Federal Demonstration Partnership (FDP) Terms and Conditions

attributes.name: new_start_date
attributes.description: The award performance period start date after this modification is applied. Captures any retroactive or prospective adjustments to the project start date.
attributes.references: Federal Demonstration Partnership (FDP) Terms and Conditions

attributes.name: originating_request_reference
attributes.description: Reference to the internal request or workflow that initiated this modification. May link to a PI request form, departmental approval, or compliance requirement.

attributes.name: previous_award_amount
attributes.description: The total award funding amount before this modification. Provides baseline for calculating the net change in funding.
attributes.references: Federal Demonstration Partnership (FDP) Financial Reporting Standards

attributes.name: previous_end_date
attributes.description: The award performance period end date before this modification. Establishes the baseline timeline for no-cost extensions and period extensions.
attributes.references: Federal Demonstration Partnership (FDP) Terms and Conditions

attributes.name: previous_start_date
attributes.description: The award performance period start date before this modification. Rarely changed but may be adjusted in administrative corrections or retroactive modifications.
attributes.references: Federal Demonstration Partnership (FDP) Terms and Conditions

attributes.name: record_created_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp when this modification record was first created in the research administration system. Part of the audit trail for compliance and data lineage.

attributes.name: record_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp when this modification record was last updated. Tracks the most recent change to any field in the record for audit and data quality purposes.

attributes.name: scope_change_description
attributes.description: Detailed description of changes to research objectives, aims, methodologies, or deliverables when modification_type is scope_change. Documents how the project scope is being altered.
attributes.references: National Institutes of Health (NIH) Grants Policy Statement Section 8.1.2.b

attributes.name: sponsor_approval_date
attributes.description: The date the sponsoring agency officially approved the modification. Critical for compliance and audit trail documentation.
attributes.references: National Institutes of Health (NIH) Grants Policy Statement Section 8.1.2

attributes.name: sponsor_modification_notice_number
attributes.description: The official notice or amendment number assigned by the sponsoring agency. Used for sponsor-initiated modifications and federal reporting.
attributes.references: Federal Demonstration Partnership (FDP) Award Modification Standards

attributes.name: sponsor_program_officer_email
attributes.description: Email address of the sponsoring agency program officer for correspondence regarding this modification.
attributes.references: National Science Foundation (NSF) Award and Administration Guide (AAG)

attributes.name: sponsor_program_officer_name
attributes.description: Name of the sponsoring agency program officer or grants management specialist who processed and approved this modification on the sponsor side.
attributes.references: National Science Foundation (NSF) Award and Administration Guide (AAG)

attributes.name: terms_and_conditions_updated_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this modification includes changes to the award terms and conditions, special conditions, or compliance requirements.
attributes.references: Federal Demonstration Partnership (FDP) Terms and Conditions

products.name: conflict_of_interest
products.description: Master record tracking financial conflict of interest (FCOI) disclosures made by investigators on sponsored research projects. Captures investigator ID, disclosure date, disclosure period, significant financial interest (SFI) type (equity, income, intellectual property), entity name, dollar value range, relatedness determination, FCOI finding (yes/no), management plan required flag, management plan description, management plan approval date, annual update date, and disclosure status. Required under 42 CFR Part 50 Subpart F (PHS FCOI regulations) and institutional FCOI policy.
products.reference: 42 CFR Part 50 Subpart F / Kuali Research - COI Module

attributes.name: conflict_of_interest_id
attributes.description: Primary key for conflict_of_interest

attributes.name: enterprise_application_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to technology.enterprise_application. Business justification: COI disclosures managed in specialized compliance systems (COI module in Kuali Research, standalone COI systems). Business need: system integration for disclosure tracking, compliance reporting, audit

attributes.name: principal_investigator_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the investigator making the disclosure.

attributes.name: regulatory_requirement_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.regulatory_requirement. Business justification: COI disclosures implement 42 CFR 50 Subpart F (PHS) and NSF financial conflict regulations. Required for sponsor reporting, FCOI public accessibility requirements, and retrospective review compliance.

attributes.name: research_award_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the sponsored research award to which this disclosure relates.

attributes.name: reviewer_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to hr.employee. Business justification: COI disclosure review assigned to specific compliance officer for relatedness determination, FCOI finding, and management plan oversight per PHS and NSF regulations. Essential for compliance office wo

attributes.name: annual_update_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent annual update to the conflict of interest disclosure, as required by PHS FCOI regulations for ongoing disclosures.

attributes.name: bias_finding_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the retrospective review identified bias in the design, conduct, or reporting of the PHS-funded research.

attributes.name: comments
attributes.description: Additional comments, notes, or observations recorded by the reviewer or investigator regarding the disclosure.

attributes.name: disclosure_date
attributes.description: Date on which the investigator submitted the conflict of interest disclosure.

attributes.name: disclosure_number
attributes.description: Business identifier for the conflict of interest disclosure, typically assigned by the institutional FCOI office or Kuali Research system.

attributes.name: disclosure_period_end_date
attributes.description: End date of the period covered by this disclosure.

attributes.name: disclosure_period_start_date
attributes.description: Start date of the period covered by this disclosure, typically the 12-month period preceding the disclosure.

attributes.name: disclosure_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the conflict of interest disclosure.

attributes.name: dollar_value_range
attributes.description: Range of dollar value for the significant financial interest, as required by PHS FCOI regulations.

attributes.name: entity_name
attributes.description: Name of the external entity (company, organization, institution) with which the investigator has a significant financial interest.

attributes.name: entity_type
attributes.description: Type of external entity (publicly traded corporation, privately held company, nonprofit organization, government agency, academic institution, or other).

attributes.name: fcoi_finding_date
attributes.business_glossary_term: Financial Conflict of Interest (FCOI) Finding Date
attributes.description: Date on which the institutional FCOI office made the FCOI finding determination.

attributes.name: fcoi_finding_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Financial Conflict of Interest (FCOI) Finding Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the institutional FCOI office determined that a financial conflict of interest exists (true if FCOI exists, false if no FCOI).

attributes.name: kuali_research_disclosure_number
attributes.description: External system identifier from Kuali Research system where the disclosure was originally created and managed.

attributes.name: management_plan_approval_date
attributes.description: Date on which the institutional FCOI office or designated official approved the management plan.

attributes.name: management_plan_approved_by
attributes.description: Name and title of the institutional official who approved the management plan.

attributes.name: management_plan_description
attributes.description: Detailed description of the management plan implemented to manage, reduce, or eliminate the FCOI, including specific conditions and restrictions imposed.

attributes.name: management_plan_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a management plan is required to manage, reduce, or eliminate the identified financial conflict of interest.

attributes.name: mitigation_report_date
attributes.description: Date on which the mitigation report was submitted to the PHS awarding component.

attributes.name: mitigation_report_submitted_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a mitigation report was submitted to the PHS awarding component documenting actions taken to eliminate or mitigate the effect of bias found in the retrospective review.

attributes.name: public_accessibility_date
attributes.description: Date on which the FCOI information was made publicly accessible, typically via institutional website or public registry.

attributes.name: public_accessibility_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether information about this FCOI must be made publicly accessible, as required by PHS FCOI regulations for certain senior/key personnel.

attributes.name: record_created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this conflict of interest disclosure record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: record_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this conflict of interest disclosure record was last updated in the system.

attributes.name: relatedness_determination
attributes.description: Determination by the institutional FCOI office as to whether the significant financial interest is related to the investigators institutional responsibilities and sponsored research.

attributes.name: relatedness_determination_date
attributes.description: Date on which the institutional FCOI office made the relatedness determination.

attributes.name: relatedness_justification
attributes.description: Justification and rationale for the relatedness determination, documenting why the SFI is or is not related to institutional responsibilities.

attributes.name: retrospective_review_completion_date
attributes.description: Date on which the retrospective review of the investigators research was completed.

attributes.name: retrospective_review_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a retrospective review of the investigators research is required due to failure to comply with FCOI policy or management plan.

attributes.name: review_completion_date
attributes.description: Date on which the institutional review of the disclosure was completed.

attributes.name: sfi_description
attributes.description: Detailed description of the significant financial interest, including nature of the relationship and activities involved.

attributes.name: sfi_type
attributes.description: Type of significant financial interest disclosed by the investigator (equity ownership, income, intellectual property rights, board position, consulting arrangement, or other).

attributes.name: sponsor_notification_date
attributes.description: Date on which the institution notified the PHS awarding component (NSF, NIH, etc.) of the identified FCOI.

attributes.name: sponsor_notification_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the institution is required to notify the PHS awarding component of the identified FCOI prior to expenditure of funds.

products.name: award_account
products.description: Master record for the institutional financial account (project/grant account) established to receive and track expenditures for a sponsored research award. Captures account number (project ID), account title, fund code, organization code, PI employee ID, award ID, account open date, account close date, total authorized budget, total expenditures to date, total encumbrances, available balance, account status (open, restricted, closed, pending closeout), cost-sharing account flag, residual balance disposition, F&A recovery account linkage, and ERP project ID. The financial SSOT linking research awards to institutional accounting within the research domain. Distinct from the finance domain's general ledger accounts — this is the research-specific project account managed by grants accounting staff.
products.reference: Oracle PeopleSoft Financials - Project Costing / Grants Module

attributes.name: award_account_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the award account record. Primary key for the award account entity.

attributes.name: account_manager_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to hr.employee. Business justification: Financial account management assigned to specific grant accountant or business officer for reconciliation, financial reporting, and closeout. Critical for post-award office portfolio management and ef

attributes.name: award_budget_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to research.award_budget. Business justification: Award accounts are established based on approved budgets. The account's total_authorized_budget comes from a specific approved budget version. Adding award_budget_id FK links the account to its govern

attributes.name: idc_rate_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to research.idc_rate. Business justification: award_account has fa_rate_percentage and idc_rate_type which should be normalized via FK to idc_rate master table. Award accounts apply specific negotiated IDC rate agreements; linking provides full r

attributes.name: primary_building_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to facility.building. Business justification: Award accounts fund building operations, maintenance, and utilities. Financial reporting and cost allocation require linking accounts to buildings for facilities cost recovery, utility chargeback calc

attributes.name: primary_room_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to facility.room. Business justification: Award accounts pay for room-specific costs including lab setup, specialized equipment, and room modifications. Space chargeback systems and cost allocation models require room-level account linkage fo

attributes.name: principal_investigator_id
attributes.description: Reference to the Principal Investigator responsible for this award account. The PI has primary accountability for scientific and financial stewardship of the project.

attributes.name: research_award_id
attributes.description: Reference to the sponsored research award that this account was established to support. Links the financial account to the underlying award agreement.

attributes.name: sponsor_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to research.sponsor. Business justification: award_account has sponsor_agency_name which should be normalized via FK to sponsor master table. This allows joining to get full sponsor details (type, contact info, payment terms, etc.) rather than s

attributes.name: account_close_date
attributes.description: The date the award account was officially closed after all expenditures were finalized, final reports submitted, and residual balances resolved. Nullable for active accounts.
attributes.references: 2 CFR 200 Uniform Guidance closeout requirements; NACUBO closeout procedures

attributes.name: account_notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for grants accounting staff to record special instructions, restrictions, compliance notes, or other important information about this award account.

attributes.name: account_number
attributes.description: The institutional project or grant account number assigned by grants accounting or the ERP system. This is the externally-known identifier used in financial transactions, journal entries, and sponsor reporting.
attributes.references: Oracle PeopleSoft Financials project accounting; NACUBO financial reporting standards

attributes.name: account_open_date
attributes.description: The date the award account was opened and made available for charging expenditures. Typically coincides with the award start date or the date of award execution.
attributes.references: 2 CFR 200 Uniform Guidance period of performance

attributes.name: account_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the award account. Open accounts accept charges; restricted accounts require special approval; closed accounts are finalized; pending closeout accounts are in the 90-day closeout window; suspended accounts are temporarily frozen; pre-award accounts are established before formal award receipt.
attributes.references: NACUBO grants accounting guidelines; 2 CFR 200 Uniform Guidance closeout requirements

attributes.name: account_title
attributes.description: Descriptive title of the award account, typically derived from the project title or sponsor program name. Used for human-readable identification in financial reports and dashboards.

attributes.name: activity_type
attributes.description: The primary functional category of sponsored activity supported by this account. Used for IPEDS reporting and institutional cost allocation.
attributes.references: IPEDS Finance Survey component; NACUBO functional expense classification

attributes.name: available_balance
attributes.description: The remaining unspent and unencumbered budget available for new commitments. Calculated as total authorized budget minus expenditures minus encumbrances.
attributes.references: NACUBO budget management standards; institutional budget control policies

attributes.name: award_type
attributes.description: The legal instrument type under which the award was made. Determines compliance requirements, intellectual property rights, and reporting obligations.
attributes.references: 2 CFR 200 Uniform Guidance definitions; federal grant vs contract distinctions

attributes.name: budget_currency_code
attributes.description: The three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the budget and financial amounts in this award account (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP). Most U.S. institutions use USD exclusively.
attributes.references: ISO 4217 currency codes; institutional financial reporting standards

attributes.name: cfda_number
attributes.business_glossary_term: Catalog of Federal Domestic Assistance (CFDA) Number
attributes.description: The CFDA number identifying the federal program under which this award was made. Required for federal awards and used in Single Audit reporting and SEFA schedules.
attributes.references: 2 CFR 200 Uniform Guidance Appendix XI; SAM.gov CFDA catalog

attributes.name: cost_sharing_account_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this account is designated for tracking institutional cost sharing or matching contributions required by the sponsor. True if this is a cost-sharing account.
attributes.references: 2 CFR 200 Uniform Guidance cost sharing requirements; sponsor award terms

attributes.name: cost_sharing_amount
attributes.description: The total amount of committed institutional cost sharing or matching funds for this award, as specified in the proposal and award agreement. Must be tracked and documented per sponsor requirements.
attributes.references: 2 CFR 200 Uniform Guidance cost sharing requirements; sponsor award terms

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time this award account record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage tracking.

attributes.name: erp_project_code
attributes.description: The project or grant identifier in the institutional ERP system (Oracle PeopleSoft Financials) that corresponds to this award account. Used for system integration and financial transaction posting.
attributes.references: Oracle PeopleSoft Financials project accounting module

attributes.name: export_control_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this award involves research subject to export control regulations (ITAR, EAR) requiring special compliance procedures and technology transfer review.
attributes.references: ITAR (International Traffic in Arms Regulations); EAR (Export Administration Regulations)

attributes.name: fa_recovery_account_linkage
attributes.business_glossary_term: Facilities and Administrative (F&A) Recovery Account Linkage
attributes.description: The institutional account number where recovered F&A (indirect cost) revenue from this award is deposited. Links the project account to the institutional IDC recovery distribution mechanism.
attributes.references: 2 CFR 200 Uniform Guidance F&A cost recovery; institutional IDC distribution policy

attributes.name: fund_code
attributes.description: The institutional fund code or fund type that classifies the source of funds for this account (e.g., federal, state, private foundation, corporate). Used for financial reporting and compliance segregation.
attributes.references: GASB/FASB fund accounting standards; NACUBO fund classification

attributes.name: human_subjects_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this award involves research with human subjects requiring Institutional Review Board (IRB) oversight and approval per federal regulations.
attributes.references: 45 CFR 46 Common Rule; institutional IRB policies

attributes.name: last_financial_report_date
attributes.description: The date the most recent financial report (Federal Financial Report, invoice, or expenditure report) was submitted to the sponsor for this award account.
attributes.references: 2 CFR 200 Uniform Guidance financial reporting requirements; sponsor reporting schedule

attributes.name: modified_by
attributes.description: The username or identifier of the system user who last modified this award account record. Used for audit trail and accountability.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time this award account record was last modified. Updated whenever any field in the record changes. Used for audit trail and change tracking.

attributes.name: mtdc_base
attributes.description: The Modified Total Direct Cost base amount used for calculating F&A costs. Excludes equipment, capital expenditures, subaward amounts over $25K, and other items per 2 CFR 200.
attributes.references: 2 CFR 200 Uniform Guidance Section 200.68 MTDC definition

attributes.name: next_financial_report_due_date
attributes.description: The date the next financial report is due to the sponsor per the award terms and reporting schedule. Used for compliance tracking and deadline management.
attributes.references: Sponsor award terms; 2 CFR 200 Uniform Guidance reporting requirements

attributes.name: organization_code
attributes.description: The institutional organization or department code responsible for administering this award account. Typically the PIs home department or the lead research unit.
attributes.references: Institutional chart of accounts; Oracle PeopleSoft Financials organizational hierarchy

attributes.name: project_end_date
attributes.description: The official end date of the project period of performance as specified in the award agreement. Defines the end of the allowable cost period, after which closeout procedures begin.
attributes.references: 2 CFR 200 Uniform Guidance period of performance; sponsor award terms

attributes.name: project_start_date
attributes.description: The official start date of the project period of performance as specified in the award agreement. Defines the beginning of the allowable cost period.
attributes.references: 2 CFR 200 Uniform Guidance period of performance; sponsor award terms

attributes.name: residual_balance_disposition
attributes.description: Specifies how any remaining unspent balance at account closeout will be handled per sponsor terms and institutional policy. Options include returning funds to sponsor, retaining for institutional use, transferring to PI discretionary account, or carrying forward to a continuation award.
attributes.references: 2 CFR 200 Uniform Guidance closeout; sponsor award terms and conditions

attributes.name: sponsor_award_number
attributes.description: The unique award or grant number assigned by the sponsoring agency. This is the external identifier used in all sponsor correspondence and reporting.
attributes.references: Sponsor award notice; federal grant award documentation

attributes.name: total_authorized_budget
attributes.description: The total budget amount authorized by the sponsor for this award account, including all approved modifications and amendments. Represents the cumulative funding ceiling.
attributes.references: Sponsor award notice; 2 CFR 200 Uniform Guidance budget requirements

attributes.name: total_encumbrances
attributes.description: The total amount of outstanding commitments and obligations (purchase orders, contracts, payroll commitments) that have been encumbered against this award account but not yet expended.
attributes.references: GASB encumbrance accounting standards; Oracle PeopleSoft Financials commitment control

attributes.name: total_expenditures_to_date
attributes.description: The cumulative total of all posted expenditures charged to this award account from inception through the current reporting period. Includes direct and indirect costs.
attributes.references: Oracle PeopleSoft Financials general ledger; NACUBO financial reporting

attributes.name: unrecovered_fa_amount
attributes.description: The amount of F&A costs that were incurred but not recovered from the sponsor due to rate caps, waivers, or sponsor policy limitations. Represents institutional cost sharing.
attributes.references: 2 CFR 200 Uniform Guidance cost sharing; institutional cost accounting standards

attributes.name: vertebrate_animals_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this award involves research with vertebrate animals requiring Institutional Animal Care and Use Committee (IACUC) oversight and approval per federal regulations.
attributes.references: PHS Policy on Humane Care and Use of Laboratory Animals; USDA Animal Welfare Act

attributes.name: created_by
attributes.description: The username or identifier of the system user who created this award account record. Used for audit trail and accountability.

products.name: proposal_personnel
products.description: Association record linking personnel (PI, Co-PI, senior personnel, graduate students, postdocs) to a specific grant proposal with their proposed role, effort, and compensation. Captures proposal ID, person ID, person name, role type (PI, Co-PI, Senior Personnel, Postdoctoral Associate, Graduate Research Assistant, Undergraduate Researcher), proposed effort percentage (academic year, summer, calendar year), proposed salary, fringe benefit rate, appointment type, and person status on proposal. Supports NSF and NIH biosketches, senior personnel listings, and budget justification requirements.
products.reference: Kuali Research - Proposal Personnel / NSF FastLane / NIH eRA Commons

attributes.name: proposal_personnel_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the proposal personnel association record. Primary key for this entity.

attributes.name: alumnus_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to advancement.alumnus. Business justification: Research personnel often include alumni postdocs, research scientists, or collaborators. Advancement needs this for engagement tracking, prospect identification, and demonstrating continued institutio

attributes.name: compliance_training_completion_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.training_completion. Business justification: Research personnel must complete protocol-specific training (IRB, IACUC, biosafety) before project work begins. Required for protocol approval, personnel authorization lists, and regulatory compliance

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the individual assigned to this proposal. May link to employee, faculty, or external collaborator records.

attributes.name: identity_account_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the system user who added this personnel member to the proposal.

attributes.name: last_modified_by_user_identity_account_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the system user who last modified this personnel record.

attributes.name: proposal_id
attributes.description: Reference to the grant proposal to which this personnel member is assigned.

attributes.name: student_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to billing.student_account. Business justification: Graduate students listed as proposal personnel receive tuition and stipend support from awarded grants. Universities must track which student accounts are funded by which proposals for financial aid p

attributes.name: student_athlete_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to athletics.student_athlete. Business justification: Identifies student-athletes employed as research assistants on grant proposals. Required for effort certification, eligibility verification (employment cannot exceed NCAA limits), and institutional re

attributes.name: academic_rank
attributes.description: Academic or professional rank of the personnel member at the time of proposal submission. Used for biosketches and to determine eligibility for certain roles (e.g., PI eligibility often requires faculty rank). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: Professor|Associate Professor|Assistant Professor|Instructor|Lecturer|Research Scientist|Postdoctoral Associate|Graduate Student|Undergraduate Student|Staff — 10 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: academic_year_effort_percentage
attributes.description: Percentage of the individual's academic year time (typically 9 months for faculty on academic-year appointments) committed to this project. Expressed as a percentage (0.00 to 100.00). Used for effort reporting and budget justification.
attributes.references: OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200, NSF PAPPG Chapter II.C.2.g(i)

attributes.name: added_date
attributes.description: Date this personnel member was added to the proposal team.

attributes.name: appointment_type
attributes.description: Type of appointment for this personnel member on the project. Academic Year (9-month) is typical for faculty. Calendar Year (12-month) is typical for research staff. Summer appointments are for faculty during summer months. Hourly is for part-time or student workers. Stipend is for graduate students and postdocs receiving fixed payments.

attributes.name: biosketch_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a biographical sketch (biosketch) is required for this personnel member as part of the proposal submission. Typically required for PI, Co-PIs, and senior personnel; not required for graduate students or undergraduates.
attributes.references: NSF PAPPG Chapter II.C.2.f(i), NIH Biosketch Requirements

attributes.name: biosketch_submitted_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the biographical sketch for this personnel member has been submitted as part of the proposal package.

attributes.name: calendar_year_effort_percentage
attributes.description: Percentage of the individual's calendar year time (12 months) committed to this project. Expressed as a percentage (0.00 to 100.00). Used for personnel on 12-month appointments or when aggregating academic year and summer effort.
attributes.references: OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200, NSF PAPPG Chapter II.C.2.g(i)

attributes.name: citizenship_status
attributes.description: Citizenship or visa status of the personnel member. Required for certain sponsor programs (e.g., Department of Defense, Department of Energy) and for export control compliance.
attributes.references: Export Administration Regulations (EAR), International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR)

attributes.name: college_school_name
attributes.description: Name of the college or school to which the personnel member's home department belongs. Higher-level organizational unit in the institutional hierarchy.

attributes.name: conflict_of_interest_disclosed_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this personnel member has disclosed any financial or personal conflicts of interest related to this proposal, as required by institutional policy and federal regulations.
attributes.references: OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200.112, NSF PAPPG Chapter II.C.1.f, Institutional COI Policy

attributes.name: cost_sharing_amount
attributes.description: Amount of this individual's compensation that will be cost-shared (contributed by the institution rather than charged to the sponsor). Cost sharing may be mandatory (required by the sponsor) or voluntary (offered by the institution).
attributes.references: OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200.306, NSF PAPPG Chapter II.C.2.g(xi)

attributes.name: current_and_pending_required_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Current and Pending Support Required Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a Current and Pending Support document is required for this personnel member. Required for senior personnel to disclose all current and pending research support to identify potential overlaps and conflicts.
attributes.references: NSF PAPPG Chapter II.C.2.f(ii), NIH Current and Pending Support Requirements

attributes.name: current_and_pending_submitted_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Current and Pending Support Submitted Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the Current and Pending Support document for this personnel member has been submitted as part of the proposal package.

attributes.name: email_address
attributes.description: Primary institutional email address for the personnel member. Used for proposal communications and sponsor correspondence.

attributes.name: first_name
attributes.description: First (given) name of the personnel member as it appears on the proposal and biosketches submitted to sponsors.
attributes.references: NSF Biographical Sketch Requirements, NIH Biosketch Format

attributes.name: fringe_benefit_amount
attributes.description: Total fringe benefit cost for this individual, calculated by applying the fringe benefit rate to the proposed salary amount. Part of the total personnel cost in the proposal budget.

attributes.name: fringe_benefit_rate_percentage
attributes.description: Institutional fringe benefit rate applied to this individual's salary. Covers benefits such as health insurance, retirement contributions, and other employee benefits. Rate is typically negotiated with the federal government and varies by employee category.
attributes.references: OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200.431, Institutional Fringe Benefit Rate Agreement

attributes.name: home_department_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the personnel member's primary academic or administrative department. Used for effort reporting and cost allocation.

attributes.name: home_department_name
attributes.description: Name of the personnel member's primary academic or administrative department.

attributes.name: institutional_base_salary
attributes.description: The individual's institutional base salary at the time of proposal submission. Used to calculate the proposed salary amount based on effort percentage. IBS is the annual compensation paid by the institution for an individual's appointment, whether that individual's time is spent on research, teaching, or other activities.
attributes.references: OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200.430, NSF PAPPG Chapter II.C.2.g(i)

attributes.name: key_personnel_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this individual is designated as key personnel on the project. Key personnel are individuals who contribute in a substantive, measurable way to the scientific development or execution of the project, whether or not they receive salaries or compensation.
attributes.references: NSF PAPPG Chapter II.C.2.f(i), NIH Grants Policy Statement

attributes.name: last_modified_date
attributes.description: Date this personnel record was last modified.

attributes.name: last_name
attributes.description: Last (family) name of the personnel member as it appears on the proposal and biosketches submitted to sponsors.
attributes.references: NSF Biographical Sketch Requirements, NIH Biosketch Format

attributes.name: middle_name
attributes.description: Middle name or initial of the personnel member.
attributes.references: NSF Biographical Sketch Requirements, NIH Biosketch Format

attributes.name: orcid_identifier
attributes.description: Unique persistent digital identifier for this researcher, assigned by ORCID. Increasingly required by sponsors (NSF, NIH) to disambiguate researchers and link their scholarly activities. Format: 0000-0000-0000-0000.
attributes.references: ORCID Registry, NSF PAPPG 23-1 Chapter II.C.2.f(i)(c)

attributes.name: person_months
attributes.description: Total person months of effort committed by this individual to the project over the entire project period. Calculated by multiplying the effort percentage by the number of months in the project period. Used in budget justification and effort reporting.
attributes.references: NSF PAPPG Chapter II.C.2.g(i)(a), NIH Budget Instructions

attributes.name: personnel_notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes or comments about this personnel member's role, qualifications, or participation in the proposal. Used for internal coordination and budget justification preparation.

attributes.name: personnel_status
attributes.description: Current status of this personnel member's participation in the proposal. Proposed indicates initial inclusion in the proposal. Confirmed indicates the individual has agreed to participate. Declined indicates the individual has declined participation. Replaced indicates the individual was substituted with another person. Removed indicates the individual was removed from the proposal team.

attributes.name: phone_number
attributes.description: Primary contact phone number for the personnel member.

attributes.name: proposed_salary_amount
attributes.description: Total salary amount requested for this individual on this proposal, calculated based on institutional base salary and proposed effort. Includes academic year and summer salary components. Expressed in the proposal's budget currency.
attributes.references: OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200.430, NSF PAPPG Chapter II.C.2.g(i)

attributes.name: role_type
attributes.description: The role this individual will serve on the proposed project. PI (Principal Investigator) is the lead researcher responsible for the scientific and administrative conduct of the project. Co-PI (Co-Principal Investigator) shares leadership responsibilities. Senior Personnel includes faculty and other professionals with significant roles. Postdoctoral Associates, Graduate Research Assistants, and Undergraduate Researchers are trainees supported by the project.
attributes.value_regex: PI|Co-PI|Senior Personnel|Postdoctoral Associate|Graduate Research Assistant|Undergraduate Researcher

products.name: research_training_completion
products.description: This association product represents the completion event between a principal investigator and a compliance training program. It captures the compliance tracking requirements mandated by federal sponsors, institutional policy, and the Office of Sponsored Programs for PI eligibility determination. Each record links one principal investigator to one training program with completion status, dates, certification details, and recertification tracking that exist only in the context of this specific PI-training completion relationship.. Existence Justification: Principal investigators must complete multiple mandatory compliance training programs (RCR, human subjects, animal care, export control, conflict of interest, financial management) to maintain eligibility for sponsored research awards. Each training program is completed by hundreds of PIs across the institution. The Office of Sponsored Programs actively manages this compliance matrix, tracking completion dates, expiration dates, recertification requirements, waiver requests, and certificate numbers for each PI-training combination to determine proposal eligibility and award activation authority.
