attributes.description: Date on which the instructor successfully completed the training program and met all requirements including passing assessment score. Null if training is assigned but not yet completed.

attributes.name: completion_status
attributes.description: Current status of the training completion record. Assigned indicates training has been assigned but not started; in_progress indicates instructor has begun but not completed; completed indicates successful completion with passing score; expired indicates completion has passed recertification date; overdue indicates assigned training past due date; waived indicates training requirement waived by compliance officer.

attributes.name: due_date
attributes.description: Date by which the instructor must complete the assigned training program. Calculated as assignment_date plus completion_deadline_days from the training program. Used to identify overdue training and escalate compliance issues.

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: Date on which this training completion expires and recertification is required. Calculated as completion_date plus recertification_frequency_months from the training program. Used to trigger recertification notifications and compliance reporting.

attributes.name: last_access_date
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent time the instructor accessed the training content. Used to identify stalled or abandoned training attempts and trigger follow-up reminders.

attributes.name: last_notification_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent reminder notification sent to the instructor. Used to manage notification frequency and avoid over-communication.

attributes.name: notification_sent_count
attributes.description: Number of reminder notifications sent to the instructor regarding this training assignment. Used to track communication attempts and escalation procedures.

attributes.name: time_spent_minutes
attributes.description: Total time in minutes the instructor spent on the training content, tracked by the LMS or training platform. Used for engagement analysis and to verify minimum time requirements if applicable.

attributes.name: waiver_date
attributes.description: Date on which the training waiver was approved. Null unless completion_status is waived. Used for compliance reporting and audit documentation.

attributes.name: waiver_reason
attributes.description: Explanation for why the training requirement was waived for this instructor. Null unless completion_status is waived. Used for compliance documentation and audit purposes.

products.name: event_participation
products.description: This association product represents the participation relationship between instructors and advancement events. It captures faculty involvement in donor cultivation and stewardship activities including speaking engagements, honoree recognition, and hosting duties. Each record links one instructor to one advancement_event with attributes that describe the nature, compensation, and logistics of their participation.. Existence Justification: Faculty members participate in multiple advancement events throughout their careers (galas, donor dinners, campaign launches, named lecture series), and each advancement event involves multiple faculty members in various capacities (speakers, honorees, hosts, panelists). The advancement office actively manages faculty rosters for each event, tracking invitation status, roles, compensation, and service credit. This is an operational business process, not an analytical correlation.

attributes.name: event_participation_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for this faculty event participation record. Primary key for the association.

attributes.name: event_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Faculty Event Participation - Advancement Event Id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the advancement event in which the instructor is participating

attributes.name: instructor_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the instructor participating in the advancement event

attributes.name: honoree_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the faculty member is being honored or recognized at this event (e.g., distinguished professor award, endowed chair announcement). Explicitly identified in detection reasoning.

attributes.name: invitation_date
attributes.description: Date when the faculty member was invited to participate in the advancement event. Used for tracking response time and planning timelines.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes about the faculty member's participation including special requirements, dietary restrictions, AV needs, or post-event feedback.

attributes.name: participation_status
attributes.description: Current status of the faculty member's participation in the event. Tracks progression from invitation through attendance. Explicitly identified in detection reasoning.

attributes.name: presentation_duration_minutes
attributes.description: Scheduled duration in minutes for the faculty member's presentation or remarks. Used for event agenda planning.

attributes.name: presentation_title
attributes.description: Title of the presentation, speech, or remarks delivered by the faculty member at the event. Null for non-speaking roles. Explicitly identified in detection reasoning.

attributes.name: response_date
attributes.description: Date when the faculty member responded to the participation invitation. Used for event planning and follow-up.

attributes.name: role_type
attributes.description: The role in which the faculty member participates in the advancement event. Determines expectations, compensation, and recognition. Explicitly identified in detection reasoning.

attributes.name: service_credit_hours
attributes.description: Number of service hours credited to the faculty member for this event participation. Used for faculty service tracking and promotion/tenure documentation.

attributes.name: speaker_fee_amount
attributes.description: Monetary compensation paid to the faculty member for their participation in the event. May be zero for voluntary participation. Explicitly identified in detection reasoning.

attributes.name: travel_reimbursed_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the institution reimburses travel expenses for the faculty member to attend this event. Relevant for regional or off-campus events. Explicitly identified in detection reasoning.

products.name: resource_evaluation
products.description: This association product represents the evaluation event between instructor and electronic_resource during trial periods. It captures faculty feedback solicited by the library to inform collection development and acquisition decisions. Each record links one instructor to one electronic_resource trial with evaluation metadata including role, recommendation, and subject relevance assessment.. Existence Justification: In higher education library operations, electronic resource trial evaluations are a formal collection development process where the library solicits feedback from multiple faculty across relevant departments before making acquisition decisions. One instructor evaluates multiple database trials across their disciplines, and each resource trial is evaluated by multiple faculty to gather diverse perspectives on relevance, usability, and value. The evaluation relationship is an operational business entity that library staff actively create, track, and aggregate to inform renewal decisions and cost-per-use analysis.

attributes.name: resource_evaluation_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for this evaluation record. Primary key.

attributes.name: electronic_resource_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the electronic resource being evaluated

attributes.name: instructor_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the instructor who evaluated the resource

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp when this evaluation record was created in the library system.

attributes.name: evaluation_comments
attributes.description: Free-text comments from the instructor regarding resource quality, usability, content coverage, and value proposition.

attributes.name: evaluation_date
attributes.description: Date when the instructor submitted their evaluation feedback to the library.

attributes.name: recommendation
attributes.description: Instructors recommendation regarding whether the institution should acquire or subscribe to this electronic resource.

attributes.name: subject_relevance_rating
attributes.description: Instructors rating of how relevant the resource is to their discipline and teaching/research needs. Scale 1-5 where 5 is highly relevant.

attributes.name: trial_evaluation_role
attributes.description: Role in which the instructor evaluated the resource. Indicates whether they were solicited as primary evaluator, department representative, or provided unsolicited feedback.

attributes.name: usage_commitment
attributes.description: Instructors statement of how they intend to use the resource (e.g., required reading for HIST 301, supplemental research for graduate seminars, reference for thesis advising).

products.name: project_participation
products.description: This association product represents the participation relationship between faculty instructors and institutional IT projects. It captures faculty involvement as subject matter experts, pilot users, governance representatives, or advisory committee members across technology initiatives. Each record links one instructor to one IT project with role, effort allocation, and participation timeline attributes that exist only in the context of this specific project engagement.. Existence Justification: In higher education IT governance, faculty members routinely participate in multiple concurrent IT projects (LMS upgrades, research computing initiatives, ERP implementations) in various capacities such as subject matter experts, pilot users, or governance representatives. Simultaneously, each IT project requires participation from multiple faculty members across different departments to ensure stakeholder representation, domain expertise, and user acceptance. Universities actively manage these participation assignments to balance faculty workload, ensure adequate project staffing, and track effort allocation for budget and compensation purposes.

attributes.name: project_participation_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for this faculty project participation record. Primary key.

attributes.name: instructor_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the instructor participating in the IT project

attributes.name: it_project_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the IT project in which the instructor is participating

attributes.name: assigned_date
attributes.description: Date when the instructor was formally assigned to participate in this IT project by governance or project management. May precede actual start_date.

attributes.name: billable_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this faculty participation is billable to the project budget (true) or contributed as in-kind effort (false). Used for project cost accounting and faculty compensation tracking.

attributes.name: effort_percentage
attributes.description: Percentage of the instructor's time allocated to this IT project participation. Used for workload planning and effort tracking across concurrent project engagements.

attributes.name: end_date
attributes.description: Date when the instructor's participation in this IT project ended or is scheduled to end. Null for ongoing active participation.

attributes.name: participation_status
attributes.description: Current status of the instructor's participation in this IT project. Active indicates ongoing engagement, completed indicates role fulfilled, on_hold indicates temporary suspension, withdrawn indicates early termination.

attributes.name: role_on_project
attributes.description: The specific role or capacity in which the instructor is participating in the IT project. Determines expectations and responsibilities for this engagement.

attributes.name: start_date
attributes.description: Date when the instructor's participation in this IT project began. Marks the start of their engagement in the specified role.

products.name: faculty_application_access
products.description: This association product represents the access provisioning relationship between instructors and enterprise applications. It captures user access management, role assignments, and usage tracking for faculty members across the institutional application portfolio. Each record links one instructor to one enterprise application with attributes that exist only in the context of this access relationship, including role, access level, provisioning dates, and training status.. Existence Justification: In higher education IT operations, instructors require access to multiple enterprise applications (Canvas LMS, Banner, research administration systems, library systems, HR self-service portals) to perform their teaching, research, and administrative duties. Each application has hundreds or thousands of faculty users with varying roles and access levels. The university actively manages this many-to-many relationship through IT provisioning processes, tracking access grants, roles, training completion, last login dates, and license assignments for compliance, security auditing, and cost optimization.

attributes.description: Primary key for faculty_application_access

attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the enterprise application for which access has been provisioned

attributes.name: provisioning_date

attributes.name: user_role

attributes.name: behavioral_concern_flag

attributes.name: created_timestamp

attributes.name: current_grade

products.name: faculty_training_requirement
products.description: This association product represents the compliance training requirement between a faculty assignment and a mandatory training program. It captures the assignment of specific compliance training obligations to faculty members in their instructional roles, tracking completion status, deadlines, waivers, and the regulatory or policy basis for the requirement. Each record links one faculty assignment to one training program with attributes that exist only in the context of this compliance obligation.. Existence Justification: In higher education compliance operations, faculty assignments require completion of multiple mandatory training programs (Title IX, FERPA, Clery Act, research ethics, LMS training) based on role, course content, and regulatory requirements. Each training program is required across multiple faculty assignments spanning departments, colleges, and terms. HR and academic affairs actively manage these training requirements as operational records, tracking completion status, due dates, waivers, and generating compliance reports for accreditation and federal audits.

attributes.name: faculty_training_requirement_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for this faculty training requirement record. Primary key.

attributes.name: faculty_assignment_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Faculty Training Requirement - Faculty Assignment Id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the faculty assignment record that is subject to this training requirement

attributes.name: training_program_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Faculty Training Requirement - Compliance Training Id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the compliance training program that is required for this faculty assignment

attributes.name: assignment_date
attributes.description: The date on which this training requirement was assigned to this faculty assignment. Typically aligns with faculty assignment start date or the date a new training program becomes mandatory.

attributes.name: assignment_reason
attributes.description: The business or regulatory reason why this specific training program is required for this faculty assignment. Examples: role_based (all instructors), course_content (FERPA for courses with student records access), department_policy (college-specific requirement), accreditation (required by accreditor), regulatory (federal mandate), new_hire (onboarding requirement), annual_refresh (recertification).

attributes.name: attempt_count
attributes.description: Number of attempts the faculty member has made to complete this training requirement. Some training programs limit the number of attempts or require remediation after multiple failures.

attributes.name: certificate_issued_date
attributes.description: Date on which a completion certificate was issued for this training requirement. Null if training does not issue certificates or if not yet completed.

attributes.name: certificate_number
attributes.description: Unique certificate number issued upon successful completion of this training requirement. Used for verification and audit purposes. Null if no certificate issued.

attributes.name: completion_date
attributes.description: The date on which the faculty member successfully completed this training program for this assignment. Null if not yet completed. Used for compliance reporting and recertification scheduling.

attributes.name: completion_status
attributes.description: Current status of this training requirement for this faculty assignment. Values: not_started (assigned but not accessed), in_progress (started but not completed), completed (successfully finished with passing score), overdue (past due date without completion), waived (requirement waived by authorized personnel), exempt (faculty member exempt from this requirement).

attributes.name: due_date
attributes.description: The date by which this training must be completed for this specific faculty assignment. Calculated from assignment start date plus training program completion deadline, or set manually by compliance office for specific circumstances.

attributes.name: last_reminder_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent reminder notification sent for this training requirement. Used to schedule next reminder and avoid over-communication.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes regarding this specific training requirement. May include special circumstances, accommodations provided, technical issues encountered, or follow-up actions required.

attributes.name: notification_sent_date
attributes.description: Date on which the initial notification email was sent to the faculty member informing them of this training requirement. Used to track communication and calculate reminder schedules.

attributes.name: recertification_due_date
attributes.description: Date by which this training must be retaken to maintain compliance, calculated from completion date plus training program recertification frequency. Null if training does not require recertification or not yet completed.

attributes.name: reminder_count
attributes.description: Number of reminder notifications sent to the faculty member regarding this incomplete training requirement. Used to track escalation and compliance follow-up efforts.

attributes.name: score_achieved
attributes.description: Percentage score achieved by the faculty member on the training assessment for this requirement. Null if not yet completed or if training does not include an assessment. Must meet or exceed training program passing score.

attributes.name: waiver_approval_date
attributes.description: Date on which the waiver was officially approved. Null if no waiver granted.

attributes.name: waiver_approved_by
attributes.description: Employee ID of the administrator who approved the waiver for this training requirement. Null if no waiver granted. Used for audit trail and accountability.

attributes.name: waiver_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator of whether a waiver has been granted for this training requirement. True if the requirement has been waived by an authorized administrator (e.g., dean, compliance officer), false otherwise.

attributes.name: waiver_reason
attributes.description: Free-text explanation of why a waiver was granted for this training requirement. Required when waiver_flag is true. Examples: prior completion at another institution, equivalent professional certification, subject matter expert exemption.

products.name: grade_appeal_case
products.description: Master reference table for grade_appeal_case. Referenced by appeal_case_id.

attributes.name: grade_appeal_case_id
attributes.description: Primary key for grade_appeal_case

attributes.name: course_section_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the course section for which the grade is being appealed.

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the individual or committee responsible for reviewing and deciding the appeal (department chair, dean, appeal committee).

attributes.name: instructor_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the instructor who assigned the disputed grade.

attributes.name: profile_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the student who initiated the grade appeal.

attributes.name: related_academic_integrity_case_conduct_case_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Related Academic Integrity Case Conduct Case Id
attributes.description: Identifier of a related academic integrity case if the grade appeal is connected to or resulted from an academic misconduct finding.

attributes.name: term_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the academic term in which the disputed grade was assigned.

attributes.name: appeal_case_number
attributes.description: Human-readable business identifier for the grade appeal case, typically formatted with prefix and sequential number for external reference and tracking.

attributes.name: appeal_fee_amount
attributes.description: Monetary fee charged to the student for filing the grade appeal, if applicable per institutional policy. Amount in institutional currency.

attributes.name: appeal_fee_paid
attributes.description: Indicates whether the required appeal fee has been paid by the student.

attributes.name: appeal_fee_waived
attributes.description: Indicates whether the appeal fee was waived due to financial hardship or other institutional policy considerations.

attributes.name: appeal_level
attributes.description: The hierarchical level at which the appeal is currently being reviewed: instructor level (informal resolution), department level, college/school level, university level, or external review.

attributes.name: appeal_reason
attributes.description: Detailed explanation provided by the student describing the grounds for the grade appeal and the specific circumstances or errors being contested.

attributes.name: appeal_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the grade appeal case indicating its position in the review and decision workflow.

attributes.name: appeal_type
attributes.description: Classification of the grade appeal based on the nature of the dispute: grade calculation error, grading policy violation, procedural irregularity, alleged bias or discrimination, extenuating circumstances, or other grounds.

attributes.name: closed_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the grade appeal case was officially closed after final decision and all administrative actions were completed.

attributes.name: confidentiality_level
attributes.description: Level of confidentiality required for this appeal case based on the nature of the issues involved (standard, elevated for sensitive matters, restricted for cases involving discrimination or harassment allegations).

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this grade appeal case record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: decision_outcome
attributes.description: Final outcome of the appeal: approved (grade changed as requested), partially approved (grade changed but not to requested level), denied (original grade upheld), remanded (sent back for additional review), or withdrawn (student withdrew appeal).

attributes.name: decision_rationale
attributes.description: Detailed explanation of the reasoning behind the appeal decision, including findings of fact and application of grading policies.

attributes.name: decision_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the final decision on the grade appeal was rendered by the reviewing authority or appeal committee.

attributes.name: department_recommendation
attributes.description: Recommendation provided by the academic department regarding the appeal, typically from the department chair or designated review committee.

attributes.name: escalation_count
attributes.description: Number of times the appeal has been escalated to a higher review level after an unfavorable decision at a lower level.

attributes.name: final_grade
attributes.description: The final grade determined after the appeal process is complete. May differ from both original and requested grades based on appeal committee decision.

attributes.name: grade_change_effective_date
attributes.description: Date on which the grade change becomes effective in the student's academic record, if the appeal is approved.

attributes.name: hearing_location
attributes.description: Physical or virtual location where the appeal hearing will be conducted (room number, building name, video conference link).

attributes.name: hearing_scheduled_date
attributes.description: Date on which a formal hearing or review meeting is scheduled for the grade appeal case, if applicable based on appeal type and institutional policy.

attributes.name: initial_review_completed_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the initial administrative review of the appeal was completed to determine if it meets procedural requirements.

attributes.name: instructor_response
attributes.description: Written response from the instructor addressing the student's appeal claims and providing their perspective on the grading decision.

attributes.name: instructor_response_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the instructor submitted their response to the grade appeal.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this grade appeal case record was most recently updated.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Additional notes, comments, or administrative observations related to the appeal case processing and review.

attributes.name: original_grade
attributes.description: The grade originally assigned by the instructor that is being appealed. Typically letter grade (A through F with optional plus/minus) or special codes (I=Incomplete, W=Withdrawal, P=Pass, N=No Pass, C=Credit).

attributes.name: priority_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this appeal case requires expedited review due to time-sensitive circumstances such as graduation eligibility, financial aid status, or academic standing.

attributes.name: requested_grade
attributes.description: The grade the student is requesting through the appeal process. May be null if student is requesting grade review without specifying desired outcome.

attributes.name: student_notified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the student was officially notified of the appeal decision.

attributes.name: submission_deadline
attributes.description: The deadline date by which the grade appeal must be submitted according to institutional policy, typically calculated from grade posting date.

attributes.name: submission_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the student formally submitted the grade appeal case for review.

attributes.name: supporting_documentation_provided
attributes.description: Indicates whether the student has submitted supporting documentation (assignments, exams, correspondence, medical records, etc.) to substantiate the appeal.

attributes.name: transcript_updated
attributes.description: Indicates whether the student's official transcript has been updated to reflect the grade change resulting from a successful appeal.

attributes.name: escalated_grade_appeal_case_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing FK on grade_appeal_case (escalated_grade_appeal_case_id)

domains.name: billing
domains.description: Administers student accounts, tuition and fee assessment, payment processing, refunds, collections, and 1098-T tax reporting. Manages billing cycles, payment plans, third-party billing, sponsor invoicing, account holds, and receivables management. SSOT for student financial obligations and payment history.
domains.references: IRS 1098-T, NACUBO, Ellucian Banner Student Accounts

products.name: student_account
products.description: Master record for each student's financial account within the bursar/student accounts office. Tracks account status, current balance, cumulative charges, cumulative payments, billing address, account type (undergraduate, graduate, professional), and overall financial standing. Serves as the parent entity for all charges, payments, refunds, holds, and billing statements. SSOT for student financial obligations and payment history in the billing domain.

attributes.name: student_account_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the student account record within the bursar/student accounts office. Primary key for the student account entity. Serves as the parent identifier for all charges, payments, refunds, holds, and billing statements.

attributes.name: alumnus_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to advancement.alumnus. Business justification: Alumni maintain billing accounts for continuing education, lifelong learning programs, transcript requests, and outstanding balance resolution. Critical for alumni services billing, transcript hold ma

attributes.name: finance_vendor_id
attributes.description: Reference to the external collections agency assigned to this account if in external collections. Nullable if not in external collections.

attributes.name: patron_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to library.patron. Business justification: Students with billing accounts are library patrons. Unified identity enables integrated reporting of student financial obligations (tuition + library fines), consolidated holds (billing + library bloc

attributes.name: payment_plan_id
attributes.description: Reference to the active payment plan record if the student is enrolled in an installment plan. Nullable if not enrolled in a payment plan.

attributes.name: profile_id
attributes.description: Reference to the student who owns this financial account. Links to the student master record in the Student domain.
attributes.references: FERPA (Family Educational Rights and Privacy Act)

attributes.name: sponsor_id
attributes.description: Reference to the third-party sponsor or employer organization that is responsible for paying charges on this account. Nullable if no third-party billing arrangement exists.

attributes.name: account_closed_date
attributes.description: Date when the student account was closed. Nullable for active accounts. Closed when student graduates, withdraws, or account is otherwise terminated.

attributes.name: account_number
attributes.description: Externally-visible unique account number assigned to the student for billing and payment purposes. Used on billing statements, payment portals, and correspondence.

attributes.name: account_opened_date
attributes.description: Date when the student account was first established in the student accounts system. Typically corresponds to the students initial enrollment or admission acceptance.

attributes.name: account_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the student account. Active accounts are in good standing; suspended accounts have restrictions; closed accounts are no longer active; collections accounts are in debt recovery.
attributes.references: NACUBO (National Association of College and University Business Officers)

attributes.name: account_type
attributes.description: Classification of the student account based on the students enrollment category. Determines applicable tuition rates, fee structures, and billing policies.

attributes.name: anticipated_balance
attributes.description: Projected account balance after all pending charges and pending financial aid are applied. Used for payment planning and financial counseling.
attributes.references: NACUBO (National Association of College and University Business Officers)

attributes.name: billing_address_line1
attributes.description: First line of the billing address where statements and correspondence are sent. Typically contains street number and name.
attributes.references: FERPA (Family Educational Rights and Privacy Act)

attributes.name: billing_address_line2
attributes.description: Second line of the billing address for apartment, suite, or unit information. Nullable if not applicable.
attributes.references: FERPA (Family Educational Rights and Privacy Act)

attributes.name: billing_city
attributes.description: City name for the billing address where statements and correspondence are sent.
attributes.references: FERPA (Family Educational Rights and Privacy Act)

attributes.name: billing_country_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO country code for the billing address. Uses ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 standard.

attributes.name: billing_postal_code
attributes.description: Postal or ZIP code for the billing address where statements and correspondence are sent.
attributes.references: FERPA (Family Educational Rights and Privacy Act)

attributes.name: billing_state_province
attributes.description: State or province code for the billing address. Uses standard postal abbreviations.
attributes.references: FERPA (Family Educational Rights and Privacy Act)

attributes.name: collections_placement_date
attributes.description: Date when the account was placed with an external collections agency. Nullable if never placed in external collections.
attributes.references: NACUBO (National Association of College and University Business Officers)

attributes.name: collections_status
attributes.description: Current status of debt collection efforts for delinquent accounts. Tracks progression from internal collections through external agency placement and legal action.
attributes.references: NACUBO (National Association of College and University Business Officers)

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this student account record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage.

attributes.name: cumulative_adjustments
attributes.description: Total sum of all adjustments applied to the student account since inception. Includes waivers, write-offs, refunds, reversals, and other balance modifications.

attributes.name: cumulative_charges
attributes.description: Total sum of all charges posted to the student account since inception. Includes tuition, fees, housing, meal plans, fines, and other assessments.
attributes.references: NACUBO (National Association of College and University Business Officers)

attributes.name: cumulative_payments
attributes.description: Total sum of all payments received and applied to the student account since inception. Includes cash, check, credit card, electronic payments, and financial aid disbursements.
attributes.references: NACUBO (National Association of College and University Business Officers)

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO currency code for all monetary amounts on this account. Uses ISO 4217 standard. Typically USD for U.S. institutions.

attributes.name: current_balance
attributes.description: Current outstanding balance on the student account. Positive values indicate amounts owed by the student; negative values indicate credit balances owed to the student. Calculated as cumulative charges minus cumulative payments and adjustments.

attributes.name: has_graduation_hold
attributes.description: Indicates whether the student account has an active hold that prevents graduation or diploma issuance. True if graduation is blocked; false otherwise.

attributes.name: has_registration_hold
attributes.description: Indicates whether the student account has an active hold that prevents course registration. True if registration is blocked; false otherwise.

attributes.name: has_transcript_hold
attributes.description: Indicates whether the student account has an active hold that prevents transcript release. True if transcript release is blocked; false otherwise.

attributes.name: hold_count
attributes.description: Number of active holds currently placed on the student account. Holds may prevent registration, transcript release, or graduation based on hold type.

attributes.name: last_1098t_tax_year
attributes.description: Most recent tax year for which a 1098-T form was generated for this student account. Nullable if no 1098-T has been issued.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this student account record was most recently updated. Used for audit trail and change tracking.

attributes.name: last_payment_amount
attributes.description: Amount of the most recent payment received and posted to the student account. Nullable if no payments have been received.

attributes.name: last_payment_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent payment received and posted to the student account. Nullable if no payments have been received.

attributes.name: last_statement_date
attributes.description: Date when the most recent billing statement was generated for this student account. Used to track billing cycle history.

attributes.name: next_statement_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date for the next billing statement to be generated for this student account. Used for billing cycle planning and communication.

attributes.name: payment_plan_enrolled
attributes.description: Indicates whether the student is currently enrolled in an installment payment plan. True if enrolled; false otherwise.
attributes.references: NACUBO (National Association of College and University Business Officers)

attributes.name: pending_charges
attributes.description: Sum of charges that have been assessed but not yet posted to the account. Includes anticipated tuition and fees for upcoming terms that are in pre-billing status.

attributes.name: pending_financial_aid
attributes.description: Sum of financial aid awards that have been packaged but not yet disbursed to the student account. Includes anticipated grants, loans, scholarships, and work-study.
attributes.references: FAFSA (Free Application for Federal Student Aid)

attributes.name: tax_form_1098t_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether the student account is eligible for IRS Form 1098-T reporting of qualified tuition and related expenses. True if eligible; false otherwise.

attributes.name: third_party_billing_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether charges on this account are billed to a third-party sponsor or employer rather than directly to the student. True if third-party billing is active; false otherwise.
attributes.references: NACUBO (National Association of College and University Business Officers)

products.name: tuition_charge

Captures charge type (tuition, technology fee, health fee, activity fee), credit hour basis, rate applied, assessed amount, term, program level, residency classification (in-state/out-of-state), and charge status. Generated during automated fee assessment based on enrollment and fee schedule rules.

attributes.name: cost_center_id

attributes.name: course_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier of the specific course for which a course-specific fee is charged. Applicable for lab fees, course fees, or other course-related charges.

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: System user identifier of the person or automated process that assessed the charge. Used for audit trail and accountability.

attributes.name: fee_schedule_id

attributes.name: org_unit_id

attributes.name: profile_id

attributes.references: FERPA - Family Educational Rights and Privacy Act

attributes.name: statement_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to billing.billing_statement. Business justification: Tuition charges appear ON billing statements. A charge may be assessed in one period and appear on the next statement. This link tracks which statement a charge was included in for billing and reconci

attributes.name: student_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to billing.student_account. Business justification: Tuition charges are posted TO a student account. Currently tuition_charge links to profile and term, but not to the student_account master record. This is the authoritative account for charge posting

attributes.name: term_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier of the academic term for which this tuition charge applies. Links to the term master record.
attributes.references: IPEDS - Integrated Postsecondary Education Data System

attributes.name: adjustment_amount
attributes.description: Dollar amount of any adjustment applied to the original charge. Positive for additional charges, negative for reductions or credits.

attributes.name: adjustment_reason
attributes.description: Free-text explanation of why an adjustment was made to the original charge. Provides context for billing office and audit purposes.

attributes.name: assessment_date
attributes.description: Date on which the charge was assessed to the student account. Represents the business event date for billing purposes.

attributes.name: billing_method
attributes.description: Method used to calculate and assess the tuition charge. Determines whether per-credit-hour rates or flat fees are applied.

attributes.name: charge_amount
attributes.description: Total dollar amount of the charge assessed to the student account. Calculated based on credit hours, rate, or flat fee depending on billing model.

attributes.name: charge_code
attributes.description: System-generated or manually assigned code identifying the specific type of charge. Used for billing categorization and financial reporting.

attributes.name: charge_description
attributes.description: Human-readable description of the charge providing context for the student and billing office. May include course title, fee purpose, or program name.

attributes.name: charge_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the charge indicating whether it has been assessed, posted to the student account, adjusted, reversed, waived, or cancelled.

attributes.name: charge_type
attributes.description: Classification of the charge indicating whether it is tuition or a specific mandatory or course-related fee. Determines billing rules and revenue allocation. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: tuition|technology_fee|health_fee|activity_fee|lab_fee|course_fee|program_fee|registration_fee — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the tuition charge record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage.

attributes.name: credit_hours
attributes.description: Number of credit hours for which the student is enrolled and upon which tuition is calculated. Used for per-credit-hour billing models.
attributes.references: IPEDS - Integrated Postsecondary Education Data System

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code indicating the currency in which the charge is denominated. Typically USD for U.S. institutions.

attributes.name: due_date
attributes.description: Date by which the charge must be paid to avoid late fees or account holds. Determined by institutional billing policy and term calendar.

attributes.name: flat_rate_amount
attributes.description: Fixed dollar amount charged for tuition when a flat-rate billing model is applied (e.g., full-time students above a credit hour threshold).

attributes.name: is_refundable
attributes.description: Indicates whether the charge is eligible for refund if the student drops the course or withdraws from the term. Determined by institutional refund policy and timing.

attributes.name: is_reportable_1098t
attributes.description: Indicates whether the charge is reportable on the IRS Form 1098-T for qualified tuition and related expenses. Required for federal tax reporting compliance.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the tuition charge record was last updated. Used for audit trail and change tracking.

attributes.name: net_charge_amount
attributes.description: Final dollar amount of the charge after all adjustments have been applied. Represents the amount owed by the student.

attributes.name: posted_date
attributes.description: Date on which the charge was officially posted to the student account and became due. May differ from assessment date due to billing cycle timing.

attributes.name: program_level
attributes.description: Academic level of the program for which the student is enrolled and charged. Determines applicable tuition rate and fee structure.
attributes.references: IPEDS - Integrated Postsecondary Education Data System

attributes.name: rate_per_credit_hour
attributes.description: Dollar amount charged per credit hour for tuition. Rate varies by program level, residency classification, and student type.

attributes.name: refund_percentage
attributes.description: Percentage of the charge that is refundable based on the date of withdrawal or drop. Decreases over time according to institutional refund schedule.

attributes.name: residency_classification
attributes.description: Classification of the student's residency status for tuition purposes. In-state residents typically receive lower tuition rates than out-of-state or international students.

attributes.name: revenue_category
attributes.description: High-level classification of the revenue type for financial reporting purposes. Aligns with institutional chart of accounts and GASB/FASB standards.

attributes.name: reversal_reason
attributes.description: Free-text explanation of why the charge was reversed. Required for audit trail and financial reconciliation.

attributes.name: student_type
attributes.description: Classification of the student's enrollment type. Affects billing model, fee assessment, and eligibility for certain charges.
attributes.references: IPEDS - Integrated Postsecondary Education Data System

attributes.name: waiver_amount
attributes.description: Dollar amount of the waiver applied to the charge. Reduces the net amount owed by the student.

attributes.name: waiver_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the type of waiver applied to reduce or eliminate the charge. Examples include employee tuition waiver, athletic scholarship waiver, or graduate assistant waiver.

products.name: statement
products.description: Periodic billing statement issued to a student or authorized payer summarizing charges, credits, payments, financial aid disbursements, and balance due for a billing cycle. Tracks statement date, due date, total charges, total credits, net balance, delivery method (email, portal, paper), and statement status. Generated during scheduled billing cycle processing.

attributes.name: statement_id

attributes.name: finance_vendor_id

attributes.name: payment_plan_id
attributes.description: Reference to an active payment plan arrangement if the student is enrolled in an installment payment program.

attributes.name: profile_id
attributes.description: Reference to the student who is the primary account holder for this billing statement.

attributes.name: student_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to billing.student_account. Business justification: Billing statements are generated FOR a student account. This is the master account-to-statement relationship. Currently billing_statement links to profile and term, but not to the student_account mast

attributes.name: term_id
attributes.description: Reference to the academic term for which this billing statement was generated.

attributes.name: account_hold_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether an account hold has been placed due to unpaid balance, preventing registration or transcript release.

attributes.name: adjustment_amount
attributes.description: Total adjustments applied to this statement including billing corrections, charge reversals, or administrative credits.

attributes.name: billing_address_line1
attributes.description: First line of the billing address to which paper statements are mailed or used for payment processing.

attributes.name: billing_address_line2
attributes.description: Second line of the billing address for apartment, suite, or additional address details.

attributes.name: billing_city
attributes.description: City component of the billing address.

attributes.name: billing_country_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code for the billing address.

attributes.name: billing_cycle
attributes.description: The billing cycle period for which this statement was generated (e.g., fall semester, spring semester, monthly).

attributes.name: billing_postal_code
attributes.description: Postal or ZIP code component of the billing address.

attributes.name: billing_state_province
attributes.description: State or province component of the billing address.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this billing statement record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for all monetary amounts on this statement (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP).

attributes.name: delivery_method
attributes.description: Method by which the billing statement was delivered to the student or authorized payer.

attributes.name: delivery_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the billing statement was delivered or made available to the student.

attributes.name: due_date
attributes.description: Date by which payment is due to avoid late fees or account holds.

attributes.name: fee_charges
attributes.description: Total mandatory and optional fees assessed including technology fees, student activity fees, lab fees, and course-specific fees.

attributes.name: financial_aid_disbursed
attributes.description: Total financial aid disbursements applied to this statement including federal, state, and institutional aid.

attributes.name: grant_amount
attributes.description: Total grant awards applied as credits including federal Pell grants, state grants, and institutional grants.

attributes.name: housing_charges
attributes.description: Total charges for on-campus housing or university-managed residential facilities.

attributes.name: is_1098t_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether charges and payments on this statement are eligible for inclusion in IRS Form 1098-T tuition statement reporting.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this billing statement record was last updated or modified.

attributes.name: late_fee_amount
attributes.description: Late payment fees assessed if payment was not received by the due date.

attributes.name: loan_disbursement
attributes.description: Total student loan disbursements applied to this statement including federal direct loans, PLUS loans, and private loans.
attributes.references: Title IV Federal Student Aid Regulations

attributes.name: meal_plan_charges
attributes.description: Total charges for dining services and meal plan subscriptions.

attributes.name: minimum_payment_due
attributes.description: Minimum payment amount required by the due date to avoid late fees or account holds, applicable when payment plans are in effect.

attributes.name: net_balance
attributes.description: Net amount due calculated as total charges minus total credits and payments. Positive indicates amount owed; negative indicates credit balance.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes or messages included on the statement for student communication regarding special circumstances, payment instructions, or account alerts.

attributes.name: previous_balance
attributes.description: Balance carried forward from the previous billing statement, if applicable.

attributes.name: refund_amount
attributes.description: Total refunds issued to the student for overpayment or credit balance, typically disbursed after financial aid exceeds charges.
attributes.references: Title IV Federal Student Aid Regulations

attributes.name: scholarship_amount
attributes.description: Total scholarship awards applied as credits to this statement from institutional, external, or donor-funded sources.

attributes.name: statement_date
attributes.description: Date on which the billing statement was generated and issued to the student or authorized payer.

attributes.name: statement_number
attributes.description: Externally-visible unique statement number used for reference in communications and payment processing.
attributes.references: NACUBO - National Association of College and University Business Officers

attributes.name: statement_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the billing statement indicating payment and processing state. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: draft|issued|paid|partially_paid|overdue|cancelled|adjusted — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: tax_year
attributes.description: Calendar year for which charges and payments on this statement apply for IRS Form 1098-T reporting purposes.

attributes.name: third_party_sponsor_amount
attributes.description: Total payments or credits from third-party sponsors such as employers, government agencies, or external organizations.

attributes.name: total_charges
attributes.description: Sum of all charges assessed on this statement including tuition, fees, housing, meal plans, and other institutional charges.

attributes.name: total_credits
attributes.description: Sum of all credits applied to this statement including financial aid disbursements, scholarships, grants, refunds, and adjustments.

attributes.name: total_payments
attributes.description: Sum of all payments received and applied to this statement from student, sponsor, or third-party sources.

attributes.name: tuition_charges

attributes.references: IPEDS - Integrated Postsecondary Education Data System

products.name: payment
products.description: Record of a payment received against a student account. Captures payment method (check, ACH, credit card, wire transfer, cash), payment amount, payment date, payer type (student, parent, sponsor, employer), confirmation number, processor reference, applied term, and payment status (pending, cleared, reversed). SSOT for all inbound monetary receipts in the billing domain.

attributes.name: payment_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the payment transaction. Primary key for the payment record.

attributes.name: alumnus_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to advancement.alumnus. Business justification: Alumni payments for transcripts, parking permits, facility rentals, continuing education, and other services. Required for comprehensive alumni transaction history and correlation with donor giving pa

attributes.name: cashier_session_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the cashier or staff member who processed the payment, if applicable. Used for audit trail and accountability in manual payment processing.

attributes.name: journal_entry_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the payment batch or deposit group to which this payment belongs. Used for reconciliation of daily deposits and batch processing.
attributes.references: NACUBO - National Association of College and University Business Officers

attributes.name: payment_plan_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the payment plan to which this payment is applied, if the payment is part of an installment or deferred payment arrangement.
attributes.references: NACUBO - National Association of College and University Business Officers

attributes.name: primary_reversed_by_payment_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the reversal payment transaction that reversed this payment. Creates an audit trail linking original payments to their reversals.

attributes.name: profile_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the student whose account this payment is applied to. Links payment to the student master record.
attributes.references: FERPA - Family Educational Rights and Privacy Act

attributes.name: student_account_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the student account to which this payment is applied. Links payment to the billing account.

attributes.name: term_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the academic term to which this payment is applied. Used for term-specific payment allocation and reporting.
attributes.references: IPEDS - Integrated Postsecondary Education Data System

attributes.name: amount
attributes.description: The total monetary amount of the payment received, in the institution's base currency. Represents the gross payment before any adjustments or allocations.

attributes.name: authorization_code
attributes.description: The authorization code provided by the credit card issuer or payment processor confirming approval of the transaction. Applicable to credit and debit card payments.
attributes.references: PCI DSS - Payment Card Industry Data Security Standard

attributes.name: bank_account_last_four
attributes.description: The last four digits of the bank account number used for the payment. Stored for payment verification while maintaining PCI compliance by not storing full account numbers.
attributes.references: PCI DSS - Payment Card Industry Data Security Standard

attributes.name: bank_routing_number
attributes.description: The nine-digit ABA routing number of the bank from which the payment originated. Applicable to ACH and check payments. Used for payment verification and reconciliation.
attributes.references: NACHA - National Automated Clearing House Association

attributes.name: base_currency_amount
attributes.description: The payment amount converted to the institution's base currency using the exchange rate. Used for financial reporting and account reconciliation.

attributes.name: card_last_four
attributes.description: The last four digits of the credit or debit card number used for the payment. Stored for payment verification while maintaining PCI compliance.
attributes.references: PCI DSS - Payment Card Industry Data Security Standard

attributes.name: card_type
attributes.description: The brand or type of credit or debit card used for the payment. Applicable only to card-based payments.
attributes.references: PCI DSS - Payment Card Industry Data Security Standard

attributes.name: channel
attributes.description: The interface or channel through which the payment was submitted. Indicates where the payer initiated the transaction (e.g., web portal, mobile app, in-person at cashier, mail, phone).

attributes.name: check_number
attributes.description: The check number from the physical check or money order used for payment. Used for tracking and reconciliation of check payments.
attributes.references: NACUBO - National Association of College and University Business Officers

attributes.name: cleared_date
attributes.description: The date on which the payment cleared the bank or payment processor and funds were confirmed as available. Applicable to checks, ACH, and credit card payments.
attributes.references: NACUBO - National Association of College and University Business Officers

attributes.name: confirmation_number
attributes.description: Externally-visible confirmation or receipt number provided to the payer upon successful payment processing. Used for payment lookup and reconciliation.
attributes.references: NACUBO - National Association of College and University Business Officers

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this payment record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage tracking.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code indicating the currency in which the payment was made. Supports international student payments in foreign currencies.

attributes.name: deposit_date
attributes.description: The date on which the payment was deposited to the institution's bank account. Used for cash flow management and bank reconciliation.

attributes.name: exchange_rate
attributes.description: The exchange rate applied to convert the payment from the original currency to the institution's base currency. Applicable only for foreign currency payments.

attributes.name: installment_number
attributes.description: The sequential installment number if this payment is part of a payment plan. Indicates which installment this payment satisfies (e.g., 1 of 4, 2 of 4).
attributes.references: NACUBO - National Association of College and University Business Officers

attributes.name: is_refundable
attributes.description: Indicates whether this payment is eligible for refund based on institutional policy and payment timing. Used to enforce refund eligibility rules.
attributes.references: NACUBO - National Association of College and University Business Officers

attributes.name: net_payment_amount
attributes.description: The net amount received by the institution after deducting processing fees. Represents the actual funds available for application to the student account.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes or comments regarding the payment transaction. Used to capture special instructions, payment purpose, or other contextual information.

attributes.name: payer_email
attributes.description: The email address of the payer. Used for sending payment confirmations, receipts, and communication regarding the payment transaction.
attributes.references: FERPA - Family Educational Rights and Privacy Act

attributes.name: payer_name
attributes.description: The full name of the individual or organization making the payment. Used for payment reconciliation and third-party billing verification.
attributes.references: FERPA - Family Educational Rights and Privacy Act

attributes.name: payer_phone
attributes.description: The contact phone number of the payer. Used for payment verification and follow-up communication if issues arise with the payment.
attributes.references: FERPA - Family Educational Rights and Privacy Act

attributes.name: payer_type
attributes.description: The category or relationship of the party making the payment. Indicates whether the payment is from the student, parent, sponsor, employer, or other third party.
attributes.references: FERPA - Family Educational Rights and Privacy Act

attributes.name: payment_date
attributes.description: The date on which the payment was received or initiated by the payer. This is the business event date for the payment transaction.

attributes.name: payment_method
attributes.description: The financial instrument or mechanism used to make the payment. Indicates how the funds were transferred (e.g., check, ACH, credit card, wire transfer, cash). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: check|ach|credit_card|debit_card|wire_transfer|cash|money_order — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: PCI DSS - Payment Card Industry Data Security Standard

attributes.name: payment_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the payment transaction. Indicates whether the payment has been received, cleared by the bank, posted to the student account, or reversed.
attributes.references: NACUBO - National Association of College and University Business Officers

attributes.name: payment_timestamp
attributes.description: The precise date and time when the payment transaction was received or processed by the institution. Used for audit trail and reconciliation.

attributes.name: posted_date
attributes.description: The date on which the payment was officially posted to the student account ledger. May differ from payment_date due to processing delays or batch posting cycles.

attributes.name: processing_fee
attributes.description: The fee charged by the payment processor or merchant service provider for processing the payment. May be absorbed by the institution or passed to the payer.
attributes.references: NACUBO - National Association of College and University Business Officers

attributes.name: processor_reference
attributes.description: The unique transaction identifier or reference number assigned by the payment processor or gateway. Used for reconciliation with processor settlement reports.
attributes.references: PCI DSS - Payment Card Industry Data Security Standard

attributes.name: reversal_reason
attributes.description: The reason for reversing or voiding the payment, if applicable. Includes reasons such as insufficient funds, duplicate payment, student withdrawal, or payer request.
attributes.references: NACUBO - National Association of College and University Business Officers

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this payment record was last modified. Used for audit trail and change tracking.

products.name: payment_plan
products.description: Installment payment plan agreement established for a student to spread tuition and fee obligations across multiple scheduled payments within a term. Tracks plan type, enrollment date, total plan amount, number of installments, enrollment fee, down payment amount, plan status (active, completed, defaulted, cancelled), and the administering term.

attributes.name: payment_plan_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the payment plan agreement. Primary key.

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: System user identifier of the financial aid or student accounts staff member who approved the payment plan enrollment.

attributes.name: policy_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.policy. Business justification: Payment plans are offered under institutional policies defining eligibility criteria, enrollment fees, installment terms, interest rates, and default consequences. Policy reference is required for pla

attributes.name: profile_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier of the student who enrolled in this payment plan.

attributes.name: term_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier of the academic term for which this payment plan applies.

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: Date when the payment plan was officially approved by the institution.
attributes.references: NACUBO - National Association of College and University Business Officers

attributes.name: auto_pay_enabled_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether automatic payment processing is enabled for this payment plan (True if auto-pay is active, False otherwise).

attributes.name: cancellation_date

attributes.description: Date when the payment plan obligations and installment schedule officially begin.

attributes.name: enrollment_fee_amount

attributes.name: final_installment_due_date
attributes.description: Date when the final scheduled installment payment is due, marking the completion of the payment plan.

attributes.name: first_installment_due_date
attributes.description: Date when the first scheduled installment payment is due.

attributes.name: grace_period_days
attributes.description: Number of days after the installment due date before late fees are assessed or the plan is considered in default.

attributes.name: installment_amount

attributes.name: installment_frequency
attributes.description: Frequency at which installment payments are scheduled (monthly, biweekly, weekly, or custom schedule).

attributes.description: Number of scheduled installment payments that were not received by their due date.

attributes.description: Number of installment payments that have been successfully received and applied to the payment plan.

attributes.name: interest_rate_percent
attributes.description: Annual interest rate percentage applied to the payment plan balance, if applicable. Zero for interest-free plans.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this payment plan record was most recently updated in the system.

attributes.name: late_fee_amount
attributes.description: Standard late fee amount charged when an installment payment is not received by the due date.
attributes.references: NACUBO - National Association of College and University Business Officers

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional comments, special terms, or administrative notes related to the payment plan agreement.

attributes.name: number_of_installments
attributes.description: Total count of scheduled installment payments in the payment plan agreement.
attributes.references: NACUBO - National Association of College and University Business Officers

attributes.name: outstanding_balance_amount
attributes.description: Remaining unpaid balance on the payment plan, calculated as total plan amount minus total paid amount plus any accrued fees or interest.

attributes.name: payment_method_type
attributes.description: Primary payment instrument type used for installment payments (ACH bank transfer, credit card, debit card, check, cash, wire transfer).

attributes.name: plan_number
attributes.description: Externally visible unique business identifier for the payment plan agreement, typically formatted as PP followed by 8 digits.

attributes.name: plan_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the payment plan: active (in good standing), completed (all payments made), defaulted (missed payments beyond grace period), cancelled (terminated by student or institution), suspended (temporarily on hold), pending (awaiting approval or first payment).

attributes.name: plan_type
attributes.description: Classification of the payment plan based on institutional offerings (standard multi-month plan, extended plan with more installments, custom negotiated plan, emergency short-term plan, deferred payment plan).

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Name of the operational system from which this payment plan record originated (e.g., Ellucian Banner Student Accounts, Nelnet Payment Plans, Cashnet).

attributes.name: total_paid_amount
attributes.description: Cumulative total of all payments received against this payment plan to date, including down payment and installments.

attributes.name: total_plan_amount
attributes.description: Total amount of tuition, fees, and other charges covered by this payment plan agreement, excluding enrollment fees and interest.

products.name: payment_plan_installment
products.description: Individual scheduled installment within a student payment plan. Captures installment sequence number, scheduled due date, scheduled amount, actual payment date, amount paid, remaining balance, late fee assessed flag, and installment status (scheduled, paid, overdue, waived). Links to the parent payment_plan for plan-level terms and references payment records when fulfilled via payment application.
products.reference: Banner TSAINSTL / Payment Plan Installment Schedule

attributes.name: payment_plan_installment_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the payment plan installment. Primary key for this entity.

attributes.name: payment_plan_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent payment plan under which this installment is scheduled. Links to the payment_plan product for plan-level terms and conditions.

attributes.name: actual_payment_date
attributes.description: The date on which the installment was actually paid by the student or sponsor. Null if the installment has not yet been paid.

attributes.name: adjustment_amount
attributes.description: Dollar amount of any manual adjustment applied to this installment after initial scheduling. Positive values increase the installment amount, negative values decrease it. Used for institutional corrections or student-specific modifications.

attributes.name: adjustment_authorized_by
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the institutional staff member who authorized the adjustment to this installment. Used for audit trail and accountability.

attributes.name: adjustment_date
attributes.description: The date on which the adjustment to this installment was authorized and applied. Used for audit trail and financial reconciliation.

attributes.name: adjustment_reason
attributes.description: Explanation or justification for any adjustment applied to the installment amount. Examples include billing error correction, financial aid disbursement, or institutional credit.

attributes.name: amount_paid
attributes.description: The actual dollar amount paid toward this installment. May differ from scheduled_amount if partial payments or overpayments occur. Null if unpaid.

attributes.name: auto_pay_attempt_date
attributes.description: The date on which an automatic payment attempt was made for this installment. Populated only if auto_pay_enabled is True and an attempt has been processed.

attributes.name: auto_pay_enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether automatic payment processing is enabled for this installment. True if the installment is scheduled for automatic deduction from a stored payment method, False otherwise.

attributes.name: auto_pay_failure_reason
attributes.description: Explanation or error message describing why an automatic payment attempt failed. Examples include insufficient funds, expired card, or payment method declined. Populated only when auto_pay_status is failed.

attributes.name: auto_pay_status
attributes.description: Status of the automatic payment attempt for this installment. Pending: scheduled but not yet processed. Successful: payment processed successfully. Failed: payment attempt declined or failed. Not Attempted: auto pay not enabled or not yet due.

attributes.name: collections_agency
attributes.description: Name of the external collections agency to which this overdue installment was referred. Populated only if collections_referral_date is not null.

attributes.name: collections_referral_date
attributes.description: The date on which this overdue installment was referred to a collections agency or internal collections process. Indicates escalation of delinquent payment.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this installment record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage tracking.

attributes.name: effective_due_date
attributes.description: The actual date by which payment must be received to avoid late fees, calculated as scheduled_due_date plus grace_period_days. Used for late fee assessment logic.

attributes.name: grace_period_days
attributes.description: Number of days after the scheduled due date during which payment can be made without incurring a late fee. Typically set at the plan level but may be overridden at the installment level.

attributes.name: hold_applied
attributes.description: Indicates whether an account hold has been applied to the student account due to this installment being overdue. True if hold is active, False otherwise. Holds may prevent registration or transcript release.

attributes.name: hold_applied_date

products.name: tax_form_1098t
products.description: IRS Form 1098-T record generated annually for each eligible student reporting qualified tuition and related expenses (QTRE) and scholarships/grants for federal tax purposes. Captures tax year, Box 1 (payments received), Box 5 (scholarships/grants), Box 8 (at least half-time enrollment), Box 9 (graduate student), TIN, delivery consent (electronic/paper), and IRS submission status. Required for Title IV compliance.

attributes.name: tax_form_1098t_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the IRS Form 1098-T record. Primary key for the tax form entity.

attributes.name: alumnus_id

attributes.name: original_form_tax_form_1098t_id
attributes.description: Reference to the original 1098-T form ID that this corrected form is replacing. Populated only when correction_indicator is true.

attributes.description: Identifier of the student for whom this 1098-T form is generated. Links to the student master record.

attributes.name: regulatory_requirement_id

Each form must reference the specific regulatory requirement for audit verification, IRS compliance reviews, and to document the l
