attributes.name: box10_insurance_contract_reimbursement
attributes.business_glossary_term: Box 10 Amounts Billed for Insurance Contract Reimbursement or Refund
attributes.description: Amounts billed for qualified tuition and related expenses that were reimbursed or refunded under an insurance contract. Reported in Box 10. Rare field, typically zero.

attributes.name: box1_payments_received
attributes.business_glossary_term: Box 1 Payments Received for Qualified Tuition and Related Expenses (QTRE)
attributes.description: Total payments received during the tax year for qualified tuition and related expenses. Reported in Box 1 of Form 1098-T. Represents amounts actually paid by or on behalf of the student.

attributes.name: box2_amounts_billed
attributes.business_glossary_term: Box 2 Amounts Billed for Qualified Tuition and Related Expenses (QTRE)
attributes.description: Total amounts billed during the tax year for qualified tuition and related expenses. Reported in Box 2 of Form 1098-T. Used by institutions that report amounts billed rather than amounts received. Mutually exclusive with Box 1 reporting method.

attributes.name: box3_change_reporting_method
attributes.business_glossary_term: Box 3 Change in Reporting Method Indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether the institution changed its reporting method from prior year amounts billed (Box 2) to amounts received (Box 1) or vice versa. Checked if true.

attributes.name: box4_adjustments_prior_year
attributes.business_glossary_term: Box 4 Adjustments Made for a Prior Year
attributes.description: Adjustments to qualified tuition and related expenses reported on a prior year 1098-T. May be positive (additional charges) or negative (refunds/reductions). Reported in Box 4.

attributes.name: box5_scholarships_grants
attributes.description: Total amount of scholarships and grants administered and processed by the institution during the tax year. Reported in Box 5. Includes Title IV federal aid, state grants, and institutional scholarships.

attributes.name: box6_adjustments_scholarships_prior_year
attributes.business_glossary_term: Box 6 Adjustments to Scholarships or Grants for a Prior Year
attributes.description: Adjustments to scholarships or grants reported on a prior year 1098-T. May be positive or negative. Reported in Box 6.

attributes.name: box7_checked_amount_includes_expenses
attributes.business_glossary_term: Box 7 Checked if Amount Includes Expenses for Academic Period Beginning January Through March
attributes.description: Indicates whether the amounts reported in Box 1 or Box 2 include expenses for an academic period that begins in the first three months of the following calendar year. Checked if true.

attributes.name: box8_half_time_student
attributes.business_glossary_term: Box 8 At Least Half-Time Student Indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether the student was enrolled at least half-time for at least one academic period that began during the tax year. Checked if true. Used to determine eligibility for certain education tax credits.

attributes.name: box9_graduate_student
attributes.description: Indicates whether the student was enrolled in a graduate-level program during the tax year. Checked if true. Affects eligibility for certain education tax benefits.

attributes.name: correction_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether this 1098-T is a corrected form replacing a previously filed form for the same student and tax year. True if this is a correction.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this 1098-T form record was first created in the system. Part of audit trail.

attributes.name: delivery_method
attributes.description: Method by which the 1098-T form is delivered to the student: electronic (via secure portal), paper (mailed), or both. Institutions must obtain student consent for electronic delivery.

attributes.name: electronic_consent_date
attributes.description: Date on which the student provided consent to receive the 1098-T form electronically. Required if delivery_method is electronic. Must be obtained prior to electronic delivery.

attributes.name: eligibility_reason
attributes.description: Reason why the student is eligible (or not eligible) for a 1098-T form. Students must be enrolled in credit courses and have qualifying transactions to receive a form.

attributes.name: filer_address_line1
attributes.description: Primary street address line for the educational institution filing the 1098-T form.

attributes.name: filer_city
attributes.description: City name for the educational institution's address.

attributes.description: Legal name of the educational institution filing the 1098-T form. Must match the name on file with the IRS for the filer EIN.

attributes.description: ZIP code for the educational institution's address.

attributes.name: filer_state
attributes.description: Two-letter state code for the educational institution's address.

attributes.name: form_number
attributes.description: Unique form number assigned to this 1098-T instance for tracking and reference purposes. Typically includes tax year and student identifier components.

attributes.name: form_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the 1098-T form. Tracks progression from draft through IRS filing and any subsequent corrections or voids.

attributes.name: irs_confirmation_number
attributes.description: Confirmation number received from the IRS FIRE system upon successful submission of the 1098-T form. Serves as proof of filing.

attributes.name: irs_submission_date
attributes.description: Date on which the 1098-T form was electronically filed with the IRS via the FIRE (Filing Information Returns Electronically) system. Required for Title IV compliance tracking.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional notes, comments, or special circumstances related to this 1098-T form. Used for internal documentation and audit trail purposes.

attributes.name: reporting_method
attributes.description: Indicates whether the institution reports qualified tuition and related expenses using the payments received method (Box 1) or the amounts billed method (Box 2). Institutions must use one method consistently.

attributes.name: student_address_line1
attributes.description: Primary street address line for the student's mailing address as of the tax year end. Required for IRS Form 1098-T mailing.

attributes.name: student_address_line2
attributes.description: Secondary address line (apartment, suite, unit number) for the student's mailing address. Optional field.

attributes.name: student_city
attributes.description: City name for the student's mailing address as of the tax year end.

attributes.name: student_country
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO country code for the student's mailing address. Defaults to USA for domestic students.

attributes.name: student_delivery_date
attributes.description: Date on which the 1098-T form was delivered to the student (electronically posted or mailed). Must be on or before January 31 following the tax year.

attributes.name: student_legal_name

attributes.name: student_postal_code
attributes.description: ZIP code or ZIP+4 code for the student's mailing address. Five-digit or nine-digit format.

attributes.name: student_state
attributes.description: Two-letter state or territory code for the student's mailing address (e.g., CA, NY, TX). Uses USPS standard abbreviations.

attributes.name: student_tin
attributes.description: The student's Social Security Number (SSN) or Individual Taxpayer Identification Number (ITIN) as reported to the IRS. Required for IRS filing.

attributes.name: tax_year
attributes.description: The calendar year for which qualified tuition and related expenses (QTRE) and scholarships/grants are being reported to the IRS. Four-digit year (e.g., 2023).

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this 1098-T form record was last modified. Updated whenever any field changes. Part of audit trail.

attributes.name: payment_plan_installment_id

attributes.name: policy_id

attributes.name: primary_late_employee_id

attributes.name: profile_id

attributes.name: statement_id

attributes.name: student_account_id

attributes.name: term_id

attributes.name: tuition_charge_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the original tuition or fee charge that triggered the late fee assessment due to missed payment deadline.

attributes.name: appeal_date

attributes.name: appeal_status
attributes.description: Current status of the students appeal of the late fee assessment.

attributes.name: appeal_submitted_flag

attributes.name: assessment_date
attributes.description: Date on which the late fee was assessed to the student account, representing the principal business event timestamp for this transaction.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp indicating when this late fee record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code indicating the currency in which the late fee is denominated.

attributes.name: days_past_due
attributes.description: Number of days the payment was overdue at the time the late fee was assessed.

attributes.name: fee_amount
attributes.description: Monetary amount of the late fee assessed to the student account.

attributes.name: fee_number
attributes.description: Business-facing unique reference number for the late fee assessment, used for tracking and correspondence.

attributes.name: fee_percentage
attributes.description: Percentage rate applied to the outstanding balance to calculate the late fee, if the fee type is percentage-based.

attributes.name: fee_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the late fee assessment indicating whether it is active, waived, reversed, or paid.

attributes.name: fee_type
attributes.description: Classification of the late fee calculation method, indicating whether it is a flat rate, percentage of balance, or tiered based on days overdue.

attributes.name: fund_code
attributes.description: Fund code indicating the institutional fund to which the late fee revenue is allocated.

attributes.name: grace_period_days
attributes.description: Number of grace period days allowed after the original due date before the late fee is assessed.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp indicating when this late fee record was last updated or modified in the system.

attributes.name: net_fee_amount
attributes.description: Net monetary amount of the late fee after applying any waivers or adjustments, representing the actual amount owed by the student.

attributes.name: notes

attributes.name: notification_method

attributes.name: notification_sent_date
attributes.description: Date on which the late fee assessment notification was sent to the student.

attributes.name: notification_sent_flag

attributes.name: original_due_date
attributes.description: Original scheduled due date for the payment that was missed, triggering the late fee assessment.

attributes.name: posted_date
attributes.description: Date on which the late fee was officially posted to the student account ledger and became part of the outstanding balance.

attributes.name: reversal_date
attributes.description: Date on which the late fee assessment was reversed or cancelled.

attributes.name: reversal_flag
attributes.description: Indicator of whether this late fee assessment has been reversed or cancelled.

attributes.name: reversal_reason
attributes.description: Textual explanation of why the late fee assessment was reversed, such as administrative error or successful appeal.

attributes.name: waiver_amount
attributes.description: Monetary amount of the late fee that was waived or forgiven, reducing the net amount owed by the student.

attributes.name: waiver_date
attributes.description: Date on which the late fee waiver was approved and applied to the student account.

attributes.name: waiver_eligible_flag
attributes.description: Indicator of whether the late fee is eligible for waiver based on institutional policy, student circumstances, or appeal process.

attributes.name: waiver_reason_code
attributes.description: Code indicating the reason for waiving the late fee, such as financial hardship, administrative error, or first-time courtesy.

attributes.name: waiver_reason_description
attributes.description: Detailed textual description of the reason for waiving the late fee, providing context for the waiver decision.

attributes.name: waived_late_fee_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing FK on late_fee (waived_late_fee_id)

products.name: cashier_session
products.description: Transactional record of a cashier window session capturing opening balance, closing balance, session operator, transaction count, and reconciliation status for in-person payment processing.

attributes.name: cashier_session_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the cashier session. Primary key.

attributes.name: building_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the bursar office or cashier office location where this session took place.

attributes.name: configuration_item_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the physical or virtual cashier workstation or terminal used for this session.

attributes.name: journal_entry_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the deposit batch to which this cashier session's receipts were assigned for bank deposit.

attributes.name: primary_cashier_employee_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the cashier or operator who conducted this session.

attributes.name: quaternary_cashier_last_modified_by_user_employee_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the user who last modified this cashier session record.

attributes.name: term_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the academic term during which this cashier session occurred, used for term-based financial reporting.

attributes.name: tertiary_cashier_supervisor_employee_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the supervisor responsible for oversight of this cashier session.

attributes.name: business_date
attributes.description: The business or fiscal date assigned to this cashier session, which may differ from the actual calendar date for sessions spanning midnight or for backdated entries.

attributes.name: card_receipts_amount
attributes.description: The total amount of credit and debit card payments received during the session.

attributes.name: cash_receipts_amount
attributes.description: The total amount of cash payments received during the session.

attributes.name: check_receipts_amount
attributes.description: The total amount of check payments received during the session.

attributes.name: closed_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the cashier session was closed and no longer accepting transactions.

attributes.name: closing_balance_amount
attributes.description: The ending cash or fund balance in the cashier drawer at the close of the session, before reconciliation adjustments.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this cashier session record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code indicating the currency used for this cashier session (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP).

attributes.name: deposit_date
attributes.description: The date on which the funds from this cashier session were deposited to the bank.

attributes.name: expected_balance_amount
attributes.description: The calculated expected balance based on opening balance plus receipts minus disbursements, used for variance analysis.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this cashier session record was last updated or modified.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-form notes or comments about the cashier session, including any unusual circumstances, system issues, or operational observations.

attributes.name: opened_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the cashier session was opened and became active for transaction processing.

attributes.name: opening_balance_amount
attributes.description: The starting cash or fund balance in the cashier drawer at the beginning of the session, used as the baseline for reconciliation.

attributes.name: other_receipts_amount
attributes.description: The total amount of payments received through other methods (money orders, wire transfers, etc.) during the session.

attributes.name: payment_count
attributes.description: The number of payment receipt transactions processed during the session.

attributes.name: reconciled_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the cashier session was reconciled and verified against expected balances.

attributes.name: reconciliation_status
attributes.description: Status of the reconciliation process indicating whether the session balanced correctly, has acceptable variance, or requires further review.

attributes.name: refund_count
attributes.description: The number of refund or disbursement transactions processed during the session.

attributes.name: session_number
attributes.description: Human-readable business identifier for the cashier session, often used for reconciliation and audit purposes.

attributes.name: session_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the cashier session indicating whether it is active, closed, reconciled, temporarily suspended, or voided.

attributes.name: session_type
attributes.description: Classification of the cashier session indicating the purpose or context (regular operations, emergency processing, training session, or audit session).

attributes.name: total_disbursements_amount
attributes.description: The total amount of refunds, change, or other disbursements made during the cashier session.

attributes.name: total_receipts_amount
attributes.description: The total amount of payments and receipts collected during the cashier session across all payment methods.

attributes.name: transaction_count
attributes.description: The total number of payment transactions processed during the cashier session.

attributes.name: variance_amount
attributes.description: The difference between the expected balance and the actual closing balance, indicating overage or shortage in the session.

attributes.name: variance_explanation
attributes.description: Detailed narrative explanation of any variance, including corrective actions taken or planned.

attributes.name: variance_reason_code
attributes.description: Code indicating the documented reason for any variance between expected and actual balances (e.g., counting error, unrecorded transaction, theft).

attributes.name: variance_tolerance_amount
attributes.description: The acceptable variance threshold amount for this session; variances within this amount are considered acceptable.

attributes.name: void_count
attributes.description: The number of voided or cancelled transactions during the session.

attributes.name: prior_cashier_session_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing FK on cashier_session (prior_cashier_session_id)

domains.name: finance
domains.description: Manages institutional financial operations including general ledger, accounts payable, accounts receivable, budgeting, purchasing, fund accounting, cost centers, grants accounting, endowment management, and fiscal year cycles. Supports GASB/FASB compliance, NACUBO reporting, F&A cost rate calculations, and Oracle PeopleSoft Financials ERP operations.
domains.references: GASB, FASB, NACUBO, Oracle PeopleSoft Financials

products.name: ledger_account
products.description: Chart of accounts master data representing all GL account codes in the institutional general ledger. Captures account number, account type (asset, liability, net position, revenue, expense), fund affiliation, NACUBO functional expense category, GASB/FASB classification, account hierarchy level, budget control flag, and active status. Serves as the SSOT for all account coding across the institution, supporting multi-dimensional chartfield accounting in Oracle PeopleSoft Financials.

attributes.name: ledger_account_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the general ledger account in the institutional chart of accounts. Primary key for the ledger account master data.
attributes.references: Oracle PeopleSoft Financials - General Ledger Module

attributes.name: finance_fund_id
attributes.description: Reference to the fund to which this account belongs. Higher education institutions use fund accounting to segregate resources by purpose and restriction (e.g., unrestricted operating, restricted grants, endowment, plant).

attributes.name: org_unit_id
attributes.description: Reference to the organizational department or cost center that owns or is responsible for this account. Used for departmental budgeting and expense tracking.

attributes.name: parent_account_ledger_account_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent account in the chart of accounts hierarchy. Null for top-level accounts. Enables roll-up reporting and hierarchical financial analysis.

attributes.name: program_id
attributes.description: Reference to the academic or administrative program associated with this account. Used to track revenues and expenses by program for IPEDS reporting and internal analysis.

attributes.name: regulatory_requirement_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.regulatory_requirement. Business justification: Chart of accounts structured to support GASB, FASB, and IPEDS reporting requirements. Controllers map accounts to regulatory reporting categories (NACUBO functional classification, IPEDS finance surve

attributes.name: account_code
attributes.description: The externally-known unique account number used to identify this GL account across all financial transactions and reports. Typically a 4-10 digit numeric code structured to reflect account hierarchy and type.
attributes.references: NACUBO Financial Accounting and Reporting Manual (FARM)

attributes.name: account_description
attributes.description: Extended textual description of the accounts purpose, usage guidelines, and any special handling instructions for financial staff.
attributes.references: Oracle PeopleSoft Financials - General Ledger Module

attributes.name: account_name
attributes.description: The human-readable descriptive name of the GL account used in financial reports and user interfaces.
attributes.references: Oracle PeopleSoft Financials - General Ledger Module

attributes.name: account_owner_email
attributes.description: The email address of the account owner for notifications, approvals, and budget alerts.

attributes.name: account_owner_name
attributes.description: The name of the individual (typically a department head, dean, or financial manager) who is responsible for the financial activity and budget management of this account.

attributes.name: account_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the account. Active accounts accept transactions; inactive accounts are temporarily disabled; suspended accounts are under review; closed accounts are permanently retired and appear only in historical reports.
attributes.references: Oracle PeopleSoft Financials - ChartField Status Management

attributes.name: account_subtype
attributes.description: A more granular classification within the account type, such as current asset, fixed asset, current liability, long-term liability, operating revenue, non-operating revenue, personnel expense, or non-personnel expense.
attributes.references: NACUBO Financial Accounting and Reporting Manual (FARM)

attributes.name: account_type
attributes.description: The fundamental accounting classification of the account indicating its role in the financial statements. Asset and liability accounts appear on the balance sheet; revenue and expense accounts appear on the income statement; net position represents equity for governmental entities.

attributes.name: budget_control_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this account is subject to budget checking and control. When true, transactions posting to this account will be validated against available budget before posting.
attributes.references: Oracle PeopleSoft Financials - Budget Control Configuration

attributes.name: budget_pool_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this account participates in budget pooling, allowing budget to be shared across multiple accounts within a defined pool.
attributes.references: Oracle PeopleSoft Financials - Budget Control Configuration

attributes.name: cash_account_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this is a cash or cash-equivalent account used in cash flow reporting and treasury management.

attributes.name: created_by_user
attributes.description: The system user ID or name of the person who created this ledger account record. Audit trail field for data governance and compliance.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this ledger account record was first created in the system. Audit trail field for data governance and compliance.

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: The date on which this account was or will be inactivated. Null for currently active accounts with no planned end date. Supports date-effective chart of accounts management.

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: The date on which this account became active and available for use in financial transactions. Supports date-effective chart of accounts management.

attributes.name: encumbrance_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this account supports encumbrance accounting, which reserves budget for outstanding purchase orders and commitments before actual expenditure.
attributes.references: GASB Codification Section 1700 - Accounting for Encumbrances

attributes.name: fa_rate_eligible_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Facilities and Administrative (F&A) Rate Eligible Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether expenses in this account are included in the modified total direct cost (MTDC) base for calculating F&A (indirect cost) recovery on sponsored projects.
attributes.references: OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200 - Facilities and Administrative Costs

attributes.name: fasb_classification
attributes.description: Classification code or label aligning this account with FASB reporting requirements for private institutions, including net asset classification (unrestricted, temporarily restricted, permanently restricted) and functional expense category.

attributes.name: fiscal_year_created
attributes.description: The fiscal year in which this account was originally established in the chart of accounts, expressed as a four-digit year (e.g., 2024).

attributes.name: gasb_classification
attributes.description: Classification code or label aligning this account with GASB reporting requirements for public institutions, including fund type, activity classification, and statement presentation category.

attributes.name: grant_eligible_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether expenses charged to this account are eligible for reimbursement under sponsored research grants and contracts. Used to enforce allowable cost policies.
attributes.references: OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200 - Cost Principles

attributes.name: hierarchy_level
attributes.description: Numeric indicator of the accounts position in the chart of accounts hierarchy. Level 1 represents top-level summary accounts; higher numbers represent increasingly detailed sub-accounts.

attributes.name: ipeds_reporting_category
attributes.business_glossary_term: Integrated Postsecondary Education Data System (IPEDS) Reporting Category
attributes.description: Classification code mapping this account to IPEDS Finance Survey reporting categories for federal reporting compliance.

attributes.name: last_modified_by_user
attributes.description: The system user ID or name of the person who most recently modified this ledger account record. Audit trail field for data governance and compliance.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this ledger account record was most recently updated. Audit trail field for data governance and compliance.

attributes.name: last_transaction_date
attributes.description: The date of the most recent financial transaction posted to this account. Used to identify dormant accounts for cleanup and archival.
attributes.references: Oracle PeopleSoft Financials - General Ledger Module

attributes.name: nacubo_function_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: National Association of College and University Business Officers (NACUBO) Functional Expense Category Code
attributes.description: Two-digit code classifying the account into NACUBO functional expense categories such as instruction, research, public service, academic support, student services, institutional support, operation and maintenance of plant, scholarships and fellowships, and auxiliary enterprises.
attributes.references: NACUBO Financial Accounting and Reporting Manual (FARM)

attributes.name: normal_balance
attributes.description: Indicates whether this account normally carries a debit or credit balance. Assets and expenses typically have debit balances; liabilities, net position, and revenues typically have credit balances.

attributes.name: reconciliation_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this account requires periodic reconciliation to external statements or subsidiary ledgers (e.g., bank accounts, investment accounts, loan accounts).
attributes.references: Internal Control Best Practices - Account Reconciliation

attributes.name: statistical_account_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this is a statistical account used to track non-monetary units such as FTE (Full-Time Equivalent), credit hours, or square footage for operational metrics and ratio analysis.
attributes.references: NACUBO Financial Accounting and Reporting Manual (FARM)

products.name: finance_fund
products.description: Fund master data representing the self-balancing accounting entities used in higher-education fund accounting. Captures fund code, fund type (current unrestricted, current restricted, endowment, plant, loan, agency), GASB net asset classification, restriction type, purpose description, sponsoring entity, fund balance, fiscal year, and compliance requirements. Supports GASB 34/35 fund-based financial reporting and NACUBO fund accounting standards.

attributes.name: finance_fund_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the fund entity. Primary key for the finance fund master data table.

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Reference to the primary cost center or organizational unit responsible for managing this fund. Links fund accounting to organizational budgeting and responsibility reporting.

attributes.name: fiscal_period_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.fiscal_period. Business justification: Finance funds track balances and activity by fiscal period. Adding fiscal_period_id FK allows joining to fiscal_period master for period_name, period dates, status flags, and reporting attributes. Rem

attributes.name: parent_fund_finance_fund_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent fund in a hierarchical fund structure, enabling roll-up reporting and multi-level fund organization. Null for top-level funds.

attributes.name: account_string_segment
attributes.description: The fund segment of the institutional chart of accounts string used in Oracle PeopleSoft Financials. Represents the fund component of the multi-segment account code (e.g., fund-department-account-program).
attributes.references: Oracle PeopleSoft Financials Chart of Accounts, NACUBO Fund Accounting Standards

attributes.name: allow_deficit_spending
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the fund is permitted to carry a negative balance or deficit. True if deficit spending is allowed; false if the fund must maintain a positive balance.

attributes.name: balance
attributes.description: The current fund balance representing the net assets available in the fund. Calculated as assets minus liabilities for the fund entity. Updated through the general ledger posting process.

attributes.name: budget_amount
attributes.description: The approved budget allocation for the fund for the current fiscal year. Represents the planned expenditure authority or revenue target.
attributes.references: NACUBO Fund Accounting Standards, Institutional Budget Policy

attributes.name: carryforward_allowed
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether unspent fund balances are permitted to carry forward to the next fiscal year. True if carryforward is allowed; false if balances must be returned or reallocated at fiscal year end.

attributes.name: closure_date
attributes.description: The date on which the fund was officially closed and removed from active use. Null for funds that remain open.

attributes.name: compliance_requirement
attributes.description: Description of specific compliance requirements, regulations, or reporting obligations associated with the fund, such as federal grant compliance, donor restrictions, or audit requirements.
attributes.references: OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200, GASB 34/35, Donor Agreements

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this fund record was first created in the system. Supports audit trail and data lineage tracking.

attributes.name: encumbrance_amount
attributes.description: The total amount of outstanding encumbrances (purchase orders, contracts, commitments) charged against the fund. Represents committed but not yet expended resources.

attributes.name: endowment_principal
attributes.description: The permanently restricted principal amount of an endowment fund that must be maintained in perpetuity. Only applicable to endowment fund types. Null for non-endowment funds.
attributes.references: NACUBO Endowment Study, UPMIFA (Uniform Prudent Management of Institutional Funds Act)

attributes.name: establishment_date
attributes.description: The date on which the fund was officially established and authorized for use in the institutional chart of accounts.

attributes.name: expenditure_to_date
attributes.description: The cumulative expenditures posted to the fund for the current fiscal year to date. Includes all expense transactions recorded in the general ledger.

attributes.name: external_reporting_required
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the fund requires external financial reporting to donors, sponsors, regulatory agencies, or other external stakeholders. True if external reporting is required; false otherwise.

attributes.name: fund_code
attributes.description: The externally-known unique alphanumeric code identifying the fund in the institutional chart of accounts. Used in Oracle PeopleSoft Financials and all financial transactions.

attributes.name: fund_name
attributes.description: The full descriptive name of the fund as it appears in financial reports and institutional documentation.

attributes.name: fund_status
attributes.description: The current lifecycle status of the fund. Active funds are operational and accept transactions; inactive funds are dormant but not closed; closed funds are permanently terminated; suspended funds are temporarily halted; pending approval funds await authorization.

attributes.name: fund_type
attributes.description: The primary classification of the fund according to higher education fund accounting principles. Current unrestricted funds support general operations; current restricted funds have donor or sponsor restrictions; endowment funds are permanently invested; plant funds support capital assets; loan funds support student lending; agency funds hold assets for others.

attributes.name: indirect_cost_rate
attributes.business_glossary_term: Facilities and Administrative (F&A) Indirect Cost Rate (IDC)
attributes.description: The federally negotiated indirect cost rate applied to sponsored projects and grants managed through this fund. Expressed as a decimal percentage (e.g., 0.5400 for 54%). Used to calculate facilities and administrative cost recovery.
attributes.references: OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200, Negotiated Rate Agreement

attributes.name: last_audit_date
attributes.description: The date of the most recent internal or external audit conducted on this fund. Used to track audit compliance and schedule future audits.
attributes.references: OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200, Institutional Audit Policy

attributes.name: manager_email
attributes.description: The email address of the fund manager for operational communication and fund-related inquiries.

attributes.name: manager_name
attributes.description: The name of the individual or office responsible for managing and overseeing the fund, including budget authority and expenditure approval.

attributes.name: net_asset_classification
attributes.business_glossary_term: Governmental Accounting Standards Board (GASB) Net Asset Classification
attributes.description: The GASB net asset classification indicating the level of restriction on the fund resources. Unrestricted assets have no donor-imposed restrictions; temporarily restricted assets have time or purpose restrictions that will expire; permanently restricted assets must be maintained in perpetuity.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional notes, comments, or special instructions related to the fund management, restrictions, or operational considerations.

attributes.name: program_code
attributes.description: The program or functional classification code associated with the fund, used for program-based budgeting and reporting. Aligns with institutional program taxonomy.

attributes.name: purpose_description
attributes.description: Detailed narrative describing the intended purpose and allowable uses of the fund resources, including any donor intent, programmatic focus, or operational scope.

attributes.name: reporting_category
attributes.description: The financial statement reporting category or line item to which this fund maps for external financial reporting purposes, such as GASB or FASB statement presentation.
attributes.references: GASB 34/35, FASB ASC 958, NACUBO Financial Reporting Standards

attributes.name: restriction_type
attributes.description: The nature of restrictions placed on the fund resources. Donor-restricted funds have limitations imposed by external donors; sponsor-restricted funds are limited by grant or contract terms; board-designated funds have internal restrictions set by the governing board; regulatory-restricted funds are constrained by law or regulation; time-restricted funds have temporal limitations.
attributes.references: NACUBO Fund Accounting Standards, FASB ASC 958

attributes.name: revenue_to_date
attributes.description: The cumulative revenue posted to the fund for the current fiscal year to date. Includes all revenue transactions recorded in the general ledger.

attributes.name: spending_rate
attributes.description: The annual spending rate applied to endowment funds, expressed as a decimal percentage (e.g., 0.0450 for 4.5%). Determines the amount available for annual distribution from endowment earnings. Only applicable to endowment fund types.

attributes.name: sponsoring_entity
attributes.description: The name of the external or internal entity that established or sponsors the fund, such as a donor name, foundation, government agency, or academic department.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this fund record was last modified in the system. Supports audit trail and change tracking.

products.name: cost_center
products.description: Organizational cost center master data representing departmental and programmatic units used for financial accountability, budget tracking, and NACUBO functional expense classification. Captures cost center code, name, responsible manager, organizational hierarchy level, college/school affiliation, functional category (instruction, research, public service, academic support, student services, institutional support, O&M, scholarships), FTE allocation, and active status. Primary organizational dimension in the PeopleSoft chartfield string.

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the cost center. Primary key for the cost center master data table. Serves as the organizational dimension in the PeopleSoft chartfield string for financial accountability and budget tracking.

attributes.name: building_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to facility.building. Business justification: Cost centers require building assignment for space chargeback accounting, facilities cost allocation, and F&A rate calculations. Higher ed institutions routinely allocate building operating costs and

attributes.name: college_school_id
attributes.description: Reference to the college or school to which this cost center belongs (e.g., College of Arts and Sciences, School of Business, School of Medicine). Used for academic organizational reporting and budget allocation. Null for non-academic administrative units.
attributes.references: IPEDS Institutional Characteristics Survey, NACUBO Financial Accounting and Reporting Manual

attributes.name: division_id
attributes.description: Reference to the top-level administrative division (e.g., Academic Affairs, Finance and Administration, Student Affairs, Research, Advancement). Used for executive-level budget and performance reporting.
attributes.references: NACUBO Financial Accounting and Reporting Manual

attributes.name: parent_cost_center_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent cost center in the organizational hierarchy. Enables roll-up reporting from departments to colleges to divisions to institution. Null for top-level cost centers (e.g., President's Office, Provost).
attributes.references: Oracle PeopleSoft Financials Tree Manager, NACUBO Financial Accounting and Reporting Manual

attributes.name: primary_cost_manager_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the employee who serves as the responsible manager or budget authority for this cost center. Typically a department chair, dean, director, or vice president. This individual has budget approval authority and financial accountability.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Position Management, NACUBO Financial Accounting and Reporting Manual

attributes.name: accreditation_body
attributes.description: The specialized or programmatic accreditation agency that oversees this cost center's academic programs (e.g., AACSB for business schools, ABET for engineering programs, ABA for law schools, LCME for medical schools). Used for compliance tracking and accreditation reporting. Null for non-accredited programs and administrative units.
attributes.references: CHEA Database of Accrediting Organizations, U.S. Department of Education Accreditation Database

attributes.name: annual_budget_amount
attributes.description: Total approved operating budget for the current fiscal year in US dollars. Includes all fund sources (general fund, restricted funds, auxiliary funds). Used for budget variance analysis, financial planning, and resource allocation decisions.
attributes.references: NACUBO Financial Accounting and Reporting Manual, GASB Statement 34

attributes.name: cip_code
attributes.description: The six-digit CIP code that classifies the primary instructional program or academic discipline of this cost center. Format: XX.XXXX (e.g., 11.0701 for Computer Science, 52.0201 for Business Administration). Used for IPEDS reporting, program review, and academic planning. Applicable only to academic departments and programs.
attributes.references: NCES Classification of Instructional Programs (CIP) 2020, IPEDS Completions Survey

attributes.name: cost_center_code
attributes.description: The business identifier code for the cost center used in financial transactions and reporting. Typically a 4-10 character alphanumeric code that appears on general ledger entries, budget documents, and financial statements. Primary organizational chartfield in PeopleSoft.
attributes.references: Oracle PeopleSoft Financials Chartfield Standards, NACUBO Financial Accounting and Reporting Manual

attributes.name: cost_center_description
attributes.description: Detailed narrative description of the cost center's mission, scope of operations, and organizational purpose. Used for organizational documentation, budget justification, and institutional knowledge management.
attributes.references: NACUBO Financial Accounting and Reporting Manual

attributes.name: cost_center_name
attributes.description: The full descriptive name of the cost center (e.g., 'Department of Computer Science', 'Office of Financial Aid', 'College of Engineering Dean's Office'). Used for human-readable reporting and organizational identification.
attributes.references: NACUBO Financial Accounting and Reporting Manual

attributes.name: cost_center_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the cost center. Active cost centers accept charges and have budget authority; inactive cost centers are temporarily disabled; pending cost centers are awaiting approval; closed cost centers are permanently retired; suspended cost centers are under review or restructuring.

attributes.name: cost_center_type
attributes.description: Classification of the cost center by organizational purpose. Academic departments deliver instruction and research; administrative units provide institutional support; research centers conduct sponsored and non-sponsored research; service units provide internal services; auxiliary enterprises are self-supporting operations; capital projects track construction and renovation.
attributes.references: NACUBO Financial Accounting and Reporting Manual, GASB Statement 35

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this cost center record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage tracking. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.

attributes.name: degrees_awarded_annual
attributes.description: Total number of degrees and certificates awarded by this cost center's academic program(s) in the most recent academic year. Includes associate, bachelor's, master's, doctoral, and professional degrees. Used for IPEDS completions reporting, program productivity analysis, and accreditation review. Applicable only to academic departments offering degree programs.
attributes.references: IPEDS Completions Survey, AACSB Accreditation Standards, ABET Accreditation Criteria

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: The date when this cost center became active and began accepting financial transactions. Used for historical reporting and organizational change tracking. Format: yyyy-MM-dd.

attributes.name: faculty_fte
attributes.description: Full-time equivalent count of faculty assigned to this cost center. Includes tenured, tenure-track, and non-tenure-track instructional faculty. Used for student-faculty ratio calculations, accreditation reporting, and instructional cost analysis.
attributes.references: IPEDS Human Resources Survey, AACSB Accreditation Standards, ABET Accreditation Criteria

attributes.name: fiscal_year
attributes.description: The fiscal year for which the annual budget amount applies. Typically a four-digit year representing the end of the fiscal period (e.g., 2024 for FY 2023-2024). Most higher education institutions use July 1 - June 30 fiscal years.
attributes.references: NACUBO Financial Accounting and Reporting Manual, GASB Statement 34

attributes.name: fte_allocation
attributes.description: Total full-time equivalent employee count allocated to this cost center. Includes faculty, staff, and student workers converted to FTE. Used for IPEDS Human Resources reporting, CUPA-HR benchmarking, and productivity analysis. Calculated as sum of individual employee FTE assignments.
attributes.references: IPEDS Human Resources Survey, CUPA-HR Standards, NACUBO Financial Accounting and Reporting Manual

attributes.name: functional_category
attributes.description: NACUBO functional expense classification used for IPEDS reporting and GASB/FASB compliance. Instruction includes teaching and departmental research; research includes organized research and sponsored programs; public service includes community engagement; academic support includes libraries and academic administration; student services includes admissions, registrar, and student life; institutional support includes executive management, fiscal operations, and HR; operation and maintenance includes facilities and utilities; scholarships and fellowships includes financial aid; auxiliary enterprises includes housing, dining, and bookstores. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: instruction|research|public_service|academic_support|student_services|institutional_support|operation_maintenance|scholarships_fellowships|auxiliary_enterprises|hospital_services|independent_operations — 11 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: NACUBO Financial Accounting and Reporting Manual, IPEDS Finance Survey, GASB Statement 35, FASB ASC 958

attributes.name: fund_source_primary
attributes.description: The primary fund source that supports this cost center's operations. General fund represents unrestricted institutional operating funds; restricted fund represents donor-restricted or externally-restricted funds; designated fund represents internally-restricted funds; auxiliary fund represents self-supporting operations; endowment fund represents endowment income; grant fund represents sponsored program funds.
attributes.references: NACUBO Financial Accounting and Reporting Manual, GASB Statement 34, FASB ASC 958

attributes.name: grant_eligible_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this cost center is eligible to serve as the administrative home for sponsored research grants and contracts. True for research-active departments and centers; false for administrative units and non-research departments. Used for proposal routing and award setup in Kuali Research.
attributes.references: 2 CFR 200 Uniform Guidance, Institutional Sponsored Programs Policy

attributes.name: hierarchy_level
attributes.description: Numeric level in the organizational hierarchy tree. Level 1 represents institution-wide (President, Provost); Level 2 represents divisions (Vice Presidents); Level 3 represents colleges/schools; Level 4 represents departments; Level 5 represents sub-departments or programs. Used for roll-up reporting and organizational analysis.

attributes.name: indirect_cost_rate
attributes.business_glossary_term: Indirect Cost Rate (IDC) or Facilities and Administrative (F&A) Rate
attributes.description: The federally-negotiated indirect cost rate (also called F&A rate) applicable to sponsored programs administered by this cost center. Expressed as a percentage of modified total direct costs. Used for grant budgeting and cost recovery calculations. Null for non-research cost centers.
attributes.references: 2 CFR 200 Uniform Guidance, NSF Grant Policy Manual, NIH Grants Policy Statement

attributes.name: last_review_date
attributes.description: The date when this cost center's budget, organizational structure, or performance was last formally reviewed by institutional leadership. Used for governance tracking and periodic review scheduling. Format: yyyy-MM-dd.

attributes.name: majors_enrolled_count
attributes.description: Total number of students currently enrolled with a declared major in this cost center's academic program(s). Includes undergraduate and graduate students. Used for program size analysis, advising workload planning, and accreditation reporting. Applicable only to academic departments offering degree programs.
attributes.references: IPEDS Fall Enrollment Survey, AACSB Accreditation Standards

attributes.name: next_review_date
attributes.description: The scheduled date for the next formal review of this cost center's budget, organizational structure, or performance. Used for governance planning and compliance tracking. Format: yyyy-MM-dd.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-form notes field for capturing additional context, special instructions, organizational changes, or administrative comments about the cost center. Used for institutional knowledge management and operational documentation.

attributes.name: research_classification
attributes.description: Classification of the primary research activity conducted by this cost center. Basic research seeks fundamental knowledge; applied research addresses specific practical problems; development translates research into products or processes; non-research indicates no significant research activity. Used for NSF HERD survey reporting and research portfolio analysis.
attributes.references: NSF Higher Education Research and Development (HERD) Survey, 2 CFR 200 Uniform Guidance

attributes.name: short_name
attributes.description: Abbreviated name or acronym for the cost center used in space-constrained reports and dashboards (e.g., 'CS Dept', 'Fin Aid', 'COE Dean').

attributes.name: space_square_feet
attributes.description: Total assignable square feet of space allocated to this cost center. Includes offices, classrooms, laboratories, and support spaces. Used for space utilization analysis, facilities cost allocation, and capital planning. Sourced from Archibus facilities management system.
attributes.references: FICM (Facilities Inventory and Classification Manual), NACUBO Space Planning Guidelines

attributes.name: staff_fte
attributes.description: Full-time equivalent count of administrative and support staff assigned to this cost center. Includes professional staff, clerical staff, and technical staff. Used for operational efficiency analysis and CUPA-HR benchmarking.
attributes.references: IPEDS Human Resources Survey, CUPA-HR Standards

attributes.name: student_credit_hours_annual
attributes.description: Total student credit hours generated by this cost center in the most recent academic year. Calculated as sum of course enrollments multiplied by credit hours. Used for instructional productivity analysis, cost-per-credit-hour calculations, and resource allocation. Applicable only to academic departments offering courses.
attributes.references: IPEDS 12-Month Enrollment Survey, NACUBO Cost of Instruction Study

attributes.name: termination_date
attributes.description: The date when this cost center was closed or inactivated. Null for active cost centers. Used for historical reporting, organizational change tracking, and audit trail. Format: yyyy-MM-dd.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this cost center record was last modified. Used for audit trail, change tracking, and data quality monitoring. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.

Sourced from Oracle PeopleSoft Financials GL module. Core transactional record for all financial activity.

attributes.name: grant_account_id
attributes.description: The grant or sponsored project identifier if this journal entry is associated with externally funded research or grant activity. Links to Kuali Research system.
attributes.references: OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200, NSF Grant Policy Manual

attributes.name: policy_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.policy. Business justification: Journal entry policies define approval hierarchies, supporting documentation requirements, and posting rules. Controllers enforce segregation of duties and materiality thresholds per institutional pol

attributes.name: primary_journal_employee_id
attributes.description: The employee or user ID of the person who prepared or created this journal entry. Links to HR or user management system for accountability.

attributes.name: reversed_by_journal_journal_entry_id
attributes.description: The journal_entry_id of the reversing entry that reversed this journal entry. Null if this entry has not been reversed.

attributes.name: reverses_journal_journal_entry_id

attributes.name: approval_date

attributes.name: approver_name

attributes.name: budget_check_status
attributes.description: Result of the budget availability check performed when this journal entry was created. Indicates whether sufficient budget was available, check failed, was bypassed by authorized user, or was not applicable.

attributes.name: created_timestamp

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the journal entry amounts (e.g., USD for US Dollar, EUR for Euro). Supports multi-currency institutions and international research grants.

attributes.name: encumbrance_indicator
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this journal entry creates or relieves an encumbrance (True) or is a standard cash-basis entry (False). Used in commitment accounting.

attributes.name: intercompany_indicator
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this journal entry represents an intercompany or inter-fund transaction (True) or a single-entity transaction (False). Critical for consolidation and elimination entries.

attributes.name: journal_category
attributes.description: Fund accounting category for the journal entry: operating funds, capital funds, endowment funds, restricted funds, unrestricted funds, or agency funds. Critical for higher education fund accounting and GASB compliance.

attributes.name: journal_date
attributes.description: The business date on which the journal entry transaction occurred or is effective. Determines the accounting period and fiscal year assignment.

attributes.name: journal_entry_description
attributes.description: Free-text description of the purpose and nature of this journal entry. Provides business context for the transaction.

attributes.name: journal_number
attributes.description: Business-facing unique journal entry number assigned by Oracle PeopleSoft Financials GL module. Used for external reference and audit trails.
attributes.references: NACUBO Financial Accounting and Reporting Manual

attributes.name: journal_source
attributes.description: The originating system or module that created this journal entry. Indicates whether the entry was generated from Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, Payroll, manual entry, budget upload, Financial Aid, Grants Accounting, encumbrance processing, or cost allocation. attributes.name: journal_type
attributes.description: Classification of the journal entry by its accounting purpose: standard operating entry, period-end adjusting entry, fiscal year closing entry, auto-reversing entry, recurring template entry, or statistical (non-monetary) entry.

attributes.name: last_modified_by
attributes.description: The user ID or name of the person who last modified this journal entry record. Used for accountability and audit trails.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this journal entry record was last updated or modified. Used for change tracking and audit trails.

attributes.name: posted_date
attributes.description: The date on which the journal entry was officially posted to the general ledger and became part of the financial record. Null if not yet posted.

attributes.name: posted_timestamp
attributes.description: The precise date and time when the journal entry was posted to the general ledger. Used for audit trails and transaction sequencing.

attributes.name: posting_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the journal entry in the GL posting workflow. Tracks progression from draft creation through approval and final posting to the general ledger.

attributes.name: preparer_name
attributes.description: The full name of the person who prepared this journal entry. Stored for reporting and audit trail purposes.

attributes.name: program_code
attributes.description: The program or functional area code for this journal entry (e.g., instruction, research, public service, academic support). Used for functional expense reporting per GASB and IPEDS.

attributes.name: reference_number
attributes.description: External reference number or document identifier associated with this journal entry (e.g., invoice number, grant award number, payroll batch ID). Used for cross-system reconciliation.

attributes.name: reversal_date
attributes.description: The date on which this journal entry will automatically reverse, if it is a reversing entry. Null for non-reversing entries.

attributes.name: reversal_indicator
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this journal entry is a reversing entry (True) or a standard entry (False). Reversing entries automatically reverse in the next accounting period.

attributes.name: supporting_documentation_reference
attributes.description: Reference to supporting documentation for this journal entry (e.g., file path, document management system ID, URL). Required for audit compliance.

attributes.name: total_credit_amount
attributes.description: The sum of all credit amounts across all line items in this journal entry. Must equal total_debit_amount for a balanced entry.

attributes.name: total_debit_amount
attributes.description: The sum of all debit amounts across all line items in this journal entry. Must equal total_credit_amount for a balanced entry.

Supports full chartfield string decomposition required for PeopleSoft Financials multi-dimensional accounting and GASB/FASB functional expense reporting.

attributes.name: program_code

attributes.name: project_grant_code
