attributes.references: NACUBO Financial Accounting and Reporting Manual

attributes.name: budget_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the budget record. Draft indicates initial development, submitted means under review, approved indicates board or authority approval, active means currently in effect, closed indicates the budget period has ended, and cancelled means the budget was withdrawn.

attributes.name: budget_type
attributes.description: Classification of the budget by its purpose and funding nature. Operating budgets cover day-to-day operations, capital budgets cover long-term assets, grant budgets track sponsored project funding, auxiliary budgets cover self-supporting units, and restricted/unrestricted indicate fund usage constraints.
attributes.references: NACUBO Financial Accounting and Reporting Manual

attributes.name: budgeted_amount
attributes.description: The total approved budget amount for this fund, cost center, and account combination for the fiscal year. Represents the financial plan allocation in the institutional currency.

attributes.name: carry_forward_amount
attributes.description: The amount of unspent budget from the prior fiscal year that is carried forward into the current budget period. Common in higher education for certain fund types and grant budgets.
attributes.references: NACUBO Fund Accounting - Carry Forward Rules

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this budget record was first created in the source system. Supports audit trail and data lineage.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the budgeted amount (e.g., USD for US Dollar, EUR for Euro). Most US institutions use USD.

attributes.name: encumbrance_balance
attributes.description: The total amount of outstanding purchase orders and commitments that have been encumbered against this budget but not yet expensed. Critical for budget availability calculations.

attributes.name: fte_count
attributes.description: The number of full-time equivalent positions funded by this budget line. Used for workforce planning and IPEDS reporting. Null for non-personnel budgets.

attributes.name: indirect_cost_rate
attributes.business_glossary_term: Indirect Cost Rate (IDC) / Facilities and Administrative (F&A) Rate
attributes.description: The federally negotiated indirect cost rate (also called F&A rate) applied to grant budgets to recover institutional overhead costs. Expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.5400 for 54%). Null for non-grant budgets.

attributes.name: is_restricted
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this budget is subject to donor or sponsor restrictions on how funds may be used. True for restricted funds, false for unrestricted funds. Critical for GASB/FASB net asset classification.

attributes.name: is_salary_budget
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this budget line is designated for personnel salaries and wages. Used for position control and FTE (Full-Time Equivalent) tracking.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this budget record was last updated in the source system. Supports change tracking and audit trail.

attributes.name: last_revision_date
attributes.description: The date of the most recent budget revision. Null if no revisions have been made since original approval.

attributes.name: manager_email
attributes.description: The email address of the budget manager for communication regarding budget status, variances, and approvals.

attributes.name: manager_name
attributes.description: The name of the individual responsible for managing and monitoring this budget. Typically a department head, dean, or financial administrator.

attributes.name: narrative
attributes.description: Detailed textual description and justification for the budget allocation. Explains the purpose, assumptions, and strategic rationale for the budgeted amount. Used in budget presentations and approval processes.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Additional free-form notes or comments about this budget record. Used for internal documentation, special instructions, or contextual information not captured in other fields.

attributes.name: period_end_date
attributes.description: The end date of the budget period. Typically aligns with the end of the fiscal year (e.g., June 30 for many institutions).

attributes.name: period_start_date
attributes.description: The start date of the budget period. Typically aligns with the beginning of the fiscal year (e.g., July 1 for many institutions).

attributes.name: pool_code
attributes.description: Optional code identifying a budget pool or shared resource allocation from which this budget draws (e.g., central IT pool, facilities pool, strategic initiative pool).

attributes.name: program_code
attributes.description: Optional program or project code for budgets tied to specific academic programs, research projects, or strategic initiatives. Used for program-level financial analysis.

attributes.name: revision_number
attributes.description: Sequential number tracking the count of revisions made to this budget record. Starts at 0 for original budget, increments with each approved revision. Supports audit trail.
attributes.references: Oracle PeopleSoft Financials Budget Version Control

attributes.name: revision_reason
attributes.description: Textual explanation for the most recent budget revision. Documents the business justification for mid-year budget adjustments (e.g., enrollment variance, grant award change, strategic reallocation).

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: The name of the source system from which this budget record originated (e.g., Oracle PeopleSoft Financials, Workday Financials). Used for data lineage and reconciliation.

attributes.name: version
attributes.description: The version status of the budget reflecting the stage in the budget development and approval cycle. Original represents the initially proposed budget, revised reflects mid-year adjustments, final is the board-approved version, working is used for planning, and proposed is submitted for approval.

products.name: budget_amendment
products.description: Budget amendment transaction record capturing approved changes to the original institutional budget during the fiscal year. Records amendment number, amendment date, originating cost center, affected chartfield string, amount transferred or adjusted, amendment reason, justification narrative, approval chain, approval date, and resulting revised budget balance. Supports budget control, audit trail, and fiscal year-end reconciliation.

attributes.name: budget_amendment_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the budget amendment transaction record. Primary key for the budget amendment entity.
attributes.references: NACUBO Financial Accounting and Reporting Manual

attributes.name: academic_program_id
attributes.description: Reference to the academic program or institutional initiative associated with this budget amendment, if applicable.

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Reference to the originating cost center or department that initiated the budget amendment request.
attributes.references: NACUBO Financial Accounting and Reporting Manual

attributes.name: finance_fund_id
attributes.description: Reference to the fund affected by this budget amendment. Supports fund accounting requirements for higher education institutions.

attributes.name: fiscal_period_id
attributes.description: Reference to the fiscal year in which this budget amendment was processed. Links to the fiscal year master data.

attributes.name: grant_account_id
attributes.description: Reference to the research grant or sponsored project that triggered this budget amendment, if applicable. Supports grants accounting and Facilities and Administrative (F&A) cost tracking.

attributes.name: journal_entry_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.journal_entry. Business justification: Budget amendments may generate journal entries when posted to the general ledger (for budget-to-actual tracking or encumbrance adjustments). Adding journal_entry_id FK (nullable) allows linking to the

attributes.name: policy_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.policy. Business justification: Budget transfer policies define approval thresholds, allowable transfer types, and authority limits. Controllers enforce institutional policy on budget reallocations. Required for internal control com

attributes.name: primary_budget_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the institutional user or employee who initiated and submitted the budget amendment request.

attributes.name: primary_budget_ledger_account_id
attributes.description: Reference to the general ledger account from which budget funds are being transferred or reduced. Null for budget increases without a corresponding source.

attributes.name: project_id
attributes.description: Reference to the capital project, research project, or special initiative that is the subject of this budget amendment, if applicable.
attributes.references: NACUBO Financial Accounting and Reporting Manual

attributes.name: target_account_ledger_account_id
attributes.description: Reference to the general ledger account to which budget funds are being transferred or added. Null for budget decreases without a corresponding target.

attributes.name: amendment_amount
attributes.description: The monetary value of the budget amendment. Positive values indicate budget increases or transfers in; negative values indicate budget decreases or transfers out. Expressed in the institutional base currency.

attributes.name: amendment_date
attributes.description: The date on which the budget amendment was officially recorded and became effective. Represents the principal business event timestamp for this transaction.

attributes.name: amendment_number
attributes.description: Externally-known unique business identifier for the budget amendment transaction. Used for tracking and audit trail purposes.
attributes.references: NACUBO Financial Accounting and Reporting Manual

attributes.name: amendment_reason_code
attributes.description: Standardized code categorizing the business reason for the budget amendment: new grant award, enrollment variance, salary adjustment, program expansion, emergency operational need, or identified cost savings.
attributes.references: NACUBO Financial Accounting and Reporting Manual

attributes.name: amendment_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the budget amendment transaction in the approval and posting workflow.
attributes.references: NACUBO Financial Accounting and Reporting Manual

attributes.name: amendment_type
attributes.description: Classification of the budget amendment transaction indicating the nature of the change: transfer between accounts, budget increase, budget decrease, reallocation within department, supplemental appropriation, or technical correction.
attributes.references: NACUBO Financial Accounting and Reporting Manual

attributes.name: approval_chain_sequence
attributes.description: Comma-separated or structured representation of the complete approval workflow path, including all approvers and approval levels through which this amendment passed.
attributes.references: NACUBO Financial Accounting and Reporting Manual

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: The date on which the budget amendment received final approval and was authorized for posting to the general ledger.
attributes.references: NACUBO Financial Accounting and Reporting Manual

attributes.name: audit_trail_notes
attributes.description: Additional notes and comments captured throughout the amendment lifecycle for audit trail, compliance documentation, and institutional memory.
attributes.references: NACUBO Financial Accounting and Reporting Manual

attributes.name: board_approval_date
attributes.description: The date on which the Board of Trustees approved this budget amendment, if board approval was required. Null if board approval was not required.

attributes.name: budget_period_end_date
attributes.description: The ending date of the budget period affected by this amendment. Supports multi-year and grant-specific budget cycles.

attributes.name: budget_period_start_date
attributes.description: The beginning date of the budget period affected by this amendment. Supports multi-year and grant-specific budget cycles.

attributes.name: chartfield_string
attributes.description: Complete chartfield combination string representing the full accounting dimension hierarchy affected by this amendment. Typically includes fund, department, account, program, project, and other institutional accounting segments as configured in Oracle PeopleSoft Financials.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp indicating when this budget amendment record was first created in the system. Part of the audit trail for data lineage and compliance.
attributes.references: NACUBO Financial Accounting and Reporting Manual

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the amendment amount. Typically USD for U.S. institutions but may vary for international operations.

attributes.name: external_reference_number
attributes.description: External document or transaction reference number from source systems, grant agencies, or regulatory bodies associated with this budget amendment.
attributes.references: NACUBO Financial Accounting and Reporting Manual

attributes.name: is_recurring
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this budget amendment represents a recurring change that will carry forward to subsequent fiscal years (true) or a one-time adjustment (false).
attributes.references: NACUBO Financial Accounting and Reporting Manual

attributes.name: justification_narrative
attributes.description: Detailed textual explanation and business justification for the budget amendment. Provides context for audit, compliance review, and institutional decision-making.
attributes.references: NACUBO Financial Accounting and Reporting Manual

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp indicating when this budget amendment record was most recently updated. Supports change tracking and audit requirements.
attributes.references: NACUBO Financial Accounting and Reporting Manual

attributes.name: original_budget_balance
attributes.description: The budget balance in the affected account before this amendment was applied. Used for audit trail and reconciliation purposes.
attributes.references: NACUBO Financial Accounting and Reporting Manual

attributes.name: posted_date
attributes.description: The date on which the approved budget amendment was posted to the general ledger and became part of the official budget of record.

attributes.name: requested_date
attributes.description: The date on which the budget amendment request was originally submitted for approval.
attributes.references: NACUBO Financial Accounting and Reporting Manual

attributes.name: requires_board_approval
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this budget amendment requires approval by the institutional Board of Trustees due to materiality thresholds or policy requirements.

attributes.name: revised_budget_balance
attributes.description: The resulting budget balance in the affected account after this amendment has been applied. Supports budget control and fiscal year-end reconciliation.
attributes.references: NACUBO Financial Accounting and Reporting Manual

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the originating system or entry method for this budget amendment: Oracle PeopleSoft Financials, Ellucian Banner, Workday, manual entry, or institutional budget planning tool.

products.name: finance_vendor
products.description: Vendor and supplier master data for all external parties from whom the institution procures goods and services. Captures vendor ID, legal name, DBA name, vendor type (supplier, contractor, consultant, utility, government), tax ID (EIN/SSN), W-9 status, payment terms, preferred payment method, remittance address, 1099 reporting flag, minority/women-owned business enterprise (MWBE) classification, debarment status, and active status. Sourced from Oracle PeopleSoft Financials AP Vendor Master.

attributes.name: finance_vendor_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the vendor record in the institutional finance system. Primary key for vendor master data.
attributes.references: Oracle PeopleSoft Financials AP Vendor Master

attributes.name: parent_vendor_finance_vendor_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent vendor record if this vendor is a subsidiary or division of a larger corporate entity. Used for consolidated spend reporting and corporate relationship management.
attributes.references: Oracle PeopleSoft Financials AP Vendor Master

attributes.name: regulatory_requirement_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.regulatory_requirement. Business justification: Vendor compliance includes debarment checks (SAM.gov), OFAC sanctions screening, and 1099 reporting requirements. Procurement officers validate regulatory compliance before vendor activation. Required

attributes.name: activation_date
attributes.description: The date on which the vendor record was activated and approved for use in procurement and accounts payable transactions.
attributes.references: Oracle PeopleSoft Financials AP Vendor Master

attributes.name: bank_account_name
attributes.description: The name on the vendor's bank account for electronic payment processing. Must match the legal name or DBA name for ACH and wire transfer compliance.

attributes.name: bank_account_number
attributes.description: The vendor's bank account number for electronic payment processing via ACH or wire transfer. Highly sensitive financial information requiring restricted access controls.

attributes.name: bank_account_type
attributes.description: The type of bank account for electronic payments: checking or savings. Required for ACH payment processing.

attributes.name: bank_routing_number
attributes.description: The nine-digit ABA routing number for the vendor's bank account, used for ACH and wire transfer payments. Also known as routing transit number (RTN).

attributes.name: contact_email
attributes.description: The email address of the primary contact person at the vendor organization. Used for invoice inquiries, payment notifications, and procurement communications.
attributes.references: Oracle PeopleSoft Financials AP Vendor Master

attributes.name: contact_name
attributes.description: The name of the primary contact person at the vendor organization for accounts payable and procurement inquiries.
attributes.references: Oracle PeopleSoft Financials AP Vendor Master

attributes.name: contact_phone
attributes.description: The phone number of the primary contact person at the vendor organization.
attributes.references: Oracle PeopleSoft Financials AP Vendor Master

attributes.name: created_date
attributes.description: The date on which this vendor record was first created in the institutional finance system. Used for audit trail and vendor relationship history tracking.
attributes.references: Oracle PeopleSoft Financials AP Vendor Master

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: The default currency in which this vendor invoices and receives payment. Uses three-letter ISO 4217 currency codes. Most US higher education institutions transact primarily in USD.

attributes.name: dba_name
attributes.description: The trade name or doing business as name under which the vendor operates, if different from the legal name. Used for vendor search and identification.
attributes.references: Oracle PeopleSoft Financials AP Vendor Master

attributes.name: debarment_check_date
attributes.description: The date on which the vendor's debarment status was last verified against the SAM Exclusions database. Institutions typically verify this annually or before major contract awards.

attributes.name: debarment_status
attributes.description: Current debarment or suspension status of the vendor as listed in the federal System for Award Management (SAM) Exclusions database. Institutions must verify vendors are not debarred before awarding contracts, especially for federally-funded purchases.

attributes.name: inactivation_date
attributes.description: The date on which the vendor record was inactivated and removed from active use. Inactivated vendors are retained for historical reporting and audit purposes.
attributes.references: Oracle PeopleSoft Financials AP Vendor Master

attributes.name: last_modified_date
attributes.description: The date on which this vendor record was most recently updated. Used for audit trail and data quality monitoring.
attributes.references: Oracle PeopleSoft Financials AP Vendor Master

attributes.name: last_payment_date
attributes.description: The date of the most recent payment issued to this vendor. Used to identify inactive vendors and support vendor relationship analysis.
attributes.references: Oracle PeopleSoft Financials AP Payment History

attributes.name: legal_name
attributes.description: The official legal name of the vendor entity as registered with government authorities and used for tax reporting and legal contracts.

attributes.name: minority_owned
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the vendor is certified as a minority-owned business enterprise. Used for diversity spend reporting and supplier diversity program compliance.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-form text field for capturing additional information about the vendor, including special handling instructions, payment preferences, or historical context not captured in structured fields.
attributes.references: Oracle PeopleSoft Financials AP Vendor Master

attributes.name: payment_method
attributes.description: The vendor's preferred method for receiving payments from the institution. ACH (Automated Clearing House) is the most common method for electronic funds transfer.

attributes.name: payment_terms
attributes.description: The negotiated payment terms for this vendor, specifying the number of days within which payment is due after invoice receipt (e.g., Net 30, Net 45, 2/10 Net 30 for early payment discounts).
attributes.references: Oracle PeopleSoft Financials AP Vendor Master

attributes.name: remittance_address_line1
attributes.description: The first line of the vendor's remittance address where payments and payment notifications should be sent. May differ from the vendor's physical business address.
attributes.references: Oracle PeopleSoft Financials AP Vendor Master

attributes.name: remittance_address_line2
attributes.description: The second line of the vendor's remittance address, typically used for suite numbers, department names, or additional location details.
attributes.references: Oracle PeopleSoft Financials AP Vendor Master

attributes.name: remittance_city
attributes.description: The city component of the vendor's remittance address.
attributes.references: Oracle PeopleSoft Financials AP Vendor Master

attributes.name: remittance_country
attributes.description: The country component of the vendor's remittance address. Use three-letter ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country codes (e.g., USA, CAN, GBR).

attributes.name: remittance_postal_code
attributes.description: The postal code or ZIP code component of the vendor's remittance address.
attributes.references: Oracle PeopleSoft Financials AP Vendor Master

attributes.name: remittance_state
attributes.description: The state or province component of the vendor's remittance address. Use standard two-letter postal abbreviations for US states.

attributes.name: requires_1099
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether payments to this vendor must be reported to the IRS on Form 1099-MISC or 1099-NEC. True for most US-based vendors receiving payments for services; false for corporations and certain exempt entities.

attributes.name: small_business
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the vendor qualifies as a small business under federal Small Business Administration (SBA) size standards. Used for small business procurement goal tracking.

attributes.name: tax_id_type
attributes.description: The type of tax identification number provided by the vendor: Employer Identification Number for businesses, Social Security Number for individuals, or Individual Taxpayer Identification Number.

attributes.name: tax_identifier
attributes.description: The vendor's federal tax identification number, either an Employer Identification Number (EIN) or Social Security Number (SSN) for individual vendors. Required for IRS 1099 reporting and tax compliance.

attributes.name: vendor_number
attributes.description: The externally-known unique vendor identifier assigned by the institution for procurement and accounts payable operations. Used on purchase orders, invoices, and payment documents.
attributes.references: Oracle PeopleSoft Financials AP Vendor Master

attributes.name: vendor_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the vendor record in the institutional procurement system. Active vendors can receive purchase orders and payments; inactive vendors are retained for historical reporting but cannot be used for new transactions.
attributes.references: Oracle PeopleSoft Financials AP Vendor Master

attributes.name: vendor_type
attributes.description: Classification of the vendor based on the nature of goods or services provided to the institution. Determines procurement workflows and approval requirements. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: supplier|contractor|consultant|utility|government|individual|non_profit — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: veteran_owned
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the vendor is certified as a veteran-owned or service-disabled veteran-owned business. Used for diversity spend reporting.

attributes.name: w9_received_date
attributes.description: The date on which the institution received a completed W-9 form from the vendor. Used to track compliance and determine when forms need to be refreshed.

attributes.name: w9_status
attributes.description: Current status of the IRS Form W-9 (Request for Taxpayer Identification Number and Certification) on file for this vendor. Required for tax reporting compliance.

attributes.name: women_owned
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the vendor is certified as a women-owned business enterprise. Used for diversity spend reporting and supplier diversity program compliance.

products.name: purchase_order

Captures PO number, PO date, vendor reference, requisition reference, PO type (standard, blanket, contract), total PO amount, encumbrance amount, fund and cost center chartfield, buyer name, department, delivery address, required delivery date, approval status, and PO status (open, partially received, closed, cancelled). Sourced from Oracle PeopleSoft Financials Purchasing module.

attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.policy. Business justification: Procurement policies set competitive bidding thresholds, sole-source justification requirements, and approval limits. Purchasing officers enforce policy compliance for each PO. Required for Uniform Gu

attributes.name: primary_purchase_employee_id
attributes.description: Identifier for the purchasing agent or buyer responsible for managing this purchase order.

attributes.name: project_id
attributes.description: Identifier for the research project or capital project associated with this purchase, if applicable.

attributes.name: approval_status
attributes.description: Current approval workflow status indicating whether the purchase order has received necessary authorizations.

attributes.name: approved_by

attributes.name: approved_date

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this purchase order record was first created in the system. Audit trail for record creation.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the purchase order monetary values.

attributes.name: encumbrance_amount
attributes.description: Amount encumbered (reserved) in the general ledger to ensure budget availability for this purchase order.

attributes.name: fob_point
attributes.description: Free On Board point indicating where ownership and liability transfer from vendor to institution.

attributes.name: grant_number

attributes.name: invoiced_amount

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this purchase order record was last modified. Audit trail for record updates.

attributes.name: notes

attributes.name: payment_terms
attributes.description: Payment terms negotiated with the vendor (e.g., Net 30, Net 60, 2/10 Net 30).

attributes.name: po_date

attributes.name: po_number

attributes.name: po_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the purchase order indicating its position in the procurement workflow. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: draft|pending_approval|approved|open|partially_received|closed|cancelled|on_hold — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: po_type
attributes.description: Classification of the purchase order indicating the procurement method and terms structure.

attributes.name: program_code

attributes.name: promised_delivery_date
attributes.description: Date the vendor has committed to deliver the goods or services.

attributes.name: received_amount
attributes.description: Cumulative monetary value of goods or services that have been received against this purchase order.

attributes.name: required_delivery_date
attributes.description: Date by which the goods or services must be delivered to meet business needs.

attributes.name: requisition_number
attributes.description: Reference to the originating purchase requisition that initiated this purchase order.

attributes.name: ship_to_address_line1
attributes.description: First line of the delivery street address for this purchase order.

attributes.name: ship_to_city
attributes.description: City name for the delivery address.

attributes.name: ship_to_country
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO country code for the delivery address.

attributes.name: ship_to_location

attributes.name: ship_to_postal_code
attributes.description: Postal or ZIP code for the delivery address.

attributes.name: ship_to_state

attributes.name: shipping_method
attributes.description: Method of shipment or delivery specified for this purchase order (e.g., ground, overnight, freight).

attributes.name: tax_amount
attributes.description: Total tax amount applicable to this purchase order.

attributes.name: total_amount
attributes.description: Total monetary value of the purchase order including all line items before tax.

attributes.name: total_amount_with_tax
attributes.description: Net total purchase order amount including tax. Final commitment amount.

attributes.name: vendor_site_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the specific vendor location or site for delivery and payment purposes.

products.name: purchase_order_line
products.description: Individual line item within a purchase order specifying the goods or services being procured. Supports three-way match (PO, receipt, invoice) and encumbrance liquidation in PeopleSoft Financials.

attributes.name: purchase_order_line_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the purchase order line item. Primary key for this entity.

attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.finance_fund. Business justification: Purchase order lines are charged to funds (self-balancing accounting entities). Adding fund_id FK allows joining to finance_fund master for fund_name, fund_type, net_asset_classification, and restrict

attributes.name: ledger_account_id

attributes.description: The interface or channel through which the payment was submitted by the customer (e.g., online portal, mail, in-person, phone, mobile app).

attributes.name: payment_method
attributes.description: The instrument or mechanism used by the customer to remit payment (e.g., check, wire transfer, ACH, credit card, cash, lockbox).

attributes.name: posted_date
attributes.description: The date on which the receipt was posted to the general ledger and became part of the official financial records.

attributes.name: posted_timestamp
attributes.description: The precise date and time when the receipt was posted to the general ledger, supporting audit trail and transaction sequencing.

attributes.name: preparer_name
attributes.description: Name of the staff member who prepared the receipt record, captured for audit and accountability purposes.

attributes.name: program_code
attributes.description: Program or project code associated with the receipt, used for grant accounting and program-level financial reporting.

attributes.name: receipt_amount
attributes.description: Total gross amount received from the customer in the payment transaction, before any application to invoices or discounts.

attributes.name: receipt_date
attributes.description: The date on which the payment was received from the customer. This is the business event date for the cash receipt transaction.

attributes.name: receipt_number
attributes.description: Business identifier for the cash receipt, typically a sequential or formatted number assigned by the AR system for external reference and reconciliation.

attributes.name: receipt_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the cash receipt indicating its processing state within the AR workflow.

attributes.name: reconciliation_date
attributes.description: The date on which the receipt was successfully reconciled with the bank statement.

attributes.name: reconciliation_status
attributes.description: Status indicating whether the receipt has been reconciled with the bank statement and deposit records.

attributes.name: reference_number
attributes.description: External reference number provided by the customer or payment processor, such as a wire transfer confirmation number or transaction ID.

attributes.name: remittance_advice
attributes.description: Free-text field capturing remittance advice or payment notes provided by the customer indicating which invoices or charges the payment is intended to cover.

attributes.name: reversal_date
attributes.description: The date on which the receipt was reversed or voided, if applicable.

attributes.name: reversal_indicator
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this receipt has been reversed or voided in a subsequent transaction.

attributes.name: reversal_reason
attributes.description: Explanation or reason code for why the receipt was reversed, such as NSF (non-sufficient funds), customer dispute, or data entry error.

attributes.name: unapplied_amount
attributes.description: Portion of the receipt amount that remains unapplied and is held as a credit on the customer account, available for future application.

products.name: endowment_distribution

Supports endowment stewardship reporting to donors and GASB restricted net asset release accounting.

attributes.name: fiscal_period_id

attributes.name: journal_entry_id

attributes.name: policy_id

attributes.name: primary_endowment_employee_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the individual who approved the distribution transaction, typically a financial officer or endowment committee member.

attributes.name: receiving_cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Endowment distributions are allocated to receiving organizational cost centers. Adding receiving_cost_center_id FK allows joining to cost_center master for cost_center_name, hierarchy, manager, and bu

attributes.name: receiving_ledger_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.ledger_account. Business justification: Endowment distributions are posted to receiving GL accounts. Adding receiving_ledger_account_id FK allows joining to ledger_account master for account_name, account_type, hierarchy, and classification

attributes.name: reversed_by_distribution_endowment_distribution_id
attributes.description: Reference to the distribution transaction that reverses this distribution, if applicable.

attributes.name: reverses_distribution_id
attributes.description: Reference to the original distribution transaction that this distribution reverses, if this is a reversal entry.

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: The date on which the distribution was formally approved.

attributes.name: approval_status
attributes.description: Approval workflow status for the distribution: not required (automatic distributions), pending (awaiting review), approved (authorized), or rejected (denied).

attributes.name: approver_name
attributes.description: Full name of the individual who approved the distribution.

attributes.name: created_by_user
attributes.description: Username or identifier of the system user who created the distribution record.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the distribution record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the distribution amount.

attributes.name: distribution_amount
attributes.description: The total dollar amount distributed from the endowment fund to operating accounts.

attributes.name: distribution_date
attributes.description: The date on which the endowment distribution was executed and funds were transferred to operating accounts.

attributes.name: distribution_method
attributes.description: The methodology used to calculate the distribution: total return (spending policy based on market value), income-only (distribute actual investment income), hybrid (combination approach), unit value (per-unit distribution), or other custom method.

attributes.name: distribution_number
attributes.description: Business identifier for the distribution transaction, used for external reference and audit trails.

attributes.name: distribution_purpose
attributes.description: Detailed description of the intended use of the distributed funds, aligned with donor restrictions and endowment purpose.

attributes.name: distribution_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the distribution transaction: pending (awaiting approval), approved (authorized but not posted), posted (recorded in GL), reversed (voided after posting), or cancelled (voided before posting).

attributes.name: distribution_timestamp
attributes.description: Precise timestamp when the distribution transaction was processed in the financial system.

attributes.name: distribution_type
attributes.description: Classification of the distribution: regular (scheduled annual/periodic), special (one-time board-approved), emergency (crisis response), or supplemental (additional to regular).

attributes.name: donor_restriction_compliance
attributes.description: Indicates whether the distribution complies with donor-imposed restrictions: compliant (meets all restrictions), variance approved (exception granted), or under review (compliance being verified).

attributes.name: endowment_market_value_basis
attributes.description: The endowment fund market value used as the basis for calculating the distribution amount, typically a trailing 12-quarter or 3-year average.

attributes.name: last_modified_by_user
attributes.description: Username or identifier of the system user who last modified the distribution record.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the distribution record was last modified in the system.

attributes.name: net_asset_classification
attributes.description: GASB/FASB net asset classification of the distribution: unrestricted (no donor restrictions), temporarily restricted (time or purpose restrictions), or permanently restricted (principal must be maintained in perpetuity).

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Additional notes or comments regarding the distribution transaction, including special circumstances or variance explanations.

attributes.name: posted_date
attributes.description: The date on which the distribution transaction was posted to the general ledger.

attributes.name: posted_timestamp
attributes.description: Precise timestamp when the distribution was posted to the general ledger system.

attributes.name: preparer_name
attributes.description: Full name of the financial staff member who prepared the distribution.

attributes.name: receiving_program_code
attributes.description: The program code identifying the academic or administrative program benefiting from the distribution.

attributes.name: restriction_released_amount
attributes.description: The portion of the distribution that represents a release of temporarily restricted net assets to unrestricted, used for GASB restricted net asset release accounting.

attributes.name: reversal_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this distribution transaction is a reversal of a previously posted distribution.

attributes.name: spending_rate
attributes.description: The percentage rate applied to the endowment fund balance to calculate the distribution amount, typically based on a trailing average market value.

attributes.name: stewardship_report_required
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this distribution requires a stewardship report to be sent to the donor or donor family, typically for named endowments.

attributes.name: supporting_documentation_reference
attributes.description: Reference to supporting documentation such as board resolutions, spending policy calculations, or approval memos stored in the document management system.

attributes.name: underwater_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether the endowment fund market value is below the original gift principal (historic dollar value), which may restrict distributions under UPMIFA.
attributes.references: UPMIFA (Uniform Prudent Management of Institutional Funds Act)

attributes.name: upmifa_compliance_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: UPMIFA (Uniform Prudent Management of Institutional Funds Act) Compliance Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the distribution complies with UPMIFA prudent spending requirements, considering factors such as duration, preservation of fund, purposes of the institution and fund, and economic conditions.
attributes.references: UPMIFA (Uniform Prudent Management of Institutional Funds Act)

Distinct from the research domain's award record — this is the financial accounting view. Sourced from Oracle PeopleSoft Financials Projects/Grants module and Kuali Research.

attributes.name: closeout_date

attributes.description: Reference to the original grant expenditure transaction that this entry reverses. Null if this is not a reversal transaction. Used for audit trail and transaction history.

attributes.name: allowability_status
attributes.description: Indicates whether the expenditure is allowable under OMB Uniform Guidance and sponsor terms and conditions. Unallowable costs must be moved to institutional funds.

attributes.name: amount
attributes.description: The monetary value of the expenditure transaction in the institution's functional currency. Represents the total cost charged to the grant account.

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: The date on which the expenditure was approved for charging to the grant account. Used for audit trail and compliance documentation.

attributes.name: approval_status
attributes.description: Current approval status of the expenditure transaction. Tracks workflow state for pre-award approval, post-award review, or audit resolution.

attributes.name: cost_sharing_indicator

attributes.name: effort_percent
attributes.description: The percentage of an employee's total compensated effort represented by this salary expenditure. Used for effort reporting and certification under OMB Uniform Guidance. Null for non-personnel expenditures.

attributes.name: expenditure_category

attributes.name: expenditure_date

attributes.name: facilities_administrative_rate
attributes.description: The indirect cost rate applied to this expenditure for calculating facilities and administrative cost recovery. Expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.5400 for 54%). Rate varies by cost pool and sponsor type.

attributes.name: grant_expenditure_description
attributes.description: Detailed narrative description of the expenditure, including purpose, business justification, and relationship to grant objectives. Required for audit trail and sponsor compliance.

attributes.name: invoice_number
attributes.description: The sponsor invoice or Federal Financial Report (FFR) number that includes this expenditure. Used for reconciliation between grant accounting and accounts receivable.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this expenditure record was last updated. Used for change tracking and data quality monitoring.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional comments, special instructions, or audit notes related to the expenditure. Used for documenting exceptions, clarifications, or compliance issues.

attributes.name: payee_name
attributes.description: The name of the individual or organization receiving payment for this expenditure. May be employee name, vendor name, or subrecipient institution name.

attributes.name: posting_date
attributes.description: The date on which the expenditure transaction was posted to the general ledger. May differ from expenditure date due to processing lag.

attributes.name: project_code
attributes.description: The project or grant code segment of the chartfield string. Often synonymous with the grant account number for sponsored projects.

attributes.name: reversal_indicator
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this expenditure transaction is a reversal or correction of a previously posted expenditure. True if this is a reversing entry; false for original transactions.

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: The operational system from which this expenditure transaction originated (e.g., Oracle PeopleSoft Financials for AP/GL transactions, Kuali Research for research-specific charges, Workday HCM for payroll).

attributes.name: source_transaction_reference
attributes.description: The unique transaction identifier in the source system. Used for data lineage, reconciliation, and drill-back to source documents.

attributes.name: sponsor_billing_status
attributes.description: Current status of the expenditure in the sponsor invoicing and payment cycle. Tracks whether the cost has been billed to the sponsor and payment received.

attributes.name: transaction_number
attributes.description: Business identifier for the expenditure transaction as recorded in the financial system. Typically sourced from Oracle PeopleSoft Financials or Kuali Research.
attributes.references: NACUBO Financial Accounting and Reporting Manual

products.name: fiscal_period

attributes.name: fiscal_period_id

attributes.name: adjustment_period_indicator

attributes.name: ap_close_date

attributes.name: ar_close_date

attributes.name: ar_status

attributes.name: budget_carryforward_flag

attributes.name: budget_close_date
attributes.description: Actual calendar date when the Budget module was closed for this fiscal period. Null if the period is still open.

attributes.name: budget_status
attributes.description: Current open/closed status of the period for budget transactions and budget checking. Controls whether budget entries and adjustments can be posted to this period.

attributes.name: created_timestamp

attributes.name: encumbrance_rollover_flag

attributes.name: fa_rate_calculation_period_flag

attributes.name: fasb_reporting_period_flag

attributes.name: fiscal_year

attributes.name: gasb_reporting_period_flag

attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this period is included in GASB financial statement reporting. True for periods that contribute to annual GASB-compliant financial statements for public institutions.

attributes.name: gl_close_date

attributes.references: Oracle PeopleSoft Financials General Ledger Module

attributes.name: gl_closed_by_user
attributes.description: Username or identifier of the user who performed the General Ledger close for this fiscal period.
attributes.references: Oracle PeopleSoft Financials General Ledger Module

attributes.name: gl_status

attributes.name: ipeds_reporting_year

attributes.description: The IPEDS reporting year to which this fiscal period maps for federal reporting purposes. IPEDS fiscal year typically runs July 1 through June 30 for most institutions.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp

attributes.name: nacubo_reporting_category

attributes.description: NACUBO reporting category or classification to which this fiscal period maps for benchmarking and comparative financial reporting purposes.

attributes.name: period_description
attributes.description: Additional descriptive text or notes about the fiscal period, including any special circumstances, adjustments, or institutional context relevant to this period.

attributes.name: period_end_date
attributes.description: Last calendar date of the fiscal period. Defines the end of the accounting period for transaction posting and reporting.

attributes.name: period_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name or label for the fiscal period (e.g., 'July 2024', 'Period 01 FY2024', 'Year-End Adjustment Period').
attributes.references: Oracle PeopleSoft Financials General Ledger Module

attributes.name: period_number
attributes.description: Sequential numeric identifier for the period within the fiscal year (e.g., 1 through 12 for monthly periods, or 1 through 13 for institutions with a 13th adjustment period).
attributes.references: Oracle PeopleSoft Financials General Ledger Module

attributes.name: period_start_date
attributes.description: First calendar date of the fiscal period. Defines the beginning of the accounting period for transaction posting and reporting.

attributes.name: period_status
attributes.description: Overall lifecycle status of the fiscal period record. Active periods are current or future; inactive periods are historical but accessible; archived periods are retained for compliance but not actively used.

attributes.name: period_type
attributes.description: Classification of the fiscal period type. Regular periods are standard monthly/quarterly periods; adjustment periods are used for year-end entries; opening/closing periods mark fiscal year boundaries.
attributes.references: Oracle PeopleSoft Financials General Ledger Module

attributes.name: purchasing_close_date
attributes.description: Actual calendar date when the Purchasing module was closed for this fiscal period. Null if the period is still open.

attributes.name: purchasing_status
attributes.description: Current open/closed status of the period for Purchasing module transactions. Controls whether purchase orders and requisitions can be posted to this period.

attributes.name: quarter_number
attributes.description: Fiscal quarter to which this period belongs within the fiscal year (1, 2, 3, or 4). Used for quarterly financial reporting and analysis.
attributes.references: NACUBO Financial Accounting and Reporting Manual

attributes.name: year_end_close_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this period is designated as the year-end closing period for the fiscal year. True if this is the final period or adjustment period for fiscal year-end close activities.

products.name: bank_account
products.description: Institutional bank account master record for all depository and disbursement accounts maintained by the institution. Captures bank name, bank routing number, account number (masked), account type (checking, money market, sweep, payroll, restricted), account purpose, currency, bank contact, authorized signatories, reconciliation frequency, and active status. Supports bank reconciliation, cash management, and treasury operations in PeopleSoft Financials.

attributes.name: bank_account_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the institutional bank account record. Primary key for the bank account master data.
attributes.references: Oracle PeopleSoft Financials - Bank Account Master

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Bank accounts are assigned to organizational cost centers for budget and responsibility tracking. Adding cost_center_id FK allows joining to cost_center master for cost_center_name, hierarchy, manager

attributes.name: account_manager_email
attributes.description: The email address of the institutional employee responsible for managing this bank account. Used for notifications, workflow routing, and audit inquiries.

attributes.name: account_manager_name
attributes.description: The name of the institutional employee responsible for managing this bank account, including reconciliation, transaction monitoring, and relationship coordination.

attributes.name: account_name
attributes.description: The descriptive name or title assigned to the bank account for internal identification and reporting purposes (e.g., General Operating Account, Payroll Disbursement Account, Restricted Grant Account).

attributes.name: account_number

attributes.name: account_number_masked
attributes.description: Partially masked version of the bank account number for display purposes (e.g., ****1234). Used in reports and user interfaces to protect sensitive financial data while maintaining reference capability.

attributes.name: account_opened_date
attributes.description: The date when the bank account was originally opened with the financial institution. Used for account history tracking and relationship management.

attributes.name: account_purpose
attributes.description: The primary business purpose or functional use of the bank account within institutional operations. Aligns with fund accounting and treasury management practices. attributes.name: account_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the bank account. Determines whether the account is available for transactions, reconciliation, and cash management operations.

attributes.name: account_type
attributes.description: Classification of the bank account based on its financial instrument type. Determines transaction capabilities, interest accrual, and liquidity characteristics. attributes.description: Indicates whether the account is enabled for ACH transactions (direct deposits, electronic payments). Critical for payroll, vendor payments, and student refunds.

attributes.name: authorized_signatories
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of names or identifiers of individuals authorized to sign checks, initiate wire transfers, or approve transactions on this account. Critical for internal controls and segregation of duties.

attributes.name: available_balance
attributes.description: The available balance in the account after accounting for outstanding checks, pending deposits, and holds. Represents funds available for immediate disbursement.

attributes.name: bank_branch_address

attributes.name: bank_branch_name

attributes.name: bank_contact_email

attributes.name: collateral_type

attributes.name: collateral_value
attributes.description: The current market value of collateral pledged by the financial institution to secure deposits. Must meet or exceed required collateralization percentage per institutional policy.

attributes.name: collateralization_required_flag

attributes.name: currency_code

attributes.name: current_balance
attributes.description: The current available balance in the bank account as of the last reconciliation or bank statement. Used for cash management and liquidity monitoring.

attributes.name: dual_signature_threshold
attributes.description: The transaction amount threshold above which dual signatures are required for disbursements. Used to enforce internal control policies and mitigate fraud risk.

attributes.name: fdic_coverage_amount
attributes.business_glossary_term: Federal Deposit Insurance Corporation (FDIC) Coverage Amount
attributes.description: The maximum amount of FDIC insurance coverage applicable to this account (typically $250,000 per depositor per institution). Used for risk assessment and collateralization monitoring.

attributes.name: fdic_insured_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Federal Deposit Insurance Corporation (FDIC) Insured Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the bank account is covered by FDIC insurance up to the statutory limit. Critical for risk management and investment policy compliance.

attributes.name: interest_accrual_method
attributes.description: The frequency and method by which interest is calculated and credited to the account. Determines timing of interest income recognition.

attributes.name: interest_rate
attributes.description: The annual interest rate percentage applied to the account balance for interest-bearing accounts. Expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.0250 for 2.50%).

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this bank account record was most recently updated. Used for change tracking and audit compliance.

attributes.name: last_reconciliation_date

attributes.name: minimum_balance_required
attributes.description: The minimum balance that must be maintained in the account to avoid fees or meet contractual requirements with the financial institution.

attributes.name: next_reconciliation_due_date
attributes.description: The date by which the next bank reconciliation must be completed based on the reconciliation frequency policy. Used for workflow management and compliance monitoring.
attributes.references: NACUBO Advisory Report - Bank Reconciliation Best Practices

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-form text field for additional notes, special instructions, or contextual information about the bank account. Used for documentation of unique account characteristics or restrictions.
attributes.references: Oracle PeopleSoft Financials - Bank Account Master

attributes.name: online_banking_enabled_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether online banking access is enabled for this account. Determines availability of electronic statements, transaction history, and real-time balance inquiries.

attributes.name: positive_pay_enabled_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether positive pay fraud prevention service is enabled for this account. Matches issued checks against presented checks to prevent fraudulent payments.

attributes.name: reconciliation_frequency

attributes.references: NACUBO Advisory Report - Bank Reconciliation Best Practices

attributes.name: signatory_requirement

attributes.name: wire_transfer_enabled_flag

products.name: space_allocation
products.description: This association product represents the allocation of physical space to sponsored research grants for F&A (facilities and administrative) cost recovery and compliance reporting. It captures the assignment of specific rooms to grant accounts with allocation percentages, time periods, and square footage assignments that exist only in the context of this relationship. Each record links one grant account to one room with attributes tracking the portion of space dedicated to that grant for indirect cost rate calculations and space utilization reporting.. Existence Justification: In higher education research administration, grant accounts routinely require multiple types of space (laboratory benches, office space, equipment rooms, storage) across different rooms and buildings, while individual rooms are frequently shared by multiple grants with specific allocation percentages tracked for F&A cost recovery. The institution must maintain detailed space allocation records showing which grants occupy which rooms, for what percentage, and during what time periods to justify indirect cost rates to federal sponsors (NSF, NIH) and comply with space survey requirements. This is an actively managed operational relationship where research administrators create, update, and audit space allocations as grants start, end, or change scope.

attributes.description: Unique identifier for this space allocation record. Primary key.

attributes.name: grant_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the grant account that is allocated space

attributes.name: room_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the room being allocated to the grant

attributes.name: allocation_percentage
attributes.description: The percentage of the room's space allocated to this grant account. Used for F&A cost calculations when multiple grants share a room. Must sum to 100% or less across all grants using the room.

attributes.name: allocation_status
attributes.description: Current status of this space allocation: active (currently in effect), pending (approved but not yet started), expired (end date passed), terminated (ended early).

attributes.name: allocation_type
attributes.description: Classification of the allocation arrangement: dedicated (100% to this grant), shared (multiple grants share the space), temporary (short-term allocation for specific project phase).

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: Date when this space allocation was officially approved.

attributes.name: approved_by
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the research administrator, department chair, or facilities manager who approved this space allocation.

attributes.name: assignment_end_date
attributes.description: The date when this space allocation ended or is scheduled to end. Null indicates an ongoing allocation. Used for historical space utilization analysis and grant closeout.

attributes.name: assignment_start_date
attributes.description: The date when this space allocation became effective. Critical for time-based F&A rate calculations and compliance reporting.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this space allocation record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: justification
attributes.description: Free-text explanation of why this space is allocated to this grant, particularly important for federal audits and space surveys. May reference specific aims, equipment, or research activities.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this space allocation record was last updated.

attributes.name: monthly_rate
attributes.description: The monthly cost rate applied to this space allocation for internal cost recovery or chargeback purposes. May be null if institution uses negotiated F&A rates rather than direct space charges.

attributes.name: square_feet_assigned
attributes.description: The net assignable square footage allocated to this grant, calculated as room NASF × allocation_percentage. Used for space surveys and F&A rate justification to federal sponsors.

attributes.description: Reference to the user who created this journal batch, supporting audit trail and accountability requirements.

attributes.description: Reference to the general ledger or sub-ledger to which this journal batch belongs, supporting multi-ledger environments for different reporting requirements.

attributes.name: posted_by_user_identity_account_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Posted By User Identity Account Id
attributes.description: Reference to the user who posted this journal batch to the general ledger, supporting audit trail requirements.

attributes.name: recurring_schedule_id
attributes.description: Reference to the recurring schedule definition that generated this batch, applicable only for recurring journal batches.

attributes.name: approved_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this journal batch was approved for posting, supporting audit trail and approval workflow tracking.

attributes.name: batch_date
attributes.description: The business date assigned to the journal batch, representing when the batch is effective for accounting purposes. This is the principal business event date for the batch.

attributes.name: batch_description
attributes.description: Detailed narrative description of the purpose, content, or context of the journal batch.

attributes.name: batch_name
attributes.description: Descriptive name or title assigned to the journal batch for identification and categorization purposes.

attributes.name: batch_number
attributes.description: Human-readable business identifier for the journal batch, typically assigned by the financial system or user. Used for external reference and reporting.

attributes.name: batch_source
attributes.description: Origin or method by which the journal batch was created. Manual indicates user-entered batches, automated indicates system-generated batches from business rules, interface indicates batches from integrated systems, import indicates batches loaded from external files, conversion indicates batches from legacy system migration, and system generated indicates batches created by scheduled processes.

attributes.name: batch_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the journal batch. Draft indicates initial creation, pending approval indicates submission for review, approved indicates authorization for posting, posted indicates successful posting to the general ledger, rejected indicates denial of approval, and cancelled indicates withdrawal from processing.

attributes.name: batch_type
attributes.description: Classification of the journal batch based on its purpose and processing characteristics. Standard batches are regular operational entries, recurring batches repeat on a schedule, adjusting batches correct prior periods, closing batches finalize fiscal periods, reversing batches automatically reverse in the next period, and statistical batches record non-monetary data.

attributes.name: control_total_amount
attributes.description: Optional control total entered by the user at batch creation time, used to validate that the sum of journal entries matches the expected total.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this journal batch record was first created in the system, supporting audit trail requirements.

attributes.name: currency_code

attributes.name: entry_count
attributes.description: The total number of individual journal entries contained within this batch, used for control and reconciliation purposes.

attributes.name: external_reference_number
attributes.description: Optional reference to an external document, transaction, or system identifier that provides additional context or traceability for this journal batch.

attributes.name: is_balanced
attributes.description: Indicates whether the journal batch is in balance, meaning total debits equal total credits. True indicates balanced, False indicates out of balance.

attributes.name: is_recurring
attributes.description: Indicates whether this journal batch is part of a recurring schedule that automatically generates batches at regular intervals. True indicates recurring, False indicates one-time.

attributes.name: line_count
attributes.description: The total number of individual journal lines across all entries in this batch, used for control and reconciliation purposes.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this journal batch record was last modified, supporting audit trail and change tracking requirements.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-form text field for additional comments, instructions, or contextual information about the journal batch.

attributes.description: The date and time when this journal batch was posted to the general ledger, supporting audit trail and posting history tracking.

attributes.description: The date when the journal batch was actually posted to the general ledger, which may differ from the batch date for timing or control purposes.

attributes.name: reversal_date

attributes.name: total_debit_amount
attributes.description: The sum of all debit amounts across all journal entries in this batch, used for batch balancing and control totals.

domains.name: facility
domains.description: Manages campus physical infrastructure including buildings, classrooms, laboratories, residence halls, utilities, and grounds. Tracks space inventory, room utilization, maintenance work orders, capital projects, energy management, and space planning. Supports Archibus operations, ADA compliance, and F&A cost rate space calculations.

products.name: building
products.description: Master record for every campus building and structure. Captures building code, name, address, construction year, gross square footage, assignable square footage, building type (academic, residential, administrative, research, athletic), ownership status (owned, leased, ground-lease), historic designation, ADA compliance status, LEED certification level, and operational status. Serves as the authoritative SSOT for all building-level space inventory and F&A cost rate space calculations reported to federal sponsors.
products.reference: Archibus Building Master / FICM (Facilities Inventory and Classification Manual)

products.name: room
products.description: Master record for every assignable and non-assignable room or space within a building. Captures room number, floor, room use code (per FICM classification), room type (classroom, laboratory, office, residence hall unit, common area), design capacity, station count, net assignable square footage, ADA accessibility features, technology infrastructure (smart classroom, AV equipment), and current occupancy status. Foundational entity for space utilization, course scheduling, and F&A indirect cost rate calculations.
products.reference: Archibus Space / FICM Room Use Codes

attributes.name: room_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the room or space within the institution's facilities inventory. Primary key for the room entity.

attributes.name: building_id
attributes.description: Reference to the building in which this room is located. Links to the building master record for campus facility hierarchy.

attributes.description: Foreign key linking to library.collection. Business justification: Academic libraries assign physical collections to specific rooms (special collections rooms, rare book vaults, archives). Required for space allocation planning, environmental control specifications f

attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.regulatory_requirement. Business justification: Rooms have specific compliance requirements based on use: biosafety levels for labs, ADA accessibility standards, clinical space regulations, hazmat storage requirements. Environmental health and safe

attributes.name: active_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the room record is currently active (True) in the facilities inventory or has been deactivated/archived (False). Used for data management and reporting scope control.

attributes.name: ada_accessible_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) Accessible Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the room meets ADA accessibility standards (True) or not (False). Includes considerations for wheelchair access, assistive listening systems, and accessible fixtures.
attributes.references: ADA Standards for Accessible Design (2010), Section 504 of the Rehabilitation Act

attributes.name: ada_features

attributes.name: assignable_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the room is assignable space (True) or non-assignable space (False) per FICM standards. Assignable spaces are used for specific institutional functions; non-assignable includes circulation, mechanical, and structural areas.
attributes.references: FICM (Facilities Inventory and Classification Manual) - NCES

attributes.name: av_equipment_description
attributes.description: Detailed inventory of audio-visual equipment installed in the room (e.g., 'Epson projector, Extron control system, wireless microphone, Blu-ray player, document camera').

attributes.name: av_equipment_level
attributes.description: Classification of the audio-visual technology infrastructure installed in the room. attributes.name: biosafety_level
attributes.description: The biosafety level classification for laboratories handling biological agents, as defined by CDC/NIH guidelines. BSL-1=minimal hazard; BSL-2=moderate hazard; BSL-3=serious/potentially lethal; BSL-4=dangerous/exotic agents. Not_applicable for non-laboratory spaces.
attributes.references: CDC/NIH Biosafety in Microbiological and Biomedical Laboratories (BMBL)

attributes.name: ceiling_height_feet
attributes.description: The height of the ceiling in feet, measured from floor to ceiling. Relevant for space planning, AV equipment installation, and building code compliance.

attributes.name: climate_control_type
attributes.description: The type of heating, ventilation, and air conditioning system serving the room. Central=building-wide system; Individual=room-specific unit; None=no climate control; VAV=variable air volume; CAV=constant air volume.

attributes.name: condition
attributes.description: Assessment of the physical condition of the room based on facilities inspections. Excellent=like new; Good=well maintained; Fair=minor issues; Poor=significant deficiencies; Critical=immediate attention required.

attributes.name: construction_year
attributes.description: The year the room was originally constructed as part of the building. Used for historical tracking, depreciation calculations, and facilities planning.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this room record was first created in the facilities management system. Used for audit trail and data lineage tracking.

attributes.name: design_capacity

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: The date this room record became effective in the facilities inventory system. Used for temporal tracking and historical space analysis.

attributes.name: emergency_equipment

attributes.name: gross_square_feet

attributes.name: last_inspection_date
attributes.description: The date of the most recent facilities inspection or condition assessment of the room. Used for compliance tracking and maintenance planning.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this room record was most recently updated. Used for change tracking and data quality monitoring.

attributes.name: natural_light_flag

attributes.name: net_assignable_square_feet
attributes.description: The net assignable square footage of the room, measured per FICM standards. Used for space utilization analysis, Facilities and Administrative (F&A) cost rate calculations, and IPEDS reporting.
attributes.references: FICM (Facilities Inventory and Classification Manual) - NCES, IPEDS Facilities Component

attributes.name: occupancy_status
attributes.description: Current occupancy or availability status of the room. attributes.name: renovation_date
attributes.description: The date of the most recent major renovation or refurbishment of the room. Used for capital planning, deferred maintenance tracking, and space quality assessment.

attributes.name: responsible_party
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the individual, department, or unit responsible for the room's management, maintenance, and scheduling. May be a facilities manager, department chair, or administrative contact.

attributes.name: room_name
attributes.description: Descriptive name or title of the room, often used for named lecture halls, laboratories, or conference rooms (e.g., 'Smith Auditorium', 'Chemistry Lab A', 'Board Room').

attributes.name: room_number
attributes.description: The official room number or identifier as displayed on signage and used in campus navigation. May include alphanumeric characters and floor prefixes (e.g., 201A, B-105, L3-220).

attributes.name: room_type
attributes.description: High-level categorical classification of the room's primary function. Used for space utilization reporting, scheduling eligibility, and facilities planning. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: classroom|laboratory|office|conference_room|study_room|residence_hall_unit|common_area|storage|mechanical|restroom|auditorium|library_space|athletic_facility|dining_facility|healthcare_facility|other — 16 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: scheduling_eligible_flag

attributes.name: reviewed_date
attributes.description: The date when the survey data was reviewed and validated by the reviewer. Part of the quality assurance workflow.

attributes.name: room_use_classification

attributes.name: sample_size

attributes.name: square_footage_surveyed
attributes.description: The net assignable square footage of the space covered by this survey record. Used for space utilization rate calculations and F&A cost allocation.

attributes.name: submission_date
attributes.description: The date when the survey data was submitted to the federal agency for F&A rate negotiation. Used for compliance tracking and audit trail.

attributes.name: survey_end_date
attributes.description: The date when the survey period ended. Used to define the observation window for space utilization analysis.

attributes.name: survey_methodology
attributes.description: The methodology used to conduct the space utilization survey. Actual Use: direct observation and documentation; Modified Traditional: simplified sampling approach; Simplified: basic classification; Detailed Analysis: comprehensive time-motion study.

products.name: utility_meter

Also tracks periodic consumption readings including start/end dates, quantity and unit of measure (kWh, therms, gallons, ton-hours), demand peaks, period costs, and data source (manual read, AMR/AMI automated). products.name: inspection
products.description: Transactional record of formal inspections of buildings, rooms, systems, or assets, including resulting deficiency findings and deferred maintenance items. products.name: project_funding
products.description: This association product represents the funding relationship between capital projects and advancement funds. It captures the allocation of donor-restricted and institutional funds to specific capital construction, renovation, or infrastructure projects. Each record links one capital project to one advancement fund with allocation amounts, restriction compliance tracking, and disbursement schedules that exist only in the context of this funding relationship. Supports Board reporting on fund utilization and donor stewardship reporting on gift impact.. Existence Justification: In higher education capital project financing, a single capital project is routinely funded by multiple advancement funds (endowments, annual giving, corporate gifts, foundation grants), and individual advancement funds commonly support multiple capital projects over time. The business actively manages fund allocations as operational records, tracking allocation amounts, disbursement schedules, restriction compliance per donor terms, and expenditure against each fund source for Board reporting and donor stewardship.
