products.name: asset_compliance
products.description: This association product represents the compliance relationship between facility assets and regulatory requirements. It captures the ongoing compliance status, inspection schedules, and certification records for each asset-requirement pair. Each record links one facility asset to one regulatory requirement with attributes that track inspection history, compliance status, and certification details specific to that asset's obligation under that regulation.. Existence Justification: In higher education facilities management, individual physical assets (elevators, boilers, fume hoods, autoclaves, fire suppression systems) must comply with multiple distinct regulatory requirements (ADA, OSHA, EPA, fire codes, pressure vessel regulations, laboratory safety standards). Simultaneously, each regulatory requirement applies to multiple assets across campus. Facilities teams actively manage compliance for each asset-requirement pair, tracking inspection schedules, certification status, and remediation activities as operational business processes.

domains.name: library
domains.description: Governs academic library services including physical and digital resource cataloging, acquisitions, circulation, interlibrary loan, electronic resource licensing, and patron services via Alma/Ex Libris. Supports OER tracking, discovery services, scholarly communication, and research support for faculty and students.
domains.references: ALA, MARC21, Dublin Core, Alma/Ex Libris

products.name: bib_record
products.description: Bibliographic master record representing a distinct intellectual work in the library catalog. Stores MARC-based metadata including title, author, edition, publication year, ISBN/ISSN, OCLC number, CIP classification, subject headings, language, format type (monograph, serial, electronic, AV), and discovery metadata. Sourced from Alma/Ex Libris catalog module. Serves as the authoritative catalog entry for all physical and digital holdings.

attributes.name: bib_record_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the bibliographic record in the library catalog. Primary key for the bibliographic master record representing a distinct intellectual work.
attributes.references: MARC 21 Bibliographic Format, Alma/Ex Libris Data Model

attributes.name: access_restrictions
attributes.description: Description of any restrictions on access to the resource, including licensing limitations, embargo periods, or institutional access requirements.
attributes.references: MARC 21 Field 506, Electronic Resource Licensing Standards

attributes.name: acquisition_date
attributes.description: Date when the first item associated with this bibliographic record was acquired by the library. Used for collection age analysis and accreditation reporting.
attributes.references: Alma Acquisitions Module, Library Collection Development Standards

attributes.name: author
attributes.description: Primary author, creator, or corporate body responsible for the intellectual content. Includes personal names, corporate entities, or conference names.

attributes.name: bib_record_description
attributes.description: Physical characteristics of the resource including pagination, dimensions, illustrations, and accompanying materials. Example: '324 pages : illustrations ; 24 cm'.

attributes.name: catalog_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the bibliographic record in the catalog. Determines visibility in discovery systems and availability for circulation.
attributes.references: Alma Cataloging Workflow, Library Catalog Management Standards

attributes.name: cataloging_level
attributes.description: Level of completeness and detail in the bibliographic description. Examples include full-level, core-level, minimal-level, or provisional cataloging.

attributes.name: cip_code
attributes.description: Taxonomic code classifying the subject matter for academic program alignment. Used for collection development and accreditation reporting.
attributes.references: NCES CIP Taxonomy, IPEDS Reporting Standards

attributes.name: circulation_count
attributes.description: Total number of times items associated with this bibliographic record have been checked out. Used for collection usage analysis and weeding decisions.
attributes.references: Alma Circulation Analytics, Library Usage Metrics

attributes.name: copyright_year
attributes.description: Year of copyright as stated in the resource. Used for intellectual property tracking and rights management.

attributes.name: created_date
attributes.description: Timestamp when the bibliographic record was first created in the library catalog system. Used for audit trails and collection development analysis.
attributes.references: Alma Data Model, Library Audit Standards

attributes.name: dewey_call_number
attributes.description: Dewey Decimal Classification number for subject-based organization. Alternative classification system used in some academic and public libraries.

attributes.name: doi
attributes.description: Persistent identifier for digital scholarly resources. Used for electronic resource linking, citation tracking, and scholarly communication.

attributes.name: edition
attributes.description: Edition information indicating version, revision, or issue of the work. Examples include 'Second edition', 'Revised', 'Director's cut'.

attributes.name: encoding_level
attributes.description: Code indicating the level of bibliographic control and completeness of the MARC record. Used for quality assessment and record enhancement workflows.
attributes.references: MARC 21 Leader/17, Library of Congress Encoding Standards

attributes.name: format_type
attributes.description: High-level categorization of the physical or digital format of the resource. Determines circulation policies, shelving, and discovery facets.

attributes.name: holdings_count
attributes.description: Total number of physical or electronic holdings attached to this bibliographic record. Used for collection size reporting and availability display.
attributes.references: Alma Holdings Management, Library Collection Metrics

attributes.name: isbn
attributes.description: Unique commercial book identifier for monographs. May include ISBN-10 or ISBN-13 format. Used for acquisitions, cataloging, and discovery.

attributes.name: issn
attributes.description: Unique identifier for serial publications including journals, magazines, and continuing resources. Eight-digit code used for periodical management and discovery.

attributes.name: language_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 639-2 language code representing the primary language of the intellectual content. Used for discovery filtering and collection analysis.

attributes.name: last_circulation_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent checkout of any item associated with this bibliographic record. Used for collection evaluation and retention decisions.
attributes.references: Alma Circulation Analytics, Library Collection Management Standards

attributes.name: last_modified_by
attributes.description: Username or identifier of the cataloger or system process that last updated the bibliographic record. Supports change tracking and accountability.
attributes.references: Alma User Management, Library Cataloging Workflow Standards

attributes.name: last_modified_date
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent update to the bibliographic record. Used for change tracking, synchronization, and data quality monitoring.
attributes.references: Alma Data Model, Library Audit Standards

attributes.name: lc_call_number
attributes.description: Library of Congress classification number used for subject-based shelving and retrieval. Primary call number for academic libraries.
attributes.references: Library of Congress Classification, MARC 21 Field 050

attributes.name: lccn
attributes.description: Unique identifier assigned by the Library of Congress for cataloging and bibliographic control. Used for authoritative cataloging and national bibliography.
attributes.references: Library of Congress Standards, MARC 21 Field 010

attributes.name: marc_record
attributes.description: Full MARC 21 bibliographic record in ISO 2709 or MARCXML format. Contains complete structured metadata for interoperability and data exchange.

attributes.name: material_type
attributes.description: Specific material or media type describing the physical or digital carrier. Examples include 'print book', 'DVD', 'streaming video', 'e-book', 'microfilm'.
attributes.references: RDA Media Type and Carrier Type, MARC 21 Fields 337/338

attributes.name: mms_code
attributes.description: Alma-specific unique identifier for the bibliographic record in the MARC Management System. Used for system-level record tracking and API integration.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Additional descriptive information not captured in other fields. May include bibliographic history, contents notes, summary, or restrictions on access.

attributes.name: oclc_number
attributes.business_glossary_term: Online Computer Library Center (OCLC) Control Number
attributes.description: Unique identifier assigned by OCLC WorldCat for shared cataloging and interlibrary loan. Enables global resource discovery and bibliographic data sharing across institutions.

attributes.name: oer_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the resource is an Open Educational Resource freely available for educational use. Supports OER tracking and affordability initiatives.
attributes.references: OER Commons Standards, Institutional OER Policy

attributes.name: peer_reviewed_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the resource has undergone peer review process. Critical for scholarly research and academic quality assessment.
attributes.references: Scholarly Publishing Standards, Alma Discovery Metadata

attributes.name: publication_place
attributes.description: Geographic location where the resource was published or distributed. Includes city and country information.
attributes.references: MARC 21 Field 264, RDA Place of Publication

attributes.name: publication_year
attributes.description: Year the resource was published, issued, or released. Used for chronological sorting, collection development, and discovery filtering.
attributes.references: MARC 21 Field 264, RDA Date of Publication

attributes.name: publisher
attributes.description: Name of the publisher, distributor, or issuing body responsible for making the resource available. Used for acquisitions and cataloging.

attributes.name: record_source
attributes.description: Origin of the bibliographic record, such as original cataloging, OCLC import, vendor-supplied metadata, or batch load. Used for quality control and provenance tracking.

attributes.name: series_statement
attributes.description: Information about the series to which the resource belongs, including series title and numbering. Used for collection grouping and discovery.

attributes.name: subject_headings
attributes.description: Controlled vocabulary subject terms describing the intellectual content. Includes Library of Congress Subject Headings (LCSH) or Medical Subject Headings (MeSH). Supports subject-based discovery.
attributes.references: Library of Congress Subject Headings, MARC 21 Fields 6XX

attributes.name: suppressed_from_discovery
attributes.description: Indicates whether the bibliographic record is hidden from public discovery interfaces while remaining in the catalog. Used for records in process or with access restrictions.
attributes.references: Alma Discovery Configuration, Library Discovery Standards

attributes.name: title
attributes.description: Full title of the intellectual work including main title, subtitle, and statement of responsibility. Primary discovery field for catalog searches.

attributes.name: url
attributes.description: Web address providing direct access to electronic resources. Used for e-books, streaming media, and digital collections.
attributes.references: MARC 21 Field 856, Alma Electronic Resource Management

attributes.name: created_by
attributes.description: Username or identifier of the cataloger or system process that created the bibliographic record. Used for workflow tracking and quality control.
attributes.references: Alma User Management, Library Cataloging Workflow Standards

products.name: holding
products.description: Physical or electronic holding record linked to a bibliographic record, representing the library's ownership or access rights to a specific manifestation of a work. Tracks call number, shelving location, library branch, collection code, acquisition date, retention policy, and item count. Sourced from Alma/Ex Libris holdings management module. Distinct from the bib_record (what exists) and item (individual copy).

attributes.name: holding_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the holding record. Primary key. Represents the library's ownership or access rights to a specific manifestation of a bibliographic work.

attributes.name: bib_record_id
attributes.description: Foreign key reference to the bibliographic record that this holding is linked to. Represents the intellectual work that this holding manifests.

attributes.name: collection_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to library.collection. Business justification: holding has collection_code (STRING) and collection_name (STRING) that reference collection. Business: holdings belong to library collections (named groupings of materials managed as units). This is a

attributes.name: access_policy
attributes.description: The policy governing who may access this holding and under what conditions. Common policies include open access, restricted access, staff only, special permission required, or course reserves.

attributes.name: acquisition_date
attributes.description: The date on which the library acquired ownership or access rights to this holding. Critical for tracking collection growth and retention policies.

attributes.name: acquisition_method
attributes.description: The method by which the library acquired this holding. Common methods include purchase, gift, exchange, deposit, license agreement, or subscription.

attributes.name: call_number
attributes.description: The classification number and location code used to organize and retrieve the item on library shelves. Typically follows Library of Congress (LC) or Dewey Decimal Classification (DDC) systems.
attributes.references: Library of Congress Classification (LCC), Dewey Decimal Classification (DDC)

attributes.name: call_number_type
attributes.description: The classification system used for the call number. Common types include Library of Congress (LC), Dewey Decimal, Superintendent of Documents (SuDoc), or local custom schemes.

attributes.name: copy_statement
attributes.description: A textual statement describing the copies held by the library. Used for serials and multi-volume sets to indicate which volumes, issues, or parts are held.

attributes.name: copyright_status
attributes.description: The copyright status of this holding. Indicates whether the work is protected by copyright, in the public domain, has unknown status, or is covered by a specific license agreement.
attributes.references: U.S. Copyright Law Title 17, Creative Commons

attributes.name: created_date
attributes.description: The timestamp when this holding record was first created in the library system. Used for audit trail and record lifecycle tracking.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: The three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the price amount. Examples include USD, EUR, GBP, CAD.

attributes.name: digitization_status
attributes.description: The status of digitization efforts for this holding. Tracks whether the item has been digitized, is scheduled for digitization, or is not applicable for digital conversion.

attributes.name: electronic_access_url
attributes.description: The URL providing electronic access to this holding. Applicable for electronic resources, digital collections, and online subscriptions.

attributes.name: enumeration_chronology
attributes.description: Structured data describing the enumeration (volume, issue, part numbers) and chronology (dates) of serial holdings. Critical for tracking journal and serial completeness.

attributes.name: fund_code
attributes.description: The code identifying the budget fund used to acquire this holding. Critical for financial tracking and collection development budget management.

attributes.name: holding_type
attributes.description: Classification of the holding based on its format and manifestation. Distinguishes between physical items, electronic resources, digital collections, microforms, serials, and monographs.

attributes.name: holdings_status
attributes.description: The current lifecycle status of this holding record. Indicates whether the holding is active and available, inactive, withdrawn from the collection, lost, missing, or in processing.

attributes.name: internal_note
attributes.description: A note visible only to library staff. May include information about processing status, preservation concerns, or administrative details.
attributes.references: MARC 21 Holdings Format - Field 852 subfield x

attributes.name: item_count
attributes.description: The total number of individual items (copies) associated with this holding record. For physical holdings, this represents the number of physical copies; for electronic holdings, this may represent the number of concurrent users or licenses.

attributes.name: last_inventory_date
attributes.description: The date when this holding was last physically inventoried or verified. Used for collection management and loss prevention.

attributes.name: last_modified_date
attributes.description: The timestamp when this holding record was last updated or modified. Used for audit trail and change tracking.

attributes.name: library_code
attributes.description: The code identifying the library branch or unit that owns or manages this holding. Used in multi-campus or multi-branch library systems.

attributes.name: library_name
attributes.description: The full name of the library branch or unit that owns or manages this holding.

attributes.name: license_code
attributes.description: The code identifying the license agreement governing access to this electronic holding. Links to detailed license terms, usage rights, and restrictions.

attributes.name: material_type
attributes.description: The physical or digital format of the holding. Examples include book, journal, DVD, e-book, streaming video, database, manuscript, map, or dataset.

attributes.name: mms_code
attributes.description: The unique identifier assigned by Alma/Ex Libris for this holding record in the Metadata Management System. Used for system-level tracking and integration.

attributes.name: oer_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this holding is designated as an Open Educational Resource. True if the resource is freely accessible and openly licensed for educational use; false otherwise.

attributes.name: permanent_location
attributes.description: The permanent home location for this holding. Distinct from temporary location, which may change due to circulation, reserves, or special exhibits.

attributes.name: preservation_priority
attributes.description: The priority level assigned for preservation and conservation activities. High priority items may require special handling, climate control, or digitization.

attributes.name: price_amount
attributes.description: The purchase price or subscription cost paid for this holding. Used for financial reporting and cost-per-use analysis.

attributes.name: proxy_enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether remote access to this electronic holding is enabled through the library's proxy server or authentication system. True if proxy access is enabled; false otherwise.

attributes.name: public_note
attributes.description: A note visible to library patrons in the public catalog. May include information about access restrictions, special handling, or usage instructions.
attributes.references: MARC 21 Holdings Format - Field 852 subfield z

attributes.name: receiving_status
attributes.description: The status of serial or continuing resource receipt. Indicates whether the library is actively receiving issues, has completed the subscription, or has ceased receiving.

attributes.name: retention_policy
attributes.description: The policy governing how long the library will retain this holding. May specify permanent retention, time-based retention, or conditions for weeding and deaccessioning.

attributes.name: shelving_location
attributes.description: The specific physical or virtual location where the holding is stored or accessed. Examples include stacks, reference, reserves, special collections, or electronic resource platform.

attributes.name: statistical_code
attributes.description: A code used for statistical reporting and analysis of library holdings. May be used to track collection development priorities, funding sources, or reporting categories.

attributes.name: suppressed_from_discovery
attributes.description: Indicates whether this holding is suppressed from public discovery interfaces. True if the holding should not appear in the library catalog or discovery services; false if it is publicly discoverable.

attributes.name: temporary_location
attributes.description: The current temporary location for this holding, if different from the permanent location. Used when items are on course reserves, special display, or temporary storage.

attributes.name: vendor_code
attributes.description: The code identifying the vendor or supplier from whom this holding was acquired. Used for acquisitions tracking and vendor performance analysis.

products.name: item
products.description: Individual physical copy or digital instance of a library holding. Tracks barcode, item policy, material type, process type, current location, due date, number of loans, last loan date, condition, and provenance notes. Sourced from Alma/Ex Libris item management. Represents the loanable unit for circulation transactions.

attributes.name: item_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the library item. Primary key representing the individual physical copy or digital instance of a library holding.

attributes.name: holding_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent holding record that groups items of the same bibliographic resource at a specific location.

attributes.name: acquisition_cost
attributes.description: Original purchase price or estimated value of the item at time of acquisition in local currency.

attributes.name: acquisition_date
attributes.description: Date when the item was acquired by the library through purchase, donation, or other means.

attributes.name: acquisition_method

attributes.name: amount_waived
attributes.description: Total amount waived or forgiven by library staff. Represents the portion of the fine that was administratively cancelled and is no longer owed.

attributes.name: assessment_date
attributes.description: Date on which the fine or fee was assessed and recorded in the library system. Represents the business event date when the charge was created.

attributes.name: balance_due

attributes.name: billing_export_date
attributes.description: Date on which the fine was exported to the student billing system. Null if not yet exported or if billing integration is not enabled.

attributes.name: billing_integration_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this fine has been exported to the student billing system (e.g., Banner Student Accounts) for inclusion in the student's account statement. True if exported, false otherwise.

attributes.name: collections_date
attributes.description: Date on which the fine was sent to collections or the bursar office. Null if the fine has not been escalated.

attributes.name: collections_status

attributes.name: created_timestamp

attributes.name: currency_code

attributes.name: daily_fine_rate

attributes.name: dispute_date

attributes.name: dispute_flag

attributes.name: dispute_resolution
attributes.description: Outcome of the patron's dispute or appeal. Indicates whether the dispute is pending review, approved (fine waived), denied (fine upheld), or withdrawn by the patron.
attributes.references: Alma/Ex Libris Fines and Fees Workflow

attributes.name: due_date
attributes.description: Date by which the fine or fee is expected to be paid. Used for aging analysis and collections escalation.
attributes.references: Alma/Ex Libris Fines and Fees Configuration

attributes.name: fine_number
attributes.description: Human-readable business identifier for the fine record. Used for patron communication and reference in billing statements.
attributes.references: Alma/Ex Libris Fines and Fees Module

attributes.name: fine_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the fine. Tracks whether the fine is open (unpaid), paid in full, waived, partially paid, sent to collections, or cancelled.
attributes.references: Alma/Ex Libris Fines and Fees Workflow

attributes.name: fine_type
attributes.description: Category of the fine or fee. Indicates whether the charge is for overdue materials, lost items, damaged items, replacement costs, processing fees, or other service charges.

attributes.name: last_modified_by
attributes.description: Identifier of the user (library staff or system process) who last modified this fine record. Used for audit trail and accountability.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent update to this fine record. Tracks changes to status, payments, waivers, or other attributes.

attributes.name: library_location
attributes.description: Physical library branch or location where the fine originated. Used for multi-branch reporting and budget allocation.

attributes.name: maximum_fine_amount
attributes.description: Cap or ceiling on the total fine amount for this fine type. Prevents overdue fines from exceeding the replacement cost of the item. Null if no cap is configured.
attributes.references: Alma/Ex Libris Fines and Fees Configuration

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes or comments added by library staff regarding the fine. May include patron communication history, dispute details, or special circumstances.
attributes.references: Alma/Ex Libris Fines and Fees Module

attributes.name: original_amount
attributes.description: Initial amount of the fine or fee assessed in the institution's base currency. Represents the gross charge before any payments, waivers, or adjustments.
attributes.references: Alma/Ex Libris Fines and Fees Module

attributes.name: overdue_days
attributes.description: Number of days the item was overdue at the time the fine was assessed. Applicable only for overdue fines; null for other fine types.

attributes.name: patron_group
attributes.description: Category or affiliation of the patron who incurred the fine (e.g., undergraduate, graduate, faculty, staff, community). Denormalized from the patron record for segmentation analysis.

attributes.name: payment_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent payment applied to this fine. Null if no payment has been received.

attributes.name: payment_method

Indicates whether the patron paid via cash, check, credit card, debit card, online portal, student account billing integration, or wire transfer. attributes.description: Date on which the fine waiver was approved and applied. Null if no waiver has been granted.
attributes.references: Alma/Ex Libris Fines and Fees Waiver Workflow

attributes.name: waiver_reason
attributes.description: Free-text explanation or code indicating why the fine was waived. Examples include patron appeal, system error, first-time offense, or administrative discretion.
attributes.references: Alma/Ex Libris Fines and Fees Waiver Policy

products.name: acquisition_order

Sourced from Alma/Ex Libris acquisitions module. Drives the library collection development workflow.

attributes.name: acquisition_order_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the library acquisition order record. Primary key for the acquisition order entity.

attributes.name: bib_record_id

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Acquisition orders are charged to departmental cost centers for budget accountability. Departmental spending reports, cost allocation, and budget manager oversight require this link. Standard practice

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the librarian or subject specialist responsible for selecting and approving this acquisition order as part of collection development.

attributes.name: ledger_account_id

attributes.name: library_fund_id
attributes.description: Reference to the library fund or budget allocation code used to finance this acquisition order.

attributes.name: library_vendor_id
attributes.description: Reference to the vendor or supplier from whom the library materials are being acquired.

attributes.name: patron_id
attributes.description: Reference to the faculty member, librarian, or staff member who requested the acquisition of this library material.

attributes.name: actual_receipt_date
attributes.description: Actual date when the ordered library materials were physically received and logged into the library system.

attributes.name: cancellation_reason
attributes.description: Explanation or reason code for why the acquisition order was cancelled, if applicable (e.g., out of print, budget constraints, duplicate order, vendor unable to supply).

attributes.name: collection_code
attributes.description: Library collection code indicating the specific collection to which the acquired material will be added (e.g., reference, circulating, special collections, reserves).

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the acquisition order record was first created in the library system.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code indicating the currency in which the acquisition order is denominated (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP).

attributes.name: discount_amount
attributes.description: Absolute monetary discount amount applied to the list price, calculated from the discount percentage or negotiated as a fixed reduction.

attributes.name: discount_percentage
attributes.description: Percentage discount applied to the list price by the vendor, typically negotiated through library consortia or volume agreements.

attributes.name: expected_receipt_date
attributes.description: Anticipated date when the ordered library materials are expected to be received from the vendor.

attributes.name: invoice_date
attributes.description: Date when the vendor issued the invoice for this acquisition order.

attributes.name: invoice_number
attributes.description: Vendor-issued invoice number associated with this acquisition order for payment processing and financial reconciliation.

attributes.name: invoice_status
attributes.description: Current status of the vendor invoice associated with this acquisition order: pending (awaiting review), approved (authorized for payment), paid (payment completed), disputed (discrepancy identified), or cancelled (invoice voided).

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the acquisition order record was most recently updated or modified in the library system.

attributes.name: list_price
attributes.description: Published or catalog price of the library material as listed by the vendor or publisher before any discounts or adjustments.

attributes.name: location_code
attributes.description: Library location or branch code where the acquired material will be housed and made available to patrons.

attributes.name: material_type
attributes.description: Classification of the library material being acquired: physical book, serial/periodical, electronic resource (e-book, database, e-journal), audiovisual material (DVD, CD), manuscript, or map.

attributes.name: net_price
attributes.description: Final price paid for the library material after applying all discounts and adjustments to the list price.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes or comments related to the acquisition order, including special instructions, vendor communications, or internal processing notes.

attributes.name: order_date
attributes.description: Date when the acquisition order was created and placed with the vendor.

attributes.name: order_number
attributes.description: Externally-known unique order number assigned to this acquisition order for tracking and reference purposes.

attributes.name: order_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the acquisition order: pending (awaiting approval), approved (authorized for purchase), sent (transmitted to vendor), received (materials delivered), cancelled (order voided), or closed (order completed and finalized).

attributes.name: order_type
attributes.description: Classification of the acquisition order type indicating the procurement method: firm order (one-time purchase), approval plan (vendor-selected materials), standing order (recurring series), subscription (periodical), gift (donated materials), or exchange (reciprocal agreement).

attributes.name: payment_date
attributes.description: Date when payment was issued to the vendor for this acquisition order.

attributes.name: quantity_ordered
attributes.description: Number of copies or units of the library material ordered from the vendor.

attributes.name: quantity_received
attributes.description: Number of copies or units of the library material actually received from the vendor, which may differ from quantity ordered due to partial shipments or vendor shortages.

attributes.name: receiving_status
attributes.description: Status indicating the receipt progress of the ordered materials: not received (no items delivered), partially received (some items delivered), fully received (all items delivered), or backordered (items delayed by vendor).

attributes.name: rush_order_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator of whether this acquisition order is marked as a rush or expedited order requiring priority processing and faster delivery.

attributes.name: shipping_cost
attributes.description: Cost of shipping and handling charged by the vendor for delivery of the library materials.

attributes.name: tax_amount
attributes.description: Sales tax or value-added tax (VAT) amount applied to the acquisition order based on institutional tax status and vendor location.

attributes.name: total_amount
attributes.description: Total cost of the acquisition order including net price, shipping cost, and tax amount. Represents the final amount charged to the library fund.

products.name: library_vendor
products.description: Library materials vendor and subscription agent master record. Stores vendor name, vendor code, vendor type (book jobber, subscription agent, publisher, database provider), contact information, EDI capability flag, preferred currency, payment terms, and account status. Sourced from Alma/Ex Libris vendor management. Scoped to library acquisitions — distinct from institutional procurement vendors in the finance domain.

attributes.name: library_vendor_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the library vendor record. Primary key.

attributes.name: account_number
attributes.description: The library's account number or customer identifier assigned by the vendor for order tracking and invoicing.

attributes.name: address_line1
attributes.description: First line of the vendor's business mailing address, typically street address or PO Box.

attributes.name: address_line2
attributes.description: Second line of the vendor's business mailing address, typically suite, floor, or building number.

attributes.name: approval_plan_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the library has an approval plan arrangement with this vendor, where materials matching a profile are automatically sent for review. True if approval plan is active; False otherwise.

attributes.name: city
attributes.description: City or municipality of the vendor's business address.

attributes.name: claiming_interval_days
attributes.description: Number of days after expected delivery date before the library initiates a claim for missing or delayed materials. Used for automated claiming workflows.

attributes.name: contract_end_date
attributes.description: Date when the library's current contract or agreement with the vendor expires. Null if no formal contract exists or if the agreement is open-ended.

attributes.name: contract_start_date
attributes.description: Date when the library's current contract or agreement with the vendor became effective. Null if no formal contract exists.

attributes.name: country_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code of the vendor's business address (e.g., USA, GBR, CAN).

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the vendor record was first created in the library system.

attributes.name: discount_percentage
attributes.description: Standard discount percentage offered by the vendor on list prices for library materials. Expressed as a percentage (e.g., 10.00 for 10% discount).

attributes.name: edi_capable_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the vendor supports Electronic Data Interchange (EDI) for automated order transmission, invoicing, and claiming. True if EDI is available; False otherwise.

attributes.name: edi_vendor_code
attributes.description: Unique identifier assigned to the vendor in the library's EDI system for electronic order and invoice exchange. Populated only if EDI is enabled.

attributes.name: firm_order_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the vendor is approved for firm (title-specific) orders. True if firm orders are allowed; False otherwise.

attributes.name: last_order_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent purchase order placed with this vendor. Used to identify inactive vendor relationships.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes about the vendor relationship, special instructions, service issues, or account-specific details for library staff reference.

attributes.name: payment_terms
attributes.description: Standard payment terms negotiated with the vendor, such as Net 30, Net 60, or prepayment required. Defines the payment due date relative to invoice date.

attributes.name: postal_code
attributes.description: Postal or ZIP code of the vendor's business address.

attributes.name: preferred_currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the vendor's preferred invoicing and payment currency (e.g., USD, GBP, EUR).

attributes.name: primary_contact_email
attributes.description: Email address of the primary vendor contact for order placement, invoicing inquiries, and account support.

attributes.name: primary_contact_name
attributes.description: Full name of the primary contact person at the vendor organization for library acquisitions and account management.

attributes.name: primary_contact_phone
attributes.description: Telephone number of the primary vendor contact for urgent order or delivery issues.

attributes.name: return_policy
attributes.description: Vendor's policy for returning damaged, incorrect, or unwanted materials, including time limits and restocking fees.

attributes.name: shipping_method
attributes.description: Default shipping method used by the vendor for delivering library materials (e.g., ground, expedited, freight, electronic delivery).

attributes.name: standing_order_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the vendor is approved for standing orders (automatic shipment of series or continuations). True if standing orders are allowed; False otherwise.

attributes.name: state_province
attributes.description: State, province, or region of the vendor's business address.

attributes.name: subscription_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the vendor is approved for journal or database subscriptions. True if subscriptions are allowed; False otherwise.

attributes.name: tax_id_number
attributes.description: Vendor's tax identification number (e.g., Employer Identification Number in the USA, VAT number in the EU) for tax reporting and compliance.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the vendor record was last modified in the library system.

attributes.name: vendor_code
attributes.description: Externally-known unique alphanumeric code assigned to the vendor in the library acquisitions system. Used for ordering, invoicing, and reporting. Sourced from Alma/Ex Libris vendor management.

attributes.name: vendor_name
attributes.description: Full legal or trading name of the library materials vendor, subscription agent, publisher, or database provider.

attributes.name: vendor_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the vendor relationship. Active vendors are approved for ordering; inactive vendors are no longer used; suspended vendors have temporary holds; pending approval vendors are under review.

attributes.name: vendor_type
attributes.description: Classification of the vendor by the type of library materials or services they provide. Book jobbers supply monographs, subscription agents manage journal subscriptions, publishers provide direct content, and database providers license electronic resources.

attributes.name: website_url
attributes.description: Public website URL of the vendor for catalog browsing, account access, and support resources.

attributes.name: library_fund_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the library fund record. Primary key for the library fund entity.

attributes.name: donor_id
attributes.description: Reference to the donor or benefactor if this fund originates from a philanthropic gift or endowment. Null for institutionally-funded library funds.

attributes.name: ledger_account_id

attributes.name: owner_employee_id

attributes.name: primary_library_employee_id

attributes.name: allocated_amount
attributes.description: The total budget amount allocated to this fund for the fiscal year. Represents the initial funding available before any commitments or expenditures.

attributes.name: approval_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether purchases from this fund require additional administrative approval beyond the fund owner. True if approval workflow is required; False if fund owner has full discretion.

attributes.name: approval_threshold_amount
attributes.description: The monetary threshold above which purchases from this fund require additional approval. Null if no threshold applies or if approval_required_flag is False.

attributes.name: available_balance
attributes.description: The remaining unencumbered and unexpended balance available for new commitments. Calculated as allocated_amount minus encumbered_amount minus expended_amount.

attributes.name: cost_center
attributes.description: The institutional cost center or budget unit code for financial tracking and reporting. Links library fund to broader university budget structure.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this fund record was first created in the library system. Audit trail for fund establishment.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for all monetary amounts in this fund (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP). Supports multi-currency library budgets.

attributes.name: encumbered_amount
attributes.description: The total amount committed to purchase orders and subscriptions but not yet expended. Represents funds reserved for pending acquisitions.

attributes.name: end_date

attributes.name: expended_amount

attributes.name: fiscal_year
attributes.description: The fiscal year to which this fund allocation applies, represented as a four-digit year (e.g., 2024). Aligns with institutional fiscal calendar.

attributes.name: fund_code
attributes.description: The externally-known unique alphanumeric code identifying this fund within the library budget structure. Used for acquisitions tracking and financial reporting.

attributes.name: fund_name
attributes.description: The human-readable descriptive name of the library fund (e.g., Science Monographs Fund, Humanities Serials Fund).

attributes.name: fund_source
attributes.description: The origin of the funding for this library fund. attributes.name: fund_type
attributes.description: Classification of the fund based on its financial status and usage restrictions. attributes.name: subject_area

attributes.name: created_by
attributes.description: The username or identifier of the library staff member who created this fund record. Audit trail for accountability.

attributes.name: collection_code

attributes.name: collection_name

attributes.name: collection_type

attributes.name: last_modified_by

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp

attributes.name: weeding_candidate_count

products.name: usage_stat
products.description: Electronic resource usage statistics record capturing COUNTER-compliant access and download metrics for licensed databases, e-journals, and e-books. Stores resource identifier, reporting period, platform, metric type (TR_B1, DR_D1, PR_P1 per COUNTER 5), total requests, unique title requests, unique item requests, and data source. Sourced from vendor SUSHI harvests via Alma/Ex Libris analytics. Drives cost-per-use analysis and renewal decisions.

attributes.name: usage_stat_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the electronic resource usage statistic record.

attributes.name: electronic_resource_id
attributes.description: Reference to the electronic resource (database, e-journal, e-book) being tracked. Links to the electronic resource catalog entry in Alma/Ex Libris.

attributes.name: platform_enterprise_application_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to technology.enterprise_application. Business justification: Usage statistics platforms (COUNTER/SUSHI endpoints) are enterprise applications requiring IT support for API integration, authentication, scheduled harvesting jobs, and data pipeline monitoring. Esse

attributes.name: platform_id
attributes.description: Reference to the vendor platform providing the electronic resource (e.g., EBSCO, ProQuest, JSTOR). Links to platform registry.

attributes.name: publisher_id
attributes.description: A standardized identifier for the publisher, such as ISNI (International Standard Name Identifier). Used for consistent publisher identification across platforms.

attributes.name: access_method
attributes.description: Indicates whether usage was through regular human access or Text and Data Mining (TDM) automated access. Per COUNTER 5 access method classification.

attributes.name: access_type
attributes.description: Indicates whether the resource access is controlled (subscription-based), open access gold (freely available at publication), open access with embargo (delayed free access), or other free-to-read model. Per COUNTER 5 access type classification.

attributes.name: cost_in_local_currency
attributes.description: The subscription or access cost for the resource during the reporting period, in the institution's local currency. Used for cost-per-use analysis and return on investment (ROI) calculations for renewal decisions.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this usage statistic record was first created in the system. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX. Used for data lineage and audit trails.

attributes.name: data_source
attributes.description: The method by which the usage statistics were obtained. SUSHI indicates automated harvest, Manual_Upload indicates file upload by staff, Vendor_Portal indicates download from vendor website, Email indicates vendor-sent reports.

attributes.name: data_type
attributes.description: The type of content being measured. Per COUNTER 5 data type classification. Used to segment usage analysis by content format. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: Book|Journal|Database|Multimedia|Repository_Item|Newspaper_or_Newsletter|Report|Conference|Thesis_or_Dissertation|Other — 10 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: doi
attributes.description: The DOI persistent identifier for the resource or item. Format: 10.xxxx/xxxxx. Used for item-level tracking and linking to publisher metadata.

attributes.name: isbn
attributes.description: The ISBN identifier for book resources. May be ISBN-10 or ISBN-13 format. Used for book-level usage tracking and cost-per-use analysis.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this usage statistic record was last updated. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX. Used for change tracking and data quality monitoring.

attributes.name: limit_exceeded_requests
attributes.description: The number of access denials due to usage limits (download caps, print limits) being exceeded during the reporting period. Per COUNTER 5 denial category.

attributes.name: local_currency_code
attributes.description: The ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the cost_in_local_currency field. Used for multi-currency cost tracking and reporting. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: USD|EUR|GBP|CAD|AUD|JPY|CNY|INR — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: metric_type
attributes.description: The COUNTER 5 metric type code indicating the type of usage being reported. TR=Title Report (books/journals), DR=Database Report, PR=Platform Report, IR=Item Report. Suffixes indicate specific metric variants (e.g., TR_B1 for book requests, DR_D1 for database searches). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: TR_B1|TR_B2|TR_B3|TR_J1|TR_J2|TR_J3|TR_J4|DR_D1|DR_D2|PR_P1|IR_A1|IR_M1 — 12 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: no_license_requests
attributes.description: The number of access denials due to simultaneous user license limits being exceeded during the reporting period. Indicates unmet demand and potential need for additional licenses.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for staff annotations regarding data quality issues, vendor reporting anomalies, platform changes, or other contextual information relevant to interpreting the usage statistics.

attributes.name: oer_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the resource is classified as an Open Educational Resource (freely accessible educational content). True if OER, False if not. Used for OER usage tracking and institutional OER adoption metrics.

attributes.name: online_issn
attributes.description: The ISSN identifier for the online version of a journal or serial. 8-digit format (XXXX-XXXX). Used for electronic journal usage tracking.

attributes.name: parent_data_type
attributes.description: The data type of the parent publication. Used in conjunction with parent_title for hierarchical reporting.

attributes.name: parent_title
attributes.description: The title of the parent publication (journal title for an article, book title for a chapter). Used for hierarchical usage reporting.

attributes.name: print_issn
attributes.description: The ISSN identifier for the print version of a journal or serial. 8-digit format (XXXX-XXXX). Used for journal-level usage tracking.

attributes.name: proprietary_identifier
attributes.description: The vendor-specific identifier for the resource or item. Used when standard identifiers (ISBN, ISSN, DOI) are not available. Format varies by platform.

attributes.name: publisher
attributes.description: The name of the publisher or content provider for the resource. Used for publisher-level usage aggregation and cost analysis.

attributes.name: reporting_period_end_date
attributes.description: The last day of the reporting period for which usage statistics are aggregated. Typically monthly (last day of month) per COUNTER 5 standard.

attributes.name: reporting_period_start_date
attributes.description: The first day of the reporting period for which usage statistics are aggregated. Typically monthly (first day of month) per COUNTER 5 standard.

attributes.name: searches_automated
attributes.description: The number of automated searches executed by discovery services, link resolvers, or other automated systems during the reporting period. Reported separately from regular searches per COUNTER 5.

attributes.name: searches_federated
attributes.description: The number of searches executed through federated search systems that query multiple resources simultaneously. Reported separately per COUNTER 5 to avoid double-counting.

attributes.name: searches_regular
attributes.description: The number of searches (queries) executed on the platform during the reporting period, excluding automated and federated searches. Applicable to database and platform reports (DR, PR). Per COUNTER 5 search definition.

attributes.name: section_type
attributes.description: The granular content type within a larger work (e.g., chapter within a book, article within a journal). Per COUNTER 5 section type attribute.

attributes.name: sushi_harvest_date
attributes.business_glossary_term: Standardized Usage Statistics Harvesting Initiative (SUSHI) Harvest Date
attributes.description: The date when the usage statistics were harvested from the vendor platform via SUSHI automated retrieval protocol. Used for data freshness tracking and audit trails.

attributes.name: total_item_investigations
attributes.description: The total number of user activities indicating interest in an item, including abstract views, table of contents views, and full-text requests. Broader measure than requests. Per COUNTER 5 investigation definition.

attributes.name: total_item_requests
attributes.description: The total number of successful full-text article requests, book section views, or multimedia file accesses during the reporting period. Excludes failed requests and robot/crawler activity per COUNTER filtering rules.

attributes.name: unique_item_investigations
attributes.description: The number of unique items investigated during the reporting period. Multiple investigations of the same item by the same user session are counted once. Per COUNTER 5 unique investigation definition.

attributes.name: unique_item_requests
attributes.description: The number of unique items (articles, chapters, multimedia files) requested during the reporting period. Multiple requests for the same item by the same user session are counted once. Per COUNTER 5 unique item definition.

attributes.name: unique_title_investigations
attributes.description: The number of unique titles for which at least one item was investigated during the reporting period. Used for title-level usage aggregation.

attributes.name: unique_title_requests
attributes.description: The number of unique titles (journals, books, databases) for which at least one item was requested during the reporting period. Used for title-level usage aggregation.

attributes.name: uri
attributes.description: The persistent URI or URL for the resource. Used for direct linking and resource identification when other identifiers are unavailable.

attributes.name: yop
attributes.description: The publication year of the content accessed, used to analyze usage patterns by content age. May be a 4-digit year, a range (e.g., 2010-2015), or 'Articles in Press' for pre-publication content. Per COUNTER 5 YOP attribute.

products.name: collection_policy_compliance
products.description: This association product represents the compliance relationship between library collections and institutional policies. It captures which policies apply to which collections and tracks the compliance status, application dates, and any approved exceptions. Each record links one collection to one policy with attributes that exist only in the context of this compliance relationship.. Existence Justification: In higher education library operations, a single collection must comply with multiple institutional policies (collection development policy, retention policy, donor agreement policy, access restriction policy, FERPA, ADA, etc.), and each institutional policy applies to multiple collections across the library system. The compliance relationship itself carries operational data including application dates, compliance status, review cycles, and approved exceptions that belong to neither the collection nor the policy alone.

products.name: resource_compliance_verification
products.description: This association product represents the compliance verification relationship between electronic resources and regulatory requirements. It captures the ongoing compliance assessment and verification activities for each resource-requirement pair. Each record links one electronic resource to one regulatory requirement with verification status, dates, methods, and responsible staff that exist only in the context of this compliance relationship.. Existence Justification: Electronic resources in higher education must comply with multiple regulatory requirements (ADA accessibility standards, copyright law, FERPA for usage data privacy, state authorization requirements, etc.), and each regulatory requirement applies to multiple electronic resources across the library collection. The compliance office actively manages verification records for each resource-requirement pair, tracking verification status, review cycles, responsible staff, and remediation activities as an operational business process.

attributes.name: non_compliance_reason

attributes.name: verification_notes

domains.name: advancement
domains.description: Administers the complete post-graduation relationship lifecycle including alumni identity, engagement history, career outcomes, fundraising campaigns, donor management, gift processing, pledge tracking, prospect research, endowment stewardship, volunteer activities, and alumni events. Manages major gifts, annual giving, planned giving, and alumni relations as an integrated function.

products.name: alumnus
products.description: Master record for every individual who has graduated from or attended the institution. Serves as the SSOT for alumni identity, capturing legal name, preferred name, graduation year, degree(s) earned, primary major/CIP code, student ID cross-reference, demographic data, FERPA consent flags, deceased indicator, and record source. This is the foundational entity for all alumni relations, advancement, and career services activities. Supports IPEDS graduation rate reporting and alumni participation rate calculations.
products.reference: Alumni Master Record (Blackbaud Raiser's Edge Constituent)

Regular is standard annual membership, lifetime is permanent membership, associate is non-graduate affiliate, emeritus is retired member, student is current student affiliate, and young alumni is recent graduate category.

attributes.name: nomination_date
attributes.description: The date on which the alumnus was nominated for membership or a leadership role within the affinity group. Used for governance and election tracking.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes or comments about this membership. May include special circumstances, historical context, or staff observations relevant to the membership relationship.

attributes.name: opt_in_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the alumnus has explicitly opted in to receive communications and participate in activities for this affinity group. True means opted in, false means opted out.

attributes.name: recognition_level
attributes.description: The recognition or tier level assigned to this membership based on engagement, giving, or service. Used for stewardship and recognition programs.

attributes.name: renewal_date
attributes.description: The date on which this membership is due for renewal. Used for annual or term-based memberships to track renewal cycles.

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: The name of the operational system from which this membership record originated. Typically Blackbaud Raisers Edge or similar advancement CRM system.

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: The unique identifier for this membership record in the source operational system. Used for data lineage and reconciliation.

attributes.name: start_date
attributes.description: The date on which this membership became effective. Represents when the alumnus officially joined the affinity group.

attributes.name: term_length_months
attributes.description: The length of the membership or leadership term in months. Used for term-based memberships and officer positions to calculate expiration and succession timing.

attributes.name: volunteer_hours
attributes.description: Total number of volunteer hours contributed by the alumnus in their capacity as a member of this affinity group. Used to track engagement and recognize service.

products.name: engagement_activity
products.description: Transactional record of every meaningful interaction between an alumnus and the institution. Captures activity type (event attendance, volunteer service, mentorship session, career fair participation, webinar, campus visit, phone call, email response, social media interaction), activity date, channel, associated program or campaign, staff member who recorded the interaction, engagement score contribution, and notes. This is the primary engagement history ledger for alumni relations and advancement qualification.
products.reference: Constituent Interaction / Action (Raiser's Edge NXT / Slate CRM)

attributes.name: engagement_activity_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for each engagement activity record. Primary key for the engagement activity entity.

attributes.name: alumnus_id
attributes.description: Reference to the alumnus who participated in this engagement activity. Links to the alumni master record.

attributes.name: campaign_id
attributes.description: Reference to the fundraising or engagement campaign associated with this activity. Nullable for activities not tied to a specific campaign.

attributes.name: enterprise_application_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to technology.enterprise_application. attributes.name: event_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific event record if this activity represents attendance at or participation in a scheduled event. Nullable for non-event activities.

attributes.name: fiscal_period_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.fiscal_period. Business justification: Engagement activities occur in specific fiscal periods for donor relations tracking and reporting. Creating engagement_activity.fiscal_period_id to link to finance.fiscal_period for period-based repor

attributes.name: primary_engagement_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the advancement or alumni relations staff member who recorded or facilitated this engagement activity. Tracks ownership and accountability for relationship management.

attributes.name: program_id
attributes.description: Reference to the alumni relations or advancement program under which this activity was conducted. Examples include annual giving programs, volunteer programs, or career services initiatives.

attributes.name: research_award_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to research.research_award. Business justification: Engagement activities center on research (lab tours, research presentations, symposia). Advancement tracks which research awards are featured in donor cultivation for major gift proposals and stewards

attributes.name: activity_date
attributes.description: The date on which the engagement activity occurred. Represents the primary business event timestamp for this interaction.

attributes.name: activity_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the engagement activity. Tracks whether the activity was completed as planned, cancelled, or is still pending.

attributes.name: activity_timestamp
attributes.description: Precise date and time when the engagement activity took place. Provides granular timing for activities requiring time-of-day tracking.

attributes.name: activity_type
attributes.description: Classification of the engagement activity. Defines the nature of the interaction between the alumnus and the institution. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: event_attendance|volunteer_service|mentorship_session|career_fair_participation|webinar|campus_visit|phone_call|email_response|social_media_interaction|donation_solicitation|survey_response|networking_event|reunion_attendance|board_meeting|committee_participation — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: attendee_count
attributes.description: Number of individuals who participated in the engagement activity. Applicable to group activities such as events, webinars, or meetings. Null for one-on-one interactions.
attributes.references: Blackbaud Raisers Edge - Event Attendance Count

attributes.name: channel
attributes.description: The communication or interaction channel through which the engagement activity was conducted. Distinguishes the medium of interaction from the activity type.

attributes.name: cost_amount
attributes.description: Direct cost incurred by the institution to conduct this engagement activity. Includes event costs, travel expenses, materials, or other direct expenditures. Used for ROI analysis and budget tracking.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this engagement activity record was first created in the system. Audit field for data governance and compliance.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the cost amount. Supports multi-currency tracking for institutions with international operations.

attributes.name: duration_minutes
attributes.description: Length of the engagement activity in minutes. Applicable to activities with measurable duration such as phone calls, meetings, mentorship sessions, or events.

attributes.name: engagement_score
attributes.description: Quantitative score assigned to this activity representing its contribution to the alumnus overall engagement level. Used for engagement scoring models and prospect qualification. Scale and methodology defined by institutional advancement strategy.

attributes.name: follow_up_date
attributes.description: Target date by which follow-up action should be completed. Nullable if no follow-up is required or scheduled.

attributes.name: follow_up_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether this engagement activity requires a follow-up action or contact. Used to drive task management and ensure relationship continuity.

attributes.name: is_major_gift_related
attributes.description: Indicates whether this engagement activity is part of a major gift cultivation, solicitation, or stewardship effort. Used to prioritize high-value donor relationship activities.
attributes.references: Blackbaud Raisers Edge - Major Gift Flag

attributes.name: is_volunteer_activity
attributes.description: Indicates whether this activity represents volunteer service by the alumnus on behalf of the institution. Used to track volunteer engagement separately from other interaction types.

attributes.name: location
attributes.description: Physical or virtual location where the engagement activity took place. May include campus building names, city names, or virtual platform identifiers.

attributes.name: modified_by
attributes.description: User identifier or system account that last modified this engagement activity record. Audit field for accountability and change management.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this engagement activity record was last updated. Audit field for change tracking and data quality monitoring.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Detailed free-text notes documenting the content, discussion points, outcomes, and any follow-up actions from the engagement activity. Critical for relationship continuity and institutional memory.

attributes.name: outcome
attributes.description: Result or outcome of the engagement activity. Captures whether the activity achieved its intended purpose and what next steps may be required.

attributes.name: priority_level
attributes.description: Priority classification assigned to this engagement activity based on strategic importance, donor capacity, or relationship stage. Guides staff time allocation and follow-up urgency.

attributes.name: response_code
attributes.description: Standardized code capturing the alumnus response or reaction to the engagement activity. Used for tracking sentiment and engagement quality across interactions.

attributes.name: source_record_reference
attributes.description: Unique identifier of this engagement activity record in the source operational system. Enables traceability and reconciliation with source systems.

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Name of the operational system from which this engagement activity record originated. Examples include Blackbaud Raisers Edge, Slate CRM, or manual entry systems.

attributes.name: subject
attributes.description: Brief subject line or title summarizing the purpose or topic of the engagement activity. Provides quick context for the interaction.

attributes.name: created_by
attributes.description: User identifier or system account that created this engagement activity record. Audit field for accountability and data quality tracking.

products.name: alumni_event
products.description: Master record for alumni-focused events organized or co-sponsored by the institution. Captures event name, type (homecoming, reunion, regional chapter event, career networking, commencement, donor recognition, athletic event), event date(s), location (venue name, city, state, country), virtual/hybrid flag, registration capacity, registration open/close dates, event cost, associated affinity group or college, and organizing staff. Distinct from the instruction domain's class schedule — this covers alumni relations programming.

attributes.name: alumni_event_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the alumni event record. Primary key.

attributes.name: affinity_group_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to advancement.affinity_group. Business justification: alumni_event has a STRING attribute 'affinity_group' that should be normalized to a FK relationship. An alumni event is typically organized by or for a specific affinity group/chapter. This creates pr

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Alumni events are often hosted by academic units/cost centers for budget and expense tracking. Creating alumni_event.cost_center_id to link to finance.cost_center for event cost allocation.

attributes.name: fiscal_period_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.fiscal_period. Business justification: Alumni events occur in specific fiscal periods for budget and expense tracking. Creating alumni_event.fiscal_period_id to link to finance.fiscal_period for period-based reporting.

attributes.name: actual_attendance
attributes.description: Final count of attendees who participated in the event. Populated after event completion for ROI (Return on Investment) analysis and reporting.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the event record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and event planning timeline analysis.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO currency code for all monetary amounts (e.g., USD, CAD, GBP). Supports international events with local pricing.

attributes.name: delivery_mode
attributes.description: Format of event delivery. In-person requires physical venue; virtual is online-only; hybrid offers both options simultaneously.

attributes.name: early_registration_deadline
attributes.description: Deadline for early-bird registration pricing. Used to incentivize advance commitments and improve planning accuracy.

attributes.name: early_registration_fee
attributes.description: Discounted registration cost for attendees who register before the early deadline, in US dollars.

attributes.name: event_code
attributes.description: Externally-known unique business identifier for the event, used in communications and registration systems.

attributes.name: event_description
attributes.description: Detailed narrative description of the event, including agenda highlights, speakers, activities, and value proposition. Used in marketing materials and registration pages.

attributes.name: event_end_date
attributes.description: The date the event concludes. For single-day events, this equals the start date. For multi-day events (e.g., reunion weekend), this is the final day.

attributes.name: event_end_time
attributes.description: Precise timestamp when the event programming concludes, including time zone information.

attributes.name: event_name
attributes.description: Full descriptive name of the alumni event as displayed in marketing materials and communications.

attributes.name: event_start_date
attributes.description: The date the event begins. For single-day events, this is the event date. For multi-day events, this is the first day.

attributes.name: event_start_time
attributes.description: Precise timestamp when the event programming begins, including time zone information for accurate scheduling across regions.

attributes.name: event_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the event. Controls visibility, registration availability, and reporting inclusion. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: draft|planning|registration_open|registration_closed|in_progress|completed|cancelled|postponed — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: event_type
attributes.description: Classification of the alumni event by its primary purpose and format. Determines programming, budget allocation, and success metrics. attributes.name: fundraising_goal_amount
attributes.description: Target dollar amount to be raised through the event, if applicable. Null for non-fundraising events.

attributes.name: guest_registration_fee
attributes.description: Cost for non-alumni guests (spouses, partners, friends) to attend the event, in US dollars.

attributes.name: is_fundraising_event
attributes.description: Indicates whether the event has a fundraising component or goal (e.g., gala, donor recognition dinner). True triggers gift tracking and campaign attribution.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent update to the event record. Tracks changes throughout the event lifecycle.

attributes.name: organizing_staff_email
attributes.description: Email address of the primary event organizer. Used for attendee inquiries and internal coordination.

attributes.name: organizing_staff_name
attributes.description: Name of the primary advancement staff member responsible for planning and executing the event.

attributes.name: organizing_staff_phone
attributes.description: Phone number of the primary event organizer for urgent inquiries and day-of-event coordination.

attributes.name: registration_capacity
attributes.description: Maximum number of attendees the event can accommodate, based on venue capacity or virtual platform limits. Null indicates unlimited capacity.

attributes.name: registration_close_date
attributes.description: Date when registration closes. After this date, no new registrations are accepted unless manually overridden.

attributes.name: registration_open_date
attributes.description: Date when registration becomes available to alumni. Controls visibility in event portals and communications.

attributes.name: requires_rsvp
attributes.description: Indicates whether attendees must formally register or RSVP to attend. True for capacity-limited or catered events; false for open-access events.

attributes.name: reunion_class_year
attributes.description: Graduation year for reunion events (e.g., 1995, 2010). Null for non-reunion events. Used to calculate milestone reunions (5th, 10th, 25th, 50th).

attributes.name: standard_registration_fee
attributes.description: Base cost for an individual to attend the event, in US dollars. Zero indicates a free event.
attributes.references: NACUBO (National Association of College and University Business Officers) Financial Standards

attributes.name: target_attendance
attributes.description: Planned or goal number of attendees for the event. Used for budgeting, venue selection, and success measurement.

attributes.name: venue_address_line1
attributes.description: Primary street address of the event venue. Business-confidential organizational contact data.

attributes.name: venue_address_line2
attributes.description: Secondary address information for the venue (suite, floor, building name). Business-confidential organizational contact data.

attributes.name: venue_city
attributes.description: City where the event venue is located. Used for regional event analysis and alumni engagement mapping.

attributes.name: venue_country_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO country code for the venue location (e.g., USA, CAN, GBR). Supports international alumni engagement.

attributes.name: venue_name
attributes.description: Name of the physical location or facility hosting the event (e.g., Alumni Center, Grand Ballroom, Stadium Club). Null for virtual-only events.

attributes.name: venue_postal_code
attributes.description: Postal or ZIP code for the venue. Business-confidential organizational contact data.

attributes.name: venue_state_province
attributes.description: Two-letter state or province code for the venue location (e.g., CA, NY, ON).

attributes.name: virtual_meeting_url
attributes.description: Web link for accessing the virtual event. Confidential to prevent unauthorized access. Null for in-person-only events.

attributes.name: virtual_platform
attributes.description: Name of the online platform used for virtual or hybrid events (e.g., Zoom, Microsoft Teams, Hopin). Null for in-person-only events.

products.name: alumni_event_registration
products.description: Transactional record capturing each alumnus's registration for an alumni event. Includes registration date, registration status (registered, waitlisted, cancelled, attended, no-show), ticket type, payment amount, payment status, dietary or accessibility requirements, guest count, check-in timestamp, and registration source (online portal, staff entry, mobile app). Enables attendance tracking, event ROI analysis, and engagement scoring.

attributes.name: alumni_event_registration_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the alumni event registration record. Primary key for this entity.

attributes.name: alumnus_id
