attributes.name: first_gift_date
attributes.description: Date of the donor's first recorded gift to the institution. Used to calculate donor tenure and loyalty metrics. [Moved from donor: This attribute represents the date of the first gift transaction, which is a derived value from the gift association. It should be calculated from gift.gift_date rather than stored redundantly on the donor record.]

attributes.name: gift_date
attributes.description: The date the gift was received or postmarked, representing the official transaction date for accounting and reporting purposes. This is the primary business event timestamp for the gift.
attributes.references: CASE VSE Reporting Standards, GASB/FASB Financial Reporting

attributes.name: gift_number
attributes.description: Business identifier for the gift transaction, typically a human-readable sequential or formatted number assigned by the advancement office for tracking and reference purposes.

attributes.name: gift_source
attributes.description: Classification of the donor type: individual, corporation, foundation, organization, or other entity. Used for CASE VSE reporting and donor segmentation.

attributes.name: gift_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the gift transaction indicating whether it has been received, is pending processing, or has been cancelled or adjusted.

attributes.name: gift_type
attributes.description: Classification of the gift based on its nature: outright gift, pledge payment, matching gift, gift-in-kind, securities transfer, or planned giving instrument.

attributes.name: in_kind_description
attributes.description: Detailed description of the donated property, goods, or services for in-kind gifts. Required for IRS substantiation and institutional asset management.
attributes.references: IRS Publication 561, CASE VSE Reporting Standards

attributes.name: ipeds_reportable_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Integrated Postsecondary Education Data System (IPEDS) Reportable Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this gift must be included in IPEDS Finance Survey reporting to the U.S. Department of Education.
attributes.references: IPEDS Finance Survey, U.S. Department of Education

attributes.name: largest_gift_amount
attributes.description: Dollar amount of the largest single gift received from this donor. Used for major gift benchmarking and upgrade solicitation strategies. [Moved from donor: This attribute represents the amount of the largest gift transaction, which is a derived value from the gift association. It should be calculated from gift.gift_amount rather than stored redundantly on the donor record.]

attributes.name: last_gift_date
attributes.description: Date of the donor's most recent gift. Used to identify lapsed donors and calculate recency metrics for predictive modeling. [Moved from donor: This attribute represents the date of the most recent gift transaction, which is a derived value from the gift association. It should be calculated from gift.gift_date rather than stored redundantly on the donor record.]

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this gift record was most recently updated. Used for audit trail, change tracking, and data synchronization.

attributes.name: lifetime_giving_total
attributes.description: Cumulative total of all gifts received from this donor since the first gift date. Includes cash, pledges paid, and gifts-in-kind at fair market value. Excludes pledge balances. [Moved from donor: This attribute represents the cumulative sum of all gift amounts, which is a derived aggregate from the gift association. It should be calculated from SUM(gift.gift_amount) rather than stored redundantly on the donor record.]

attributes.name: matching_gift_company_name
attributes.description: Name of the corporation or employer that may provide a matching gift for this donation. Used for matching gift claim processing.

attributes.name: matching_gift_eligible_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this gift is eligible for corporate matching gift programs. Used to trigger matching gift solicitation workflows.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes capturing additional context, special instructions, or donor communications related to the gift. Used for stewardship and internal coordination.

attributes.name: payment_method
attributes.description: The instrument or mechanism used to make the gift: cash, check, credit card, wire transfer, ACH, stock transfer, property donation, or other method. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: cash|check|credit_card|wire_transfer|ach|stock|property|other — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: payment_reference_number
attributes.description: External reference number from the payment processor, bank, or credit card transaction. Used for reconciliation and audit trail.

attributes.name: purpose
attributes.description: Free-text description of the donors intended use or purpose for the gift. Captures donor intent for restricted gifts and stewardship reporting.

attributes.name: receipt_number
attributes.description: Unique receipt number issued to the donor for tax purposes. Required for gifts above IRS thresholds and for donor record-keeping.

attributes.name: restriction_type
attributes.description: Classification of gift restrictions per FASB/GASB accounting standards: unrestricted, temporarily restricted, or permanently restricted (endowment).

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Name of the operational system from which this gift record originated (e.g., Blackbaud Raisers Edge, manual entry). Used for data lineage and reconciliation.

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: The unique identifier for this gift record in the source operational system. Used for data lineage, reconciliation, and bi-directional synchronization.

attributes.name: stock_shares
attributes.description: Number of shares transferred for securities gifts. Used in conjunction with stock price to calculate gift value.

attributes.name: stock_symbol
attributes.description: Ticker symbol for securities gifts. Used for tracking stock transfers and calculating fair market value at the time of transfer.

attributes.name: tax_deductible_amount
attributes.description: The portion of the gift amount that qualifies as tax-deductible under IRS regulations. May differ from gift amount for quid pro quo gifts or benefits received.
attributes.references: IRS Publication 526, U.S. Department of Education

products.name: pledge
products.description: Record of a donor's formal commitment to make a future gift, including multi-year pledge schedules with individual installment detail (due dates, scheduled amounts, payment status per installment), pledge balance, installment frequency, reminder dates, and fulfillment status. Tracks pledge origination date, total amount, amount paid to date, outstanding balance, write-off amounts, and installment-level aging. Supports pledge reminder workflows, automated installment tracking, and aging analysis. Sourced from Blackbaud Raisers Edge pledge module. Distinct from gift (completed transactions) and planned_gift (deferred/estate commitments).
products.reference: Blackbaud Raiser's Edge Pledge / CASE Pledge Record

attributes.name: pledge_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the pledge record. Primary key.

attributes.name: advancement_fund_id
attributes.description: Reference to the designated fund or endowment to which the pledge is directed.

attributes.name: appeal_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific fundraising appeal or solicitation effort that resulted in this pledge.

attributes.name: campaign_id
attributes.description: Reference to the fundraising campaign associated with this pledge.

attributes.name: donor_id
attributes.description: Reference to the alumnus or constituent who made the pledge commitment.

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the advancement staff member, volunteer, or alumnus who solicited this pledge.

attributes.name: fiscal_period_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.fiscal_period. Business justification: Pledges are recorded in specific fiscal periods for receivable tracking and financial reporting. Creating pledge.fiscal_period_id to link to finance.fiscal_period for period-based reporting.

attributes.name: receivable_ledger_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.ledger_account. Business justification: Pledges post to pledge receivable ledger accounts for GL accounting. Creating pledge.receivable_ledger_account_id to link to finance.ledger_account for receivable tracking and financial reporting.

attributes.name: research_award_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to research.research_award. Business justification: Pledges designated for research need linkage to specific awards for fulfillment tracking, stewardship, and financial planning. Advancement tracks pledge payments against research funding commitments f

attributes.name: acknowledgment_date
attributes.description: The date on which the pledge acknowledgment letter or receipt was sent to the donor.

attributes.name: acknowledgment_sent_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a formal acknowledgment letter or receipt has been sent to the donor for this pledge.

attributes.name: amount
attributes.description: The total committed amount of the pledge across all installments, representing the donor's full commitment.

attributes.name: amount_paid
attributes.description: The cumulative amount that has been paid against the pledge to date, calculated from completed installment payments.

attributes.name: anonymous_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the donor has requested that this pledge remain anonymous in public recognition and reporting.

attributes.name: balance_outstanding
attributes.description: The remaining unpaid balance on the pledge, calculated as pledge_amount minus amount_paid minus write_off_amount.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this pledge record was first created in the data platform.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the pledge amount (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP).

attributes.name: designation
attributes.description: The specific purpose, program, or project to which the pledge is designated, such as scholarship fund, building project, or unrestricted support.

attributes.name: final_installment_date
attributes.description: The due date for the final scheduled installment payment, representing the expected completion date of the pledge.

attributes.name: first_installment_date
attributes.description: The due date for the first scheduled installment payment.

attributes.name: installment_frequency
attributes.description: The recurring schedule on which pledge installments are due, such as monthly, quarterly, or annually.

attributes.name: installments_paid
attributes.description: The count of installments that have been successfully paid to date.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this pledge record was most recently updated in the data platform.

attributes.name: last_payment_amount
attributes.description: The amount of the most recent installment payment received.

attributes.name: last_payment_date
attributes.description: The date on which the most recent installment payment was received.

attributes.name: matching_gift_eligible_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this pledge is eligible for corporate matching gift programs.

attributes.name: next_installment_amount
attributes.description: The scheduled payment amount for the next upcoming installment.

attributes.name: next_installment_date
attributes.description: The due date for the next upcoming installment payment, used for reminder workflows and aging analysis.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes capturing additional context, special conditions, donor preferences, or stewardship considerations related to the pledge.

attributes.name: number_of_installments
attributes.description: The total number of scheduled installment payments for this pledge.

attributes.name: payment_method
attributes.description: The preferred or default payment instrument the donor will use to fulfill pledge installments, such as check, credit card, or electronic funds transfer (EFT). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: check|credit_card|eft|wire|stock|cash|payroll_deduction — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: pledge_date
attributes.description: The date on which the donor formally committed to the pledge. This is the principal business event timestamp for the pledge origination.

attributes.name: pledge_number
attributes.description: Business-facing unique identifier or reference number for the pledge, often used in donor communications and receipts.

attributes.name: pledge_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the pledge commitment indicating whether it is active, fulfilled, or terminated.
attributes.references: Blackbaud Raiser's Edge Pledge Status Codes

attributes.name: pledge_type
attributes.description: Classification of the pledge based on its structure and conditions, such as outright, multi-year installment, or conditional commitment.

attributes.name: reminder_date
attributes.description: The date on which a payment reminder should be sent to the donor for an upcoming installment.
attributes.references: Blackbaud Raiser's Edge Pledge Reminder Workflow

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: The name of the operational system from which this pledge record was sourced, typically Blackbaud Raiser's Edge.

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: The unique identifier for this pledge record in the source operational system.

attributes.name: tax_deductible_amount
attributes.description: The portion of the pledge that qualifies as a tax-deductible charitable contribution under IRS regulations.

attributes.name: write_off_amount
attributes.description: The portion of the pledge that has been written off as uncollectible, reducing the expected receivable.

attributes.name: write_off_date
attributes.description: The date on which the pledge or a portion thereof was written off as uncollectible.

attributes.name: write_off_reason
attributes.description: Explanation or justification for writing off the pledge amount, such as donor financial hardship, death, or inability to contact.

products.name: campaign
products.description: Master record for fundraising campaigns and donor recognition programs. For campaigns: captures campaign name, type (comprehensive, capital, annual, endowment, emergency), start/end dates, goal amount, amount raised, donor count, phase, sub-campaign hierarchy, and CASE reporting classification. For recognition societies/giving clubs: captures society name, minimum giving threshold, tier, member benefits, and active membership roster. SSOT for campaign definitions and recognition program structures used across gift, pledge, and appeal records.
products.reference: Blackbaud Raiser's Edge Campaign / CASE Campaign Record

attributes.name: campaign_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the fundraising campaign or donor recognition program. Primary key.

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Campaigns often align with academic cost centers for budget allocation and expense tracking. Creating campaign.cost_center_id to link to finance.cost_center for financial reporting and stewardship.

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Staff member responsible for coordinating and managing the campaign.

attributes.name: fiscal_period_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.fiscal_period. Business justification: Campaigns span fiscal periods and are reported by period for fundraising progress tracking. Creating campaign.fiscal_period_id to link to finance.fiscal_period for period-based reporting.

attributes.name: owning_org_unit_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to hr.org_unit. Business justification: Campaigns are institutional fundraising initiatives requiring org hierarchy linkage for budget ownership, gift allocation reporting, campaign performance dashboards by college/unit, and stewardship ac

attributes.name: parent_campaign_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent campaign if this is a sub-campaign within a larger comprehensive campaign hierarchy.

attributes.name: active_membership_count
attributes.description: Current number of active members in a recognition society. Null for fundraising campaigns.

attributes.name: amount_raised
attributes.description: Total amount raised to date, including gifts, pledges, and planned gifts counted toward the campaign goal.

attributes.name: budget_amount
attributes.description: Total budget allocated for campaign operations, marketing, events, and staffing.

attributes.name: campaign_description
attributes.description: Detailed narrative describing the campaign purpose, objectives, and intended impact.

attributes.name: campaign_name
attributes.description: Full name of the fundraising campaign or recognition society.

attributes.name: campaign_number
attributes.description: Externally-known business identifier for the campaign, used in communications and reporting.

attributes.name: campaign_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the campaign: planning (pre-launch), quiet_phase (leadership gifts), public_phase (broad solicitation), active (ongoing), completed (goal achieved), suspended (temporarily paused), or cancelled (terminated). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: planning|quiet_phase|public_phase|active|completed|suspended|cancelled — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: campaign_type
attributes.description: Classification of the campaign: comprehensive (institution-wide), capital (facilities/infrastructure), annual (yearly giving), endowment (permanent funds), emergency (crisis response), or recognition_society (donor club/giving circle).

attributes.name: case_reporting_classification
attributes.business_glossary_term: Council for Advancement and Support of Education (CASE) Reporting Classification
attributes.description: CASE standard classification code for reporting purposes (e.g., comprehensive campaign, capital campaign).

attributes.name: contact_email
attributes.description: Primary email address for campaign inquiries and donor communications.

attributes.name: contact_phone
attributes.description: Primary phone number for campaign office or coordinator.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this campaign record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for all monetary amounts in this campaign (e.g., USD, GBP, EUR).

attributes.name: donor_count
attributes.description: Total number of unique donors who have contributed to this campaign.

attributes.name: end_date
attributes.description: Planned or actual end date of the campaign. Null for ongoing recognition societies.

attributes.name: gift_counting_rules
attributes.description: Description of which gift types are counted toward campaign totals (e.g., outright gifts, pledges, planned gifts, matching gifts).

attributes.name: goal_amount
attributes.description: Target fundraising amount for the campaign in the specified currency.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this campaign record was last updated.

attributes.name: member_benefits_description
attributes.description: Description of benefits provided to members of a recognition society (e.g., event invitations, publications, naming opportunities).

attributes.name: minimum_giving_threshold
attributes.description: Minimum cumulative or annual giving amount required for membership in a recognition society. Null for fundraising campaigns.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Additional notes, comments, or internal documentation about the campaign.

attributes.name: phase
attributes.description: Current operational phase: planning (pre-launch), quiet (leadership solicitation), public (broad outreach), or completion (wrap-up and stewardship).

attributes.name: priority
attributes.description: Institutional priority level assigned to this campaign for resource allocation and strategic focus.

attributes.name: public_launch_date
attributes.description: Date when the campaign transitioned from quiet phase to public phase and broad solicitation began.

attributes.name: quiet_phase_goal_amount
attributes.description: Target amount to be raised during the quiet phase before public launch, typically from leadership donors.

attributes.name: recognition_tier
attributes.description: Tier or level within a recognition society hierarchy (e.g., Bronze, Silver, Gold, Platinum). Applicable to recognition societies.

attributes.name: start_date
attributes.description: Official start date when the campaign becomes active for gift counting and solicitation.

attributes.name: stewardship_plan
attributes.description: Description of donor stewardship activities and recognition plans for campaign contributors.

attributes.name: success_metrics
attributes.description: Key performance indicators and success criteria for evaluating campaign effectiveness beyond dollar goals.

attributes.name: visibility_status
attributes.description: Controls who can view campaign information: public (all), internal (institution only), or confidential (restricted access).

attributes.name: website_url
attributes.description: Public website URL for the campaign with information, updates, and online giving portal.

products.name: advancement_fund
products.description: Master record for a designated fund that receives and holds gift revenue for a specific institutional purpose. Captures fund name, code, type (endowed, expendable, restricted, unrestricted, quasi-endowment), purpose description, college/unit designation, minimum endowment threshold, fund status, NACUBO classification, and gift restriction terms (purpose restrictions, eligibility criteria, donor-imposed conditions, reporting requirements). SSOT for fund definitions and restriction compliance. Primary dimension for gift designation reporting. Linked to finance domain general ledger accounts.
products.reference: Blackbaud Raiser's Edge Fund / NACUBO Fund Classification

attributes.name: advancement_fund_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the advancement fund. Primary key for the fund master record.

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Advancement funds map to academic cost centers for stewardship reporting and budget alignment. Creating advancement_fund.cost_center_id to link to finance.cost_center for financial and operational rep

attributes.name: fiscal_period_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.fiscal_period. Business justification: Advancement funds are reported and valued by fiscal period for financial reporting. Creating advancement_fund.fiscal_period_id to link to finance.fiscal_period for period-based reporting.

attributes.name: ledger_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.ledger_account. Business justification: Advancement funds (endowments, scholarships, capital campaigns) map to general ledger accounts for financial tracking and reporting. This FK links advancement_fund to the finance ledger_account master

attributes.name: manager_employee_id
attributes.description: FK to hr.employee

attributes.name: owning_org_unit_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to hr.org_unit. Business justification: Advancement funds are budget entities requiring org hierarchy linkage for financial accountability, NACUBO/IPEDS reporting, stewardship reporting, and institutional budget roll-ups. Owning_college_sch

attributes.name: research_award_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to research.research_award. Business justification: Endowed funds distribute to specific research awards annually. Critical for fund accounting, stewardship reporting, and demonstrating research impact to donors. Links gift-funded endowments to the res

attributes.name: closure_date
attributes.description: Date the fund was permanently closed to new gifts and distributions ceased. Applicable for term endowments that have expired or funds that have been fully expended per donor intent.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this fund record was first created in the advancement system. Used for data lineage and audit trail.

attributes.name: current_market_value
attributes.description: Current total market value of the fund including principal, accumulated income, and investment gains/losses. Updated periodically based on investment pool valuation cycles.
attributes.references: NACUBO Endowment Study Standards, FASB ASC 958-205

attributes.name: donor_advised_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the fund allows donor advisory privileges for distribution recommendations. True if donor retains advisory rights per gift agreement; false for fully institutionally-controlled funds.

attributes.name: donor_recognition_level
attributes.description: Recognition tier or society membership associated with the fund based on gift size (e.g., Presidents Circle, Founders Society, Legacy Society). Used for donor engagement and event invitations.

attributes.name: establishment_date
attributes.description: Date the fund was officially established and began accepting gifts. Corresponds to board approval date or execution of gift agreement.

attributes.name: facilities_support_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the fund supports capital projects, building maintenance, or facility improvements. True for facilities funds; false otherwise.
attributes.references: NACUBO Financial Accounting and Reporting Manual (FARM)

attributes.name: faculty_support_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the fund supports faculty positions, research, or professional development (e.g., endowed chairs, professorships, research grants). True for faculty support funds; false otherwise.
attributes.references: NACUBO Financial Accounting and Reporting Manual (FARM)

attributes.name: first_distribution_date
attributes.description: Date of the first distribution from the fund to support its designated purpose. May differ from establishment date if fund needed to reach minimum threshold or had a waiting period.

attributes.name: fund_code
attributes.description: Externally-known unique alphanumeric code identifying the fund in financial systems and donor communications. Used for gift designation and general ledger mapping.
attributes.references: NACUBO Financial Accounting and Reporting Manual (FARM)

attributes.name: fund_name
attributes.description: Official name of the fund as established by donor agreement or institutional policy. Used in donor reports, gift receipts, and stewardship communications.

attributes.name: fund_status
attributes.description: Current operational status of the fund. Active funds accept gifts and make distributions; inactive funds are temporarily not accepting gifts; closed funds are permanently closed; suspended funds are under review; pending-establishment funds are awaiting final approval or minimum threshold.

attributes.name: fund_type
attributes.description: Classification of the fund based on spending restrictions and permanence. Endowed funds maintain principal in perpetuity; expendable funds can be fully spent; restricted funds have donor-imposed purpose restrictions; unrestricted funds have no donor restrictions; quasi-endowments are board-designated; term endowments revert after a specified period.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 958-205 (Not-for-Profit Financial Statements), GASB Statement 34

attributes.name: gift_agreement_document_url
attributes.business_glossary_term: Gift Agreement Document Uniform Resource Locator (URL)
attributes.description: URL or file path to the executed gift agreement or memorandum of understanding that established the fund and specifies donor restrictions and institutional obligations.
attributes.references: CASE Reporting Standards, Institutional Records Management Policy

attributes.name: gift_restriction_terms
attributes.description: Detailed text of donor-imposed restrictions on fund use, including purpose restrictions, eligibility criteria for beneficiaries, geographic limitations, time restrictions, and any other conditions specified in the gift agreement.

attributes.name: investment_pool_assignment
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the investment pool in which the fund assets are invested (e.g., Long-Term Investment Pool, Balanced Pool, Fixed Income Pool). Determines investment strategy and return profile.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this fund record was most recently updated. Used for change tracking and data quality monitoring.

attributes.name: last_valuation_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent market valuation used to update the current market value. Typically corresponds to fiscal quarter-end or year-end investment pool valuation.

attributes.name: market_value_currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the current market value (e.g., USD, GBP, EUR).

attributes.name: minimum_endowment_threshold
attributes.description: Minimum principal balance required to establish or maintain the fund as an endowment. Funds below this threshold may be held in a pooled fund until the minimum is reached.

attributes.name: nacubo_classification
attributes.business_glossary_term: National Association of College and University Business Officers (NACUBO) Classification
attributes.description: Standardized fund classification per NACUBO reporting taxonomy. Used for endowment surveys, peer benchmarking, and financial statement preparation.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional context, special handling instructions, historical background, or operational notes relevant to fund administration and stewardship.

attributes.name: original_gift_amount
attributes.description: Total amount of the original gift(s) that established the fund, representing the historical principal. Used for UPMIFA historic dollar value calculations and endowment preservation compliance.

attributes.name: program_support_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the fund supports academic programs, departmental operations, or institutional initiatives. True for program support funds; false otherwise.
attributes.references: NACUBO Financial Accounting and Reporting Manual (FARM)

attributes.name: purpose_description
attributes.description: Detailed narrative describing the intended use of fund distributions, including eligible expenditure categories, beneficiary populations, and programmatic objectives as specified in the gift agreement or board resolution.
attributes.references: CASE Reporting Standards, Uniform Prudent Management of Institutional Funds Act (UPMIFA)

attributes.name: reporting_frequency
attributes.description: Frequency of stewardship reports to be provided to donors or fund beneficiaries, as specified in the gift agreement or institutional policy.
attributes.references: CASE Reporting Standards, Donor Gift Agreement

attributes.name: scholarship_fund_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the fund is designated for student financial aid (scholarships, fellowships, or awards). True for scholarship funds; false for other purposes.
attributes.references: NACUBO Financial Accounting and Reporting Manual (FARM)

attributes.name: spending_calculation_method
attributes.description: Methodology used to calculate annual distributions. Total-return applies rate to smoothed market value; income-only distributes actual investment income; hybrid combines approaches; unit-value uses pooled fund units.
attributes.references: UPMIFA Section 4, NACUBO Endowment Study Standards

attributes.name: spending_policy_rate
attributes.description: Annual distribution rate applied to the fund balance to calculate available spending, typically expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.0450 for 4.5%). May be institution-wide policy or fund-specific per donor agreement.
attributes.references: UPMIFA Section 4, NACUBO Endowment Study Standards

attributes.name: stewardship_reporting_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the fund requires periodic stewardship reports to donors or their designees. True if donor agreement specifies reporting obligations; false otherwise.
attributes.references: CASE Reporting Standards, Donor Gift Agreement

attributes.name: threshold_currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the minimum endowment threshold amount (e.g., USD, GBP, EUR).

attributes.name: underwater_status_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the fund current market value has fallen below the historic dollar value (original gift amount), creating an underwater endowment. True if underwater; false if market value exceeds or equals historic value. Critical for UPMIFA compliance and spending decisions.

attributes.name: variance_reporting_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the fund requires institutional approval or board notification for expenditures that deviate from the stated purpose or exceed normal spending policy. True if variance reporting is required per gift agreement or policy; false otherwise.

products.name: appeal
products.description: Master record for a specific fundraising solicitation or outreach effort within a campaign, such as a direct mail piece, email solicitation, phonathon, or event ask. Captures appeal name, appeal code, appeal type (mail, email, phone, event, digital, personal ask), associated campaign, solicitation date range, target audience segment, cost of solicitation, response rate, and total revenue generated. Enables ROI analysis at the appeal level and supports CASE reporting on solicitation methods.

attributes.name: appeal_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the fundraising appeal or solicitation effort. Primary key.

attributes.name: advancement_fund_id
attributes.description: Reference to the primary fund or designation that gifts from this appeal are directed toward (e.g., scholarship fund, capital project, unrestricted annual fund).

attributes.name: affinity_group_id
attributes.description: Reference to the affinity group or alumni chapter associated with this appeal, if targeted to a specific group.

attributes.name: campaign_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent fundraising campaign under which this appeal is organized.

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the staff member, volunteer, or external vendor responsible for executing this appeal.

attributes.name: fiscal_period_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.fiscal_period. Business justification: Appeals run in specific fiscal periods for fundraising tracking and ROI analysis. Creating appeal.fiscal_period_id to link to finance.fiscal_period for period-based reporting.

attributes.name: org_unit_id
attributes.description: Reference to the academic college or school benefiting from or sponsoring this appeal.

attributes.name: appeal_code
attributes.description: Unique business identifier code for the appeal used in tracking and reporting. Typically alphanumeric code assigned by advancement office.

attributes.name: appeal_description
attributes.description: Detailed description of the appeal purpose, messaging strategy, and intended outcomes.

attributes.name: appeal_name
attributes.description: Descriptive name of the fundraising appeal or solicitation effort (e.g., Annual Fund Spring Mail, Homecoming Phonathon, President's Circle Dinner).

attributes.name: appeal_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the appeal indicating whether it is planned, active, completed, cancelled, or suspended.

attributes.name: appeal_type
attributes.description: Classification of the solicitation method used for this appeal (direct mail, email, phone, event, digital, personal ask, social media). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: direct_mail|email|phone|event|digital|personal_ask|social_media — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: ask_amount_high
attributes.description: Highest suggested gift amount presented to prospects in this appeal.

attributes.name: ask_amount_low
attributes.description: Lowest suggested gift amount presented to prospects in this appeal.

attributes.name: ask_currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the ask amounts (e.g., USD, GBP, CAD).

attributes.name: average_gift_amount
attributes.description: Average gift amount received per responding donor for this appeal, calculated as total_revenue_amount / response_count.

attributes.name: case_reportable_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Council for Advancement and Support of Education (CASE) Reportable Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this appeal and its results are included in CASE reporting and benchmarking surveys.

attributes.name: cost_currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the solicitation cost amount (e.g., USD, GBP, CAD).

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this appeal record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this appeal record was last updated in the system.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Additional notes, observations, or lessons learned from executing this appeal, used for future planning and continuous improvement.

attributes.name: owning_office
attributes.description: Name of the advancement office or unit responsible for managing this appeal (e.g., Annual Giving, Major Gifts, Alumni Relations, Development Office).

attributes.name: package_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the specific solicitation package or creative treatment used in this appeal (e.g., letter version, email template, script version).

attributes.name: response_count
attributes.description: Number of individuals or households who responded to this appeal with a gift or pledge.

attributes.name: response_rate_percentage
attributes.description: Percentage of targeted individuals who responded to the appeal, calculated as (response_count / target_count) * 100.

attributes.name: reunion_class_year
attributes.description: Graduation year of the alumni class targeted for reunion giving in this appeal, if applicable.

attributes.name: revenue_currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the total revenue amount (e.g., USD, GBP, CAD).

attributes.name: roi_percentage
attributes.description: Return on investment for this appeal expressed as a percentage, calculated as ((total_revenue_amount - solicitation_cost_amount) / solicitation_cost_amount) * 100.

attributes.name: solicitation_cost_amount
attributes.description: Total cost incurred to execute this appeal including printing, postage, event costs, staff time, and vendor fees.

attributes.name: solicitation_end_date
attributes.description: Date when the appeal solicitation effort ends or is scheduled to end.

attributes.name: solicitation_start_date
attributes.description: Date when the appeal solicitation effort begins or began. Represents the principal business event timestamp for this appeal.

attributes.name: target_audience_segment
attributes.description: Description of the donor or prospect segment targeted by this appeal (e.g., alumni class of 2010, LYBUNT donors, major gift prospects, parents of current students).

attributes.name: target_count
attributes.description: Number of individuals or households targeted for solicitation in this appeal.

attributes.name: total_revenue_amount
attributes.description: Total revenue generated from gifts and pledges attributed to this appeal.

products.name: major_gift_proposal
products.description: Tracks a formal major gift solicitation proposal from cultivation through ask to close, representing the primary workflow record for major gifts officers. Captures proposal title, ask amount, ask date, expected close date, actual close date, proposal stage (identification, qualification, cultivation, solicitation, stewardship, closed-won, closed-lost), assigned gift officer, primary prospect, fund designation, and proposal outcome. Supports pipeline management and major gifts forecasting. Sourced from Blackbaud Raiser's Edge proposal module.
products.reference: Blackbaud Raiser's Edge Proposal / Major Gifts Pipeline

attributes.name: major_gift_proposal_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the major gift proposal record. Primary key for the major gift proposal entity.

attributes.name: advancement_fund_id
attributes.description: Identifier linking to the institutional fund or campaign master record. Used for gift allocation and financial reporting integration.

attributes.name: campaign_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the fundraising campaign or initiative to which this major gift proposal is attributed. Links to campaign master data for performance tracking and goal measurement.

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Major gift proposals often support specific academic units/cost centers for budget planning. Creating major_gift_proposal.cost_center_id to link to finance.cost_center for proposal tracking and budget

attributes.name: fiscal_period_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.fiscal_period. Business justification: Major gift proposals are tracked by fiscal period for pipeline reporting and forecasting. Creating major_gift_proposal.fiscal_period_id to link to finance.fiscal_period for period-based reporting.

attributes.name: primary_major_employee_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the major gifts officer or fundraiser assigned to manage and steward this proposal through the solicitation lifecycle.

attributes.name: actual_close_date
attributes.description: Date when the prospect made a final commitment decision (accepted or declined). Null until the proposal reaches a closed-won or closed-lost stage.

attributes.name: ask_amount
attributes.description: The monetary amount being requested from the prospect in this major gift solicitation. Represents the target gift size for pipeline forecasting and capacity planning.

attributes.name: ask_date
attributes.description: Date when the formal solicitation ask was made to the prospect. Represents the key milestone when the proposal moved from cultivation to active solicitation.

attributes.name: board_approval_date
attributes.description: Date when the board of trustees or governing body formally approved acceptance of the major gift. Null if board approval is not required or has not yet occurred.

attributes.name: board_approval_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the major gift proposal requires formal approval from the board of trustees or institutional leadership before acceptance. Typically true for gifts above a certain threshold or with special conditions.

attributes.name: committed_amount
attributes.description: Actual amount committed by the prospect if the proposal was accepted. May differ from the original ask amount due to negotiation. Null if proposal was declined or is still open.

attributes.name: confidential_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the major gift proposal contains sensitive or confidential information requiring restricted access. Used for data security and privacy compliance in advancement operations.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp recording when the major gift proposal record was first created in the advancement database. Used for audit trail and data lineage tracking.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the ask amount (e.g., USD, GBP, EUR). Required for international fundraising and multi-currency gift tracking.

attributes.name: decline_reason
attributes.description: Explanation or category code for why the prospect declined the major gift proposal. Used for prospect intelligence and future cultivation strategy. Null if proposal was not declined.

attributes.name: expected_close_date
attributes.description: Anticipated date when the prospect is expected to make a commitment decision on the major gift proposal. Used for pipeline forecasting and fiscal year revenue projections.

attributes.name: fund_designation
attributes.description: Name or code of the institutional fund, endowment, or program to which the major gift will be directed (e.g., 'Engineering Scholarship Fund', 'Athletics Capital Campaign', 'Unrestricted Annual Fund').

attributes.name: gift_agreement_date
attributes.description: Date when the formal gift agreement was executed by all parties. Used for legal compliance and stewardship reporting. Null if no agreement is required or has not been executed.

attributes.name: gift_agreement_executed_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a formal gift agreement or memorandum of understanding has been signed by both the donor and the institution. Required for endowments and restricted gifts with specific terms.

attributes.name: gift_purpose
attributes.description: Primary purpose or use category for the proposed major gift (e.g., endowment, capital project, program operating support, scholarship, research funding, unrestricted support). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: endowment|capital|program-support|scholarship|research|unrestricted|faculty-support|student-support — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: last_contact_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent substantive contact or interaction with the prospect regarding this proposal. Used for tracking cultivation activity and ensuring timely follow-up.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp recording when the major gift proposal record was most recently updated. Used for audit trail, change tracking, and data synchronization.

attributes.name: naming_opportunity
attributes.description: Description of any building, room, endowment, or program naming rights associated with the major gift proposal. Null if no naming opportunity is part of the solicitation.

attributes.name: next_action_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date for the next planned action or follow-up activity related to the proposal. Used for gift officer task management and pipeline velocity tracking.

attributes.name: next_action_description
attributes.description: Description of the next planned action or step in the solicitation process (e.g., 'Schedule site visit', 'Send proposal document', 'Follow-up call with spouse').

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-form text field for gift officers to record additional context, strategy notes, prospect preferences, or other relevant information about the major gift proposal that does not fit structured fields.

attributes.name: probability_percentage
attributes.description: Estimated likelihood (0-100%) that the proposal will result in a closed-won outcome. Used for weighted pipeline forecasting and revenue projections. Typically increases as proposal advances through stages.

attributes.name: proposal_description
attributes.description: Detailed narrative describing the major gift proposal, including the case for support, impact statement, and specific use of funds. Used for proposal documentation and stewardship reporting.

attributes.name: proposal_document_url
attributes.description: Link or file path to the formal written proposal document, case statement, or presentation materials. Used for document management and proposal version control.

attributes.name: proposal_number
attributes.description: Business identifier for the major gift proposal, typically a human-readable code or number used by gift officers and advancement staff to reference the proposal in communications and reports.

attributes.name: proposal_outcome
attributes.description: Final disposition of the major gift proposal. Indicates whether the prospect accepted, declined, deferred the decision, or the proposal was withdrawn. Null until proposal reaches a terminal stage.

attributes.name: proposal_stage
attributes.description: Current stage of the major gift proposal in the fundraising pipeline. Tracks progression from initial identification through cultivation, ask, and closure. Used for pipeline management and forecasting. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: identification|qualification|cultivation|solicitation|negotiation|stewardship|closed-won|closed-lost — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: proposal_start_date
attributes.description: Date when the major gift proposal was formally created and entered into the advancement system. Marks the beginning of the proposals lifecycle for tracking and reporting.

attributes.name: proposal_status
attributes.description: Operational status of the proposal indicating whether it is actively being pursued, on hold, withdrawn, or completed. Complements proposal_stage with administrative state information. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: active|pending|on-hold|withdrawn|declined|accepted|completed — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: proposal_title
attributes.description: Descriptive title or name of the major gift proposal, summarizing the purpose or focus of the solicitation (e.g., 'Endowed Chair in Computer Science', 'New Engineering Building Campaign').

attributes.name: proposal_type
attributes.description: Classification of the major gift proposal by gift instrument or structure (e.g., outright cash gift, multi-year pledge, planned/deferred gift, foundation grant, corporate sponsorship, in-kind donation).

attributes.name: recognition_level
attributes.description: Donor recognition tier or giving society level associated with the proposed gift amount (e.g., 'Presidents Circle', 'Founders Society', 'Legacy Circle'). Used for stewardship planning and benefits fulfillment.

attributes.name: weighted_amount
attributes.description: Calculated value representing ask_amount multiplied by probability_percentage, used for realistic pipeline forecasting and expected revenue modeling.

products.name: planned_gift
products.description: Record of a deferred or estate gift commitment (bequest intention, charitable remainder trust, charitable gift annuity, life insurance assignment, retained life estate) made by a donor. Captures gift vehicle type, estimated value, estate percentage or fixed amount, maturity date, legal documentation status, revocability, and stewardship tier. Distinct from pledge (which is a binding near-term commitment) and from gift (which is a completed transaction). Supports planned giving program management and estate pipeline reporting.
products.reference: Blackbaud Raiser's Edge Planned Gift / CASE Planned Giving Record

attributes.name: planned_gift_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the planned gift record. Primary key.

attributes.name: advancement_fund_id
attributes.description: Reference to the institutional fund or endowment that will receive the planned gift proceeds upon maturity. Links to fund master record.
attributes.references: Advancement Services Fund Management; Financial Accounting Standards

attributes.name: campaign_id
attributes.description: Reference to the fundraising campaign under which this planned gift commitment was secured, if applicable. Used for campaign reporting and goal tracking.

attributes.name: donor_alumnus_id
attributes.description: Reference to the alumnus who has made the planned gift commitment. Links to the alumnus master record.

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the advancement staff member or planned giving officer who cultivated and secured this commitment. Used for performance tracking and relationship continuity.

attributes.name: fiscal_period_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.fiscal_period. Business justification: Planned gifts are tracked by fiscal period for pipeline reporting and estate planning. Creating planned_gift.fiscal_period_id to link to finance.fiscal_period for period-based reporting.

attributes.name: regulatory_filing_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.regulatory_filing. Business justification: Planned gifts (bequests, charitable remainder trusts, gift annuities) trigger IRS Form 8282, 990 Schedule D, and state insurance department filings for gift annuity reserves. Direct link required for

attributes.name: research_award_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to research.research_award. Business justification: Planned gifts often designated for research (bequests for endowed chairs, estate gifts for research programs). Advancement tracks intended beneficiary awards for stewardship, financial planning, and e

attributes.name: actual_maturity_date
attributes.description: Actual date when the planned gift matured and assets were transferred to the institution. Populated when commitment status reaches matured.
attributes.references: CASE Planned Giving Standards; Gift Processing Standards

attributes.name: anonymous_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the donor has requested complete anonymity for this planned gift commitment. Overrides all recognition and publication settings.
attributes.references: Donor Privacy Policy; CASE Donor Bill of Rights

attributes.name: commitment_date
attributes.description: Date when the donor formally communicated or documented their planned gift intention. Principal business event timestamp for this commitment.

attributes.name: commitment_number
attributes.description: Externally-known unique identifier or reference number for the planned gift commitment, used in donor communications and legal documentation.
attributes.references: Blackbaud Raisers Edge - Planned Giving Module

attributes.name: commitment_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the planned gift commitment. Tracks progression from initial intention through legal execution to maturity or revocation.
attributes.references: CASE Planned Giving Standards; Advancement Services Lifecycle Management

attributes.name: contingent_beneficiary_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the institution is named as a contingent (secondary) beneficiary rather than primary beneficiary. Affects probability of realization and pipeline valuation.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this planned gift record was first created in the data platform. Audit trail for data lineage.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the estimated value amount (e.g., USD, GBP, EUR).

attributes.name: designation_purpose
attributes.description: Intended use or purpose of the planned gift proceeds as specified by the donor (e.g., scholarship endowment, faculty chair, unrestricted support, capital project).
attributes.references: CASE Gift Acceptance and Counting Standards; Institutional Gift Policy

attributes.name: documentation_date
attributes.description: Date when legal documentation was executed or verified. Distinct from commitment date, which may precede formal documentation.

attributes.name: estate_percentage
attributes.description: Percentage of the donor's estate designated for the institution in bequest commitments. Null for fixed-amount or non-bequest vehicles.
attributes.references: CASE Planned Giving Standards; Estate Planning Documentation Standards

attributes.name: estimated_value_amount
attributes.description: Estimated present or future value of the planned gift at maturity, used for pipeline reporting and stewardship tier assignment. Subject to periodic revaluation.
attributes.references: CASE Planned Giving Valuation Guidelines; IRS Publication 561 - Determining the Value of Donated Property

attributes.name: expected_maturity_date
attributes.description: Anticipated date when the planned gift will be realized and transferred to the institution. May be estimated based on actuarial tables for life-contingent gifts.
attributes.references: CASE Planned Giving Pipeline Management Standards

attributes.name: fixed_amount
attributes.description: Specific dollar amount designated in the planned gift commitment. Used for fixed bequests and annuity contracts. Null for percentage-based commitments.

attributes.name: gift_vehicle_type
attributes.description: The legal instrument or vehicle through which the planned gift will be realized. Determines tax treatment, timing, and stewardship approach.
attributes.references: IRS Publication 526 - Charitable Contributions; Council for Advancement and Support of Education (CASE) Planned Giving Standards

attributes.name: last_contact_date
attributes.description: Date of most recent stewardship contact or engagement activity with the donor regarding this planned gift commitment.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this planned gift record was most recently updated in the data platform. Audit trail for change tracking.

attributes.name: legal_documentation_status
attributes.description: Level of legal formalization of the planned gift commitment. Tracks progression from verbal intention through executed legal instruments to institutional verification.
attributes.references: CASE Planned Giving Documentation Standards; Institutional Legal Compliance

attributes.name: next_contact_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date for next stewardship contact or follow-up activity. Used for relationship management and stewardship workflow.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes capturing additional context, special conditions, donor preferences, or stewardship considerations for this planned gift commitment.

attributes.name: primary_beneficiary_name
attributes.description: Name of the primary beneficiary organization as documented in the legal instrument. Typically the institution's legal name or a specific college/school within it.

attributes.name: prospect_rating
attributes.description: Prospect research rating indicating the donor's overall giving capacity and engagement level. Used for portfolio assignment and cultivation strategy.
attributes.references: Prospect Research Standards; Advancement Services Portfolio Management

attributes.name: recognition_name
attributes.description: Name(s) to be used for donor recognition purposes in planned giving society materials, honor rolls, and stewardship communications. May differ from legal name.

attributes.name: recognition_published_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the donor has consented to public recognition of their planned gift commitment in institutional publications and honor rolls.
attributes.references: Donor Privacy and Recognition Policy; CASE Standards

attributes.name: revaluation_date
attributes.description: Date when the estimated value was last reviewed and updated. Planned gifts should be periodically revalued based on market conditions and actuarial updates.
attributes.references: CASE Planned Giving Valuation Standards; Financial Reporting Standards

attributes.name: revocable_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the donor retains the legal right to revoke or modify the planned gift commitment. True for most bequests; false for irrevocable trusts and executed annuities.
attributes.references: CASE Planned Giving Standards; IRS Publication 526

attributes.name: revocation_date
attributes.description: Date when the donor formally revoked or withdrew the planned gift commitment. Populated when commitment status changes to revoked.

attributes.name: revocation_reason
attributes.description: Explanation or reason provided for revocation of the planned gift commitment. Used for relationship management and program improvement analysis.

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Name of the operational system from which this planned gift record originated (e.g., Blackbaud Raisers Edge, custom planned giving database).

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Unique identifier for this planned gift record in the source operational system. Used for data lineage and reconciliation.

attributes.name: stewardship_tier
attributes.description: Recognition and stewardship tier assigned based on estimated gift value, donor relationship, and institutional priorities. Determines engagement strategy and benefits.
attributes.references: Advancement Services Stewardship Framework; Donor Relations Standards

attributes.name: verification_method
attributes.description: Method by which the institution verified the existence and terms of the planned gift commitment.
attributes.references: CASE Planned Giving Verification Standards; Advancement Services Best Practices

products.name: prospect_rating
products.description: Stores wealth screening and prospect research ratings for donors and prospects, capturing estimated giving capacity, affinity score, inclination rating, wealth indicators (real estate holdings, stock ownership, business interests, compensation), research source, rating date, and assigned rating tier. Supports prospect research workflows and major gifts officer portfolio management. Sourced from third-party wealth screening vendors (e.g., DonorSearch, iWave) integrated into Blackbaud Raiser's Edge.
products.reference: Blackbaud Raiser's Edge Prospect Research / Wealth Screening

attributes.name: prospect_rating_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the prospect rating record. Primary key for the prospect rating entity.

attributes.name: alumnus_id
attributes.description: Reference to the alumnus or donor being rated. Links to the alumnus master record.

attributes.name: fiscal_period_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.fiscal_period. Business justification: Prospect ratings are done in specific fiscal periods for pipeline tracking and forecasting. Creating prospect_rating.fiscal_period_id to link to finance.fiscal_period for period-based reporting.

attributes.name: primary_prospect_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the advancement staff member (major gifts officer or prospect manager) assigned to manage this prospect based on the rating.

attributes.name: affinity_score
attributes.description: Numerical score (0-100) representing the prospect's emotional connection and engagement with the institution, based on attendance, volunteerism, event participation, and communication responsiveness.

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: Date when the rating was formally approved for use in major gifts officer portfolio assignment and solicitation strategy.

attributes.name: assigned_rating_tier
attributes.description: Portfolio management tier assigned for major gifts officer workload distribution: tier 1 (highest capacity/priority), tier 2, tier 3, tier 4, or unassigned.

attributes.name: board_memberships
attributes.description: Corporate and nonprofit board memberships held by the prospect, indicating leadership capacity and network connections.

attributes.name: business_interests_value
attributes.description: Estimated value of private business ownership, partnerships, and closely-held company interests based on business valuation data and public filings.

attributes.name: capacity_currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for all capacity amounts (e.g., USD, CAD, GBP).

attributes.name: capacity_rating
attributes.description: Overall giving capacity tier assigned to the prospect: major (100K-999K), principal (1M+), planned (estate gift potential), annual (under 100K), or unrated.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the prospect rating record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: data_quality_score
attributes.description: Numerical score (0-100) representing the completeness and reliability of the underlying data used to generate the rating, often provided by wealth screening vendors.

attributes.name: estimated_annual_income
attributes.description: Estimated annual income from all sources including salary, bonuses, investment income, and business income, derived from compensation disclosures and wealth screening data.

attributes.name: estimated_capacity_amount
attributes.description: Estimated total giving capacity in dollars based on wealth indicators, typically representing a lifetime giving potential or single major gift capacity.

attributes.name: estimated_capacity_range_high
attributes.description: Upper bound of the estimated giving capacity range in dollars.

attributes.name: estimated_capacity_range_low
attributes.description: Lower bound of the estimated giving capacity range in dollars.

attributes.name: estimated_net_worth
attributes.description: Total estimated net worth calculated as sum of all assets (real estate, stocks, business interests, other investments) minus estimated liabilities.

attributes.name: foundation_affiliations
attributes.description: Names of private foundations where the prospect serves as trustee, officer, or donor, sourced from IRS Form 990 filings.

attributes.name: inclination_rating
attributes.description: Qualitative assessment of the prospect's likelihood to give based on past giving behavior, philanthropic interests, and engagement patterns.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the prospect rating record was last updated, supporting audit trail and data lineage requirements.

attributes.name: last_reviewed_date
attributes.description: Date when the rating was last reviewed and validated by prospect research staff, ensuring currency and accuracy.

attributes.name: next_review_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date for the next rating review and refresh, typically 12-24 months from last review per CASE best practices.

attributes.name: philanthropic_interests
attributes.description: Known philanthropic interests and giving priorities of the prospect based on past giving history, foundation grants, board memberships, and public statements.

attributes.name: political_contributions_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the prospect has made political contributions disclosed in Federal Election Commission (FEC) records, signaling capacity and civic engagement.

attributes.name: portfolio_assignment_date
attributes.description: Date when the prospect was assigned to a major gifts officer portfolio based on this rating.

attributes.name: propensity_score
attributes.description: Predictive score (0-100) indicating likelihood of making a gift, often generated by statistical modeling or machine learning algorithms based on historical donor behavior.

attributes.name: rating_date
attributes.description: Date when the prospect rating was assigned or last updated. Principal business event timestamp for the rating lifecycle.

attributes.name: rating_effective_date
attributes.description: Date from which the rating becomes effective for prospect management and major gifts officer portfolio assignment.

attributes.name: rating_expiration_date
attributes.description: Date when the rating expires and should be refreshed. Typically 12-24 months from rating date per CASE best practices.

attributes.name: rating_notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes from prospect researchers providing context, qualitative insights, and recommendations for cultivation strategy based on the rating.

attributes.name: rating_number
attributes.description: Business identifier for the prospect rating record, typically assigned by the wealth screening vendor or prospect research office.

attributes.name: rating_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the prospect rating: active (current and valid), expired (outdated), under review (being reassessed), pending (awaiting approval), or archived (historical record).

attributes.name: rating_type
attributes.description: Classification of the rating methodology used: wealth screening from third-party vendor, manual prospect research, peer screening, electronic screening, or combined approach.

attributes.name: real_estate_holdings_value
attributes.description: Estimated total value of real estate holdings owned by the prospect, sourced from public property records and wealth screening vendors.

attributes.name: research_confidence_level
attributes.description: Confidence level in the accuracy and completeness of the wealth indicators and capacity estimate: high (multiple verified sources), medium (limited sources), low (estimated or inferred).

attributes.name: research_source
attributes.description: Name of the third-party wealth screening vendor or research source that provided the rating data (e.g., DonorSearch, iWave, WealthEngine, RelSci).

attributes.name: research_vendor_code
attributes.description: External identifier assigned by the wealth screening vendor to this rating record, used for data reconciliation and vendor support.

attributes.name: stock_ownership_value
attributes.description: Estimated value of publicly traded stock holdings, including insider holdings reported to SEC and beneficial ownership disclosed in proxy statements.

attributes.name: wealth_indicator_source
attributes.description: Primary source of wealth indicators used in the rating: public records, SEC filings, proxy statements, Forbes/Fortune lists, foundation 990s, or third-party wealth screening vendor.

Captures action type, channel (mail, email, phone, in-person), date, assigned staff, donor response, template used, signer, delivery status, and completion status. Supports stewardship plan fulfillment, acknowledgment compliance within IRS-required timeframes, and moves management contact reporting.

attributes.name: donor_response_date
