attributes.name: donor_response_notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes capturing the content or sentiment of the donor's response.

attributes.name: donor_response_received
attributes.description: Indicates whether the donor provided a response or acknowledgment to this stewardship action.

attributes.name: donor_response_type
attributes.description: Method by which the donor responded to the stewardship action.

attributes.name: fund_name
attributes.description: Name of the fund or endowment being stewarded.

attributes.name: impact_metrics_included
attributes.description: Indicates whether quantitative impact metrics or outcomes were included in this stewardship communication.

attributes.name: irs_acknowledgment_required
attributes.business_glossary_term: Internal Revenue Service (IRS) Acknowledgment Required Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this stewardship action fulfills IRS 501(c)(3) substantiation letter requirements for gifts of $250 or more.

attributes.name: irs_acknowledgment_sent_date
attributes.business_glossary_term: Internal Revenue Service (IRS) Acknowledgment Sent Date
attributes.description: Date when the IRS-compliant gift acknowledgment letter was sent to the donor.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this stewardship action record was most recently updated.

attributes.name: message_body
attributes.description: Full text content of the stewardship communication message.

attributes.name: moves_management_stage
attributes.description: Stage in the moves management cycle that this stewardship action supports (identification, cultivation, solicitation, stewardship).

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Additional free-text notes or comments about this stewardship action for internal reference.

attributes.name: recognition_level
attributes.description: Recognition tier or giving society level referenced in this stewardship action (e.g., President's Circle, Dean's Society).

attributes.name: scheduled_date
attributes.description: The originally planned date for this stewardship action, used for tracking timeliness and compliance with stewardship timelines.

attributes.name: scholarship_recipient_name
attributes.description: Name of the student receiving scholarship support from the donor's gift, used in scholarship introduction letters.

attributes.name: signer_name
attributes.description: Name of the individual whose signature appears on the stewardship communication (e.g., President, Dean, Development Officer).

attributes.name: signer_title
attributes.description: Official title of the individual signing the stewardship communication.

attributes.name: subject_line
attributes.description: Subject line or title of the stewardship communication, particularly for emails and letters.

attributes.name: template_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the template or format used for this stewardship communication.

attributes.name: template_name
attributes.description: Descriptive name of the template used for this stewardship communication.

products.name: endowment
products.description: Master record for an individual endowed fund tracking the endowment's market value, original gift principal, spending distribution amount, payout rate, investment pool allocation, fund purpose, named honoree, and annual endowment report status. Supports endowment stewardship reporting to donors and compliance with UPMIFA (Uniform Prudent Management of Institutional Funds Act) spending policy. Linked to the fund master record and to finance domain investment pool records.
products.reference: NACUBO Endowment Study / UPMIFA Endowment Record

attributes.name: endowment_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the endowed fund record. Primary key for the endowment entity.

attributes.name: advancement_fund_id
attributes.description: Reference to the master fund record in the finance domain. Links this endowment to the institutional fund accounting structure.

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the advancement or finance staff member responsible for managing this endowment's stewardship, reporting, and donor relations.
attributes.references: NACUBO Financial Accounting and Reporting Manual (FARM)

attributes.name: fiscal_period_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.fiscal_period. Business justification: Endowments are valued and reported by fiscal period for financial statements. Creating endowment.fiscal_period_id to link to finance.fiscal_period for period-based valuation and reporting.

attributes.name: gift_agreement_id
attributes.description: Reference to the legal gift agreement document that governs this endowment's terms, restrictions, and spending provisions.

attributes.name: investment_pool_id
attributes.description: Reference to the investment pool in which this endowment's assets are invested. Most endowments participate in a commingled investment pool for economies of scale.

attributes.name: primary_donor_id
attributes.description: Reference to the primary donor (alumnus or constituent) who established this endowment. Used for stewardship reporting and donor relations.

attributes.name: principal_ledger_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.ledger_account. Business justification: Endowments post to principal ledger accounts for GL accounting of endowment assets. Creating endowment.principal_ledger_account_id to link to finance.ledger_account for financial reporting.

attributes.name: accounting_segment
attributes.description: The chart of accounts segment or cost center code to which spending distributions from this endowment are posted in the general ledger.

attributes.name: annual_distribution_amount
attributes.description: The dollar amount authorized for spending distribution from this endowment for the current fiscal year. Calculated based on spending policy rate and market value.

attributes.name: benefiting_college
attributes.description: The academic college or school that receives spending distributions from this endowment. May be institution-wide for unrestricted endowments.
attributes.references: NACUBO Financial Accounting and Reporting Manual (FARM)

attributes.name: benefiting_department
attributes.description: The specific academic department or administrative unit that receives spending distributions from this endowment, if more granular than college level.
attributes.references: NACUBO Financial Accounting and Reporting Manual (FARM)

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this endowment record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage tracking.

attributes.name: current_principal_amount
attributes.description: The current corpus or principal balance of the endowment, including all subsequent gifts added to principal. Represents the donor-restricted amount that must be maintained in perpetuity for true endowments.

attributes.name: establishment_date
attributes.description: The date when the endowment fund was officially established and began accepting gifts. Marks the beginning of the fund's operational lifecycle.

attributes.name: fund_name
attributes.description: The official name of the endowed fund, typically reflecting the donor's naming preference or the fund's purpose.

attributes.name: fund_number
attributes.description: The externally-known fund accounting number assigned to this endowment in the institutional chart of accounts. Used for financial reporting and donor communication.
attributes.references: NACUBO Financial Accounting and Reporting Manual (FARM)

attributes.name: fund_purpose
attributes.description: Detailed description of the donor-specified purpose and restrictions for spending distributions from this endowment. Defines how funds may be used (e.g., scholarships, faculty support, program funding).

attributes.name: fund_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the endowment fund. Active: fund is operational and distributing. Inactive: temporarily not distributing. Closed: fund has been terminated. Suspended: distributions paused pending review. Pending establishment: fund committed but not yet operational.

attributes.name: fund_type
attributes.description: Classification of the endowment based on donor restrictions and institutional policy. True endowment: donor-restricted principal in perpetuity. Quasi-endowment: board-designated funds functioning as endowment. Term endowment: donor-restricted for a specified period.
attributes.references: UPMIFA (Uniform Prudent Management of Institutional Funds Act)

attributes.name: ipeds_reportable_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Integrated Postsecondary Education Data System (IPEDS) Reportable Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this endowment is included in the institution's annual IPEDS Finance Survey endowment reporting. True if reportable, False if excluded.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this endowment record was most recently updated. Used for audit trail and change tracking.

attributes.name: last_stewardship_report_date
attributes.description: The date when the most recent annual stewardship report was sent to the donor or their designee. Used to track stewardship compliance.

attributes.name: market_value
attributes.description: The current fair market value of the endowment fund, including principal, accumulated gains, and reinvested income. This is the total investable asset value used for spending distribution calculations.

attributes.name: market_value_date
attributes.description: The date as of which the market value was calculated. Typically the last business day of the fiscal quarter or year.

attributes.name: minimum_balance_required
attributes.description: The minimum endowment balance required by institutional policy before spending distributions can begin. Typically $25,000 to $50,000 for most institutions.

attributes.name: nacubo_reportable_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: National Association of College and University Business Officers (NACUBO) Reportable Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this endowment is included in the institution's annual NACUBO-Commonfund Study of Endowments participation. True if reportable, False if excluded.

attributes.name: named_honoree
attributes.description: The individual or entity honored or memorialized by this endowment, as specified by the donor. Used in fund naming and stewardship communications.

attributes.name: next_stewardship_report_due_date
attributes.description: The date by which the next annual stewardship report is due to be sent to the donor. Typically aligned with fiscal year-end reporting cycles.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-form text field for additional notes, special instructions, or historical context about this endowment that does not fit in structured fields.
attributes.references: NACUBO Financial Accounting and Reporting Manual (FARM)

attributes.name: original_gift_date
attributes.description: The date when the initial gift that established this endowment was received. May differ from establishment date if there was a delay in fund setup.

attributes.name: original_principal_amount
attributes.description: The initial gift amount that established the endowment. This is the historic dollar value of the original contribution and serves as the baseline for UPMIFA spending policy calculations.

attributes.name: purpose_category
attributes.description: High-level classification of the endowment's spending purpose for reporting and analysis. Aligns with NACUBO and IPEDS endowment reporting categories.

attributes.name: spending_policy_method
attributes.description: The methodology used to calculate annual spending distributions. Total return: percentage of smoothed market value. Income only: actual income earned. Hybrid: combination approach.

attributes.name: spending_policy_rate
attributes.description: The annual spending distribution rate applied to this endowment, expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.0450 for 4.5%). Determines the amount available for spending each year under the institution's UPMIFA-compliant spending policy.

attributes.name: stewardship_report_status
attributes.description: Status of the annual endowment stewardship report to the donor. Required: report must be sent. Completed: report has been delivered. Waived: donor declined reporting. Pending: report in preparation.

attributes.name: underwater_amount
attributes.description: The dollar amount by which the current market value is below the original principal, if the endowment is underwater. Null or zero if not underwater.

attributes.name: underwater_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the endowment's current market value has fallen below the original principal amount (underwater status). True if underwater, False if not. Affects spending policy decisions under UPMIFA.

attributes.name: unit_market_value
attributes.description: The current market value per unit in the investment pool. Used to calculate the endowment's total market value from units held.

attributes.name: units_held
attributes.description: The number of units this endowment holds in the investment pool. Market value equals units held multiplied by unit market value.

attributes.name: ytd_distribution_amount
attributes.description: The cumulative amount distributed from this endowment during the current fiscal year to date. Used to track spending against the annual authorization.

products.name: matching_gift_claim
products.description: Tracks corporate matching gift submissions and fulfillment for gifts where an employer matches an employee's donation. Captures the original donor gift reference, employer/corporation name, match ratio, claimed amount, submission date, employer verification status, payment received date, and matching gift program rules. Enables advancement staff to maximize matching gift revenue and track outstanding claims. Sourced from Blackbaud Raiser's Edge and third-party matching gift platforms (e.g., Double the Donation).
products.reference: Blackbaud Raiser's Edge Matching Gift / Corporate Matching Program

attributes.name: matching_gift_claim_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the matching gift claim record. Primary key.

attributes.name: advancement_fund_id
attributes.description: Reference to the institutional fund or designation to which the matching gift proceeds are allocated.

attributes.name: alumnus_id
attributes.description: Reference to the alumnus donor who made the original gift eligible for employer matching.

attributes.name: campaign_id
attributes.description: Reference to the fundraising campaign to which the matching gift is attributed for development reporting.

attributes.name: donor_gift_id
attributes.description: Reference to the original donor gift that qualifies for employer matching. Links to the gift transaction that triggered this matching gift claim.

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the advancement staff member responsible for processing and tracking this matching gift claim.

attributes.name: fiscal_period_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.fiscal_period. Business justification: Matching gift claims are recorded in specific fiscal periods for revenue recognition. Creating matching_gift_claim.fiscal_period_id to link to finance.fiscal_period for period-based reporting.

attributes.name: journal_entry_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.journal_entry. Business justification: Matching gift claims generate GL journal entries when payments are received. Creating matching_gift_claim.journal_entry_id to link to finance.journal_entry for revenue recognition and audit trail.

attributes.name: research_award_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to research.research_award. Business justification: Matching gifts may be designated for specific research awards. Advancement tracks designation for fund accounting, stewardship, and ensuring matching funds are applied correctly. Links corporate match

attributes.name: revenue_ledger_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.ledger_account. Business justification: Matching gift claims post to revenue ledger accounts for GL accounting. Creating matching_gift_claim.revenue_ledger_account_id to link to finance.ledger_account for revenue recognition.

attributes.name: acknowledgment_date
attributes.description: Date when the gift acknowledgment for the matching gift was sent to the donor.

attributes.name: acknowledgment_sent_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a gift acknowledgment letter or receipt was sent to the donor for the matching gift received.

attributes.name: appeal_date
attributes.description: Date when an appeal was submitted to the employer to reconsider a denied matching gift claim.

attributes.name: appeal_outcome
attributes.description: The result of the matching gift claim appeal process, if an appeal was submitted.

attributes.name: appeal_submitted_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether an appeal was submitted to the employer after an initial denial of the matching gift claim.

attributes.name: claim_number
attributes.description: Business identifier for the matching gift claim, often assigned by the matching gift platform or employer. Used for tracking and correspondence.
attributes.references: Blackbaud Raisers Edge Matching Gift Module

attributes.name: claim_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the matching gift claim in the processing workflow. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: pending|submitted|under_review|approved|paid|denied|cancelled|expired — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Blackbaud Raisers Edge Matching Gift Workflow

attributes.name: claimed_match_amount
attributes.description: The total matching gift amount claimed from the employer, calculated based on the original gift amount and match ratio.
attributes.references: Blackbaud Raisers Edge Matching Gift Calculation

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this matching gift claim record was first created in the advancement system.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the matching gift claim amounts (e.g., USD, GBP, EUR).

attributes.name: deadline_date
attributes.description: The deadline date by which the matching gift claim must be submitted to the employer to remain eligible, typically based on the original gift date.

attributes.name: denial_date
attributes.description: Date when the matching gift claim was officially denied by the employer or platform.

attributes.name: denial_reason
attributes.description: Explanation provided by the employer or platform for why the matching gift claim was denied, if applicable.

attributes.name: employer_name
attributes.description: Name of the corporation or employer organization that provides the matching gift program.

attributes.name: employer_organization_code
attributes.description: Reference to the employer organization entity in the advancement system that sponsors the matching gift program.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this matching gift claim record was most recently updated in the advancement system.

attributes.name: match_ratio
attributes.description: The ratio at which the employer matches the employee donation (e.g., 1.00 for dollar-for-dollar, 2.00 for two-to-one, 0.50 for half-match). Expressed as a multiplier.

attributes.name: matching_gift_program_name
attributes.description: Name of the specific matching gift program offered by the employer, as some employers may have multiple programs with different rules.

attributes.name: maximum_match_amount
attributes.description: The maximum total matching gift amount the employer will provide per employee per calendar or fiscal year.

attributes.name: minimum_gift_amount
attributes.description: The minimum donation amount required by the employer matching gift program for a gift to qualify for matching.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes and comments regarding the matching gift claim processing, communications with employer, or special circumstances.

attributes.name: original_gift_amount
attributes.description: The amount of the original donor gift that qualifies for employer matching, in the gift currency.

attributes.name: payment_method
attributes.description: The payment instrument or method used by the employer to remit the matching gift funds.

attributes.name: payment_received_date
attributes.description: Date when the institution received the matching gift payment from the employer.

attributes.name: payment_reference_number
attributes.description: External reference number or transaction identifier provided by the employer for the matching gift payment (e.g., check number, wire confirmation).

attributes.name: platform_claim_reference
attributes.description: External claim identifier assigned by the third-party matching gift platform for tracking and reconciliation.

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Name of the source system from which this matching gift claim record originated (e.g., Blackbaud Raisers Edge, Double the Donation API).

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: The unique identifier for this matching gift claim record in the source system, used for data lineage and reconciliation.

attributes.name: submission_date
attributes.description: Date when the matching gift claim was submitted to the employer or matching gift platform for processing.
attributes.references: Blackbaud Raisers Edge Matching Gift Tracking

attributes.name: submission_method
attributes.description: The method or channel through which the matching gift claim was submitted to the employer.

attributes.name: third_party_platform_name
attributes.description: Name of the third-party matching gift service or platform used to facilitate the claim (e.g., Double the Donation, HEP Development, Benevity).

attributes.name: verification_date
attributes.description: Date when the employer verified the employees donation and approved the matching gift claim.

attributes.name: verification_status
attributes.description: Status of employer verification of the employees donation and eligibility for matching gift program.

products.name: event
products.description: Master record for donor cultivation and stewardship events organized by the advancement office, including gala dinners, donor recognition ceremonies, named lecture series, groundbreakings, campaign kickoffs, and regional receptions. Captures event name, type, date, location, capacity, budget, actual cost, associated campaign, and event purpose (cultivation, stewardship, recognition, solicitation). Includes registration and attendance tracking at the individual level (registrant type, attendance status, meal preference, table assignment, registration fee). Distinct from academic or student events managed in other domains.

attributes.name: event_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the advancement event record. Primary key for the advancement event entity.

attributes.name: affinity_group_id
attributes.description: Reference to the alumni affinity group sponsoring or associated with this event. Examples: regional alumni chapter, academic college alumni society, athletic booster club. Null for institution-wide events.

attributes.name: building_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to facility.building. Business justification: Advancement events (galas, donor receptions, alumni gatherings) occur in campus buildings. This FK links advancement_event to the facility building master, enabling facility scheduling and space utili

attributes.name: campaign_id
attributes.description: Reference to the fundraising campaign associated with this event. Links the event to broader fundraising initiatives such as capital campaigns, annual giving drives, or endowment campaigns.

attributes.name: clery_incident_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.clery_incident. Business justification: Alumni events held on campus or in Clery geography (Greek houses, adjacent properties) where crimes occur must be Clery-reported per 34 CFR 668.46. Link required for incident location verification and

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Advancement events are often hosted by academic units/cost centers for budget and expense tracking. Creating advancement_event.cost_center_id to link to finance.cost_center for event cost allocation.

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the advancement staff member responsible for planning and executing this event. Primary point of contact for event logistics, vendor coordination, and post-event reporting.

attributes.name: fiscal_period_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.fiscal_period. Business justification: Advancement events occur in specific fiscal periods for budget and expense tracking. Creating advancement_event.fiscal_period_id to link to finance.fiscal_period for period-based reporting.

attributes.name: service_request_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to technology.service_request. Business justification: Advancement events requiring IT support (AV setup, live streaming, registration kiosks, WiFi provisioning) generate service requests that link to event context for resource planning, cost allocation,

attributes.name: actual_attendance
attributes.description: Confirmed number of individuals who attended the event. Captured through check-in systems or manual counts. Used for ROI analysis, per-attendee cost calculation, and future planning.

attributes.name: actual_cost
attributes.description: Total actual expenditure incurred for the advancement event after completion. Compared against budget to calculate variance and inform future event planning. Includes all invoiced and paid expenses.

attributes.name: budget_amount
attributes.description: Total approved budget allocated for the advancement event. Includes venue rental, catering, entertainment, marketing, staffing, and other direct costs. Used for financial planning and variance analysis.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this advancement event record was first created in the system. Audit field for data lineage and record lifecycle tracking.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO currency code for all monetary amounts associated with this event (registration fees, budget, costs). Typically USD for U.S. institutions but may vary for international events.

attributes.name: delivery_mode
attributes.description: Format through which the event is delivered to attendees. In-person events require physical venue, virtual events use online platforms, hybrid events combine both modalities.

attributes.name: early_registration_deadline
attributes.description: Date by which registrants must register to receive early registration pricing or benefits. Incentivizes early commitment and aids in planning.

attributes.name: early_registration_fee
attributes.description: Discounted ticket price for attendees who register before the early registration deadline. Incentivizes early commitment and improves planning accuracy.

attributes.name: end_time
attributes.description: Precise date and time when the advancement event concludes. Used for venue booking, catering planning, and staff scheduling.

attributes.name: event_date
attributes.description: Calendar date on which the advancement event takes place. Primary business event timestamp for scheduling, reporting, and fiscal year attribution.

attributes.name: event_description
attributes.description: Detailed narrative description of the advancement event including purpose, agenda, featured speakers, and expected outcomes. Used in invitations, marketing materials, and internal planning documents.

attributes.name: event_name
attributes.description: Official name of the advancement event as it appears in invitations, marketing materials, and donor communications. Examples: Annual Scholarship Gala, President's Circle Reception, Engineering Building Groundbreaking.

attributes.name: event_number
attributes.description: Externally-visible unique business identifier for the advancement event. Used in communications, invitations, and reporting. Format may follow institutional conventions (e.g., EVT-2024-001).

attributes.name: event_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the advancement event. Tracks progression from initial planning through execution and post-event follow-up. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: planning|registration_open|registration_closed|in_progress|completed|cancelled|postponed — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: event_type
attributes.description: Classification of the advancement event by format and purpose. Determines event planning requirements, budget allocation, and success metrics. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: gala|reception|groundbreaking|lecture_series|campaign_kickoff|donor_recognition|stewardship_dinner|reunion|cultivation_event|solicitation_event — 10 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: fundraising_goal_amount
attributes.description: Target dollar amount of gifts or pledges to be secured at or attributed to this event. Used for fundraising events with solicitation components. Null for non-fundraising events.

attributes.name: guest_registration_fee
attributes.description: Ticket price for guests accompanying registered alumni or donors. May differ from standard alumni pricing to reflect different engagement levels.

attributes.name: is_fundraising_event
attributes.description: Indicates whether this event includes direct fundraising solicitation or gift commitments. True for galas with pledge drives, campaign kickoffs, or solicitation dinners. Affects IRS reporting and gift attribution.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this advancement event record was most recently updated. Audit field for change tracking and data quality monitoring.

attributes.name: purpose
attributes.description: Primary strategic objective of the event within the donor engagement lifecycle. Cultivation events build relationships, stewardship events thank donors, recognition events honor contributions, and solicitation events request gifts.

attributes.name: registration_capacity
attributes.description: Maximum number of attendees that can register for the event. Determined by venue capacity, catering limits, or strategic attendance targets. Used to manage waitlists and close registration.

attributes.name: registration_close_date
attributes.description: Date when event registration closes. After this date, no new registrations are accepted. Used for final headcount, catering orders, and seating arrangements.

attributes.name: registration_open_date
attributes.description: Date when event registration becomes available to invitees. Marks the beginning of the registration period and triggers invitation communications.

attributes.name: requires_rsvp
attributes.description: Indicates whether attendees must formally register or RSVP to attend the event. True for capacity-limited or catered events requiring headcount. False for open-invitation events.

attributes.name: reunion_class_year
attributes.description: Graduation year of the alumni class being honored at a reunion event. Used for milestone reunion planning (5th, 10th, 25th, 50th anniversaries). Null for non-reunion events.

attributes.name: standard_registration_fee
attributes.description: Regular ticket price for event attendance after early registration period. May vary by attendee type (alumnus, guest, non-alumnus). Revenue supports event costs and may contribute to fundraising goals.

attributes.name: start_time
attributes.description: Precise date and time when the advancement event begins. Used for invitation details, venue coordination, and attendance tracking.

attributes.name: target_attendance
attributes.description: Planned or goal number of attendees for the event. Set during planning phase based on venue capacity, strategic objectives, and historical data. Used to measure event success.

attributes.name: venue_address_line1
attributes.description: First line of the venue street address including building number and street name. Used for invitations, directions, and logistics coordination.

attributes.name: venue_address_line2
attributes.description: Second line of the venue street address for suite, floor, room number, or building name. Optional field for additional location details.

attributes.name: venue_city
attributes.description: City or municipality where the event venue is located. Used for regional event analysis and travel planning for attendees.

attributes.name: venue_country_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO country code for the event venue location. Supports international event tracking and regional alumni engagement analysis.

attributes.name: venue_postal_code
attributes.description: Postal or ZIP code for the event venue location. Used for mapping, proximity analysis, and mailing logistics.

attributes.name: venue_state_province
attributes.description: State, province, or administrative region where the event venue is located. Supports geographic segmentation and regional engagement analysis.

attributes.name: virtual_meeting_url
attributes.description: Web address or link for accessing the virtual event platform. Distributed to registered attendees prior to the event. Confidential to prevent unauthorized access.

attributes.name: virtual_platform
attributes.description: Name of the technology platform used for virtual or hybrid event delivery. Examples: Zoom, Microsoft Teams, Webex, Hopin. Null for in-person only events.

products.name: recognition_society
products.description: Master record for a named donor recognition society or giving club (e.g., President's Circle, Dean's Society, Heritage Society for planned giving, annual giving leadership clubs), capturing society name, minimum giving threshold, giving level tier, associated fund or campaign, member benefits, and active member count. Supports tiered donor recognition programs and stewardship differentiation by giving level.
products.reference: Blackbaud Raiser's Edge Recognition Program / CASE Donor Recognition

attributes.name: recognition_society_id

attributes.name: associated_fund_advancement_fund_id

attributes.name: campaign_id

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the advancement staff member responsible for coordinating stewardship activities and member engagement for this recognition society.

attributes.name: fiscal_period_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.fiscal_period. Business justification: Recognition societies are reported by fiscal period for fundraising and membership tracking. Creating recognition_society.fiscal_period_id to link to finance.fiscal_period for period-based reporting.

attributes.name: owning_org_unit_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to hr.org_unit. Business justification: Recognition societies are donor stewardship programs requiring org hierarchy linkage for budget ownership, membership reporting by academic unit, event planning coordination, and institutional advance

attributes.name: active_member_count
attributes.description: Current number of active members who meet the giving threshold and are in good standing within the recognition society.

attributes.name: annual_recognition_event_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the recognition society hosts an annual signature event for members (True) or not (False).

attributes.name: contact_email
attributes.description: Primary email address for inquiries and communications regarding the recognition society.

attributes.name: contact_phone
attributes.description: Primary phone number for inquiries and communications regarding the recognition society.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp indicating when this recognition society record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: Date on which the recognition society ceased operations or was retired, if applicable. Null for active societies.

attributes.name: effective_start_date

products.name: corporate_sponsorship

Captures sponsor name, sponsorship type (event, program, facility, research, scholarship), sponsorship amount, benefit package, contract period, renewal date, assigned relationship manager, and fulfillment status. attributes.name: regulatory_filing_id

products.name: advancement_registration
products.description: This association product represents the Event between alumnus and alumni_event. It captures the operational business process of alumni registering for, paying for, and attending institutional events. Each record links one alumnus to one alumni_event with transactional attributes that exist only in the context of this specific registration instance.. Existence Justification: Alumni event registration is a well-established operational business process in higher education advancement. Alumni register for multiple events over their lifetime (homecoming, reunions, regional chapters, career networking), and each event hosts multiple alumni attendees. The institution actively manages registrations as discrete business transactions with payment processing, capacity management, dietary accommodations, check-in tracking, and cancellation workflows.

attributes.name: dietary_requirements

attributes.name: guest_count

attributes.name: payment_amount

attributes.name: ticket_type
attributes.description: Classification of the registration ticket (standard, early_bird, guest, vip, complimentary). Determines pricing and access level for the event.

products.name: advancement_assignment
products.description: This association product represents the Assignment between alumnus and volunteer_role. It captures the operational record of an alumnus serving in a specific volunteer capacity within institutional programs. Each record links one alumnus to one volunteer_role with attributes that track the lifecycle, performance, and engagement of that specific volunteer assignment. Supports volunteer management, recognition programs, and institutional advancement reporting.. Existence Justification: In higher education advancement operations, alumni regularly serve in multiple volunteer roles simultaneously or over time (e.g., an alumnus may serve as both a career mentor and a reunion committee member, or transition from phonathon caller to advisory board member). Conversely, each volunteer role (admissions ambassador, scholarship interviewer, etc.) is filled by multiple alumni across the institution. The business actively manages these assignments as operational records with lifecycle tracking, performance evaluation, and engagement measurement.

attributes.name: training_completed_flag

products.name: campaign_volunteer
products.description: This association product represents the volunteer participation relationship between faculty instructors and fundraising campaigns. It captures faculty volunteer assignments as solicitors, committee members, or ambassadors in advancement campaigns. Each record links one instructor to one campaign with attributes tracking their volunteer role, solicitation outcomes, participation period, and recognition level.. Existence Justification: In higher education advancement operations, faculty instructors serve as volunteers in multiple fundraising campaigns simultaneously (annual fund, capital campaign, college-specific drives), and each campaign recruits multiple faculty volunteers to serve as solicitors, committee members, and ambassadors. The advancement office actively manages these volunteer assignments, tracking each instructor's role, solicitation outcomes, dollars raised, participation period, and recognition level for each campaign they support.

attributes.name: recognition_level
attributes.description: Recognition tier awarded to the volunteer based on their contribution to the campaign (dollars raised, hours contributed, leadership demonstrated). Used for volunteer appreciation and stewardship.

attributes.name: volunteer_role
attributes.description: The specific role the instructor plays in the campaign (solicitor, committee member, ambassador, etc.). Determines responsibilities and expectations.

attributes.name: volunteer_status
attributes.description: Current status of the volunteer assignment: active (currently volunteering), inactive (paused), completed (assignment finished), declined (invitation declined).

products.name: advancement_application_access
products.description: This association product represents the access provisioning relationship between alumni and enterprise applications. It captures when alumni are granted access to institutional systems (giving portal, career services platform, email forwarding, library systems, event registration), what level of access they have, and their usage patterns. Each record links one alumnus to one enterprise application with attributes that exist only in the context of this access relationship. Supports IT cost allocation, license management, and alumni engagement analytics.. Existence Justification: Alumni access multiple enterprise applications throughout their relationship with the institution (giving portal, career services platform, email forwarding, library systems, event registration), and each application serves many alumni. IT teams actively provision and manage these access relationships, tracking access levels, usage patterns, and license assignments for cost allocation, security compliance, and engagement analytics. This is an operational M:N relationship that IT staff create, update, and revoke as part of user access management.

attributes.name: usage_frequency

domains.name: compliance
domains.description: Ensures institutional adherence to federal, state, and accreditation requirements. Manages Title IX investigations, Clery Act reporting, ADA accommodations, FERPA audits, NCAA eligibility, accreditation self-studies, regulatory filings, audit findings, corrective actions, and policy enforcement across the institution.
domains.references: Title IX, Clery Act, FERPA, NCAA, HLC, SACSCOC, ABET, AACSB

products.name: regulatory_requirement
products.description: Master catalog of all federal, state, and accreditation regulatory requirements applicable to the institution. Captures requirement source (e.g., Title IV, FERPA, Clery Act, ADA, Title IX, IPEDS, NCAA), regulatory body, effective dates, applicability scope (institution-wide, program-specific, department-specific), compliance obligation type, citation reference, and enforcement mechanism. Serves as the authoritative reference for all compliance obligations tracked across the institution.

attributes.name: regulatory_requirement_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the regulatory requirement record. Primary key for the regulatory requirement catalog.

attributes.name: active_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this regulatory requirement is currently active and enforceable. True for active requirements, false for superseded or expired requirements.

attributes.name: applicability_criteria
attributes.description: Specific conditions or criteria that determine when this requirement applies (e.g., applies to all Title IV participating institutions, applies to NCAA Division I athletics programs, applies to programs with clinical components, applies to institutions with on-campus housing).

attributes.name: applicability_scope
attributes.description: Defines the organizational scope to which this requirement applies: institution-wide (all units), program-specific (certain academic programs), department-specific (specific departments), college-specific (specific colleges/schools), campus-specific (specific campus locations), student-specific (certain student populations), employee-specific (certain employee groups). attributes.references: U.S. Code; Code of Federal Regulations; Accreditation Standards

attributes.name: compliance_status

products.name: standard_requirement_mapping
products.description: This association product represents the compliance mapping between accreditation standards and underlying regulatory requirements. It captures the explicit crosswalk maintained by institutions to demonstrate how accreditation standards satisfy federal and state regulatory obligations. Each record links one accreditation standard to one regulatory requirement with mapping metadata including effective dates, mapping type, coverage scope, and compliance status. This is a core compliance artifact used during self-studies, audits, and regulatory reporting.. Existence Justification: In higher education compliance operations, institutions actively maintain standard-requirement crosswalk matrices that map accreditation standards to underlying federal and state regulatory requirements. One accreditation standard frequently addresses multiple regulatory requirements (e.g., a faculty qualification standard may satisfy Title IV, state authorization, and professional accreditation requirements), and one regulatory requirement is typically addressed by multiple accreditation standards (e.g., FERPA requirements are addressed through standards on records management, student services, and IT security). These mappings are living documents maintained by compliance offices, updated during self-studies, and used for audit preparation and regulatory reporting.

products.name: policy_implementation
products.description: This association product represents the implementation relationship between institutional policies and regulatory requirements. It captures how each policy addresses specific regulatory obligations, including implementation dates, coverage scope, compliance levels, and gap analysis findings. Each record links one policy to one regulatory requirement with attributes that exist only in the context of this implementation relationship.. Existence Justification: In higher education compliance operations, institutional policies routinely implement multiple regulatory requirements (e.g., a Title IX policy addresses federal Title IX regulations, Clery Act reporting, and state anti-discrimination laws), and regulatory requirements are typically addressed by multiple policies (e.g., FERPA requirements are implemented through records management policies, student conduct policies, and IT security policies). Compliance officers actively manage policy-to-regulation mappings as operational records with implementation dates, coverage assessments, gap analysis findings, and review statuses - this is required for accreditation self-studies and federal program reviews.

attributes.name: coverage_scope
attributes.description: Extent to which this policy addresses the regulatory requirement: full (completely satisfies), partial (addresses some aspects), supplemental (provides additional guidance), indirect (supports compliance indirectly).

attributes.description: ISO 639-1 language code indicating the primary language of the certificate template (e.g., en, es, fr).

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this certificate template record was most recently modified.

attributes.name: layout_format
attributes.description: Page orientation format for the certificate template.

attributes.name: logo_image_url
attributes.description: URL or file path to the institutional logo image displayed on the certificate.

attributes.name: page_size
attributes.description: Standard page size specification for the certificate template.

attributes.name: paper_stock_specification
attributes.description: Technical specification of the paper stock used for physical certificates including weight, finish, and security features.

attributes.name: public_display_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether certificates issued from this template can be publicly displayed or shared by recipients.

attributes.name: renewal_eligible_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether certificates issued from this template are eligible for renewal after expiration.

attributes.name: seal_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether an official institutional seal or embossment is required on certificates generated from this template.

attributes.name: security_features
attributes.description: Description of security features embedded in the certificate template such as watermarks, holograms, QR codes, or blockchain verification.

attributes.name: signature_block_count
attributes.description: Number of signature blocks included in the certificate template for authorized signatories.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the certificate template indicating its availability for use.

attributes.name: template_code
attributes.description: Unique business identifier code for the certificate template used for external reference and system integration.

attributes.name: template_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name of the certificate template describing its purpose or program.

attributes.name: template_type
attributes.description: Classification of the certificate template by its primary purpose within the institution.

attributes.name: transcript_notation
attributes.description: Standard text notation that appears on the academic transcript when this certificate is awarded.

attributes.name: verification_url
attributes.description: URL where third parties can verify the authenticity of certificates issued from this template.

attributes.name: version_number
attributes.description: Semantic version number of the certificate template to track revisions and updates.

attributes.name: parent_certificate_template_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing FK on certificate_template (parent_certificate_template_id)

domains.name: hr
domains.description: Manages the full non-faculty employee lifecycle including recruiting, onboarding, compensation, benefits, payroll, performance management, and offboarding. Tracks position control, job classifications, salary administration, leave accruals, FTE workforce data, and CUPA-HR benchmarking. Supports Workday HCM operations and institutional workforce planning.

products.name: employee
products.description: Master record for all non-faculty staff employees at the institution. Captures full identity, demographic, employment classification, job title, department assignment, FTE status, FLSA classification, EEO category, hire date, termination date, and employment type (full-time, part-time, temporary, contract). Serves as the SSOT for non-faculty workforce identity sourced from Workday HCM. Excludes faculty, who are owned by the faculty domain.

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the non-faculty staff employee record in the Databricks Silver Layer. Primary key for the employee master data product sourced from Workday HCM.

attributes.name: supervisor_employee_id
attributes.description: The employee_id of the direct supervisor or manager for this employee. Supports org hierarchy traversal, performance management workflows, and approval routing in Workday HCM.

attributes.name: annual_salary
attributes.description: The employee's annualized base salary in USD. For part-time employees, this reflects the annualized equivalent of their scheduled hours. Used for budget planning, CUPA-HR benchmarking, and compensation equity analysis.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Compensation; CUPA-HR; NACUBO; IRS W-2

attributes.name: benefits_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether the employee is eligible to enroll in institutional benefit plans (health, dental, vision, retirement). Determined by employment type, FTE percentage, and ACA eligibility rules.
attributes.references: Affordable Care Act (ACA); ERISA; Workday HCM Benefits Eligibility

attributes.name: citizenship_status
attributes.description: The employee's citizenship or immigration status relevant to employment eligibility verification. Used for I-9 compliance, visa sponsorship tracking, and export control compliance.
attributes.references: Immigration Reform and Control Act (IRCA); I-9 Employment Eligibility Verification; U.S. Citizenship and Immigration Services

attributes.name: cost_center_code
attributes.description: The financial cost center code to which the employee's compensation is charged. Used for budget allocation, financial reporting, and Oracle PeopleSoft Financials integration.
attributes.references: Oracle PeopleSoft Financials; NACUBO Financial Reporting Standards

attributes.name: department_code
attributes.description: The institutional department or organizational unit code to which the employee is primarily assigned. Used for cost allocation, org hierarchy reporting, and IPEDS submissions.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Organization; Oracle PeopleSoft Financials Cost Center; IPEDS

attributes.name: disability_status
attributes.description: The employee's self-reported disability status per Section 503 of the Rehabilitation Act. Required for federal contractor affirmative action reporting and ADA accommodation tracking.
attributes.references: Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA); Section 503 Rehabilitation Act; OFCCP Regulations

attributes.name: eeo_category
attributes.description: The EEO-6 job category assigned to the employee for federal equal employment opportunity reporting. Categories include Executive/Administrative, Professional, Technical, Clerical, Skilled Crafts, and Service/Maintenance. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: executive_administrative|professional|technical_paraprofessional|clerical_secretarial|skilled_crafts|service_maintenance — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: EEO-6 Higher Education Staff Information Report; U.S. Equal Employment Opportunity Commission; IPEDS HR Survey

attributes.name: employment_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the employee's employment relationship with the institution. Drives access provisioning, payroll processing, and workforce reporting.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Employment Status; IPEDS HR Survey; CUPA-HR

attributes.name: employment_type
attributes.description: Classification of the employee's engagement basis with the institution. Determines benefit eligibility, FTE calculation, and IPEDS workforce reporting categories.
attributes.references: IPEDS HR Survey; CUPA-HR Benchmarking; Workday HCM Employment Type

attributes.name: flsa_classification
attributes.description: The employee's FLSA overtime exemption status. Exempt employees are salaried and not eligible for overtime pay; non-exempt employees are hourly and eligible for overtime. Drives payroll processing rules.
attributes.references: Fair Labor Standards Act (FLSA); U.S. Department of Labor; Workday HCM FLSA Status

attributes.name: fte_percent
attributes.description: The employee's FTE percentage expressed as a decimal (e.g., 1.0000 = full-time, 0.5000 = half-time). Used for IPEDS HR Survey reporting, benefit eligibility determination, and workforce planning analytics.
attributes.references: IPEDS HR Survey; CUPA-HR; Workday HCM FTE

attributes.name: gender
attributes.description: The employee's self-reported gender identity. Required for IPEDS HR Survey federal reporting and EEO-6 compliance. Collected and stored in accordance with FERPA and institutional privacy policies.
attributes.references: IPEDS HR Survey; EEO-6; U.S. Department of Education; FERPA

attributes.name: highest_degree_earned
attributes.description: The highest academic degree attained by the employee. Used for IPEDS HR Survey reporting, minimum qualification verification, and workforce education analytics.
attributes.references: IPEDS HR Survey; CUPA-HR; U.S. Department of Education

attributes.name: hire_date
attributes.description: The official date the employee began employment at the institution. Used for benefits eligibility determination, service anniversary calculations, and IPEDS reporting.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Hire Date; IPEDS HR Survey; ERISA

attributes.name: institution_employee_number
attributes.description: The institution-assigned employee badge or personnel number used across campus systems (ERP, badge access, payroll). Serves as the human-readable cross-system identifier for the employee.

attributes.name: institutional_email
attributes.description: The official institution-issued email address for the employee. Primary contact channel for HR communications, SSO authentication, and directory services.
attributes.references: FERPA; Workday HCM Contact Information; SAML/SSO Standards

attributes.name: job_profile_code
attributes.description: The Workday HCM job profile identifier that defines the standard set of responsibilities, qualifications, and compensation grade for this position type across the institution.

attributes.name: job_title
attributes.description: The official institutional job title for the employee's current position as defined in the position control system. Used in directories, org charts, and CUPA-HR salary benchmarking.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Job Profile; CUPA-HR Position Classification

attributes.name: legal_first_name
attributes.description: The employee's legal given (first) name as recorded on official government-issued identification. Used for payroll, tax reporting, and FERPA-compliant records.
attributes.references: FERPA; IRS W-2 Reporting; Workday HCM Legal Name

attributes.name: legal_last_name
attributes.description: The employee's legal surname (family name) as recorded on official government-issued identification. Used for payroll, tax reporting, and FERPA-compliant records.
attributes.references: FERPA; IRS W-2 Reporting; Workday HCM Legal Name

attributes.name: legal_middle_name
attributes.description: The employee's legal middle name or initial as recorded on official identification. Used for disambiguation and formal legal documents.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Legal Name; IRS W-2 Reporting

attributes.name: mobile_phone
attributes.description: The employee's personal mobile phone number. Used for emergency notifications, two-factor authentication, and urgent HR communications.

attributes.name: original_hire_date
attributes.description: The employee's first-ever hire date at the institution, preserved across rehires and position changes. Used for continuous service calculations, retirement vesting, and long-service recognition.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Continuous Service Date; ERISA Vesting Rules

attributes.name: pay_frequency
attributes.description: The frequency at which the employee is paid. Drives payroll processing schedules and period-to-date compensation calculations in Workday HCM Payroll.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Payroll; FLSA; IRS Payroll Regulations

attributes.name: pay_grade
attributes.description: The compensation grade or band assigned to the employee's position, defining the salary range minimum, midpoint, and maximum. Used for salary administration and CUPA-HR benchmarking.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Compensation Grade; CUPA-HR Salary Benchmarking; NACUBO

attributes.name: personal_email
attributes.description: The employee's personal (non-institutional) email address. Used for emergency contact, offboarding communications, and benefit enrollment notifications.

attributes.name: position_number
attributes.description: The unique position control number assigned to the budgeted position the employee occupies. Links to the position control system for headcount and budget management.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Position Management; NACUBO Position Control

attributes.name: preferred_name
attributes.description: The name the employee prefers to be addressed by in day-to-day institutional communications, directories, and LMS systems. May differ from legal name.

attributes.name: race_ethnicity_code
attributes.description: The employee's self-reported race and ethnicity classification per OMB standards. Required for IPEDS HR Survey and EEO-6 federal reporting. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: hispanic_latino|american_indian_alaska_native|asian|black_african_american|native_hawaiian_pacific_islander|white|two_or_more_races — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: IPEDS HR Survey; EEO-6; OMB Statistical Policy Directive 15; U.S. Department of Education

attributes.name: record_created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when the employee record was first created in the Workday HCM system of record. Used for data lineage, audit compliance, and onboarding workflow tracking.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Audit Trail; FERPA; Institutional Data Governance Policy

attributes.name: record_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp of the most recent modification to the employee record in the Workday HCM system of record. Used for incremental ETL processing, change detection, and audit compliance.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Audit Trail; FERPA; Institutional Data Governance Policy

attributes.name: rehire_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether the employee is eligible for rehire at the institution following separation. Set during offboarding review and used to screen future applications in Slate CRM and Workday Recruiting.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Rehire Eligibility; Institutional HR Policy

attributes.name: remote_work_type
attributes.description: The employee's approved work arrangement classification indicating whether they work on-site, in a hybrid arrangement, or fully remote. Used for space planning, tax nexus compliance, and workforce analytics.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Work Space; Institutional Remote Work Policy; State Tax Nexus Regulations

attributes.name: retirement_plan_code
attributes.description: The code identifying the retirement plan in which the employee participates (e.g., TIAA-CREF 403(b), state pension plan). Used for retirement contribution processing and ERISA compliance reporting.
attributes.references: ERISA; IRS 403(b) Regulations; Workday HCM Benefits; NACUBO

attributes.name: termination_date
attributes.description: The date the employee's employment with the institution ended. Null for active employees. Used for offboarding workflows, final pay processing, and workforce attrition analytics.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Termination; COBRA Notification Requirements; IPEDS HR Survey

attributes.name: termination_reason
attributes.description: The coded reason for the employee's separation from the institution (e.g., voluntary resignation, retirement, involuntary termination, end of contract). Used for turnover analysis and IPEDS reporting. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: voluntary_resignation|retirement|involuntary_termination|end_of_contract|death|transfer_out — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Workday HCM Termination Reason; IPEDS HR Survey; CUPA-HR

attributes.name: union_code
attributes.description: The code identifying the collective bargaining unit or union to which the employee belongs, if applicable. Drives contract-specific pay rules, leave accruals, and grievance tracking.
attributes.references: National Labor Relations Act (NLRA); Workday HCM Union Membership; Institutional Collective Bargaining Agreements

attributes.name: veteran_status
attributes.description: The employee's self-reported protected veteran status per VEVRAA requirements. Required for VETS-4212 federal contractor reporting and affirmative action planning.
attributes.references: Vietnam Era Veterans' Readjustment Assistance Act (VEVRAA); VETS-4212 Report; U.S. Department of Labor

attributes.name: visa_expiration_date
attributes.description: The expiration date of the employee's work authorization visa. Used to trigger renewal workflows and ensure continuous employment eligibility compliance.
attributes.references: U.S. Citizenship and Immigration Services; I-9 Compliance

attributes.name: visa_type
attributes.description: The type of work authorization visa held by the employee if applicable (e.g., H-1B, J-1, O-1, TN). Null for U.S. citizens and permanent residents. Used for visa expiration tracking and compliance.
attributes.references: U.S. Citizenship and Immigration Services; I-9 Compliance; Export Control Regulations

attributes.name: work_location_code
attributes.description: The code identifying the primary physical work location or campus building assigned to the employee. Links to the Archibus facilities management system for space planning and emergency management.
attributes.references: Archibus Facilities Management; Workday HCM Location

attributes.name: work_phone
attributes.description: The employee's primary institutional work telephone number including area code. Used for directory listings and HR communications.

attributes.name: workday_worker_reference
attributes.description: The native worker identifier assigned by Workday HCM. Used as the operational system-of-record key for cross-system integration and ETL reconciliation with Workday HCM.

attributes.name: worker_type
attributes.description: Workday HCM worker classification distinguishing regular employees from contingent workers, interns, and graduate assistants. Governs payroll processing rules and benefit eligibility.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Worker Type; FLSA; IRS Worker Classification

products.name: position
products.description: Authorized position control record representing a budgeted staff role within the institution. Tracks position number, title, department, FTE allocation, funding source, FLSA classification, pay grade, position type (regular, temporary, grant-funded), and open/filled/frozen status. Supports institutional workforce planning and IPEDS FTE reporting. Sourced from Workday HCM Position Management.

attributes.name: position_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the authorized position control record within the institution. Primary key for the position data product in the HR domain. Sourced from Workday HCM Position Management.

attributes.name: building_id
attributes.description: Reference to the primary physical work location (building, campus, or site) assigned to this position. Used in Archibus space planning, facilities management, and geographic workforce distribution reporting.
attributes.references: Archibus Facilities Management; Workday HCM Location Management

attributes.name: grant_account_id
attributes.description: Reference to the sponsored research grant or contract funding this position, applicable when position_type is grant_funded. Links to the Kuali Research award record for effort reporting and F&A cost allocation.
attributes.references: Kuali Research Awards; OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR Part 200; NIH Grants Policy Statement

attributes.name: job_family_id
attributes.description: Reference to the job family grouping that classifies this position within the institution's job architecture. Supports CUPA-HR benchmarking, compensation band alignment, and career pathway analysis.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Job Architecture; CUPA-HR Staff Salary Survey

attributes.name: job_profile_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to hr.job_profile. Business justification: Position control records must reference the institutional job classification catalog. Position has job_code (STRING) as a denormalized business key, but lacks the formal FK to job_profile. This FK est

attributes.name: position_org_unit_id
attributes.description: Reference to the organizational department or cost center to which this position is assigned. Used for workforce planning, budget allocation, and IPEDS FTE reporting by organizational unit.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Organizational Management; IPEDS Human Resources Survey

attributes.name: position_supervisory_org_org_unit_id
attributes.description: Reference to the Workday HCM supervisory organization to which this position belongs. Defines the management hierarchy, reporting structure, and span of control for workforce analytics.

attributes.name: reports_to_position_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing identifier of the position to which this position directly reports in the organizational hierarchy. Enables org chart construction and management chain analysis without requiring an active incumbent.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Position Management; NACUBO Organizational Standards

attributes.name: authorized_date
attributes.description: The date on which the position was formally authorized and approved by institutional leadership or the budget office. Marks the effective start of the position's existence in the position control system.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Position Management; NACUBO Workforce Standards

attributes.name: available_for_overlap
attributes.description: Indicates whether the position allows an overlap period where both an outgoing and incoming incumbent can be simultaneously active. Used in transition planning and headcount management within Workday HCM.

attributes.name: budgeted_annual_salary
attributes.description: The annual salary amount budgeted for this position in the institutional operating budget. Used in position control, budget encumbrance calculations, and financial planning. Expressed in USD. Distinct from the incumbent's actual salary.
attributes.references: Oracle PeopleSoft Financials Budgeting; NACUBO Budget Standards; Workday HCM Position Budgeting

attributes.name: chartfield_string
attributes.description: The Oracle PeopleSoft Financials chartfield string (combination of fund, department, program, project, and account codes) used to budget and encumber salary costs for this position. Enables financial reconciliation between HR and Finance systems.
attributes.references: Oracle PeopleSoft Financials; NACUBO Fund Accounting Standards

attributes.name: compensation_grade_profile
attributes.description: The specific compensation grade profile within Workday HCM that defines the salary range steps and progression rules applicable to this position. Supports structured merit and equity review processes.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Compensation Grade Profiles; CUPA-HR Staff Salary Survey

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when the position record was first created in Workday HCM Position Management. Provides audit trail for position control governance and data lineage in the Silver Layer lakehouse.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Audit Trail; FERPA; NACUBO Records Retention Standards

attributes.name: cupa_hr_benchmark_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: College and University Professional Association for Human Resources (CUPA-HR) Benchmark Code
attributes.description: The CUPA-HR survey benchmark code assigned to this position for participation in the annual CUPA-HR Staff Salary Survey. Enables peer institution salary comparisons and market pricing for compensation administration.
attributes.references: CUPA-HR Staff Salary Survey; CUPA-HR Administrative Compensation Survey

attributes.name: eeo_category
attributes.description: EEO-1 job category assigned to the position as required by the Equal Employment Opportunity Commission (EEOC) for federal reporting. Categories include Executive/Senior Level Officials, First/Mid-Level Officials, Professionals, Technicians, Sales Workers, Administrative Support, Craft Workers, Operatives, Laborers/Helpers, and Service Workers. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: exec_senior|first_mid_officials|professionals|technicians|sales|admin_support|craft|operatives|laborers|service — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: EEO-1 Component 1 Report; Equal Employment Opportunity Commission (EEOC); Title VII of the Civil Rights Act

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: The date from which the current position attributes (title, grade, FTE, department) are effective. Supports position history tracking and point-in-time workforce reporting in Workday HCM.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Position Management; IPEDS Human Resources Survey

attributes.name: employee_category
attributes.description: Broad institutional classification of the position's workforce category for IPEDS reporting and HR analytics. Distinguishes staff, administrators, executives, technical/paraprofessional, and service/maintenance roles. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: staff|administrator|executive|technical|service|professional — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: IPEDS Human Resources Survey; U.S. Department of Education

attributes.name: end_date
attributes.description: The date on which the position is scheduled to end or was eliminated. Applicable to temporary, grant-funded, and seasonal positions with defined terms. Null for permanent positions with no planned end.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Position Management; NACUBO Workforce Standards

attributes.name: flsa_classification
attributes.description: Designation of the position under the Fair Labor Standards Act (FLSA) indicating whether the role is exempt from overtime pay requirements (exempt) or entitled to overtime compensation (non_exempt). Critical for payroll compliance and labor law adherence.
attributes.references: Fair Labor Standards Act (FLSA) 29 U.S.C. § 201; U.S. Department of Labor

attributes.name: frozen_date
attributes.description: The date on which the position was placed in frozen status, suspending active recruitment. Used in budget freeze tracking and workforce planning analysis.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Position Management; NACUBO Workforce Standards

attributes.name: fte_allocation
attributes.description: The authorized Full-Time Equivalent (FTE) value for this position, expressed as a decimal fraction of a full-time workload (e.g., 1.0000 for full-time, 0.5000 for half-time). Used in IPEDS FTE workforce reporting and institutional workforce planning.
attributes.references: IPEDS Human Resources Survey; NACUBO FTE Reporting Standards

attributes.name: funding_source
attributes.description: The primary funding source supporting this position's salary and benefits costs. General fund positions are supported by institutional operating budget; grant positions are funded by sponsored research awards; auxiliary positions are funded by self-supporting units; restricted and designated funds have specific use constraints.
attributes.references: Oracle PeopleSoft Financials; NACUBO Fund Accounting Standards; GASB Statement No. 34

attributes.name: headcount_type
attributes.description: Indicates whether the position is designated as full-time or part-time based on the authorized FTE allocation and institutional policy thresholds. Used in IPEDS headcount reporting and workforce analytics.
attributes.references: IPEDS Human Resources Survey; U.S. Department of Education

attributes.name: ipeds_occupation_category
attributes.business_glossary_term: Integrated Postsecondary Education Data System (IPEDS) Occupation Category
attributes.description: The IPEDS occupation category code assigned to this position for federal human resources reporting to the U.S. Department of Education. Classifies positions into IPEDS-defined staff categories for annual HR survey submission.
attributes.references: IPEDS Human Resources Survey; U.S. Department of Education; National Center for Education Statistics (NCES)

attributes.name: is_benefits_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether the position is eligible for institutional employee benefits (health insurance, retirement, tuition remission, etc.) based on FTE allocation and position type. Drives benefits enrollment eligibility in Workday HCM Benefits.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Benefits; ACA Employer Shared Responsibility; IRS Section 125

attributes.name: is_critical_position
attributes.description: Indicates whether this position has been designated as critical to institutional operations or strategic mission. Critical positions receive priority in succession planning and budget protection during financial constraints.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Position Management; NACUBO Workforce Planning Standards

attributes.name: is_remote_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether the position is eligible for remote or hybrid work arrangements per institutional telework policy. Supports workforce planning, facilities space planning, and Archibus space utilization analysis.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Position Management; Archibus Space Planning

attributes.name: job_code
attributes.description: Standardized job code from the institution's job catalog in Workday HCM that classifies the position's duties and responsibilities. Used in CUPA-HR benchmarking, IPEDS reporting, and compensation equity analysis.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Job Catalog; CUPA-HR Staff Salary Survey; IPEDS Human Resources Survey

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when the position record was most recently updated in Workday HCM. Used for incremental ETL processing, change data capture, and audit compliance in the Databricks Silver Layer.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Audit Trail; NACUBO Records Retention Standards

attributes.name: max_incumbents
attributes.description: The maximum number of employees authorized to hold this position simultaneously. Typically 1 for standard positions; greater than 1 for pooled positions supporting multiple incumbents (e.g., graduate assistant pools).
attributes.references: Workday HCM Position Management; NACUBO Workforce Standards

attributes.name: pay_frequency
attributes.description: The frequency at which the incumbent of this position is paid (e.g., biweekly, semimonthly, monthly). Drives payroll processing cycles in Workday HCM Payroll.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Payroll; NACUBO Payroll Standards

attributes.name: pay_grade
attributes.description: Compensation pay grade or salary band assigned to the position within the institution's salary administration structure (e.g., Grade 7, Band E). Determines the minimum, midpoint, and maximum salary range applicable to the position.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Compensation; CUPA-HR Staff Salary Survey; NACUBO Compensation Guidelines

attributes.name: position_description
attributes.description: Narrative description of the position's primary duties, responsibilities, required qualifications, and scope of work. Used in recruitment postings, performance management, and accreditation documentation.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Position Management; EEOC Uniform Guidelines on Employee Selection Procedures

attributes.name: position_number
attributes.description: Externally-known, human-readable unique identifier assigned to the authorized position in Workday HCM (e.g., P-00012345). Used in workforce planning, IPEDS reporting, and budget reconciliation across institutional systems.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Position Management; IPEDS Human Resources Survey

attributes.name: position_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the authorized position.
