Open indicates the position is vacant and available for recruitment; filled indicates an active incumbent; frozen indicates the position is budgeted but hiring is suspended; eliminated indicates the position has been abolished; pending_approval indicates the position is awaiting authorization.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Position Management; NACUBO Workforce Standards

attributes.name: position_type
attributes.description: Categorical classification of the position's funding and employment nature. Regular positions are permanently budgeted; temporary positions are time-limited; grant-funded positions are supported by sponsored research awards; seasonal positions are cyclical; pooled positions support variable staffing needs.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Position Management; NACUBO Workforce Standards

attributes.name: requires_background_check
attributes.description: Indicates whether the position requires a pre-employment background check as a condition of hire per institutional policy or regulatory requirement (e.g., positions working with minors, financial fiduciary roles, law enforcement).
attributes.references: Workday HCM Recruiting; FERPA; Title IX; Clery Act

attributes.name: salary_maximum
attributes.description: The maximum annual salary defined for the position's pay grade or compensation band. Used in salary administration, offer approvals, and CUPA-HR benchmarking. Expressed in USD.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Compensation; CUPA-HR Staff Salary Survey; NACUBO Compensation Guidelines

attributes.name: salary_midpoint
attributes.description: The midpoint annual salary for the position's pay grade or compensation band, representing the market reference point. Used in compa-ratio analysis, equity reviews, and CUPA-HR benchmarking. Expressed in USD.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Compensation; CUPA-HR Staff Salary Survey; NACUBO Compensation Guidelines

attributes.name: salary_minimum
attributes.description: The minimum annual salary defined for the position's pay grade or compensation band. Used in salary administration, equity analysis, and CUPA-HR benchmarking. Expressed in USD.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Compensation; CUPA-HR Staff Salary Survey; NACUBO Compensation Guidelines

attributes.name: soc_code
attributes.description: The U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics Standard Occupational Classification (SOC) code assigned to this position. Used in IPEDS reporting, labor market analysis, and H-1B visa sponsorship documentation for international hires.
attributes.references: U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics SOC System; IPEDS Human Resources Survey; U.S. Department of Labor

attributes.name: standard_hours_per_week
attributes.description: The standard number of scheduled work hours per week for this position as defined in Workday HCM. Used to calculate FTE allocation, benefits eligibility thresholds under the ACA, and overtime liability under FLSA.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Position Management; ACA Employer Shared Responsibility 26 U.S.C. § 4980H; FLSA 29 U.S.C. § 207

attributes.name: title
attributes.description: Official working title of the position as defined in Workday HCM and used in institutional communications, org charts, and CUPA-HR benchmarking submissions.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Position Management; CUPA-HR Staff Salary Survey

attributes.name: union_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the collective bargaining unit or union affiliation applicable to this position, if any. Determines applicable labor contract terms, grievance procedures, and wage scales. Null for non-unionized positions.
attributes.references: National Labor Relations Act (NLRA); Workday HCM Labor Relations

products.name: job_profile
products.description: Institutional catalog of standardized job classifications defining role families, job codes, FLSA exemption status, EEO-1 category, pay grade range, minimum qualifications, and CIP-aligned functional area. Used for compensation benchmarking against CUPA-HR survey data and for position control alignment. Sourced from Workday HCM Job Profile.
products.reference: CUPA-HR Job Classification / Workday Job Profile

attributes.name: job_profile_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the job profile record in the institutional catalog. Primary key for the hr.job_profile data product.

attributes.name: job_family_id
attributes.description: FK to hr.job_family

attributes.name: workday_job_profile_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Workday HCM Job Profile System ID
attributes.description: Native system identifier for this job profile record in Workday HCM, used for ETL reconciliation, system-of-record traceability, and API integration with downstream HR analytics platforms.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Job Profile Object; Institutional Data Integration Standards

attributes.name: ada_essential_functions_documented
attributes.business_glossary_term: Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) Essential Functions Documented Indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether the essential physical and cognitive functions of this job profile have been formally documented in compliance with ADA requirements, supporting reasonable accommodation determinations and interactive process management.
attributes.references: Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) 42 U.S.C. § 12101; EEOC ADA Guidance

attributes.name: background_check_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether a pre-employment background check is required for all incumbents hired into this job profile. Supports compliance with institutional policy, Title IX, and Clery Act obligations for positions with student contact.
attributes.references: Clery Act (20 U.S.C. § 1092(f)); Title IX; Institutional HR Policy

attributes.name: bargaining_unit_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the specific collective bargaining unit or union contract applicable to this job profile when union_eligible is true (e.g., 'AFSCME', 'AAUP', 'SEIU'). Used for contract administration and labor cost reporting.
attributes.references: National Labor Relations Act (NLRA); Institutional Collective Bargaining Agreements

attributes.name: benefits_eligibility_class
attributes.description: Benefits eligibility classification assigned to this job profile determining which institutional benefit plans (health, dental, retirement, tuition waiver) are available to incumbents. Drives ACA compliance tracking and benefits cost modeling.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Benefits Eligibility Rules; ACA Employer Mandate (IRC § 4980H)

attributes.name: certifications_required
attributes.description: Free-text description of mandatory professional licenses or certifications required for this job profile (e.g., 'CPA', 'PMP', 'PE License', 'RN License'). Used in applicant screening and compliance verification.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Job Profile Qualifications; Institutional HR Policy

attributes.name: cip_code
attributes.description: CIP code aligned to the functional area or academic discipline most closely associated with this job profile, enabling linkage between workforce data and academic program structures. Used for IPEDS reporting and institutional research analytics.
attributes.references: NCES Classification of Instructional Programs (CIP) 2020; U.S. Department of Education

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this job profile record was first created in the institutional data catalog. Supports audit trail requirements and data lineage tracking in the Databricks Silver Layer.
attributes.references: Institutional Data Governance Policy; FERPA Audit Requirements

attributes.name: critical_job
attributes.description: Flags this job profile as mission-critical to institutional operations, triggering enhanced succession planning, targeted retention strategies, and priority position-fill timelines in workforce planning.
attributes.references: Institutional Workforce Planning Framework; Workday HCM Succession Planning

attributes.name: cupa_hr_survey_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: College and University Professional Association for Human Resources (CUPA-HR) Survey Code
attributes.description: CUPA-HR benchmark survey position code mapped to this job profile, enabling direct salary benchmarking against national higher-education compensation survey data. Critical for compensation equity analysis and market pricing.
attributes.references: CUPA-HR Administrators in Higher Education Survey; CUPA-HR Professionals in Higher Education Survey

attributes.name: driving_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether incumbents in this job profile are required to operate institutional or personal vehicles as part of their duties, triggering MVR (Motor Vehicle Record) check requirements and institutional auto liability coverage.
attributes.references: Institutional Risk Management Policy; Workday HCM Job Profile

attributes.name: eeo1_category
attributes.description: EEO-1 occupational category assigned to this job profile as required by the U.S. Equal Employment Opportunity Commission for annual EEO-1 Component 1 workforce demographic reporting. Drives federal compliance reporting and diversity analytics. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: Executive/Senior Officials|First/Mid Officials|Professionals|Technicians|Sales Workers|Administrative Support|Craft Workers|Operatives|Laborers|Service Workers — 10 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: EEOC EEO-1 Component 1 Survey; 29 CFR Part 1602

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date on which this job profile version became effective and available for use in position creation and hiring actions. Supports point-in-time compensation analysis and audit trail requirements.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Effective Dating; Institutional HR Policy

attributes.name: employee_type
attributes.description: Classification of the employment arrangement associated with this job profile indicating whether positions are regular (continuing), temporary, seasonal, or casual. Affects benefits eligibility, position control, and FTE workforce reporting.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Worker Type; IPEDS HR Survey

attributes.name: flsa_status
attributes.business_glossary_term: Fair Labor Standards Act (FLSA) Exemption Status
attributes.description: Classification of the job profile under the Fair Labor Standards Act (FLSA) indicating whether incumbents are exempt from overtime pay requirements. Critical for payroll compliance, overtime liability management, and U.S. Department of Labor regulatory reporting.
attributes.references: Fair Labor Standards Act (FLSA) 29 U.S.C. § 201; U.S. Department of Labor

attributes.name: fte_capacity
attributes.description: Standard FTE value associated with this job profile (typically 1.00 for full-time, 0.50 for half-time). Used in position control, workforce planning, and IPEDS FTE headcount calculations.
attributes.references: IPEDS Human Resources Survey; NACUBO FTE Methodology

attributes.name: inactive_date
attributes.description: Date on which this job profile was deactivated or deprecated in the institutional catalog. Null for currently active profiles. Used for historical workforce reporting and position control audits.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Job Profile; Institutional HR Policy

attributes.name: ipeds_occupational_category
attributes.business_glossary_term: Integrated Postsecondary Education Data System (IPEDS) Occupational Category
attributes.description: IPEDS staff occupational category assigned to this job profile for annual IPEDS Human Resources (HR) survey submission to the U.S. Department of Education. Categories include Instructional Staff, Research Staff, Public Service Staff, Management, Business/Financial Operations, etc. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: Instructional|Research|Public Service|Management|Business/Financial|Computer/Mathematical|Architecture/Engineering|Life/Physical/Social Science|Community Service|Legal|Arts/Design|Healthcare|Service|Sales|Office/Admin|Natural Resources|Construction|Maintenance|Production|Transportation — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: IPEDS Human Resources Survey; U.S. Department of Education NCES

attributes.name: job_code
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric code that uniquely identifies the job profile within Workday HCM and is referenced in position control, offer letters, and CUPA-HR survey submissions. Serves as the business-facing identifier across HR systems.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Job Profile; CUPA-HR Survey Methodology

attributes.name: job_description
attributes.description: Full detailed narrative of duties, responsibilities, and essential functions for this job profile. Serves as the authoritative document for ADA essential functions determination, FLSA classification justification, and accreditation staff qualification documentation.
attributes.references: ADA (42 U.S.C. § 12101); FLSA; EEOC Uniform Guidelines on Employee Selection

attributes.name: job_family_group
attributes.description: Higher-level cluster that aggregates multiple job families into a strategic workforce segment (e.g., 'Administrative and Professional', 'Technical and Skilled Trades', 'Executive Leadership'). Supports institutional workforce analytics and IPEDS reporting.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Job Family Group; IPEDS Human Resources Survey

attributes.name: job_level
attributes.description: Granular career level designation within a job family indicating seniority and scope (e.g., 'Level 1', 'Level 2', 'Senior', 'Principal', 'Lead'). Drives pay grade assignment and career progression frameworks. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: Entry|Associate|Mid|Senior|Principal|Lead|Expert|Fellow — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Workday HCM Job Level; CUPA-HR Compensation Survey

attributes.name: job_summary
attributes.description: Concise narrative description of the primary purpose and scope of the job profile, typically 2-4 sentences. Used in job postings, offer letters, and accreditation documentation.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Job Profile Description; EEOC Uniform Guidelines

attributes.name: job_title
attributes.description: Official human-readable title of the job profile as it appears on offer letters, organizational charts, and institutional directories (e.g., 'Senior Financial Analyst', 'Director of Admissions').
attributes.references: Workday HCM Job Profile; CUPA-HR Survey Methodology

attributes.name: last_reviewed_date
attributes.description: Date on which this job profile was last formally reviewed and validated by HR Compensation or the Classification and Compensation team. Supports cyclical job evaluation programs and accreditation documentation.
attributes.references: Institutional HR Classification and Compensation Policy; CUPA-HR Best Practices

attributes.name: management_level
attributes.description: Hierarchical management tier assigned to the job profile indicating span of control and organizational authority. Used for succession planning, compensation banding, and organizational design analytics.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Management Level; CUPA-HR Administrative Compensation Survey

attributes.name: min_education_requirement
attributes.description: Minimum academic credential required for appointment to this job profile. Used in applicant screening, position posting compliance, and accreditation documentation for staff qualification standards.
attributes.value_regex: High School Diploma/GED|Associate Degree|Bachelor Degree|Master Degree|Doctoral Degree|Professional Degree
attributes.references: Workday HCM Job Profile Qualifications; Regional Accreditation Standards (HLC; SACSCOC)

attributes.name: min_experience_years
attributes.description: Minimum number of years of relevant professional experience required for appointment to this job profile. Used in applicant screening, job posting, and compensation equity analysis.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Job Profile Qualifications; CUPA-HR Survey

attributes.name: pay_grade
attributes.description: Institutional pay grade or salary band code assigned to this job profile (e.g., 'P3', 'M5', 'E2'). Determines the applicable salary range minimum, midpoint, and maximum for compensation administration and NACUBO benchmarking.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Compensation Grade; NACUBO; CUPA-HR Salary Survey

attributes.name: pay_grade_max_usd
attributes.description: Maximum annual base salary in US dollars defined for this pay grade and job profile. Caps compensation for incumbents and triggers reclassification review when employees approach or exceed this threshold.
attributes.references: CUPA-HR Salary Survey; NACUBO; Equal Pay Act

attributes.name: pay_grade_midpoint_usd
attributes.description: Midpoint annual base salary in US dollars for this pay grade, representing the market reference point for a fully competent incumbent. Used in compa-ratio calculations and compensation equity reviews.

attributes.name: pay_grade_min_usd
attributes.description: Minimum annual base salary in US dollars defined for this pay grade and job profile. Used in offer generation, equity analysis, and CUPA-HR compensation benchmarking to ensure pay equity compliance.
attributes.references: CUPA-HR Salary Survey; NACUBO; Equal Pay Act

attributes.name: profile_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the job profile in the institutional catalog. Active profiles are available for position creation and hiring. Inactive or Deprecated profiles are retained for historical position and compensation records but cannot be used for new positions.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Job Profile Status; Institutional Position Control Policy

attributes.name: retirement_plan_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether incumbents in this job profile are eligible to participate in institutional retirement plans (e.g., TIAA, state pension). Supports benefits administration and ERISA compliance reporting.
attributes.references: ERISA; IRS Retirement Plan Rules; Workday HCM Benefits

attributes.name: sox_sensitive
attributes.description: Indicates whether this job profile is designated as a SOX-sensitive role with access to financial systems or controls, requiring enhanced internal audit oversight and segregation of duties controls. Applicable to institutions subject to SOX or analogous GASB/FASB internal control frameworks.
attributes.references: Sarbanes-Oxley Act (SOX) Section 302/404; GASB Statement No. 34; NACUBO

attributes.name: stem_designated
attributes.business_glossary_term: Science Technology Engineering Mathematics (STEM) Designation Indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether this job profile is classified as a STEM-designated role, relevant for OPT STEM extension eligibility for international employees and for institutional STEM workforce diversity reporting.
attributes.references: DHS STEM OPT Extension Rule (8 CFR 214.2(f)); U.S. Department of Homeland Security

attributes.name: union_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether positions filled under this job profile are eligible for collective bargaining unit membership. Drives labor relations tracking, union dues processing, and contract compliance monitoring.
attributes.references: National Labor Relations Act (NLRA); Workday HCM Union Configuration

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this job profile record was most recently modified in the institutional data catalog. Used for incremental ETL processing, change data capture, and audit trail compliance.
attributes.references: Institutional Data Governance Policy; Workday HCM Audit Trail

attributes.name: work_location_type
attributes.description: Designated work arrangement type for this job profile indicating whether the role is performed on-site at an institutional facility, fully remote, or in a hybrid arrangement. Supports workforce planning and facilities space utilization analysis.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Work Space; Institutional Remote Work Policy

attributes.name: work_shift
attributes.description: Standard work shift designation associated with this job profile indicating the expected hours of operation. Relevant for facilities, public safety, and healthcare-adjacent roles within the institution.

products.name: org_unit
products.description: Institutional organizational hierarchy entity representing departments, divisions, colleges, schools, and administrative units in a parent-child tree structure. Tracks unit name, unit code, parent unit, cost center reference, unit type (academic, administrative, auxiliary, research center), effective dates, responsible manager, and active/inactive status. Supports workforce reporting rollups by organizational level, budget alignment, supervisory hierarchy navigation, and IPEDS organizational structure reporting. Sourced from Workday HCM Supervisory Organization.

attributes.name: org_unit_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the organizational unit record in the institutional hierarchy. Primary key for the org_unit data product sourced from Workday HCM Supervisory Organization.

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Reference to the financial cost center associated with this organizational unit. Supports budget alignment, financial reporting rollups, and cross-system reconciliation between Workday HCM and Oracle PeopleSoft Financials.
attributes.references: Oracle PeopleSoft Financials; NACUBO Financial Reporting Standards

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the employee who serves as the responsible manager or unit head for this organizational unit. Used for supervisory hierarchy navigation, approval routing, and workforce planning. Sourced from Workday HCM position management.
attributes.references: Workday HCM HCM Position Management; CUPA-HR Workforce Reporting Standards

attributes.name: parent_org_unit_id
attributes.description: Reference to the immediate parent organizational unit in the institutional hierarchy tree. Null for the root-level institution node. Enables recursive parent-child traversal for workforce rollup reporting and supervisory hierarchy navigation.

attributes.name: accreditation_body
attributes.description: Name of the primary specialized or programmatic accreditation body governing this organizational unit's academic programs. Examples: 'ABET', 'AACSB', 'LCME', 'ABA', 'HLC'. Null for non-academic or non-accredited units. Used for accreditation compliance tracking and self-study documentation. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: ABET|AACSB|LCME|ABA|HLC|SACSCOC|MSCHE|NWCCU|NECHE|WSCUC|ACEN|CCNE — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: ABET; AACSB International; LCME; ABA; HLC; SACSCOC

attributes.name: accreditation_status
attributes.description: Current accreditation status of the organizational unit with its primary accreditation body. Accredited units are in good standing; candidate units are pursuing initial accreditation; probation units have conditions to resolve; not_accredited units are unaccredited; exempt units are not subject to specialized accreditation requirements.
attributes.references: HLC Accreditation Standards; SACSCOC Accreditation Standards; AACSB International; ABET

attributes.name: banner_org_code
attributes.description: Ellucian Banner SIS organization code mapped to this Workday HCM supervisory organization. Used for cross-system reconciliation between HR and student information systems, particularly for academic department alignment in course scheduling and faculty assignment.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner SIS; Workday HCM Supervisory Organization

attributes.name: building_code
attributes.description: Archibus building code for the primary building where this organizational unit's administrative offices are located. Used for facilities management, space planning, and emergency contact routing.

attributes.name: cip_code
attributes.description: U.S. Department of Education Classification of Instructional Programs (CIP) code associated with the academic unit's primary discipline. Used for IPEDS completions reporting, program accreditation alignment, and STEM designation tracking. Applicable to academic units only; null for administrative and auxiliary units.
attributes.references: IPEDS CIP Code Taxonomy; U.S. Department of Education

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this organizational unit record was first created in the Databricks Silver layer data product. Supports audit trail, data lineage tracking, and SCD Type 2 history management.
attributes.references: Databricks Lakehouse Silver Layer Standards; FERPA Audit Requirements

attributes.name: dissolved_date
attributes.description: Calendar date on which the organizational unit was formally dissolved, merged, or reorganized out of existence by institutional governance. Null for active units. Retained for accreditation audit trails and IPEDS historical reporting.
attributes.references: HLC Accreditation Standards; IPEDS Reporting Requirements

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: Date on which the organizational unit ceased or will cease to be operationally effective. Null for currently active units with no planned end date. Used for historical reporting, accreditation documentation, and SCD management in the Silver layer.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Supervisory Organization; IPEDS Reporting Requirements

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: Date on which the organizational unit became or becomes operationally effective. Used for time-based workforce reporting, budget period alignment, and IPEDS organizational structure snapshots. Supports slowly changing dimension (SCD) tracking in the Silver layer.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Supervisory Organization; IPEDS Reporting Requirements

attributes.name: email_address
attributes.description: Official institutional email address for the organizational unit used for external communications, directory listings, and system notifications. Typically a shared mailbox (e.g., engineering@university.edu).

attributes.name: established_date
attributes.description: Calendar date on which the organizational unit was formally established or chartered by institutional governance. Distinct from effective_start_date which tracks system activation. Used for accreditation history, institutional research, and anniversary reporting.
attributes.references: HLC Accreditation Standards; SACSCOC Accreditation Standards

attributes.name: fte_actual
attributes.description: Current actual Full-Time Equivalent (FTE) headcount filled within this organizational unit based on active position assignments in Workday HCM. Compared against fte_budget for workforce planning variance reporting and IPEDS Human Resources Survey submissions.
attributes.references: CUPA-HR Workforce Reporting Standards; IPEDS Human Resources Survey

attributes.name: fte_budget
attributes.description: Authorized Full-Time Equivalent (FTE) headcount budget allocated to this organizational unit for workforce planning and position control purposes. Used in CUPA-HR benchmarking, institutional workforce planning, and budget variance analysis. Expressed as a decimal to accommodate fractional FTE allocations.
attributes.references: CUPA-HR Workforce Reporting Standards; IPEDS Human Resources Survey

attributes.name: gl_fund_code
attributes.description: General Ledger fund code from Oracle PeopleSoft Financials that classifies the primary funding source for this organizational unit (e.g., general fund, restricted fund, auxiliary fund, endowment fund). Supports NACUBO-compliant financial reporting and budget alignment.
attributes.references: Oracle PeopleSoft Financials; NACUBO Financial Reporting Standards; GASB Statement No. 34

attributes.name: hierarchy_depth
attributes.description: Integer representing the depth level of this unit within the institutional hierarchy tree, where the root institution node is level 1. Used for hierarchy-aware reporting, rollup aggregation logic, and organizational structure analytics.

attributes.name: idc_rate_type
attributes.description: Facilities and Administrative (F&A) indirect cost rate type applicable to this organizational unit for sponsored research and grant administration. Determines the IDC rate applied to direct costs on federal awards administered through Kuali Research. Governed by OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200.
attributes.references: OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200; NSF Grant Policy Manual; NIH Grants Policy Statement

attributes.name: ipeds_unit_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: Integrated Postsecondary Education Data System (IPEDS) Unit ID
attributes.description: Federal IPEDS unit identifier assigned by the U.S. Department of Education for postsecondary institution reporting. Required for Title IV financial aid administration and federal compliance reporting. Applicable primarily at the institution and campus levels.
attributes.references: IPEDS Reporting Requirements; U.S. Department of Education Title IV

attributes.name: is_academic_unit
attributes.description: Indicates whether this organizational unit is classified as an academic unit that delivers instruction, awards credentials, or conducts academic programs. Used to filter units for IPEDS academic reporting, accreditation submissions, and curriculum governance workflows.
attributes.references: IPEDS Reporting Requirements; HLC Accreditation Standards

attributes.name: is_degree_granting
attributes.description: Indicates whether this organizational unit has authority to award academic degrees or credentials. Used for accreditation scope determination, IPEDS completions reporting, and program review governance.
attributes.references: U.S. Department of Education Title IV; HLC Accreditation Standards; SACSCOC Accreditation Standards

attributes.name: is_research_active
attributes.description: Indicates whether this organizational unit actively administers sponsored research grants, contracts, or IRB protocols through Kuali Research. Used for Facilities and Administrative (F&A) cost allocation, indirect cost rate (IDC) reporting, and research compliance oversight.
attributes.references: Kuali Research Administration; OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200; NSF; NIH

attributes.name: mission_statement
attributes.description: Formal mission statement of the organizational unit as approved by institutional governance. Required for programmatic accreditation submissions (AACSB, ABET, LCME) and institutional self-study documentation.
attributes.references: AACSB International Accreditation Standards; ABET Criteria; HLC Accreditation Standards

attributes.name: next_accreditation_review_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date of the next accreditation review, site visit, or self-study submission for this organizational unit. Used for compliance planning, institutional research scheduling, and accreditation project management.
attributes.references: HLC Accreditation Standards; SACSCOC Accreditation Standards; AACSB International; ABET

attributes.name: org_hierarchy_path
attributes.description: Materialized full path string representing the unit's position in the institutional hierarchy from root to current node, using unit codes delimited by forward slashes. Example: 'INST/DIV-ACAD/COLL-ENG/DEPT-CS'. Enables efficient hierarchy traversal and rollup queries in the Databricks Silver layer without recursive CTEs.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Supervisory Organization; Databricks Lakehouse Best Practices

attributes.name: org_unit_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the organizational unit. Active units are operational and accept workforce assignments and budget allocations. Inactive units are suspended but retained for historical reporting. Pending units are approved but not yet operational. Dissolved units have been formally closed and are retained for audit and accreditation history.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Supervisory Organization; HLC Accreditation Standards

attributes.name: peoplesoft_deptid
attributes.description: Oracle PeopleSoft Financials department identifier (DEPTID) mapped to this organizational unit. Enables financial reporting rollups, budget alignment, and cross-system reconciliation between Workday HCM workforce data and PeopleSoft GL transactions.
attributes.references: Oracle PeopleSoft Financials; NACUBO Financial Reporting Standards

attributes.name: phone_number
attributes.description: Primary telephone number for the organizational unit's main administrative office. Used for institutional directory, emergency communications, and vendor/partner contact routing.

attributes.name: position_count_authorized
attributes.description: Total number of authorized positions (filled and vacant) approved for this organizational unit through the institutional position control process. Supports workforce planning, budget justification, and headcount reporting.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Position Management; CUPA-HR Workforce Reporting Standards

attributes.name: position_count_filled
attributes.description: Number of currently filled (occupied) positions within this organizational unit as tracked in Workday HCM. Used for vacancy analysis, workforce planning, and IPEDS Human Resources Survey reporting.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Position Management; IPEDS Human Resources Survey

attributes.name: primary_campus_location
attributes.description: Name or code of the primary campus or physical location where this organizational unit is headquartered. Used for facilities planning, space allocation in Archibus, and multi-campus reporting. Examples: 'Main Campus', 'North Campus', 'Downtown Center', 'Online'.
attributes.references: Archibus Facilities Management; IPEDS Reporting Requirements

attributes.name: room_number
attributes.description: Room number of the primary administrative office for this organizational unit within the designated building. Used for facilities management, directory services, and space utilization reporting in Archibus.

attributes.name: unit_code
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric code uniquely identifying the organizational unit within institutional systems. Used as the business key in Banner, Workday, and PeopleSoft integrations. Examples: 'COLL-ENG', 'DEPT-CS', 'DIV-ACAD'.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Supervisory Organization; Ellucian Banner SIS

attributes.name: unit_description
attributes.description: Free-text narrative description of the organizational unit's mission, scope, and primary functions. Used for institutional directory, accreditation self-study documentation, and onboarding materials.
attributes.references: HLC Accreditation Standards; SACSCOC Accreditation Standards

attributes.name: unit_level
attributes.description: Hierarchical level of the organizational unit within the institutional structure. Determines the unit's position in the parent-child tree and governs reporting rollup behavior. Institution is the root; divisions and colleges are mid-tier; departments, programs, offices, and centers are leaf-level units. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: institution|division|college|school|department|program|office|center — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: IPEDS Organizational Structure Reporting; Workday HCM Supervisory Organization

attributes.name: unit_name
attributes.description: Official full name of the organizational unit as recognized in institutional records, accreditation filings, and IPEDS reporting. Examples: 'College of Engineering', 'Department of Computer Science', 'Office of Financial Aid'.
attributes.references: IPEDS Organizational Structure Reporting; HLC Accreditation Standards

attributes.name: unit_short_name
attributes.description: Abbreviated or shortened display name for the organizational unit used in dashboards, reports, and space-constrained interfaces. Examples: 'Eng College', 'CS Dept', 'Fin Aid Office'.

attributes.name: unit_type
attributes.description: Classification of the organizational unit by its primary institutional function. Academic units deliver instruction and award degrees; administrative units provide institutional support services; auxiliary units are self-supporting enterprises (e.g., housing, dining); research centers conduct sponsored and non-sponsored research; athletics units manage NCAA-governed programs.
attributes.references: IPEDS Organizational Structure Reporting; NACUBO Functional Classification Standards

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this organizational unit record was most recently modified in the Databricks Silver layer data product. Used for incremental ETL processing, change detection, and audit trail compliance.
attributes.references: Databricks Lakehouse Silver Layer Standards; FERPA Audit Requirements

attributes.name: website_url
attributes.description: Official public-facing website URL for the organizational unit. Used for institutional directory, accreditation documentation, and alumni/prospective student communications.

attributes.name: workday_org_reference
attributes.description: Native Workday HCM Supervisory Organization identifier for this unit. Serves as the source system key for ETL reconciliation, API integration, and cross-system lineage tracking between Workday HCM and the Databricks Silver layer.

products.name: staffing_event
products.description: Transactional record capturing all employee lifecycle events including hire, rehire, transfer, promotion, demotion, reclassification, leave of absence, return from leave, separation (voluntary/involuntary/retirement), and onboarding process completion. Each event records effective date, event type, prior and new position/job/department/compensation values, reason code, initiating manager, and event-specific attributes. For separations: rehire eligibility, COBRA notification date, exit interview status, final paycheck date. For onboarding: I-9 verification status, background check clearance, benefits enrollment deadline, IT provisioning status, orientation completion, policy acknowledgments. Sourced from Workday HCM business process audit trail. Serves as the single authoritative lifecycle record for all workforce movement, turnover analysis, IPEDS reporting, and CUPA-HR benchmarking.
products.reference: Workday HCM Staffing Event / Business Process

attributes.name: staffing_event_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each staffing event record in the Workday HCM business process audit trail. Primary key for the staffing_event data product.

attributes.name: job_profile_id
attributes.description: Reference to the job profile (standardized job definition including title, family, and level) assigned to the employee after this staffing event. Drives compensation grade and CUPA-HR job classification alignment.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Job Profile; CUPA-HR Salary Survey

attributes.name: org_unit_id
attributes.description: Reference to the organizational department or cost center to which the employee belongs after this staffing event. Used for workforce distribution reporting and CUPA-HR benchmarking.

attributes.name: position_id
attributes.description: Reference to the position (budgeted headcount slot) associated with this staffing event, reflecting the new position after the event. Supports position control and Full-Time Equivalent (FTE) workforce planning.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Position Management; IPEDS HR Survey

attributes.name: primary_staffing_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the employee record for whom this staffing event applies. Links to the canonical employee master in Workday HCM.

attributes.name: background_check_status
attributes.description: For hire and onboarding events, the status of the pre-employment background check screening. Null for non-hire events. Required for compliance with institutional hiring policies and applicable state regulations.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Onboarding; FCRA (Fair Credit Reporting Act); Institutional HR Policy

attributes.name: benefits_enrollment_deadline
attributes.description: For hire and onboarding events, the deadline by which the new employee must complete benefits enrollment elections in Workday HCM. Null for non-hire events. Typically 30 days from hire date per IRS qualifying event rules.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Benefits; IRS Section 125; ACA Employer Mandate

attributes.name: cobra_notification_date
attributes.description: For separation events, the date on which the Consolidated Omnibus Budget Reconciliation Act (COBRA) continuation coverage notification was sent to the departing employee. Required within 14 days of qualifying event per federal law. Null for non-separation events.
attributes.references: COBRA (Consolidated Omnibus Budget Reconciliation Act); U.S. Department of Labor

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time this staffing event record was first captured in the data lakehouse Silver layer. Used for data lineage, ETL audit, and record provenance tracking.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Audit Trail; FERPA Data Governance

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: The real-world date on which the staffing event takes effect for payroll, benefits, and position control purposes. This is the principal business event date distinct from the record creation timestamp.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Effective Dating; FLSA; IRS Payroll Regulations

attributes.name: employment_type
attributes.description: Classification of the employee's appointment type after this staffing event. Determines benefits eligibility, IPEDS reporting category, and Affordable Care Act (ACA) compliance tracking.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Worker Type; IPEDS HR Survey; ACA Employer Mandate

attributes.name: event_status
attributes.description: Current workflow status of the staffing event within the Workday HCM business process lifecycle. Indicates whether the event has been fully processed and is authoritative for workforce records.

attributes.name: event_timestamp
attributes.description: The precise date and time the staffing event was submitted or triggered in Workday HCM. Captures the exact moment of business process initiation for audit trail purposes.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Business Process Audit Trail

attributes.name: event_type
attributes.description: Categorical classification of the employee lifecycle event. Drives downstream processing logic, reporting segmentation, and IPEDS workforce reporting. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: hire|rehire|transfer|promotion|demotion|reclassification|leave_of_absence|return_from_leave|separation|onboarding_completion — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Workday HCM Business Process Types; IPEDS HR Survey; CUPA-HR

attributes.name: exit_interview_status
attributes.description: For separation events, tracks the completion status of the exit interview process. Supports voluntary turnover analysis and institutional retention strategy. Null for non-separation events.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Offboarding; HR Best Practices

attributes.name: final_paycheck_date
attributes.description: For separation events, the date on which the employee's final paycheck was issued, including any accrued vacation payout. Null for non-separation events. Required for state wage payment law compliance.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Payroll; State Wage Payment Laws; FLSA

attributes.name: flsa_status
attributes.description: The employee's Fair Labor Standards Act (FLSA) exemption status after this staffing event, indicating whether the employee is exempt from overtime pay requirements. Critical for payroll compliance and Department of Labor reporting.
attributes.references: Fair Labor Standards Act (FLSA); U.S. Department of Labor

attributes.name: i9_verification_status
attributes.description: For hire and onboarding events, the status of the Form I-9 Employment Eligibility Verification process confirming the employee's legal authorization to work in the United States. Null for non-hire events.
attributes.references: U.S. Citizenship and Immigration Services (USCIS) Form I-9; Immigration Reform and Control Act (IRCA)

attributes.name: it_provisioning_status
attributes.description: For hire and onboarding events, tracks whether IT system access provisioning (network accounts, email, Single Sign-On (SSO), Learning Management System (LMS) access) has been completed. Null for non-hire events.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Onboarding; Institutional IT Policy; FERPA Data Access Controls

attributes.name: leave_return_date
attributes.description: For leave of absence events, the expected or actual date the employee is scheduled to return from leave. Null for non-leave events. Used for workforce planning and FMLA entitlement tracking.
attributes.references: FMLA (Family and Medical Leave Act); Workday HCM Leave Management

attributes.name: leave_type
attributes.description: For leave of absence events, classifies the type of leave (e.g., Family and Medical Leave Act (FMLA), medical, personal, military, parental, sabbatical). Null for non-leave events. Drives leave entitlement tracking and compliance reporting.
attributes.references: FMLA (Family and Medical Leave Act); USERRA; Workday HCM Leave Management

attributes.name: new_annual_salary
attributes.description: The employee's annualized base salary resulting from this staffing event. Drives payroll processing, benefits calculations, and CUPA-HR benchmarking submissions. Classified as confidential business-sensitive data.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Compensation; CUPA-HR Salary Survey; FLSA

attributes.name: new_department_code
attributes.description: The organizational department code associated with the employee's position after this staffing event. Used for headcount reporting and budget allocation.

attributes.name: new_fte
attributes.description: The employee's Full-Time Equivalent (FTE) value after this staffing event. Drives IPEDS FTE headcount reporting, benefits eligibility determination, and institutional workforce planning.
attributes.references: IPEDS HR Survey; Workday HCM FTE Calculation; ACA Employer Mandate

attributes.name: new_job_title
attributes.description: The employee's job title resulting from this staffing event. Used for workforce reporting, organizational charts, and CUPA-HR benchmarking submissions.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Job Profile; CUPA-HR Salary Survey

attributes.name: new_position_code
attributes.description: The position code assigned to the employee as a result of this staffing event. Reflects the post-event position for workforce planning and position control reporting.

attributes.name: orientation_completed
attributes.description: For hire and onboarding events, indicates whether the new employee has completed the required institutional new employee orientation program. Null for non-hire events. Supports onboarding compliance tracking.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Onboarding; Institutional HR Policy

attributes.name: pay_frequency
attributes.description: The payroll payment frequency for the employee after this staffing event. Determines payroll processing schedule and annualization calculations in Workday HCM.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Payroll; IRS Payroll Regulations

attributes.name: pay_grade
attributes.description: The compensation grade or salary band assigned to the employee's position after this staffing event. Used for salary administration, equity analysis, and CUPA-HR benchmarking alignment.

attributes.name: policy_acknowledgment_date
attributes.description: For hire and onboarding events, the date on which the new employee completed required policy acknowledgments (e.g., code of conduct, FERPA training, Title IX, acceptable use policy). Null for non-hire events.
attributes.references: FERPA; Title IX; Institutional Compliance Policy; Workday HCM Onboarding

attributes.name: prior_annual_salary
attributes.description: The employee's annualized base salary immediately before this staffing event. Used for compensation change analysis, equity reviews, and CUPA-HR salary benchmarking. Classified as confidential business-sensitive data.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Compensation; CUPA-HR Salary Survey; FLSA

attributes.name: prior_department_code
attributes.description: The organizational department code associated with the employee's position before this staffing event. Enables inter-departmental transfer tracking and workforce distribution analysis.

attributes.name: prior_fte
attributes.description: The employee's Full-Time Equivalent (FTE) value before this staffing event, expressed as a decimal (e.g., 1.0 for full-time, 0.5 for half-time). Used for IPEDS FTE reporting and workforce planning.
attributes.references: IPEDS HR Survey; Workday HCM FTE Calculation

attributes.name: prior_job_title
attributes.description: The employee's job title immediately before this staffing event. Captured for historical record and career progression analysis in CUPA-HR benchmarking.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Job Profile; CUPA-HR Salary Survey

attributes.name: prior_position_code
attributes.description: The position code held by the employee immediately before this staffing event. Enables before/after comparison for transfer, promotion, demotion, and reclassification analysis.

attributes.name: reason_code
attributes.description: Standardized reason code from Workday HCM explaining why the staffing event occurred (e.g., VOLUNTARY_RESIGNATION, INVOLUNTARY_TERMINATION, PROMOTION_MERIT, LATERAL_TRANSFER). Used for turnover analysis and IPEDS reporting. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: voluntary_resignation|involuntary_termination|retirement|promotion_merit|promotion_equity|lateral_transfer|reclassification_upward|reclassification_downward|medical_leave|fmla_leave — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Workday HCM Reason Codes; IPEDS HR Survey; CUPA-HR

attributes.name: reason_description
attributes.description: Free-text narrative description providing additional context for the staffing event reason beyond the standardized reason code. May include manager comments or HR notes entered during the Workday business process.

attributes.name: rehire_eligible
attributes.description: For separation events, indicates whether the departing employee has been designated as eligible for future rehire by the institution. Null for non-separation events. Used in talent acquisition screening.

attributes.name: salary_change_pct
attributes.description: The percentage change in base salary resulting from this staffing event, calculated as (new_annual_salary - prior_annual_salary) / prior_annual_salary. Supports compensation equity analysis and merit increase reporting.

attributes.name: separation_type
attributes.description: For separation events, classifies whether the departure was voluntary (resignation), involuntary (termination), retirement, death, or end of contract. Null for non-separation events. Drives turnover analysis and IPEDS reporting.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Termination Reason; IPEDS HR Survey; CUPA-HR

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time this staffing event record was last modified in the data lakehouse Silver layer. Supports incremental load detection and change data capture.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Audit Trail; Data Governance Standards

products.name: employee_compensation
products.description: Point-in-time compensation record for each employee capturing base salary or hourly rate, compensation type, pay grade assignment, FTE-adjusted annualized salary, effective date, and reason for change (merit, equity, market adjustment, promotion). Includes reference to institutional compensation structures: salary grades, pay ranges (minimum, midpoint, maximum), pay frequency, and compensation plan effective dates. Tracks full compensation history per employee. Sourced from Workday HCM Compensation. Supports CUPA-HR salary benchmarking, pay equity reporting, and salary administration.

attributes.name: employee_compensation_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each point-in-time compensation record in the employee compensation history. Primary key for this table.

attributes.name: compensation_plan_id
attributes.description: Reference to the institutional compensation plan (salary structure) under which this employee is compensated. Compensation plans define pay grades, ranges, and eligibility rules.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Compensation Plan; CUPA-HR Benchmarking

attributes.name: job_profile_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to hr.job_profile. Business justification: Compensation records reference job classifications to determine pay grade alignment and market benchmarking. employee_compensation has job_profile_code (STRING) as a denormalized business key but lack

attributes.name: pay_grade_id
attributes.description: Reference to the pay grade assigned to this compensation record. Pay grades define the salary band (minimum, midpoint, maximum) applicable to the employee's role.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Pay Grade; CUPA-HR Salary Administration

attributes.name: position_id
attributes.description: Reference to the institutional position (position control record) associated with this compensation record. Supports position-based budgeting and workforce planning.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Position Management; NACUBO Workforce Standards

attributes.name: primary_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the employee whose compensation is recorded. Links to the HR employee master record in Workday HCM.

attributes.name: workday_compensation_event_id
attributes.description: Source system business identifier for the compensation change event as recorded in Workday HCM. Used for traceability and reconciliation back to the system of record.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Compensation Event; NACUBO Data Governance

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: The date on which this compensation change was formally approved in Workday HCM. May differ from the effective_date for retroactive adjustments. Used for audit trail and governance reporting.
attributes.references: Workday HCM; NACUBO Internal Controls; Institutional Governance

attributes.name: base_salary_amount
attributes.description: The annualized base salary amount for salaried employees expressed in USD. For hourly employees, this field is null and hourly_rate is used instead. Core field for CUPA-HR salary benchmarking and pay equity reporting.
attributes.references: Workday HCM; CUPA-HR Salary Survey; FLSA; NACUBO

attributes.name: change_reason
attributes.description: Business reason driving this compensation change event. Supports pay equity analysis, merit cycle reporting, and CUPA-HR benchmarking. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: merit|equity_adjustment|market_adjustment|promotion|demotion|reclassification|initial_hire|contract_renewal — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Workday HCM Compensation Change Reason; CUPA-HR; NACUBO

attributes.name: compa_ratio
attributes.description: The ratio of the employee's base salary to the midpoint of their pay grade range, expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.95 = 95% of midpoint). A compa-ratio below 1.0 indicates the employee is paid below the market midpoint; above 1.0 indicates above midpoint. Core metric for pay equity analysis and CUPA-HR benchmarking.
attributes.references: CUPA-HR Salary Survey Methodology; NACUBO Compensation Administration

attributes.name: compensation_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of this compensation record. Active indicates the record is the current effective compensation; inactive indicates it has been superseded by a newer record; pending indicates an approved but not yet effective change; cancelled indicates a retracted change.
attributes.references: Workday HCM; NACUBO HR Data Standards

attributes.name: compensation_type
attributes.description: Classification of the compensation structure: salary (annualized fixed), hourly (rate-based), stipend (fixed periodic payment for specific roles such as graduate assistants), or supplemental (additional pay on top of base). Drives payroll calculation method.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Compensation Type; CUPA-HR Classification Standards

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this compensation record was first created in the data platform (Silver layer ingestion timestamp). Supports audit trail, data lineage, and incremental load processing.
attributes.references: Workday HCM; NACUBO Data Governance; Databricks Lakehouse Silver Layer Standards

attributes.name: cupa_hr_survey_category
attributes.business_glossary_term: College and University Professional Association for Human Resources (CUPA-HR) Survey Category
attributes.description: The CUPA-HR occupational survey category code assigned to this employee's position for external salary benchmarking purposes (e.g., Administrative Compensation Survey, Staff Compensation Survey, Faculty in Higher Education Survey). Enables direct comparison to national higher-education salary data.
attributes.references: CUPA-HR Survey Methodology; IPEDS; U.S. Department of Education

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for all monetary amounts in this compensation record (e.g., USD). Supports institutions with international campuses or employees paid in foreign currencies.
attributes.references: ISO 4217; FASB ASC 830 Foreign Currency Matters

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: The date on which this compensation record becomes effective. Defines the start of the compensation period for this point-in-time record. Used for retroactive pay calculations and compensation history reporting.
attributes.references: Workday HCM; FLSA; CUPA-HR Salary Administration

attributes.name: employee_category
attributes.description: Broad institutional classification of the employee at the time of this compensation record. Drives applicable compensation plan, pay grade structure, and CUPA-HR survey category. Faculty includes tenure-track, tenured, and non-tenure-track instructional staff.
attributes.references: CUPA-HR Survey Categories; IPEDS Human Resources Survey; Workday HCM

attributes.name: end_date
attributes.description: The date on which this compensation record ceases to be effective. Null indicates the record is currently active (open-ended). Populated when a subsequent compensation change supersedes this record.

attributes.name: flsa_status
attributes.description: The employee's FLSA overtime exemption status at the time of this compensation record. Exempt employees are not entitled to overtime pay; non-exempt employees must receive overtime pay for hours worked beyond 40 per week. Critical for payroll compliance and DOL audit readiness.
attributes.references: Fair Labor Standards Act (FLSA); U.S. Department of Labor; Workday HCM

attributes.name: fte_annualized_salary
attributes.description: The FTE-adjusted annualized salary representing what the employee would earn if working full-time (1.0 FTE) for a full year. Calculated as base_salary_amount divided by fte_percent and normalized to 1.0 FTE. Used for CUPA-HR benchmarking comparisons and pay equity analysis across part-time and full-time employees.
attributes.references: CUPA-HR Salary Survey Methodology; IPEDS Human Resources Survey; NACUBO

attributes.name: fte_percent
attributes.description: The employee's FTE percentage at the time of this compensation record, expressed as a decimal (e.g., 1.0 = full-time, 0.5 = half-time). Used to calculate FTE-adjusted salary and for IPEDS FTE workforce reporting.
attributes.references: IPEDS Human Resources Survey; CUPA-HR; NACUBO Workforce Planning

attributes.name: funding_source
attributes.description: The primary funding source for this compensation record. Indicates whether the salary is funded from the general operating budget, a sponsored research grant (subject to F&A cost allocation), auxiliary enterprise revenue, or other restricted/designated funds. Critical for grant effort reporting and F&A cost allocation.
attributes.references: OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200; Kuali Research; Oracle PeopleSoft Financials; NACUBO

attributes.name: grant_funded_percent
attributes.description: The percentage of this compensation funded by sponsored research grants or contracts, expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.50 = 50% grant-funded). Used for effort reporting compliance under OMB Uniform Guidance and F&A (Facilities and Administrative) cost allocation. Null if funding_source is not grant.
attributes.references: OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200; NIH Grants Policy Statement; NSF Grant Policy Manual; Kuali Research

attributes.name: hourly_rate
attributes.description: The hourly pay rate for non-exempt hourly employees expressed in USD per hour. Null for salaried employees. Must meet or exceed applicable federal and state minimum wage requirements under FLSA.
attributes.references: Workday HCM; FLSA; U.S. Department of Labor

attributes.name: ipeds_occupation_category
attributes.business_glossary_term: Integrated Postsecondary Education Data System (IPEDS) Occupation Category
attributes.description: The IPEDS occupational activity category assigned to this employee for federal reporting purposes (e.g., Instruction, Research, Public Service, Academic Support, Student Services, Institutional Support, Auxiliary Enterprises). Required for annual IPEDS Human Resources survey submission to the U.S. Department of Education.
attributes.references: IPEDS Human Resources Survey; U.S. Department of Education; OMB SOC Classification

attributes.name: is_equity_adjustment
attributes.description: Indicates whether this compensation change includes an equity adjustment component intended to address internal pay equity disparities. True when the change reason includes an equity component. Used for pay equity reporting and Title IX/Title VII compliance monitoring.
attributes.references: Title VII Civil Rights Act; Title IX; CUPA-HR Pay Equity Analysis; NACUBO

attributes.name: is_market_adjustment
attributes.description: Indicates whether this compensation change includes a market adjustment component driven by external salary benchmarking data (e.g., CUPA-HR survey results). True when the change reason includes a market component. Used for compensation strategy reporting.
attributes.references: CUPA-HR Salary Survey; Workday HCM; NACUBO Compensation Administration

attributes.name: job_family
attributes.description: The job family grouping for the employee's role at the time of this compensation record (e.g., Information Technology, Academic Affairs, Finance, Facilities). Used for cross-functional compensation benchmarking and CUPA-HR survey alignment.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Job Family; CUPA-HR Occupational Classification

attributes.name: merit_increase_amount
attributes.description: The dollar amount of the merit-based salary increase applied in this compensation change event. Null if the change reason is not merit. Used for merit cycle budget tracking and equity analysis.
attributes.references: Workday HCM; CUPA-HR Merit Survey; NACUBO

attributes.name: merit_increase_percent
attributes.description: The percentage merit increase applied in this compensation change event, expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.03 = 3%). Null if the change reason is not merit. Used for merit budget analysis and CUPA-HR merit survey reporting.
attributes.references: CUPA-HR Merit Survey; Workday HCM; NACUBO

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes entered by HR administrators documenting the rationale, context, or special circumstances for this compensation change. May include references to market data, performance review outcomes, or negotiation details. Classified confidential due to sensitive compensation context.
attributes.references: Workday HCM; NACUBO HR Data Governance; FERPA

attributes.name: pay_frequency
attributes.description: The frequency at which the employee is paid under this compensation record. Drives payroll cycle processing and per-period gross pay calculations.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Payroll; FLSA; U.S. Department of Labor

attributes.name: pay_range_maximum
attributes.description: The maximum salary amount of the pay grade range applicable at the time of this compensation record. Captured as a point-in-time snapshot. Used to identify employees at or above the range maximum (red-circled employees) for compensation administration.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Pay Range; CUPA-HR; NACUBO Compensation Administration

attributes.name: pay_range_midpoint
attributes.description: The midpoint salary amount of the pay grade range applicable at the time of this compensation record. The midpoint represents the market-competitive rate for the role. Used as the denominator in compa-ratio calculations for CUPA-HR benchmarking.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Pay Range; CUPA-HR Salary Survey; NACUBO

attributes.name: pay_range_minimum
attributes.description: The minimum salary amount of the pay grade range applicable at the time of this compensation record. Captured as a point-in-time snapshot to preserve historical accuracy. Used for compa-ratio calculation and pay equity analysis.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Pay Range; CUPA-HR; NACUBO Compensation Administration

attributes.name: previous_salary_amount
attributes.description: The employee's base salary or annualized rate immediately prior to this compensation change event. Captured as a point-in-time snapshot to enable change analysis without requiring a self-join on the history table. Used for pay equity and audit reporting.
attributes.references: Workday HCM; CUPA-HR; NACUBO Compensation Administration

attributes.name: range_penetration
attributes.description: Measures where the employee's salary falls within the pay grade range, expressed as a decimal between 0 and 1 (e.g., 0.0 = at minimum, 0.5 = at midpoint, 1.0 = at maximum). Calculated as (salary - range_minimum) / (range_maximum - range_minimum). Used for salary administration and equity reviews.
attributes.references: CUPA-HR Salary Administration; NACUBO Compensation Best Practices

attributes.name: salary_change_amount
attributes.description: The net dollar change in base salary resulting from this compensation event (new salary minus previous salary). Positive values indicate increases; negative values indicate decreases. Used for compensation change reporting and budget impact analysis.

attributes.name: salary_change_percent
attributes.description: The percentage change in base salary resulting from this compensation event, expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.04 = 4% increase). Used for compensation equity analysis, merit cycle reporting, and CUPA-HR benchmarking.
attributes.references: CUPA-HR; Workday HCM; NACUBO Compensation Administration

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this compensation record was last modified in the data platform. Used for incremental data processing, change detection, and audit trail maintenance in the Databricks Silver layer.
attributes.references: Workday HCM; NACUBO Data Governance; Databricks Lakehouse Silver Layer Standards

products.name: benefit_plan
products.description: Catalog of institutional benefit offerings including health insurance plans, dental, vision, life insurance, disability, retirement (403b/457b), tuition waiver, and flexible spending accounts. Tracks plan name, plan type, carrier, coverage tiers, employee/employer contribution rates, eligibility rules, and open enrollment periods. Sourced from Workday HCM Benefit Plan configuration.

attributes.name: benefit_plan_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the benefit plan record in the institutional data lakehouse. Primary key for the benefit_plan entity.

attributes.name: aca_metal_tier
attributes.description: ACA actuarial value metal tier classification for health plans (Bronze, Silver, Gold, Platinum, Catastrophic). Required for ACA Section 6056 employer reporting (IRS Forms 1094-C/1095-C) and minimum value determination.
attributes.references: ACA Section 1302; IRS Forms 1094-C/1095-C; 45 CFR Part 156 Actuarial Value

attributes.name: annual_deductible_family
attributes.description: Annual deductible amount for family coverage under this health plan. The aggregate amount the family must pay before the plan covers costs. Expressed in USD.
attributes.references: IRS Publication 969; ACA Section 1302; Workday HCM Benefit Plan Design

attributes.name: annual_deductible_individual
attributes.description: Annual deductible amount for individual coverage under this health plan. The amount an employee must pay out-of-pocket before the plan begins paying. Used in plan comparison tools and benefits counseling. Expressed in USD.
attributes.references: IRS Publication 969 HDHP Minimum Deductible; ACA Section 1302; Workday HCM Benefit Plan Design

attributes.name: carrier_name
attributes.description: Name of the insurance carrier, financial institution, or third-party administrator (TPA) underwriting or administering this benefit plan (e.g., 'Blue Cross Blue Shield', 'TIAA', 'Fidelity Investments', 'Delta Dental', 'VSP Vision Care').
attributes.references: Workday HCM Benefit Provider Configuration; ERISA Plan Document; State Insurance Regulations

attributes.name: carrier_plan_code
attributes.description: The carrier's or administrator's own identifier for this plan as used in EDI 834 enrollment transactions, carrier invoices, and claims adjudication. Required for electronic data interchange with benefit carriers.
attributes.references: ANSI X12 EDI 834 Benefit Enrollment Transaction; Workday HCM Benefit Provider Plan ID

attributes.name: cobra_eligible_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this benefit plan is subject to COBRA continuation coverage requirements under 29 USC 1161. Health, dental, and vision plans at institutions with 20+ employees are typically COBRA-eligible.
attributes.references: COBRA (29 USC 1161-1168); IRS Notice 2004-2; DOL COBRA Regulations

attributes.name: contribution_frequency
attributes.description: Frequency at which employee and employer contributions are applied. Must align with the institution's payroll cycle configuration in Workday HCM to ensure accurate deduction processing.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Payroll Deduction Schedule; IRS Publication 15

attributes.name: coverage_tier
attributes.description: Coverage tier defining the scope of dependents included under this plan enrollment option. Drives premium calculation and payroll deduction amounts. Standard tiers align with IRS dependent coverage rules.
attributes.references: IRS Section 152 Dependent Definition; ACA Section 1001; Workday HCM Coverage Target

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the benefit plan record was first created in the institutional data lakehouse, sourced from Workday HCM. Used for data lineage, audit trail, and Silver layer ingestion tracking.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Audit Trail; FERPA Data Governance; Institutional Data Governance Policy

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date on which the benefit plan becomes active and available for employee enrollment. Marks the start of the plan's binding coverage period. Used in open enrollment processing and ACA compliance reporting.
attributes.references: ERISA Section 102; ACA Section 1251; Workday HCM Benefit Plan Effective Date

attributes.name: eligibility_employee_class
attributes.description: Employee classification(s) eligible to enroll in this benefit plan (e.g., 'Full-Time Faculty', 'Staff FTE >= 0.75', 'Adjunct Faculty', 'Graduate Assistants'). Drives Workday HCM eligibility rule configuration and open enrollment targeting. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: full_time_faculty|part_time_faculty|full_time_staff|part_time_staff|graduate_assistant|adjunct|postdoctoral|executive — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: ERISA Section 410 Minimum Participation; ACA Section 4980H FTE Definition; Workday HCM Eligibility Rule; CUPA-HR Employee Classification

attributes.name: eligibility_fte_minimum
attributes.description: Minimum Full-Time Equivalent (FTE) percentage required for an employee to be eligible for this benefit plan (e.g., 0.75 = 75% FTE). Aligns with ACA employer shared responsibility rules for applicable large employers and institutional HR policy.
attributes.references: ACA Section 4980H; IRS Section 4980H(c)(4) FTE Definition; Workday HCM Eligibility Rule; CUPA-HR FTE Standards

attributes.name: employee_contribution_amount
attributes.description: Per-pay-period dollar amount deducted from the employee's paycheck for this benefit plan and coverage tier. Used in payroll processing, total compensation statements, and CUPA-HR benchmarking. Expressed in USD.
attributes.references: ERISA Section 402; IRS Section 125 Cafeteria Plan; Workday HCM Benefit Rate Table; NACUBO Financial Reporting

attributes.name: employer_contribution_amount
attributes.description: Per-pay-period dollar amount contributed by the institution toward this benefit plan and coverage tier. Represents the institutional cost of benefits and is used in total compensation reporting, budget planning, and NACUBO benchmarking. Expressed in USD.
attributes.references: ERISA Section 402; IRS Section 106; Workday HCM Benefit Rate Table; NACUBO Financial Reporting

attributes.name: employer_match_cap_rate
attributes.description: Maximum percentage of employee compensation up to which the employer will match retirement contributions, expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.06 = match applies up to 6% of salary). Null for non-retirement plans or plans without a match cap.
attributes.references: ERISA Section 401; IRS Section 403(b); Workday HCM Retirement Savings Plan Configuration

attributes.name: employer_match_rate
attributes.description: Employer matching contribution rate for retirement plans (403b/457b), expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.05 = 5% match). Represents the institutional commitment to employee retirement savings. Used in total compensation modeling and CUPA-HR benchmarking. Null for non-retirement plans.
attributes.references: ERISA Section 401; IRS Section 403(b); Workday HCM Retirement Savings Plan; CUPA-HR Benefits Survey

attributes.name: hsa_eligible_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this health plan qualifies as a High Deductible Health Plan (HDHP) under IRS Section 223, making enrolled employees eligible to contribute to a Health Savings Account (HSA). Critical for FSA/HSA compatibility rules.
attributes.references: IRS Section 223; IRS Publication 969; IRS Revenue Procedure for HDHP Thresholds

attributes.name: irs_plan_type_code
attributes.description: IRS-defined plan type code used on Form 5500 and Form 1095-C Line 14 to classify the benefit plan for federal tax and ERISA reporting purposes (e.g., '1A', '1B', '1C', '1D', '1E' for ACA offer codes; '3C' for self-insured). Required for ACA employer reporting.
attributes.references: IRS Form 5500 Schedule A; IRS Form 1095-C Line 14 Codes; ERISA Section 104

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the benefit plan record was most recently updated in the source system (Workday HCM) or the data lakehouse. Supports incremental ETL processing, change data capture, and audit compliance.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Audit Trail; Institutional Data Governance Policy; ERISA Record Retention Requirements

attributes.name: minimum_essential_coverage_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this plan qualifies as Minimum Essential Coverage (MEC) under ACA Section 5000A. Required for IRS Form 1095-C reporting and employer shared responsibility penalty avoidance.
attributes.references: ACA Section 5000A; IRS Section 4980H; IRS Form 1095-C Line 14

attributes.name: minimum_value_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this health plan meets the ACA minimum value standard (covers at least 60% of total allowed costs). Required for employer shared responsibility compliance under ACA Section 4980H and IRS Form 1095-C Line 14 coding.
attributes.references: ACA Section 36B; IRS Section 4980H; IRS Form 1095-C Instructions

attributes.name: network_type
attributes.description: Indicates whether this plan provides in-network only, out-of-network, or both in-network and out-of-network coverage. Relevant for health, dental, and vision plans. Drives employee cost-sharing and plan comparison analytics.
attributes.references: ACA Section 1302 Essential Health Benefits; Workday HCM Benefit Plan Design; NCQA Network Adequacy Standards

attributes.name: open_enrollment_end_date
attributes.description: Last date of the annual open enrollment window. Elections not submitted by this date default to prior-year elections or waiver per institutional policy.
attributes.references: ACA Section 1311; ERISA Section 101; Workday HCM Open Enrollment Event

attributes.name: open_enrollment_start_date
attributes.description: First date of the annual open enrollment window during which eligible employees may elect, change, or waive this benefit plan. Drives HR communications, Workday enrollment task activation, and compliance deadlines.
attributes.references: ACA Section 1311; ERISA Section 101; Workday HCM Open Enrollment Event

attributes.name: out_of_pocket_max_family
attributes.description: Maximum annual out-of-pocket cost for family coverage under this plan. Expressed in USD. ACA-mandated limit for in-network essential health benefits.

attributes.name: out_of_pocket_max_individual
attributes.description: Maximum annual out-of-pocket cost for an individual enrollee under this plan. After this limit is reached, the plan covers 100% of covered services. ACA-mandated limit applies to in-network essential health benefits. Expressed in USD.

attributes.name: plan_code
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric code uniquely identifying the benefit plan within Workday HCM and used in IPEDS, CUPA-HR, and institutional reporting. Serves as the business-facing identifier across HR systems and carrier interfaces.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Benefit Plan Configuration; CUPA-HR Reporting Standards

attributes.name: plan_document_url
attributes.description: URL to the official Summary Plan Description (SPD) or plan document as required by ERISA Section 102. Provides employees access to plan terms, coverage details, and claims procedures. Must be maintained and distributed within ERISA-mandated timeframes.
attributes.references: ERISA Section 102 Summary Plan Description; DOL 29 CFR 2520.102-3; Workday HCM Benefit Plan Document

attributes.name: plan_name
attributes.description: Full descriptive name of the benefit plan as displayed to employees during open enrollment and in the employee self-service portal (e.g., 'Blue Cross PPO Gold', 'TIAA 403(b) Retirement Plan', 'Delta Dental Premier').
attributes.references: Workday HCM Benefit Plan Configuration; ERISA Plan Document Requirements

attributes.name: plan_status
