Critical for sourcing effectiveness analytics and cost-per-hire reporting. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: job_board|employee_referral|direct|agency|career_fair|social_media|internal_transfer — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: source_detail
attributes.description: Specific source name within the source channel (e.g., 'Indeed', 'LinkedIn', 'HigherEdJobs', 'Chronicle of Higher Education', employee name for referrals). Enables granular sourcing ROI analysis.

attributes.name: state_province
attributes.description: State or province of residence for the applicant. Used in geographic sourcing analytics, relocation eligibility assessment, and OFCCP compliance reporting.

attributes.name: veteran_status
attributes.description: Applicant's self-identified veteran status per VEVRAA (Vietnam Era Veterans' Readjustment Assistance Act) categories. Required for federal contractor OFCCP compliance reporting and veteran hiring benchmarks.

attributes.name: work_authorization_status
attributes.description: Indicates whether the applicant is legally authorized to work in the country of the position without employer sponsorship. Used for I-9 eligibility screening and visa sponsorship decision tracking.
attributes.references: USCIS I-9 Employment Eligibility Verification; Immigration Reform and Control Act (IRCA)

attributes.name: workday_candidate_reference
attributes.description: The native candidate identifier assigned by Workday HCM Recruiting. Used to cross-reference records back to the system of record for reconciliation and integration purposes.

attributes.name: years_of_experience
attributes.description: Total years of relevant professional work experience as self-reported by the applicant. Used for minimum qualification screening and compensation band placement during offer stage.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Recruiting; CUPA-HR Compensation Benchmarking

products.name: performance_review
products.description: Annual or mid-cycle performance evaluation and professional development record for a staff employee. Captures review period, review type (annual, probationary, mid-year), overall rating, goal achievement rating, competency ratings, reviewer identity, employee self-assessment flag, calibration status, and final approval date. Also tracks training and professional development completions including training type (mandatory compliance, professional development, safety, DEI), delivery method, completion date, credit hours, pass/fail status, certificate issued flag, and expiration date for recurring compliance trainings (Title IX, FERPA, HIPAA, cybersecurity). Sourced from Workday HCM Talent and Performance. Supports merit increase decisions, talent development planning, and compliance training verification.

attributes.name: performance_review_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each performance review record in the Workday HCM Talent and Performance module. Primary key for the performance_review data product.

attributes.name: org_unit_id
attributes.description: Reference to the organizational department to which the employee belongs at the time of the review, used for departmental performance reporting.

attributes.name: position_id
attributes.description: Reference to the position held by the employee at the time of the review, supporting position control and workforce planning analysis.

attributes.name: primary_performance_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the staff employee who is the subject of this performance review. Links to the employee master record in Workday HCM.

attributes.name: reviewer_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the manager or supervisor who authored and submitted the performance review. Typically the direct supervisor in the Workday HCM reporting hierarchy.

attributes.name: training_record_id
attributes.description: FK to hr.training_record

attributes.name: calibrated_overall_rating
attributes.description: The overall performance rating after calibration review, which may differ from the manager's initial rating. Represents the final agreed-upon rating used for merit decisions and talent planning.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Talent Management; CUPA-HR Performance Management Standards

attributes.name: calibration_status
attributes.description: Indicates the current state of the rating calibration process for this review. Calibration sessions ensure consistency and fairness of ratings across departments and divisions before final approval.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Talent Management; CUPA-HR Performance Management Standards

attributes.name: competency_rating
attributes.description: Aggregate rating reflecting the employee's demonstration of institutional core competencies (e.g., collaboration, communication, service excellence, DEI commitment) as evaluated during the review period.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Talent Management; CUPA-HR Competency Frameworks

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when the performance review record was first created in the Workday HCM system and ingested into the Silver Layer of the Databricks Lakehouse. Supports audit trail and data lineage.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Talent Management; FERPA (Family Educational Rights and Privacy Act)

attributes.name: development_plan_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether a formal individual development plan (IDP) is required as an outcome of this performance review, typically triggered by a needs_improvement or unsatisfactory rating.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Talent Management; CUPA-HR Professional Development Standards

attributes.name: due_date
attributes.description: The institutional deadline by which the performance review must be completed and submitted in Workday HCM. Used for compliance tracking and HR reporting on timely completion rates.

attributes.name: employee_acknowledged_date
attributes.description: The date on which the employee electronically acknowledged receipt and review of their performance evaluation in Workday HCM. Required for FERPA-adjacent employee record integrity and HR audit trails.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Talent Management; FERPA (Family Educational Rights and Privacy Act)

attributes.name: employee_comments
attributes.description: Free-text narrative provided by the employee in their self-assessment, capturing their own perspective on accomplishments, challenges, and development goals. Confidential HR record.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Talent Management; FERPA (Family Educational Rights and Privacy Act)

attributes.name: final_approval_date
attributes.description: The date on which the performance review received final HR or senior leadership approval, marking the review as officially closed and eligible to inform merit increase decisions.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Talent Management; CUPA-HR Performance Management Standards

attributes.name: fte_at_review
attributes.description: The employee's Full-Time Equivalent (FTE) value at the time of the performance review. Supports workforce planning analytics and ensures part-time employees are evaluated proportionally.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Human Capital Management; IPEDS (Integrated Postsecondary Education Data System) FTE Reporting

attributes.name: goal_achievement_rating
attributes.description: Rating reflecting the degree to which the employee achieved their individual performance goals set at the beginning of the review period. Distinct from competency ratings; focuses on measurable outcomes and KPI attainment.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Talent Management; CUPA-HR Performance Management Standards

attributes.name: goals_count
attributes.description: The total number of individual performance goals formally documented and evaluated in this review cycle. Supports workforce analytics on goal-setting practices and alignment with institutional KPIs.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Talent Management; CUPA-HR Performance Management Standards

attributes.name: goals_met_count
attributes.description: The number of individual performance goals that the employee fully achieved during the review period. Used in conjunction with goals_count to assess goal attainment rates.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Talent Management; CUPA-HR Performance Management Standards

attributes.name: leadership_rating
attributes.description: Rating specific to leadership behaviors and people management competencies, applicable to employees in supervisory or managerial roles. Marked not_applicable for individual contributors.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Talent Management; CUPA-HR Leadership Competency Standards

attributes.name: merit_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether the employee is eligible for a merit-based salary increase based on their performance review outcome. Eligibility may be restricted by budget, employment type, or rating threshold policies.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Compensation; CUPA-HR Compensation Benchmarking

attributes.name: merit_increase_pct
attributes.description: The percentage salary increase recommended or approved based on the performance review outcome. Confidential compensation data used in salary administration and CUPA-HR benchmarking analysis.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Compensation; CUPA-HR Compensation Benchmarking; NACUBO Compensation Standards

attributes.name: overall_rating
attributes.description: The summary performance rating assigned to the employee for the review period, drawn from the institution's standardized rating scale in Workday HCM. Directly informs merit increase eligibility and talent development planning.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Talent Management; CUPA-HR Performance Management Standards

attributes.name: overall_rating_numeric
attributes.description: Numeric representation of the overall performance rating on a standardized scale (e.g., 1.00–5.00) as configured in Workday HCM. Enables quantitative analytics, benchmarking, and merit matrix calculations.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Talent Management; CUPA-HR Performance Management Standards

attributes.name: pip_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether a formal Performance Improvement Plan (PIP) has been initiated as a result of this review. A PIP is a structured corrective action document for employees rated unsatisfactory.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Talent Management; CUPA-HR Employee Relations Standards

attributes.name: review_comments
attributes.description: Free-text narrative comments provided by the reviewing manager summarizing the employee's performance, accomplishments, and areas for development during the review period. Confidential HR record.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Talent Management; FERPA (Family Educational Rights and Privacy Act)

attributes.name: review_period_end_date
attributes.description: The last day of the performance evaluation period covered by this review. Together with review_period_start_date, defines the full evaluation window.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Talent Management; CUPA-HR Performance Management Standards

attributes.name: review_period_start_date
attributes.description: The first day of the performance evaluation period covered by this review. Defines the beginning of the window during which the employee's performance is assessed.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Talent Management; CUPA-HR Performance Management Standards

attributes.name: review_status
attributes.description: Current workflow state of the performance review in Workday HCM. Tracks progression from initial draft through employee acknowledgment, manager submission, HR approval, and final completion. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: draft|in_progress|employee_acknowledged|manager_submitted|hr_approved|completed|cancelled — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: review_type
attributes.description: Classification of the performance review cycle. Annual reviews support merit decisions; probationary reviews assess new hires within their introductory period; mid-year reviews provide interim feedback; project and off-cycle reviews address specific circumstances.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Talent Management; CUPA-HR Performance Management Standards

attributes.name: self_assessment_completed
attributes.description: Indicates whether the employee completed a self-assessment as part of the performance review process in Workday HCM. Self-assessments are a standard component of annual and mid-year review cycles.

attributes.name: self_assessment_date
attributes.description: The date on which the employee submitted their self-assessment in Workday HCM. Used to track employee engagement in the review process and measure timeliness.

attributes.name: submitted_date
attributes.description: The date on which the manager formally submitted the completed performance review in Workday HCM. Used to measure on-time submission compliance against the due date.

attributes.name: talent_segment
attributes.description: Confidential talent classification assigned during calibration, used for succession planning and targeted development investment. Supports the institution's talent development and retention strategy.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Talent Management; CUPA-HR Talent Development Frameworks

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp of the most recent update to the performance review record in the source system or the Silver Layer. Used for incremental ETL processing and change data capture.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Talent Management; ETL (Extract Transform Load) Data Pipeline Standards

attributes.name: workday_review_reference
attributes.description: The native business identifier assigned by Workday HCM to this performance review event. Used for cross-system traceability and reconciliation with the source system of record.

products.name: grievance
products.description: Formal employee grievance or disciplinary action record tracking complaints, investigations, and resolutions related to workplace conduct, policy violations, harassment, discrimination, or labor relations. Captures grievance type, filing date, parties involved, investigation status, findings, resolution type, appeal status, and closure date. Supports HR compliance, Title VII, ADA, and labor relations reporting. Distinct from Title IX cases owned by the compliance domain.

attributes.name: grievance_id
attributes.description: Unique system-generated identifier for the employee grievance or disciplinary action record. Primary key for the grievance data product.

attributes.name: grievance_employee_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the employee who filed the grievance or is the subject of the disciplinary action. Links to the HR employee master record.
attributes.references: Workday HCM - Worker Record; FERPA (inapplicable — employee data governed by NLRA and Title VII)

attributes.name: grievance_investigator_employee_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the HR staff member, compliance officer, or external investigator assigned to conduct the formal investigation of the grievance.
attributes.references: Workday HCM - Employee Relations Module; EEOC Guidance on Workplace Investigations

attributes.name: grievance_respondent_employee_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the employee named as the respondent or subject of the grievance (e.g., the accused party in a harassment or misconduct complaint). May differ from the filing employee.
attributes.references: Workday HCM - Employee Relations Module; Title VII of the Civil Rights Act of 1964

attributes.name: org_unit_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the organizational department in which the grievance or disciplinary matter originated. Used for workforce analytics and compliance reporting.
attributes.references: Workday HCM - Organizational Hierarchy; CUPA-HR Workforce Reporting

attributes.name: ada_accommodation_involved
attributes.business_glossary_term: Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) Accommodation Involved Indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether the grievance involves a dispute related to a requested or denied Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) reasonable accommodation.
attributes.references: Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA); ADAAA; EEOC ADA Guidance

attributes.name: appeal_decision_date
attributes.description: The date on which the appeal review body issued its final decision. Null if appeal is pending or not filed.
attributes.references: NLRA; Institutional HR Policy; AAA Arbitration Rules

attributes.name: appeal_filed_date
attributes.description: The date on which a formal appeal of the grievance resolution was submitted. Null if no appeal was filed.
attributes.references: NLRA; Institutional HR Policy; AAA Arbitration Rules

attributes.name: appeal_status
attributes.description: Current status of any appeal filed by the grievant or respondent following the initial resolution. Tracks whether the case has been escalated through institutional or arbitration channels.
attributes.references: NLRA; Institutional HR Policy; AAA Arbitration Rules

attributes.name: closure_date
attributes.description: The date on which the grievance case was fully closed, including completion of any corrective actions, appeals, or follow-up requirements. Distinct from resolution_date when appeals extend the case.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when the grievance record was first created in the system. Serves as the audit trail creation marker for data lineage and compliance purposes.
attributes.references: Workday HCM - Audit Trail; Institutional Data Governance Policy

attributes.name: disciplinary_action_type
attributes.description: The specific type of disciplinary action imposed on the respondent employee as a result of the grievance investigation findings. Distinct from resolution_type which captures the broader case outcome. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Workday HCM - Disciplinary Action Module; Institutional HR Policy; CUPA-HR

attributes.name: eeoc_charge_filed
attributes.business_glossary_term: Equal Employment Opportunity Commission (EEOC) Charge Filed Indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether the grievant has filed or expressed intent to file a formal charge with the Equal Employment Opportunity Commission (EEOC) in connection with this matter. Triggers legal hold and counsel notification.
attributes.references: Title VII of the Civil Rights Act of 1964; EEOC Charge Filing Procedures; ADA; ADEA

attributes.name: eeoc_charge_number
attributes.business_glossary_term: Equal Employment Opportunity Commission (EEOC) Charge Number
attributes.description: The official charge number assigned by the EEOC if a formal charge has been filed. Used to cross-reference internal HR records with external regulatory proceedings.
attributes.references: Title VII of the Civil Rights Act of 1964; EEOC Charge Filing Procedures

attributes.name: external_counsel_engaged
attributes.description: Indicates whether external legal counsel has been engaged to advise on or represent the institution in connection with this grievance matter.
attributes.references: Institutional Legal Policy; ABA Model Rules of Professional Conduct

attributes.name: filing_date
attributes.description: The date on which the grievance or complaint was formally filed by the employee or initiated by HR. Serves as the principal business event date for timeline and statute-of-limitations tracking.
attributes.references: NLRA; Title VII of the Civil Rights Act of 1964; Institutional HR Policy; EEOC Charge Filing Deadlines

attributes.name: filing_method
attributes.description: The channel or method through which the grievance was submitted (e.g., written form, online HR portal, email, verbal report). Relevant for procedural compliance and documentation standards.

attributes.name: finding_summary
attributes.description: Narrative summary of the investigation findings, documenting key facts established, evidence reviewed, and the basis for the finding determination. Restricted to authorized HR and legal personnel.
attributes.references: EEOC Guidance; Institutional HR Policy; FERPA (if student-related); Title VII

attributes.name: fmla_related
attributes.business_glossary_term: Family and Medical Leave Act (FMLA) Related Indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether the grievance involves a dispute related to Family and Medical Leave Act (FMLA) rights, including denial of leave, interference, or retaliation for taking FMLA leave.
attributes.references: Family and Medical Leave Act (FMLA); U.S. Department of Labor FMLA Regulations

attributes.name: grievance_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the grievance record. Tracks progression from initial filing through investigation, resolution, and closure. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: filed|under_investigation|pending_review|resolved|closed|appealed|withdrawn — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Workday HCM - Employee Relations Module; Institutional HR Policy

attributes.name: grievance_type
attributes.description: Classification of the nature of the grievance or disciplinary matter. Drives routing, investigation procedures, and regulatory reporting obligations. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: harassment|discrimination|retaliation|policy_violation|workplace_conduct|labor_relations|wage_dispute|other — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Title VII of the Civil Rights Act of 1964; ADA; ADEA; NLRA; Institutional HR Policy

attributes.name: hr_case_number
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric case reference number assigned by the HR department or case management system for tracking and correspondence. Format: GRV-YYYY-NNNNNN.
attributes.references: Workday HCM - Employee Relations Case Management; Institutional HR Policy

attributes.name: incident_date
attributes.description: The date on which the underlying incident, policy violation, or conduct giving rise to the grievance allegedly occurred. May predate the filing date.
attributes.references: EEOC Charge Filing Deadlines; Title VII; Institutional HR Policy

attributes.name: investigation_close_date
attributes.description: The date on which the formal investigation was concluded and findings were documented. Used to calculate investigation duration and compliance with regulatory timelines.
attributes.references: EEOC Guidance on Workplace Investigations; Institutional HR Policy

attributes.name: investigation_finding
attributes.description: The formal outcome determination of the investigation indicating whether the allegations were substantiated, unsubstantiated, or inconclusive. Drives resolution and disciplinary action decisions.
attributes.references: EEOC Guidance; Title VII; ADA; Institutional HR Policy

attributes.name: investigation_start_date
attributes.description: The date on which the formal investigation into the grievance was initiated. Used to measure investigation duration and compliance with institutional response-time policies.
attributes.references: EEOC Guidance on Workplace Investigations; Institutional HR Policy

attributes.name: is_anonymous
attributes.description: Indicates whether the grievance was filed anonymously. Anonymous filings may limit the scope of investigation and available remedies.
attributes.references: Institutional HR Policy; EEOC Guidance on Anonymous Complaints

attributes.name: is_union_grievance
attributes.description: Indicates whether the grievance is filed under a collective bargaining agreement (CBA) and involves union representation. Triggers specific procedural timelines and arbitration rights under the NLRA.
attributes.references: National Labor Relations Act (NLRA); Collective Bargaining Agreement (CBA)

attributes.name: legal_hold_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a legal hold has been placed on records associated with this grievance due to pending or anticipated litigation, EEOC proceedings, or regulatory inquiry. Prevents record destruction.
attributes.references: Federal Rules of Civil Procedure; Institutional Records Retention Policy; EEOC

attributes.name: mediation_outcome
attributes.description: The outcome of the mediation process if mediation was conducted. Indicates whether the parties reached a settlement agreement through mediation.
attributes.references: EEOC Mediation Program; AAA Mediation Rules; Institutional HR Policy

attributes.name: mediation_requested
attributes.description: Indicates whether formal mediation was requested by either party as an alternative dispute resolution mechanism prior to or in lieu of a full investigation.
attributes.references: EEOC Mediation Program; NLRA; Institutional HR Policy; AAA Mediation Rules

attributes.name: priority_level
attributes.description: Assigned urgency level of the grievance case, used to prioritize investigator workload and escalation timelines. Critical cases may involve imminent safety or legal risk.

attributes.name: protected_class_basis
attributes.description: The protected class characteristic(s) alleged as the basis for discrimination or harassment in the grievance. Applicable for EEO-related grievances. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: race|color|national_origin|sex|religion|age|disability|pregnancy|genetic_information|veteran_status|not_applicable|other — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Title VII of the Civil Rights Act of 1964; ADA; ADEA; GINA; VEVRAA; Executive Order 11246

attributes.name: record_retention_date
attributes.description: The date after which the grievance record may be eligible for destruction per institutional records retention policy and applicable regulatory requirements. Calculated from closure date plus required retention period.
attributes.references: Institutional Records Retention Policy; EEOC Record Retention Requirements (1 year minimum); NLRA; Title VII

attributes.name: resolution_date
attributes.description: The date on which the grievance was formally resolved and a resolution determination was communicated to the involved parties.

attributes.name: resolution_type
attributes.description: The type of resolution or corrective action taken as a result of the grievance investigation. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: no_action|verbal_warning|written_warning|suspension|termination|mediation|settlement|training_required|policy_change|other — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Title VII; ADA; NLRA; Institutional HR Policy; CUPA-HR

attributes.name: settlement_amount
attributes.description: Monetary settlement amount paid to the grievant as part of the resolution, if applicable. Null if no monetary settlement was reached. Reported in USD.
attributes.references: Institutional Finance Policy; NACUBO Financial Reporting; EEOC Settlement Guidance

attributes.name: subtype
attributes.description: Secondary classification providing more granular categorization within the grievance type (e.g., 'sexual harassment' under harassment, 'racial discrimination' under discrimination, 'FMLA retaliation' under retaliation). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Title VII of the Civil Rights Act of 1964; ADA; ADEA; FMLA; Institutional HR Policy

attributes.name: suspension_days
attributes.description: Number of calendar days of suspension imposed on the respondent employee as part of the disciplinary action. Applicable only when disciplinary_action_type includes a suspension.

attributes.name: union_contract_article
attributes.description: The specific article or section of the collective bargaining agreement (CBA) cited in the union grievance. Applicable only when is_union_grievance is true.
attributes.references: National Labor Relations Act (NLRA); Collective Bargaining Agreement (CBA)

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when the grievance record was most recently modified. Used for change tracking, data synchronization, and audit compliance.
attributes.references: Workday HCM - Audit Trail; Institutional Data Governance Policy

attributes.name: workday_case_reference
attributes.business_glossary_term: Workday Human Capital Management (HCM) Case ID
attributes.description: The source system case identifier from Workday HCM Employee Relations module. Used for cross-system reconciliation and audit trail between the data lakehouse and the system of record.

products.name: time_entry
products.description: Transactional record of employee time worked including clock-in/clock-out timestamps, hours worked by earning code (regular, overtime, shift differential, on-call), work location, cost center allocation, supervisor approval status, and pay period assignment. Critical for non-exempt/hourly staff FLSA compliance, overtime calculation, and payroll input. Sourced from Workday HCM Time Tracking.

attributes.name: time_entry_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the time entry record. Primary key.

attributes.name: grant_account_id
attributes.description: Reference to the research grant or sponsored project funding this time entry. Required for grant-funded employee time tracking and effort reporting.

attributes.name: org_unit_id
attributes.description: Reference to the organizational department where the work was performed. Used for departmental labor reporting and workforce analytics.

attributes.name: pay_period_id
attributes.description: Reference to the pay period in which this time entry will be processed for payment. Links time entries to payroll cycles.

attributes.name: payroll_run_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific payroll run in which this time entry was processed for payment. Links time entries to payroll results.

attributes.name: position_id
attributes.description: Reference to the position under which the time was worked. Links to the position master record.

attributes.name: primary_time_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the employee who recorded this time entry. Links to the employee master record.

attributes.name: tertiary_time_approved_by_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the employee who approved this time entry. Provides audit trail for approval authority.

attributes.name: approval_status
attributes.description: Current approval state of the time entry. Tracks whether the supervisor has reviewed and approved the time for payroll processing.

attributes.name: approved_date
attributes.description: Date when the supervisor approved the time entry. Indicates readiness for payroll processing.

attributes.name: chartfield_string
attributes.description: Complete financial accounting string combining fund, department, account, program, and project codes. Used for detailed labor cost allocation in the general ledger.

attributes.name: clock_in_timestamp
attributes.description: Precise date and time when the employee clocked in or started work. Critical for FLSA compliance and overtime calculation.

attributes.name: clock_out_timestamp
attributes.description: Precise date and time when the employee clocked out or ended work. Used to calculate total hours worked.

attributes.name: cost_center_code
attributes.description: Financial accounting code identifying the cost center to which this time should be charged. Used for labor cost allocation and budgetary reporting.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this time entry record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage tracking.

attributes.name: earning_code
attributes.description: Classification code indicating the type of time worked. Examples include regular hours, overtime, shift differential, on-call, holiday pay, or compensatory time. Drives pay rate calculation in payroll.

attributes.name: earning_description
attributes.description: Human-readable description of the earning code. Provides context for the type of time worked.

attributes.name: employee_comments
attributes.description: Free-text notes or explanations provided by the employee regarding this time entry. May include justification for unusual hours or work circumstances.

attributes.name: entry_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the time entry in the approval and payroll workflow. Tracks progression from draft through approval to payment.

attributes.name: entry_type
attributes.description: Method by which the time entry was created. Distinguishes between clock-in/out, manual entry, system import, or adjustment/correction entries.

attributes.name: flsa_status
attributes.description: Classification of the employee position as exempt or non-exempt from FLSA overtime requirements. Determines overtime eligibility and timekeeping requirements.

attributes.name: fund_code
attributes.description: Financial fund code identifying the funding source for this labor. Critical for grant-funded positions and restricted fund compliance.

attributes.name: hours_worked
attributes.description: Total number of hours worked during this time entry period. Calculated from clock-in/out timestamps or manually entered. Used for payroll calculation.
attributes.references: Fair Labor Standards Act (FLSA) Hours Worked Definition

attributes.name: is_overtime_eligible
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this time entry is eligible for overtime compensation. Typically true for non-exempt employees working over 40 hours per week.

attributes.name: on_call_hours
attributes.description: Number of hours the employee was on-call and available for work. May be compensated at a different rate than active work hours.

attributes.name: overtime_hours
attributes.description: Number of hours worked beyond the standard workweek threshold (typically 40 hours). Subject to overtime premium pay under FLSA for non-exempt employees.

attributes.name: payroll_processed_flag
attributes.description: Indicator showing whether this time entry has been processed through payroll and included in a paycheck. Prevents duplicate payment processing.

attributes.name: regular_hours
attributes.description: Number of hours worked at the standard pay rate. Typically up to 40 hours per week for non-exempt employees under FLSA.
attributes.references: Fair Labor Standards Act (FLSA) Regular Rate Definition

attributes.name: rejection_reason
attributes.description: Explanation provided by the supervisor when rejecting a time entry. Helps employee understand what corrections are needed.

attributes.name: shift_differential_hours
attributes.description: Number of hours worked during shifts that qualify for differential pay (e.g., evening, night, weekend shifts). Eligible for additional compensation per institutional policy.

attributes.name: submitted_date
attributes.description: Date when the employee submitted the time entry for supervisor approval. Used to track timeliness of time entry submission.

attributes.name: supervisor_comments
attributes.description: Free-text notes or feedback provided by the supervisor during the approval process. May include approval rationale or correction instructions.

attributes.name: time_entry_number
attributes.description: Human-readable business identifier for the time entry. May be used for employee and supervisor reference.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this time entry record was last modified. Tracks the most recent change for audit and reconciliation purposes.

attributes.name: work_date
attributes.description: The calendar date on which the work was performed. Used for pay period assignment and labor distribution reporting.
attributes.references: Fair Labor Standards Act (FLSA) Timekeeping Requirements

attributes.name: work_location_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the physical location where the work was performed. Used for labor distribution, facilities management, and multi-campus reporting.

attributes.name: work_location_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name of the work location. Provides context for where the employee performed work.

attributes.name: workday_time_entry_reference
attributes.description: External unique identifier from Workday HCM Time Tracking system. Used for source system reconciliation and audit trail.

attributes.name: adjusted_time_entry_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing FK on time_entry (adjusted_time_entry_id)

products.name: onboarding_task
products.description: Tracks individual onboarding tasks and milestones for new hires including I-9 verification, background check completion, system access provisioning, orientation attendance, and policy acknowledgments

attributes.name: onboarding_task_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the onboarding task record. Primary key for the onboarding task entity.

attributes.name: enterprise_application_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to technology.enterprise_application. Business justification: IT onboarding tasks in higher-ed explicitly provision access to specific enterprise applications (Banner, Workday, Canvas, email). Links HR onboarding workflows to target systems for automated provisi

attributes.name: org_unit_id
attributes.description: Reference to the department the new hire is joining. Used for department-specific onboarding tasks and reporting.

attributes.name: position_id
attributes.description: Reference to the position the employee is being onboarded into. Links to the position control record.

attributes.name: primary_onboarding_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the employee undergoing onboarding. Links to the employee master record.

attributes.name: quaternary_onboarding_approved_by_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the employee who approved the task completion. Applicable only when requires_approval is true.

attributes.name: quinary_onboarding_waived_by_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the HR or management employee who authorized the waiver. Required for audit trail.

attributes.name: staffing_event_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent staffing event that triggered this onboarding task. Links to the hire or rehire event.

attributes.name: tertiary_onboarding_completed_by_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the employee who marked the task as completed. May differ from assigned_to_employee_id in cases of delegation or escalation.

attributes.name: access_level
attributes.description: Level or type of access being granted (e.g., Read-Only, Standard User, Administrator, Faculty, Staff). Used for role-based access control (RBAC).
attributes.references: Information Technology Role-Based Access Control (RBAC) Standards

attributes.name: approved_date
attributes.description: Date when the task completion was approved. Marks final closure for tasks requiring approval.

attributes.name: assigned_date
attributes.description: Date when the task was assigned to the responsible party. Marks the start of the task lifecycle.

attributes.name: assigned_to_role
attributes.description: Functional role responsible for the task. Used for routing and escalation when specific employee assignment is not yet determined. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: new_hire|hr_specialist|it_administrator|hiring_manager|payroll_specialist|benefits_coordinator|facilities_manager|training_coordinator — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: certificate_issued_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a completion certificate was issued for the training. Required for certain compliance trainings.
attributes.references: Human Resources Training and Development Standards

attributes.name: completed_date
attributes.description: Date when the task was marked as completed. Used for compliance reporting and onboarding cycle time analysis.

attributes.name: compliance_framework
attributes.description: Name of the regulatory framework or policy that mandates this task (e.g., IRCA, FERPA, Institutional Background Check Policy, Title IX Training Requirement).
attributes.references: U.S. Department of Education, Immigration Reform and Control Act (IRCA), Family Educational Rights and Privacy Act (FERPA)

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the onboarding task record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage.

attributes.name: document_received_date
attributes.description: Date when the required document was received and verified. Used for compliance reporting and audit trail.

attributes.name: document_received_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the required document has been received and verified. Critical for compliance tasks.

attributes.name: document_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether the task requires submission or verification of a document (e.g., I-9 supporting documents, degree verification, certifications).

attributes.name: document_type
attributes.description: Type of document required for task completion (e.g., I-9 List A Document, Degree Certificate, Professional License, Policy Acknowledgment Form).
attributes.references: Immigration Reform and Control Act (IRCA), Human Resources Document Classification Standards

attributes.name: due_date
attributes.description: Target completion date for the onboarding task. Critical for compliance tasks that must be completed by the first day of work or within regulatory timeframes.

attributes.name: is_compliance_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether the task is required for regulatory compliance (e.g., I-9 verification per Immigration Reform and Control Act, background checks per institutional policy).
attributes.references: Family Educational Rights and Privacy Act (FERPA), Immigration Reform and Control Act (IRCA)

attributes.name: is_mandatory
attributes.description: Indicates whether the task is required for all new hires or optional. Mandatory tasks block onboarding completion if not finished.

attributes.name: requires_approval
attributes.description: Indicates whether the task requires managerial or HR approval before being marked as complete.

attributes.name: started_date
attributes.description: Date when work on the task began. Indicates transition from assigned to in-progress status.

attributes.name: system_access_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether the task involves provisioning access to institutional systems (e.g., Banner, Workday, Canvas, email, network).

attributes.name: task_instructions
attributes.description: Detailed instructions for completing the task. May include links to forms, systems, or resources needed.

attributes.name: task_name
attributes.description: Descriptive name of the onboarding task (e.g., Complete I-9 Form, Background Check Verification, System Access Provisioning).

attributes.name: task_notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes about task progress, issues encountered, or special circumstances. Used for communication between HR, IT, and hiring managers.

attributes.name: task_number
attributes.description: Human-readable business identifier for the onboarding task. Used for tracking and reference in communications.

attributes.name: task_priority
attributes.description: Priority level of the task. Critical tasks (e.g., I-9, background check) must be completed before start date; others may have flexible timelines.

attributes.name: task_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the onboarding task. Tracks progress from assignment through completion. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: not_started|in_progress|pending_approval|completed|waived|cancelled|overdue — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Workday HCM Business Process Status Model

attributes.name: task_type
attributes.description: Category of the onboarding task. Classifies tasks by functional area to support workflow routing and reporting. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: compliance|administrative|system_access|orientation|training|documentation|benefits|payroll|equipment|facility_access — 10 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: training_completion_date
attributes.description: Date when the required training was completed. Used for compliance reporting and certification tracking.
attributes.references: Human Resources Training and Development Standards

attributes.name: training_module_name
attributes.description: Name of the training module or orientation session required (e.g., FERPA Compliance Training, Title IX Awareness, Campus Safety Orientation).

attributes.name: training_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether the task involves completion of a training module or orientation session (e.g., FERPA training, Title IX training, safety orientation).
attributes.references: Human Resources Training and Development Standards

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the onboarding task record was last modified. Used for audit trail and change tracking.

attributes.name: waived_date
attributes.description: Date when the task waiver was approved. Used for compliance reporting and audit trail.

attributes.name: waived_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the task was waived for this employee (e.g., rehire who already completed background check, transfer from another department).

attributes.name: waiver_reason
attributes.description: Explanation for why the task was waived. Required when waived_flag is true for audit and compliance purposes.

attributes.name: workday_task_reference
attributes.description: External identifier from Workday HCM system. Used for integration and reconciliation with source system.

attributes.name: prerequisite_onboarding_task_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing FK on onboarding_task (prerequisite_onboarding_task_id)

products.name: training_record
products.description: Records employee completion of required and elective training programs including safety training, harassment prevention, FERPA training, and professional development courses with certification tracking

attributes.name: training_record_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the training record. Primary key.

attributes.name: org_unit_id
attributes.description: Reference to the department or organizational unit to which the employee belonged at the time of training.

attributes.name: primary_training_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the employee who completed or is assigned the training.

attributes.name: training_program_id
attributes.description: Reference to the training program or course catalog entry.

attributes.name: attempts_count
attributes.description: Number of attempts the employee made to complete or pass the training.

attributes.name: certificate_issue_date
attributes.description: Date the training certificate was issued to the employee.

attributes.name: certificate_issued_flag
attributes.description: Indicator of whether a certificate of completion was issued to the employee.

attributes.name: certificate_number
attributes.description: Unique identifier or serial number of the issued training certificate.

attributes.name: completion_date
attributes.description: Date the employee successfully completed the training program.

attributes.name: compliance_framework
attributes.description: Name of the regulatory framework or policy that mandates this training such as Family Educational Rights and Privacy Act (FERPA), Occupational Safety and Health Administration (OSHA), or Title IX.
attributes.references: U.S. Department of Education Compliance Standards

attributes.name: compliance_requirement_flag
attributes.description: Indicator of whether this training is required for regulatory or institutional compliance.

attributes.name: contact_hours

attributes.name: cost_amount

attributes.name: created_timestamp

attributes.name: credit_hours

attributes.name: currency_code

attributes.name: delivery_method

attributes.name: due_date

attributes.name: employee_comments

attributes.name: enrollment_date

attributes.name: expiration_date

attributes.name: ferpa_training_flag

attributes.name: funding_source

attributes.name: instructor_name

attributes.name: passed_flag

attributes.name: passing_score

attributes.name: safety_training_flag
attributes.description: Indicator of whether this training covers workplace safety or Occupational Safety and Health Administration (OSHA) requirements.

attributes.name: score

attributes.name: start_date
attributes.description: Date the employee began the training program or course.

attributes.name: title_ix_training_flag
attributes.description: Indicator of whether this training covers Title IX sexual harassment and discrimination prevention.

attributes.name: training_category

attributes.name: training_location

attributes.name: training_provider
attributes.description: Name of the organization or vendor that provided the training program.

attributes.name: training_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the training record for this employee.

attributes.name: training_title
attributes.description: The full title or name of the training program or course.

attributes.name: training_type
attributes.description: Classification of the training program by requirement type.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this training record was last modified in the system.

attributes.name: waiver_granted_flag
attributes.description: Indicator of whether the employee was granted a waiver exempting them from completing this training.

attributes.name: waiver_reason

attributes.name: workday_training_reference

attributes.name: renewal_training_record_id

products.name: accrual_plan
products.description: Master reference table for accrual_plan. Referenced by accrual_plan_id.

attributes.name: accrual_plan_id
attributes.description: Primary key for accrual_plan

attributes.name: accrual_frequency
attributes.description: Frequency at which leave time is accrued under this plan (e.g., monthly, per pay period).

attributes.name: accrual_rate
attributes.description: Rate at which leave time accrues per accrual period, expressed in hours or days depending on unit of measure.

attributes.name: accrual_start_event
attributes.description: Event that triggers the start of accrual under this plan (e.g., hire date, eligibility date).

attributes.name: accrual_unit
attributes.description: Unit of measure for accrued leave time (hours or days).

attributes.name: advance_notice_days
attributes.description: Number of days advance notice required before taking leave under this plan. Zero if no advance notice required.

attributes.name: approval_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether supervisor or HR approval is required before leave under this plan can be taken.

attributes.name: carryover_allowed
attributes.description: Indicates whether unused accrued leave can be carried over to the next accrual period or fiscal year.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this accrual plan record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: description
attributes.description: Detailed description of the accrual plan including purpose, rules, and any special conditions.

attributes.name: documentation_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether supporting documentation (e.g., medical certificate) is required for leave requests under this plan.

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: Date when the accrual plan is no longer active. Null for open-ended plans.

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: Date when the accrual plan becomes active and available for employee assignment.

attributes.name: eligibility_criteria
attributes.description: Description of the employee eligibility requirements for this accrual plan (e.g., full-time staff, faculty with tenure).

attributes.name: employee_group_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the employee group or classification to which this accrual plan applies (e.g., staff, faculty, administrative).

attributes.name: fiscal_year_reset
attributes.description: Indicates whether accrual balances reset at the start of each fiscal year.

attributes.name: integration_code
attributes.description: External system integration code used to synchronize this accrual plan with payroll or HRIS systems (e.g., Workday HCM).

attributes.name: last_modified_by
attributes.description: Username or identifier of the user who last modified this accrual plan record.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this accrual plan record was last updated.

attributes.name: maximum_accrual_balance
attributes.description: Maximum amount of leave time that can be accrued under this plan. Null if no cap applies.

attributes.name: maximum_carryover_amount
attributes.description: Maximum amount of accrued leave that can be carried over to the next period if carryover is allowed. Null if no limit or carryover not allowed.

attributes.name: minimum_usage_increment
attributes.description: Minimum increment in which leave can be taken (e.g., 0.25 for quarter-hour increments, 1.0 for full-day increments).

attributes.name: negative_balance_allowed
attributes.description: Indicates whether employees can take leave in advance of accrual, resulting in a negative balance.

attributes.name: payout_on_termination
attributes.description: Indicates whether unused accrued leave is paid out to the employee upon termination of employment.

attributes.name: plan_code
attributes.description: Unique business identifier code for the accrual plan used in external communications and system integrations.

attributes.name: plan_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name of the accrual plan (e.g., 'Standard Staff PTO', 'Faculty Sabbatical Leave').

attributes.name: plan_type
attributes.description: Category of leave or time-off that this accrual plan governs.

attributes.name: policy_reference
attributes.description: Reference to the institutional policy document or section that governs this accrual plan.

attributes.name: proration_method
attributes.description: Method used to prorate accruals for part-time employees or mid-period hires.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the accrual plan indicating whether it is available for assignment to employees.

attributes.name: union_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the union or collective bargaining unit associated with this accrual plan, if applicable. Null for non-union plans.

attributes.name: waiting_period_days
attributes.description: Number of days an employee must be employed before they begin accruing leave under this plan. Zero if accrual starts immediately.

attributes.name: created_by
attributes.description: Username or identifier of the user who created this accrual plan record.

attributes.name: superseded_accrual_plan_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing FK on accrual_plan (superseded_accrual_plan_id)

attributes.name: lifetime_maximum_benefit

attributes.description: Detailed description of the competency framework including its purpose, scope, and intended application within the institution.

attributes.name: documentation_location
attributes.description: File path, SharePoint location, or document management system reference where detailed framework documentation, competency definitions, and behavioral indicators are stored.

attributes.name: effective_end_date

attributes.name: effective_start_date

attributes.name: external_reference_url

attributes.name: framework_category
attributes.description: Organizational scope and applicability category of the competency framework.

attributes.name: framework_code

attributes.name: framework_name

attributes.name: framework_type

attributes.name: industry_alignment

attributes.name: integration_system

attributes.name: language_code
attributes.description: ISO 639-1 two-letter language code (optionally with ISO 3166-1 country code) indicating the primary language of the competency framework content (e.g., 'en', 'en-US', 'fr', 'es').

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the competency framework record was most recently updated.

attributes.name: last_review_date
attributes.description: Date when the competency framework was most recently reviewed for accuracy, relevance, and alignment with organizational strategy.

attributes.name: multi_language_support_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this competency framework has been translated and is available in multiple languages.

attributes.name: next_review_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date for the next formal review of the competency framework.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Additional notes, comments, or contextual information about the competency framework including implementation guidance, known limitations, or special considerations.

attributes.name: owner_department
attributes.description: Name of the department or organizational unit responsible for maintaining and governing this competency framework (e.g., 'Human Resources', 'Organizational Development').

attributes.name: proficiency_levels
attributes.description: Number of proficiency or mastery levels defined in the framework rating scale (e.g., 3 for Basic/Intermediate/Advanced, 5 for a five-point scale).

attributes.name: proficiency_scale_description
attributes.description: Textual description of the proficiency levels and rating scale used in this framework (e.g., '1=Awareness, 2=Basic, 3=Intermediate, 4=Advanced, 5=Expert').

attributes.name: purpose_statement

attributes.name: regulatory_compliance_flag

attributes.name: regulatory_reference
attributes.description: Citation or reference to the regulatory requirement, accreditation standard, or compliance mandate that this framework addresses.

attributes.name: review_cycle_months

attributes.name: source_organization

attributes.name: source_type

attributes.name: status

attributes.name: target_audience

attributes.name: usage_scope

attributes.name: version_number
