domains.name: studentlife
domains.description: Manages student affairs operations including campus housing assignments, dining services, health and counseling services, student organizations, campus events, conduct adjudication support, and co-curricular engagement tracking.

products.name: studentlife_housing_assignment
products.description: Transactional record of a student's assignment to a specific residence hall room or bed space for a given term or academic year. Captures assignment start and end dates, assignment type (standard, medical, RA, overflow), room and bed identifiers, assignment status (pending, active, cancelled, expired), check-in and check-out timestamps, meal plan linkage, roommate group reference, and the administrative action that triggered the assignment. Serves as the authoritative record for residential occupancy.

attributes.name: studentlife_housing_assignment_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the housing assignment record. Primary key for the housing assignment entity.

attributes.name: account_hold_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to billing.account_hold. Business justification: Unpaid housing charges trigger account holds preventing future housing assignments and registration. Links housing assignment to billing hold for operational enforcement of payment requirements and ho

attributes.name: dining_plan_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the meal plan associated with this housing assignment. Many residence halls require or include a meal plan. Links to the meal plan master record. Nullable if no meal plan is associated.

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: The user identifier of the housing staff member or system user who created or last modified this housing assignment. Used for audit and accountability purposes.

attributes.name: enrollment_application_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to enrollment.enrollment_application. Business justification: Housing assignments are made to admitted students. Linking to the original application enables tracking the full enrollment funnel from application through housing placement, supports yield analysis b

attributes.name: housing_application_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to studentlife.housing_application. Business justification: A housing assignment is the OUTCOME of a housing application. Business process: student submits housing_application (with preferences, roommate requests, special accommodations), then housing office p

attributes.name: housing_contract_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the housing contract or agreement that governs this assignment. The contract specifies terms, conditions, fees, and policies. Links to the housing contract master record.

attributes.name: housing_cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Housing operations are auxiliary enterprise cost centers in higher ed. Assignments generate room and board revenue that must be allocated to specific cost centers for budget management, variance analy

attributes.name: housing_revenue_ledger_account_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Housing Revenue Ledger Account Id (Foreign Key)
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.ledger_account. Business justification: Housing charges post to specific revenue ledger accounts for financial statement preparation. Direct link enables accurate revenue recognition, supports month-end close processes, and facilitates auxi

attributes.name: profile_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier of the student assigned to the residence hall room or bed space. Links to the student master record in the Student Information System (SIS).
attributes.references: FERPA (Family Educational Rights and Privacy Act)

attributes.name: residence_hall_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the residence hall building where the student is assigned. Links to the residence hall master record.

attributes.name: residence_room_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to studentlife.residence_room. Business justification: Housing assignments are to specific ROOMS within residence halls, not just halls. Currently housing_assignment has residence_hall_id (FK to hall) and room_number (STRING), but no FK to the residence_r

attributes.name: roommate_group_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the roommate group or suite assignment that links multiple students sharing the same room or suite. Used to track roommate relationships and preferences. Nullable for single-occupancy assignments.

attributes.name: term_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the academic term or session for which this housing assignment is effective. Links to the term master record.

attributes.name: accommodation_notes
attributes.description: Confidential notes describing the nature of special accommodations provided for this assignment. May include details about accessibility features, medical equipment, or other modifications. Restricted access due to privacy considerations.
attributes.references: ADA (Americans with Disabilities Act), FERPA (Family Educational Rights and Privacy Act)

attributes.name: assignment_action_code
attributes.description: Code indicating the administrative action or trigger that created or modified this housing assignment. Initial assignment is the first placement; room change is a student-initiated move; emergency relocation is due to facility issues; administrative move is staff-initiated; student request is a voluntary change; disciplinary action is due to conduct issues.

attributes.name: assignment_created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this housing assignment record was first created in the system. Represents the initial assignment action.

attributes.name: assignment_end_date
attributes.description: The date on which the housing assignment expires and the student is expected to vacate the assigned space. Typically aligns with the end of the academic term or a designated move-out date. Nullable for open-ended assignments.

attributes.name: assignment_fee_amount
attributes.description: The total housing fee amount charged for this assignment for the specified term. Includes room charges and may include mandatory fees. Expressed in the institution's base currency (typically USD for U.S. institutions).
attributes.references: NACUBO (National Association of College and University Business Officers)

attributes.name: assignment_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this housing assignment record was last modified or updated in the system. Tracks the most recent change to any field in the record.

attributes.name: assignment_notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes or comments related to this housing assignment. May include special instructions, administrative notes, or other relevant information for housing staff.

attributes.name: assignment_priority_code
attributes.description: Code indicating the priority level or method by which the student received this housing assignment. Priority assignments are for students with special status (e.g., returning residents, athletes); guaranteed assignments are contractually promised; waitlist assignments were initially on a waiting list; lottery assignments were allocated through a random selection process.

attributes.name: assignment_start_date
attributes.description: The date on which the housing assignment becomes effective and the student is authorized to occupy the assigned space. Typically aligns with the start of the academic term or a designated move-in date.

attributes.name: assignment_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the housing assignment. Pending indicates awaiting confirmation or payment; active indicates the student is currently assigned and occupying or authorized to occupy the space; cancelled indicates the assignment was revoked before occupancy; expired indicates the assignment term has ended; terminated indicates early termination; on hold indicates temporary suspension.

attributes.name: assignment_type
attributes.description: Classification of the housing assignment indicating the nature or purpose of the assignment. Standard assignments are regular student housing; medical accommodations are for students with documented health needs; resident assistant assignments are for student staff; overflow and temporary are for capacity management; guest assignments are for short-term visitors.

attributes.name: cancellation_date
attributes.description: The date on which the housing assignment was cancelled or terminated. Null if the assignment has not been cancelled.

attributes.name: cancellation_reason_code
attributes.description: Code indicating the reason for cancellation or termination of the housing assignment if the assignment status is cancelled or terminated. Student withdrawal indicates the student left the institution; financial hardship indicates inability to pay; disciplinary indicates conduct violations; medical indicates health reasons; transfer indicates move to another institution; administrative indicates institutional decision; student request indicates voluntary cancellation. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: student_withdrawal|financial_hardship|disciplinary|medical|transfer|administrative|student_request — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: check_in_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the student physically checked into the assigned residence hall room and took occupancy. Recorded by housing staff during the move-in process. Null if the student has not yet checked in.

attributes.name: check_out_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the student physically checked out of the assigned residence hall room and vacated the space. Recorded by housing staff during the move-out process. Null if the student has not yet checked out.

attributes.name: damage_assessment_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator of whether a damage assessment was conducted for this assignment at check-out. True indicates assessment was completed; false indicates no assessment or assessment pending.

attributes.name: damage_charge_amount
attributes.description: The total amount charged to the student for damages to the assigned room or furnishings beyond normal wear and tear. Assessed during check-out inspection. Zero if no damages were found. Expressed in the institution's base currency.
attributes.references: NACUBO (National Association of College and University Business Officers)

attributes.name: deposit_amount
attributes.description: The refundable or non-refundable deposit amount required to secure this housing assignment. Typically collected at the time of assignment confirmation. Expressed in the institution's base currency.
attributes.references: NACUBO (National Association of College and University Business Officers)

attributes.name: emergency_contact_name
attributes.description: The full name of the emergency contact person designated by the student for this housing assignment. Used by housing staff in case of emergencies or urgent situations.
attributes.references: FERPA (Family Educational Rights and Privacy Act)

attributes.name: emergency_contact_phone
attributes.description: The primary phone number of the emergency contact person. Used by housing staff to reach the contact in case of emergencies.
attributes.references: FERPA (Family Educational Rights and Privacy Act)

attributes.name: key_issued_date
attributes.description: The date on which the physical key or access card was issued to the student. Null if no key has been issued.

attributes.name: key_issued_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator of whether a physical key or access card has been issued to the student for this assignment. True indicates key has been issued; false indicates key has not been issued or has been returned.

attributes.name: key_returned_date
attributes.description: The date on which the student returned the physical key or access card at the end of the assignment. Null if the key has not been returned.

attributes.name: occupancy_rate_code
attributes.description: Code indicating the intended occupancy level of the assigned room or space. Single is one student per room; double is two students; triple is three students; quad is four students; suite is a multi-room unit with shared common space.

attributes.name: refund_amount
attributes.description: The amount refunded to the student upon cancellation or early termination of the housing assignment, calculated according to the institution's refund policy. Zero if no refund is due. Expressed in the institution's base currency.
attributes.references: NACUBO (National Association of College and University Business Officers)

attributes.name: room_type_code
attributes.description: Code indicating the type or style of the assigned room. Standard is a traditional dormitory room; apartment includes kitchen facilities; suite has multiple bedrooms with shared living space; studio is a single-room unit; accessible is ADA-compliant; honors is for honors program students; wellness is substance-free; quiet is designated low-noise. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: standard|apartment|suite|studio|accessible|honors|wellness|quiet — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the source system or module from which this housing assignment record originated. Typically the housing management module of the Student Information System (SIS) such as Ellucian Banner Housing or similar system.

attributes.name: source_system_record_code
attributes.description: The unique identifier or primary key of this housing assignment record in the source operational system. Used for data lineage and reconciliation between the lakehouse and source systems.

attributes.name: special_accommodation_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator of whether this assignment includes special accommodations for the student due to documented medical, disability, or other needs. True indicates accommodations are in place; false indicates a standard assignment.

attributes.name: previous_studentlife_housing_assignment_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing FK on studentlife_housing_assignment (previous_studentlife_housing_assignment_id)

products.name: housing_application
products.description: Master record for a student's formal application for on-campus housing for a specific term or academic year. Captures application submission date, application status (submitted, under review, assigned, waitlisted, cancelled), housing preference selections (room type, building preference, single/double/triple, gender-inclusive), special accommodation requests, roommate preference entries, application fee payment status, priority group (freshman required, returning, graduate), and lottery number assignment. Distinct from the assignment record which is created after placement.

attributes.name: housing_application_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the housing application record. Primary key for the housing application entity.

attributes.name: academic_term_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the academic term or semester for which the student is applying for housing (e.g., Fall 2024, Spring 2025).

attributes.name: application_fee_ledger_account_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Application Fee Ledger Account Id (Foreign Key)
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.ledger_account. Business justification: Housing application fees are non-refundable revenue that posts to specific ledger accounts. Link supports fee revenue tracking, reconciliation of application fee payments to general ledger, and ensure

attributes.name: award_package_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to aid.award_package. Business justification: Housing applications reference financial aid packages for affordability verification and housing deposit waiver eligibility. This FK links housing_application to the aid award_package master, enabling

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the housing staff member who reviewed and processed the application.

attributes.name: enrollment_application_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to enrollment.enrollment_application. Business justification: Housing applications are submitted by admitted students post-acceptance. Institutions track which admission application corresponds to each housing request for yield management, enrollment confirmatio

attributes.name: payment_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to billing.payment. Business justification: Housing application fees and deposits are payments processed through billing system. Links application to payment transaction for payment verification, deposit refund processing, and financial reconci

attributes.name: primary_housing_profile_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier of the student submitting the housing application. Links to the student master record.
attributes.references: FERPA (Family Educational Rights and Privacy Act)

attributes.name: quaternary_housing_roommate_preference_3_student_profile_id
attributes.description: Student ID of the third preferred roommate selected by the applicant for mutual roommate matching.
attributes.references: FERPA (Family Educational Rights and Privacy Act)

attributes.name: student_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to billing.student_account. Business justification: Housing application fees and deposits are financial transactions that post to student accounts. Billing office tracks payment status to determine application completion and deposit refund eligibility

attributes.name: tertiary_housing_roommate_preference_2_student_profile_id
attributes.description: Student ID of the second preferred roommate selected by the applicant for mutual roommate matching.
attributes.references: FERPA (Family Educational Rights and Privacy Act)

attributes.name: accommodation_description
attributes.description: Detailed description of the special accommodations requested by the student, including accessibility needs, medical requirements, or other documented needs.
attributes.references: ADA (Americans with Disabilities Act), HIPAA (Health Insurance Portability and Accountability Act)

attributes.name: accommodation_documentation_received_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether required documentation supporting the accommodation request has been received from the student or disability services office.

attributes.name: application_fee_amount
attributes.description: Dollar amount of the non-refundable housing application fee charged to the student.

attributes.name: application_fee_payment_date
attributes.description: Date when the housing application fee payment was received and processed.

attributes.name: application_fee_payment_status
attributes.description: Current payment status of the housing application fee indicating whether the fee has been paid, waived, or is still pending.

attributes.name: application_notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes or comments entered by housing staff regarding the application review, special circumstances, or administrative actions.

attributes.name: application_number
attributes.description: Externally visible unique application number assigned to the housing application for tracking and reference purposes. Format: HA followed by 8 digits.

attributes.name: application_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the housing application indicating its position in the review and assignment workflow. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: submitted|under_review|approved|assigned|waitlisted|cancelled|withdrawn|expired — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: building_preference_1
attributes.description: Name or code of the students first-choice residence hall or housing facility.

attributes.name: building_preference_2
attributes.description: Name or code of the students second-choice residence hall or housing facility.

attributes.name: building_preference_3
attributes.description: Name or code of the students third-choice residence hall or housing facility.

attributes.name: cancellation_reason
attributes.description: Reason provided for cancelling or withdrawing the housing application (e.g., student withdrew from university, found off-campus housing, financial reasons).

attributes.name: cancellation_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the housing application was cancelled or withdrawn by the student or housing office.

attributes.name: contract_end_date
attributes.description: Effective end date of the housing contract period for which the student is applying.

attributes.name: contract_start_date
attributes.description: Effective start date of the housing contract period for which the student is applying.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the housing application record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: deposit_amount
attributes.description: Dollar amount of the refundable or partially refundable housing deposit required to secure the housing assignment.

attributes.name: deposit_payment_date
attributes.description: Date when the housing deposit payment was received and processed.

attributes.name: deposit_payment_status
attributes.description: Current payment status of the housing deposit indicating whether the deposit has been paid, waived, refunded, or forfeited.

attributes.name: early_arrival_reason
attributes.description: Reason or justification for the early arrival request (e.g., athletic team reporting, orientation leader training, international student acclimation).

attributes.name: early_arrival_requested_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the student has requested permission to move in before the standard move-in date (e.g., for athletics, orientation leaders, international students).

attributes.name: emergency_contact_name
attributes.description: Full name of the primary emergency contact person for the student while residing in campus housing.
attributes.references: FERPA (Family Educational Rights and Privacy Act)

attributes.name: emergency_contact_phone
attributes.description: Primary phone number of the emergency contact person for the student.
attributes.references: FERPA (Family Educational Rights and Privacy Act)

attributes.name: emergency_contact_relationship
attributes.description: Relationship of the emergency contact person to the student (e.g., parent, guardian, spouse, sibling). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: parent|guardian|spouse|sibling|other_family|friend|other — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: FERPA (Family Educational Rights and Privacy Act)

attributes.name: expected_arrival_date
attributes.description: Date when the student expects to arrive on campus and move into housing, if different from the standard move-in date.

attributes.name: gender_inclusive_housing_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the student has opted into gender-inclusive housing where students of different genders may share a room or suite.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the housing application record was last updated or modified.

attributes.name: late_arrival_expected_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the student expects to arrive after the standard move-in date due to travel, academic, or personal reasons.

attributes.name: lifestyle_preference
attributes.description: Living-learning community or lifestyle environment preference selected by the student (e.g., quiet study floors, substance-free housing, wellness community). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: quiet_study|social|substance_free|wellness|honors|international|STEM — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: lottery_number
attributes.description: Randomly assigned number used to determine housing assignment priority within the same priority group when demand exceeds capacity.

attributes.name: meal_plan_preference
attributes.description: Preferred dining meal plan option selected by the student as part of the housing application.

attributes.name: parking_permit_requested_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the student has requested a parking permit as part of the housing application process.

attributes.name: priority_group
attributes.description: Classification of the applicant into priority categories that determine housing assignment order and eligibility for specific housing types. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: freshman_required|returning_student|transfer_student|graduate_student|international_student|athlete|honors_program — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: review_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the housing application was reviewed by housing staff.

attributes.name: room_type_preference
attributes.description: Primary room configuration preference selected by the student (single occupancy, double, triple, quad, suite-style, or apartment-style).

attributes.name: special_accommodation_requested_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the student has requested special accommodations due to disability, medical condition, or other documented need.

attributes.name: submission_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the student submitted the housing application. Used for priority ordering and deadline enforcement.

attributes.name: superseded_housing_application_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing FK on housing_application (superseded_housing_application_id)

products.name: residence_hall
products.description: Master record for each on-campus residential facility managed by student housing. Captures building code, building name, campus location, hall type (traditional, suite-style, apartment, LLC — Living Learning Community), total bed capacity, gender designation (all-gender, women-only, men-only, mixed), construction year, renovation year, amenity flags (laundry, kitchen, study rooms, elevator, ADA accessible), housing office contact, and operational status (open, closed, under renovation). Complements facility.building with housing-specific operational attributes.

attributes.name: residence_hall_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the on-campus residential facility. Primary key for the residence hall master record.

attributes.name: building_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to facility.building. Business justification: Residence halls are buildings in the facility inventory. Required for work order management, capital project planning, facility condition assessments, ADA compliance tracking, energy reporting, and sp

attributes.name: ada_room_count
attributes.business_glossary_term: Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) Room Count
attributes.description: Number of rooms in the residence hall that are specifically designed and equipped to meet ADA accessibility requirements (wider doorways, roll-in showers, accessible fixtures). Null or zero if no ADA rooms available.
attributes.references: ADA Title II and Section 504 Compliance

attributes.name: building_nickname
attributes.description: Informal or commonly used name for the residence hall by students and campus community (e.g., 'The Towers', 'Old Dorm'). May be null if no nickname exists.

attributes.name: campus_location
attributes.description: Geographic area or zone of the campus where the residence hall is located. Used for housing assignment preferences and proximity planning to academic buildings.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date when this residence hall record became effective or when the hall was first opened for student occupancy. Used for historical tracking and reporting.

attributes.name: end_date
attributes.description: Date when this residence hall record was terminated or when the hall was permanently closed. Null for currently active halls. Used for historical tracking and decommissioning records.

attributes.name: fire_safety_system_type
attributes.description: Type of fire safety system installed in the residence hall. Sprinkler = automatic sprinkler system; Alarm-only = fire alarm and detection only; Sprinkler-and-alarm = both systems; None = no automated fire safety system (rare, legacy buildings only).
attributes.references: Campus Fire Safety Act and NFPA Standards

attributes.name: floor_count
attributes.description: Total number of floors in the residence hall building, including ground floor. Used for facilities planning and emergency response planning.

attributes.name: gender_designation
attributes.description: Gender assignment policy for the residence hall. All-gender = open to all gender identities; Women-only/Men-only = single-gender facility; Mixed-by-floor = different floors designated for different genders; Mixed-by-wing = different wings/sections designated for different genders.
attributes.references: Title IX Compliance and Housing Policy

attributes.name: hall_type
attributes.description: Classification of the residence hall based on room configuration and living arrangement. Traditional = corridor-style with shared bathrooms; Suite-style = multiple bedrooms sharing common area and bathroom; Apartment = full kitchen and living space; LLC (Living Learning Community) = thematic residential program; Honors = designated for honors college students; Graduate = for graduate students; Family = for married/family housing. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: traditional|suite_style|apartment|llc|honors|graduate|family — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: has_24hr_desk_staff
attributes.description: Indicates whether the residence hall has a staffed front desk or reception area operating 24 hours per day. True = 24-hour staffing; False = limited hours or no desk staff.

attributes.name: has_air_conditioning
attributes.description: Indicates whether the residence hall has air conditioning in residential rooms. True = air conditioned; False = no air conditioning. Important for student housing preferences and summer session planning.

attributes.name: has_computer_lab
attributes.description: Indicates whether the residence hall has a computer lab with workstations available to residents. True = computer lab available; False = no computer lab.
attributes.references: Housing Amenities and IT Services Standards

attributes.name: has_dining_hall
attributes.description: Indicates whether the residence hall has an on-site dining hall or cafeteria within the building. True = dining hall in building; False = no on-site dining.
attributes.references: Dining Services and Housing Integration Standards

attributes.name: has_elevator
attributes.description: Indicates whether the residence hall is equipped with elevator access. True = elevator available; False = stairs only. Critical for accessibility planning and move-in logistics.

attributes.name: has_fitness_center
attributes.description: Indicates whether the residence hall has an on-site fitness center or exercise room available to residents. True = fitness facility available; False = no fitness center.

attributes.name: has_kitchen_facility
attributes.description: Indicates whether the residence hall has shared kitchen facilities available to residents (excludes in-unit kitchens in apartment-style halls). True = communal kitchen available; False = no shared kitchen.

attributes.name: has_laundry_facility
attributes.description: Indicates whether the residence hall has on-site laundry facilities (washers and dryers) available to residents. True = laundry available; False = no laundry facility.

attributes.name: has_study_rooms
attributes.description: Indicates whether the residence hall has dedicated study rooms or quiet study spaces available to residents. True = study rooms available; False = no dedicated study spaces.

attributes.name: housing_office_contact_name
attributes.description: Name of the primary housing office staff member or hall director responsible for this residence hall. Used for operational communications and student inquiries.

attributes.name: housing_office_email
attributes.description: Primary email address for the housing office or hall director responsible for this residence hall. Classified as confidential organizational contact data.

attributes.name: housing_office_phone
attributes.description: Primary phone number for the housing office or hall director responsible for this residence hall. Classified as confidential organizational contact data.

attributes.name: is_ada_accessible
attributes.business_glossary_term: Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) Accessible Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the residence hall meets ADA accessibility standards and has accessible rooms available for students with disabilities. True = ADA compliant with accessible units; False = not fully accessible.
attributes.references: ADA Title II and Section 504 Compliance

attributes.name: occupancy_term_pattern
attributes.description: Standard term pattern for which the residence hall is available for student occupancy. Academic-year = fall and spring only; Year-round = all terms including summer; Fall-spring-only = closed in summer; Summer-only = only open for summer sessions.

attributes.name: operational_status
attributes.description: Current operational state of the residence hall. Open = actively housing students; Closed = temporarily not in use; Under-renovation = closed for capital improvements; Seasonal = only open certain terms (e.g., summer-only); Decommissioned = permanently closed and no longer used for housing.

attributes.name: parking_availability
attributes.description: Assessment of parking availability near the residence hall for resident students. None = no parking; Limited = very few spaces; Adequate = sufficient for most residents; Ample = abundant parking.

attributes.name: record_created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this residence hall record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage tracking.

attributes.name: record_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this residence hall record was last modified in the system. Used for audit trail and change tracking.

attributes.name: resident_assistant_count
attributes.description: Number of Resident Assistants (RAs) or peer staff members assigned to the residence hall. Used for staffing planning and student support ratio calculations.

attributes.name: security_access_type
attributes.description: Method of building access control for the residence hall. Card-access = electronic card reader system; Key-access = traditional physical keys; Biometric = fingerprint or facial recognition; Open-access = no controlled entry (rare).
attributes.references: Campus Security and Clery Act Compliance

attributes.name: total_bed_capacity
attributes.description: Maximum number of students that can be housed in the residence hall when fully occupied. Used for enrollment planning and housing assignment capacity management.

attributes.name: total_room_count
attributes.description: Total number of assignable residential rooms in the building, including singles, doubles, triples, and suites. Excludes common areas and staff apartments.

attributes.name: parent_residence_hall_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing FK on residence_hall (parent_residence_hall_id)

products.name: residence_room
products.description: Master record for each individual room or suite within a residence hall, representing the assignable unit of on-campus housing. Captures room number, floor, room type (single, double, triple, quad, suite, studio, apartment), bed count, square footage, ADA accessibility status, gender designation, occupancy status (available, occupied, offline, reserved), current occupancy count, maximum occupancy, and special designation flags (RA room, LLC room, medical accommodation room). Provides the inventory of assignable housing units.

attributes.name: residence_room_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the residence room. Primary key for the residence room entity.

attributes.name: llc_program_id
attributes.description: FK to studentlife.llc_program

attributes.name: residence_hall_id
attributes.description: Foreign key reference to the residence hall that contains this room.

attributes.name: ada_accessible
attributes.description: Indicates whether the room meets ADA accessibility requirements for students with physical disabilities (wheelchair access, accessible bathroom, etc.).
attributes.references: ADA Title II, Section 504 Rehabilitation Act

attributes.name: ada_features
attributes.description: Detailed description of specific ADA accessibility features present in the room (e.g., roll-in shower, lowered counters, visual fire alarms, wider doorways).
attributes.references: ADA Title II, Section 504 Rehabilitation Act

attributes.name: air_conditioning
attributes.description: Indicates whether the room has air conditioning. Important for student preferences and medical accommodations.

attributes.name: available_from_date
attributes.description: The date from which the room becomes available for occupancy in the current academic term.

attributes.name: available_until_date
attributes.description: The date until which the room remains available for occupancy in the current academic term (typically end of semester or academic year).

attributes.name: bathroom_type
attributes.description: Classification of bathroom facilities associated with the room (private in-room, shared between two rooms, suite bathroom, communal hall bathroom).

attributes.name: bed_count
attributes.description: The total number of beds physically available in the room. Represents the physical capacity of the room.

attributes.name: cable_tv_available
attributes.description: Indicates whether cable television service is available in the room.

attributes.name: closet_count
attributes.description: Number of closets or wardrobe units available in the room for student storage.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this room record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: current_occupancy_count
attributes.description: The current number of students actively assigned to and occupying this room.

attributes.name: floor_number
attributes.description: The floor level on which the room is located within the residence hall. Ground floor is typically 1, basement may be 0 or negative.

attributes.name: furnished
attributes.description: Indicates whether the room comes furnished with standard university furniture (bed, desk, chair, dresser).

attributes.name: furniture_description
attributes.description: Detailed description of furniture items included in the room (e.g., twin XL bed, desk with hutch, rolling chair, 4-drawer dresser).

attributes.name: gender_designation
attributes.description: The gender designation policy for room assignment (male, female, gender_inclusive, gender_neutral). Used to enforce housing assignment policies.

attributes.name: internet_access_type
attributes.description: Type of internet connectivity available in the room (wired ethernet, wireless WiFi, both, or none).

attributes.name: is_active
attributes.description: Indicates whether this room record is currently active in the housing inventory. Inactive rooms are no longer available for assignment.

attributes.name: is_honors_housing
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this room is part of honors housing reserved for students in the honors program.

attributes.name: is_llc_room
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this room is part of a Living Learning Community (LLC) or themed housing program.

attributes.name: is_medical_accommodation
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this room is designated for students requiring medical accommodations (e.g., air conditioning for medical conditions, proximity to elevators, single room for health reasons).

attributes.name: is_quiet_floor
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this room is located on a designated quiet floor with enhanced noise restrictions.

attributes.name: is_ra_room
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this room is designated for a Resident Assistant (RA) or other student staff member.

attributes.name: is_substance_free
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this room is part of substance-free housing where residents commit to abstaining from alcohol and drugs.

attributes.name: kitchen_type
attributes.description: Type of kitchen facilities available to room occupants (none, kitchenette, full kitchen, shared floor kitchen).

attributes.name: last_renovation_date
attributes.description: The date when the room last underwent renovation or significant refurbishment. Used for maintenance planning and quality assessment.

attributes.name: maximum_occupancy
attributes.description: The maximum number of students that can be assigned to this room according to housing policy and fire code regulations.
attributes.references: Campus Housing Policy, Fire Safety Code

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Additional notes or comments about the room, including special features, restrictions, or maintenance issues.

attributes.name: occupancy_status
attributes.description: Current occupancy state relative to capacity (vacant, partial, full, overbooked). Distinct from room_status which indicates operational availability.

attributes.name: room_number
attributes.description: The official room number or identifier within the residence hall (e.g., 201, 3A, Suite 405). This is the human-readable identifier used for room assignments and communications.

attributes.name: room_rate_amount
attributes.description: The standard housing rate charged per semester or academic year for this room. Used for billing and financial planning.
attributes.references: Campus Housing Policy, Student Accounts Standards

attributes.name: room_rate_period
attributes.description: The billing period for the room rate (semester, academic year, monthly, annual).
attributes.references: Campus Housing Policy, Student Accounts Standards

attributes.name: room_status
attributes.description: Current operational status of the room indicating its availability for assignment (available, occupied, offline, reserved, maintenance, renovation).

attributes.name: room_type
attributes.description: Classification of the room based on its configuration and intended occupancy structure (single, double, triple, quad, suite, studio, apartment, efficiency). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: single|double|triple|quad|suite|studio|apartment|efficiency — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: square_footage
attributes.description: The total floor area of the room measured in square feet. Used for space planning and occupancy standards.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this room record was last modified in the system.

attributes.name: view_description
attributes.description: Description of the view from the room windows (e.g., courtyard, campus quad, parking lot, city skyline). May influence student preferences.

attributes.name: window_count
attributes.description: Number of windows in the room. Relevant for natural light, ventilation, and student preferences.

attributes.name: connected_residence_room_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing FK on residence_room (connected_residence_room_id)

products.name: dining_plan
products.description: Reference catalog record defining the meal plan options offered by the institution's dining services for a given academic year. Captures plan code, plan name, plan type (block, declining balance, unlimited, commuter), number of meals per week or block allotment, dining dollar (flex dollar) allocation, eligible dining locations, price per term, mandatory vs. optional designation by student population, and active status. Serves as the authoritative catalog of available dining plan offerings.

attributes.name: dining_plan_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the dining plan catalog record. Primary key for the dining plan reference entity.

attributes.name: academic_year
attributes.description: Academic year for which this dining plan catalog is effective, in format YYYY-YYYY (e.g., 2023-2024). Dining plans are typically versioned annually with pricing and structure changes.

attributes.name: block_meal_count
attributes.description: Total number of meal swipes allocated for the entire term or academic year for block-based plans. Null for weekly and declining balance plans.

attributes.name: carryover_limit
attributes.description: Maximum number of unused meals or maximum dollar amount of dining dollars that can roll over to the next term if rollover is allowed. Null if no rollover is permitted or if rollover is unlimited.

attributes.name: created_date
attributes.description: Date when this dining plan catalog record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage tracking.

attributes.name: dietary_accommodation_notes
attributes.description: Notes on special dietary accommodations or allergen-friendly options available under this plan (e.g., vegetarian, vegan, gluten-free, kosher, halal stations available at all eligible locations). Used for accessibility and compliance documentation.

attributes.name: dining_dollars_amount
attributes.description: Dollar value of flex dollars (also called dining dollars or declining balance) included with the plan per term. Used at retail dining locations, convenience stores, and cafes. Zero for meal-only plans.

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: Date when this dining plan expires and is no longer available for new enrollments or usage. Typically aligns with the end of the academic term or year.

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: Date when this dining plan becomes available for student selection and use. Typically aligns with the start of the academic term or year.

attributes.name: eligible_dining_locations
attributes.description: Comma-separated list or description of dining hall names and retail locations where this plan can be used (e.g., Main Dining Hall, North Commons, Campus Cafe, Student Union Food Court). May reference all-access or restricted location sets.

attributes.name: eligible_student_types
attributes.description: Description of student classifications eligible to purchase this plan (e.g., Residential students only, Commuters, Graduate students, All students). Used to control plan availability during registration.

attributes.name: guest_swipes_included
attributes.description: Number of guest meal passes included with the plan per term, allowing the plan holder to bring guests to dining halls. Zero if no guest privileges are included.

attributes.name: last_modified_date
attributes.description: Date when this dining plan catalog record was most recently updated. Tracks changes to pricing, structure, or availability.

attributes.name: mandatory_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this dining plan is required for certain student populations (e.g., first-year students living on campus). True if mandatory, false if optional.

attributes.name: mandatory_for_population
attributes.description: Description of the student population for whom this plan is mandatory (e.g., First-year residents, All on-campus students, Sophomore residents in traditional halls). Null if plan is not mandatory for any group.

attributes.name: meal_equivalency_value
attributes.description: Dollar value assigned to one meal swipe when used at retail dining locations instead of all-you-care-to-eat dining halls. Allows students to use meal swipes as credit at cafes and food courts. Null if meal equivalency is not offered.

attributes.name: meals_per_week
attributes.description: Number of meal swipes available per week for weekly-based plans. Null for block plans and declining balance plans.

attributes.name: online_ordering_enabled_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this dining plan supports mobile app or web-based ordering for pickup or delivery at participating dining locations. True if online ordering is enabled, false otherwise.

attributes.name: plan_code
attributes.description: Short alphanumeric code uniquely identifying the dining plan in the catalog (e.g., UNL19, COM10, BLK150). Used for registration and billing system integration.

attributes.name: plan_description
attributes.description: Detailed description of the dining plan features, benefits, restrictions, and intended audience. Used for marketing materials, student portal displays, and advising resources.

attributes.name: plan_name
attributes.description: Full descriptive name of the dining plan as displayed to students and families (e.g., Unlimited Meal Plan, 10 Meals Per Week Plus $200 Flex, Commuter Block 50).

attributes.name: plan_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the dining plan in the catalog: active (available for selection), inactive (temporarily unavailable), pending (scheduled for future activation), discontinued (no longer offered but historical records exist), archived (historical record only).

attributes.name: plan_type
attributes.description: Classification of the dining plan structure: unlimited (unlimited swipes per week), block (fixed number of meals per term), declining_balance (dollar-based account), commuter (limited access for non-residents), hybrid (combination of meals and dollars), flex (flexible allocation).

attributes.name: price_per_term
attributes.description: Cost of the dining plan for one academic term (semester or quarter) in US dollars. Used for student billing and financial aid Cost of Attendance (COA) calculations.

attributes.name: price_per_year
attributes.description: Total annual cost of the dining plan for the full academic year in US dollars. Null if plan is only offered on a per-term basis.

attributes.name: refund_policy
attributes.description: Description of the refund or cancellation policy for this dining plan, including deadlines, prorated refund schedules, and conditions for full or partial refunds (e.g., 100% refund before census date, prorated through week 4, no refund after week 4).

attributes.name: rollover_allowed_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether unused meals or dining dollars can roll over from one term to the next within the same academic year. True if rollover is permitted, false otherwise.

attributes.name: tax_exempt_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the dining plan charges are exempt from sales tax under state or local regulations. True if tax-exempt, false if taxable. Varies by jurisdiction and plan structure.

attributes.name: superseded_dining_plan_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing FK on dining_plan (superseded_dining_plan_id)

products.name: dining_enrollment
products.description: Transactional record of a student's enrollment in a specific dining/meal plan for a given term. Captures enrollment date, plan selected, term, enrollment status (active, cancelled, changed), dining dollar balance, meals remaining (for block plans), number of guest meals used, plan change history reference, and the billing trigger date for integration with the student billing domain. Tracks the student's active dining contract for the term.

attributes.name: dining_enrollment_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the dining enrollment record. Primary key for the dining enrollment entity.

attributes.name: dining_cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Dining services operate as self-supporting auxiliary enterprises with dedicated cost centers. Meal plan enrollments drive revenue allocation, cost recovery analysis, and budget performance tracking es

attributes.name: meal_plan_revenue_ledger_account_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Meal Plan Revenue Ledger Account Id (Foreign Key)
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.ledger_account. Business justification: Meal plan charges post to specific revenue ledger accounts for revenue recognition. Link enables accurate auxiliary enterprise financial reporting, supports revenue reconciliation processes, and facil

attributes.name: payment_plan_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to billing.payment_plan. Business justification: Meal plan costs are often included in payment plans alongside tuition and housing. Links dining enrollment to payment arrangement for installment billing of board charges and payment default tracking.

attributes.name: primary_dining_plan_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier of the specific meal plan selected by the student. References the meal plan catalog.

attributes.name: profile_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier of the student enrolled in the dining plan. Links to the student master record.
attributes.references: FERPA - Family Educational Rights and Privacy Act

attributes.name: student_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to billing.student_account. Business justification: Meal plan charges are billed to student accounts each term. Links dining enrollment to financial account for charge posting, payment tracking, refund processing, and financial aid disbursement coordin

attributes.name: term_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier of the academic term for which the dining plan is active. Links to the academic calendar.
attributes.references: IPEDS - Integrated Postsecondary Education Data System

attributes.name: auto_renewal_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the meal plan is set to automatically renew for the next term. Used for enrollment forecasting and student communication.

attributes.name: billing_status
attributes.description: Current status of the billing transaction for this dining enrollment. Tracks whether charges have been posted, paid, or adjusted.
attributes.references: NACUBO - National Association of College and University Business Officers

attributes.name: billing_trigger_date
attributes.description: Date when the dining plan charge should be posted to the student billing system. Used for integration with student accounts and financial aid disbursement timing.
attributes.references: NACUBO - National Association of College and University Business Officers

attributes.name: cancellation_date
attributes.description: Date when the dining enrollment was cancelled. Null if enrollment is still active or completed normally.

attributes.name: cancellation_reason
attributes.description: Reason code for dining plan cancellation. Used for refund policy application and retention analysis. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: withdrawal|housing_change|medical|financial|graduation|transfer|other — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this dining enrollment record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage.

attributes.name: daily_meal_limit
attributes.description: Maximum number of meals allowed per day for plans with daily caps. Null for unlimited plans.

attributes.name: dietary_restriction_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the student has documented dietary restrictions or allergies requiring special meal accommodations. Used for dining services planning and compliance.

attributes.name: dietary_restriction_notes
attributes.description: Free-text description of specific dietary restrictions, allergies, or medical dietary requirements. Confidential information used by dining services staff.

attributes.name: dining_dollar_balance
attributes.description: Current remaining balance of dining dollars available to the student. Applicable for declining balance and hybrid plans. Decrements with each transaction.

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: Date when the dining plan coverage ends. Marks the last day the student can use the meal plan benefits. Typically aligns with term end date.

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: Date when the dining plan coverage begins. Marks the first day the student can use the meal plan benefits.

attributes.name: enrollment_date
attributes.description: Date when the student enrolled in the dining plan. Represents the business event date when the enrollment contract was established.

attributes.name: enrollment_number
attributes.description: Human-readable business identifier for the dining enrollment. Externally visible reference number used in student communications and billing statements.

attributes.name: enrollment_source
attributes.description: Channel or system through which the dining enrollment was created. Used for process analysis and system integration tracking.

attributes.name: enrollment_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the dining enrollment. Indicates whether the enrollment is active, has been cancelled, is suspended, pending activation, completed for the term, or has been changed to a different plan.

attributes.name: exemption_reason
attributes.description: Documented reason for meal plan exemption request. Used for policy compliance and audit purposes.

attributes.name: exemption_status
attributes.description: Status of any request for exemption from mandatory meal plan requirements. Tracks approval workflow for students seeking waivers.

attributes.name: guest_meal_allowance
attributes.description: Total number of guest meals permitted under this meal plan for the enrollment period. Null if guest meals are not included in the plan.

attributes.name: guest_meals_used
attributes.description: Number of guest meal privileges used by the student during the enrollment period. Tracks when students bring non-enrolled guests to dining facilities.

attributes.name: housing_requirement_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the meal plan enrollment is mandatory due to on-campus housing requirements. Used for policy enforcement and exemption tracking.

attributes.name: initial_dining_dollar_amount
attributes.description: Original dining dollar allocation at the start of the enrollment period. Used to calculate usage and remaining balance.

attributes.name: initial_meal_count
attributes.description: Total number of meals allocated at enrollment for block meal plans. Used to track usage and calculate remaining meals.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this dining enrollment record was last updated. Used for audit trail and change tracking.

attributes.name: last_transaction_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent dining transaction (meal swipe or dining dollar purchase) under this enrollment. Used for activity monitoring and engagement analysis.

attributes.name: meals_remaining
attributes.description: Number of meals remaining in the current enrollment period for block meal plans. Decrements with each meal swipe. Null for unlimited or declining balance plans.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes or comments related to the dining enrollment. Used by dining services staff for special circumstances or administrative annotations.

attributes.name: plan_change_date
attributes.description: Date when the student changed from one meal plan to another during the term. Null if no plan change occurred.

attributes.name: plan_change_reason
attributes.description: Reason code for why the student changed meal plans. Used for operational analysis and policy evaluation.

attributes.name: plan_cost_amount
attributes.description: Total cost of the meal plan for the enrollment period. Amount charged to the student account.
attributes.references: NACUBO - National Association of College and University Business Officers

attributes.name: plan_type
attributes.description: Category of meal plan structure. Unlimited allows unrestricted dining hall access; block provides a fixed number of meals per term; declining balance uses a dollar amount; commuter is designed for non-resident students; hybrid combines features; flex offers maximum flexibility.
attributes.references: NACUBO - National Association of College and University Business Officers

attributes.name: refund_amount
attributes.description: Dollar amount refunded to the student upon cancellation or plan change. Calculated based on refund policy and usage.
attributes.references: NACUBO - National Association of College and University Business Officers

attributes.name: refund_processed_date
attributes.description: Date when the refund was processed and posted to the student account. Null if no refund was issued.
attributes.references: NACUBO - National Association of College and University Business Officers

attributes.name: rollover_balance_amount
attributes.description: Dining dollar balance carried over from the previous term, if permitted by plan rules. Null if no rollover is allowed or applicable.

attributes.name: weekly_meal_limit
attributes.description: Maximum number of meals allowed per week for plans with weekly caps. Null for unlimited or term-block plans.

attributes.name: changed_from_dining_enrollment_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing FK on dining_enrollment (changed_from_dining_enrollment_id)

products.name: dining_transaction
products.description: Transactional record of each individual dining swipe, declining balance purchase, or dining dollar redemption at a campus dining facility. Captures transaction timestamp, dining location, transaction type (meal swipe, dining dollar, guest meal, catering), amount charged or meals decremented, payment method (meal plan, dining dollars, cash, credit card), terminal ID, and resulting balance after transaction. Provides the detailed usage ledger for dining plan consumption and dining services revenue tracking.

attributes.name: dining_transaction_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the dining transaction record. Primary key for the dining transaction entity.

attributes.name: academic_term_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the academic term during which the transaction occurred. Links to the academic term master record. Used for term-based meal plan analysis and reporting.

attributes.name: building_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the campus dining facility where the transaction occurred. Links to the dining facility master record.

attributes.name: dining_enrollment_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to studentlife.dining_enrollment. Business justification: dining_transaction currently links to dining_plan (the plan definition) but not to dining_enrollment (the student's active enrollment instance for a term). A transaction should link to the specific en

attributes.name: dining_plan_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the meal plan associated with this transaction. Links to the student's active meal plan at the time of transaction.

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the dining services staff member who processed the transaction at the terminal. Used for operational accountability and training purposes. Null for self-service kiosk transactions.

attributes.name: it_asset_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to technology.it_asset. Business justification: Dining transactions occur at POS terminals tracked as IT assets. Real business process: POS device inventory management, maintenance scheduling, transaction reconciliation, and hardware lifecycle trac

attributes.name: original_transaction_dining_transaction_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the original transaction that this refund transaction is reversing. Links to another dining transaction record. Null if this is not a refund transaction.

attributes.name: profile_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier of the student who performed the dining transaction. Links to the student master record.
attributes.references: FERPA (Family Educational Rights and Privacy Act)

attributes.name: refund_transaction_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the refund transaction that reversed this original transaction. Links to another dining transaction record. Null if transaction has not been refunded.

attributes.name: student_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to billing.student_account. Business justification: Individual dining purchases (guest meals, à la carte items) may be charged to student accounts when declining balance is used. Enables financial reconciliation of dining transactions with student bill

attributes.name: transaction_ledger_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.ledger_account. Business justification: Individual dining transactions (cash sales, dining dollars) post to revenue accounts daily. Link supports point-of-sale revenue reconciliation, daily cash management, month-end close processes, and en

attributes.name: authorization_code
attributes.description: Payment authorization code returned by the payment processor for credit card, debit card, or mobile payment transactions. Used for payment reconciliation and dispute resolution. Null for meal plan and cash transactions.
attributes.references: PCI DSS (Payment Card Industry Data Security Standard)

attributes.name: balance_after
attributes.description: Student's dining dollar or declining balance account balance in US dollars immediately after this transaction was processed. Provides audit trail for balance changes. Null for meal plan swipe transactions that do not use monetary balance.

attributes.name: balance_before
attributes.description: Student's dining dollar or declining balance account balance in US dollars immediately before this transaction was processed. Null for meal plan swipe transactions that do not use monetary balance.

attributes.name: card_last_four
attributes.description: Last four digits of the credit or debit card used for the transaction. Stored for customer service and dispute resolution purposes. Null for non-card payment methods. Full card number is never stored per PCI compliance.
attributes.references: PCI DSS (Payment Card Industry Data Security Standard)

attributes.name: card_type
attributes.description: Type of credit or debit card used for the transaction. Used for payment processing fee analysis and reconciliation. Null for non-card payment methods.
attributes.references: PCI DSS (Payment Card Industry Data Security Standard)

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this transaction record was first created in the system. Audit field for data lineage and troubleshooting. May differ slightly from transaction_timestamp due to processing delays.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the transaction. Typically USD for US-based institutions. Included for international campus locations or study abroad programs.

attributes.name: discount_amount
attributes.description: Monetary value of discount applied to the transaction in US dollars. Zero if no discount applied. Used for promotional tracking and revenue reconciliation.

attributes.name: discount_code
attributes.description: Promotional or employee discount code applied to the transaction. Used for special pricing programs, staff discounts, or promotional campaigns. Null if no discount applied.

attributes.name: guest_count
attributes.description: Number of guest meals included in this transaction. Used when a student uses meal plan swipes or pays for guests. Zero for standard single-person transactions.

attributes.name: is_refunded
attributes.description: Indicates whether this transaction has been refunded. True if a refund was issued, false otherwise. Used for financial reconciliation and customer service tracking.

attributes.name: meal_period
attributes.description: Designated meal period during which the transaction occurred. Used for meal plan swipe validation and dining facility operational reporting. All-day applies to retail and grab-and-go locations without period restrictions.

attributes.name: meals_decremented
attributes.description: Number of meal swipes deducted from the student's meal plan balance as a result of this transaction. Typically 1 for standard meal swipe, 0 for non-meal-plan transactions, may be greater than 1 for guest meals charged to meal plan.

attributes.name: meals_remaining
attributes.description: Number of meal swipes remaining on the student's meal plan after this transaction was processed. Provides audit trail for meal plan consumption. Null for non-meal-plan transactions.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Additional notes or comments about the transaction. May include customer service notes, exception handling details, or operational remarks. Free-form text field.

attributes.name: order_number
attributes.description: Order number for made-to-order or catering transactions. Used to track order fulfillment and customer pickup. Null for standard meal swipe and grab-and-go transactions.

attributes.name: payment_method
attributes.description: Payment instrument used to complete the transaction. Meal plan uses prepaid meal swipes, dining dollars and declining balance use prepaid account funds, credit/debit card and cash are direct payment, mobile payment includes Apple Pay and Google Pay, campus card uses student ID card payment feature. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: meal_plan|dining_dollars|declining_balance|credit_card|debit_card|cash|mobile_payment|campus_card — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: special_instructions
attributes.description: Customer-provided special instructions or notes for the order. Applicable to made-to-order and catering transactions. May include dietary restrictions, preparation preferences, or delivery instructions.

attributes.name: tax_amount
attributes.description: Sales tax amount applied to the transaction in US dollars. Applicable to retail purchases and certain dining dollar transactions based on state and local tax regulations. May be zero for meal plan swipes.

attributes.name: terminal_code
attributes.description: Identifier of the point-of-sale terminal or kiosk where the transaction was processed. Used for terminal reconciliation, troubleshooting, and location-specific analytics within a dining facility.

attributes.name: tip_amount
