products.name: immunization_record
products.description: Master record tracking a student's immunization compliance status as required by the institution and applicable state public health regulations. Captures immunization type (MMR, meningococcal, hepatitis B, varicella, COVID-19, influenza, TB test), dose sequence number, administration date, expiration date, verification source (self-reported, provider-verified, state registry), compliance status (compliant, non-compliant, exemption granted), exemption type (medical, religious, philosophical), and compliance hold trigger flag. Supports public health compliance and registration hold enforcement.

attributes.name: immunization_record_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the immunization record. Primary key for this entity.

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the health services staff member who reviewed and verified this immunization record. Links to the staff or employee master record. Supports audit trail and accountability.

attributes.name: enterprise_application_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to technology.enterprise_application. Business justification: Immunization records are managed in specialized health compliance applications (Medicat, Point & Click, Epic). Real business process: integration with student health information systems for compliance

attributes.name: profile_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the student to whom this immunization record belongs. Links to the student master record in the Student Information System (SIS).
attributes.references: FERPA (Family Educational Rights and Privacy Act)

attributes.name: academic_term_code
attributes.description: The academic term code for which this immunization compliance status applies. Links to the term master record. Supports term-specific compliance tracking and hold enforcement.

attributes.name: administration_date
attributes.description: The date on which the immunization was administered to the student. Critical for determining compliance status and expiration timelines.

attributes.name: compliance_hold_flag
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether a registration or enrollment hold is active due to non-compliance with this immunization requirement. True indicates hold is active and student cannot register; false indicates no hold. Drives SIS (Student Information System) hold enforcement.
attributes.references: Institutional Registration Policy; SIS Hold Management

attributes.name: compliance_status
attributes.description: The current compliance status of the student for this immunization requirement. Compliant indicates all requirements met; non-compliant indicates missing or incomplete immunization; exemption granted indicates approved waiver; pending verification indicates documentation submitted but not yet confirmed; expired indicates previously compliant but now past expiration date. Drives registration hold logic.
attributes.references: State Public Health Regulations; Institutional Compliance Policy

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this immunization record was first created in the system. Supports audit trail and data lineage tracking.

attributes.name: document_reference_number
attributes.description: The reference number or identifier for the physical or digital immunization documentation stored in the student health record system. Enables retrieval of supporting documentation for audit or verification purposes.

attributes.name: dose_sequence_number
attributes.description: The sequential dose number for multi-dose immunization series (e.g., 1 for first dose, 2 for second dose). Tracks completion progress for vaccines requiring multiple administrations.

attributes.name: exemption_approval_date
attributes.description: The date on which the exemption was approved by the institution or authorized health personnel. Nullable if no exemption applies.

attributes.name: exemption_documentation_on_file
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether supporting documentation for the exemption (e.g., physician letter, religious affidavit) is on file with the institution. True indicates documentation is present; false indicates missing or not applicable.

attributes.name: exemption_expiration_date
attributes.description: The date on which the exemption expires and requires renewal. Some exemptions (e.g., medical) may be temporary. Nullable for permanent exemptions or when no exemption applies.
attributes.references: State Public Health Regulations; Institutional Health Services Policy

attributes.name: exemption_type
attributes.description: The type of exemption granted if the student is not required to receive the immunization. Medical exemptions are based on health contraindications; religious exemptions are based on sincerely held religious beliefs; philosophical exemptions are based on personal or moral beliefs (where permitted by state law). None indicates no exemption applies.

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: The date on which the immunization expires and requires renewal or booster. Used to trigger compliance alerts and registration holds. Nullable for immunizations with lifetime validity.
attributes.references: State Public Health Regulations; Institutional Health Policy

attributes.name: hold_effective_date
attributes.description: The date on which the compliance hold was placed on the student account. Nullable if no hold is active.

attributes.name: hold_release_date
attributes.description: The date on which the compliance hold was released after the student achieved compliance or received an exemption. Nullable if hold is still active or never placed.

attributes.name: immunization_name
attributes.description: The specific name or brand of the vaccine administered (e.g., Pfizer-BioNTech COVID-19, Menactra, Gardasil). Provides detailed identification beyond the general type.

attributes.name: immunization_type
attributes.description: The type of immunization administered or documented. Common types include MMR (Measles Mumps Rubella), meningococcal, hepatitis B, varicella (chickenpox), COVID-19, and influenza. Required for public health compliance and registration hold enforcement.
attributes.references: CDC (Centers for Disease Control and Prevention) Immunization Schedules; State Public Health Regulations

attributes.name: is_active
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this immunization record is currently active. True indicates active; false indicates the record has been superseded, corrected, or voided. Supports record lifecycle management.

attributes.name: is_required_for_enrollment
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this immunization is required for enrollment at the institution. True indicates mandatory; false indicates recommended but not required. Drives hold enforcement logic.
attributes.references: State Public Health Regulations; Institutional Health Policy

attributes.name: is_required_for_housing
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this immunization is specifically required for students living in campus housing. True indicates mandatory for housing residents; false indicates not a housing-specific requirement. Some immunizations (e.g., meningococcal) may have housing-specific mandates.
attributes.references: State Public Health Regulations; Institutional Housing Policy

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this immunization record was last modified. Supports audit trail and change tracking.

attributes.name: lot_number
attributes.description: The manufacturer lot number of the vaccine administered. Critical for tracking in case of recalls or adverse event investigations.
attributes.references: CDC Vaccine Adverse Event Reporting System (VAERS); FDA Vaccine Safety Standards

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes or comments regarding the immunization record. May include special circumstances, follow-up requirements, or clarifications from health services staff.

attributes.name: notification_method
attributes.description: The method by which the compliance notification was sent to the student. Email indicates electronic mail; portal message indicates student portal notification; mail indicates postal mail; SMS indicates text message; phone indicates voice call.

attributes.name: notification_sent_date
attributes.description: The date on which the most recent compliance notification was sent to the student regarding this immunization requirement. Supports communication tracking and FERPA compliance.

attributes.name: provider_location
attributes.description: The city and state or country where the immunization was administered. Supports verification and international student documentation.

attributes.name: provider_name
attributes.description: The name of the healthcare provider, clinic, or facility that administered the immunization. Used for verification and audit purposes.

attributes.name: review_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the immunization record was last reviewed by health services staff. Supports audit trail and compliance verification workflows.

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: The name of the source system from which this immunization record originated (e.g., Ellucian Banner Student Health module, Medicat, state immunization registry). Supports data lineage and integration tracking.

attributes.name: verification_date
attributes.description: The date on which the immunization record was verified by the institution or authorized health personnel. Distinct from administration date; tracks when the institution confirmed the record.

attributes.name: verification_source
attributes.description: The source from which the immunization record was verified. Self-reported indicates student-provided documentation; provider-verified indicates confirmation from a healthcare provider; state registry indicates data pulled from state immunization information systems; school record indicates transfer from prior educational institution; military record indicates documentation from military service; international record indicates foreign healthcare documentation.

attributes.description: Self-referencing FK on immunization_record (booster_immunization_record_id)

products.name: hall_service_provision
products.description: This association product represents the ongoing IT service delivery contract between a residence hall and an IT service. It captures the specific configuration, service tier, bandwidth allocation, port count, cost allocation, and SLA commitments for each hall-service pairing. Each record links one residence hall to one IT service with attributes that exist only in the context of this provisioning relationship, enabling residential IT service management, cost recovery, and SLA tracking.. Existence Justification: Residence halls consume multiple IT services simultaneously (network connectivity, cable TV, phone service, security camera systems, card access, printing services, learning management system access), and each IT service is delivered to multiple residence halls across campus. The business actively manages these provisioning relationships with hall-specific service tiers, bandwidth allocations, port counts, monthly cost allocations for chargeback, and SLA commitments that vary by hall priority and service type.

attributes.description: Date of the most recent service review or assessment for this hall-service provisioning. Used to track periodic reviews of service adequacy, performance, and cost.

attributes.name: monthly_cost

attributes.name: port_count

attributes.name: provision_status

attributes.name: service_contact_name

attributes.name: service_tier
attributes.description: Service level tier provisioned for this hall-service combination (e.g., standard, enhanced, premium). Determines feature set, bandwidth, and support level specific to this provisioning.

attributes.name: sla_level
attributes.description: Service level agreement tier specific to this hall-service provisioning (e.g., gold, silver, bronze). May differ from the service's default SLA based on hall priority or contract.

products.name: org_application_access
products.description: This association product represents the provisioned access relationship between student organizations and enterprise applications. It captures the business process of granting, managing, and tracking application access for student organizations, including access levels, provisioning lifecycle, usage purpose, and cost allocation. Each record links one student organization to one enterprise application with attributes that exist only in the context of this access grant.. Existence Justification: Student organizations require access to multiple enterprise applications to support their operations (financial systems for budget tracking, collaboration tools for member communication, event management platforms, etc.), and each enterprise application serves multiple student organizations across the institution. The IT department actively manages this many-to-many relationship through an application access provisioning process that tracks access levels, approval workflows, provisioning dates, expiration cycles, usage purposes, and cost allocation for chargeback purposes.

attributes.name: approval_status

attributes.name: approver_name

products.name: identity_account
products.description: Master record for every institutional digital identity and associated system account provisioned for students, faculty, staff, alumni, and sponsored guests. Captures NetID/username, display name, primary email address, account type (student, faculty, staff, sponsored), account status (active, suspended, disabled, expired), password policy group, multi-factor authentication (MFA) enrollment status, account creation date, last login timestamp, account expiration date, and source identity system (Banner, Workday, manual). Serves as the SSOT for identity and access management (IAM) and feeds single sign-on (SSO), directory services (Active Directory/LDAP), and provisioning workflows.

attributes.name: identity_account_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the institutional digital identity account record. Primary key for the identity_account product.
attributes.references: Internal Identity and Access Management (IAM) Standard

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: The institutional employee identifier for faculty and staff accounts. Sourced from Workday HCM or legacy HR systems. Null for student-only and alumni accounts. Used for payroll integration, benefits administration, and HR reporting.
attributes.references: Workday HCM; Human Resources Information System (HRIS) Standards

attributes.name: profile_id
attributes.description: The institutional student identifier for enrolled or former student accounts. Sourced from Ellucian Banner Student Information System (SIS). Null for non-student accounts. Used for academic records, financial aid, and student services integration.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner SIS; FERPA (Family Educational Rights and Privacy Act)

attributes.name: access_level
attributes.description: The overall access privilege tier assigned to this account, determining the scope of systems and data the account holder can access. Basic for limited guest access; standard for typical student/staff access; elevated for accounts requiring access to sensitive data; privileged for IT staff with system administration rights; administrative for accounts with full institutional access.
attributes.references: Identity and Access Management (IAM) Access Control Policy; Role-Based Access Control (RBAC) Framework

attributes.name: account_creation_date
attributes.description: The date on which this identity account was originally provisioned in the institutional identity management system. This is the official start date of the account's lifecycle and is used for audit and compliance reporting.
attributes.references: Identity and Access Management (IAM) Audit Standards

attributes.name: account_deactivation_date
attributes.description: The date on which this identity account was permanently deactivated or disabled. Null for active accounts. Once deactivated, accounts typically enter a grace period before data is archived or purged according to retention policies.
attributes.references: Identity and Access Management (IAM) Lifecycle Policy; Data Retention Policy

attributes.name: account_expiration_date
attributes.description: The date on which this identity account is scheduled to expire and be automatically disabled. Nullable for accounts with indefinite validity (e.g., permanent staff). For students and sponsored accounts, this is typically tied to graduation date or sponsorship end date.
attributes.references: Identity and Access Management (IAM) Lifecycle Policy

attributes.name: account_locked
attributes.description: Indicates whether the account is currently locked due to excessive failed login attempts, security policy violation, or administrative action. True if locked and authentication is blocked; false if unlocked and authentication is permitted. Locked accounts require administrator intervention or automatic unlock after a timeout period.
attributes.references: Identity and Access Management (IAM) Security Policy; Incident Response Procedures

attributes.name: account_notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for administrative notes, special instructions, or context about this identity account. May include information about access exceptions, security incidents, or account history. Used by IT support staff and identity administrators.
attributes.references: Identity and Access Management (IAM) Operations Procedures

attributes.name: account_status
attributes.description: The current lifecycle state of the identity account. Active accounts have full access; suspended accounts are temporarily blocked pending investigation or compliance action; disabled accounts are permanently deactivated; expired accounts have passed their validity period; pending accounts are awaiting provisioning or approval.
attributes.references: Identity and Access Management (IAM) Lifecycle Policy

attributes.name: account_type
attributes.description: The primary classification of the identity account based on the holder's relationship to the institution. Determines access privileges, resource entitlements, and lifecycle policies. Student accounts are for enrolled learners; faculty for instructional staff; staff for administrative and support personnel; alumni for graduates; sponsored for external collaborators; affiliate for contractors and temporary workers.
attributes.references: Institutional Identity Classification Policy; eduPerson Affiliation

attributes.name: alternate_email
attributes.description: A secondary or personal email address provided by the account holder for account recovery, notifications when the primary institutional email is unavailable, or alumni forwarding. Nullable if not provided.
attributes.references: Institutional Email Policy; Account Recovery Procedures

attributes.name: alumni_status
attributes.description: The alumni relationship status for accounts associated with graduates. Not_alumni for current students and non-graduates; active_alumni for engaged graduates with current contact information; lapsed_alumni for graduates with outdated contact information or no recent engagement; deceased for graduates who have passed away. Used for alumni services and advancement operations.
attributes.references: Alumni Relations Policy; Advancement Data Standards

attributes.name: compliance_training_completed
attributes.description: Indicates whether the account holder has completed required institutional compliance training (e.g., FERPA, cybersecurity awareness, Title IX, research ethics). True if all required training is current; false if training is incomplete or expired. May be used to gate access to certain systems or data.
attributes.references: Institutional Compliance Training Policy; FERPA Training Requirements

attributes.name: compliance_training_date
attributes.description: The date on which the account holder most recently completed required institutional compliance training. Null if training has never been completed. Used to track training currency and trigger renewal notifications.

attributes.name: deactivation_reason
attributes.description: The primary reason why this identity account was deactivated. Graduation for students who completed their program; employment_termination for faculty/staff who left the institution; withdrawal for students who left before completing; expiration for accounts that reached their validity period; security_violation for accounts disabled due to policy breach; request for voluntary account closure.
attributes.references: Identity and Access Management (IAM) Lifecycle Policy; Human Resources Offboarding Procedures

attributes.name: department_code
attributes.description: The organizational department or academic unit to which this account holder is primarily affiliated. For students, this is typically their major department; for faculty and staff, this is their employing department. Used for access control, resource allocation, and organizational reporting.
attributes.references: Institutional Organizational Hierarchy; Human Resources Department Taxonomy

attributes.name: directory_visible
attributes.description: Indicates whether this account and its associated contact information are visible in the institutional directory (LDAP, web directory, email address book). True if the account holder has opted in to directory listing; false if they have opted out for privacy reasons. FERPA-protected students may default to false.
attributes.references: FERPA (Family Educational Rights and Privacy Act); Institutional Directory Policy

attributes.name: display_name
attributes.description: The full human-readable name of the account holder as it appears in institutional directories, email clients, and user interfaces. Typically formatted as 'FirstName LastName' or 'LastName, FirstName'.

attributes.name: failed_login_attempts
attributes.description: The cumulative count of consecutive failed authentication attempts since the last successful login. Reset to zero upon successful authentication. Used to trigger account lockout when the threshold is exceeded and to detect potential brute-force attacks.
attributes.references: Identity and Access Management (IAM) Security Policy; NIST SP 800-63B

attributes.name: ferpa_protected
attributes.business_glossary_term: FERPA (Family Educational Rights and Privacy Act) Protected
attributes.description: Indicates whether this account is subject to enhanced privacy protections under FERPA. True for student accounts where the student has requested directory information suppression; false otherwise. FERPA-protected accounts have restricted visibility in directories and reports.
attributes.references: FERPA (Family Educational Rights and Privacy Act); 34 CFR Part 99

attributes.name: graduation_year
attributes.description: The year in which the account holder graduated or is expected to graduate from the institution. Null for non-student accounts or students who have not yet declared an expected graduation date. Used for alumni segmentation, reunion planning, and lifecycle transitions.
attributes.references: Ellucian Banner SIS; Alumni Relations Policy

attributes.name: last_login_timestamp
attributes.description: The most recent date and time the account holder successfully authenticated to any institutional system via single sign-on (SSO). Used for dormant account detection, security monitoring, and user engagement analytics. Null if the account has never been used.
attributes.references: Identity and Access Management (IAM) Audit Standards; Security Information and Event Management (SIEM) Policy

attributes.name: last_modified_by
attributes.description: The NetID or system identifier of the user or automated process that last modified this identity account record. Used for audit trails and accountability in identity lifecycle management.
attributes.references: Identity and Access Management (IAM) Audit Standards; Data Governance Policy

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when any attribute of this identity account record was last updated. Used for change tracking, audit trails, and synchronization with downstream systems.
attributes.references: Identity and Access Management (IAM) Audit Standards; Data Governance Policy

attributes.name: last_password_change_date
attributes.description: The date on which the account password was most recently changed by the user or reset by an administrator. Used to enforce password rotation policies and identify accounts with stale credentials.

attributes.name: legal_name
attributes.description: The full legal name of the account holder as it appears on official government-issued identification documents. May differ from display_name if the account holder uses a preferred name. Used for official records, financial aid, payroll, and compliance reporting.
attributes.references: FERPA (Family Educational Rights and Privacy Act); Human Resources Records Policy

attributes.name: lockout_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the account was most recently locked. Null if the account has never been locked or if the most recent lock has been cleared. Used for security incident investigation and automatic unlock scheduling.
attributes.references: Identity and Access Management (IAM) Security Policy; Security Information and Event Management (SIEM) Policy

attributes.name: mfa_enrolled
attributes.description: Indicates whether the account holder has enrolled in multi-factor authentication (MFA). True if at least one MFA method (authenticator app, SMS, hardware token) is registered; false otherwise. MFA enrollment may be required for certain account types or access levels.
attributes.references: Institutional Multi-Factor Authentication Policy; NIST SP 800-63B

attributes.name: mfa_method
attributes.description: The primary multi-factor authentication method registered for this account. Authenticator app includes TOTP-based apps like Google Authenticator or Duo; SMS sends one-time codes via text message; hardware token includes YubiKey or RSA SecurID; biometric includes fingerprint or facial recognition; backup codes are single-use recovery codes.
attributes.references: Institutional Multi-Factor Authentication Policy; NIST SP 800-63B

attributes.name: netid
attributes.description: The unique institutional username or network identifier assigned to the user. This is the primary login credential used across all institutional systems and serves as the canonical identifier for single sign-on (SSO) and directory services.
attributes.references: Institutional Identity Management Policy; eduPerson Schema

attributes.name: password_policy_group
attributes.description: The password complexity and rotation policy tier assigned to this account. Standard applies to most users; elevated for accounts with access to sensitive data; administrative for IT staff and system administrators; service for application service accounts with extended validity periods.
attributes.references: Institutional Password Policy; NIST SP 800-63B Digital Identity Guidelines

attributes.name: password_reset_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether the account holder must reset their password at next login. True when an administrator forces a password reset due to security incident, policy violation, or initial provisioning; false for normal operation.
attributes.references: Institutional Password Policy; Incident Response Procedures

attributes.name: phone_number
attributes.description: The primary contact phone number for the account holder. Used for SMS-based multi-factor authentication, account recovery, and emergency notifications. Should be in E.164 international format when possible.
attributes.references: FERPA (Family Educational Rights and Privacy Act); Institutional Contact Information Policy

attributes.name: preferred_name
attributes.description: The name the account holder prefers to be called in non-official contexts, such as class rosters, email signatures, and informal communications. Nullable if the account holder has not specified a preferred name different from their legal name. Supports inclusive practices for transgender and non-binary individuals.
attributes.references: Institutional Preferred Name Policy; Title IX Guidelines

attributes.name: primary_email
attributes.description: The primary institutional email address associated with this identity account. This is the official communication channel for institutional correspondence and serves as the primary contact method for password resets and account notifications.
attributes.references: Institutional Email Policy; FERPA (Family Educational Rights and Privacy Act)

attributes.name: pronouns
attributes.description: The personal pronouns the account holder uses (e.g., she/her, he/him, they/them, ze/zir). Nullable if not provided. Used to support inclusive communication and respect for gender identity. May be displayed in directory listings and email signatures.
attributes.references: Institutional Diversity and Inclusion Policy; Title IX Guidelines

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: The authoritative system of record from which this identity account was originally provisioned or synchronized. Banner for student accounts sourced from the Student Information System (SIS); Workday for employee accounts from Human Capital Management (HCM); manual for accounts created directly in the identity management system; LDAP for legacy directory imports; SAML federation for federated external identities.
attributes.references: Identity and Access Management (IAM) Integration Architecture; System of Record (SOR) Policy

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: The unique identifier for this person in the source system of record. For Banner-sourced accounts, this is the Banner PIDM or student ID; for Workday-sourced accounts, this is the Workday Employee ID. Used for reconciliation and synchronization between the identity system and upstream systems.
attributes.references: Identity and Access Management (IAM) Integration Architecture; Data Integration Standards

attributes.name: sponsor_netid
attributes.description: For sponsored guest accounts, the NetID of the institutional faculty or staff member who is responsible for this account and has authorized its creation. Null for non-sponsored accounts. The sponsor is accountable for the guest's access and must renew or terminate the sponsorship.
attributes.references: Sponsored Account Policy; Identity and Access Management (IAM) Governance

attributes.name: sponsorship_end_date
attributes.description: For sponsored guest accounts, the date on which the sponsorship expires and the account should be deactivated. Null for non-sponsored accounts. Sponsored accounts are typically created for external collaborators, visiting researchers, or contractors and require a faculty or staff sponsor.
attributes.references: Sponsored Account Policy; Identity and Access Management (IAM) Lifecycle Policy

attributes.name: sso_enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether this account is enabled for single sign-on (SSO) across institutional applications. True if the account can authenticate via the central identity provider (Shibboleth, SAML, CAS); false if SSO is disabled and direct authentication is required.
attributes.references: Single Sign-On (SSO) Policy; SAML (Security Assertion Markup Language) Standards

attributes.name: linked_identity_account_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing FK on identity_account (linked_identity_account_id)

products.name: access_entitlement
products.description: Master record defining a specific access right, role, or permission set that can be granted to an identity account, covering application roles, network access groups, shared drive permissions, VPN profiles, and privileged access levels. Captures entitlement name, entitlement type (role, group, permission), target system or application, access level (read, write, admin), approval workflow required flag, maximum grant duration, and owner department. Enables role-based access control (RBAC) governance, access certification campaigns, and least-privilege enforcement.

attributes.name: access_entitlement_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the access entitlement record. Primary key for the access entitlement entity.

attributes.name: approval_workflow_id
attributes.description: Foreign key reference to the approval workflow process that must be completed before this entitlement can be granted. Null if no approval is required.
attributes.references: ISO/IEC 27001 A.9.2.1 User Registration and De-registration

attributes.name: enterprise_application_id
attributes.description: Foreign key reference to the application or system record in the enterprise application portfolio that this entitlement controls access to.

attributes.name: org_unit_id
attributes.description: Foreign key reference to the organizational unit or department that owns this entitlement and is accountable for access reviews and certification.

attributes.name: access_entitlement_description
attributes.description: Detailed description of what access rights, capabilities, and responsibilities this entitlement grants. Used to help requesters and approvers understand the scope and purpose of the entitlement.
attributes.references: ISO/IEC 27001 A.9.2.1 User Registration and De-registration

attributes.name: access_entitlement_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the entitlement. Active entitlements can be granted; Inactive entitlements are disabled but retained for historical reference; Deprecated entitlements are being phased out; Pending Review entitlements await certification; Suspended entitlements are temporarily disabled due to security concerns.
attributes.references: ISO/IEC 27001 A.9.2.6 Removal or Adjustment of Access Rights

attributes.name: access_level
attributes.description: The level or scope of access granted by this entitlement. Read allows viewing data; Write allows creating and updating; Admin allows configuration and user management; Execute allows running processes; Full Control allows all operations including deletion and permission changes. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: read|write|admin|execute|full_control|modify|contribute|view_only — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: active_assignment_count
attributes.description: Current number of identities that have been granted this entitlement and have active assignments. Used for license management and access analytics.
attributes.references: ISO/IEC 27001 A.9.2.5 Review of User Access Rights

attributes.name: allows_bulk_operations
attributes.description: Indicates whether this entitlement permits bulk data operations such as mass updates, batch exports, or bulk deletions. Bulk operation capabilities increase risk and require additional oversight.

attributes.name: allows_data_export
attributes.description: Indicates whether this entitlement permits exporting or downloading data from the target system. Export capabilities require data loss prevention monitoring.

attributes.name: auto_revoke_on_expiry
attributes.description: Indicates whether the entitlement should be automatically revoked when the grant duration expires (True) or requires manual review (False).
attributes.references: NIST SP 800-53 AC-2(3) Disable Inactive Accounts

attributes.name: business_justification
attributes.description: Business rationale for why this entitlement exists and what job functions or roles require it. Used during access reviews to validate continued need.
attributes.references: ISO/IEC 27001 A.9.2.5 Review of User Access Rights

attributes.name: business_owner_email
attributes.description: Email address of the business owner for this entitlement, used for access request notifications and certification campaigns.
attributes.references: ISO/IEC 27001 A.9.2.5 Review of User Access Rights

attributes.name: business_owner_name
attributes.description: Full name of the individual who serves as the business owner for this entitlement, responsible for approving access requests and conducting periodic access reviews.
attributes.references: ISO/IEC 27001 A.9.2.5 Review of User Access Rights

attributes.name: certification_frequency_days
attributes.description: Number of days between required access certification reviews for this entitlement. Common values are 90, 180, or 365 days. Used to schedule periodic access reviews and attestation campaigns.
attributes.references: ISO/IEC 27001 A.9.2.5 Review of User Access Rights

attributes.name: compliance_framework
attributes.description: Regulatory or compliance framework that governs this entitlement. Examples include 'FERPA' (Family Educational Rights and Privacy Act), 'HIPAA' (for university health centers), 'PCI-DSS' (for payment systems), 'FISMA' (for federally funded research), 'GLBA' (for financial aid), 'SOX' (for financial systems).

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this entitlement record was first created in the identity and access management system.

attributes.name: data_classification_level
attributes.description: Highest level of data classification that this entitlement grants access to. Restricted includes FERPA-protected student records, PHI, PCI data; Confidential includes internal business data; Internal includes operational data; Public includes publicly available information.

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: Date when this entitlement definition will be or was retired and no longer available for new assignments. Null indicates no planned end date.

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: Date when this entitlement definition became active and available for assignment to identities.

attributes.name: entitlement_category
attributes.description: High-level classification of the type of resource or capability this entitlement controls. Application Access covers enterprise applications; Network Access covers VPN and network segments; Data Access covers databases and file systems; Physical Access covers building and room entry; Privileged Access covers administrative and elevated rights; Shared Resource covers collaborative spaces and drives.
attributes.references: ISO/IEC 27001 A.9.1 Business Requirements of Access Control

attributes.name: entitlement_code
attributes.description: Business identifier code for the entitlement, used for external reference and integration with identity management systems. Typically follows organizational naming conventions for role and permission identifiers.

attributes.name: entitlement_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name of the access entitlement, describing the role, permission set, or access right being granted. Examples include 'Faculty Portal Admin', 'Student Records Read-Only', 'Financial Aid Counselor', 'Research Grant Manager'.

attributes.name: entitlement_type
attributes.description: Classification of the entitlement mechanism. Role represents a collection of permissions assigned as a unit; Group represents membership-based access; Permission represents a specific action right; Privilege represents elevated access; Profile represents a configuration template.

attributes.name: ferpa_protected
attributes.business_glossary_term: Family Educational Rights and Privacy Act (FERPA) Protected Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this entitlement grants access to FERPA-protected student education records. True requires additional compliance controls and audit logging per federal regulations.

attributes.name: is_privileged
attributes.description: Indicates whether this entitlement grants privileged or administrative access that allows modification of system configurations, security settings, or access to sensitive data. Privileged entitlements require enhanced monitoring and stricter controls.

attributes.name: is_sod_restricted
attributes.business_glossary_term: Is Segregation of Duties (SOD) Restricted Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this entitlement is subject to segregation of duties controls and cannot be granted in combination with certain other entitlements to prevent fraud or conflicts of interest.

attributes.name: last_certification_date
attributes.description: Date when this entitlement was last reviewed and certified by the business owner as still required and appropriately scoped.
attributes.references: ISO/IEC 27001 A.9.2.5 Review of User Access Rights

attributes.name: maximum_grant_duration_days
attributes.description: Maximum number of days this entitlement can be granted to an identity before it must be reviewed or renewed. Null indicates no time limit. Used to enforce time-bound access for temporary roles, contractors, and high-risk entitlements.
attributes.references: NIST SP 800-53 AC-2(3) Disable Inactive Accounts

attributes.name: mfa_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether multi-factor authentication is required to exercise this entitlement. True for high-risk and privileged entitlements per institutional security policy.

attributes.name: modified_by
attributes.description: Username or identifier of the administrator who last modified this entitlement definition.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this entitlement record was last modified or updated.

attributes.name: network_zone
attributes.description: Network access zone from which this entitlement can be exercised. Campus restricts to on-campus network; VPN requires VPN connection; Remote allows any authenticated connection; Partner allows access from partner institutions; Public allows internet access.

attributes.name: next_certification_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date for the next access certification review of this entitlement. Calculated based on last certification date plus certification frequency.
attributes.references: ISO/IEC 27001 A.9.2.5 Review of User Access Rights

attributes.name: owner_department
attributes.description: Name of the academic or administrative department that owns and is responsible for this entitlement. Examples include 'Information Technology Services', 'Office of the Registrar', 'Financial Aid Office', 'Human Resources', 'Research Administration'.
attributes.references: ISO/IEC 27001 A.9.2.3 Management of Privileged Access Rights

attributes.name: requires_approval
attributes.description: Indicates whether granting this entitlement to an identity requires formal approval workflow. True for sensitive or privileged entitlements; False for standard self-service entitlements.
attributes.references: ISO/IEC 27001 A.9.2.1 User Registration and De-registration

attributes.name: risk_level
attributes.description: Risk classification of the entitlement based on the sensitivity of data and operations it grants access to. Critical entitlements require highest scrutiny and approval; High entitlements access sensitive data (FERPA, financial); Medium entitlements access internal operational data; Low entitlements access public or non-sensitive resources.

attributes.name: sod_conflict_group
attributes.description: Identifier for the SOD conflict group this entitlement belongs to. Entitlements in the same conflict group cannot be granted to the same identity simultaneously. Examples include 'FINANCE_APPROVE_PAY', 'STUDENT_RECORDS_MODIFY_GRADE'.

attributes.name: target_system
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the application, system, or platform to which this entitlement grants access. Examples include 'Banner SIS', 'Canvas LMS', 'Workday HCM', 'Active Directory', 'Oracle Financials', 'Slate CRM', 'VPN Gateway', 'Shared Drive Infrastructure'.

attributes.name: technical_owner_name
attributes.description: Full name of the IT staff member or system administrator who serves as the technical owner for this entitlement, responsible for provisioning and de-provisioning access.
attributes.references: ISO/IEC 27001 A.9.2.6 Removal or Adjustment of Access Rights

attributes.name: usage_guidelines
attributes.description: Instructions and guidelines for appropriate use of this entitlement, including acceptable use policies, restrictions, and responsibilities of users who are granted this access.

attributes.name: created_by
attributes.description: Username or identifier of the administrator who created this entitlement definition.

attributes.name: parent_access_entitlement_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing FK on access_entitlement (parent_access_entitlement_id)

products.name: access_provisioning_event
products.description: Transactional record of every access grant, modification, or revocation applied to an identity account for a specific entitlement. Captures provisioning action type (grant, modify, revoke), target identity account, entitlement granted or revoked, requesting party, approving party, approval timestamp, effective date, expiration date, provisioning method (automated joiner-mover-leaver, manual request, access review), and source trigger (HR event, student enrollment, manual request). Provides the authoritative audit trail for access provisioning required by SOX, FERPA, and institutional security policy.

attributes.name: access_provisioning_event_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the access provisioning event. Primary key for this transactional record of access grant, modification, or revocation.
attributes.references: Internal Identity and Access Management (IAM) Standard

attributes.name: access_certification_id
attributes.description: Reference to the access certification campaign that resulted in this provisioning event (for revocations or modifications identified during periodic access reviews).

attributes.name: access_entitlement_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific entitlement (role, permission, group membership, or access right) being granted, modified, or revoked in this event.

attributes.name: enterprise_application_id
attributes.description: Reference to the enterprise application or system where the access was provisioned (e.g., Banner, Workday, Canvas, Active Directory).

attributes.name: primary_access_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the identity (person or system) who requested this access provisioning. Null for automated system-initiated events.

attributes.name: primary_access_identity_account_id
attributes.description: Reference to the identity account (user, service account, or system account) that is the target of this provisioning action.

attributes.name: provisioning_request_id
attributes.description: Reference to the originating access request that triggered this provisioning event. Null for automated joiner-mover-leaver events.

attributes.name: quaternary_access_sod_exception_approved_by_employee_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: SOD Exception Approved By Identity ID
attributes.description: Reference to the senior manager or compliance officer who approved the segregation of duties exception. Required when sod_conflict_detected is true.

attributes.name: target_system_account_identity_account_id
attributes.description: The native account identifier in the target system where the entitlement was provisioned (e.g., Active Directory SamAccountName, Banner PIDM, Workday User ID).

attributes.name: tertiary_access_executed_by_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the identity (IAM administrator or automated service account) that executed the provisioning action in the target system.

attributes.name: action_type
attributes.description: Type of provisioning action performed: grant (new access), modify (change existing access), revoke (remove access), suspend (temporary disable), restore (re-enable), or extend (renew expiration).

attributes.name: approval_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the provisioning request was approved by the authorizing party. Required for manual requests; null for automated events.

attributes.name: audit_log_reference
attributes.description: Reference to the detailed audit log entry in the target system for this provisioning event. Enables cross-system audit trail correlation.

attributes.name: business_justification
attributes.description: Free-text explanation of the business need for this access grant or modification. Required for manual requests and high-risk entitlements per SOX and institutional security policy.

attributes.name: compliance_framework
attributes.description: Primary regulatory or policy framework governing this access provisioning event (FERPA for student data, SOX for financial systems, HIPAA for health records, institutional policy for general access). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: ferpa|sox|hipaa|pci_dss|fisma|gdpr|ccpa|institutional_policy — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: FERPA 34 CFR Part 99, SOX Section 404, HIPAA Security Rule

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this provisioning event record was first created in the IAM system. Used for audit trail and data lineage.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date when the granted or modified access becomes active and usable by the identity. May be future-dated for scheduled access grants.

attributes.name: emergency_access_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this was an emergency access grant bypassing normal approval workflows. Requires post-facto review and justification per institutional security policy.

attributes.name: emergency_justification
attributes.description: Detailed explanation for emergency access grant, including incident reference and business impact. Required when emergency_access_flag is true.

attributes.name: error_code
attributes.description: System error code returned by the target system if provisioning failed. Used for troubleshooting and root cause analysis.

attributes.name: error_message
attributes.description: Detailed error message returned by the target system if provisioning failed. Used for troubleshooting and root cause analysis.

attributes.name: event_number
attributes.description: Human-readable business identifier for this provisioning event, used in audit logs and compliance reports.

attributes.name: execution_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the provisioning action was executed in the target system. This is the principal business event timestamp for this transaction.

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: Date when the granted access automatically expires and is revoked. Null for permanent access grants. Required for temporary access and guest accounts per FERPA and institutional policy.
attributes.references: FERPA 34 CFR Part 99, NIST SP 800-53 AC-2

attributes.name: ip_address
attributes.description: IP address from which the provisioning request originated. Used for security monitoring and forensic analysis.

attributes.name: new_entitlement_value
attributes.description: For grant and modify actions, captures the new state of the entitlement after the change. Enables audit trail of access changes.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Additional free-text notes or comments about this provisioning event, entered by administrators or approvers.

attributes.name: previous_entitlement_value
attributes.description: For modify actions, captures the previous state of the entitlement before the change. Enables audit trail of access changes.

attributes.name: provisioning_duration_seconds
attributes.description: Time elapsed in seconds between provisioning initiation and completion. Used for SLA monitoring and performance analysis of IAM automation.

attributes.name: provisioning_method
attributes.description: Method by which this provisioning event was triggered: automated joiner-mover-leaver workflow, manual access request, periodic access review, emergency grant, or bulk import. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: automated_joiner|automated_mover|automated_leaver|manual_request|access_review|emergency_grant|bulk_import — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: provisioning_status
attributes.description: Current status of the provisioning workflow: pending (awaiting execution), in_progress (being applied), completed (successfully applied), failed (error occurred), or rolled_back (reverted due to failure).

attributes.name: request_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the access provisioning was requested. Null for automated system-initiated events.

attributes.name: retry_count
attributes.description: Number of times the provisioning action was retried after initial failure. Used for reliability monitoring of IAM automation.

attributes.name: revocation_reason
attributes.description: Reason for access revocation: employee/student termination, role change, access review finding, security incident response, policy violation, no longer needed, or system decommission. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: termination|role_change|access_review|security_incident|policy_violation|no_longer_needed|system_decommission — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: risk_level
attributes.description: Risk classification of the entitlement being provisioned, based on data sensitivity and privilege level. High and critical access requires additional approval workflows.

attributes.name: segregation_of_duties_check
attributes.description: Indicates whether a segregation of duties conflict check was performed before granting this access. Required for financial system access per SOX.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404, COSO Internal Control Framework

attributes.name: session_reference
attributes.description: Unique session identifier for the provisioning request. Enables correlation of multiple provisioning events within a single user session.

attributes.name: sod_conflict_detected
attributes.description: Indicates whether a segregation of duties conflict was detected during the provisioning workflow. True requires exception approval from senior management.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404, COSO Internal Control Framework

attributes.name: trigger_source
attributes.description: Source event or system that triggered this provisioning action: HR event (hire, termination, transfer), student enrollment, manual request, access certification review, role change, policy update, or security incident response. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: hr_event|student_enrollment|manual_request|access_certification|role_change|policy_update|security_incident — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this provisioning event record was last modified in the IAM system. Used for audit trail and data lineage.

attributes.name: user_agent
attributes.description: Browser or client application user agent string for the provisioning request. Used for security monitoring and user experience analysis.

attributes.name: reversal_access_provisioning_event_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing FK on access_provisioning_event (reversal_access_provisioning_event_id)

products.name: service_request
products.description: Core transactional record for every IT service desk request submitted by students, faculty, or staff through the institutional ITSM platform (e.g., ServiceNow, Cherwell, Jira Service Management). Captures ticket number, request category (hardware, software, access, network, account, AV/classroom tech), request subcategory, requester identity, affected user, priority level, service level agreement (SLA) tier, submission channel (portal, email, phone, walk-in), assigned technician, assigned team, current status (open, in-progress, pending, resolved, closed), open timestamp, SLA due timestamp, resolution timestamp, resolution notes, and customer satisfaction score. Serves as the SSOT for IT service delivery operations.

attributes.name: service_request_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the IT service desk request. Primary key for the service request entity.

attributes.name: incident_id
attributes.description: Identifier of a related incident ticket if this service request is linked to a broader system outage or known issue. Enables correlation analysis and root cause investigation.
attributes.references: ITIL v4 Incident and Problem Management

attributes.name: it_asset_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the IT asset (hardware device, software license, network equipment) associated with the service request. Links to the institutional Configuration Management Database (CMDB).

attributes.name: it_service_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to technology.it_service. Business justification: Service requests are submitted for specific IT catalog services. This FK links service desk operations to the service catalog, enabling request volume analysis per service and service portfolio manage

attributes.name: knowledge_article_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the knowledge base article used to resolve the service request or created as a result of this request. Supports knowledge management and self-service capabilities.

attributes.name: primary_service_employee_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the person who submitted the service request. May be a student, faculty member, or staff member. Links to the institutional identity management system.

attributes.name: tertiary_service_assigned_technician_employee_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the IT support technician currently assigned to resolve the service request. Links to the HR or staff directory system.
attributes.references: ITIL v4 Incident and Request Management

attributes.name: acknowledged_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the service request was first acknowledged by a technician or automatically by the system. Used to measure initial response time against SLA targets.

attributes.name: actual_effort_hours
attributes.description: Actual number of labor hours spent resolving the service request, as logged by the assigned technician. Used for performance analysis, cost tracking, and process improvement.

attributes.name: assigned_team
attributes.description: Name of the IT support team or functional group responsible for resolving the request (e.g., Desktop Support, Network Operations, Application Support, Identity Management, Classroom Technology Services).

attributes.name: closed_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the service request was formally closed after requester confirmation or auto-closure. Marks the end of the request lifecycle.

attributes.name: cost_center
attributes.description: Financial cost center to which any service charges or labor costs should be allocated. Used for chargeback models and budget tracking.

attributes.name: customer_feedback
attributes.description: Free-text comments provided by the requester in the post-resolution satisfaction survey. Captures qualitative feedback on service quality, technician performance, or process improvements.

attributes.name: customer_satisfaction_score
