products.name: asset_software_installation
products.description: This association product represents the installation relationship between IT assets and software licenses. It captures the operational reality that a single IT asset can have multiple software packages installed (operating system, productivity suite, specialized applications), and a single software license (especially site licenses, concurrent licenses, or multi-seat licenses) can be deployed across multiple physical or virtual assets. Each record represents one software installation on one asset, tracking installation lifecycle, compliance status, and verification history.. Existence Justification: In higher education IT operations, a single IT asset (workstation, server, laptop) routinely has multiple software packages installed simultaneously—operating system, productivity suite, specialized academic applications, security tools. Conversely, a single software license (particularly site licenses, concurrent licenses, or multi-seat volume licenses) is deployed across multiple physical and virtual assets throughout the institution. Software asset management (SAM) systems actively track each installation as a distinct operational record with installation dates, compliance status, version tracking, and verification history.

products.name: roster
products.description: Transactional record associating a student-athlete with a specific team for a specific academic year and term. Represents the official roster slot. attributes.description: The hometown or city of origin of the student-athlete, typically used for roster publication and media guides.

attributes.description: For evaluation contacts, specifies the type of athletic activity being observed (e.g., game, practice, workout, combine, camp, showcase). Used to track evaluation opportunities against NCAA limits.

attributes.name: family_members_present
attributes.description: Names or relationship descriptions of family members who participated in or were present during the recruiting contact (e.g., mother, father, guardian, sibling).

attributes.name: high_school_coach_present
attributes.description: Indicates whether the prospect's high school or club coach was present during the recruiting contact or evaluation.

attributes.name: initiator_role
attributes.description: The official role or title of the staff member who made the contact. Important for compliance as different roles have different recruiting privileges under NCAA rules.

attributes.name: next_contact_planned_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date for the next planned recruiting contact or follow-up with this prospect. Used for recruiting workflow management.

attributes.name: offer_extended
attributes.description: Indicates whether a formal scholarship offer or roster spot commitment was extended to the prospect during this contact.

attributes.name: offer_type
attributes.description: Classification of the scholarship or roster offer extended (e.g., full scholarship, partial scholarship, preferred walk-on, recruited walk-on).

attributes.name: official_visit_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this contact was part of an official visit paid for by the institution. Official visits are limited in number and subject to strict NCAA regulations.

attributes.name: permissibility_review_date
attributes.description: Date when the compliance office reviewed and determined the permissibility status of this recruiting contact.

attributes.name: permissibility_status
attributes.description: Compliance determination indicating whether the recruiting contact was permissible under NCAA rules, impermissible (violation), under review by compliance office, or waived through exception process.

attributes.name: prospect_family_present
attributes.description: Indicates whether the prospect's family members (parents, guardians, or legal representatives) were present during the recruiting contact. Important for compliance documentation.

attributes.name: prospect_interest_level
attributes.description: Coaching staff's assessment of the prospect's interest level in the program following this contact (high, medium, low, undecided, committed elsewhere). Used for recruiting pipeline management.

attributes.name: record_created_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp when this recruiting contact record was first created in the athletics compliance system. Used for audit trail and data lineage.

attributes.name: record_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp when this recruiting contact record was last modified. Tracks changes to compliance status, notes, or other fields.

attributes.name: recruiting_class_year
attributes.description: The expected high school graduation year or recruiting class year of the prospect (e.g., 2024, 2025). Used to organize recruiting efforts by class cohort.

attributes.name: recruiting_period_type
attributes.description: Classification of the recruiting calendar period during which the contact occurred. NCAA defines four period types: contact period (in-person and off-campus contact allowed), evaluation period (in-person evaluation only, no contact), quiet period (on-campus contact only), dead period (no in-person contact).

attributes.name: scholarship_discussed
attributes.description: Indicates whether athletic scholarship opportunities or financial aid were discussed during this recruiting contact. Important for tracking offer timelines and compliance.

attributes.name: unofficial_visit_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this contact occurred during an unofficial visit where the prospect visited campus at their own expense.

attributes.name: visit_end_date
attributes.description: For official or unofficial visits, the date the campus visit concluded. Used to calculate total visit duration for compliance purposes.

attributes.name: visit_start_date
attributes.description: For official or unofficial visits, the date the campus visit began. Used to track visit duration and compliance with 48-hour official visit limits.

attributes.name: followup_recruiting_contact_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing FK on recruiting_contact (followup_recruiting_contact_id)

products.name: official_visit
products.description: Transactional record of an official paid campus visit by a prospective student-athlete, funded by the institution under NCAA/NAIA regulations. Captures recruit reference, sport, visit start date, visit end date, visit number (1st through 5th for NCAA), expenses paid (transportation/lodging/meals/entertainment), total visit cost, host student-athlete assigned, compliance pre-approval status, and post-visit compliance certification.

attributes.name: official_visit_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the official visit record. Primary key.

attributes.name: expense_cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Recruiting visit expenses are charged to team/sport cost centers for budget tracking and variance analysis. Enables athletic directors to monitor recruiting spending by sport against budgeted amounts

attributes.name: expense_ledger_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.ledger_account. Business justification: Official visit expenses (transportation, lodging, meals, entertainment tracked in total_visit_cost) must post to recruiting expense GL accounts for financial reporting and NCAA compliance. Required fo

attributes.name: host_student_athlete_id
attributes.description: Reference to the current student-athlete assigned to host the prospect during the visit.
attributes.references: NCAA Bylaw 13.6.7.7 - Entertainment During Official Visit

attributes.name: policy_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.policy. Business justification: Institutional visit policies govern approval processes, expense reimbursement, and entertainment restrictions. Real business process: visit pre-approval requires verification against institutional pol

attributes.name: primary_official_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the athletics staff member coordinating this official visit.
attributes.references: NCAA Bylaw 11 - Conduct and Employment of Athletics Personnel

attributes.name: prospect_id
attributes.description: Reference to the prospective student-athlete being recruited.

attributes.name: regulatory_requirement_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.regulatory_requirement. Business justification: Official visits governed by specific NCAA regulations (48-hour rule, expense limits, entertainment restrictions). Real business process: compliance pre-approval and post-certification of visits requir

attributes.name: sport_id
attributes.description: FK to athletics.sport

attributes.name: tertiary_official_compliance_post_certified_by_staff_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the compliance staff member who certified the visit post-completion.

attributes.name: academic_meeting_included_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether meetings with academic advisors or faculty were included in the official visit.

attributes.name: academic_year
attributes.description: Academic year during which the official visit takes place (e.g., 2023-2024).

attributes.name: accompanying_parent_guardian_count
attributes.description: Number of parents or legal guardians accompanying the prospect on the official visit (NCAA allows institution to pay for up to two).

attributes.name: accompanying_spouse_count
attributes.description: Number of spouses accompanying the prospect on the official visit (applicable for graduate transfers or older prospects).

attributes.name: athletic_event_attendance_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the prospect attended an athletic event during the official visit.
attributes.references: NCAA Bylaw 13.6.7.7 - Entertainment During Official Visit

attributes.name: athletic_facilities_tour_included_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a tour of athletic facilities was included in the official visit itinerary.

attributes.name: campus_tour_included_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a campus tour was included in the official visit itinerary.

attributes.name: compliance_post_certification_date
attributes.description: Date when the compliance office certified the official visit as compliant after completion.

attributes.name: compliance_post_certification_status
attributes.description: Status of compliance office post-visit certification confirming all expenses and activities were within NCAA regulations.

attributes.name: compliance_pre_approval_date
attributes.description: Date when the compliance office approved the official visit to proceed.

attributes.name: compliance_pre_approval_status
attributes.description: Status of compliance office pre-approval for the official visit before it occurs.

attributes.name: compliance_violation_description
attributes.description: Detailed description of any compliance violations identified related to this official visit.

attributes.name: compliance_violation_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether any NCAA compliance violations were identified during or after the official visit.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for all expense amounts. Typically USD for U.S. institutions.

attributes.name: division_level
attributes.description: Athletic division level of the institution conducting the official visit.

attributes.name: entertainment_expense_amount
attributes.description: Total amount paid by the institution for entertainment activities during the official visit (tickets to athletic events, campus activities, etc.).
attributes.references: NCAA Bylaw 13.6.7.7 - Entertainment During Official Visit

attributes.name: itinerary_description
attributes.description: Detailed description of the planned activities and schedule for the official visit.

attributes.name: lodging_expense_amount
attributes.description: Total amount paid by the institution for the prospect's lodging during the official visit.

attributes.name: meals_expense_amount
attributes.description: Total amount paid by the institution for meals provided to the prospect during the official visit.

attributes.name: record_created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this official visit record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: record_effective_date
attributes.description: Date from which this official visit record is effective for reporting and compliance purposes.

attributes.name: record_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this official visit record was last updated in the system.

attributes.name: recruiting_period_type
attributes.description: Type of NCAA recruiting period during which the official visit occurs (contact, evaluation, quiet, or dead period).

attributes.name: total_visit_cost
attributes.description: Total cost of the official visit paid by the institution, including all allowable expenses.

attributes.name: transportation_expense_amount
attributes.description: Total amount paid by the institution for the prospect's transportation to and from campus (airfare, mileage, etc.).

attributes.name: visit_end_date
attributes.description: Date when the official visit ends. Must be within 48 hours of start date per NCAA regulations.
attributes.references: NCAA Bylaw 13.6.2.2 - Duration of Official Visit

attributes.name: visit_end_timestamp
attributes.description: Precise date and time when the official visit ends, used for 48-hour compliance tracking.
attributes.references: NCAA Bylaw 13.6.2.2 - Duration of Official Visit

attributes.name: visit_notes
attributes.description: Additional notes or comments about the official visit from recruiting staff or compliance office.

attributes.name: visit_number
attributes.description: Sequential number of this official visit for the prospect (NCAA allows up to 5 official visits per prospect across all institutions).
attributes.references: NCAA Bylaw 13.6.2.1 - Number of Official Visits

attributes.name: visit_start_date
attributes.description: Date when the official visit begins. NCAA official visits may not exceed 48 hours.
attributes.references: NCAA Bylaw 13.6.2.2 - Duration of Official Visit

attributes.name: visit_start_timestamp
attributes.description: Precise date and time when the official visit begins, used for 48-hour compliance tracking.
attributes.references: NCAA Bylaw 13.6.2.2 - Duration of Official Visit

attributes.name: visit_status
attributes.description: Current status of the official visit in its lifecycle.

attributes.name: rescheduled_official_visit_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing FK on official_visit (rescheduled_official_visit_id)

products.name: game
products.description: Master record for each scheduled athletic contest (game, match, meet, regatta, tournament bout) for an institutional team. Captures team reference, opponent name, opponent institution code, game date, game time, venue, home/away/neutral site designation, game type (regular season/conference/non-conference/exhibition/scrimmage/postseason/tournament), game status (scheduled/completed/cancelled/postponed/forfeited), final score (home/away), outcome (win/loss/tie/no contest), attendance, broadcast information, and officials assigned.

attributes.name: game_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the athletic contest. Primary key.

attributes.name: athletic_facility_id
attributes.description: Reference to the facility record where the game is played.

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the staff member who certified the game result.

attributes.name: rescheduled_game_id
attributes.description: Reference to the new game record if this game was rescheduled.

attributes.name: sport_id
attributes.description: FK to athletics.sport

attributes.name: team_id
attributes.description: Reference to the institutional team participating in this game.

attributes.name: academic_year
attributes.description: Academic year in which the game occurs (e.g., 2024-2025).

attributes.name: attendance
attributes.description: Number of spectators who attended the game.

attributes.name: away_team_score
attributes.description: Final score for the away team. Null if game not completed.

attributes.name: broadcast_network
attributes.description: Television or streaming network broadcasting the game (e.g., ESPN, CBS Sports, conference network).

attributes.name: broadcast_type
attributes.description: Type of media broadcast for the game (television, streaming, radio, none).

attributes.name: cancellation_reason
attributes.description: Explanation for why the game was cancelled or postponed (e.g., weather, facility issue, COVID-19).

attributes.name: conference_game_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this game counts toward conference standings (True/False).

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the game record was first created in the system in yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX format.

attributes.name: datetime
attributes.description: Combined scheduled date and time of the game as a timestamp in yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX format.

attributes.name: game_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date of the athletic contest in yyyy-MM-dd format.

attributes.name: game_number
attributes.description: Business identifier for the game, often used in schedules and communications (e.g., G-2024-001).

attributes.name: game_status
attributes.description: Current status of the game in its lifecycle (scheduled, in progress, completed, cancelled, postponed, forfeited).

attributes.name: game_time
attributes.description: Scheduled start time of the game (e.g., 7:00 PM, 14:30).

attributes.name: game_type
attributes.description: Classification of the game (regular season, conference, non-conference, exhibition, scrimmage, postseason, tournament).

attributes.name: head_official_name
attributes.description: Name of the head referee or umpire for the game.

attributes.name: home_away_neutral
attributes.description: Indicates whether the game is played at the institutional home venue, away, or at a neutral site.

attributes.name: home_team_score
attributes.description: Final score for the home team. Null if game not completed.

attributes.name: institutional_score
attributes.description: Final score for the institution's team (home or away). Null if game not completed.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Additional notes or comments about the game (e.g., notable performances, records broken, special circumstances).

attributes.name: officials_assigned
attributes.description: Names of referees, umpires, or officials assigned to the game (comma-separated list).

attributes.name: opponent_institution_code
attributes.description: Standard code identifying the opposing institution (e.g., IPEDS UnitID or NCAA institution code).

attributes.name: opponent_name
attributes.description: Name of the opposing team or institution (e.g., University of Michigan, Ohio State).

attributes.name: opponent_score
attributes.description: Final score for the opposing team. Null if game not completed.

attributes.name: outcome
attributes.description: Result of the game from the institutional team's perspective (win, loss, tie, no contest, forfeit win, forfeit loss).

attributes.name: overtime_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the game went into overtime or extra innings (True/False).

attributes.name: overtime_periods
attributes.description: Number of overtime periods or extra innings played.

attributes.name: result_certified_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the game result has been officially certified by athletics administration (True/False).

attributes.name: result_certified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the game result was officially certified in yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX format.

attributes.name: season
attributes.description: Athletic season designation (e.g., Fall 2024, Spring 2025, 2024-2025).

attributes.name: ticket_revenue
attributes.description: Total revenue generated from ticket sales for this game in US dollars.

attributes.name: tournament_name
attributes.description: Name of the tournament if the game is part of a tournament (e.g., NCAA Division I Championship, Conference Tournament).

attributes.name: tournament_round
attributes.description: Round designation within a tournament (e.g., First Round, Quarterfinals, Semifinals, Finals).

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the game record was last updated in the system in yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX format.

attributes.name: venue_city
attributes.description: City where the game venue is located.

attributes.name: venue_name
attributes.description: Name of the facility where the game is played (e.g., Memorial Stadium, Alumni Arena).

attributes.name: venue_state
attributes.description: State or province where the game venue is located (two-letter abbreviation).

attributes.name: weather_conditions
attributes.description: Weather conditions at game time for outdoor events (e.g., sunny, rainy, temperature).

products.name: game_participation
products.description: Transactional record capturing each student-athlete's participation in a specific game or contest. Captures student-athlete reference, game reference, participation status (played/did not play/injured/suspended/ineligible), starter flag, minutes played or sets played, position played, individual statistics summary (sport-specific: points, rebounds, assists, yards, goals, times, etc.), and any disciplinary action during the contest.

attributes.name: game_participation_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for each student-athlete participation record in a specific game or contest. Primary key for the game participation entity.

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the staff member (coach, athletic trainer, compliance officer) who recorded this participation record. Links to the staff master record.

attributes.name: game_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific game or contest in which the student-athlete participated. Links to the game master record.

attributes.name: student_athlete_id
attributes.description: Reference to the student-athlete who participated in this game. Links to the student_athlete master record.

attributes.name: team_id
attributes.description: Reference to the team for which the student-athlete participated in this game. Links to the team master record.

attributes.name: academic_year
attributes.description: Academic year during which the game was played (e.g., 2023-2024). Used for eligibility tracking and compliance reporting.

attributes.name: aces
attributes.description: Total aces served by the student-athlete in this match. Applicable to volleyball and tennis.

attributes.name: assists
attributes.description: Total assists credited to the student-athlete in this game. Applicable to basketball, soccer, hockey, lacrosse.

attributes.name: blocks
attributes.description: Total blocks recorded by the student-athlete in this game. Applicable to volleyball and basketball.

attributes.name: competition_level
attributes.description: Level of competition for this game. Determines whether the game counts toward NCAA eligibility and season-of-competition limits.
attributes.references: NCAA Bylaw 17 - Playing and Practice Seasons

attributes.name: counts_toward_eligibility_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this game participation counts toward the student-athletes season of competition for NCAA eligibility purposes. True if counts, False otherwise.
attributes.references: NCAA Bylaw 14 - Eligibility; NCAA Bylaw 17 - Playing and Practice Seasons

attributes.name: disciplinary_action_description
attributes.description: Detailed description of any disciplinary action taken against the student-athlete during or as a result of this game.

attributes.name: disciplinary_action_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether any disciplinary action was taken against the student-athlete during or as a result of this game. True if action taken, False otherwise.

attributes.name: ejection_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the student-athlete was ejected from the game. True if ejected, False otherwise. Critical for NCAA compliance and disciplinary tracking.
attributes.references: NCAA Bylaw 12 - Amateurism; NCAA Disciplinary Standards

attributes.name: ejection_reason
attributes.description: Detailed reason for ejection if the student-athlete was ejected from the game. Includes rule violation description and referee notes.

attributes.name: fouls_committed
attributes.description: Total fouls committed by the student-athlete in this game. Applicable to basketball, soccer, and other contact sports.

attributes.name: goals_scored
attributes.description: Total goals scored by the student-athlete in this game. Applicable to soccer, hockey, lacrosse, water polo.

attributes.name: hits
attributes.description: Total hits recorded by the student-athlete in this game. Applicable to baseball and softball.

attributes.name: injury_description
attributes.description: Brief description of the injury sustained during this game. Protected health information subject to HIPAA and FERPA restrictions.

attributes.name: injury_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the student-athlete sustained an injury during this game. True if injured, False otherwise. Critical for medical tracking and eligibility.

attributes.name: innings_played
attributes.description: Number of innings the student-athlete participated in during the game. Applicable to baseball and softball.

attributes.name: jersey_number
attributes.description: Jersey number worn by the student-athlete during this game. May differ from roster jersey number in some sports.

attributes.name: kills
attributes.description: Total kills recorded by the student-athlete in this match. Applicable to volleyball.

attributes.name: medical_clearance_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether medical clearance is required before the student-athlete can participate in future games. True if clearance required, False otherwise.

attributes.name: minutes_played
attributes.description: Total minutes the student-athlete participated in the game. Applicable to sports with timed play (basketball, soccer, hockey, lacrosse).

attributes.name: participation_notes
attributes.description: Additional notes or comments regarding the student-athletes participation in this game. May include coaching observations, special circumstances, or compliance notes.

attributes.name: participation_status
attributes.description: Status indicating whether and how the student-athlete participated in the game. Critical for NCAA compliance reporting and eligibility tracking.
attributes.references: NCAA Bylaw 14 - Eligibility; NCAA Bylaw 17 - Playing and Practice Seasons

attributes.name: points_scored
attributes.description: Total points scored by the student-athlete in this game. Applicable to basketball, football (via touchdowns), track and field scoring systems.

attributes.name: position_played
attributes.description: Primary position the student-athlete played during this game. Sport-specific position codes (e.g., QB, PG, MF, P).

attributes.name: rebounds
attributes.description: Total rebounds (offensive and defensive combined) by the student-athlete in this game. Applicable to basketball.

attributes.name: record_created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this game participation record was first created in the system. Critical for audit trail and compliance verification.

attributes.name: record_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this game participation record was last updated in the system. Critical for audit trail and compliance verification.

attributes.name: red_cards
attributes.description: Number of red cards received by the student-athlete in this game. Applicable to soccer and other sports using card systems.
attributes.references: Sport-Specific Statistics Standards; NCAA Disciplinary Standards

attributes.name: runs_batted_in
attributes.description: Total runs batted in by the student-athlete in this game. Applicable to baseball and softball.

attributes.name: saves
attributes.description: Total saves made by the student-athlete in this game. Applicable to goalkeepers in soccer, hockey, lacrosse, water polo.

attributes.name: season
attributes.description: Academic season during which the game was played. Critical for NCAA eligibility clock and season-of-competition tracking.
attributes.references: NCAA Bylaw 14 - Eligibility; NCAA Bylaw 17 - Playing and Practice Seasons

attributes.name: sets_played
attributes.description: Number of sets the student-athlete participated in during the match. Applicable to volleyball and tennis.

attributes.name: starter_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the student-athlete was in the starting lineup for this game. True if starter, False if substitute or did not play.

attributes.name: strikeouts
attributes.description: Total strikeouts recorded by the student-athlete in this game. For pitchers in baseball and softball, or batters who struck out.

attributes.name: touchdowns
attributes.description: Total touchdowns scored by the student-athlete in this game. Applicable to football.

attributes.name: yards_gained
attributes.description: Total yards gained by the student-athlete in this game. Applicable to football (rushing, passing, receiving yards).

attributes.name: yellow_cards
attributes.description: Number of yellow cards received by the student-athlete in this game. Applicable to soccer and other sports using card systems.
attributes.references: Sport-Specific Statistics Standards; NCAA Disciplinary Standards

attributes.name: amended_game_participation_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing FK on game_participation (amended_game_participation_id)

products.name: practice_session
products.description: Transactional record of a scheduled team practice session, used for NCAA countable athletically related activity (CARA) hour tracking. Captures team reference, practice date, start time, end time, duration in hours, practice type (team practice/individual workout/film session/walk-through/conditioning/weight training/competition preparation), CARA countable flag, weekly CARA hour accumulation, in-season vs out-of-season designation, and coach supervisor.

attributes.name: practice_session_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the practice session record. Primary key.

attributes.name: athletic_facility_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to athletics.athletic_facility. Business justification: practice_session has facility_id but this appears to point to a generic facility table. Since practice sessions are athletics-specific and athletic_facility exists as the domain-specific facility mast

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the compliance staff member who certified this practice session record.

attributes.name: facility_id
attributes.description: Reference to the athletic facility where the practice session was conducted.

attributes.name: primary_practice_head_coach_id
attributes.description: Reference to the head coach responsible for supervising this practice session.

attributes.name: team_id
attributes.description: Reference to the team conducting this practice session.

attributes.name: academic_year
attributes.description: The academic year during which the practice session occurred, formatted as YYYY-YYYY (e.g., 2023-2024).

attributes.name: attendance_count
attributes.description: Number of student-athletes who attended this practice session.

attributes.name: cancellation_reason
attributes.description: Explanation for why the practice session was cancelled or postponed, if applicable.

attributes.name: cara_countable_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Countable Athletically Related Activity (CARA) Countable Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this practice session counts toward the weekly and seasonal NCAA CARA hour limits (20 hours per week, 8 hours per week out-of-season).

attributes.name: competition_preparation_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this practice session was specifically focused on preparing for an upcoming competition or game.

attributes.name: compliance_certification_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the practice session was certified as compliant by athletics compliance staff.

attributes.name: compliance_certified_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this practice session has been reviewed and certified as compliant with NCAA CARA hour regulations.

attributes.name: compliance_review_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this practice session requires additional compliance review due to unusual circumstances or potential rule violations.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this practice session record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: duration_hours
attributes.description: Total duration of the practice session in hours, calculated from start and end times. Used for NCAA CARA hour tracking.

attributes.name: heat_index
attributes.description: Calculated heat index during the practice session, combining temperature and humidity for heat illness risk assessment.
attributes.references: NCAA Sports Medicine Handbook - Heat Illness Prevention

attributes.name: injury_count
attributes.description: Number of injuries that occurred during this practice session.

attributes.name: injury_occurred_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether any student-athlete injury occurred during this practice session.

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this practice session record was most recently modified.

attributes.name: mandatory_attendance_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether attendance at this practice session was mandatory for all eligible team members.

attributes.name: medical_staff_present_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether athletic training or medical staff were present during the practice session for injury prevention and response.

attributes.name: opponent_scouting_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this practice session included film review or scouting of an upcoming opponent.

attributes.name: practice_date
attributes.description: The calendar date on which the practice session occurred. Principal business event timestamp for this transaction.

attributes.name: practice_end_time
attributes.description: The timestamp when the practice session concluded, used for precise CARA hour calculation.

attributes.name: practice_focus
attributes.description: Primary focus or objective of the practice session (e.g., offensive drills, defensive strategy, conditioning, scrimmage).

attributes.name: practice_intensity_level
attributes.description: Subjective assessment of the overall intensity level of the practice session.

attributes.name: practice_notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes about the practice session, including coaching observations, special circumstances, or compliance annotations.

attributes.name: practice_session_number
attributes.description: Business identifier for the practice session, typically formatted as season-team-sequence (e.g., 2024-FB-001).

attributes.name: practice_start_time
attributes.description: The timestamp when the practice session began, used for precise CARA hour calculation.

attributes.name: practice_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the practice session.

attributes.name: practice_type
attributes.description: Classification of the practice activity type. Determines whether the session counts toward NCAA CARA hour limits.

attributes.name: record_effective_date
attributes.description: The date from which this practice session record is considered effective for reporting and compliance purposes.

attributes.name: scrimmage_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this practice session included a scrimmage or simulated game situation.

attributes.name: season_designation
attributes.description: Designation of the competitive season phase during which the practice occurred. Affects CARA hour limits and compliance rules.

attributes.name: temperature_fahrenheit
attributes.description: Ambient temperature in degrees Fahrenheit during the practice session, used for heat safety monitoring.
attributes.references: NCAA Sports Medicine Handbook - Heat Illness Prevention

attributes.name: term_code
attributes.description: The academic term code during which the practice session occurred (e.g., 202401 for Spring 2024).

attributes.name: video_recorded_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether video footage of the practice session was recorded for coaching review and player development.

attributes.name: weather_condition
attributes.description: Description of weather conditions during outdoor practice sessions, relevant for safety and performance tracking.

attributes.name: weekly_cara_hours_accumulated
attributes.business_glossary_term: Weekly Countable Athletically Related Activity (CARA) Hours Accumulated
attributes.description: Running total of CARA hours accumulated for the team during the calendar week containing this practice session. Used to monitor compliance with the 20-hour weekly limit.

attributes.name: makeup_practice_session_id

attributes.description: Date when the student-athlete received medical clearance to return to full athletic participation.

attributes.name: medical_clearance_status
attributes.description: Current medical clearance status indicating whether the student-athlete is authorized to participate in athletic activities (not cleared, cleared with restrictions, fully cleared, pending evaluation).

attributes.name: medical_redshirt_applied_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a medical hardship waiver application has been submitted to the NCAA for this case (true/false).

attributes.name: medical_redshirt_eligible_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this injury qualifies the student-athlete for a medical hardship waiver (medical redshirt) under NCAA rules (true/false).

attributes.name: physician_referral_date
attributes.description: Date when the student-athlete was referred to a physician for medical evaluation or treatment.

attributes.name: physician_referral_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the student-athlete was referred to a physician for evaluation or treatment (true/false).

attributes.name: record_created_timestamp

attributes.name: record_updated_timestamp

attributes.name: reportable_injury_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this injury must be reported to the NCAA Injury Surveillance System or other regulatory bodies (true/false).

attributes.name: return_to_play_protocol
attributes.description: Structured protocol governing the student-athletes progression back to full athletic participation, including stages and criteria for advancement.

attributes.name: return_to_play_stage
attributes.description: Current stage in the return-to-play progression (initial rest, light activity, sport-specific exercise, non-contact practice, full contact practice, unrestricted participation).

attributes.name: severity_level
attributes.description: Clinical assessment of injury severity (minor, moderate, severe, catastrophic) based on expected recovery time and impact on participation.

attributes.name: treating_athletic_trainer_name

attributes.name: treating_physician_name
attributes.description: Full name of the physician who evaluated or treated the student-athlete.

attributes.name: treatment_plan

attributes.name: related_sports_medicine_case_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing FK on sports_medicine_case (related_sports_medicine_case_id)

products.name: drug_test
products.description: Transactional record of a mandatory drug or substance testing event for a student-athlete under NCAA, conference, or institutional drug testing programs. Captures student-athlete reference, sport, test date, testing program (NCAA/conference/institutional), test type (random/reasonable suspicion/post-season/pre-season), substances tested, result (negative/positive/dilute/refused), chain of custody reference, positive finding notification date, sanction imposed, and appeal status.

attributes.name: drug_test_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the drug test record. Primary key for the drug test entity.

attributes.name: primary_drug_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the institutional staff member (typically compliance officer or athletic director) who notified the student-athlete of the test result.

attributes.name: regulatory_requirement_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.regulatory_requirement. Business justification: Drug testing programs governed by specific NCAA/conference regulations and institutional policies. Real business process: testing protocols, substance lists, and sanction procedures must comply with s

attributes.name: research_irb_protocol_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to research.irb_protocol. Business justification: Links drug testing data used in IRB-approved research (epidemiological studies, substance use patterns, testing efficacy research). Required for research compliance when de-identified testing data is

attributes.name: sport_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to athletics.sport. Business justification: drug_test is conducted for student-athletes in a specific sport. Currently uses sport_code/sport_name but lacks FK to sport master table. Adding sport_id enables JOIN to retrieve sport_name and other

attributes.name: student_athlete_id
attributes.description: Reference to the student-athlete who was tested. Links to the student-athlete master record.

attributes.name: appeal_decision_date
attributes.description: The date on which a final decision was rendered on the student-athlete's appeal. Null if appeal is pending or no appeal was filed.
attributes.references: NCAA Drug Testing Program Policy; Due Process Requirements

attributes.name: appeal_filed_date
attributes.description: The date on which the student-athlete submitted a formal appeal of the test result or sanction. Null if no appeal was filed.
attributes.references: NCAA Drug Testing Program Policy; Due Process Requirements

attributes.name: appeal_filed_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the student-athlete filed a formal appeal of the positive test result or imposed sanction.
attributes.references: NCAA Drug Testing Program Policy; Due Process Requirements

attributes.name: appeal_status
attributes.description: The current status of the appeal process: pending (under review), upheld (original decision affirmed), overturned (decision reversed), withdrawn (athlete withdrew appeal), or dismissed (appeal rejected on procedural grounds). Null if no appeal was filed.
attributes.references: NCAA Drug Testing Program Policy; Due Process Requirements

attributes.name: b_sample_requested_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the student-athlete requested analysis of the B sample (confirmatory sample) following a positive A sample result, as permitted under NCAA and WADA protocols.
attributes.references: NCAA Drug Testing Program Policy; WADA International Standard for Laboratories

attributes.name: b_sample_result
attributes.description: The outcome of the B sample analysis: confirmed (positive result verified), not confirmed (positive result not verified), not requested (athlete did not request B sample analysis), or pending (analysis in progress).
attributes.references: NCAA Drug Testing Program Policy; WADA International Standard for Laboratories

attributes.name: chain_of_custody_number
attributes.description: Unique tracking number documenting the handling and transfer of the specimen from collection through analysis and storage.
attributes.references: Chain of Custody Standards; WADA International Standard for Laboratories

attributes.name: collection_site_code
attributes.description: Standardized code identifying the collection site or facility where the sample was obtained.

attributes.name: concentration_level
attributes.description: The measured concentration or quantity of the detected substance in the specimen, typically expressed in ng/mL or other laboratory units. Applicable for positive results.

attributes.name: games_missed
attributes.description: The number of contests or competitions the student-athlete was ineligible to participate in due to the drug test sanction.

attributes.name: laboratory_accreditation_number
attributes.description: Accreditation identifier for the testing laboratory, confirming compliance with WADA or NCAA standards.
attributes.references: WADA International Standard for Laboratories; NCAA Drug Testing Program Policy

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional context, special circumstances, or administrative notes related to the drug test event, result, or sanction process.

attributes.name: notification_date
attributes.description: The date on which the student-athlete was officially notified of a positive test result or other adverse finding.
attributes.references: NCAA Drug Testing Program Policy; FERPA; Due Process Requirements

attributes.name: notification_method
attributes.description: The method by which the student-athlete was notified of the test result (in-person, phone, email, certified mail, or other).
attributes.references: NCAA Drug Testing Program Policy; Due Process Requirements

attributes.name: positive_substance_name
attributes.description: The specific banned substance or metabolite detected in a positive test result. Null if test result is negative.
attributes.references: NCAA Banned Substances List; WADA Prohibited List

attributes.name: record_created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this drug test record was first created in the system.
attributes.references: Data Governance Standards; Audit Trail Requirements

attributes.name: record_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this drug test record was last modified in the system.
attributes.references: Data Governance Standards; Audit Trail Requirements

attributes.name: result_reported_date
attributes.description: The date on which the laboratory reported the test results to the institution or governing body.

attributes.name: sanction_imposed
attributes.description: Description of the penalty or sanction imposed on the student-athlete as a result of a positive test (e.g., suspension from competition, loss of eligibility, mandatory counseling, withholding of financial aid). Null if no sanction was imposed.
attributes.references: NCAA Drug Testing Program Policy; Institutional Athletic Policy

attributes.name: specimen_code
attributes.description: Unique identifier assigned to the biological specimen for chain of custody tracking and laboratory processing.
attributes.references: Chain of Custody Standards; Laboratory Accreditation Standards

attributes.name: specimen_type
attributes.description: The type of biological specimen collected for testing (urine, blood, saliva, or hair).

attributes.name: substance_class
attributes.description: The category or class of the detected substance (e.g., stimulant, anabolic agent, cannabinoid, narcotic, diuretic, masking agent). Applicable for positive results.
attributes.references: NCAA Banned Substances List; WADA Prohibited List

attributes.name: substances_tested
attributes.description: List or description of the substance classes or specific substances included in the testing panel (e.g., stimulants, anabolic agents, cannabinoids, narcotics, diuretics, masking agents).
attributes.references: NCAA Banned Substances List; WADA Prohibited List

attributes.name: suspension_end_date
attributes.description: The date on which a suspension or eligibility withholding sanction ends, allowing the student-athlete to return to competition. Applicable if a suspension was imposed.

attributes.name: suspension_start_date
attributes.description: The date on which a suspension or eligibility withholding sanction begins. Applicable if a suspension was imposed.

attributes.name: test_date
attributes.description: The date on which the drug test sample was collected from the student-athlete.

attributes.name: test_location
attributes.description: The physical location or facility where the drug test sample was collected.

attributes.name: test_result
attributes.description: The outcome of the drug test: negative (no banned substances detected), positive (banned substance detected), dilute (sample concentration too low), invalid (sample compromised), refused (athlete declined to provide sample), or pending (results not yet available).
attributes.references: NCAA Drug Testing Program Policy; FERPA; HIPAA

attributes.name: test_time
attributes.description: The precise timestamp when the drug test sample was collected, including time zone information.
attributes.references: NCAA Drug Testing Program Policy; Chain of Custody Standards

attributes.name: test_type
attributes.description: The category of drug test administered: random selection, reasonable suspicion, championship event, post-season, pre-season, or follow-up testing.

attributes.name: testing_laboratory_name
attributes.description: Name of the certified laboratory that performed the drug test analysis.
attributes.references: NCAA Drug Testing Program Policy; WADA Laboratory Accreditation

attributes.name: testing_program
attributes.description: The governing body or program under which the drug test was administered (NCAA, conference, institutional, NAIA, or other).
attributes.references: NCAA Drug Testing Program Policy; NAIA Drug Testing Policy

attributes.name: therapeutic_use_exemption_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the student-athlete has an approved Therapeutic Use Exemption for the detected substance, which may mitigate or nullify a positive result.
attributes.references: NCAA Medical Exceptions Policy; WADA International Standard for Therapeutic Use Exemptions

attributes.name: threshold_exceeded_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the detected substance concentration exceeded the NCAA or WADA reporting threshold, triggering a positive result.
attributes.references: NCAA Drug Testing Program Policy; WADA Technical Document on Decision Limits

attributes.name: tue_approval_date
attributes.description: The date on which the Therapeutic Use Exemption was approved by the NCAA or institutional medical authority. Null if no TUE applies.
attributes.references: NCAA Medical Exceptions Policy; WADA International Standard for Therapeutic Use Exemptions

CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW `education_ecm`.`_metrics`.`advancement_advanced_degree`
WITH METRICS
LANGUAGE YAML
AS $$
  version: 1.1
  comment: "Advanced Degree business metrics"
  source: "`education_ecm`.`advancement`.`advanced_degree`"
  dimensions:
    - name: "Awarding Institution City"
      expr: awarding_institution_city
    - name: "Awarding Institution Country"
      expr: awarding_institution_country
    - name: "Awarding Institution Ipeds Code"
      expr: awarding_institution_ipeds_code
    - name: "Awarding Institution Name"
      expr: awarding_institution_name
    - name: "Awarding Institution State"
      expr: awarding_institution_state
    - name: "Awarding Institution Type"
      expr: awarding_institution_type
    - name: "Career Relevance Flag"
      expr: career_relevance_flag
    - name: "Concentration Specialization"
      expr: concentration_specialization
    - name: "Created Timestamp"
      expr: created_timestamp
    - name: "Data Source"
      expr: data_source
    - name: "Degree Level"
      expr: degree_level
    - name: "Degree Record Number"
      expr: degree_record_number
    - name: "Degree Status"
      expr: degree_status
    - name: "Degree Title"
      expr: degree_title
    - name: "Degree Type"
      expr: degree_type
    - name: "Enrollment Start Year"
      expr: enrollment_start_year
  measures:
    - name: "Row Count"
      expr: COUNT(1)
    - name: "Distinct Advanced Degree"
      expr: COUNT(DISTINCT advanced_degree_id)
$$

CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW `education_ecm`.`_metrics`.`advancement_advancement_application_access`
WITH METRICS
LANGUAGE YAML
AS $$
  version: 1.1
  comment: "Advancement Application Access business metrics"
  source: "`education_ecm`.`advancement`.`advancement_application_access`"
  dimensions:
    - name: "Access Granted Date"
      expr: access_granted_date
    - name: "Access Level"
      expr: access_level
    - name: "Access Revoked Date"
      expr: access_revoked_date
    - name: "Access Status"
      expr: access_status
    - name: "Cost Allocation Code"
      expr: cost_allocation_code
    - name: "Last Login Timestamp"
      expr: last_login_timestamp
    - name: "License Type"
      expr: license_type
    - name: "Usage Frequency"
      expr: usage_frequency
    - name: "Access Granted Date Month"
      expr: DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', access_granted_date)
    - name: "Access Revoked Date Month"
      expr: DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', access_revoked_date)
  measures:
    - name: "Row Count"
      expr: COUNT(1)
    - name: "Distinct Advancement Application Access"
      expr: COUNT(DISTINCT advancement_application_access_id)
$$

CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW `education_ecm`.`_metrics`.`advancement_advancement_assignment`
WITH METRICS
LANGUAGE YAML
AS $$
  version: 1.1
  comment: "Advancement Assignment business metrics"
  source: "`education_ecm`.`advancement`.`advancement_assignment`"
  dimensions:
    - name: "Application Date"
      expr: application_date
    - name: "Approval Date"

    - name: "financial_aid_impact_flag"
      expr: financial_aid_impact_flag
      comment: "Whether transaction impacts financial aid eligibility"
    - name: "r2t4_required_flag"
      expr: r2t4_required_flag
      comment: "Whether Return of Title IV funds calculation is required"
    - name: "sap_impact_flag"
      expr: sap_impact_flag
      comment: "Whether transaction impacts Satisfactory Academic Progress"
    - name: "override_flag"
      expr: override_flag
      comment: "Whether an override was used for this transaction"
    - name: "dfw_flag"
      expr: dfw_flag
      comment: "Whether this is a D/F/W (drop/fail/withdraw) transaction"
  measures:
    - name: "total_transactions"
      expr: COUNT(1)
      comment: "Total number of add/drop transactions"
    - name: "unique_students"
      expr: COUNT(DISTINCT profile_id)
      comment: "Distinct count of students with add/drop activity"
    - name: "unique_courses_affected"
      expr: COUNT(DISTINCT course_section_id)
      comment: "Distinct count of course sections affected by transactions"
    - name: "total_credit_hours_added"
      expr: SUM(CAST(CASE WHEN transaction_type = 'add' THEN credit_hours_after ELSE 0 END AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Sum of credit hours added through add transactions"
    - name: "total_credit_hours_dropped"
      expr: SUM(CAST(CASE WHEN transaction_type IN ('drop', 'withdraw') THEN credit_hours_before ELSE 0 END AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Sum of credit hours dropped through drop/withdraw transactions"
    - name: "total_fte_change"
      expr: SUM((CAST(fte_after AS DOUBLE)) - (CAST(fte_before AS DOUBLE)))
      comment: "Net change in FTE from all transactions"
    - name: "total_tuition_adjustments"
      expr: SUM(CAST(tuition_adjustment_amount AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Sum of tuition adjustment amounts from all transactions"
    - name: "avg_refund_percentage"
      expr: AVG(CAST(refund_percentage AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average refund percentage across transactions"
    - name: "complete_withdrawals"
      expr: COUNT(CASE WHEN is_complete_withdrawal = TRUE THEN 1 END)
      comment: "Count of complete term withdrawals"
    - name: "late_withdrawals"
      expr: COUNT(CASE WHEN is_after_withdraw_deadline = TRUE THEN 1 END)
      comment: "Count of withdrawals after the deadline"
    - name: "transactions_with_financial_aid_impact"
      expr: COUNT(CASE WHEN financial_aid_impact_flag = TRUE THEN 1 END)
      comment: "Count of transactions impacting financial aid"
    - name: "transactions_requiring_r2t4"
      expr: COUNT(CASE WHEN r2t4_required_flag = TRUE THEN 1 END)
      comment: "Count of transactions requiring Return of Title IV calculation"
    - name: "transactions_with_sap_impact"
      expr: COUNT(CASE WHEN sap_impact_flag = TRUE THEN 1 END)
      comment: "Count of transactions impacting Satisfactory Academic Progress"
    - name: "transactions_with_override"
      expr: COUNT(CASE WHEN override_flag = TRUE THEN 1 END)
      comment: "Count of transactions requiring an override"
    - name: "dfw_transactions"
      expr: COUNT(CASE WHEN dfw_flag = TRUE THEN 1 END)
      comment: "Count of D/F/W (drop/fail/withdraw) transactions"
$$
metric_views.description: Course add/drop activity metrics tracking registration changes, credit hour adjustments, financial impacts, and withdrawal patterns.

CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW `education_ecm`.`_metrics`.`facility_building`
WITH METRICS
LANGUAGE YAML
AS $$
  version: 1.1
  comment: "Strategic building performance metrics including space efficiency, financial performance, and facility condition for capital planning and operational optimization decisions"
  source: "`education_ecm`.`facility`.`building`"
  dimensions:
    - name: "building_code"
      expr: building_code
      comment: "Unique building identifier code"
    - name: "building_name"
      expr: building_name
      comment: "Building name for reporting"
    - name: "building_type"
      expr: building_type
      comment: "Building classification (academic, administrative, residential, research, etc.)"
    - name: "campus_id"
      expr: campus_id
      comment: "Campus location identifier"
    - name: "operational_status"
      expr: operational_status
      comment: "Current operational status (active, inactive, under renovation, etc.)"
    - name: "ownership_status"
      expr: ownership_status
      comment: "Ownership classification (owned, leased, etc.)"
    - name: "leed_certification_level"
      expr: leed_certification_level
      comment: "LEED sustainability certification level"
    - name: "ada_compliant"
      expr: ada_compliant
      comment: "ADA compliance status flag"
    - name: "construction_decade"
      expr: CONCAT(SUBSTRING(construction_year, 1, 3), '0s')
      comment: "Decade of original construction for age cohort analysis"
    - name: "energy_star_tier"
      expr: CASE WHEN CAST(energy_star_score AS INT) >= 75 THEN 'High Performer' WHEN CAST(energy_star_score AS INT) >= 50 THEN 'Average' WHEN energy_star_score IS NOT NULL THEN 'Below Average' ELSE 'Not Rated' END
      comment: "Energy Star performance tier for sustainability reporting"
  measures:
    - name: "total_buildings"
      expr: COUNT(DISTINCT building_id)
      comment: "Total count of distinct buildings for portfolio size tracking"
    - name: "total_gross_square_feet"
      expr: SUM(CAST(gross_square_feet AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total gross square footage across buildings for space inventory"
    - name: "total_assignable_square_feet"
      expr: SUM(CAST(assignable_square_feet AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total assignable square footage for utilization planning"
    - name: "avg_space_utilization_rate"
      expr: AVG(CAST(space_utilization_rate AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average space utilization rate for efficiency assessment"
    - name: "total_replacement_value"
      expr: SUM(CAST(replacement_value AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total replacement value of building portfolio for insurance and capital planning"
    - name: "total_annual_operating_cost"
      expr: SUM(CAST(annual_operating_cost AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total annual operating costs for budget planning and cost management"
    - name: "total_deferred_maintenance_backlog"
      expr: SUM(CAST(deferred_maintenance_backlog AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total deferred maintenance backlog for capital prioritization and risk assessment"
    - name: "avg_facility_condition_index"
      expr: AVG(CAST(facility_condition_index AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average facility condition index (FCI) for portfolio health assessment; lower is better"
    - name: "operating_cost_per_gsf"
      expr: ROUND(SUM(CAST(annual_operating_cost AS DOUBLE)) / NULLIF(SUM(CAST(gross_square_feet AS DOUBLE)), 0), 2)
      comment: "Operating cost per gross square foot for cost efficiency benchmarking"
    - name: "assignable_to_gross_ratio"
      expr: ROUND(SUM(CAST(assignable_square_feet AS DOUBLE)) / NULLIF(SUM(CAST(gross_square_feet AS DOUBLE)), 0), 3)
      comment: "Assignable to gross square footage ratio for space efficiency analysis"
    - name: "deferred_maintenance_per_gsf"
      expr: ROUND(SUM(CAST(deferred_maintenance_backlog AS DOUBLE)) / NULLIF(SUM(CAST(gross_square_feet AS DOUBLE)), 0), 2)
      comment: "Deferred maintenance per gross square foot for capital needs assessment"
$$
metric_views.description: Strategic building performance metrics including space efficiency, financial performance, and facility condition for capital planning and operational optimization decisions

CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW `education_ecm`.`_metrics`.`facility_work_order`
WITH METRICS
LANGUAGE YAML
AS $$
  version: 1.1
  comment: "Work order operational performance metrics for maintenance efficiency, cost control, and service quality decisions"
  source: "`education_ecm`.`facility`.`work_order`"
  dimensions:
    - name: "work_order_number"
      expr: work_order_number
      comment: "Unique work order identifier"
    - name: "work_order_type"
      expr: work_order_type
      comment: "Work order classification (corrective, preventive, emergency, project, etc.)"
    - name: "work_order_status"
      expr: work_order_status
      comment: "Current work order status (open, in progress, completed, closed, etc.)"
    - name: "priority_level"
      expr: priority_level
      comment: "Work order priority level for resource allocation"
    - name: "trade_category"
      expr: trade_category
      comment: "Trade skill category (electrical, plumbing, HVAC, etc.)"
    - name: "building_id"
      expr: building_id
      comment: "Building location identifier"
    - name: "assigned_crew_id"
      expr: assigned_crew_id
      comment: "Assigned crew identifier"
    - name: "request_month"
      expr: DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', request_date)
      comment: "Month of work order request for trend analysis"
    - name: "completion_month"
      expr: DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', actual_completion_date)
      comment: "Month of work order completion for productivity tracking"
    - name: "ada_compliance_flag"
      expr: ada_compliance_flag
      comment: "ADA compliance related work order flag"
    - name: "safety_incident_flag"
      expr: safety_incident_flag
      comment: "Safety incident related work order flag"
  measures:
    - name: "total_work_orders"
      expr: COUNT(DISTINCT work_order_id)
      comment: "Total count of work orders for workload tracking"
    - name: "total_work_order_cost"
      expr: SUM(CAST(total_cost AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total work order cost for maintenance budget tracking"
    - name: "total_labor_cost"
      expr: SUM(CAST(labor_cost AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total labor cost for workforce cost analysis"
    - name: "total_materials_cost"
      expr: SUM(CAST(materials_cost AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total materials cost for supply chain management"
    - name: "total_contractor_cost"
      expr: SUM(CAST(contractor_cost AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total contractor cost for outsourcing analysis"
    - name: "total_labor_hours"
      expr: SUM(CAST(actual_labor_hours AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total actual labor hours for workforce capacity planning"
    - name: "total_downtime_hours"
      expr: SUM(CAST(downtime_hours AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total downtime hours for service disruption impact assessment"
    - name: "avg_labor_hours_per_wo"
      expr: AVG(CAST(actual_labor_hours AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average labor hours per work order for productivity benchmarking"
    - name: "avg_cost_per_work_order"
      expr: AVG(CAST(total_cost AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average cost per work order for cost efficiency tracking"
    - name: "labor_cost_percentage"
      expr: ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CAST(labor_cost AS DOUBLE)) / NULLIF(SUM(CAST(total_cost AS DOUBLE)), 0), 2)
      comment: "Labor cost as percentage of total work order cost for cost structure analysis"
    - name: "contractor_cost_percentage"
      expr: ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CAST(contractor_cost AS DOUBLE)) / NULLIF(SUM(CAST(total_cost AS DOUBLE)), 0), 2)
      comment: "Contractor cost as percentage of total work order cost for insourcing vs outsourcing decisions"
    - name: "avg_labor_rate"
      expr: ROUND(SUM(CAST(labor_cost AS DOUBLE)) / NULLIF(SUM(CAST(actual_labor_hours AS DOUBLE)), 0), 2)
      comment: "Average labor rate per hour for workforce cost benchmarking"
$$
metric_views.description: Work order operational performance metrics for maintenance efficiency, cost control, and service quality decisions

CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW `education_ecm`.`_metrics`.`library_acquisition_order`
WITH METRICS
LANGUAGE YAML
AS $$
  version: 1.1
  comment: "Collection development and acquisition spend metrics tracking order fulfillment, vendor performance, and budget utilization"
  source: "`education_ecm`.`library`.`acquisition_order`"
  dimensions:
    - name: "order_status"
      expr: order_status
      comment: "Current status of the acquisition order (pending, approved, ordered, received, cancelled)"
    - name: "order_type"
      expr: order_type
      comment: "Type of order (firm, approval, standing, gift)"
    - name: "material_type"
      expr: material_type
      comment: "Type of material being acquired (book, journal, media, database)"
    - name: "collection_code"
      expr: collection_code
      comment: "Collection the material is being acquired for"
    - name: "invoice_status"
      expr: invoice_status
      comment: "Status of invoice processing (pending, approved, paid, disputed)"
    - name: "receiving_status"
      expr: receiving_status
      comment: "Status of physical receipt (not received, partially received, fully received)"
    - name: "rush_order_flag"
      expr: rush_order_flag
      comment: "Whether this is a rush order requiring expedited processing"
    - name: "order_month"
      expr: DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', order_date)
      comment: "Month when order was placed"
    - name: "currency_code"
      expr: currency_code
      comment: "Currency used for the order"
  measures:
    - name: "total_orders"
      expr: COUNT(1)
      comment: "Total number of acquisition orders"
    - name: "total_list_price"
      expr: SUM(CAST(list_price AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total list price of all ordered materials"
    - name: "total_net_price"
      expr: SUM(CAST(net_price AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total net price after discounts"
    - name: "total_discount_amount"
      expr: SUM(CAST(discount_amount AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total discount amount negotiated with vendors"
    - name: "total_shipping_cost"
      expr: SUM(CAST(shipping_cost AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total shipping and handling costs"
    - name: "total_tax_amount"
      expr: SUM(CAST(tax_amount AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total tax amount on orders"
    - name: "total_amount"
      expr: SUM(CAST(total_amount AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total acquisition spend including all costs"
    - name: "avg_discount_pct"
      expr: AVG(CAST(discount_percentage AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average discount percentage negotiated across orders"
    - name: "effective_discount_rate_pct"
      expr: ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CAST(discount_amount AS DOUBLE)) / NULLIF(SUM(CAST(list_price AS DOUBLE)), 0), 2)
      comment: "Actual discount rate achieved as percentage of list price"
    - name: "avg_order_value"
      expr: AVG(CAST(total_amount AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average total value per acquisition order"
    - name: "rush_order_rate_pct"
      expr: ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(CASE WHEN rush_order_flag = TRUE THEN 1 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(1), 0), 2)
      comment: "Percentage of orders requiring rush processing"
    - name: "unique_vendors"
      expr: COUNT(DISTINCT library_vendor_id)
      comment: "Number of unique vendors used for acquisitions"
$$
metric_views.description: Collection development and acquisition spend metrics tracking order fulfillment, vendor performance, and budget utilization

      expr: SUM(CAST(transaction_amount AS DOUBLE))

    - name: "total_idc_recovered"

      comment: "Total indirect costs recovered"
    - name: "total_encumbrances"

    - name: "referral_source"

      comment: "Source of referral to the wellness program"

    - name: "avg_post_assessment_score"
      expr: AVG(CAST(post_assessment_score AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average post-assessment score across wellness programs"
    - name: "avg_assessment_improvement"
      expr: AVG(CAST(assessment_improvement_score AS DOUBLE))

    - name: "sla_compliance_rate"
      expr: ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN sla_breach_flag = FALSE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(1), 0), 2)
      comment: "Percentage of requests meeting SLA - key service quality metric"
    - name: "escalated_request_count"
      expr: SUM(CASE WHEN escalated_flag = TRUE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
      comment: "Count of escalated requests - first-level resolution effectiveness indicator"
    - name: "avg_customer_satisfaction_score"
      expr: AVG(CAST(customer_satisfaction_score AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average customer satisfaction score - service quality metric"
$$
metric_views.description: IT service request KPIs tracking fulfillment efficiency, customer satisfaction, and service desk performance

CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW `education_ecm`.`_metrics`.`technology_software_license`
WITH METRICS
LANGUAGE YAML
AS $$
  version: 1.1
  comment: "Software license optimization KPIs tracking utilization, compliance, and cost efficiency for license management"
  source: "`education_ecm`.`technology`.`software_license`"
  dimensions:
    - name: "license_status"
      expr: license_status
      comment: "Current status of the software license"
    - name: "license_type"
      expr: license_type
      comment: "Type of software license (perpetual, subscription, etc.)"
    - name: "compliance_status"
      expr: compliance_status
      comment: "License compliance status"
    - name: "software_category"
      expr: software_category
      comment: "Category of software for portfolio analysis"
    - name: "auto_renewal_flag"
      expr: auto_renewal_flag
      comment: "Whether license auto-renews"
    - name: "is_open_source"
      expr: is_open_source
      comment: "Whether this is open source software"
    - name: "usage_tracking_enabled"
      expr: usage_tracking_enabled
      comment: "Whether usage tracking is enabled"
    - name: "expiration_quarter"
      expr: DATE_TRUNC('QUARTER', license_expiration_date)
      comment: "Quarter when license expires for renewal planning"
  measures:
    - name: "total_licenses"
      expr: COUNT(1)
      comment: "Total number of software licenses"
    - name: "total_annual_cost"
      expr: SUM(CAST(annual_cost AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total annual software license cost - recurring spend metric"
    - name: "total_contract_value"
      expr: SUM(CAST(total_contract_value AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total contract value of all licenses"
    - name: "avg_annual_cost"
      expr: AVG(CAST(annual_cost AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average annual cost per license"
    - name: "non_compliant_license_count"
      expr: SUM(CASE WHEN compliance_status = 'Non-Compliant' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
      comment: "Count of non-compliant licenses - audit risk indicator"
    - name: "compliance_rate"
      expr: ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN compliance_status = 'Compliant' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(1), 0), 2)
      comment: "Percentage of licenses in compliance - key audit metric"
    - name: "active_license_count"
      expr: SUM(CASE WHEN license_status = 'Active' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
      comment: "Count of active licenses"
    - name: "open_source_license_count"
      expr: SUM(CASE WHEN is_open_source = TRUE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
      comment: "Count of open source licenses for portfolio mix analysis"
$$
metric_views.description: Software license optimization KPIs tracking utilization, compliance, and cost efficiency for license management

CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW `education_ecm`.`_metrics`.`technology_vulnerability`
WITH METRICS
LANGUAGE YAML
AS $$
  version: 1.1
  comment: "Vulnerability management KPIs tracking remediation effectiveness, risk exposure, and security posture across IT assets"
  source: "`education_ecm`.`technology`.`vulnerability`"
  dimensions:
    - name: "severity_level"
      expr: severity_level
      comment: "Severity level of the vulnerability"
    - name: "remediation_status"
      expr: remediation_status
      comment: "Current remediation status"
    - name: "business_criticality"
      expr: business_criticality
      comment: "Business criticality of affected system"
    - name: "network_exposure"
      expr: network_exposure
      comment: "Network exposure level of the vulnerability"
    - name: "data_classification_exposure"
      expr: data_classification_exposure
      comment: "Data classification level exposed by vulnerability"
    - name: "verification_status"
      expr: verification_status
      comment: "Verification status of remediation"
    - name: "discovery_source"
      expr: discovery_source
      comment: "Source that discovered the vulnerability"
    - name: "discovery_month"
      expr: DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', discovery_date)
      comment: "Month when vulnerability was discovered"
  measures:
    - name: "total_vulnerabilities"
      expr: COUNT(1)
      comment: "Total number of vulnerabilities"
    - name: "critical_vulnerability_count"
      expr: SUM(CASE WHEN severity_level = 'Critical' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
      comment: "Count of critical vulnerabilities requiring immediate action"
    - name: "high_severity_vulnerability_count"
      expr: SUM(CASE WHEN severity_level = 'High' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
      comment: "Count of high severity vulnerabilities"
    - name: "avg_cvss_score"
      expr: AVG(CAST(cvss_base_score AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average CVSS base score - overall risk exposure metric"
    - name: "remediated_vulnerability_count"
      expr: SUM(CASE WHEN remediation_status = 'Remediated' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
      comment: "Count of remediated vulnerabilities"
    - name: "remediation_rate"
      expr: ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN remediation_status = 'Remediated' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(1), 0), 2)
      comment: "Percentage of vulnerabilities remediated - key security effectiveness metric"
    - name: "open_vulnerability_count"
      expr: SUM(CASE WHEN remediation_status = 'Open' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
      comment: "Count of open vulnerabilities - current risk exposure"
    - name: "high_criticality_exposure_count"
      expr: SUM(CASE WHEN business_criticality = 'High' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
      comment: "Count of vulnerabilities on high-criticality systems - business risk indicator"
$$
metric_views.description: Vulnerability management KPIs tracking remediation effectiveness, risk exposure, and security posture across IT assets
